Its stack spans the GENE vision-language-action foundation model (GENE-26.5), the Eno general-purpose robot, and Genesis World, a multi-physics simulation platform that generates synthetic training data and is developed in the open as the `genesis-world` Python package. The company is pre-product with customer deployments targeted for the end of 2026; its primary public developer surface today is the open-source Genesis simulation stack on PyPI, GitHub, and Read the Docs rather than a hosted web API.

providers.name: Halo Health (Symplr)
providers.description: Halo Health, now part of symplr and marketed as symplr Clinical Communications, is a HIPAA-compliant clinical communication and collaboration platform for healthcare organizations. It provides role-based secure messaging, voice communication, critical alert and clinical-alarm notification, and on-call schedule management so care teams can coordinate around patients. The platform integrates with hospital EHR and clinical systems using healthcare interoperability standards - HL7 ADT for patient admit/discharge/transfer events, HL7 ORU for laboratory and radiology results, and SMTP for alerts such as sepsis notifications - rather than through a documented public developer REST API. symplr acquired Halo Health to extend its healthcare operations software portfolio, and the product now sits alongside symplr's broader workforce, compliance, and provider-data solutions.

providers.name: HAMAMA
providers.description: Hamama is a West Sacramento, California consumer-products company that makes it easy to grow fresh microgreens at home. Founded by two MIT-trained mechanical engineers, Hamama sells self-watering microgreen grow kits and its signature pre-seeded "Seed Quilts" (non-GMO, mostly Certified Organic) that sprout edible greens in 7-10 days with nothing more than a single addition of water, no soil, pesticides, or fertilizer required. The company sells grow kits, ceramic trays, Seed Quilt refills, green-onion and mushroom kits, and accessories directly to consumers through its Shopify storefront, offers flexible subscribe-and-save refill plans, and supports growers with Growing Guides, recipes, a rewards program, and a Grow Coach customer-support team.

providers.name: Hello Heart
providers.description: Hello Heart is a digital health company that combines a mobile app, connected blood-pressure monitors, a smart pill box, and the Nia AI assistant (trained on ACC/AHA guidelines) to help people proactively manage cardiovascular health. Sold primarily to employers, health plans, unions, and public-sector benefits programs as a covered heart-health benefit, the platform pairs self-monitoring with clinically-grounded, "safe AI" coaching to lower blood pressure and reduce cardiac risk. Hello Heart is HITRUST CSF certified, SOC 2 Type 2 audited, NIST CSF aligned, and HIPAA compliant, with data encrypted in transit and at rest and stored within U.S. borders. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public identity, security, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Imagen
providers.description: Imagen (Imagen Technologies) is an AI-enabled, sub-specialized diagnostic imaging partner for independent practices, hospitals, and health systems. It combines in-clinic imaging equipment, FDA-cleared AI algorithms, and a 24/7 teleradiology network of fellowship-trained, board-certified specialists to deliver rapid, accurate radiology interpretations, plus advanced analytics for care-gap identification. Imagen operates across 23 states, serving roughly 3.5 million patients, and is backed by GV and Threshold Ventures. The company publishes a security program covering SOC 2 Type II, the HITRUST CSF, and HIPAA. Imagen Technologies exposes no public developer API surface at this time. (Note the distinct namesake company Imagen AI, imagen-ai.com, an AI photo-editing product that does publish an API and SDK.)

providers.name: Kapwing
providers.description: Kapwing is a browser-based, AI-powered video creation platform used by more than 30 million creators and creative teams to generate, edit, caption, translate, dub, and repurpose video from a single prompt. Core tools include a drag-and-drop video and audio editor, subtitle and transcription generation, text-to-speech and dubbing in 40+ languages, a prompt-to-video generator, smart cut and clean audio, B-roll generation, and a repurpose studio for turning long videos into social clips. Kapwing (San Francisco, CA) is backed by CRV. It does not publish a public REST API; its developer surface is the official Kapwing Plugin API (the @kapwing/plugin-helpers npm package), which lets whitelisted plugins add media to the Kapwing editor canvas.

providers.name: Karak
providers.description: Karak — now operating as OpenGDP — is a blockchain infrastructure project incubated by Andalusia Labs and backed by Pantera Capital. Originally a universal restaking protocol (K2 / v1 + v2 staking), it has rebranded to OpenGDP, positioned as a global base layer for programmable GDP: an EVM-compatible execution layer unifying stablecoin settlement, real-world asset tokenization, and autonomous economic workflow orchestration for enterprises, institutions, and governments. The stack spans the OpenGDP Network (base execution layer with adaptive multi-proposers, automatic fee swaps, dedicated blockspace, native orderbook, private transactions, and stablecoin gas), the OpenGDP Network Stack (ONS) for launching bespoke economic networks, and a platform layer for moving value, programming assets, and orchestrating GDP. It exposes on-chain/EVM infrastructure (precompiles, validators, the K2 bridge) rather than a hosted REST API; developer resources are published at docs.opengdp.network.

providers.name: Lemonaide
providers.description: Lemonaide is a Bangkok-headquartered B2B used-car and insurtech platform operating across Southeast Asia, positioning itself as a technology and services layer that reduces asymmetric information in the automotive market. The company sells software to used-car dealerships and insurers, including a Dealer Management System, a Dealer CRM with microtargeting, and a Digital Escrow settlement product, alongside operated services such as after-sales BPO, warranty third-party administration, 24-hour digital roadside assistance, vehicle inspection, and repair-workshop audit assessment. Lemonaide states that more than 2,000 dealers use its platform and names Carro, Carsome, and Toyota Sure among its partners. It is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Lemonaide publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Mantle
providers.description: Mantle is an AI-powered data platform for alternative assets management, positioning itself as "alternative assets data, structured for the agentic era." It offers two products: Mantle Equity, a cap table management platform for founders and CFOs covering fundraising, SAFEs, stock options, 409A valuations, and QSBS attestation; and Mantle Portal, a portfolio management and insights product for institutional investors such as endowments and family offices. Mantle converts fragmented documents into structured, trustworthy data and layers AI workflows on top. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant and is backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API or API documentation was found; the product is delivered as a hosted SaaS application with an end-user help center.

providers.name: MoreMarkets
providers.description: MoreMarkets is a self-custodial, cross-chain DeFi yield platform that lets holders of assets like XRP and DOGE earn institutional-grade yield without giving up custody of their funds. It uses Multi-Party Computation (MPC) key management and NEAR chain signatures to lock native assets in onchain vaults (a BoringVault-based architecture with tellers, managers, and principal/receipt/positional tokens) and deploy equivalent tokens across chains into DeFi lending and yield strategies, bridged via Wormhole and the Omni Bridge. In July 2025 it launched the XRP Earn Account and later partnered with Flare for additional XRP yield strategies. Backed by Electric Capital.

providers.name: Nuvolo
providers.description: Nuvolo is a modern Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) and Enterprise Asset Management provider that delivers its Connected Workplace suite natively on the ServiceNow platform. It unifies facilities and space management, real estate and lease administration, capital planning and projects, maintenance and work management, healthcare technology management (HTM), GxP and life-sciences asset management, refrigeration management, sustainability and energy, and OT security into a single cloud platform. Nuvolo serves healthcare, life sciences, public sector, retail, and education organizations, helping them manage the full lifecycle of their assets, spaces, and facilities with mobile access and real-time reporting. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Pigeonly
providers.description: Pigeonly is an inmate-communication service that helps families and friends stay connected with incarcerated loved ones across more than 4,000 correctional facilities in the United States. Through its website and mobile apps, users can send photos, letters, postcards, greeting cards, and printed articles, and set up more affordable prison phone calls, all in a few clicks. Backed by 500 Global, Pigeonly is a consumer-facing platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, developer documentation, OAuth surface, or machine-readable specifications, so this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Plan A
providers.description: Plan A is a Berlin-based sustainability technology company providing certified carbon accounting and ESG management software that helps businesses measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. The platform is built on GHG Protocol standards, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and offers AI-enhanced emissions intelligence, supplier engagement, decarbonisation planning, and regulatory reporting (CSRD/ESRS). Plan A operates enterprise data integrations via custom APIs but does not publish a public developer platform, OpenAPI specification, or API reference. Backed by HV Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners; surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with verified public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Plume Health
providers.description: Plume Health (Plume) is a telehealth company delivering gender-affirming care to transgender and gender non-conforming people across the United States. Through a mobile app and licensed clinicians, Plume provides gender-affirming hormone therapy (estrogen and testosterone), mental health support, medical letters for surgery and identification changes, and everyday clinical care, all on a monthly membership subscription. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, Plume operates as a HIPAA-covered, LegitScript-certified consumer healthcare provider. It is a consumer-facing care service and does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Qualifyze
providers.description: Qualifyze is a supplier risk management and audit platform for the life sciences and pharmaceutical industries. It helps quality, procurement, and compliance teams qualify suppliers faster, run and manage GxP audits globally, and monitor supplier risk continuously. Its Audit Management Platform streamlines audit execution, CAPA management, and real-time visibility with access to a shared library of 5,000+ audit reports, while its Quality Insights Platform layers AI-driven predictive risk monitoring on top of the supply chain. Qualifyze is a delivered SaaS product for enterprise life-sciences customers; it exposes no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time. The company publishes ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 compliance posture.

providers.name: Queen Mary University of London
providers.description: Queen Mary University of London (QMUL) is a public research university in London, United Kingdom, and a member of the Russell Group, ranked #120 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public, machine-accessible footprint is research- and library-oriented rather than a formal developer program: Queen Mary Research Online (QMRO) is an open-access DSpace institutional repository that exposes a standards-based OAI-PMH metadata-harvesting interface, and the university maintains a public GitHub organization (QMUL) for code released by its staff. QMUL does not publish a central, branded developer portal with signup-gated REST APIs; core student, timetable, and library platforms (QMplus/Moodle, MyQMUL, library discovery) sit behind institutional authentication.

providers.name: QUIBIM
providers.description: QUIBIM is a healthcare AI company that unlocks medical imaging data to improve patient outcomes through quantitative imaging biomarkers and radiomics. Its cloud-based, tissue-agnostic platform ingests, harmonizes, and analyzes imaging data (MRI, CT, PET) to extract automated radiomics and deep-learning imaging biomarkers that support clinical decision-making and biopharma drug development. Regulated clinical products include QP-Prostate, QP-Brain, QP-Liver, QP-Breast, QP-Lung, and the QP-Insights multi-omics platform, several of which are CE and UKCA marked and integrate with hospital PACS systems. QUIBIM is ISO 27001:2022 certified and HIPAA and GDPR compliant. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; QUIBIM publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Rainwalk Technology
providers.description: Rainwalk Technology is a white-label, embedded pet insurance provider founded in 2018 and based in Columbia, South Carolina. Rainwalk lets partners such as shelters, breeders, veterinary practices, and consumer platforms launch and distribute accident-and-illness pet insurance directly at the point of sale through its APIs and hosted quoting/enrollment flows, keeping partners in control of the customer experience. Coverage includes accidents, illnesses, diagnostics, surgery, and medications, with hassle-free reimbursements and free virtual vet consultations. The company operates a partner/embedded API surface (api.rainwalk.io) plus hosted quoting, insured, and agent portals, and is backed by Techstars Ventures, ManchesterStory, Insurtech Gateway, Bridge Capital, and Seaplane Ventures. Rainwalk was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched via the pipeline.

providers.name: Redwood Bank
providers.description: Redwood Bank is a specialist UK challenger bank for small and medium-sized businesses, headquartered in Letchworth Garden City, Hertfordshire. Launched in 2017 after receiving its banking licence from the Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority (Financial Services Register firm reference 755924, company number 09872265), it is wholly owned by Redwood Financial Partners Ltd — a vehicle controlled by Jonathan and David Rowland, with Warrington Borough Council holding a roughly one-third stake. Redwood focuses narrowly on business and charity savings accounts and individually underwritten commercial and buy-to-let mortgages, and is not one of the CMA9 mandated banks. Because its product range is deposit- and lending-only (it does not offer a payment / business current account), it falls outside the PSD2 scope that compels UK Open Banking, and as of this review it publishes no public developer portal, no OBIE Read/Write (AIS/PIS/CBPII) APIs, and no confirmed Open Banking Open Data endpoint.

providers.name: Sage Care
providers.description: Sage Care (sagecare.ai) builds an AI-native, HIPAA-compliant software platform made exclusively for home care agencies. Its product bundles an AI receptionist, a purpose-built CRM, an AI notetaker and a clinical scribe that automate the intake, referral, scheduling and documentation work that home care operators handle every day. Sage Care integrates with existing home care management systems such as WellSky and AxisCare rather than replacing them, and ships native iOS and desktop applications for caregivers and office staff. The company is backed by General Catalyst and surfaced through its portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Sage Care publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation — it is an application vendor rather than an API provider, so this profile captures company identity and security/compliance posture only.

providers.name: Sazabi
providers.description: Sazabi is an AI-native observability platform that helps engineering teams find and fix production issues faster. Autonomous agents watch application logs (stdout/stderr) to detect anomalies, unfamiliar errors, traffic spikes, and failed deployments without traditional dashboards, then deliver contextual, root-cause alerts into Slack and Microsoft Teams. Engineers investigate in natural language by mentioning the Sazabi agent, and the platform can hand off context to coding agents such as Claude, Cursor, and Codex or open pull requests to remediate. Sazabi instruments 35+ hosting providers with no code changes and exposes a hosted Sazabi MCP server so agents can query logs, inspect issues and projects, and discover Sazabi tools. Founded by Sherwood Callaway; part of the Y Combinator P26 (Spring 2026) batch; backed by an $8M seed round led by J2 Ventures, Village Global, and Y Combinator, with an open beta.

providers.name: Shift Technology
providers.description: Shift Technology is a Paris-founded InsurTech company delivering AI-native decisioning and automation for the global insurance industry. Its purpose-built AI agents automate core insurance workflows — claims coverage and liability, fraud and risk detection, subrogation, injury evaluation, payment integrity, and process orchestration — for property & casualty and health insurers. Shift serves 120+ insurers across 30+ countries, including 100% of the top five U.S. P&C carriers, and has analyzed more than four billion policies, claims, and documents covering 350M+ policyholders. The company also operates the Insurance Data Network (IDN). Shift is a General Catalyst portfolio company; it markets an enterprise, contact-sales product and does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: SkySelect
providers.description: SkySelect is an AI-powered aircraft parts procurement platform for airlines, MROs (maintenance, repair and overhaul providers), and aircraft lessors. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, it operates an eProcurement-as-a-Service platform that automates sourcing, purchasing, and order tracking for aviation materials. Rather than a listings-based marketplace, buyers submit a demand list and SkySelect's specialised procurement AI automatically issues RFQs to a global network of 3,000+ verified suppliers, having processed more than US$6 billion in transactions. The platform exposes an integration API (inventory sync, RFQ reception, and quote submission) gated behind account login; partners such as Rotabull connect via API Key and Secret credentials generated in Developer Settings. SkySelect is backed by Initialized Capital and raised US$9M in 2026.

providers.name: Tianjin University
providers.description: Tianjin University (TJU) is a national public research university in Tianjin, China, founded in 1895 as Peiyang University and recognized as the oldest modern university in China. It is ranked #269 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. TJU operates the usual institutional web properties (official site, library OPAC, faculty and international-cooperation portals) but does not publish a public developer portal or documented, openly accessible API. No public API documentation, base URLs, or sign-up flows could be verified at the time of cataloging; the entries below reflect only confirmed public web properties, not documented APIs.

providers.name: TriNet Zenefits
providers.description: TriNet Zenefits (formerly Zenefits) is an all-in-one cloud HR platform for small and medium-sized businesses, providing payroll, benefits administration, time and scheduling, hiring and onboarding, performance management, and compliance in a single system of record. Acquired by TriNet in 2022, the platform combines self-service HR software with optional advisory services. TriNet Zenefits exposes a REST API at https://api.zenefits.com for programmatic access to people, companies, employments, compensation, payroll, and time-off resources, secured via OAuth 2.0.

providers.name: Urban Jungle
providers.description: Urban Jungle Services Ltd is a London-based direct-to-consumer insurtech, founded in 2016 by Jimmy Williams and Greg Smyth to sell home insurance to "Generation Rent" — renters, sharers and students the traditional UK market underserves. It is an FCA-authorised intermediary (FRN 782061, company number 10414152, England and Wales) and a certified B Corp, selling contents, buildings and contents, students contents, tenants liability, landlord, home emergency and public liability cover through its own digital journey at myurbanjungle.com, and claiming over 100,000 customers. Its API posture is partner-gated and undocumented in public. Urban Jungle announced a partnership programme and quote API in 2018, positioned so lettings agents, PropTech firms, institutional landlords and eCommerce sites can serve Urban Jungle quotes inside their own apps without being directly FCA-regulated themselves, but there is no developer portal, no reference documentation, no machine- readable specification and no self-serve signup. The only route in is a partnerships email address on a marketing page. No ACORD, AL3 or NGDS reference appears anywhere on the company's site or in its front-end bundles.

providers.name: USADATA, Inc.
providers.description: USADATA is a data and marketing intelligence company founded in 1998 and headquartered in New York City, backed by Insight Partners. It maintains a database of 260+ million US consumer records, 15+ million businesses, and 190 million households, updated monthly, and provides audience intelligence, data enrichment, hygiene, and omnichannel campaign activation. Products include the SL360 self-serve audience platform, Hailey AI conversational audience builder, a white-label Leads Portal with an embeddable Leads Module, and RESTful APIs for real-time and batch enrichment, audience building, hygiene (address standardization, NCOA, dedup, deceased suppression), and matchback attribution, with integrations into Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, and other CRM and marketing platforms. API access is sales-gated with no public developer portal or published reference documentation.

providers.name: Vega
providers.description: Vega (vega.io) is the operating system for agentic SecOps, a post-SIEM security operations platform whose Security Analytics Mesh (SAM) powers AI-native federated detection, agentic triage, and analytics on every security data source in place, with no ingestion or migration. Founded in 2024 and backed by Cyberstarts, Accel, Redpoint, and CRV, Vega raised $120M (announced September 2025) and continuously assesses detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK. The platform is sales-led; its application and developer documentation sit behind a customer login.

providers.name: Voatz
providers.description: Voatz is a remote voting technology company providing secure, mobile-based voting for public elections and organizational governance. Voters cast ballots from a smartphone, tablet, or web browser, with identity assured through hardware-backed authentication and biometric verification, ballots anchored to a permissioned blockchain, and a voter-verifiable paper audit trail produced for every vote. The platform pairs the voter-facing mobile app with an administrative dashboard for election officials and supports accessibility features for voters with disabilities. Voatz has run elections across seven countries for more than five million voters, with pilots and deployments for U.S. counties (West Virginia, Utah County, Denver), political parties, and international election authorities. The company is a Techstars-backed startup. Voatz publishes no public developer API; its surface is a security, audit, and disclosure program rather than an integration platform.

providers.name: Waste Connections
providers.description: Waste Connections is the third-largest integrated provider of solid waste services in North America, serving approximately nine million residential, commercial, and industrial customers across 46 U.S. states and six Canadian provinces. The company provides non-hazardous waste collection, transfer, disposal, and recycling services, primarily in exclusive and secondary markets. Waste Connections is investing in AI-powered dynamic routing and expanding customer connectivity features through its online customer portal.

providers.name: Wuhan University
providers.description: Wuhan University (WHU), founded in 1893 and located in Wuhan, Hubei, China, is one of China's oldest and most prestigious comprehensive research universities, ranked #194 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. It operates under the Ministry of Education of China and is recognized for surveying and remote sensing, geoinformatics, and the sciences. WHU does not publish a centralized, publicly documented developer or API portal; its official web presence (en.whu.edu.cn) is informational only. Discoverable developer activity is concentrated in research-group GitHub organizations rather than institutional API products. No public, documented institutional API endpoints could be confirmed at the time of review.

providers.name: 98point6 Technologies
providers.description: 98point6 Technologies is a Seattle-based digital health software company, founded in 2015, that builds and licenses a cloud-based virtual care platform to health systems, payers and virtual care providers. After selling its own care-delivery division in 2023 it operates purely as a licensed software provider. The platform combines an AI-driven Automated Assistant for patient intake and visit documentation, a web-based Clinician Console with automated clinical decision support, and a white-labeled patient application, covering both asynchronous and real-time (messaging, audio, video) care. It advertises HL7 and FHIR based EMR integration with Epic and Cerner, SSO for patient login, and an SDK for building a fully branded patient experience, but that integration surface is delivered under a licensing agreement, so no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published publicly.

providers.name: Atmos Energy
providers.description: Atmos Energy is one of the largest natural-gas-only distributors in the United States, delivering natural gas to residential, commercial, public-authority, and industrial customers across multiple states including Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Colorado, Kansas, and Virginia. The company provides online account management, a Builder Portal for developers and contractors, and digital service request capabilities for natural gas connections and meter installations.

providers.name: Beamery
providers.description: Beamery is an AI-powered talent lifecycle management and workforce transformation platform used by enterprises to unify fragmented talent data and run skills-based hiring. It combines a talent CRM (candidate relationship management), talent marketing, workforce and skills intelligence, internal talent mobility, and AI-driven candidate recommendations into a single system of record for talent. Beamery integrates with HR ecosystems such as Workday and SAP SuccessFactors and is delivered as enterprise SaaS. Backed by EQT Ventures and Index Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched with its public security, compliance, and trust surface. Sector: hr-tech.

providers.name: Caresyntax
providers.description: Caresyntax is a surgical intelligence company that builds a vendor-neutral, enterprise-scale data platform for the operating room. Founded in 2013 in Berlin and now dual-headquartered in Berlin and San Francisco, it captures video, audio, image, device, EMR, financial and outcomes data from inside and around the OR and applies AI analytics to it — delivering pre-operative workflow optimization, real-time intraoperative decision support, and post-operative clinical safety, quality and utilization insights. The platform pairs the PRIME365 vendor-neutral OR / medical-device integration layer with the qvident surgical performance-management and analytics suite, and is deployed in more than 4,000 operating rooms worldwide. Caresyntax sells to hospitals and surgery centers, MedTech manufacturers and insurers, and integrates with EMR, PACS and scheduling systems. It operates an API gateway at api.caresyntax.com, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract — integration is delivered through enterprise and partner engagements.

providers.name: Clearvector
providers.description: ClearVector is an identity-driven detection and response platform for cloud production environments. It attributes every action in real time to human, non-human, and third-party identities across AWS, GCP, and Azure, threading together activity across GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, cloud control planes, and runtime (EC2, Lambda, containers). Per-customer predictive behavioral models surface risky behavior, and one-click isolation contains compromised identities and resources without disrupting production. Offered as SaaS, an Enterprise plan, and a ClearVector Private SaaS deployment for teams that need complete infrastructure control. Backed by Menlo Ventures. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; ClearVector publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface — the product is delivered through a login-gated application at app.clearvector.com.

providers.name: Convex Finance
providers.description: Convex Finance is a DeFi protocol that boosts Curve Finance liquidity provider and CRV staker yields through its CVX token and pooled staking mechanism. It allows users to earn boosted CRV rewards and CVX without locking CRV directly.

providers.name: Cult.fit
providers.description: Cult.fit (Curefit / cure.fit, operated by Diverse Retails Private Limited) is an Indian health and fitness company offering a connected consumer experience across group fitness classes, gyms, at-home workouts, mental well-being and meditation, healthy food, and diagnostics. Its flagship products include CultPass gym and class memberships, sport and fitness centers, live and on-demand digital workouts, and the cult.fit and cure.fit mobile and web apps. Backed by Accel and other investors, the company operates a large consumer platform but does not publish a public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, corporate web properties, and engineering surface (the curefit GitHub organization and engineering blog).

providers.name: Dialogue
providers.description: Dialogue is a leading Canadian virtual healthcare and employee wellness provider operating an Integrated Health Platform that delivers primary care, mental health support, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), and wellness programming to members through a single mobile and web application available 24/7/365. The company serves more than 52,000 Canadian organizations — including Sun Life, National Bank of Canada, Via Rail, Lightspeed, and Samsung — connecting employees and their families with multidisciplinary care teams of nurses, physicians, and mental health specialists. Dialogue is a consumer-facing digital health application; it does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Ediphi
providers.description: Ediphi is a cloud-native preconstruction platform for commercial construction contractors that unifies estimating, cost modeling, general conditions and general requirements (GCs & GRs) tracking, bid-package contracting, and a shared cloud unit-price catalog in one real-time collaborative workspace. Founded by Dustin DeVan (founder of BuildingConnected, acquired by Autodesk), it is used by ENR Top 400 general contractors including Hensel Phelps, Suffolk Construction, and DPR Construction. Its "Last Mile" module provides API-driven automation for Excel integration and reporting. Ediphi runs a private application API at api.ediphi.com; as of this profile there is no public developer portal or published API specification.

providers.name: Eleos Health
providers.description: Eleos Health is the most widely adopted AI platform in behavioral and community-based healthcare. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Eleos delivers purpose-built AI workflow agents that span clinical documentation, compliance, and revenue cycle management. The platform embeds directly inside providers' existing web-based electronic health records (EHRs) via a lightweight browser extension for both in-person and telehealth sessions, turning ambient session capture or quick text summaries into structured, payer-ready progress notes and cutting documentation time by roughly 70%. Eleos Compliance reviews every note against common risk areas (note cloning, empty notes, interventions, progress mentions, action plans, and the golden thread), and its revenue cycle tooling automates eligibility checks and claim protection. Deployed across 120+ care organizations in 30+ states, Eleos integrates without custom API builds; it is backed by Menlo Ventures and Greenfield Partners.

providers.name: Ellipsus
providers.description: Ellipsus is a collaborative writing platform built for creative and fiction writers, combining a modern text editor with granular, Git-style version control so authors can draft, branch, share, and merge work together across devices. Founded in 2022 and operated by a small distributed team across Berlin (Germany), Madrid (Spain), and Szczecin (Poland), the product threads collaboration through every stage of writing — organizing drafts, discussing feedback, tracking changes, and preserving public version history — with a writers-first, artist-ownership, anti-AI-generated-content stance. Ellipsus offers a free tier and a paid Plus license, and is backed by Speedinvest. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Figure Markets
providers.description: Figure Markets is a blockchain-native digital-asset marketplace built on the Provenance Blockchain that lets individuals and institutions trade, borrow against, and earn yield on crypto and real-world assets from a single account. Its exchange runs on Connamara's EP3 matching engine with FIX and REST APIs, offering a central limit order book for crypto (BTC, ETH, and more), equities, bonds, alternative assets, and YLDS, the first SEC-registered yielding stablecoin. Products include Figure Exchange (pro trading), crypto-backed loans, Democratized Prime (HELOC-backed yield), and self-custodied wallets, bridging traditional order-book finance with on-chain clearing and settlement. The company is backed by DCM Ventures. The trading API is served from api.figuremarkets.com and is access-controlled; no public OpenAPI is currently published.

providers.name: Forecastr
providers.description: Forecastr is a startup financial planning and forecasting platform, founded in 2018 in Louisville, Kentucky, that helps founders and finance teams build investor-ready financial models, track cash flow and runway, plan headcount, budget expenses, and run what-if scenario analysis. It pairs cloud-based forecasting software (a spreadsheet-style formula builder, pre-built templates, drag-and-drop dashboards, and shareable live models) with fractional CFO services, and keeps actuals current through accounting integrations with QuickBooks Online and Xero. Forecastr is an API consumer of those accounting platforms rather than a public API provider; it publishes no developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Graneet
providers.description: Graneet is a French vertical-SaaS ERP for the construction and public-works (BTP) sector, built for small and mid-sized contractors (roughly EUR 2M to 100M in revenue) to protect project profitability from the office to the job site. It unifies cost estimating and quotations, progress (situation) invoicing, purchase and supplier-invoice management, project planning and labor tracking, cash and bank reconciliation, and real-time margin dashboards, with a companion mobile app and prebuilt integrations to accounting tools such as Sage 100 and Pennylane. The product is delivered as a cloud application (app.graneet.com) backed by internal Main, BFF, and Quotation APIs; there is no public developer API or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: graph8
providers.description: graph8 is an autonomous revenue system — an AI-native B2B sales platform that finds buyers, launches campaigns, runs conversations and builds pipeline against a single buyer graph. It spans buyer and intent data (a claimed 700M contacts and 100M companies), signals, a campaign studio, named agents, CRM and pipeline reporting, a built-in CDP with 500+ connectors, and a desktop companion. It is one of four brands under one company: graph8 the platform, graph8 build the developer platform, CIENCE the SDR and GTM services arm, and Tenbound the research magazine and community. The developer surface at graph8.com/build is documented across six areas — REST API, SDKs, CLI, MCP, React components and infrastructure — but is in preview: at the time of profiling no OpenAPI and no MCP endpoint were publicly fetchable, and a workspace endpoint is issued on request rather than self-serve.

providers.name: IKI AI
providers.description: IKI AI is an AI-native workspace for knowledge, research, strategy, and creative work, backed by 500 Global. It pairs an AI assistant that summarizes, highlights, and connects saved content with an AI editor that grounds writing in a user's personal knowledge base, plus shared Team Spaces and a browser extension for one-click webpage saving with notes. The product targets researchers, students, consultants, copywriters, coaches, lawyers, founders, and venture teams, and emphasizes privacy with a choice of top-tier LLMs. IKI AI is delivered as a consumer and team SaaS (web app at app.iki.ai and a Chrome extension) with subscription plans; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI. This profile tracks its public identity, commercial, and security surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Intego
providers.description: Intego is a consumer cybersecurity company with more than 25 years of Mac and Windows protection, headquartered in France (Intego S.A.). Its flagship Intego ONE suite bundles antivirus with real-time threat detection, a network firewall, the SmartClean disk-cleanup and performance optimizer, and Intego VPN for encrypted private browsing, sold as separate macOS and Windows product lines. Intego also runs The Mac Security Blog, a long-running source of Apple and macOS security reporting. The company publishes a Compliance Hub for procurement and vendor-security reviews and holds an active ISO/IEC 27001:2022 information-security certification. Intego is a consumer software vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead and enriched with its public identity, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Kata Containers
providers.description: Kata Containers is an open source project that builds lightweight virtual machines that seamlessly plug into the container ecosystem. It combines the speed of containers with the security isolation of virtual machines, providing a hardware-level isolation boundary for each container or pod.

providers.name: Lantern
providers.description: Lantern (legal entity Employer Direct Healthcare, LLC dba Lantern Specialty Care) is a US specialty care platform that connects members with high-quality, lower-cost care for surgery, cancer and infusion therapy — the complex, high-cost episodes that account for roughly half of healthcare spending. Founded in 2011 as SurgeryPlus and later expanded into cancer and infusion care, Lantern sells to employers, public-sector employers, labor union trusts, health plans and benefits consultants, pairing a hand-selected "Network of Excellence" of specialists with dedicated care teams that navigate a member end to end through a treatment journey. Lantern is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Lantern publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or discovery surface — this profile captures its public company, trust and security posture only.

providers.name: LifeLock
providers.description: LifeLock is a consumer identity-theft-protection brand founded in 2005 in Tempe, Arizona and owned by Gen Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: GEN). It monitors members' personal information — Social Security numbers, names, addresses, credit applications and public records — for signs of misuse, alerts them through its proprietary Identity Alert System, and provides U.S.-based restoration specialists plus reimbursement coverage when identity theft occurs. Current plans (Core, Advanced, Total) layer on credit-bureau monitoring, dark-web monitoring, automatic data-broker removal, scam support and reimbursement, home-title and SIM-swap monitoring, and the Million Dollar Protection Package. LifeLock is also sold bundled with Norton device security as Norton 360 with LifeLock. It is a direct-to-consumer subscription service and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; its machine-readable surface is a first-party llms.txt at lifelock.norton.com.

providers.name: Limbic
providers.description: Limbic is a clinical AI company for mental healthcare, founded in 2020 and headquartered in New York with a London engineering base. Its two products — Limbic Access, a Class IIa (UKCA) medical device for conversational patient intake, assessment and clinical decision support, and Limbic Care, an AI companion delivering guided CBT and on-demand support between therapy sessions — are embedded by health plans, health systems, behavioral health providers and NHS Talking Therapies services. Both are built on the proprietary "Limbic Layer", a clinical reasoning layer that sits between the user and a large language model to enforce validated clinical guidance. Limbic Access embeds into a provider website with a small script snippet rather than a public developer API; the company publishes no developer portal, OpenAPI definitions or SDKs, and integrates with EHR and patient management systems through customer engagements. Research code accompanying its peer-reviewed studies (including work published in Nature Medicine) is open on GitHub.

providers.name: Lord & Taylor
providers.description: Lord & Taylor is one of the oldest American department-store apparel and home-goods retail brands, now operating as a direct-to-consumer online store at lordandtaylor.com. The storefront runs on the Shopify commerce platform, so its public, agent-accessible API surface is the Shopify commerce stack: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect customer authentication (issued via Shopify Customer Accounts) plus two hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — an unauthenticated Storefront MCP exposing product search, cart, product-detail and store-policy tools, and an OAuth-protected Customer Account MCP exposing order-status, return-request and store-credit tools. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from live discovery documents and MCP tool listings.

providers.name: memrise
providers.description: Memrise is a language-learning app founded in 2010 and headquartered in London, UK, trusted by 80 million learners across iOS, Android, and web. It is built around real native-speaker video, goal-based specialised courses (exams, work, relationships, travel), a spaced-repetition memory-science engine created by co-founder and Princeton neuroscientist Greg Detre, and AI conversation practice. Memrise offers courses in 149+ languages and has been profitable since 2016. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. Memrise is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and machine-readable (llms.txt) surface.

providers.name: Morado
providers.description: Morado is a Colombian fintech and B2B marketplace for the beauty and wellness industry across Latin America, founded in 2022 by Angela Maria Acosta (an early Rappi employee). It is the "everything store for beauty shops" — giving salons, spas, and independent beauty entrepreneurs (a workforce that is majority women) access to intelligent credit, working-capital lines, inventory supply, inventory management, last-mile logistics, and digital tools through a 100% digital process, even for businesses without a traditional financial history. Credit applications run over WhatsApp with 30/60/90-day revolving lines and 3-12 month term products, serving 32,000+ micro-business clients. Backed by QED Investors, Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global, H20 Capital, Latitud, and Village Global. Public surface is the moradocolombia.com marketing/credit site (built on Wix) — no first-party developer API, though the Wix site exposes a hosted MCP endpoint and an llms.txt.

providers.name: Moviepass
providers.description: MoviePass is a consumer movie-theater subscription service that lets members see films in theaters nationwide for a low monthly fee. The relaunched service (led by co-founder Stacy Spikes after reacquiring the brand) uses a credit-based system: members choose a monthly plan, earn credits, and redeem them for showtimes at over 4,000 participating US theaters, including major chains and independent cinemas, with plans starting around $10/month and no long-term commitment. Members browse showtimes and book through the MoviePass iOS and Android apps. MoviePass was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it is a direct-to-consumer app business and does not publish a traditional public developer API. Its marketing site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP server plus an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Notable
providers.description: Notable is an intelligent-automation company purpose-built for healthcare, applying AI agents to administrative and operational workflows across patient access, revenue cycle management, care operations, and contact-center automation. Its platform pairs a library of prebuilt AI Agents with Flow Builder, a low-code interface for designing, training, and deploying automations, and Sidekick, a natural-language assistant for staff. Deployed at more than 1,000 healthcare locations and used by health systems including Intermountain Healthcare and the Medical University of South Carolina, Notable is backed by Greylock and ICONIQ Capital. This profile has been enriched from the company's public trust, security, and developer surfaces.

providers.name: OPGG
providers.description: OP.GG is the world's leading League of Legends statistics and performance tracking platform. Founded in Seoul, South Korea and launched in 2013, it grew from a LoL stats search engine into a global gaming platform serving tens of millions of monthly active users across games including League of Legends, Valorant, Teamfight Tactics, Overwatch 2, and PUBG. OP.GG surfaces summoner ranks, win rates, champion mastery, builds, tier lists, match history, and live meta trends. Its programmatic surface centers on an official, hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents access to LoL, TFT, and Valorant game data, plus first-party AI-readable ai.json summoner/match snapshot endpoints advertised in its published llms.txt. OP.GG is backed by 500 Global, SBVA, DS Asset Management, Dunamu & Partners, and others.

providers.name: Page
providers.description: Page is an AI-powered government relations (GR) platform that tracks legislation, regulatory activity, and policy developments across 70+ jurisdictions in real time. It provides bill tracking, regulatory affairs monitoring, live hearing and vote alerts, lobbying and parliamentary questions data, smart alerts, AI analysis of policy trends, and detailed politician and staff directories, alongside Wonk — an AI assistant for policy research and document generation. Page serves enterprises, multi-client firms, law firms, government agencies, associations, and nonprofits. It is headquartered in Washington, DC with an additional office in Waterloo, Ontario, and is backed by Canaan Partners. Page holds SOC 2 Type II certification. As of this profile Page exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Passes
providers.description: Passes is a creator monetization and accelerator platform founded in 2022 by Lucy Guo and headquartered in Los Angeles. Creators use Passes to build direct, paid relationships with their audiences through subscriptions, paid DMs, livestreams, one-on-one video calls, merchandise, automated message sequences, and instant payouts, while keeping 90% of what they earn. Backed by Bond Capital and Multicoin Capital, the company rebranded in 2026 as a creator accelerator. Passes does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its real public web surface — llms.txt, security.txt, mobile deep-link association files, and domain-security posture — harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Quadric
providers.description: Quadric is a semiconductor IP company based in Burlingame, California that licenses the Chimera GPNPU (general-purpose neural processing unit) processor IP and its accompanying software stack for on-device and edge AI inference. The Chimera architecture unifies scalar, vector, and matrix compute in a single fully C++ programmable core so both AI graph operators and classic DSP/C++ code run on one pipeline, giving SoC designers a future-proof target for evolving model roadmaps. Quadric ships a developer toolchain rather than a hosted web API: the cloud-based DevStudio portal, the Chimera SDK (ONNX import from PyTorch and TensorFlow), the ChiPy Python programming interface, an LLVM-based C++ extensibility path, and an instruction-set simulator for pre-silicon performance modeling. This profile catalogs Quadric's developer surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ray White
providers.description: Ray White is Australasia's largest real estate group, a family-owned brokerage network founded in 1902 and headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, running 550+ Australian offices and roughly a thousand offices in total across Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, Papua New Guinea, the Middle East and Atlanta USA, spanning residential sales, auctions, commercial (Ray White Commercial / rwc.com.au), rural and livestock, property management, projects, marine, hotels, valuations, business sales, insurance and mortgage broking through sister brand Loan Market. In the Australian property value chain Ray White sits on the AGENCY side of a portal duopoly — it lists into REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain rather than operating a portal or a registry of its own — and it is an API CONSUMER, not an API producer. In December 2025 Ray White named realestate.com.au and PropTrack its data partners explicitly for their "industry leading API architecture", piping that licensed market data into its proprietary OneSystem, NurtureCloud and Pulse platforms. Its API posture is therefore honestly stated as none-published — as of 2026-07-26 no developer portal, no public API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published partner-API application path could be found on raywhite.com or any developer/api/docs subdomain (all of which fail DNS resolution). RESO is absent — Ray White does not appear in the RESO certification directory, which is unsurprising because RESO is a North American, NAR-driven mandate with no Australian counterpart; Australia's closest thing to a required machine-readable property rail is PEXA electronic conveyancing, which Ray White transacts through as a participant rather than exposes.

providers.name: Raya
providers.description: Raya (legal entity Raya App Inc) is a private, membership-based global community for dating, friendship, and professional networking, founded by Daniel Gendelman in 2014 and launched in February 2015 out of Los Angeles, California. Membership is application-only: applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis by a global committee, an Instagram handle is required for identity verification, and accepted members choose a 1, 6, or 12 month paid subscription. The product is iOS-only (App Store id 957215308, minimum iOS 17.0) and is known for photo-slideshow profiles set to music, screenshot detection, and a community drawn heavily from creative industries. Public sources report roughly $15.5M raised from investors including Cowboy Ventures, Dreamers VC and S32, and the company appears on secondary marketplaces such as Forge Global and EquityZen. It is a consumer application company, not an API provider: enrichment probed rayatheapp.com, raya.co, api.rayatheapp.com, api.raya.co and icecream.rayatheapp.com and found no developer portal, no documentation, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI contract, no MCP server, and no A2A agent card. The api.rayatheapp.com host is a private first-party mobile backend that returns 404 to every unauthenticated path. This profile is identity-only pending a public API surface.

providers.name: Sajilni
providers.description: Sajilni is a Middle East / MENA event ticketing and event-management platform built for organizers who care about data and branding. Organizers use it to create events, design branded registration pages, sell and scan tickets, manage seating and booths, run promo/discount codes, collect payments, and analyze attendee data. The consumer-facing site is sajilni.com with an organizer/business portal at business.sajilni.com; the platform is a Java/Spring web application with an internal authentication service at auth.sajilni.com. As of this enrichment pass Sajilni publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or webhook surface, so this profile captures the company identity, commercial pages, and a live domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Savana
providers.description: Savana is a Malvern, Pennsylvania based financial software company, founded in 2009, that sells a cloud-native, API-first Digital Delivery Platform to banks, credit unions and fintechs. The platform sits above the core banking system rather than replacing it, unifying banker-facing experiences (CRM, BPM, servicing, assisted account opening) and customer-facing experiences (online and mobile banking, digital account opening) across any core, and shipping 140+ pre-built configurable servicing workflows. Savana markets a set of "Banking APIs" that orchestrate whole servicing processes — not just data exchange — between assisted and self-service channels, but as of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; documentation and the status page are reachable only by authenticated customers. Savana raised a $45M Series A led by Georgian with participation from Fiserv in 2022.

providers.name: Strongkeep
providers.description: StrongKeep is a cybersecurity platform built for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) that lack a dedicated IT team or a large security budget. It bundles malware protection, scam and phishing protection, security-awareness ("secure habits") training, human-risk monitoring, and compliance readiness (such as Cyber Essentials) into a single dashboard, with most customers reportedly going live within 60 minutes. StrongKeep offers a free no-install security scan, plans starting at $39/month, and vertical solutions for healthcare clinics and professional-services firms. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. StrongKeep does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from its public web surface (identity, security.txt, and domain-security probes).

providers.name: The Block
providers.description: The Block is a New York-based digital-assets research, analysis, and news brand founded in 2018, covering cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Web3 markets. Its subscription platform, The Block Pro, packages breaking news, in-depth research, proprietary datasets, and venture-funding intelligence for professional investors, funds, and enterprises. The Block Pro also exposes a set of license-gated APIs - a real-time News API (REST, request-only, JSON), a Deals/Funding API, an Ecosystems/Data API, and a WebSocket news stream - available only to organizations holding a Block Pro subscription. The APIs have no public developer portal or OpenAPI definition; access and technical documentation are arranged through The Block's client-services team.

providers.name: Tonk
providers.description: Tonk, built by Tonk Labs, is an open-source containerized format, host environment, and protocol for multiplayer, local-first software you keep and share like files. A .tonk bundle packages an application together with its data into a single self-contained file that runs anywhere, works offline, and stays under user control. It is built on a document-based virtual file system using Automerge CRDTs, a browser/WebAssembly runtime compiled from Rust, and peer-to-peer synchronization through WebSocket relays. Tonk ships first-party npm client libraries, a CLI, a sync relay, an authentication library, and an MCP worker rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Electric Capital.

providers.name: TrackMan
providers.description: TrackMan A/S is a Danish sports-technology company (headquartered in Vedbaek, Denmark) that builds Doppler radar and optically tracked launch monitors, simulator software, and data platforms for golf, baseball, football, and US football. Its hardware lineage includes the TrackMan 4 outdoor/indoor launch monitor, TrackMan iO indoor launch monitor, the V3 stadium ball-tracking system used by every Major League Baseball club, and the portable B1 baseball launch monitor. On the software side TrackMan operates TrackMan Range (a connected driving-range platform), Virtual Golf 3 (the simulator rendering and gameplay engine), the TrackMan Golf App for performance and social play, TrackMan 360 for golf-club business operations, and a cloud data platform that aggregates measurements across products. TrackMan exposes several developer-facing surfaces — a TrackMan Cloud GraphQL API at api.golf.trackman.com/graphql for tournaments and facility data, the TrackMan Range REST API at docs.trackmanrange.com for range/bay/session integration, a device-local TM4 WebSocket protocol for receiving live shot measurements over LAN/UPnP from a TrackMan 4 unit, and the TrackMan Baseball Data API (Swagger-documented, OAuth-client + username/password) for ingesting V3 stadium and B1 portable measurements and media. The TrackMan public GitHub organization hosts internal Unity tooling rather than client SDKs, and most developer access is partner-gated through TrackMan Sports Solutions or the Golf B2B program. The commercial model is hardware sales plus tiered software subscriptions (TrackMan Range, TrackMan 360, V3 Cloud) sold direct to teams, leagues, ranges, and consumers.

providers.name: TytoCare
providers.description: TytoCare is an AI-powered remote physical examination and virtual care company. Its FDA-cleared handheld examination device and Home Smart Clinic / Pro Smart Clinic platforms let clinicians remotely examine heart, lungs, ears, throat, skin, and temperature, serving 240+ healthcare organizations and 1.6M+ patients. TytoCare publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs — EHR and telehealth integrations are delivered through private partner channels. An Insight Partners portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Upstream Security
providers.description: Upstream Security is a cloud-based automotive and smart-mobility cybersecurity company. Its purpose-built vehicle data platform delivers Cyber XDR detection and response for connected vehicles, runtime AI and API security, proactive quality detection, and advanced analytics, alongside AutoThreat PRO threat intelligence and Vehicle Security Operations Center (vSOC) services for OEMs, Tier 1 and 2 suppliers, fleets, insurers, EV charging, and mobility IoT operators. Upstream publishes no public developer portal or API; the platform is sold as enterprise SaaS with demo-based onboarding.

providers.name: VendorPM
providers.description: VendorPM is a PropTech procurement and vendor-lifecycle-management platform for the commercial real estate industry, unifying vendor credentialing, compliance screening, eTendering/eBidding, procurement, and contract management under a single login. Its marketplace connects property managers with a network of 50,000+ vendors to fulfill building services and contracts of all sizes, while an AI Procurement CoPilot surfaces recommendations and a Yardi Voyager ERP integration syncs vendor compliance and profile data. VendorPM serves 100+ property management groups and 6,000+ buildings across the US and Canada. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company; VendorPM exposes no public self-serve developer API — its Yardi/ERP integration is provisioned through a Customer Success Manager.

providers.name: Viewabo
providers.description: Viewabo is an interactive visual product-support platform for modern customer experience, product, and field-service teams. A support agent sends a browser link to anyone on-site; the customer taps it and shares their smartphone camera in real time — with no app download and no account required — so the team can see the problem live through the customer's camera, guide a remote fix, and confirm whether an on-site dispatch is actually needed. Hardware makers, equipment manufacturers, and medical/industrial product teams use it to cut truck rolls, resolve tickets faster, and triage before dispatch. Pricing is usage-based per video session with unlimited seats.

providers.name: Voiio
providers.description: Voiio is a German employee assistance and work-life balance platform, positioning itself as "#1 in Work-Life-Balance" in the German market. The platform provides employee support across all life stages (family planning, childcare, eldercare, personal wellness, career support) through digital services, coaching, live lectures, expert referrals, and a 24/7 accessible portal. Integration with employer systems is available via Magic Links (authenticated deep-link URLs) and a white-label customization approach. No public REST API or developer portal has been identified; integrations are enterprise-contract based.

providers.name: Vulcan Technologies
providers.description: Vulcan Technologies builds frontier AI for law and government, headquartered in Austin, Texas and founded in 2025. Its flagship product, Justinian, is a legal AI agent that runs on roughly 157 billion records of American law and policy — including 13+ billion court records, every municipal code, and federal and state statutes, regulations, and active legislative sessions — planning research, drafting work product, and verifying and citing every claim against source. A second product, Trajan, is a government AI concierge for citizen services such as permits, registrations, and license renewals. Vulcan is FedRAMP Ready, runs in AWS GovCloud (US), and serves customers including the Virginia Office of Regulatory Management, the U.S. Department of Education, and South Carolina agencies. The company raised a $10.9M seed round (October 2025) co-led by General Catalyst and Cubit Capital, with participation from Y Combinator, SV Angel, and others. Vulcan is a product/agent company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Zenjob
providers.description: Zenjob is a Berlin-based staffing platform that connects businesses with vetted temporary workers (students and side-jobbers) through a mobile app and a self-service booking platform (Buchungsplattform). Companies create shifts, staff them in real time, track working hours, and handle invoicing in one place. Zenjob offers an integration layer (marketed as "Schnittstellen (API)") for personnel management, shift creation and staffing, time tracking, and billing, plus partner integrations with workforce and vendor-management systems including Quinyx, ATOSS, Ubeya, and compleet. The API is partner/consultation-led (arranged via a scheduled onboarding call) rather than a self-serve public developer program; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDK. Backed by 500 Global, Zenjob was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 42 Technologies
providers.description: 42 Technologies is a retail business-intelligence and reporting platform, founded in 2013, that consolidates omnichannel retail data — point-of-sale, ecommerce, wholesale, and online-marketplace sources — into a single unified dashboard. It provides merchandisers, buyers, and retail executives with more than 100 purpose-built retail metrics, NRF retail-calendar-aware analytics, multi-currency support, and automated reporting, integrating with 100+ systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Amazon, Walmart, Magento, and WooCommerce. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; 42 does not publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Agworld
providers.description: Agworld is a collaborative farm-management platform - now part of the Semios Group and majority-owned by Telus Agriculture & Consumer Goods - used by growers, agronomists, and ag retailers to plan, schedule, record, and report on field activities. The product surface covers planning, scheduling, precision spray records, agronomic and financial insights, and compliance reporting. Agworld integrates with John Deere, Climate-style monitor data via Agworld DBX, plus Figured, PowerBI, Shed, CalAg, Frames, CART by FarmReady, and Mobble. The companion DBX product is a label, manufacturer, ingredient, and pest database (Greenbook). Agworld does not publish an open public developer portal; partner integrations are arranged through their team.

providers.name: Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
providers.description: The Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau (TTB), statutorily named the Tax and Trade Bureau, is a bureau of the United States Department of the Treasury. TTB regulates and collects federal excise taxes on alcohol, tobacco, firearms, and ammunition. The bureau enforces Federal laws and regulations related to alcohol and tobacco products, issues permits for producers, importers, and wholesalers, approves label applications for alcohol beverages, and provides open data on tax collections, permit holders, and approved product labels. TTB administers approximately $20 billion in annual federal excise tax collections from the alcohol and tobacco industries.

providers.name: Aporia
providers.description: Aporia was an AI guardrails and observability platform for production LLM and ML applications, known for low-latency guardrails covering hallucination, prompt injection, PII, toxicity, off-topic responses, and custom policies, alongside full ML monitoring for drift and data quality. Coralogix acquired Aporia in late 2024 and the Aporia guardrails technology is now offered as part of the Coralogix AI Observability and AI Guardrails product line, with the standalone Aporia.com experience consolidated into Coralogix's portfolio.

providers.name: Astelia
providers.description: Astelia is an AI-native exposure management and vulnerability management company whose platform helps security teams find and fix the reachable fraction of their vulnerabilities. Using agentic AI and read-only integrations, Astelia maps network topology, extracts the technical requirements an exploit actually needs, and correlates reachability with network context to surface which vulnerabilities are truly exploitable by an attacker. Rather than ranking issues on probability scores alone, it delivers attack-path visualization, coverage-gap analysis, and evidence-based remediation guidance tailored to each organization's environment. Astelia is backed by Index Ventures and documents its security posture in a public trust center (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, HIPAA, GDPR). This API Evangelist profile enriches the company as a network lead; the product surface is enterprise SaaS with no public API published at this time.

providers.name: Aventon
providers.description: Aventon is a consumer electric bicycle (e-bike) manufacturer headquartered in Brea, California. Founded in 2012 and originally known for fixed-gear and track bikes, the company pivoted to electric bikes and is now one of the larger direct-to-consumer e-bike brands in the United States, with a lineup that spans commuter, fat-tire, lightweight, folding, cargo, and mountain e-bikes sold online and through a dealer network. Aventon operates no traditional public developer API of its own, but its Shopify-powered storefront at aventon.com natively exposes agent-facing commerce surfaces: a published /llms.txt, Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect discovery, and a live Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and checkout.

providers.name: Barn & Willow
providers.description: Barn & Willow is a direct-to-consumer home furnishings brand specializing in made-to-measure window treatments — custom drapery, curtains, roman shades and blinds in natural fabrics such as linen, cotton and velvet. The company sells online at barnandwillow.com, a Shopify-hosted storefront, offering free fabric swatches, measuring guides and design consultations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the storefront exposes a real agentic-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile and hosted MCP endpoint for agent-driven shopping, Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect authentication, and an llms.txt agent-instructions document.

providers.name: Boardroom Governance
providers.description: Boardroom is a governance aggregation platform that helps developers fetch and display governance data across DAOs and decentralized networks. The Boardroom Governance API provides access to proposals, votes, protocols, and voter data for Web3 governance applications.

providers.name: Cheerio
providers.description: Cheerio is a fast, flexible, and elegant Node.js library for parsing and manipulating HTML and XML using a jQuery-compatible API. It is widely used for server-side web scraping, HTML transformation, data extraction, and static site generation. Cheerio is MIT licensed and distributed as the cheerio npm package, maintained under the cheeriojs GitHub organization.

providers.name: Crogl
providers.description: Crogl is an enterprise AI security operations platform that deploys autonomous AI agents to investigate security alerts and threat advisories entirely within a customer's own infrastructure. Using a neurosymbolic approach that combines knowledge graphs, large language models, and security best practices, Crogl gathers context, queries existing security tools, and cross-references data across SIEM, EDR, ticketing, and data-lake systems without exfiltrating data. It is tool-agnostic — integrating with Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, Jira, Databricks, Snowflake, Amazon S3, and Cribl — and every action is auditable so human analysts retain final decisions. Crogl is offered as a free single-user deployment and an enterprise plan with SSO, RBAC, and 24/7 SLAs. It is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company. Crogl does not currently publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer SDK; its API surface (connectors) is part of the on-premises product.

providers.name: CropX
providers.description: CropX is an Israeli ag-IoT company that combines in-field soil and weather hardware with a cloud Farm Management Software (FMS) platform. The hardware portfolio includes SV-series soil sensors (moisture, temperature, conductivity, salinity at depth), ET-series evapotranspiration sensors, WS-series weather stations, RG rain gauges, the Apex root-zone sensor, an in-development nitrate sensor, and TD-series cellular telemetry gateways. The FMS covers farm / field / crop data, device management, irrigation scheduling, disease monitoring, nutrition, effluent, and reporting. CropX does not publish a public developer portal; integrations with third-party sensors and machinery are arranged through their team.

providers.name: Entelo
providers.description: Entelo is an AI-powered talent-sourcing and recruiting-automation platform for finding, engaging, and hiring candidates using predictive analytics, diversity-aware search, and candidate-engagement tooling. Entelo was acquired and is now delivered as "Entelo Recruit" within Rival (rival-hr.com), an AI-powered HR orchestration suite spanning recruiting, workflow, learning, and performance. Its former domain entelo.com now 301-redirects to Rival. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published for the Entelo/Rival Recruit product.

providers.name: Functionize
providers.description: Functionize is an AI-native intelligent test automation platform that uses generative AI and computer vision to author, run, and self-heal web and mobile UI tests. The Functionize Architect agent generates tests from natural-language prompts, while Smart Test Agents reduce maintenance by adapting to UI changes at runtime. Tests execute against the Functionize Test Cloud and integrate with CI/CD pipelines via the Functionize CLI and a partner-gated REST API. Programmatic surfaces are not publicly documented; access is gated behind a Functionize tenant and a customer support portal at support.functionize.com.

providers.name: Kredete
providers.description: Kredete is an intelligent global finance app for diaspora and emerging-market communities, founded in 2022 and operating across four continents. It moves money across 60+ markets at the mid-market rate with settlement in about ten seconds, issues US dollar Visa cards accepted in 170+ countries, opens multi-currency accounts in the customer's own name, pays yield on US dollar savings held through partner US chartered institutions, and reports rent and repayment history to the major US credit bureaus so customers build a US credit file. Kredete for Business adds multi-currency operating accounts, corporate cards, FedWire routing, payroll, and invoicing. An in-app agent runs these actions on the customer's behalf with confirmation. Kredete is a financial technology company, not a bank; remittance and banking services are provided by partner US licensed financial institutions. Backed by Partech and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass Kredete publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Lawhive
providers.description: Lawhive is a UK consumer legal-services marketplace that connects individuals and small businesses with regulated solicitors online at fixed, transparent prices, positioned as roughly half the cost of a traditional high-street law firm. Clients answer intake questions on the site, receive a quote or a callback, and are matched with a vetted consultant lawyer who then runs the matter end to end through the Lawhive platform, covering conveyancing, divorce and family, employment, immigration, landlord and tenant, and property work. Lawhive Ltd is not a law firm and does not give legal advice itself; regulated legal services are delivered by its network, including affiliate firm Lawhive Legal Ltd, which is authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA ID 8003766). The company is backed by Balderton Capital and GV. Lawhive publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation, so this profile captures its identity, legal and compliance posture, and probed domain-security surface rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Lithium Finance
providers.description: Lithium Finance is a decentralized asset-pricing protocol that combines machine learning with collective intelligence to value illiquid assets, with an initial focus on NFTs. Quantitative models analyze historical trading data to produce a base valuation and to flag cases where machine learning struggles — such as rare NFTs with little trading history — and the protocol then incentivizes a community of Price Experts to submit pricing estimates through on-chain Pricing Quests. Two ecosystem roles drive the network: Price Seekers (data consumers such as projects, lenders, issuers and analysts) fund prize pools to post asset-pricing enquiries, and Price Experts (brokers, traders and market participants) answer them for bounties. The economy runs on the LITH token plus non-transferable Reputation Points, and the protocol is governed by the Lithium DAO via Snapshot. The public surface is a set of Solidity Enquiry Pool, Reputation and LITH token contracts rather than a hosted web API.

providers.name: LVMH
providers.description: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton is the world's largest luxury goods conglomerate, headquartered in Paris and operating over 75 prestigious brands. Its portfolio spans fashion and leather goods (Louis Vuitton, Christian Dior, Fendi, Loewe, Celine), wines and spirits (Moët & Chandon, Hennessy, Veuve Clicquot), perfumes and cosmetics (Givenchy, Guerlain), watches and jewelry (Tiffany & Co., Bulgari, TAG Heuer), and selective retailing (Sephora, DFS). LVMH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the group level; technical and partner integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed innovation partnerships such as the Aura Blockchain Consortium.

providers.name: Mosaic Ml
providers.description: MosaicML - now Databricks Mosaic Research - is a machine learning systems company that builds open-source tooling for training and deploying large neural networks and generative AI models faster and at lower cost. Its flagship open-source projects include Composer (a PyTorch library of training speedup methods), LLM Foundry (code for training and finetuning large language models), and Streaming (a library for streaming large datasets from cloud object stores into PyTorch training). MosaicML also shipped a managed training and inference platform driven by the mosaicml-cli (mcli) command-line tool; following the 2023 Databricks acquisition that platform is now offered as Databricks Mosaic AI.
