The company does not publish a standalone public REST/OpenAPI surface - its developer surface is Python packages, a CLI, and its open-source GitHub repositories.

providers.name: Naver
providers.description: Naver Corp. is South Korea's largest internet company, operating the Naver search portal, Naver Webtoon, Naver Pay, Naver Maps, Naver Shopping, WORKS Mobile, and the LINE messenger platform (jointly with SoftBank via LY Corporation). Naver runs two distinct public developer surfaces: Naver Developers (developers.naver.com) which hosts Naver's classic Open APIs — Search (blog, news, book, encyclopedia, café, knowledge, web, image, shop, doc), Papago N2MT translation, Naver Login (OAuth 2.0), Naver Maps geocoding and static map, Datalab trend, CAPTCHA, and SmartEditor; and Naver Cloud Platform (www.ncloud.com) — Naver's IaaS / PaaS offering with Compute (Server, Container, Functions), Storage (Object, Block, File), Network (VPC, CDN+, Global Edge), AI (CLOVA Speech, CLOVA OCR, Papago, HyperCLOVA X), Maps, SENS (SMS / push messaging), Cloud Search, and Certificate Manager.

providers.name: Novoic
providers.description: Novoic is a London-based clinical AI company building speech biomarkers for the early detection of Alzheimer's disease and cognitive impairment. Its technology analyzes how people speak - acoustic and linguistic patterns - to screen for subtle cognitive change in about ten minutes on any smart device. Products include Storyteller (automated, browser-based speech-based cognitive testing), Dashboard (an enterprise platform for running screening programs across sites with AI-assisted triage and analytics), and a Speech API for direct access to their speech processing, automated speech recognition, quality control, and speech-biomarker models. Novoic is deployed across 50+ medical institutions, partners with the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, and emphasizes HIPAA/GDPR compliance. It also publishes two open-source feature-extraction libraries, surfboard (audio) and blabla (linguistics).

providers.name: Playwright
providers.description: Playwright is an open-source framework from Microsoft for web automation and browser testing. It enables reliable end-to-end testing for modern web apps, supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. Playwright is consumed as a library and CLI rather than a hosted HTTP API.

providers.name: Robocurve
providers.description: Robocurve is a San Francisco Public Benefit Corporation (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building open-source tools and independent benchmarks to help society understand what AI and robots can actually do in the physical world. Its flagship framework, Inspect Robots ("the Inspect AI for robotics"), runs any vision-language-action policy on any embodiment against any benchmark with full trace logs and live Rerun visualization, and integrates with ROS, Isaac Lab, and LeRobot. World Evals is its curated catalog of physical-world benchmarks (KitchenBench, DataCenterBench). Everything ships MIT-licensed as Python packages with a command-line interface rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: Rouje
providers.description: Rouje is a Parisian ready-to-wear and beauty brand founded by Jeanne Damas, selling feminine ready-to-wear, shoes, accessories, and the "Les Filles en Rouje" makeup and skincare line direct-to-consumer online and through boutiques across France. Rouje has no first-party developer API, but its Shopify-hosted storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven shopping and checkout, a published llms.txt / agents.md with explicit agent instructions, Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect discovery, and public read-only product/collection JSON endpoints. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

providers.name: Upmem
providers.description: UPMEM is a French fabless semiconductor company pioneering Processing-In-Memory (PIM). Its Data Processing Units (DPUs) are embedded directly in DRAM on standard DIMM modules, putting thousands of programmable cores inside memory to accelerate data-intensive workloads such as analytics, genomics, and AI inference. Developers program DPUs in C using the UPMEM DPU SDK (LLVM-based compiler, DPU runtime, C/C++/Java/Python host libraries, dpu-lldb debugger, and a functional simulator), distributed from sdk.upmem.com and an APT PPA. UPMEM publishes no hosted web API; its developer surface is the SDK and an open-source GitHub organization. The corporate website (www.upmem.com) is offline as of 2026-07-21, while the SDK documentation and release archive remain live.

providers.name: UptimeHealth
providers.description: UptimeHealth is a healthcare operations platform for managing medical equipment service, compliance documentation, and facility maintenance across dental, medical, and veterinary practices from a single dashboard. The platform tracks devices, automates compliance tasks and logs, and coordinates repair service requests, reporting 73,000+ devices protected across 6,000+ facilities. UptimeHealth publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation — its platform (uptimecontroller.com) is a closed SaaS application.

providers.name: wanelo
providers.description: wanelo ("The intelligent everything store") is an AI-powered shopping storefront offering natural-language and visual product discovery, personalized recommendations, and a buy-for-me assistant, built on Shopify. It exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, ucp.dev) with a hosted MCP endpoint for catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OpenID Connect and a published /llms.txt (mirroring /agents.md). Originally a social-shopping product backed by Slow Ventures, wanelo.com now operates as an agent-ready commerce store. Read-only catalog browsing (products/collections/search JSON) requires no authentication.

providers.name: AmerisourceBergen
providers.description: AmerisourceBergen (now Cencora) fosters a positive impact on healthcare around the world by advancing the development and delivery of pharmaceuticals and healthcare products. The company provides pharmaceutical distribution, manufacturer solutions, provider solutions, and animal health solutions across 50+ countries through 1,300+ facilities.

providers.name: Apache Mahout
providers.description: Apache Mahout is an open-source framework for building scalable machine learning applications. The project has evolved to include Qumat, a unified Python API for building quantum circuits that runs across multiple quantum backends including Qiskit, Cirq, and Amazon Braket, along with QDP for GPU-accelerated classical-to-quantum data encoding.

providers.name: Arka
providers.description: Arka is a custom packaging company that lets ecommerce brands design, order, and ship eco-friendly custom boxes, mailers, and sustainable packaging online. Arka offers low minimums, fast turnaround, and plug-in integrations with commerce platforms including Shopify, BigCommerce, and Square so merchants can reorder packaging alongside their fulfillment workflow. Arka's storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface — a published /llms.txt, an agentic-discovery sitemap, OIDC/OAuth 2.0 discovery for the Shopify Customer Account API, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and complete buyer-approved checkouts. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled here as part of the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Balloon
providers.description: Balloon is a research-backed team collaboration and decision-making platform built to eliminate groupthink and give quieter voices a psychologically safe way to contribute. Its core workflow, called a "flight," is a two-stage, partly anonymous process in which a leader poses a question, team members submit ideas ("balloons") and discuss them, and the group then evaluates and "pumps" the strongest ideas on merit, surfacing a Balloon Score that shows consensus and buy-in. Balloon ships 150+ expert-authored flight templates across 25 business areas and supports asynchronous, time-zone-independent participation, positioning itself as a replacement for status and ideation meetings (the company cites a 70% reduction in meeting time and that ~80% of information shared is new to the organization). Founded by Amanda Greenberg and Noah Bornstein, Balloon is backed by 500 Global and other investors, with an advisory board including Adam Grant, Amy Edmondson, and Daniel Pink. It is a SaaS web application (app at balloon.app) with no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Bancomat
providers.description: BANCOMAT S.p.A. is Italy's leading payment network operator managing the PagoBancomat debit card scheme, ATM network, and BANCOMAT Pay mobile payment service. Launched in 1983 for ATM withdrawals and expanded in 1986 with PagoBancomat for PIN-based POS payments, the network underpins Italian electronic payment infrastructure. BANCOMAT Pay, introduced in 2019, enables mobile e-commerce and P2P payments linked to bank accounts via phone number and IBAN.

providers.name: Bitmain
providers.description: Bitmain Technologies is a Beijing-based designer and manufacturer of ASIC cryptocurrency-mining hardware, best known for its Antminer line of Bitcoin (SHA-256) and other proof-of-work miners. Bitmain also operates Antpool, one of the world's largest Bitcoin mining pools, which exposes a public HTTP API that lets account operators programmatically read account balances, account and worker hashrate, worker lists, payment history, and pool-wide statistics. The Antpool API authenticates each request with an HMAC-SHA256 signature computed from the operator's user id, API key, and an incrementing nonce, and rate-limits clients to 600 requests per 10 minutes per IP. This company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Cequence Security
providers.description: Cequence Security delivers the Unified API Protection (UAP) platform, combining external API attack-surface discovery, posture and compliance analysis, inline runtime protection, and testing into a single solution for defending web applications, APIs, and AI endpoints against business logic abuse, bot attacks, and fraud. The Cequence product family is organized into API Spyder (agentless external discovery), API Sentinel (API inventory, posture, and compliance), API Spartan (runtime bot and abuse defense), API Security Testing (shift-left OpenAPI conformance and vulnerability testing), and Cequence Defender (inline reverse-proxy enforcement of API policy).

providers.name: ChowNow
providers.description: ChowNow is a Playa Vista, Los Angeles-based restaurant technology company providing commission-free online ordering, branded mobile apps, marketing tools, and operational software purpose-built for independent restaurants. Founded in 2011, ChowNow powers ordering websites, native iOS/Android apps, QR-code dine-in ordering, catering, email and SMS marketing, a rewards program, Flex Delivery, order aggregation, and centralized menu management for 20,000+ restaurants. The platform integrates with 20+ point-of-sale systems including Toast, Square, Revel, Clover, Lightspeed, Heartland Genius, Skytab, and PosiTouch, and syndicates restaurant menus through a Discovery Network spanning Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, and other channels, with optional hand-off to DoorDash, UberEats, and Grubhub for last-mile delivery. ChowNow's business model is flat-fee software-as-a-service for restaurants rather than per-order commissions, and the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks reference, or open developer portal. Third-party integration is handled through pre-built connectors managed inside the restaurant dashboard and a private partnerships program; prospective POS, delivery, and technology partners apply through a partnerships form rather than self-serve API documentation. The company's public GitHub presence consists primarily of forks of open-source Python/JavaScript tooling and archived internal libraries, with no SDK, client library, or specification repositories.

providers.name: Classera
providers.description: Classera is an AI-powered education technology company that goes beyond a traditional Learning Management System (LMS) to deliver a complete education ecosystem spanning LMS, school ERP, fintech and payment solutions, and an educational marketplace, with more than 25 integrated services. Its platform emphasizes gamification, personalization, AI-driven and social learning, and serves K-12 private schools, higher education, ministries of education, and corporate and government training. Classera reports more than 30 million users across 45+ countries and partners including Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, HP, Zoom, and Intel. Headquartered in San Francisco, it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cuyana
providers.description: Cuyana is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer women's fashion brand founded in 2011 by Karla Gallardo and Shilpa Shah, built on a "Fewer, Better Things" philosophy of timeless, high-quality essentials — leather totes and handbags, small leather goods, and apparel — crafted from sustainable, Leather Working Group (LWG) certified materials through ethical manufacturing partnerships. The brand runs an omnichannel direct-to-consumer business across its e-commerce store and a growing fleet of retail locations. Cuyana's storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes agent-facing surfaces on the cuyana.com domain: a live hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp for AI shopping agents (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs), and Shopify Customer Account OAuth/OIDC discovery documents under /.well-known/. Cuyana is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Dayuse
providers.description: Dayuse is a global online marketplace for daytime hotel bookings, letting travelers reserve 3-to-5-star hotel rooms by the hour or for a microstay during the day rather than for an overnight stay, at discounts of up to 75% off the nightly rate. Founded in France in 2010, the platform connects consumers with more than 9,000 partner hotels across roughly 29 countries, with use cases spanning remote work, layovers, wellness and spa access, and privacy. Hoteliers join through the Dayuse partner network and manage daytime inventory via the partner portal. Dayuse is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API is currently published, so this profile captures identity, partner surface, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Dragonfly
providers.description: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory datastore built for performance and scalability, designed as a drop-in replacement for Redis and Memcached with improved efficiency and throughput. Dragonfly uses a multi-threaded, shared-nothing architecture to deliver significantly higher throughput with lower latency than Redis. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to migrate existing workloads.

providers.name: Glassdoor
providers.description: Glassdoor is an online platform for company reviews, salary reports, and job listings, now part of Recruit Holdings (alongside Indeed) and tightly integrated with the broader Workday talent ecosystem. Historically Glassdoor offered a public Partner Job Search / Employer Reviews API (api.glassdoor.com/api/api.htm), but the program was closed to new applications in 2021 and active integrations require an existing partner relationship. Current API access is enterprise sales-led for ATS, programmatic recruitment, and employer-brand partners. No self-serve developer portal is active today.

providers.name: Hill House
providers.description: Hill House Home is a digital-first lifestyle brand that brings beauty and joy to everyday rituals. Since launching with bedding in 2016 it has extended its collections to bath, baby, accessories and apparel, including the widely beloved Nap Dress. The direct-to-consumer storefront at hillhousehome.com runs on Shopify and exposes a live, public Storefront MCP server (catalog search, cart, and store-policy tools) at /api/mcp, plus Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect discovery for customer-scoped access. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and enriched from its public commerce surface.

providers.name: Innertrends
providers.description: InnerTrends is a UK-based analytics and data consultancy that operates as a fractional data department for SaaS marketing and growth teams. Founded in 2015 and based in Norwich, England, it builds a marketing and growth data warehouse that consolidates customer and attribution data, delivers custom reports and customer-journey deep-dive analyses, and provides tracking and measurement consulting for product-led and subscription businesses. The company is ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Investly
providers.description: Investly is a European fintech invoice-financing marketplace that helps growing small and medium-sized businesses unlock working capital by financing their outstanding 30-180 day invoices. Businesses sell their approved invoices through a reverse-auction marketplace where investors bid to fund them, giving merchants the best available price from multiple funding providers and access to cash in 1-3 working days rather than waiting on customer payment terms. Founded by Siim Maivel and operating across Estonia and the United Kingdom, Investly is backed by Speedinvest, Startup Wise Guys, and Founders Capital. The platform serves established businesses across manufacturing, wholesale, construction, logistics, and business-services sectors and has funded invoices worth tens of millions of pounds to date. Investly runs a production HAL/HATEOAS backend API at api.investly.co, though it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Maxwell Financial
providers.description: Maxwell is an end-to-end mortgage-origination technology and services company serving banks, independent mortgage banks, and credit unions. Its platform spans a customizable borrower Point of Sale, a Lender Hub for loan officers (pipeline, application processing, document validation, underwriting, and pricing), Business Intelligence analytics, and outsourced services including Maxwell Fulfillment (processing, underwriting, closing), Maxwell Diligence (QC and due diligence), and Private Label Origination. The product is a hosted SaaS delivered through login-gated lender and borrower hubs with a public documentation hub; it does not publish an open, versioned developer API.

providers.name: Md Ally
providers.description: MD Ally is a New York-based digital health company that integrates telehealth into the 911 emergency response system. Its platform lets emergency dispatchers route low-acuity, non-emergency callers to a virtual care tier, connecting patients with telehealth clinicians, in-network resources, and social services instead of dispatching EMS or defaulting to an emergency-room visit. MD Ally works with public safety agencies and payers to expand traditional two-tier dispatch models, reduce unnecessary ambulance transports and ER visits, and improve patient navigation. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars.

providers.name: Moritz
providers.description: Moritz is an AI-native law firm delivering commercial, corporate, and employment legal work with same-day turnaround at transparent flat-rate pricing. Founded in 2025 by Pamir Ehsas (former outside counsel to OpenAI and Google) and Stefan Mandaric (ex-Fulbright scholar at MIT), the firm uses AI to complete roughly 80% of the work (intake and first draft) with 50+ contracted co-counsel lawyers finalizing every matter. Moritz operates across the EU, US, and Australia and reports having supported more than 100 companies in closing agreements representing over $2B in aggregate contract value. It is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company that raised a $9M seed round backed by 20VC, the Urban Innovation Fund, and 20 unicorn founders. Moritz is a legal-services company; it does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Neuron7.ai
providers.description: Neuron7.ai is an AI service intelligence company whose Service Decision Platform deploys autonomous AI agents for field service, technical support, and customer care. The platform learns from an organization's toughest service challenges, captures and reuses expert tribal knowledge, recommends step-by-step resolutions, and pre-empts equipment failures before they reach customers. Neuron7 integrates with existing CRM, CX, and field service management systems to help technicians and support teams resolve issues faster, prevent downtime, and raise first-time-fix rates. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. Neuron7 exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its public web, security, and compliance footprint.

providers.name: Nitra
providers.description: Nitra is an integrated financial and operational platform — an "operating system" — for independent medical practices, unifying business banking, spend management, payments, accounting, capital, and front-desk automation in one system. Its core products include the Nitra Card (a Visa business card with cashback and vendor pricing), NitraMart (a medical-supplies marketplace), BillPay payment processing, accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Nextech), Trina (an AI assistant for phone reception and invoice matching), and capital products such as lending, equipment financing, and insurance factoring. Nitra primarily serves eye care, aesthetics, dental specialty, and fertility practices as well as multi-site groups. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and HIPAA-aware, holds funds at FDIC-insured banks, and is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital. Nitra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Own (OwnBackup)
providers.description: Own (formerly OwnBackup, now Own from Salesforce) is a SaaS data protection platform that provides backup, recovery, archiving, sandbox seeding, and data security and compliance for cloud applications including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and ServiceNow. Founded in 2015 and acquired by Salesforce in 2024, Own helps organizations protect and manage the data held in their business-critical SaaS systems against loss, corruption, and compliance risk. Own is delivered as a managed product rather than a public developer API platform: it operates a public system status page and a trust center listing its security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, FedRAMP, HDS, GDPR, HIPAA/HITECH) and a published vulnerability disclosure policy, but does not currently publish an open, self-serve REST/OpenAPI developer surface.

providers.name: Pactum
providers.description: Pactum is an AI procurement negotiation platform that deploys autonomous agents to conduct commercial supplier negotiations at scale while enforcing buyer-defined policies and guardrails. Its agent suite spans requisition alignment and negotiation, tactical and post-sourcing sourcing, price-list, discount, payment-terms, and rebate negotiations, letting enterprise procurement teams reach agreements on long-tail spend that would otherwise go unnegotiated. Pactum is a venture-backed enterprise SaaS company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, so this record captures the company's identity plus its published security, trust, and disclosure surface.

providers.name: Pico
providers.description: Pico is a creator-monetization and CRM platform for online creators, publishers, and media companies, built in New York and backed by Bloomberg Beta. It combines an audience CRM with email capture, landing pages, paywalls, memberships, and subscription payments in a single tool so creators can identify their audience, gate premium content, and convert readers into paying members. Pico raised a $6.5M round in 2021 ("Pico 2.0") and a $10M Series A in 2023, when it rebranded to Hype (hype.co). It exposes a developer API — authenticated with an X-Api-Key header and documented at docs.trypico.com — for searching and managing contacts and integrating the platform into custom workflows.

providers.name: PlayPlay
providers.description: PlayPlay is an online video and visual creation platform that lets business teams produce on-brand videos and images without prior editing experience. Through a drag-and-drop editor, AI-assisted tools (text-to-video, script and voice-over generation, automatic subtitles) and enterprise collaboration, brand-kit and review workflows, it serves marketing, communications and HR teams at large organizations. Founded in France and backed by Balderton Capital, Insight Partners and Point Nine, PlayPlay is a SaaS product without a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its published identity, legal and security surface (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).

providers.name: Reevo
providers.description: Reevo is an AI-native revenue platform ("revenue operating system") that consolidates the sales workflow into one system across four products: Find (lead sourcing, enrichment, routing and scoring), Engage (email sequences, dialing, inbox and meeting prep), Win (deal monitoring, smart task logging and coaching) and Foundation (a native CRM with an AI copilot, reporting, workflows and integrations). It helps GTM teams eliminate tool sprawl and automate repetitive sales work. Backed by Kleiner Perkins; API access is listed as a paid-plan feature but no public developer documentation or OpenAPI is published.

providers.name: Revel Ai Health
providers.description: RevelAi Health is a healthcare technology company building a conversational AI platform for orthopedic and musculoskeletal care teams. Its AI agent, "kimi," automates patient outreach, triage, clinical documentation, and follow-up across the care episode, supporting value-based care models, quality reporting, and Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROM) collection. The platform offers multilingual population-health outreach across voice, text, and email, ambient clinical documentation, and AI-augmented staffing and task management for ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals and health systems, and physician practices. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance programs. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Revion
providers.description: Revion builds an AI-powered operating system for automotive retail service operations. Its voice-first platform lets dealership technicians dictate repair information hands-free, automatically structuring their speech into repair orders, multi-point inspections, and service recommendations in real time so shops can service more vehicles and capture more high-margin work. Revion is a Winter 2026 Y Combinator company based in New York City, operating across US and EU regions. As of this profile Revion is an early-stage product company with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this entry captures its public identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Runbooks
providers.description: Runbooks is an all-in-one IT operations platform purpose-built for IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs). It consolidates ITSM (service desk, ticketing, incident management, knowledge base, SLA management), ITAM (hardware and software asset tracking, lifecycle management, warranty tracking, QR code asset labels), BizOps (CRM, client management, quarterly business reviews, budget forecasting, vendor management), SecOps (audit logs, MFA, password management), and Insights (automated reports, satisfaction tracking, quality assurance, KPI analytics) into a single integrated system. The platform targets IT departments and MSPs managing 50-5,000 users at a flat $25 per tech per month pricing model with no tiers or hidden fees. Runbooks is SOC 2 compliant with 99.9% uptime.

providers.name: SPOTIO
providers.description: SPOTIO is a field sales engagement and territory management platform for outside sales teams - lead and prospect tracking, activity logging, territory mapping and assignment, route optimization, appointment setting, and pipeline visibility, delivered through a mobile-first field app and a web console. For custom integrations beyond its native Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive, and Zapier connectors, SPOTIO publishes a documented Open REST API and outbound webhooks. The developer portal (developer.spotio2.com, powered by Stoplight) covers a curl quickstart and token authentication; full endpoint reference access is oriented toward enterprise customers with an API key, so the logical APIs below are honestly modeled from SPOTIO's documented product surface and webhook event catalog rather than a published OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Standard Industries
providers.description: Standard Industries is a privately-held global industrial company headquartered in New York City and tracing its origins to 1886. The company operates a portfolio of building solutions, performance materials, logistics, real estate, and investment businesses, with more than 20,000 employees and approximately $11 billion in annual revenues. Standard Building Solutions includes GAF (North America's largest roofing manufacturer), GAF Energy (Timberline Solar nailable solar shingles), BMI Group (Europe's largest pitched and flat roofing manufacturer, with brands including Braas, Monier, Icopal, Wolfin, and Redland), Siplast (specialty roofing and waterproofing for iconic structures), SGI (mining and mineral processing), Schiedel (flue, stove, and ventilation systems), and Standard Logistics. Performance Materials is anchored by W. R. Grace & Co., which produces catalysts, engineered materials, process technologies, and fine chemicals. Standard Investments deploys capital across public equities and early-to-growth venture investments. Winter Properties is a vertically integrated real estate firm with more than 100 years of history in New York City. Standard Industries does not publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology integration with customers and partners is handled inside the individual operating companies (most notably GAF and Grace).

providers.name: Symbl.ai
providers.description: Symbl.ai is a conversation-intelligence platform for understanding and generating insights from human conversations across voice, video, and text. Its developer platform exposed Async, Streaming, and Telephony APIs plus the Nebula LLM for real-time speech-to-text and conversational insights — action items, topics, questions, follow-ups, sentiment, and custom trackers — with first-party SDKs for JavaScript, Web (browser), Python, and Go. Symbl.ai was acquired by Invoca; the standalone developer platform (api./docs./platform. symbl.ai) has since been decommissioned, but the official client SDKs remain published on npm, PyPI, pkg.go.dev, and the github.com/symblai organization, and the marketing, blog, pricing, and support surfaces stay live.

providers.name: Tempo Labs
providers.description: Tempo (Tempo Labs) is an AI app builder at tempo.new positioned around the "Prompt. Develop. Design. Collaborate." loop - users describe an app in natural language, Tempo generates code, and developers iterate either in the visual canvas or directly in code. The product targets design-to-code and prompt-to-code workflows for React / Next.js apps and is primarily consumed as a hosted web product rather than as an API. Public developer surface is limited; integrations and connected services (auth, database, hosting) are surfaced inside the product rather than via a documented public API.

providers.name: Ten Little
providers.description: Ten Little is a direct-to-consumer children's footwear and essentials brand that designs healthy, non-toxic shoes for babies and kids. Its APMA-approved shoes use a proprietary TenForm Fit System — wide, foot-shaped toe boxes and flexible zero-drop soles grounded in medical and biomechanical research — to support natural movement and healthy foot development at every size and stage, and to accommodate AFO/SMO orthotics and braces. The brand sells online through a Shopify storefront and publishes no first-party developer API; the only API surfaces reachable on its domain are Shopify's platform-level Customer Account OIDC/OAuth and MCP endpoints.

providers.name: Terex
providers.description: Terex Corporation is a global manufacturer of aerial work platforms and materials processing equipment. Terex provides digital telematics solutions through its MyTerex platform and Connect by Terex for remote diagnostics, fleet management, and predictive maintenance of construction and industrial equipment.

providers.name: WABCO Holdings
providers.description: WABCO Holdings was a leading global supplier of technologies and services that improve the safety, efficiency, and connectivity of commercial vehicles. The company developed advanced braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems. WABCO was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen in 2020 and now operates as ZF's Commercial Vehicle Control Systems division, continuing to serve OEMs, fleets, and aftermarket customers worldwide with integrated telematics, fleet management, and vehicle safety technologies.

providers.name: Winn.ai
providers.description: Winn.ai is an AI-powered revenue execution platform for B2B sales teams that joins live sales calls to provide real-time playbook guidance, coach representatives on messaging and objection handling, and automate administrative work such as meeting note-taking, follow-up drafting, and CRM data entry. The product sits on top of a team's existing sales stack and reports outcomes including higher playbook adoption, dramatically higher CRM fill rates, and a large reduction in post-call admin work. Winn.ai is a privately held company backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a product web application and a Vanta-hosted trust center (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, webhooks, or specification surface.

providers.name: Wolf
providers.description: Wolf (fromwolf.com) is a white-label, multi-tenant staffing and gig-work platform that lets staffing companies run their own branded on-demand workforce. Its API coordinates job seekers, clients, campaigns (client orders), shifts, tenders (a seeker's request to work a shift), applications, timesheets, availability, notifications, and in-app chat — everything needed to build a client- or worker-facing staffing interface on top of the Wolf backend. Each tenant runs on its own database and authenticates with a tenant key plus a platform API key or per-user authentication token. Wolf was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: WorkForce Software
providers.description: WorkForce Software, an ADP company since October 2024, makes the WorkForce Suite, an enterprise workforce management platform covering time and attendance, employee scheduling, absence and leave management, labor forecasting, data capture, and payroll compliance for large, complex organizations. The Suite integrates with leading HCM and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, ADP) via RESTful APIs, SOAP APIs, and file-based interfaces, with SSO/SLO and MFA support; API and integration documentation is provided to customers through the WorkForce Software community portal rather than a public developer portal.

providers.name: Zibra AI
providers.description: Zibra AI is a Ukrainian deep-tech company building AI-powered real-time volumetric rendering and compression technology for VFX, gaming, virtual production, film, and TV. Its flagship product, ZibraVDB, compresses OpenVDB volumetric datasets to roughly five percent of their original size while preserving visual quality, enabling real-time playback of smoke, fire, fog, and other volumetric effects. Zibra ships a native C++ ZibraVDB SDK (DirectX 12, Vulkan, and Metal on Windows, Linux, and macOS) alongside plugins for Unreal Engine, Houdini, and Unity, with Blender support in progress. It exposes no public REST/HTTP API; integration is through the SDK and digital-content-creation plugins. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Accenture
providers.description: A global professional services company providing consulting, technology, and outsourcing services. Serves clients across more than 40 industries in over 120 countries with expertise in digital transformation, cloud, and AI.

providers.name: Anheuser-Busch
providers.description: An American brewing company and subsidiary of AB InBev producing iconic beer brands including Budweiser, Bud Light, Michelob, and Stella Artois. One of the largest beverage producers in North America with operations across brewing, distribution, and marketing.

providers.name: Arcserve
providers.description: Arcserve is a data protection, backup, and disaster recovery software vendor that helps organizations safeguard business-critical data across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Its Unified Data Protection (UDP) platform combines backup, replication, high availability, immutable storage, and AI-assisted ransomware detection, alongside SaaS Backup for cloud application data and Replication and High Availability (RHA) for continuous availability. Arcserve sells through MSPs, resellers, and direct channels with a usage-based pricing model. Programmatic surfaces are product-internal (a SOAP API for RHA scenario control and HTTP/PowerShell control of the UDP Console) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Base Ai
providers.description: Base is an AI Engagement OS for customer-led growth (CLG). The platform unifies advocacy, references, referrals, reviews, community, customer success, lifecycle engagement, and revenue attribution for B2B post-sale teams. Built for customer marketing, customer success, and RevOps teams, Base uses 100+ AI agents to automate onboarding, adoption, upsell/expansion, retention, and advocacy across the entire post-sale customer lifecycle, and to turn customer signals and feedback into references, testimonials, and expansion plays. Base integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, Slack, and Zendesk, and is backed by Wing Venture Capital. Base does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference.

providers.name: BetterUp
providers.description: BetterUp is an enterprise Human Transformation Platform that combines human and AI-powered coaching, grounded in behavioral science and enterprise data, to help organizations develop leaders, managers, and their broader workforce. Founded by Alexi Robichaux, BetterUp serves 750+ enterprise customers including Google, Salesforce, Moderna, and Workday, with a network of 4,000+ coaches across 70+ countries. The platform delivers leadership development, manager effectiveness, AI coaching, and workforce resilience programs. BetterUp is HR-tech / organizational-development software and exposes no public developer API; platform integration is delivered through packaged enterprise connectors (Workday, Salesforce, Slack, Microsoft Viva, SAP SuccessFactors, Degreed) plus HRIS and SSO provisioning. Sector: hr-tech.

providers.name: Blng
providers.description: BLNG is an AI-driven creative suite for the jewelry industry, giving jewelers, designers, brands, and retailers tools to explore, refine, and present designs fast and without compromise. Its Design product turns sketches, doodles, photos, illustrations, or text prompts into photorealistic renderings on web and iOS; Studio transforms CAD models into market-ready marketing photos and videos at scale; and Retail enables live, made-to-order design in-store. BLNG is a Speedinvest portfolio company. It publishes a consumer/professional application and product documentation, but no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface at this time.

providers.name: Bookbub
providers.description: BookBub is a book-discovery and ebook-deals platform that connects a membership of over 10 million power readers with limited-time discounted ebooks, new releases, and preorders across major retailers (Kindle, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Google Play) in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. For readers it curates personalized daily deal alerts and recommendations; for authors and publishers it operates a partner side offering Featured Deals promotions, BookBub Ads (a self-serve display advertising platform), preorder and new-release alerts, author profiles, and free marketing tools, all managed through the Partner Dashboard. BookBub is backed by Bloomberg Beta. No public developer API is currently published; partner tooling is delivered through the web dashboard rather than a documented API surface.

providers.name: Brand.ai
providers.description: Brand.ai (Access to Tools Inc.) is a San Francisco-based AI platform for brand management that converts a company's brand assets into machine-readable intelligence so that people and AI agents can maintain brand consistency across tools and workflows. The product has two parts: Brand OS, which structures brand data through a Brand Foundation, Brand Ontology, Daily Signals and connected applications; and Brand Studio, which provides asset creation, a visual strategy Canvas, project management and Brand Check validation. Founded in 2024 and backed by Uncork Capital, the company targets brand builders, agencies and enterprise teams. Brand.ai is not a public developer API provider — it is a demo-gated SaaS platform with a published security posture (SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, CCPA), a Vanta trust center and a public status page, but no public API, SDK or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Canadian Tire Bank
providers.description: Canadian Tire Bank (operating as Canadian Tire Financial Services) is a federally regulated Schedule I bank, wholly owned by Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited and federally chartered in 2003. Headquartered in Oakville, Ontario with operations in St. Catharines and Welland, the bank is the financial-services arm of one of Canada's best-known retailers. It issues the Triangle Mastercard, Triangle World Mastercard, Triangle World Elite Mastercard, Gas Advantage and Cash Advantage Mastercards, and offers high-interest savings accounts and GICs, all tied to the Triangle Rewards loyalty program. On open finance, the bank exposes no first-party public developer API or banking API portal. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / Fall Economic Statement 2024, overseen by the FCAC) is legislated but not yet operational, so consumer data access today is voluntary and aggregator-based — Canadian Tire Bank card and account data is reached through aggregators such as Finicity (by Mastercard), Flinks and Plaid rather than a first-party API. The cantire.com developer portal is run by the retail parent Canadian Tire Corporation, not the bank, is gated behind sign-in, and its TLS certificate expired in February 2026.

providers.name: Cape Analytics
providers.description: Cape Analytics (now part of Moody's) is a geospatial property intelligence provider that applies computer vision and machine learning to high-resolution aerial and satellite imagery, property records, and other novel data sources to produce inspection-quality condition and characteristic data for over 100 million residential and commercial structures across the United States and Canada. Its insights — roof condition and material, swimming pools, solar panels, accessory structures, tree overhang, wildfire and wind exposure, distance to hazards, and a proprietary Liquidity Score — are delivered to insurance underwriters, lenders, and real estate investors in under two seconds via API, batch/bulk files, an Automated Property Condition Report (aPCR), and a customer web portal, as well as through third-party platforms such as Guidewire and Duck Creek. Cape does not publish a public, self-service developer portal or open API specification; API access is provisioned to customers and partners through a gated onboarding flow.

providers.name: Chai Research
providers.description: Chai Research Corp. (CHAI) is a Palo Alto consumer AI company building a character-and-story chat platform, where users create and talk to AI characters on iOS, Android and the web. Founded in 2021 by William Beauchamp, the company trains and serves its own conversational language models on an in-house GPU cluster, and runs Chaiverse — a developer platform where outside model builders submit HuggingFace-hosted language models, have them deployed to real Chai App users, and compete on a public leaderboard. A public Chat API (api.chai-research.com) and a chaiverse pip package were previously documented; both have since been withdrawn — see x-coverage.

providers.name: Chemius
providers.description: Chemius is a cloud-based chemical compliance platform that automates Safety Data Sheet (SDS), Technical Data Sheet (TDS), and regulatory label creation in 38+ languages for organizations handling chemical products. The platform exposes an API suite covering SDS, TDS, ADR transport documentation, ERP integration, labels, web shop product data, and PDF generation, and offers AI-assisted authoring through the Chemius AI SDS assistant. Chemius is hosted in DIN ISO/IEC 27001-certified German data centers and supports CLP 1272/2008, REACH 1907/2006, detergents, aerosols, and US OSHA / GHS regulatory frameworks.

providers.name: Coast Capital Savings
providers.description: Coast Capital Savings is a member-owned financial co-operative headquartered in Surrey, British Columbia, serving over 600,000 members across roughly 45 branches. On November 1, 2018 it became Canada's first British Columbia-based federal credit union (regulated federally rather than provincially), and in May 2026 it completed a merger with Prospera Credit Union. With approximately $21.9 billion CAD in total assets it is one of Canada's largest credit unions. As a cooperative credit union rather than a Schedule I/II bank, Coast Capital operates within Canada's voluntary and still-fragmented open-finance landscape: the federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework legislated under Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC) as overseer, is not yet operational. Coast Capital publishes NO public first-party developer portal or documented API; consumer financial-data access today is aggregator-mediated (e.g. Plaid) via screen-scraping/credential-based connections rather than a first-party API.

providers.name: Codewisp
providers.description: Codewisp is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and publish real web games from natural-language prompts, with no coding or game-development tools required. Users describe the game they want and the platform generates the code, structure, and assets automatically, supporting 2D, 3D, and multiplayer browser games with instant, prompt-driven refinement. Founded by game developer Elvin Fu and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch, Codewisp reports 2,000+ weekly active creators and 17,000+ games created, offering a browser-based block editor, a community explore and marketplace surface, and shareable instant-play links. Codewisp is a consumer creation product and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: ConnectRN
providers.description: connectRN is a Waltham, Massachusetts based per-diem (PRN) healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nurses, CNAs and allied clinicians with open shifts at hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and skilled nursing facilities across the United States. Clinicians browse and claim shifts through the connectRN mobile app with no minimum commitment, no required weekends or holidays, and same-day pay; facilities post shifts, auto-backfill open coverage and approve timesheets through a web platform at app.connectrn.com. In April 2026 connectRN merged with SnapCare, combining connectRN's PRN clinician community with SnapCare's Booker workforce technology platform. connectRN operates a public status page but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its API host api.connectrn.com serves the first-party mobile and web applications only.

providers.name: Continuum
providers.description: Continuum (gocontinuum.ai) is an AI-powered platform that automates B2B returns, warranties, and repairs for distributors and manufacturers. It handles the post-sales workflow end to end through four solution hubs: a Customer Hub with self-service warranty and return portals, a Warehouse Hub for one-click receiving, inspection and dispute processing, a Vendor & Finance Hub for automated vendor engagement and accounts-receivable management, and a Manufacturer Warranty Hub for warranty claim automation. The company reports outcomes such as a 70% reduction in returns labor cost, a 30% increase in profitability, and an 8% reduction in customer churn. Continuum integrates with major distribution ERP systems (Infor, NetSuite, Epicor, Oracle, Acumatica). Based in Chicago, it is seed-funded and backed by Cowboy Ventures. Continuum is SOC 2 audited and publishes a public trust center. No public developer API or documentation is available at this time.

providers.name: dv01
providers.description: dv01 is an "InvestorTech" data and analytics platform for the structured finance and consumer-lending markets, part of Fitch Group. It aggregates, standardizes, and validates loan-level data across asset classes (RMBS, auto, student loans, personal loans, buy-now-pay-later) and delivers it, along with reporting and surveillance tooling, to issuers, lenders, and investors. Products include Data Direct, Data Management, DealStudio, Securitizations, Tape Cracker, and portfolio/market surveillance. dv01 publishes no public developer REST API or OpenAPI; data is delivered into client environments via Snowflake Data Share, BigQuery, SFTP, and S3. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital and enriched with verified public identity, compliance, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Enzai
providers.description: Enzai is an enterprise AI governance platform that helps organizations adopt AI while managing regulatory and operational risk. Its product suite spans agentic AI governance (real-time analysis, risk flagging, and agent-sprawl management), AI use-case intake and approval workflows, a centralized AI registry inventorying first- and third-party AI systems, and compliance frameworks that map AI initiatives to the EU AI Act, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001. Enzai is headquartered in Belfast with a London office, is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by venture capital including Seedcamp. No public API or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: FordPass / Ford Pro
providers.description: FordPass is Ford Motor Company's consumer connected-vehicle mobile app and service platform for Ford and Lincoln owners, exposing remote start/stop, remote lock/unlock, vehicle status (fuel/charge, tire pressure, oil life, odometer, location), Vehicle Health alerts, BlueCruise hands-free driving, Wi-Fi hotspot, Phone As A Key, scheduled service, and roadside assistance via the embedded FordPass Connect 4G LTE modem. Ford Pro is Ford's commercial fleet brand spanning Ford Pro Telematics, Ford Pro Intelligence, Ford Pro E-Telematics for EVs, Ford Pro Charging, Ford Pro FinSimple, and dealer/upfit services. The Ford Developer Marketplace (developer.ford.com) hosts Ford's partner-facing API program — FordConnect Query API for consumer-vehicle data and remote command access (with vehicle-owner consent via FordPass account OAuth), plus a Ford Pro REST API surface for fleets including Vehicle Status, Vehicle Historical Status, Vehicle Metadata, Vehicle Efficiency (fuel/energy/idle), Driver Behavior, Trip Reports, and Vehicle Health. Ford Pro Telematics is integrated with Geotab, Fleetio, Samsara, Motive, Verizon Connect, and other fleet platforms, and Smartcar offers a consumer OAuth bridge to Ford vehicles using FordPass Connect credentials. Access to Ford APIs is gated behind a partner application and credentials issued through the Ford Developer Portal; Ford has periodically restricted individual-developer access. No public OpenAPI specification is published outside the partner portal, so this profile documents the Ford developer surface as an index without a generated machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Genmo
providers.description: Genmo is a San Francisco research lab building open-source video generation models. Its flagship release, Mochi 1, is an Apache-2.0 licensed 10B-parameter text-to-video diffusion model (AsymmDiT architecture) with strong prompt adherence and high-fidelity motion. Genmo does NOT publish a first-party hosted developer REST API. Programmatic access to Mochi comes in three honest forms: (1) the open-source model itself, self-hosted via the repo's Python pipeline ("simple composable API"), CLI, Gradio UI, or ComfyUI; (2) third-party hosted inference APIs from partners such as Replicate and fal.ai; and (3) a credit-based consumer web app and Playground at genmo.ai/play. The endpoints documented here for hosted access are modeled from partner documentation and are not operated by Genmo.

providers.name: Heard
providers.description: Heard (Heard Technologies, Inc.) is the financial management platform built specifically for therapists and wellness practitioners in private practice. Founded in 2019 and based in Seattle, Washington, Heard pairs easy-to-use software with a dedicated human team to handle bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and business banking in a single subscription, so licensed mental health and allied health clinicians can focus on their clients. Heard serves solo and single-owner group practices across the United States, from newer sole proprietors to established S corporations, and connects with tools practices already use such as SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, Headway, Jane App, Stripe, and Square. Heard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company identity, its public web properties, and the published llms.txt.

providers.name: HyperWrite
providers.description: HyperWrite (by OthersideAI) is an AI writing assistant plus Personal Assistant and Agent product line that combines AutoWrite, TypeAhead, HyperChat, an AI Document Editor, Scholar AI research, and a Chrome extension that lets an agent take real actions in the browser (Gmail, LinkedIn, shopping, travel). HyperWrite has historically described a partner/API program for its agent, but there is no fully public self-serve API reference - profiled here through the consumer product surface.

providers.name: Imubit
providers.description: Imubit is a Houston-based industrial AI company behind the Optimizing Brain, the process industry's first Closed Loop AI Optimization (AIO) solution powered by deep reinforcement learning. Its cloud-based platform learns a dynamic model from a plant's own historian and DCS data, then writes optimal setpoints back through existing control-system infrastructure to continuously optimize throughput, yield, energy use and emissions. Imubit reports 100+ closed-loop applications deployed across refining, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals and polymers, cement and building materials, and mining, minerals and metals, and is trusted by 7 of the 10 largest U.S. refiners. Imubit publishes no public developer API; its GitHub organization ships open-source Python libraries for pulling data from industrial historians (OSIsoft PI, Aspen IP21) and supporting infrastructure.

providers.name: Indigo Agriculture
providers.description: Indigo Agriculture is a Boston-based agriculture-technology company combining microbial seed and foliar treatments (biotrinsic) and on-farm seed treatment hardware (CLIPS) with two large supply-chain programs: Carbon by Indigo, a soil-carbon program that pays growers for verified carbon credits using Indigo's proprietary measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) stack; and Source by Indigo, a Scope-3 program that connects consumer-goods buyers to sustainably grown crops with greenhouse-gas, water, and low-carbon-biofuel outcome reporting. Indigo does not publish a public developer portal; partner and supply-chain integrations are negotiated directly through their team.

providers.name: LF AI and Data
providers.description: The LF AI & Data Foundation is a Linux Foundation umbrella that advances open source artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data projects. It hosts 80+ projects spanning graduated, incubation, and sandbox stages, including ONNX, Milvus, Horovod, Flyte, Kedro, Pyro, Egeria, OpenLineage, Marquez, and the Adversarial Robustness Toolbox, fostering scalable, trustworthy, and interoperable AI and data solutions.

providers.name: Limehome
providers.description: Limehome is a Munich-headquartered digital hospitality operator founded in 2018 that designs, leases and runs fully-equipped design apartments and aparthotels across Europe, from Berlin to Barcelona and Linz to Lecce. The company runs a 100% digital guest journey: guests browse and book units online, receive an access code, and complete check-in and check-out contactlessly with no on-site reception staff. Limehome operates offices in Munich and Madrid with more than 200 employees, is led by CEOs Dr. Josef Vollmayr and Cesar de Sousa Freitas, and is backed by Picus Capital, HV Capital and Lakestar. Revenue comes from direct bookings (fee-free, with a 15% membership discount) alongside a "Lease to Limehome" real-estate partnership model. Limehome runs a production API host at api.limehome.com behind AWS API Gateway, but publishes no public developer portal, documentation or machine-readable specification; that surface is first-party/private. The company does maintain a public GitHub organization with a small number of open-source engineering libraries, and an engineering blog.

providers.name: Lizzyai
providers.description: Lizzy is a generative-AI platform for legal professionals, delivering a secure Gen AI workspace across all practice areas through both a web application and a Microsoft Word/Outlook add-in. It supports contract drafting, review, analysis, and proofreading, customizable legal workflows and playbooks, in-document citations, redlining and track-changes, and the handling of long, scanned, watermarked, and multiple documents. A multi-LLM approach routes each task to the most capable model, and firms can train a private model that embeds their own know-how. Built for enterprise IT with a zero-trust architecture, no training on customer data, PII anonymization, SSO via SAML and OAuth 2.0, and shared, VPC, or self-hosted deployment options.

providers.name: Lovable
providers.description: Lovable is an AI app builder that generates full-stack web applications from natural- language prompts, with live preview, GitHub sync, and Supabase / Firebase integration. Lovable's developer-facing surface is in early release: the "Build with URL" API generates apps from a shareable URL, and the Lovable MCP Server lets AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor) manage Lovable projects via Model Context Protocol.

providers.name: Material Security
providers.description: Material Security is a cloud workspace security platform for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. It connects via API (not an inline gateway) to give security teams unified detection and response across email, accounts and identity, and sensitive data — protecting against advanced email threats and phishing, preventing risky file sharing while automatically classifying sensitive data, and detecting account takeover and identity threats. Material is a private company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Amplify Partners.

providers.name: Metamarkets Group
providers.description: Metamarkets was a real-time analytics platform for programmatic advertising, giving ad exchanges, SSPs, DSPs, and ad networks interactive dashboards over billions of daily bid, impression, click, and spend events. Its Real-time Data Ingestion (RDI) API accepted continuous streams of OpenRTB-based JSON event records over authenticated HTTPS POST, surfacing them in the Metamarkets dashboard within seconds. Founded in 2010 and the birthplace of the Druid analytics database (now Apache Druid), Metamarkets was acquired by Snap Inc. in 2017; its successor products live on as Rill Data. This profile enriches the dcvc portfolio lead from the surviving public documentation at docs.metamarkets.com.

providers.name: MORI
providers.description: MORI (Baby Mori) is a UK-based, online-first baby and children's brand founded in 2015 by Akin Onal, known for soft essentials made from a proprietary bamboo and organic cotton fabric blend. Its direct-to-consumer range spans sleepwear, daywear, footwear, blankets and muslins, nursery and home goods, and a Sleep Club subscription, shipping across the UK, US, and Europe. MORI operates as a Shopify-hosted e-commerce business and does not publish a first-party developer API. Its machine-readable surface is provided natively by the Shopify platform: a live Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (search_catalog, get_cart, update_cart, get_product_details, search_shop_policies_and_faqs), a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, an agent-instructions /llms.txt (mirrored at /agents.md), and the Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth discovery. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Motif
providers.description: Motif is an AEC (architecture, engineering, and construction) software company building an intelligent, browser-based workspace for building design. Founded in 2023 by former Autodesk leaders Amar Hanspal and Brian Mathews, Motif unifies sheet review, live 3D streaming, AI-assisted visual exploration, and real-time collaboration in a single cloud platform that bridges 2D and 3D workflows as a step toward making Building Information Modeling (BIM) a practical reality. The company has raised $46M led by Redpoint Ventures (seed) and Alphabet's CapitalG (Series A), and was named to Forbes' 2025 Next Billion-Dollar Startups list. Motif is a collaboration SaaS product for design and construction teams; it publishes product learning docs and a help center but does not yet expose a public developer API — a plugin/API surface is part of its stated long-term strategy.

providers.name: MUBI
providers.description: MUBI is a London-headquartered global streaming service, film distributor and production company founded in 2007 by Efe Cakarel (originally as The Auteurs, rebranded MUBI in 2010). It operates a curated subscription video-on-demand service for arthouse, independent, documentary and world cinema across more than 190 countries, alongside MUBI GO (weekly cinema tickets), the Notebook film-criticism publication and print magazine, MUBI Editions, a merchandise shop, and theatrical distribution and sales arms including The Match Factory and Cineart. MUBI publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification; the api.mubi.com host serves its own first-party web, mobile and TV clients only.

providers.name: Northspyre
providers.description: Northspyre is a real estate development management platform that gives owners, developers, and project teams an end-to-end system for managing deals, projects, and portfolios across the full development lifecycle — acquisition, early planning, pre-development, construction, and stabilization. It unifies siloed project data and automates routine work with tools for financial modeling and deal pipeline management, budget and cost control, vendor procurement and management, forecasting, portfolio analytics, and investor and lender reporting. Northspyre is delivered as a hosted SaaS application and is SOC 2 Type II certified. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity, compliance posture, and domain security.

providers.name: Openroll
providers.description: Openroll is an AI-native operating system for compensation, built for People and Finance teams. It connects to existing HRIS, ATS, ERP, and finance systems, runs fully auditable analyses, and turns repeated workflows into agentic operations - covering compensation reviews, salary bands, headcount planning, pay-strategy monitoring, and actuals-versus-budget variance. Founded in 2024 and backed by Y Combinator, Openroll operates from San Francisco and Stockholm, is SOC 2 Type I and Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and never uses customer data to train its AI models.

providers.name: People.ai
providers.description: People.ai is an AI-powered revenue intelligence platform for enterprise sales teams. It automatically captures sales activity and contact data from email, calendar, and meetings, matches it into CRM systems like Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics 365, and delivers AI-driven forecasting, opportunity management, account execution, and engagement forensics to improve pipeline visibility and drive predictable revenue growth. People.ai integrates with Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Slack, Zoom, Webex, 6sense, and ZoomInfo. It is delivered as an enterprise SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API; its trust and security posture is documented with SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, GDPR, and CSA STAR. As of 2026 People.ai has rebranded to Backstory (www.people.ai now 301-redirects to www.backstory.ai); the product login remains at app.people.ai.

providers.name: Proximie
providers.description: Proximie is a health-tech company building a cloud platform it describes as the operating system for intelligent operating rooms, connecting surgical teams, medical devices, and data for remote telementoring, telesurgery, session recording, and AI-powered surgical insights across 500+ facilities in 50 countries. For developers, Proximie ships a pre-release C++ SDK (media streaming and session management, with an internal REST layer) and runs a Development Partners program that lets OEMs and medtech companies embed real-time connectivity, secure data routing, and white-label collaboration into their own devices. Proximie also open-sources WebRTC/Janus tooling (jarust, janus-mobile-sdk). Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Reinsurance Group of America
providers.description: Reinsurance Group of America (RGA) is a leading global provider of life and health reinsurance and financial solutions, serving clients in more than 70 countries. RGA offers digital health data scoring APIs, underwriting automation, risk assessment tools, and client portal integrations for insurance carriers and reinsurers.

providers.name: Relevize
providers.description: Relevize is an AI-driven partner payments and channel marketing platform that helps B2B companies run Market Development Funds (MDF), SPIFs, and partner incentive programs. It combines virtual and physical expense cards (Magic Cards) with spending controls, AI-powered claims and receipt processing that cuts submission time, automated purchase orders and vendor invoicing, and a compliance engine that validates proof of execution. A companion DemandGen product runs partner-led demand generation campaigns. Customers include Apptio, Atlassian, Chili Piper, New Relic, and WatchGuard. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Insight Partners.

providers.name: Rocksalt
providers.description: Rocksalt is a B2B inbound and social-engagement platform, headquartered in Redwood City, California and founded in 2023 by Arjun Moorthy (CEO), Anita Moorthy (CMO), and Ajoy Sojan (CTO). The product helps founders, executives, and subject-matter experts build visibility and win business on LinkedIn and Reddit in roughly ten minutes a day: an AI-powered digest surfaces the industry conversations worth joining, suggests personalized comments grounded in the user's expertise, assists with post creation, and adds team collaboration workflows plus analytics and HubSpot CRM sync. Rocksalt raised seed funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2025. It is a marketing SaaS application delivered through a web app rather than a public developer API; this profile was surfaced from the Lightspeed portfolio and enriched with the company's public identity and web properties.

providers.name: SafeGraph
providers.description: SafeGraph is a geospatial data company that builds and maintains high-quality Point of Interest (POI), building geometry, and geocoded address datasets used for location intelligence, site selection, competitive analysis, and machine-learning models. Its core products are Places (millions of POIs with base, rich, and premium attributes), Geometry (building-footprint polygons), Address (structured geocoded addresses across 25+ countries), and Spend (transaction data). Rather than a hosted REST API, SafeGraph delivers data as bulk parquet files via S3, Snowflake, AWS Data Exchange, CARTO, Databricks, and ArcGIS. Surfaced originally as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched here from SafeGraph's public documentation, changelog, and packages.

providers.name: Scopio, Scopio LLC
providers.description: Scopio (Scopio LLC) is a New York-based global visual-content marketplace and creative-talent platform, founded in 2017 and backed by 500 Global. It connects businesses with a network of 25,000+ vetted photographers and visual artists across 172 countries and a library of more than three million authentic, diverse stock images that can be licensed under standard, extended, and editorial licenses. Brands including Disney, Microsoft, and Meta use Scopio to hire creative talent and source unique imagery, with AI used to sort, tag, title, and feature contributed work. Scopio operates as a consumer- and business-facing web and mobile marketplace (Shopify-hosted storefront plus iOS/Android artist apps); it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Simantic
providers.description: Simantic builds simulated hardware for embedded QA, modernizing embedded firmware development through hardware simulation designed for AI adoption in hardware engineering. Its platform emulates microcontroller (MCU) systems so engineers can inject sensor readings and observe how their firmware reacts over CAN, Ethernet, and BLE, running full firmware test suites in CI (for example GitHub Actions) on every push and pull request without physical boards. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets AI agents step through firmware, inspect peripheral state, and replay scenarios against a simulated MCU, and a CLI drives simulations locally. Simantic offers private, self-hosted deployment so firmware and test data never leave a team's own servers. Founded in 2025, Simantic is a Y Combinator (Fall 2026) company.

providers.name: Softheon
providers.description: Softheon is a healthcare technology company that provides SaaS software for health plans, brokers, and government agencies to run shopping and enrollment, billing and payments, member renewals, reporting and analytics, and compliance across the ACA marketplace, ICHRA, dental, and Medicare Advantage markets. Its all-in-one platform automates health-insurance administration end to end and is increasingly layering in agentic AI to streamline operations at scale. Founded around 2000 and headquartered in Stony Brook, New York, Softheon operates a developer portal (developer.softheon.com) and a compliance trust center, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Streamloots
providers.description: Streamloots is a monetization platform for live-streaming creators and their communities, originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It lets streamers turn viewers into paying supporters through interactive collectible Cards that trigger on-stream moments, plus Subscriptions, Auctions, a Marathon goal timer, and Tips. The platform works across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Facebook, and Trovo, offers creator-favorable revenue splits and bi-monthly payouts, and provides fraud protection, a points store, and browser/OBS alert overlays. Streamloots runs a backend API at api.streamloots.com that powers its apps and Twitch Extension, but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sumary
providers.description: Sumary is a Denmark-based fintech building an AI-native workflow engine for finance and accounting teams. Its platform layers autonomous accounting agents, anomaly detection, and on-demand reporting over a company's existing accounting systems — automating reconciliations and variance explanations, validating transactions to catch errors and potential fraud, and generating management reports, margin analyses, and cost breakdowns for bookkeepers, controllers, CFOs, and finance leaders. The company raised a $4.2M (27M DKK) pre-seed round led by byFounders with participation from Partech and Tenity. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface has been located; this profile captures the company's web, trust, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Traba
providers.description: Traba is a New York City-based staffing marketplace and AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain, founded in 2021 and backed by Founders Fund. Traba connects vetted, high-reliability light-industrial workers with production plants, warehouses, and distribution centers, and pairs that staffing marketplace with Neo, an AI intelligence layer that unifies live operational data across WMS, ERP, HRIS, TMS, and payroll systems, surfaces root causes, and automates approved supply chain workflows. Traba publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Ulysses (Kaminashi)
providers.description: Kaminashi Inc. (株式会社カミナシ) is a Tokyo-based SaaS company founded in December 2016 under its former corporate name Ulysses Inc. (ユリシーズ株式会社). It builds the Kaminashi frontline-operations DX platform for deskless workers — digital checklists and inspections, equipment maintenance (CMMS), frontline employee management, training and manuals, and reporting — serving food manufacturing, machine manufacturing, logistics, hotels, and building maintenance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and a16z. The company is ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) certified and publishes no public developer API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Upside Services
providers.description: Upside (Upside Services, Inc.) is a retail technology company whose platform delivers personalized cash-back offers on gas, groceries, and dining to more than five million consumers through the Upside app and embedded partner experiences. Merchants across fuel and convenience, grocery, and restaurants pay only for measured incremental profit, verified against control groups. Upside operates an enterprise partner API used by companies like Fiserv, GasBuddy, Lyft, Uber, and Marqeta to embed offers, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs - API access is arranged through its partnerships team. Backed by DCVC (first invested 2016).

providers.name: Vertical Bar Inc.
providers.description: Vertical Bar Inc. builds CrossCheck, a DevOps and operations-visibility platform for NetSuite environments. CrossCheck gives NetSuite teams configuration tracking, change management and deployment safety: environment snapshots, comparisons and restore, automated record-and-replay regression testing that catches issues before production, AI-assisted error analysis with fix suggestions, and process mining to surface workflow delays and inefficiencies. Vertical Bar also offers managed services and industry-specific solutions for medical device, food and beverage, chemical, and aerospace and defense manufacturers, plus the FieldTrail browser extension for NetSuite field customization. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Vetcove
providers.description: Vetcove is a free purchasing and procurement platform for veterinary clinics and animal-health organizations that lets a practice shop every distributor and manufacturer at once. It consolidates accounts from suppliers such as Henry Schein, Patterson Vet, MWI, and Midwest Veterinary into one interface where staff compare live pricing and availability, place and track orders, and manage inventory across vendors without changing existing supplier relationships. The service is delivered as a web application and mobile app and is free to veterinary clinics and nonprofits. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wheel
providers.description: Wheel is a telehealth and virtual care enablement platform (Wheel Horizon) that lets digital health companies, pharmaceutical and life-sciences firms, health plans, retail pharmacies, and AI health companies launch, scale, and manage virtual care services. Wheel provides a 50-state network of board-certified clinicians, 70+ evidence-based care protocols, real-time care intelligence, and clinical operations infrastructure powering roughly 7 million virtual visits annually. Its enterprise and partner integration surface is delivered through a gated developer portal (developers.wheel.com) rather than a public self-serve API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; the "Wheel 3" name is a portfolio-scrape artifact for Wheel (wheel.com), which also appears in the network as the `wheel` stub (backed by CRV).

providers.name: Zervant
providers.description: Zervant is an online invoicing and billing platform for freelancers, sole traders, and small businesses. It lets users create, send, and manage estimates and invoices online, automate recurring invoices and payment reminders, track time and expenses, and get paid online across free and paid subscription tiers. Founded in Espoo, Finland and now part of the Ageras group, Zervant is a Northzone portfolio company. No public developer API is currently documented — this profile captures the company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Antero Resources
providers.description: Antero Resources is an independent oil and natural gas company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of natural gas, NGLs, and oil properties in the Appalachian Basin (West Virginia and Ohio).
