Faro is backed by investors including General Catalyst.

providers.name: Fhenix
providers.description: Fhenix is a blockchain R&D company building confidential computing for EVM-compatible chains using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE). Its CoFHE (FHE Coprocessor) lets Solidity smart contracts compute directly on encrypted data — encrypt inputs client-side, operate on ciphertexts on-chain via the FHE.sol Solidity libraries, and unseal results through a threshold decryption network, so sensitive state stays private without ever being decrypted on-chain. The developer stack is a smart-contract-plus-client-library surface (not a REST API): the cofhejs TypeScript SDK, Hardhat/Foundry plugins and starters, the fhenix-contracts Solidity libraries, and mock contracts for local testing. CoFHE is live on public testnets (Ethereum Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Base Sepolia) with mainnet planned. Fhenix is backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Finaloop
providers.description: Finaloop is a real-time, ecommerce-native bookkeeping and accounting platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and multichannel brands. It replaces QuickBooks/Xero, human bookkeepers, and integration tooling with automation plus a team of ecommerce accounting experts, delivering always-current financials. Finaloop continuously syncs sales, returns, fees, reimbursements, inventory movements, COGS, and banking across 60+ ecommerce, marketplace, payment, banking, lending, and 3PL integrations (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, PayPal, Stripe, Chase, ShipBob, and more) to produce real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, inventory analytics, and tax services. Finaloop exposes no public developer API; its APIs are internal connectors to source platforms, so this profile is identity- and posture-focused rather than spec-bearing.

providers.name: Firstory
providers.description: Firstory is a podcast hosting and monetization platform for creators, holding the leading share of the Mandarin-language podcast market and a growing presence across the Asia-Pacific region with over 14,000 shows. Creators upload an episode once and distribute it to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, KKBOX, YouTube, Amazon Music, Pocket Casts, and more than ten other players, then use AI Studio to auto-generate transcripts, summaries, highlights, and newsletter drafts. Firstory layers on second-by-second analytics, dynamic ad insertion, membership subscriptions, listener donations, cross-promotion, a personal website builder, the Flink universal link, and embeddable players. It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public surface and infrastructure signals.

providers.name: Genalyte
providers.description: Genalyte, Inc. is a San Diego, California in-vitro diagnostics company building point-of-care blood testing systems based on silicon photonic microring resonator technology. Founded by Cary Gunn, the company developed the Maverick Diagnostic System and its successor Merlin, an automated benchtop analyzer that runs hematology, chemistry and immunoassay panels — including CBC, lipid panel and comprehensive metabolic panel — from small whole-blood or serum volumes and returns results in roughly twenty to thirty minutes while the patient is still in the clinic. A cloud verification layer the company markets as CloudLab quality-checks results and routes them into electronic medical record systems. Genalyte received FDA clearance for a thyroid stimulating hormone immunoassay performed on a silicon chip and previously held an FDA Emergency Use Authorization for a rapid COVID-19 antibody test. The company is investor-backed (Khosla Ventures, Verily Life Sciences and others) and is a HIPAA covered entity that publishes a Notice of Privacy Practices. As of this profile Genalyte publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Graphcore
providers.description: Graphcore is a semiconductor and AI-computing company that designs the Intelligence Processing Unit (IPU), a processor purpose-built for machine intelligence workloads, along with the IPU-Machine, IPU-POD and Bow systems that scale it. Its developer surface is the Poplar SDK software stack -- Poplar, PopART (Poplar Advanced Runtime), PopTorch (a PyTorch interface for the IPU) and PopLibs -- distributed as open-source components on GitHub and as prebuilt wheels in the Poplar SDK download. Graphcore targets training and inference for deep-learning models and integrates with standard frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and ONNX. Founded in Bristol, UK, Graphcore became part of SoftBank Group in 2024. It exposes no public REST API; this profile catalogs its software developer surface. Surfaced originally as a portfolio company of Atomico, Balderton Capital and DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Handoff
providers.description: Handoff is an AI-native construction management and estimating platform built for residential contractors — remodelers, home builders, handymen, and trade contractors. It handles estimating, AI takeoffs, proposals, project management, scheduling, CRM, change orders, invoicing, and financial management end-to-end, generating detailed, localized estimates in seconds from descriptions, photos, drawings, or voice. Built by 1build and backed by Initialized Capital, Greycroft, Y Combinator, and Masco Ventures, Handoff serves 10,000+ monthly active users managing billions in annualized residential construction projects. Handoff does not currently expose a public developer API; it offers a Zapier integration for connected workflows, with an API on its public roadmap.

providers.name: Huice
providers.description: Huice (慧策) is a Chinese enterprise software company whose flagship product, Wangdiantong (旺店通) ERP, is a tailor-made e-commerce management system for merchants operating across multiple online channels. It provides order management, warehouse and inventory management (WMS), goods and product-archive management, procurement, after-sales/returns processing, and financial operations (慧经营). Huice runs a public Open Platform (open.wangdian.cn) exposing an HTTP API (openapi2) for third-party integrators to synchronize shops, goods, orders, stock, purchasing, and logistics. The API uses a sid + appkey + timestamp + MD5 signature (sign) authentication scheme, page_no/page_size pagination, and a code/message response envelope, with separate sandbox and production hosts.

providers.name: Indifi
providers.description: Indifi Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian digital lending platform that provides collateral-free business loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Founded in Gurugram, Indifi originates and underwrites term loans, working-capital lines of credit, unsecured lines of credit, invoice discounting, and merchant cash advances (against POS transaction history), funding them through a network of 15+ RBI-regulated NBFCs and banks as well as its own NBFC, Indifi Capital Pvt. Ltd. (RBI Cert. No. B-14.03389). Loans range up to INR 50 lakhs with tenures up to 36 months and rates from 1.5% per month, assessed largely on business cash-flow, GST, and platform transaction data rather than traditional collateral. Indifi works through industry partnerships with e-commerce marketplaces and sector aggregators and through co-lending/DSA lending partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API or portal. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Innoviti
providers.description: Innoviti Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru-based payment technology company and RBI-authorized payment aggregator (online and, since January 2026, in-store) operating under India's Payment & Settlements Act 2007. Founded in 2002, Innoviti builds collections, reconciliation, and revenue-assurance infrastructure for large organized retail. Its products include innoviti unipay (an enterprise payment and reconciliation platform for omnichannel settlements and leakage control), innoviti genie (a sales acceleration and dealer-margin platform for mobile and electronics retail), and innoviti link (a POS-free mobile collection app accepting cards, UPI, and EMI). The company serves enterprise retailers including Samsung, Reliance Retail, Tanishq, Shoppers Stop, and More Retail, holds multiple payment-communication patents, and maintains PCI DSS, PCI P2PE, and PCI PIN certifications. Added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Insightec
providers.description: Insightec Ltd. is an Israeli medical device company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Tirat Carmel, Israel, that develops and sells MR-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) systems under the Exablate brand. Its Exablate Neuro platform focuses more than a thousand ultrasound beams through the intact skull to ablate a target deep in the brain without an incision, and is approved for essential tremor and Parkinson's disease, including staged bilateral treatment. The Exablate body platform is used for uterine fibroids, palliation of bone metastases, and prostate indications, and the company runs clinical programs in blood-brain-barrier opening and glioblastoma. Insightec publishes a public product documentation portal of operator manuals and handbooks for the Exablate systems, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs, or agent surface; its systems integrate with GE and Siemens MR scanners as clinical devices rather than through a public API.

providers.name: Lalilo
providers.description: Lalilo is an adaptive reading and literacy web application for primary-school classrooms, founded in Paris in 2016 and acquired by Renaissance (Wisconsin Rapids, USA) in 2021. It delivers roughly 90,000 interactive phonics, fluency and comprehension exercises that adapt in real time to each student, uses speech recognition to assess oral reading aloud, and gives teachers a dashboard for tracking progress and running differentiated small-group instruction. It is used by around 40,000 teachers and 400,000 students a year in France across cycles 2 and 3, with explicit support for DYS, allophone, ULIS, SEGPA and IME learners. Lalilo publishes no public API, developer portal or API documentation: the product is consumed through the teacher and student web applications at app.lalilo.com, and integration or rostering questions are handled through Renaissance support rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: LaunchNotes
providers.description: LaunchNotes is a release communication platform for sharing changelogs, roadmaps, and deprecation notices. The platform helps product, engineering, and customer-facing teams coordinate launches, communicate releases, and notify customers about deprecations through a structured publishing workflow and an extensible API.

providers.name: Lisan
providers.description: Lisan is an AI-powered Arabic proofreading and writing-assistance platform, headquartered in the UAE and backed by 500 Global. Its language engine detects and corrects eight classes of error in Arabic text — spelling, grammar, morphology, semantics, style, formatting, proper nouns, and citations — and returns context-aware suggestions together with explanations that help writers build language skill, plus error statistics and performance reporting. Lisan reaches writers through a web application, a Windows desktop app, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Outlook add-ins, Chrome and Edge browser extensions, and a WordPress plugin. For institutions it adds enforcement of an organization's own style guide, writing-productivity tooling, and analytics dashboards, and it advertises an API and SDK for developers. As of July 2026 that developer surface is not publicly documented — Lisan publishes no developer portal, API reference, base URL, or machine-readable specification, and API/SDK access is arranged through its institutional contact channel.

providers.name: Locust
providers.description: Locust is an open source load testing tool written in Python that lets you define user behavior with code and swarm your system with millions of simultaneous users. Supports HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT, SocketIO, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and other protocols via pluggable user classes, with a real-time web UI for orchestrating tests.

providers.name: Mech-Mind Robotics
providers.description: Mech-Mind Robotics provides industrial 3D cameras (the Mech-Eye industrial 3D camera and laser profiler line) together with software suites — Mech-Vision machine-vision software, Mech-Viz robot-programming software, and the Mech-DLK deep-learning toolkit — that give industrial robots embodied AI and 3D vision. Typical applications include bin picking, depalletizing, machine tending, piece picking, and item picking; the company reports 3000+ deployed applications for 1000+ clients worldwide. The developer surface is the Mech-Eye SDK (a C++ core with Python and C# bindings), ROS and ROS2 interfaces, and the Mech-DLK SDK, all published under the MechMindRobotics GitHub organization; there is no public REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: Medmonk
providers.description: Medmonk is a pharma market access platform that connects brand teams, healthcare providers, pharmacies, and patients on a single real-time infrastructure. It automates point-of-sale copay enrollment, benefit investigations, prior authorizations, financial assistance, hub workflows, and adherence tracking across specialty and rare-disease medications, reaching roughly 98% of U.S. pharmacy and buy/bill network connectivity. Medmonk states it exposes FHIR-compliant APIs to integrate with existing EHR, CRM, and pharmacy systems, and claims SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance, though it publishes no public developer portal or API documentation. Founded in the Y Combinator W12 batch.

providers.name: Navro
providers.description: Navro (formerly Paytrix) is a London-based payments curation platform that lets large businesses move money globally through a single contract and API integration. Rather than stitching together a patchwork of banks and payment providers, Navro routes each payment via the right rail, currency and compliance model, executing millions of payouts across 140+ currencies and 200+ regions. Its products span Navro Workforce (global payroll, contractor and pension payouts), Navro Life (cross-border pensions), Navro Digital (payments for digital platforms and enterprises) and Navro Capital (international fund flows). Clients integrate once via the Navro API or use the no-code Navro Hub portal for real-time payment visibility and reporting. Founded by Aran Brown (CEO) and Eddie Harrison, Navro operates from London with offices in Ireland and the United States, and is authorised by the UK Financial Conduct Authority, the Central Bank of Ireland and FinCEN in the US.

providers.name: NDBC — National Data Buoy Center
providers.description: The NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC) operates a global network of over 1,000 moored buoys, drifting buoys, Coastal-Marine Automated Network (C-MAN) stations, and partner stations that continuously measure and transmit meteorological and oceanographic conditions. Real-time and historical data — wind direction and speed, wave height and period, sea surface temperature, atmospheric pressure, air temperature, dew point, visibility, and salinity — are distributed freely via HTTP file URLs, a THREDDS/OPeNDAP server (NetCDF), an RSS observation feed, and a latest-observations snapshot updated every five minutes. No API key or authentication is required; data is in the public domain under U.S. government open-data policy.

providers.name: nference
providers.description: nference is a healthcare-AI company that builds an agentic intelligence layer for clinical research and drug development. Its nSights platform aggregates and analyzes de-identified multimodal patient data at massive scale — 1.4 billion+ clinical notes, 10 billion+ radiology images, 20 million+ digitized pathology whole-slide images, 12 million+ ECG waveforms, and 100 million+ echocardiogram videos — extracting 30,000+ clinical biomarkers to help life-sciences and health-system partners design patient cohorts, explore patient journeys, annotate data for model development, and run advanced data-science workflows across cardiology, oncology, immunology, rare diseases, neurology, infectious diseases, and nephrology. nference spun out the venture companies Anumana (ECG-based biomarker discovery) and Pramana (digital pathology). The company operates as an enterprise B2B platform with no public self-serve API; it is profiled here for its security, compliance, and governance posture. Backed by Matrix Partners.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Pointone
providers.description: PointOne is an AI-powered legal practice management platform that automates time entry, billing compliance, and analytics for law firms. Its products include PointOne Time (automatic cross-device time capture with AI-generated narratives), PointOne Review (pre-bill review with AI markup and collaboration), and PointOne Intelligence (time analytics and resource-allocation insights), along with automatic enforcement of Outside Counsel Guidelines. The platform syncs with billing systems including Aderant, Clio, Filevine, QuickBooks, Actionstep, Elite 3E, Surepoint, MyCase, and LeanLaw, and serves 200+ law firms. PointOne is backed by Bessemer, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and 8VC. No public developer API is currently published; integrations are delivered as pre-built connectors.

providers.name: Prenetics
providers.description: Prenetics Global Limited (NASDAQ: PRE) is a consumer healthcare and longevity company whose flagship brand is IM8, a science-backed daily-nutrition and longevity supplement line co-founded with David Beckham that reached roughly $120M in annual recurring revenue within its first year. The company's IM8 Health direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify and exposes an agent-native commerce surface: it publishes an /llms.txt agent guide and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp that advertises a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) shopping endpoint, letting AI agents search the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout via Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Shopify card handlers. Prenetics itself publishes no separate developer/API program; the agent-commerce surface is the IM8 Health UCP/MCP storefront.

providers.name: Rebellions
providers.description: Rebellions is an AI infrastructure company that designs energy-efficient AI inference hardware (NPUs) and the software stack to deploy large language and multimodal models on it at scale. Its products include the Rebel100 inference chip (FP8, HBM3e), the ATOM-Max Server and POD, and RebelServer. The RBLN SDK compiles and serves HuggingFace Transformers/Diffusers, PyTorch, and TensorFlow models on RBLN accelerators, with integrations for vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, TorchServe, and Kubernetes. Rebellions does not expose a public REST/HTTP API; developers integrate through first-party Python SDKs (optimum-rbln, vllm-rbln), the RBLN compiler and driver, and the model zoo. Backed by Kindred Ventures and partnered with Samsung, Arm, IBM, and AWS.

providers.name: RefleXion Medical
providers.description: RefleXion Medical is a privately held therapeutic oncology company headquartered in Hayward, California, founded in 2009 by Sam Mazin and Akshay Nanduri around the biology-guided radiotherapy (BgRT) concept conceived at Stanford University in 2007. The company designs, manufactures and commercializes the RefleXion X1 radiotherapy platform and SCINTIX biology-guided radiotherapy, which uses onboard PET detectors to sense emissions from an injected radiopharmaceutical and autonomously direct external-beam radiotherapy delivery with sub-second latency. The RefleXion X1 received FDA clearance for SRS, SBRT and IMRT in 2020, and SCINTIX therapy was FDA cleared in February 2023 for treating tumors in the lung or bone arising from primary and metastatic cancer. RefleXion has raised more than $500 million from investors including TPG's The Rise Fund, KCK Group, PSP Investments, Sofinnova, Pfizer Ventures and Johnson & Johnson Innovation. RefleXion is a medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Ryerson Holding
providers.description: Ryerson Holding Corporation is a leading value-added processor and distributor of industrial metals, with operations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, China, and Brazil. The company offers a broad range of stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and alloy steels in various shapes and forms. Ryerson operates an e-commerce platform at Ryerson.com enabling online metal ordering, order status tracking, and shipment management. The company has integrated its CRM (Salesforce) with ERP (SAP) for streamlined order management and uses EDI and API-based integration for wholesale distribution operations.

providers.name: SanDisk
providers.description: SanDisk, a Western Digital brand, is a leading manufacturer of flash memory products including memory cards, USB flash drives, solid-state drives, and embedded storage solutions. SanDisk provides developer SDKs for integrating iXpand storage devices into iOS applications, enabling third-party app developers to access and manage iXpand Flash Drive storage through the Lightning interface. Western Digital also maintains the My Cloud Home platform with RESTful APIs for building off-device cloud storage applications.

providers.name: Snap-on
providers.description: Snap-on Incorporated is a global manufacturer and marketer of tools, equipment, diagnostics, repair information, and systems solutions for professional users in vehicle repair, industrial, and other industries. The company provides diagnostic tools, electronic parts catalogs (EPC), repair information systems (ShopKey Pro, SureTrack), and shop management software. Snap-on integrates with dealer management systems (DMS) through its EPC integration program and strategic technology partnerships.

providers.name: Sojern
providers.description: Sojern is an AI-powered digital marketing platform built for the hospitality and travel industry. Powered by the Sojern Traveler Ecosystem, it unifies real-time traveler intent data, AI-driven audience predictions, and multichannel media activation across display, social, video, connected TV, SEM, metasearch, email, and native channels to help hotels, destinations, attractions, airlines, and agencies drive direct bookings, improve ROI, and grow guest loyalty. The platform spans audiences, creative services, activation, optimization, measurement, and attribution, plus guest-experience tools. Sojern has no public developer API surface; it is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sonar Mental Health
providers.description: Sonar Mental Health provides 24/7 text-based wellbeing coaching and care navigation for youth. Trained Wellbeing Coaches lead the conversations, supported by AI tooling that surfaces context and flags risk without making independent decisions, delivering between-visit and after-hours support, escalation and care coordination to higher levels of care, and real-time insights dashboards for measurement-based care across schools, health systems, primary care, and EAP pathways. The company reports serving 20,000+ young people with higher engagement between visits, and is backed by 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture (SOC 2, HIPAA), and public web properties.

providers.name: Streamfold
providers.description: Streamfold is the company behind Rotel, a high-performance, resource-efficient OpenTelemetry collector written in Rust. Rotel focuses on minimal overhead and fast cold-starts for resource-constrained environments such as AWS Lambda, serverless functions, and embedded systems, supporting OTLP/gRPC, OTLP/HTTP, and Kafka receivers with exporters for ClickHouse, Datadog, AWS X-Ray, Kafka, and OTLP. It ships Python (pyrotel) and Node.js (@streamfold/rotel) embeddings, an AWS Lambda extension layer, a CloudWatch Lambda forwarder, and a Rust processor SDK. Rotel is open source under Apache-2.0. In March 2026 Streamfold announced it is joining Cursor to bring observability to agentic, AI-driven software systems. Streamfold was a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Sumer
providers.description: Sumer (Sumer.Money) is a blockchain liquidity infrastructure protocol positioning itself as the most capital-efficient way to put crypto assets to work across chains. Users deposit native assets such as liquid staked ETH, and Sumer's correlation-aware risk engine matches assets and liabilities to mint synthetic suTokens (suETH, suUSD) that act as "money multipliers" — travelling across connected blockchains as collateral while the underlying deposit keeps accruing staking rewards and lending interest. The protocol runs an omnichain lending/borrowing market, a points and veSumer staking program, and its Supernova EVM chain, drawing price data from Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone, and Supra oracles. Backed by Pantera Capital and other crypto investors, with contracts audited by Certik, Ancilia, Tikkala, and CD Security.

providers.name: Term Finance
providers.description: Term Finance is a noncustodial, fixed-rate lending and borrowing protocol for crypto assets, modeled on the tri-party repo arrangements common in traditional finance (TradFi). Liquidity suppliers and takers are matched through a weekly blind double-auction that aggregates bids and offers into a single market-clearing rate, while collateral backing each loan sits in isolated, non-rehypothecatable smart contracts known as repoLockers. The protocol is deployed across Ethereum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Smart Chain and Plasma, and its Solidity contracts have been audited by Sigma Prime, Runtime Verification, Dedaub and Certora. Term Finance is developer-facing primarily through on-chain smart contracts and a Solidity API reference rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: The Lafz
providers.description: Lafz is a halal-certified cosmetics and personal-care brand, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore as part of the Believe PTE FMCG group. It sells hair care, skin care, makeup, a caffeine range, deodorants and fragrance made without alcohol, parabens or animal by-products. The direct-to-consumer storefront at lafz.com runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing surfaces: a Shopify customer-account OpenID Connect provider, an /llms.txt agent guide, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) shopping MCP server for buyer-approved agent-driven checkout. thelafz.com is the corporate "halal compliant factories" site. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio-graph lead and enriched from its live public surfaces.

providers.name: Tovala
providers.description: Tovala is a Chicago-based food-technology company that pairs a fresh meal delivery service with its proprietary smart countertop ovens. Weekly rotating, chef-crafted meals ship with QR codes that the Tovala Smart Oven (5-in-1) and Smart Oven Pro (6-in-1 with steam) scan to cook automatically, eliminating shopping, prepping, and cleanup. The company also offers GLP-1 balanced and high-protein menus, flexible meal plans, and a consumer mobile app backed by its api.tovala.com platform. Tovala is a Y Combinator portfolio company.

providers.name: TraceAir
providers.description: TraceAir is a construction site intelligence platform for homebuilders and land developers, combining drone photogrammetry and LiDAR scans with cloud analytics to track sitework progress, verify earthwork cut/fill quantities, generate lot layouts and yield estimates, and document builds with 360-degree interior scans across the full project lifecycle from land acquisition to handover. The company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the platform is accessed through its web application.

providers.name: TypeLaw
providers.description: TypeLaw is an AI-powered legal document automation platform that formats and prepares court-compliant briefs for attorneys, paralegals, and law firms. Lawyers upload a draft brief and pick the court, and TypeLaw automatically produces a compliant PDF with tables of contents, tables of authorities, hyperlinked citations, cover pages, and certificates, with a human expert reviewing every document before delivery. A Bloomberg Beta portfolio company, TypeLaw delivers its product through its web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Uare.ai
providers.description: Uare.ai is a consumer Individual AI platform founded by LivePerson founder Rob LoCascio that lets people build and own a personal AI trained on their own voice, knowledge, and experiences, organized by its proprietary Human Life Model across seven dimensions (Identity, World, Story, Mindset, Drive, Pattern, Growth). The company raised a $10.3M seed led by Mayfield and Boldstart Ventures in November 2025. Memberships are metered in Credits and include MCP tool integrations that connect an Individual AI to 1000+ applications, with iOS and Android apps alongside the web app at app.uare.ai. Uare.ai publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or SDKs as of July 2026.

providers.name: UpCodes
providers.description: UpCodes is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform for the construction industry, offering a searchable database of US construction and building codes consolidated by state and city for easier navigation. The platform includes libraries of codes, diagrams, and assemblies, project collaboration and bookmarking, code calculators with a BIM design data import tool, SAML single sign-on for enterprise teams, and an AI Copilot that answers code compliance questions, locates assemblies, and generates project-specific checklists. Plans span Essentials, Professional, and Enterprise tiers. UpCodes does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: UrbanSitter
providers.description: UrbanSitter is an online marketplace that connects families with trusted local caregivers, including babysitters, nannies, child care providers, daycares and preschools, tutors, pet sitters, senior caregivers, and household help. Operated by UrbanSitter, Inc., the platform lets parents browse caregiver profiles, read reviews from other families, compare pay rates, and book and pay sitters, while caregivers find and manage child care and home care jobs. UrbanSitter runs its platform on a private Spring Boot API (Swagger UI is IP-safelisted) and does not publish a public developer program.

providers.name: Virta Health
providers.description: Virta Health is a virtual, nutrition-first healthcare company delivering sustainable weight loss and type 2 diabetes reversal. Its program combines personalized nutrition plans, continuous expert health coaching, physician-led medication management, and connected devices, delivered through a consumer mobile app and sold to employers, health plans, and healthcare providers. Virta is HITRUST- and SOC 2 Type II-certified and operates as a HIPAA-covered clinical service. As of this enrichment pass Virta publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and compliance certifications.

providers.name: voize
providers.description: voize is a German healthcare AI company (voize GmbH) building a voice-documentation platform for long-term care, skilled nursing, and disability-support facilities. Caregivers speak naturally on a smartphone during patient care and voize's on-device and cloud speech models convert the free speech into structured, categorized entries that sync bi-directionally in real time into the facility's electronic health record (EHR) system. The product reduces documentation burden for nursing staff, works offline, recognizes patient names and corrects grammar, and integrates directly with major EHRs used in skilled nursing. voize is backed by HV Capital and operates in Germany and the United States. It ships a mobile application rather than a public developer API, but exposes EHR integrations, a trust center, and a vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty program on its public surface.

providers.name: Workhint
providers.description: Workhint is a work orchestration platform that uses AI to configure workflows, roles, and operations from modular components, helping teams manage flexible and on-demand workforces. The platform spans sourcing and onboarding, a workflow engine, tasks and projects, shifts and field visits, delivery management, auto-invoicing, global payments and payout workflows, contract management, and 1099 compliance. Backed by 500 Global and Softeq. API access and custom integrations are offered on the Enterprise plan, but no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Worknmates
providers.description: Worknmates, now operating as OFFI (getoffi.com), is a Latin American flexible-workspace marketplace. Companies give employees budgets to book coworking spaces, offices, and work-ready apartments near where they live, with real-time transaction tracking, per-city budgets, and approved-space networks; hosts list and monetize their spaces, with payouts through dLocal and PayPal. A 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer program or documented API is published.

providers.name: Wuzzuf
providers.description: Wuzzuf is Egypt's leading online recruitment platform, operated by Cairo-based BasharSoft and backed by investors including 500 Global. It connects millions of job seekers with tens of thousands of employers across Egypt and the Middle East, offering job search, applicant tracking, employer branding pages, and recruitment products for companies. Wuzzuf does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: Adobe Commerce
providers.description: Adobe Commerce (formerly Magento Commerce) is an enterprise e-commerce platform for building and operating online storefronts, marketplaces, and B2B/B2C catalogs across web, mobile, and headless experiences. The Adobe Commerce Web APIs expose REST and GraphQL access to products, categories, customers, carts, orders, inventory, and configuration with OAuth 1.0a and token-based (Bearer) authentication against a merchant-hosted base URL.

providers.name: Bark
providers.description: Bark is a digital safety and parental-controls company that helps families keep children safer online and in the real world. Its AI-powered platform monitors texts, email, social media, web browsing, and 30+ apps across more than 20 content categories, flagging potential issues such as online predators, cyberbullying, self-harm, and adult content, and pairs that monitoring with screen-time management, app blocking, web filtering, and GPS location alerts. Bark ships as an app for existing iOS and Android devices as well as purpose-built hardware including the Bark Phone, Bark Watch, and Bark Home.

providers.name: Black Crow AI
providers.description: Black Crow AI is an ecommerce AI company that turns paid advertising traffic into predictable revenue using AI-generated post-click Storefronts. Storefronts are shopping experiences built specifically for paid ad traffic, kept aligned with ad creative and audience intent, generated in minutes through a no-code workflow, and optimized through structured split-test experimentation and continuous learning. Black Crow also exposes a script-based "Global API" callback that surfaces its real-time visitor prediction scores (delivered in under 20 milliseconds) so brands can ingest scores into any target platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CO2 AI
providers.description: CO2 AI is an enterprise sustainability platform that helps organizations measure, reduce, and report carbon emissions across their entire value chain. It combines trustworthy emissions data, AI-powered workflows, and supply-chain collaboration to baseline and track Scope 1, 2, and 3 corporate footprints, compute audit-ready product carbon footprints (PCF) at scale across thousands of SKUs (PACT, TfS, PEF, ISO aligned), engage suppliers for primary data, and build decarbonization plans ranked by Marginal Abatement Cost. Backed by Partech and surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a climate-sector company profile. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile captures the company's security, trust, and legal surface.

providers.name: data.gov.uk CKAN Publishing Service
providers.description: data.gov.uk CKAN Publishing Service is a national government open-data portal for United Kingdom running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 57,757 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Defense Health Agency
providers.description: The Defense Health Agency (DHA) is a joint, integrated combat support agency that enables the Army, Navy, and Air Force medical services to provide a medically ready force and ready medical force to combatant commands. DHA operates the Military Health System (MHS), MHS Genesis electronic health record, the Military Health System Data Repository (MDR), and the Enterprise Intelligence and Data Solutions (EIDS) program. Data exchange inside MHS Genesis uses SMART on FHIR APIs, but DHA does not currently publish a general-purpose public developer API.

providers.name: Donnees Quebec
providers.description: Donnees Quebec is a provincial government open-data portal for Canada running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 1,608 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Ebix
providers.description: Ebix is a United States insurance software and exchange company headquartered in Johns Creek, Georgia, operating as market infrastructure between carriers, MGAs, brokers and agencies rather than as a carrier itself. Its portfolio spans property and casualty agency management (EbixASP), P&C policy administration and broker systems (EbixEvolution, PlacingHub, Sunrise Exchange, iClose), life insurance and annuity distribution connectivity (EbixExchange), health insurance and employee benefits administration, health content, risk and compliance (RiskEnvision, WCExchange), and — through the EbixCash arm — travel, payments and forex services. Its core P&C plumbing is ACORD-native rather than API-native: TEAM-UP moves policy, claims and direct-bill commission download to agency management systems as ACORD-standard AL3 files, its Translation Services practice converts carrier-proprietary formats into ACORD AL3 and ACORD XML using Java/XML/XSLT, EbixASP maintains a continuously updated ACORD forms library with bi-directional exchange against ACORD applications, and the EbixASP Real-Time Interface synchronizes carrier credentials and service transactions with IVANS. Ebix markets API-driven quote-to-bind workflows and, since October 2025, a plug-and-play connector platform built with 1SilverBullet that exposes quoting, eApp, enrollment, underwriting checks, payments and policy servicing as modular APIs with "a standardized connector fabric with pre-built mappings and a developer portal" — but no public self-serve developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification could be confirmed as of 2026-07-25. Every probed developer path on ebix.com (/developers, /api, /developer, /partners, /integrations) returns the site's single-page-app homepage shell rather than a developer surface; developer.ebix.com and docs.ebix.com do not resolve; api.ebix.com answers with a JSON 404 and no documented routes; and the live EbixCash API Hub at api.ebixcash.com serves an OpenAPI document that returns HTTP 401 "Missing Authorization header". The one agent-facing discovery document Ebix does publish is a real llms.txt at www.ebix.com/llms.txt, which indexes the solution, service and corporate pages but names no API, portal or specification; every /.well-known/ probe across www.ebix.com, api.ebix.com, api.ebixcash.com and ebixasp.com missed, no first-party SDK exists in any public package registry, and no trust center, security.txt or vulnerability-disclosure program was found. Ebix's integration surface is therefore customer- and partner-gated, sold and documented under contract, which is the norm for United States insurance infrastructure where no federal regulator and no open-insurance mandate exists. Ebix filed Chapter 11 in December 2023, sold its North American life and annuity assets to Zinnia, and exited bankruptcy on 30 August 2024 consolidated with Eraaya Lifespaces.

providers.name: Federato
providers.description: Federato is an AI-native insurance technology platform built for the full policy lifecycle, from submission through policyholder management. Its RiskOps-style tooling spans underwriting workflow, automated submission triage, portfolio and appetite alignment, rate/price/quote, a configurable forms engine, federated data infrastructure, and producer, partner, and policyholder portals. Federato serves insurance carriers, managing general agents (MGAs), MGA aggregators, and mutual insurers. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and announced a $100M Series D led by Goldman Sachs. No public API or open developer reference was found during enrichment; the developer documentation portal (Archbee) is magic-link protected, and the GitHub organization holds only forks of third-party infrastructure tools.

providers.name: Fictiv
providers.description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain platform that connects engineering and hardware teams with a vetted global network of manufacturers to source custom mechanical parts. It provides instant online quoting, automated design-for-manufacturability (DFM) analysis, and end-to-end order visibility across CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, urethane casting, and compression molding — from rapid prototyping through full-scale production. Now part of MISUMI, Fictiv operates a quote-to-order web platform at app.fictiv.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Five9
providers.description: Five9 is a leading cloud contact center (CCaaS) platform providing inbound, outbound, blended, and omnichannel customer engagement with intelligent virtual agents, workforce optimization, agent assist, and analytics. Five9 exposes multiple developer APIs including REST APIs for configuration and reporting, SOAP-based Configuration and Statistics Web Services, the Agent and Supervisor REST APIs (app.five9.com/appsvcs), and Voicestream/event APIs, with authentication via session login and API user credentials.

providers.name: FMC Corporation
providers.description: FMC Corporation (NYSE: FMC) is a global agricultural sciences company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with roots dating to 1883. FMC develops, manufactures, and sells crop protection chemistries (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides), biological solutions (biopesticides, biostimulants, biofertilizers, pheromones), seed treatments, and precision agriculture technology. Following the 2019 spin-off of Livent (lithium) and the 2021 divestiture of the Health & Nutrition business to DuPont/Eastman, FMC operates as a focused pure-play agricultural sciences company. The 2022 acquisition of Argentine biologicals firm BIOPHERO accelerated FMC's pheromone-based crop protection portfolio (Sofero brand).

providers.name: Inkling
providers.description: Inkling is a frontline employee training and enablement platform (now part of Echo360) that delivers mission-critical knowledge, learning pathways, and operational workflows to essential workers across retail, hospitality, healthcare, and manufacturing. Its products include the Habitat content authoring tool, mobile Knowledge & Training modules, InkForms operational checklists, certification pathways, reporting and analytics, and LMS/LXP integrations. Inkling publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through LMS/LXP connectors and professional services. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Sapphire Ventures portfolio company and enriched with the provider's public identity, security posture, and site properties.

providers.name: Intact Financial
providers.description: Intact Financial Corporation is the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada, headquartered in Toronto and trading on the TSX as IFC. It underwrites personal auto, personal property, and commercial P&C lines through the Intact Insurance, belairdirect, BrokerLink, Intact Prestige, Intact Public Entities, and On Side Restoration brands in Canada, through Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions in the United States, and through Intact Insurance UK, EU, IE and 123.ie internationally following the 2021 acquisition of RSA. Distribution runs through a network of more than 6,000 independent broker offices plus direct-to-consumer channels. Its API posture is partner-gated and closed. There is no public, self-serve developer portal, no published API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI artifact on any Intact domain probed. developer/developers/docs/api subdomains on intactfc.com and intact.ca do not resolve; /developers, /api, /developer and /partners return 404. The only integration surfaces are login walls — the Intact Portal for brokers at portal.intactinsurance.com (brokers.intact.ca redirects there) and the customer Client Centre behind IBM Security WebSEAL at apps.intactinsurance.com. Broker connectivity in Canada is mediated by CSIO, the industry standards body whose EDI, XML, eDocs and JSON API standards are the Canadian analogue of ACORD. Intact Insurance is listed in the CSIO member directory but appears on none of CSIO's certified-member lists (eDocs, CL Data, Compliance/Z-code, API Security Standards, JSON API Standards) and is recorded as "Not Yet Rated" on both the personal and commercial tracks of CSIO's 2026 Standards Certification Ratings. No ACORD reference was found anywhere on the company's public web properties.

providers.name: Layla AI
providers.description: Layla is an AI travel agent that plans trips conversationally, generating itineraries with flights, hotels, activities, and restaurants wired into real booking inventory from partners such as Booking.com and Skyscanner. The consumer product is at layla.ai; a Layla for Brands white-label offering lets travel companies embed an AI travel agent into their own site with their own branding and inventory.

providers.name: Leaner Technologies
providers.description: Leaner Technologies (株式会社Leaner Technologies) is a Tokyo-based B2B SaaS company founded on February 22, 2019 by CEO Yusuke Ohira, operating under the mission "調達のスタンダードを刷新し続ける" (continuously renew the standard of procurement). It builds the "Leaner" (リーナー) cloud suite for corporate procurement and purchasing departments: Leaner購買 (purchasing), a purchase-to-pay system covering quotation, approval workflow, ordering, receiving and payment; Leaner sourcing, a quotation and sourcing workspace; Leaner Connect, an SRM supplier-relationship platform; plus procurement BPO and consulting services. The platform aggregates supplier and EC catalogs (including Amazon Business and MonotaRO) into cross-catalog search, and applies AI to classify purchasing data for indirect-spend visibility and cost optimization. The company holds ISMS ISO/IEC 27001:2013 / JIS Q 27001:2014 certification (registration JP21/080659, February 2021). Leaner publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs as of this enrichment pass — its integration surface is delivered through partner catalog connections rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Leap To Win Technologies Private
providers.description: Leap To Win Technologies Private Limited is a Bengaluru, India company incorporated on 26 June 2024 (CIN U62090KA2024PTC190203) that operates Propico (propico.in), a rental guarantee and property management service. For property owners Propico underwrites a fixed guaranteed monthly rent with zero-vacancy risk, handling tenant screening and placement, rent collection, inspections, maintenance coordination and legal compliance; for tenants it sells rental protection plans covering unfair security-deposit deductions and surprise move-out costs. The company markets two packages - a Premium Guaranteed plan and a Standard property-management plan - and serves Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and Pune. Propico runs a marketing and customer web app backed by an authenticated multi-service API gateway at api.propico.in, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or OpenAPI definition. It does publish a well-formed llms.txt, making it agent-discoverable as a content surface even though it exposes no programmable interface.

providers.name: LendingPad
providers.description: LendingPad is a cloud-based mortgage loan origination system (LOS) that lets brokers, lenders, and institutions originate, process, underwrite, close, and fund residential mortgage loans with real-time, multi-user collaboration across the borrower, broker, lender, and service-provider lifecycle. It ships in Broker, Lender, Processing, and Institution editions and runs a large Partners Marketplace of integrated vendors (credit, AUS, AVM/appraisal, title, compliance, doc-prep, pricing/PPE, POS, CRM, and investors such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, UWM, and Rocket Mortgage). LendingPad exposes an Enterprise API for loan data exchange, but access is gated - it is limited to Lender Edition clients under an executed API Agreement and NDA, keys and testing-site access are issued by the support desk, and there is no public developer portal or self-serve API reference. The API entries below are honestly modeled from the vendor-integration and marketplace capabilities LendingPad describes publicly; endpoint-level surfaces are not published and are not fabricated here.

providers.name: London Datastore
providers.description: London Datastore is a open data portal open-data portal for GB running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately an open datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Mars
providers.description: Mars, Incorporated is one of the world's largest privately held companies, producing confectionery, pet food, food, and providing veterinary care. The company owns iconic brands including M&M's, Snickers, Twix, Milky Way, Skittles, Wrigley, Orbit, Extra, Pedigree, Whiskas, Royal Canin, IAMS, and Sheba, and operates Mars Petcare clinical brands including Banfield Pet Hospital, VCA Animal Hospitals, BluePearl, and Antech Diagnostics. Mars operates in over 80 countries. Mars operates a public Azure-API-Management developer portal at developer.mars.com for partner and B2B integrations, alongside closed channels such as the Mars Supplier Gateway.

providers.name: Medusa
providers.description: Medusa is an open-source headless commerce platform with a modular architecture.

providers.name: Open Development Cambodia
providers.description: Open Development Cambodia is a organization open-data portal for Cambodia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 13,484 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Open Development Mekong

It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 13,483 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 13,484 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Paxton AI
providers.description: Paxton AI is a legal AI assistant built for attorneys and law firms, delivering rapid case-law and regulatory research, AI-assisted document drafting, file analysis, deposition and discovery summarization, and specialized workflows for medical chronologies and billing summaries. Founded by Tanguy Chau (CEO) and Michael Ulin and headquartered in Bend, Oregon, the company has raised roughly $28M across a $6M seed round led by WVV Capital and a $22M Series A led by Unusual Ventures, with participation from Kyber Knight and 25Madison. Paxton's platform covers US federal regulations, state laws, and case law across all fifty states, surfaces precise authority-linked citations, and runs in a closed model environment that is SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA compliant with data never used for model training. The product is delivered as a web SaaS targeted at solo practitioners, small and mid-size firms, and enterprise legal teams across personal injury, family, employment, criminal, and corporate practice areas; commercial access is sold via per-seat Individual plans ($499/month or $2,999/year) and a volume-priced Enterprise plan, with a 7-day free trial. Paxton publishes a small public GitHub presence with citator and legal-hallucination benchmark datasets but does not offer a public developer API, SDK, or open-source platform.

providers.name: plancraft
providers.description: plancraft is a German cloud-based business management software for craftspeople and trades businesses (Handwerk). It digitizes administrative workflows end to end — quote and estimate creation, project planning, time tracking, on-site documentation, material and labor costing, and invoicing — inside one integrated platform aimed at small and mid-sized construction and trade companies. plancraft supports DATEV export for tax/accounting workflows and DATANORM and GAEB catalog imports for material data and tender processing. It is a venture-backed SaaS company (portfolio company of Creandum). As of this enrichment pass plancraft publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface — integrations are delivered as prebuilt connectors and standardized file-format import/export.

providers.name: Queensland Government Data
providers.description: Queensland Government Data is a open data portal open-data portal for Australia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 188,778 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: ShopShops
providers.description: ShopShops is a livestream commerce marketplace for authenticated pre-owned luxury and designer goods — handbags, jewelry, watches, accessories, and shoes sold through live shopping events and an online store. Buyers shop curated secondhand inventory with authentication (via Entrupy), buy-now-pay-later (Afterpay / Shop Pay), and return assurance (Seel). The storefront runs on Shopify and publishes a live agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, an MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search and buyer-approved checkout, an OIDC/OAuth2 Customer Account API, and an llms.txt describing how AI shopping agents may transact with the store.

providers.name: Spire Global
providers.description: Spire Global operates a constellation of more than 100 LEMUR nanosatellites collecting maritime AIS, aviation ADS-B, GNSS-RO weather profiles, and RF geolocation data, and offers Space Services for hosted payloads and managed satellite missions. Its data products are exposed as developer-friendly APIs: Spire Maritime 2.0 (now operated by Kpler) delivers vessel-tracking AIS through a GraphQL endpoint; Spire Aviation publishes REST APIs and real-time streams for flight metadata, live ADS-B tracking, historic positions, and event feeds; Spire Weather and Climate provides RESTful weather and ocean data APIs including 30 years of maritime weather history; and Spire Space Services exposes a developer portal for managed satellite operations. Spire's APIs are documented at product-specific subdomains and authenticated with API keys.

providers.name: TelevisaUnivision (Univision Communications)
providers.description: TelevisaUnivision (formerly Univision Communications) is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, operating television networks (Univision, UniMás, TUDN, Galavisión), the ViX streaming platform, Uforia audio platform, and a suite of advanced advertising technology solutions. The company serves advertisers and media partners through programmatic ad platforms, first-party audience data, and content partnerships rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Tredence
providers.description: Tredence is a global data science and AI solutions company headquartered in San Jose, California, founded in 2013 by Shub Bhowmick, Sumit Mehra and Shashank Dubey. The firm positions itself around the "last-mile problem in AI" — the gap between insight creation and value realization — and delivers agentic AI, generative AI, data engineering, data science, MLOps, LLMOps, data modernization, supply-chain and customer-experience analytics as consulting engagements backed by named accelerators and platforms including RAPID (agentic process automation), Sancus (AI-led data quality and master data management), MLWorks (industrial MLOps), Customer Cosmos, Supply Chain Control Tower, Revenue Growth Management, On-Shelf Availability, Test and Learn Platform and UnityGO. It serves retail, CPG, healthcare, life sciences, banking/financial services/insurance, telco/media/tech, travel and hospitality, and industrials, with delivery centers across North America, Europe and Asia. Tredence publishes an authored llms.txt for AI agents and an ISO 27001:2022 / ISO 27701:2019 / SOC 2 Type 2 certifications page, but does not operate a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or first-party SDK is published on any Tredence host.

providers.name: vAuto
providers.description: vAuto is a Cox Automotive brand providing new and used vehicle inventory management, appraisal, pricing, and merchandising software for automotive dealers (ProfitTime GPS, Provision, Conquest, Stockwave). vAuto exposes partner-gated APIs through the Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com) - notably the vAuto Inventory API and the vAuto Appraisal API - that let authorized integrators programmatically read vehicle inventory, update list price, and create and access appraisals in the vAuto ecosystem. Access is not open self-service; integrators must be approved partners, authenticate via Cox Automotive Bridge ID / OAuth with an issued API key, and endpoint-level reference documentation is behind the partner developer portal login. Per-path endpoints below are modeled from the published product summaries, not copied from public reference docs.

providers.name: Wattpad
providers.description: Wattpad is a Toronto-based social storytelling platform where a global community of more than 90 million writers and readers create, share, and read serialized original fiction across every genre. Founded in 2006 and acquired by Naver (WEBTOON) in 2021, Wattpad extends its stories into publishing, film, and TV through Wattpad WEBTOON Studios. Wattpad formerly operated a public developer API (developer.wattpad.com), but public access was discontinued around April 2018 and the API is now internal-only, so this profile captures the company's web properties and operational surface rather than an active API program.

providers.name: 10x Genomics
providers.description: 10x Genomics is a life sciences technology company building instruments, reagents, and software that resolve biology at single-cell and spatial resolution. Its Chromium platform delivers single-cell gene expression, immune profiling, and multiomic analysis; its Visium and Xenium platforms deliver spatial transcriptomics and in situ single-cell spatial biology. The company supports researchers with analysis software (Cell Ranger, Space Ranger, Xenium Onboard Analysis, Loupe Browser), a cloud analysis platform, and open datasets. 10x Genomics does not publish a general-purpose public REST developer API; its developer surface is command-line analysis pipelines, file-format tooling, and open-source repositories on GitHub.

providers.name: Agile
providers.description: A collection of resources, standards, and APIs representing the broader agile landscape — the set of software development principles first codified in the 2001 Agile Manifesto. Agile values individuals and interactions over processes and tools, working software over comprehensive documentation, customer collaboration over contract negotiation, and responding to change over following a plan. This topic index covers the full ecosystem of agile frameworks, methodologies, tools, and APIs including Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, XP, and Lean.

providers.name: Agile Methodology
providers.description: A collection of resources, standards, and APIs related to agile methodology — the set of principles and frameworks that guide modern software development. Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and XP emphasize iterative delivery, customer collaboration, and adaptability. This topic covers the ecosystem of project management APIs, ceremony-facilitation tools, and metrics platforms that teams use to implement agile methodology in practice.

providers.name: Analytics
providers.description: A curated index of analytics platforms, SDKs, and open source solutions spanning the full analytics spectrum — from web and product analytics (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Plausible, Matomo, Heap) to customer data platforms (Segment, mParticle, RudderStack), mobile analytics (Firebase Analytics, Adjust, AppsFlyer, Braze), business intelligence (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Redash), event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), and real-time analytics infrastructure (ClickHouse, Druid, Pinot). Covers both SaaS and self-hosted, open source and commercial offerings.

providers.name: Anine Bing
providers.description: Anine Bing is a Los Angeles-based contemporary womenswear and fashion brand selling apparel, denim, footwear, and accessories direct to consumers through its online store at aninebing.com. The storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: a published /llms.txt and /agents.md, a Universal Commerce Protocol (ucp.dev) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, and a live UCP shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Customer authentication is provided by Shopify's Customer Account API over OpenID Connect. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Index Ventures, this profile has been enriched from the brand's real public agent, auth, and discovery surfaces.

providers.name: Anomali
providers.description: Anomali is an enterprise cybersecurity vendor whose Agentic SOC Platform unifies threat intelligence, security data, and agentic AI. Its flagship ThreatStream is a leading Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) that operationalizes indicators of compromise across a Unified Security Data Lake with SIEM, SOAR, and XDR capabilities. Anomali exposes a ThreatStream REST API (api.threatstream.com) for managing intelligence, observables, investigations, and integrations, and maintains a partner marketplace of prebuilt integrations. This API Evangelist profile was seeded from the general-catalyst portfolio and enriched from Anomali's public surfaces (status page, security/responsible-disclosure program, privacy and terms pages, GitHub organization, and blog).

providers.name: ApiShare
providers.description: ApiShare is an API governance platform that provides a unified operational model for API lifecycle management, access control, catalog management, and asset reuse across organizations. It operates as a native component of an Internal Developer Platform, enabling self-service, standardized, and secure API governance without replacing existing systems.

providers.name: Aristotle
providers.description: Aristotle (heyaristotle.com) is an AI tutoring platform that delivers personalized, one-on-one, dialogue-based instruction across all subjects. Rather than lecturing or simply marking answers wrong, it uses a Socratic, voice-first approach to diagnose conceptual misconceptions and verifies each response turn-by-turn before delivering it to the student. Positioned as an affordable alternative to human tutors, its methodology is grounded in learning science (Bloom's two-sigma work, ICAP, LearnLM benchmarks). Backed by True Ventures. Sector: EdTech / AI education. No public developer API or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Biome Makers
providers.description: Biome Makers is a global agricultural technology company founded in 2015 and headquartered in El Macero, California, that uses soil microbiome DNA sequencing and machine learning to measure and restore soil health. Its BeCrop platform decodes the functionality of soil microbial communities across 200+ crops in 56+ countries, delivering agronomic recommendations, agricultural-input validation, and supply-chain sustainability benchmarking to farmers, ag retailers, CPG companies, and research labs. Products include BeCrop Farm, BeCrop Test, BeCrop Trials, and BeCrop Rate. BeCrop is accessible via API for large-scale partner integrations, though the developer API is partner-gated and no public OpenAPI specification is currently published.

providers.name: BrainCo
providers.description: BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCalm - that measure attention and stress from brainwave signals for education, wellness and biofeedback, alongside the BrainRobotics neuroprosthetic hand and the Revo (Revo1/Revo2/Revo3) family of dexterous robotic hands for robotics and embodied-AI developers. BrainCo ships first-party SDKs rather than a public REST API: the Crimson SDK for its portable EEG devices (Node.js and native/BLE), the Focus SDK for headband brainwave measurement, and the Revo Hand SDKs (Python and C/C++, distributed on PyPI and GitHub) that speak RS-485, CAN 2.0A/CAN FD, EtherCAT and Protobuf, plus ROS 2 drivers and URDF/MJCF/USD simulation assets. The company is backed by IDG Capital and operates in the healthcare, neurotech, robotics and education-technology sectors.

providers.name: Brightfield
providers.description: Brightfield is an extended-workforce intelligence company whose TDX (Talent Data Exchange) and TDX AI platform give enterprises data, automation, and precision over contingent-labor and statement-of-work (SOW) spending across 100+ countries. Products include Rate Intelligence, Rate Card Manager, SOW Rate Insights, SOW Quality and Risk Analytics, Supplier Scorecard, and an ROI Dashboard, built on transaction-level data from 700+ companies and $500B+ of global spend. Founded and led by CEO Jason Ezratty and headquartered in Washington, DC, Brightfield is backed by Sapphire Ventures. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application; no public developer API or documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: BUX
providers.description: BUX is a European neobroker and mobile-first investing app operated by BUX B.V., a subsidiary of ABN AMRO. It lets retail investors across Europe buy and sell individual stocks and ETFs commission-free starting from as little as EUR 10, build automated BUX Investment Plans (thematic and expert-built portfolios), and earn interest on uninvested cash across BUX Basic, Plus, and Prime account tiers. BUX is authorised and regulated by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM), with client financial instruments and money held in segregated custody via ABN AMRO Clearing and deposits protected up to EUR 100,000 under the Dutch Deposit Guarantee Scheme. BUX does not publish a public developer API or SDKs; this profile captures the company's identity, legal, and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Chainlink
providers.description: Build hybrid smart contracts with Chainlink

providers.name: Coursebase
providers.description: Coursebase is an AI-powered corporate Learning Management System (LMS) used by over 1,000 organizations to create, deliver, and manage employee training across online, in-person, and blended formats. The platform offers a library of 1,000+ pre-built eLearning courses, AI-assisted content generation (auto-generated test questions and course summaries), analytics and reporting dashboards, single sign-on, multi-language support, and API-based integration with external HR systems for syncing user account information. Coursebase was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched in the API Evangelist network; the public surface is a marketing site with an enterprise "contact us" API integration offering rather than a self-serve developer portal or published OpenAPI.

providers.name: Courtyard
providers.description: Courtyard (courtyard.io) is a marketplace and tokenization service for physical collectibles — trading cards, luxury watches, and other graded assets. Collectors vault a physical item in Courtyard's insured facility and receive a blockchain-backed digital token (an NFT on Ethereum/Polygon) representing verified ownership, which can then be instantly bought, sold, bid on, or redeemed for physical shipment. The platform combines a "Proof of Integrity" authentication process, KYC-gated onboarding, a hosted wallet with fiat funding, digital pack drops and auctions, and a curated showroom experience. Courtyard is a Forerunner Ventures portfolio company operating in the commerce / collectibles sector; it exposes a consumer web application and smart contracts rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: DataSnipper
providers.description: DataSnipper is an AI-powered, agentic productivity platform built specifically for audit, tax, and finance teams. It automates repetitive testing and analysis work - extracting, matching, and analyzing data across documents and systems - while keeping human professionals in control of final decisions. Capabilities include AI Agents for end-to-end workflows (revenue testing, tests of detail, royalty calculations), Excel Agents that run analysis directly inside spreadsheets, and document intelligence that collects and cross-references evidence. The platform serves external audit, internal audit, tax, financial control, government audit, and advisory teams, with a security-first posture (no training on customer data, encryption, and 24-hour document deletion). Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Donut
providers.description: Donut is an employee experience platform that helps companies design, automate, and scale people programs directly inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Best known for its intro and coffee-chat pairing bot, Donut runs onboarding journeys, team-connection and watercooler programs, peer recognition, and engagement surveys, and imports data from 50+ HRIS systems (BambooHR, Greenhouse, Workday) alongside Zoom, Google Meet, and calendar integrations. It is trusted by 20,000+ teams including Anthropic, Figma, Carta, and Ramp. Donut authenticates users via Slack OAuth and is SOC 2 compliant. It does not currently publish a public developer API; its GitHub organization ships a Slack app template and internal tooling.

providers.name: Dropsuite
providers.description: Dropsuite, now a NinjaOne company, is a cloud backup, archiving, and recovery platform built for managed service providers (MSPs) and their small-to-midsize business customers. It provides automated backup and one-click restore for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, email, and website/database data, plus long-term email archiving with legal hold, eDiscovery, and journaling for compliance. Partners manage tenants through a multi-tenant portal and can automate provisioning, reporting, and reconciliation through a partner REST API gated to Direct Partners and Distributors (credentials issued in the Partner Portal under Settings -> API Settings). Dropsuite was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ellipsis Labs
providers.description: Ellipsis Labs builds decentralized finance applications and infrastructure on Solana. Its flagship product is Phoenix, a fully on-chain, atomically-settled limit order book exchange for spot assets, now expanded with Phoenix Perps for on-chain perpetual futures. The team also develops Atlas (a high-performance DeFi Layer 2), Gavel (token distribution and liquidity bootstrapping), and Plasma (a sandwich-resistant AMM reference implementation). Ellipsis exposes its protocol to developers through open-source SDKs (TypeScript, Rust, Python), command-line tools, and on-chain Solana programs rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Electric Capital and Paradigm.

providers.name: ERGO NEXT Insurance
providers.description: ERGO NEXT Insurance (formerly NEXT Insurance) is a Palo Alto, California technology-first Property & Casualty insurer focused on the specific needs of U.S. small and medium-sized business owners. Founded in 2016, the company offers fully digital commercial coverage including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Business Owner's Policy (BOP), Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Tools & Equipment, Employment Practices Liability, Product Liability, and Liquor Liability — serving more than 750,000 customers across 1,300+ professions. In March 2025 Munich Re signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of NEXT Insurance at a valuation of $2.6 billion; ERGO Group AG (Munich Re's primary insurance arm) closed the full acquisition on July 1, 2025 and on January 15, 2026 the company rebranded as ERGO NEXT Insurance, becoming Munich Re/ERGO's foothold in the U.S. SMB market. ERGO NEXT's partner-facing surface is NEXT Connect, an embedded insurance platform that lets payroll, point-of-sale, accounting, e-commerce, payments, banking, and fintech platforms quote and bind small-business coverage from within their own product through low-code components and API calls. NEXT Connect aggregates 15+ carriers (including ERGO NEXT itself, Travelers, Liberty Mutual, Chubb, CNA, The Hartford) and is documented in the wild through embedded-payroll partners such as Check, Gusto Embedded, Intuit QuickBooks, Square, LegalZoom, and Amazon Business Prime, but ERGO NEXT does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve SDKs — partner onboarding is gated through a partnerships team. The company also offers a pay-as-you-go Workers' Comp product that integrates with partner payroll runs so premium is calculated against actual per-cycle W-2 wages.

providers.name: FireMon
providers.description: FireMon is a cybersecurity company providing firewall and security policy management across hybrid, on-premises, and cloud environments. Its platform normalizes and governs security policies spanning firewalls, cloud security groups, and microsegmentation tools, delivering compliance automation, policy optimization, change automation, and real-time risk insight. FireMon serves more than 1,700 customers across 70+ countries, concentrated in healthcare, financial services, retail, and manufacturing. Its Security Manager platform exposes a REST API, delivered per-install (self-hosted or cloud appliance) rather than as a single public hosted endpoint. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from FireMon's public web and documentation surface.

providers.name: Flux CD
providers.description: Flux is a set of continuous and progressive delivery solutions for Kubernetes that are open and extensible, enabling GitOps-based automation for keeping Kubernetes clusters in sync with sources of configuration like Git repositories.

providers.name: Growatt
providers.description: Growatt New Energy is a global manufacturer of solar PV inverters, energy storage systems, and smart energy management products for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations.
