Growatt operates the ShineServer / ShinePhone cloud monitoring platform and publishes a token-authenticated Open API (V1) that lets third-party systems read plant and device telemetry, retrieve historical energy data, and read or write inverter parameters for MIN (TLX) string inverters and SPH (MIX) hybrid inverters across regional endpoints. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital; enriched from Growatt's public developer surface.

providers.name: Headnote
providers.description: Headnote is a legal payments and accounts-receivable platform built specifically for law firms. Founded in 2016 by attorney Sarah Schaaf, it lets firms accept trust-compliant credit card and eCheck (ACH) payments via shareable payment links and a hosted client payment portal, then automates collections, AR tracking, and client NPS/satisfaction reporting. Headnote is designed to be 100% compliant with IOLTA rules, the ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, and lawyer trust/operating account requirements across all 50 states, and integrates with existing billing and practice-management software by attaching a Headnote payment link to invoices. Card and bank data are tokenized with Stripe and Plaid and the platform runs on AWS with PCI-compliant, encrypted-at-rest-and-in-transit infrastructure. Headnote was acquired by ASG LegalTech (an Alpine Investors platform, alongside PracticePanther, Bill4Time, and MerusCase) in 2020. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. Headnote does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile is an identity record.

providers.name: HireArt
providers.description: HireArt is a workforce management platform that helps enterprises source, employ, and manage their contingent workforce - contract workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors - through a single self-serve system. Its products span Employer of Record (EOR), on-demand sourcing and recruitment, a Vendor Management System (VMS), worker classification and compliance (1099 vs. W-2 with indemnification), program management, and freelancer management. Customers include Toyota Research Institute, Zoox, Via, Scale AI, Dropbox, Meta Quest, Carta, and Rover. HireArt was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Hopper
providers.description: Hopper is a travel marketplace and fintech, best known for consumer flight, hotel, car, and homes booking with fintech ancillaries such as Price Freeze, Cancel for Any Reason, and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason. Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is the B2B arm that exposes Hopper's e-commerce (Stays, Cars, Packages), fintech ancillaries, loyalty portals, and HTS Assist agentic AI to banks, airlines, and travel providers including Capital One, Air Canada, Virgin Australia, Tripadvisor, Frontier, Wizz Air, and Porter.

providers.name: KeepFace
providers.description: KeepFace is an all-in-one influencer marketing platform that helps brands, agencies, and enterprises discover, manage, and measure creator campaigns at scale. The platform spans creator discovery and CRM across 2M+ influencers in 43 countries, campaign management from brief through outreach, contract, and content approval, AI-driven brand-safety scoring and sentiment analysis of posts, real-time performance reporting (engagement rate, estimated media value, deletion-proof post archives), affiliate link tracking with pay-on-attributed-sales commissioning, and customer and employee advocacy programs. KeepFace is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: LegalZoom
providers.description: LegalZoom.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: LZ) is a Glendale, California online legal technology and services company that helps individuals and small businesses create legal documents and form, run, and grow their businesses without necessarily hiring an attorney. Founded in 1999, LegalZoom offers business formation services (LLC, S-Corp, C-Corp, nonprofit, DBA), registered agent service, EIN/tax ID filing, annual report and compliance filings, business licenses, virtual mail, business banking partnerships, trademark registration, and ongoing bookkeeping and tax services through LZ Books and LZ Tax. On the personal side it provides wills, living trusts, power of attorney, prenuptial agreements, and a partner-driven divorce flow via Divorce.com. Customers access an attorney-network legal advice subscription (LZ Legal Services / business advisory plans) connecting them to independent attorneys for consultations and document review. LegalZoom went public on Nasdaq in 2021 (ticker LZ) and serves customers primarily in the United States. The company's revenue model is transactional document and formation fees plus recurring subscription services (registered agent, compliance, attorney advice, bookkeeping). LegalZoom does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; partner integrations (e.g. divorce.com, banking partners, accounting partners) appear to be private commercial arrangements rather than self-service developer APIs. The legalzoom.com web app calls a set of internal hosts under apigw.legalzoom.com (checkout-graphql-public-api, customer, experimentation, revv, attorney-state-service, site-search) but these are first-party and not documented for third-party use.

providers.name: Lockton
providers.description: Lockton Companies is the world's largest privately held, independent insurance brokerage, founded by Jack Lockton in 1966 and headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, United States. Lockton is a broker and intermediary rather than a risk carrier: it places commercial property and casualty, specialty and financial lines, employee benefits and people solutions, private client coverage, and — through Lockton Re — treaty and facultative reinsurance, for tens of thousands of clients across a global network of associates and offices reaching more than 140 locations. Its API posture is honestly characterized as partner-gated with no public API surface. As of July 2026 Lockton publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or Swagger definition, no GraphQL endpoint, no Postman workspace, and no webhook or event catalog. The hostnames developer.lockton.com, developers.lockton.com, docs.lockton.com and api.lockton.com do not resolve in DNS, and a crawl of the 6,953 URLs in global.lockton.com/sitemap.xml surfaces no developer, API, ACORD, IVANS, OpenAPI or Swagger path. Client-facing technology is delivered through authenticated regional Lockton Client Portals and the proprietary Lockton SAGE intelligence and analytics ecosystem, which is presented on the website behind a contact form with no self-serve access, no documented data feed and no published integration surface. This is the expected posture for a US broker-intermediary: the United States has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate, so data exchange between carriers, brokers and agency management systems runs on ACORD standards in an EDI and forms idiom rather than a public API idiom. Lockton's most substantive standards signal is governance rather than implementation — in July 2026 Nidhi Howell, Chief Business Technology Officer of Lockton Re, was appointed to the ACORD Solutions Group Board of Directors representing the reinsurance broking channel — but no ACORD AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS or IVANS agency-download implementation is documented on any public Lockton property.

providers.name: Mirantis
providers.description: Mirantis provides enterprise Kubernetes and container platform solutions for multi-cloud, hybrid-cloud, and edge deployments. Its product line includes Mirantis Kubernetes Engine (MKE), k0rdent Enterprise, Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes (MOSK), Mirantis Container Runtime, Mirantis Secure Registry, Lens Desktop, and the open source k0s Kubernetes distribution and k0smotron orchestrator.

providers.name: Nordigen
providers.description: Connect to bank accounts using official bank APIs and get raw transaction data

providers.name: PickTrace
providers.description: PickTrace is an agricultural workforce and harvest management SaaS platform for large-scale farms, founded by brothers Austin and Harrison Steed and a Y Combinator (Summer 2015) alumnus headquartered in Glendale, California. The platform captures time-and-attendance, piecework, productivity, onboarding, payroll, and receiving data in the field, office, and packinghouse, giving growers real-time visibility across their entire workforce year-round. It is used daily by tens of thousands of farm workers at some of the largest berry, citrus, and apple growers in the United States, Mexico, Peru, Chile, and Australia. PickTrace exposes a RESTful API that lets customers and third-party developers create, update, and extract objects from all PickTrace tools and bi-directionally sync labor data into and out of the platform for automation, payroll efficiency, and audit-ready compliance.

providers.name: Pika
providers.description: Pika (Pika Labs) is a generative AI video platform that turns text prompts and images into short, high-quality videos. Pika is primarily a consumer and creator product delivered through its web app at pika.art (and historically a Discord bot), with features such as text-to-video, image-to-video, Pikascenes, Pikaframes keyframe interpolation, lip sync, and AI sound effects. Pika does NOT publish a first-party developer API on its own domain. Its pika.art/api page is a landing page that directs developers to fal.ai, Pika's official inference partner, which hosts Pika's 2.x video models as callable API endpoints (for example fal-ai/pika/v2.2/text-to-video and fal-ai/pika/v2.2/image-to-video). Consumer access is sold as credit-based monthly subscriptions; programmatic access is billed per generation on fal. Various unofficial third-party wrappers (PiAPI, useapi.net, Pollo, and others) also resell Pika access but are not operated or endorsed by Pika.

providers.name: Poplin
providers.description: Poplin (formerly SudShare) is a nationwide on-demand laundry pickup and delivery marketplace connecting customers with independent, work-from-home "Laundry Pros" who wash, dry, and fold laundry, serving 500+ cities and 150,000+ customers. Poplin operates two consumer-facing mobile apps - the customer app and the Laundry Pro app - plus a Laundry Pro web portal (laundry-pro.poplin.co), but it does not expose a public or partner developer API. No developer portal or API reference was found at poplin.co, and the api.poplin.co subdomain resolves but returns a bare 404 with no documentation, indicating internal-only use. Business/SMB accounts (property managers, hospitality) are onboarded through sales and an account manager rather than through self-service API keys.

providers.name: Remerge
providers.description: Remerge is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) specializing in app retargeting, re-engagement, and user acquisition for mobile apps. The Berlin-based company (Remerge GmbH) helps advertisers in gaming, e-commerce, and delivery build in-app audience segments, run programmatic re-engagement and acquisition campaigns across millions of ad placements, and validate results with incrementality measurement. Remerge is a managed advertising service run through its platform and account teams rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and legal surface. It operates an ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned ISMS and publishes a public Trust Center and vulnerability disclosure policy.

providers.name: Simpleclub
providers.description: Simpleclub is a German digital learning platform serving over two million students (grades 5-13), apprentices, and organizations across school, vocational training (Ausbildung), continuing education, retraining, and workforce upskilling. The product pairs curriculum-aligned content (including IHK-aligned vocational tracks) with an AI-powered learning assistant, trainer/learning-management tooling, and the ability for organizations to upload custom content. It counts 750+ corporate clients such as Deutsche Bahn, Bosch, and Vodafone. Simpleclub maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Flutter tooling (math keyboard, flutter_math, design-token builder) but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile is an end-user/EdTech company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Source Beauty
providers.description: Source Beauty is an online beauty and wellbeing marketplace serving Egypt, selling skincare, makeup, fragrance, hair care, body care, K-beauty and wellness/supplement products from hundreds of local Egyptian and international brands. The consumer-facing storefront (sourcebeauty.com) offers curated brand pages, bundles and gift sets, promotional offers, bilingual English/Arabic shopping, and free shipping on qualifying orders. Source Beauty is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce website only and publishes no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Summer 2
providers.description: SummerOS (formerly reached at gosummer.com, which now 308-redirects to summeros.com) is an AI-driven asset-intelligence platform for short-term rental operators, owners, investors, and property managers. It provides professional-grade revenue forecasting, competitive market intelligence, and portfolio-wide performance analytics, plus an AI assistant (Sunny AI), so short-term rental teams can make data-driven pricing and investment decisions instead of relying on spreadsheets. It connects to property-management systems (Guesty, Hospitable, Streamline, Track) rather than exposing a public developer API. Surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio lead and enriched from its live public surface.

providers.name: Track Titan
providers.description: Track Titan is a sim racing analytics and coaching platform that records in-game telemetry from simulators including iRacing, Assetto Corsa and ACC, the F1 series, Automobilista 2, Forza Motorsport, and Le Mans Ultimate, turning laps into time-loss analysis, AI coaching feedback, auto-installed esports car setups, and structured Academy learning content for a community of over 295,000 sim racers on PC and console. Founded by former professional sim racer and Porsche coach Max Teichert and backed by investors including Partech, Track Titan is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of July 2026 (api.tracktitan.io serves only an internal backend service).

providers.name: Tranched
providers.description: Tranched is a London-based fintech building an embedded, on-chain securitisation platform that connects fintech lenders and loan originators directly to professional investors. Its "Deep Tokenisation" approach represents loans as on-chain tokens governed by Smart Loan Agreements and automated waterfall contracts, letting originators structure and launch institutional-grade asset-based financing transactions up to 90% faster and at lower cost than traditional securitisation, with automated compliance, reporting, and monitoring. Tranched connects to a lender's loan management system via API integration to retrieve the data required for assigning and monitoring loans. Founded in 2023 by Clement Larrue and Michael Elalouf, the company raised a $3.4M pre-seed round led by Speedinvest in November 2024.

providers.name: Turintech
providers.description: TurinTech AI builds Artemis, a code and AI optimization platform that searches configuration spaces across models, runtime, hardware, and source code to make production AI systems and software faster, cheaper, and more reliable without changing the existing stack. Artemis spans AI inference, agentic software, latency-critical infrastructure, and planning & scheduling, and is driven through the Artemis CLI, which imports Git repositories, generates and validates AI-optimized code versions (via LLM, agent, or genetic-algorithm methods), runs compile/test/benchmark validation, and opens optimization pull requests. TurinTech also offers evoML for automated machine-learning model building. Access is via the Artemis CLI and platform using an API key (ARTEMIS_API_KEY). The company is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Unlearn.AI
providers.description: Unlearn.AI provides an AI-powered platform that streamlines clinical trial development using digital twins of patients and advanced data analytics. Its TrialPioneer workspace spans trial planning and simulation (Scout literature search, Hindsight data exploration, SimLab scenario modeling), advanced trial monitoring with anomaly detection, and digital-twin control-arm forecasting that reduces control arm sizes and shortens enrollment. Backed by Insight Partners; no public developer API surface is published.

providers.name: Unlonely
providers.description: Unlonely was a crypto/web3 livestreaming platform founded by Grace and Brian Guan and backed by Multicoin Capital — livestreams on Base with token-gated chat, creator and temp tokens, the $VIBES on-chain interaction economy, and stream clips minted as NFCs (non-fungible clips). The product is defunct: the unlonely.app domain registration has expired and the hosted GraphQL API is no longer live, but the platform was open source and this profile preserves its real GraphQL schema (225 types) harvested from the public monorepo.

providers.name: Xtype
providers.description: xtype is an automated governance platform for ServiceNow, giving enterprises visibility, control, orchestration, and compliance across every instance in their ServiceNow estate — tracking changes, access decisions, and configurations and enforcing policy in real time. Products include xtype Enterprise and the free xtype View. The company is backed by ServiceNow Ventures, Columbia Capital, Norwest Venture Partners, Inner Loop Capital, and SaaS Venture Capital, with offices in Covina (CA), Tel Aviv, and Vienna. xtype publishes no public developer API: api.xtype.io is a live Kong gateway with no publicly documented routes.

providers.name: Zama
providers.description: Zama is an open-source cryptography company building state-of-the-art Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) solutions for blockchain and AI. Its developer surface is a suite of libraries and protocols rather than a hosted REST API: TFHE-rs (a Rust implementation of TFHE), Concrete (a Python-to-FHE compiler), Concrete ML (privacy-preserving machine learning), fhEVM and the Zama Protocol for building confidential smart contracts and dApps on EVM-compatible chains, plus TypeScript SDKs (the fhEVM Relayer SDK and React SDK). Zama publishes the ERC-7984 confidential token standard, a developer hub, GitBook documentation, and an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and enriched from Zama's public developer surface.

providers.name: 7 Cups
providers.description: 7 Cups (7cups.com) is an on-demand emotional health and online therapy service founded in 2013 and backed by Y Combinator. It connects people seeking support with a network of trained volunteer listeners for free, anonymous one-on-one chat, and matches members with licensed therapists and social workers for paid online therapy delivered by messaging, audio, or video. The platform also runs peer community forums, group support chat rooms, and self-help "growth path" content. 7 Cups operates across 189 countries in 140 languages with hundreds of thousands of trained listeners. It is a consumer web and mobile product rather than an API-first developer platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record and carries no public API at this time.

providers.name: Ambiq Micro
providers.description: Ambiq Micro is a semiconductor company that designs ultra-low-power System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions for battery-powered and endpoint-AI devices. Its proprietary Subthreshold Power Optimized Technology (SPOT) platform lets its Apollo family of Arm Cortex-M microcontrollers and Artasie real-time clocks run at extremely low energy, powering wearables, hearables, healthcare, smart-home, industrial and gaming devices. Ambiq's developer surface is an embedded C/C++ toolchain - the AmbiqSuite SDK and the open-source neuralSPOT AI SDK/Toolkit - plus a set of first-party Python AI toolkits (heartKIT, sleepKIT, physioKIT, neuralspotx) published on PyPI and GitHub (AmbiqAI, AmbiqMicro). This is not a web/REST API provider; it is profiled here for its open-source developer and AI SDK footprint.

providers.name: Base Power
providers.description: Base Power (Base Texas REP, LLC, PUCT License #10338) is an Austin, Texas home energy company that pairs an installed home battery (40–80 kWh) with retail electricity service across Texas and Illinois. The battery powers a home automatically during outages with no manual switch and helps lower the energy bill: batteries charge when grid demand is low and send power back to the grid when demand is high (grid-balancing), and that grid revenue helps keep member energy rates low. Base can be the retail electricity provider with or without a battery, works with existing solar, and serves the Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, TNMP, CoServ, GVEC, Farmers Electric, and El Paso Electric areas in Texas plus ComEd in Illinois. Led by CEO Zach Dell and co-founder Justin Lopas; named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies (2026); backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Addition, Bond Capital, Ribbit Capital, and Spark Capital. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Base publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: BitTorrent
providers.description: BitTorrent is the company behind the BitTorrent peer-to-peer file-sharing protocol and the uTorrent and BitTorrent desktop and web torrent clients, one of the most widely deployed distributed content-delivery technologies on the internet. Now part of the TRON ecosystem, BitTorrent also operates BitTorrent Chain (BTTC) — a layer-2 proof-of-stake cross-chain scaling and interoperability network bridging TRON, Ethereum, and BSC — along with the BTT token, the BTFS decentralized storage layer, and BitTorrent Speed. Its developer surface spans the local uTorrent Web UI API for controlling torrent clients and the BitTorrent Chain developer documentation for building on the BTTC network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Buildium
providers.description: Buildium, part of RealPage, is a cloud property-management platform aimed at small and mid-sized residential, association, and community-association property managers. The platform covers accounting, leasing, applicant and tenant management, rent collection, maintenance, communications, owner and resident portals, and association management. Buildium publishes a Public API used by certified partners and customers for property, lease, tenant, owner, vendor, rental application, financial, and webhook integration with the Buildium platform.

providers.name: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
providers.description: The Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) works to promote safety, protect the environment, and conserve resources offshore through vigorous regulatory oversight and enforcement.

providers.name: Clearview AI
providers.description: Clearview AI is a U.S.-based facial recognition company providing identity verification, investigative search, and biometric matching services primarily to law enforcement, government agencies, and approved financial sector customers. The platform indexes publicly available images and exposes proprietary facial recognition technology through a controlled, customer-vetted developer surface. Public technical documentation of the API is intentionally limited; access is gated, and integrations are scoped through customer agreements with strict use-case, audit, and transparency requirements.

providers.name: Cloud Native Buildpacks
providers.description: Cloud Native Buildpacks (CNBs) transform application source code into OCI-compliant container images that can run on any cloud, without requiring Dockerfiles. Initiated by Pivotal and Heroku in January 2018, CNBs are a CNCF incubating project licensed under Apache-2.0. They centralize container expertise through composable buildpacks, enable layer rebasing for efficient OS updates, and generate Software Bills of Materials (SBOM). The pack CLI and kpack platform operator are primary integration points.

providers.name: Compound Finance
providers.description: Compound is a decentralized, blockchain-based protocol that allows users to lend and borrow cryptocurrencies (DeFi lending protocol) built on Ethereum.

providers.name: Comscore
providers.description: Comscore is a cross-platform media measurement and audience analytics company that provides a trusted, independent currency for planning, transacting, and evaluating media across digital, social, television, streaming/CTV, movies, and programmatic advertising. Its products measure audiences, brands, and consumer behavior for media buyers and sellers, spanning advertising effectiveness, CTV and video measurement, programmatic targeting (Proximic by Comscore), social intelligence, and box-office tracking. Comscore publishes first-party audience- measurement SDKs for Android, iOS/tvOS, and Flutter used to instrument content and apps, and maintains an ISO/IEC 27001-certified trust and security program. It does not currently expose a public self-serve REST API or developer portal.

providers.name: connectFirst Credit Union
providers.description: connectFirst Credit Union is a member-owned, cooperative (Schedule-equivalent provincial credit union) financial institution headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, formed on May 3, 2021 by amalgamating four Alberta credit unions (First Calgary Financial, Chinook Financial, Mountain View Financial, and Legacy Financial). At its peak it held over CAD $6 billion in assets under administration and served more than 128,000 members across 41 branches in Central and Southern Alberta, offering retail, commercial, agricultural, and dealer-services banking. Members voted in November 2023 to merge with Servus Credit Union; the legal amalgamation closed May 1, 2024 as "Connect First and Servus Credit Union Ltd." (~CAD $29.3B assets, 600,000+ members), and the unified brand realigned to Servus Credit Union in January 2025 — the connectfirstcu.com domain now 301-redirects to servus.ca. Its open-finance posture is honest and typical of a Canadian credit union: no first-party public developer portal or downloadable OpenAPI, digital banking delivered via the Celero Xpress platform (powered by ebankIT) with core/banking-tech through the Central 1 / Celero cooperative ecosystem, and third-party consumer data access available only through aggregators (Plaid coverage confirmed). Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FCAC-overseen) is legislated but not yet operational, so no mandated open-banking API exists.

providers.name: Dependabot.yml
providers.description: GitHub Dependabot configuration file defining automated dependency update schedules, package ecosystems to monitor, grouping, cooldown, and review assignment rules.

providers.name: Distyl
providers.description: Distyl is an applied-AI company architecting the AI-native enterprise. Rather than layering automation onto broken processes, Distyl reimagines enterprise operations from the ground up with AI at the core, partnering with Fortune 500 organizations across Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Insurance, Retail, and Financial Services to design and operationalize AI transformations and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems in weeks. Its product suite includes Weave, Distillery, Context Mesh, Context Views, Journey, Personalization, and Apprentice. Founded by operators and researchers from Palantir, CIA, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Tesla, NASA, Stanford, and MIT, and backed by Coatue, OpenAI, Lightspeed, Microsoft, and Khosla Ventures. Distyl is a services/platform company with no public developer API; this profile captures its published web surface. Distyl is SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant.

providers.name: DoubleZero
providers.description: DoubleZero is a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN) that builds and operates a global, permissionless, dedicated-fiber backbone for distributed systems like blockchains — delivering low-latency, high-throughput connectivity where milliseconds matter. Its two-ring architecture pairs edge-node filtering with private high-bandwidth transport, connecting Solana validators, RPCs, and market-data consumers directly to one another. The network is coordinated by onchain smart contracts on Solana and powered by the 2Z SPL token, which meters bandwidth access, rewards fiber and device contributors for measured performance, and drives stake delegation. Operators connect through the first-party `doublezero` CLI and `doublezerod` daemon. Founded by Austin Federa with Malbec Labs; backed by Multicoin Capital and Dragonfly Capital.

providers.name: Floy
providers.description: Floy is a Munich-based healthcare AI company (founded 2021) that builds AI-powered radiology software for medical imaging. Its two products — opportunistic screening and diagnostic assistance — analyse CT and MRI examinations to surface additional findings beyond the initial radiologist assessment, enabling earlier diagnosis and better patient outcomes. The models are trained on 17 million medical examinations. Floy is an ISO 13485:2016 certified, EU MDR Class IIb medical-device manufacturer and is GDPR compliant, with research partnerships including DKFZ, LMU Klinikum Munich, Stanford, and the University of Oxford. It is backed by HV Capital, 10x Founders, xdeck, and Acurio Ventures. Floy is a clinical B2B product and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: General Intuition
providers.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab building large action foundation models that can perceive, predict, and act across space and time in both virtual and physical environments. Spun out of the gaming clip platform Medal, the company trains its spatial-temporal reasoning models on billions of action-labeled gameplay clips - recordings of exactly which buttons a player pressed and when - to teach AI agents how to move through and reason about the world. Its Mira world model powers applications across games, simulation, and robotics. Founded in 2025 and based in New York City, General Intuition has raised $454M total, including a $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation, and is onboarding first partners to a commercial API ahead of a broader developer release.

providers.name: Hello Patient
providers.description: Hello Patient builds AI agents (branded "Mia") for patient conversations across voice, text, and web chat, helping healthcare practices automate their front office, back office, and patient-growth workflows. Mia handles 24/7 appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and patient intake on the front office; revenue-cycle (RCM) follow-up and no-show recovery on the back office; and lead conversion, patient recall, and targeted outreach for growth. The platform serves dentistry, dermatology, ENT, mental health, optometry, primary care, urgent care, veterinary, and consumer-health practices, and integrates with EHR and practice systems including ModMed, AdvancedMD, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Athena Health, Veradigm, Zenoti, and others. Hello Patient is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type 2 certified. It is backed by 8VC and Scale Venture Partners. No public developer API is documented at this time; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: hyperexponential
providers.description: hyperexponential (hx) is a London-based insurtech that builds the #1 pricing and underwriting decision platform for commercial property & casualty (P&C) insurance. Its platform - spanning the Hyperoperator agentic assistant, a no-code Workflow Builder, Calculation Engines, and Portfolio Intelligence - lets actuaries and underwriters build, deploy, and iterate pricing models and underwriting workflows without heavy engineering. Carriers use hx to automate submission triage, risk assessment, renewals, portfolio monitoring, and regulatory compliance, with top global carriers running $75bn+ in annual commercial P&C premium on the platform. hyperexponential is backed by a16z and Battery Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and compliance surface; hx does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI, so this repo is enriched from identity, trust-center, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Infera
providers.description: Infera is an AI-native laboratory automation platform (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that converts plain-English descriptions of experiments into validated, instrument-ready runs across the lab instruments a team already owns. It compiles protocols into vendor-specific scripts for liquid handlers, plate readers, mass spectrometers, thermocyclers and centrifuges (Opentrons, Hamilton, Tecan and others), limits AI to initial drafts while keeping downstream steps deterministic and fully checkable, supports both automated and manual bench procedures, and maintains an end-to-end audit trail of protocols and runs. Founded in San Francisco by Troy Zhang and Chloe Sow.

providers.name: kagent
providers.description: kagent is an open-source framework for running AI agents in Kubernetes, automating complex DevOps operations and troubleshooting tasks with intelligent workflows. It is a Cloud Native Computing Foundation sandbox project that brings agentic AI to cloud-native environments.

providers.name: Kayrros
providers.description: Kayrros is an environmental-intelligence and geospatial-AI company that independently tracks human activity and its physical footprint worldwide by combining satellite imagery, alternative data, and machine learning. Its products span energy markets — crude oil and jet fuel intelligence, LNG, renewables, solar and battery-storage construction monitoring, industrial and on-road energy demand, and stockpiles — and environmental risk — methane emissions via Methane Watch, wildfire risk, forest-carbon and deforestation monitoring, and carbon accounting. Kayrros delivers asset-level data feeds, APIs, and dashboards to traders, operators, financial institutions, regulators, insurers, and the public sector. The company was acquired by Energy Aspects in May 2026.

providers.name: Matic
providers.description: Matic is a digital insurance marketplace and independent insurance agency that lets consumers compare and buy home, auto, pet, umbrella, jewelry and other personal-lines insurance from a network of 60+ A-rated carriers in one place. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Matic is best known for its embedded-insurance model: it integrates insurance shopping into the digital experiences of mortgage lenders, servicers, banks and other financial-services partners so borrowers and account holders can obtain coverage at the point of need. Matic is a licensed agency operating in all 50 states and is backed by investors including Anthemis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; this enrichment pass confirms Matic operates as a consumer-facing insurance marketplace with a partner/embedded-insurance business but no publicly documented developer API surface.

providers.name: Meal Ticket
providers.description: Meal Ticket is a Boise, Idaho-based SaaS company (founded 2011) delivering profitability management software for the foodservice supply chain. Its TrackMax+ platform helps food distributors and suppliers manage rebates, allowances, trade programs, payments, and operator-level intelligence at line-item detail, while its MarketMan platform provides AI-powered inventory and food-cost management to 15,000+ restaurant locations across 55+ countries. Meal Ticket serves 100+ distributors and suppliers and processes $40B+ in annual sales and rebate volume. The company operates as a customer-facing SaaS with a single-sign-on login surface (OpenID Connect) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Mockito
providers.description: Mockito is a popular open-source mocking framework for unit tests in Java. It lets developers write clean, readable tests by creating mock objects, stubbing their behavior, verifying interactions, and using simple, fluent APIs to keep test setup minimal and intent obvious.

providers.name: Model ML
providers.description: Model ML is an AI-native platform for financial services that embeds an agentic "finance agent" into the tools professionals already use — Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, its own app, and a firm's internal systems. It automates deliverables through Workflows, runs compound-intelligence analysis via Grids, performs document review and risk assessment, captures information with a Notetaker, and answers questions through Chat and agentic dashboards backed by real-time data connections. It targets investment banking, consulting, private equity and credit, and asset and wealth management. Model ML is a fintech company backed by QED Investors. The company publishes a trust center and a security program (ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR) but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: NUnit
providers.description: NUnit is a unit-testing framework for all .NET languages. Initially ported from JUnit, the current production release has been completely rewritten with many new features and support for a wide range of .NET platforms. NUnit is a software testing framework, not a remote HTTP API service.

providers.name: OnTheMarket
providers.description: OnTheMarket is the third-largest residential property portal in the United Kingdom, operating onthemarket.com. It was founded in 2013 by Agents' Mutual Limited as an agent-owned challenger to Rightmove and Zoopla, listed on AIM as OnTheMarket plc, and was acquired outright by CoStar Group in December 2023 for approximately GBP 99 million. In a market with no MLS and no cooperative listing standard, OnTheMarket sits at the demand end of the value chain: consumers search the portal, and listings arrive from member estate agents' CRM systems rather than from a shared data pool. Its API posture is honest and narrow. There is no public developer portal — developer., developers., api. and docs.onthemarket.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /api-docs all return 404 on the main site. What does exist is a member-only integration surface: the OnTheMarket Real Time Datafeed (RTDF), a Rightmove-RTDF-compatible feed API served from the live, OnTheMarket-operated host realtime-api.onthemarket.com, used by agency CRM vendors to push listings and pull branch enquiries on behalf of member agents. No machine-readable contract for it is published anywhere; OnTheMarket's developer guide is distributed under agreement, and every path on the host returns 404 to an anonymous caller. There is no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData $metadata document and no Universal Property Identifier anywhere in the stack — RESO is a North American construct and the UK has never adopted it, so "certified but unreachable" does not apply here; there is no certification layer in this market at all. OnTheMarket publishes no open data. The genuinely open UK property layer belongs to the public sector — HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and Ordnance Survey — and none of it comes from the portals. OnTheMarket's own Terms of Use go further than most and expressly forbid automated access to any page other than the home page.

providers.name: Orchid Labs
providers.description: Orchid Labs is the company behind Orchid, an open-source, decentralized marketplace for bandwidth and a privacy-focused VPN. Orchid lets users pay for VPN service through nanopayments settled on a probabilistic payment layer built on Ethereum, using the OXT utility token and Orchid Accounts rather than traditional subscriptions. The stack includes an open-source multi-hop VPN client (Dart), the Orchid DApp for account creation and management, a decentralized directory of bandwidth providers running as smart contracts, and an L2/L3 nanopayment protocol. Backed by a16z, Sequoia Capital, DFJ, and Polychain, Orchid Labs focuses on decentralized privacy infrastructure rather than a conventional developer REST API.

providers.name: Oviva
providers.description: Oviva is a European digital health company, founded in 2014, delivering personalized, dietitian-led care for people managing type 2 diabetes, obesity, and other diet-related conditions. It combines a mobile app for logging food, activity, and progress with human coaching from a network of 420+ dietitians, psychologists, and doctors, operating across the UK, Germany, and Switzerland and serving 900K+ people. Oviva is delivered as a regulated digital therapeutic (CE-marked, ISO 27001, NHS DTAC and CQC assessed) rather than through a public developer API; this profile captures its security, compliance, and legal surface. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Sym
providers.description: Sym was a developer-first authorization and access-management platform for platform, security, and infrastructure engineering teams. Rather than a REST API, Sym exposes its control plane as infrastructure-as-code: teams declare access flows, environments, targets, and user-facing fields with the Sym Terraform provider, customize runtime behavior with the Python SDK (hooks and reducers in impl.py), and operate the platform with the symflow CLI. It automated context-based, time-bound access requests and approvals across AWS (IAM, SSO), Okta, GCP, Jira, Slack, and other targets with centralized governance embedded in an organization's existing SDLC. The Sym product is now largely wound down — the docs root is sunset and most source repositories under github.com/symopsio are archived — but its published packages, Terraform provider, and changelog remain available.

providers.name: Talus Network
providers.description: Talus Network is a decentralized Layer 1 platform for building and running autonomous, verifiable AI agents fully on-chain. Its core product, Nexus, is an agentic workflow engine that lets developers compose agents as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of reusable Tools — LLM calls, HTTP requests, storage, exchanges — executed and settled on-chain. Talus is built on Sui Move smart contracts with a Cosmos SDK / CometBFT Protochain node, and ships a developer surface as Rust crates (nexus-sdk, nexus-cli, nexus-toolkit), a Homebrew/AUR CLI, GitBook developer docs, and on-chain Move module API references. Backed by Polychain, Talus positions itself as infrastructure for the autonomous digital economy. There is no traditional REST / OpenAPI HTTP API; the platform is consumed through the SDK, CLI, and Move contracts.

providers.name: TourAmigo
providers.description: Tour Amigo is a cloud-based booking and operations platform for multi-day tour operators, destination management companies (DMCs), and river and expedition cruise operators. The platform covers itinerary building, supplier and contract management, direct online selling, agent and customer portals, financial management with native Xero integration, and an API-powered channel manager that distributes tours to partners such as GetYourGuide, TourRadar, and Tourhub. Backed by 500 Global, with core markets in Australia, New Zealand, and Europe.

providers.name: United States Botanic Garden
providers.description: The United States Botanic Garden (USBG) is a living museum in Washington, D.C. that showcases a diverse collection of plants from around the world. Established by the U.S. Congress in 1820, the Botanic Garden serves as a resource for education and inspiration, promoting an understanding and appreciation of plants and their importance to the environment and human well-being. The Garden maintains more than 9,500 accessions representing approximately 44,000 plants, managed through its Living Collections database (BG-BASE). The USBG is administered by the Architect of the Capitol and is located adjacent to the U.S. Capitol on the National Mall.

providers.name: Valyuu
providers.description: Valyuu is an Amsterdam-founded embedded recommerce service provider offering a plug-and-play trade-in platform that businesses integrate to buy back, resell, and recycle used consumer electronics such as smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches across Dutch, German, and English-language markets. Its partner-facing Trade-In API powers embedded trade-in flows covering device catalogs, condition questions, offers, payments, and shipping. Valyuu is a Techstars portfolio company; as of mid-2026 valyuu.com redirects to prioont.com, whose storefront is currently unreachable.

providers.name: Varnish Cache
providers.description: Varnish Cache is a high-performance HTTP accelerator and reverse proxy designed for content-heavy dynamic websites and APIs. It sits in front of web servers and caches HTTP responses to serve repeated requests without hitting the backend, dramatically reducing load and latency. Varnish is configured via VCL (Varnish Configuration Language), a domain-specific language for request/response policy, and managed through a CLI interface (varnishadm) and a set of command-line tools for logging, statistics, and monitoring.

providers.name: Whelp
providers.description: Whelp is an omnichannel customer messaging and support platform that unifies Live Chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and Viber into a single shared team inbox. It pairs a built-in CRM and unified customer view with a drag-and-drop AI chatbot builder, outbound bulk-messaging campaigns, and reporting and analytics for sales, marketing, and support teams. Whelp is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Yulife
providers.description: YuLife is a London-founded (2016) technology-driven insurtech and employee benefits platform offering group life insurance, group health insurance, income protection and a gamified wellbeing app. Employees complete everyday wellness activities to earn YuCoin rewards, with access to an EAP, telemedicine and wellbeing apps such as Meditopia. A certified B Corp, YuLife insures 400k+ lives across the UK and US and sells to employers and brokers. It publishes no public developer API or portal; api.yulife.com is the internal app backend (issuer api.uk.yulife.com), and a Vanta Trust Center is at trust.yulife.com.

providers.name: Affiliated Managers Group
providers.description: Affiliated Managers Group (AMG) is a global asset management company that partners with outstanding independent investment management firms. With approximately $813 billion in assets under management across roughly 40 affiliate firms and 500+ investment strategies, AMG provides capital, distribution, and operational support while preserving each affiliate's investment autonomy. AMG operates a Wealth Platform for financial advisors and an Institutional Platform for global institutional investors, offering mutual funds, separately managed accounts, and alternative investment strategies.

providers.name: Alif Semiconductor
providers.description: Alif Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Pleasanton, California with engineering operations in Grenoble, France. It designs secure, AI/ML-enabled 32-bit microcontrollers and fusion processors for edge computing, built around Arm Cortex-M55 cores and dedicated Arm Ethos-U55 Neural Processing Units. Its Ensemble (E1C, E1, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8) and Balletto (B1) product families target battery-powered edge AI and generative-AI workloads, pairing hardware AI acceleration with autonomous aiPM power management and a multilayered hardware Root of Trust security subsystem. Alif ships an embedded developer surface rather than a public web API: a Zephyr-based SDK, CMSIS Device Family Packs, VS Code project templates, the Conductor configuration tool, evaluation kits, datasheets, and reference manuals published across its support hub and GitHub organization. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and Mayfield.

providers.name: AngularJS
providers.description: AngularJS (Angular.js, version 1.x) is the original Angular JavaScript framework for building dynamic single-page web applications, created by Google. It introduced MVC patterns to front-end development with two-way data binding, dependency injection, directives, filters, services, and controllers. AngularJS reached End of Life on December 31, 2021 and is no longer actively maintained. Developers should migrate to the modern Angular framework (v14+).

providers.name: Appriss Retail
providers.description: Appriss Retail provides AI-powered solutions that help retailers manage Total Retail Loss across in-store and online channels. Its SaaS platform combines data intelligence, decision intelligence, and workflow intelligence to reduce returns fraud, shrink, and exceptions in real time. Marquee products include Appriss Engage (return and claims authorization, incorporating the Verify return-authorization engine), Appriss Secure (shrink and exception analytics), Appriss Incident (case management), Sidekick (an AI collaborator for loss-prevention teams), and the APIS performance-intelligence platform. Appriss Retail serves more than 60 of the top 100 U.S. retailers, drawing on 20+ years of retail data science. Programmatic integration is delivered to retailer clients through the APIS Online cloud portal rather than a public self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Ben
providers.description: Ben (thanksben.com) is an AI-native global employee benefits and rewards platform for enterprises. It unifies benefits eligibility rules, policy configuration, employee enrollment and access, spend and compliance dashboards, and rewards/recognition into a single system spanning 140+ countries, replacing fragmented regional benefits tooling. Customers include Moet, Henkel, Virgin, Zalando, Deliveroo, and Octopus Energy. Ben is backed by Seedcamp and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API today, so this profile captures the company's identity and its public security and trust surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a Vanta-hosted Trust Center, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Better Health
providers.description: Better Health (Better Health Supplies) is a modern, direct-to-consumer medical supplier that ships home medical supplies for chronic conditions straight to patients' doorsteps. The company covers diabetes and continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), incontinence, urology and self-catheterization, ostomy, and wound care categories, carrying leading brands and pairing product fulfillment with insurance-benefit navigation and one-on-one peer and clinical support. Better Health operates a Shopify-based storefront at joinbetter.com plus an education-focused community blog, and is backed by General Catalyst. It is cataloged in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare company profile; it publishes a consumer commerce experience rather than a first-party developer API, so this record captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Change.org
providers.description: Change.org is an independent, nonprofit-owned social-change platform where anyone can start, sign, and win petitions. With over 500 million users worldwide, it lets people launch campaigns on social, political, and community issues, collect signatures, engage decision makers, and reach the media to drive real-world outcomes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Change.org's historical public developer/petitions API has been deprecated and is no longer maintained; no first-party OpenAPI, SDK, or hosted MCP server is currently published.

providers.name: Chui
providers.description: Chui, now operating as Trueface (part of BigBear.ai after the Pangiam acquisition), is a facial recognition and computer vision company. Originally launched as "Chui," the world's first faceprint API for access and identity, the technology is delivered today as a licensed developer SDK with C++, Python, Android, and iOS bindings, plus a Dockerized on-premises REST API (Trueface On-Prem / PTOP) for 1:1 and 1:N face matching, spoof and liveness detection, object detection, and identity verification. Deployment options span on-device, self-hosted Docker, and AWS. The technology has been evaluated in NIST FRVT and DHS/CBP testing and is applied across fintech, education, security, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and government. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled by the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clearcover
providers.description: Clearcover is a digital-first auto insurance company that offers customizable, affordable car insurance backed by AI-assisted claims that can resolve eligible claims in minutes rather than days. Customers buy and manage policies through a mobile app, file claims by photographing damage, and track claim status in real time, with coverage spanning liability, comprehensive and collision, medical payments, uninsured/underinsured motorist protection, roadside assistance, and alternate transportation. Clearcover operates across multiple US states through several underwriting entities, distributes through both direct and independent-agent channels, and runs a developer portal for partner and embedded insurance integrations. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Columnar
providers.description: Columnar is a data-infrastructure company advancing open standards for database connectivity. It builds and maintains tooling around ADBC (Apache Arrow Database Connectivity), including dbc — a cross-platform command-line package manager that installs and manages ADBC drivers across macOS, Linux, and Windows and eight programming languages — and databow, a command-line SQL query tool over ADBC. Columnar also ships the DuckDB ADBC community extension and publishes Agent Skills so AI agents can connect to and query databases through ADBC. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and is built on the Apache Arrow open-source ecosystem.

providers.name: Dezerv
providers.description: Dezerv (Dezerv Investments Private Limited) is an Indian wealth-management platform building a house of investment solutions for affluent Indians. It offers discretionary Portfolio Management Services (PMS), curated mutual-fund portfolios, bonds, an Investment Portfolio Analyser (IPA), a Wealth Monitor for tracking held-away assets, and ESOP financing, alongside a research-led investment philosophy and a weekly money newsletter. Dezerv is a SEBI-registered Portfolio Manager (INP000007377) and Investment Manager to a Category-I AIF / Angel Fund; mutual-fund distribution is via its AMFI-registered subsidiary. The company is client-facing (client.dezerv.in portal) and does not publish a public developer API surface. This API Evangelist profile enriches the company identity, links, and security posture rather than an API.

providers.name: Docura Health
providers.description: Docura Health builds purpose-built software for physicians who prepare medical-legal reports — independent medical examinations (IME), qualified medical examiner (QME), agreed medical examiner (AME), permanent-and-stationary, and supplemental evaluations. The platform organizes complete case files (medical records, audio, and video), generates intelligent chronological summaries that link back to source documents, guides AMA Guides-compliant impairment ratings (5th and 6th Edition), and produces structured reports from customizable templates matched to each evaluator's practice style. Docura is HIPAA compliant with enterprise-grade end-to-end encryption and audit trails, and is backed by Y Combinator. This profile was seeded from a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from Docura Health's public website and trust center; no public developer API or documentation was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: EcoMap Technologies
providers.description: EcoMap Technologies is an ecosystem intelligence software company (Baltimore, MD) that helps economic development organizations, chambers of commerce, universities, arts agencies, bioscience associations, and state and local governments map, connect, and measure their entrepreneurial ecosystems. Its platform turns scattered regional resource directories, referrals, and stakeholder relationships into a measurable, reportable network. Products span EcoMap Discover (resource hub and navigation), the Ecosystem Relationship Manager, an AI-powered Ecosystem ChatBot, the Economic Intelligence Monitor for regional benchmarking, and a Nonprofit Intelligence Dashboard. EcoMap reports 250,000+ resources mapped across 100+ ecosystems nationwide.

providers.name: Employee Cycle
providers.description: Employee Cycle is an HR analytics and reporting platform that bills itself as "the first Employee Data Platform." It connects a company's HRIS, ATS, payroll, performance, and engagement systems into one place and turns that data into automated, real-time dashboards and reports covering headcount, turnover, tenure, DEI, and other people metrics. The no-code dashboard and report builder lets non-technical HR teams run multi-dimensional workforce analysis without manual spreadsheets, with a claimed one-day implementation. Employee Cycle integrates with 20+ HR systems (ADP, BambooHR, Greenhouse, Lattice, Rippling, UKG, and more) and is aimed at enterprise HR teams, typically at organizations with 500+ employees. The company is SOC 2 compliant (audited by Sensiba San Filippo, monitored by Drata), GDPR and CCPA aligned, and built on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. It is backed by the Techstars accelerator and venture funding. Employee Cycle offers pre-built data integrations rather than a public developer REST API; this profile tracks the company's identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ensighten
providers.description: Ensighten is an enterprise tag management, data governance, and client-side website security platform. It gives digital, marketing, and privacy teams centralized control over the third-party tags, scripts, and vendor code that run on their web and mobile properties, enforcing consent and privacy rules (GDPR, CCPA) at the point of data collection. The platform combines server- and client-side tag management, malicious-script and data-leakage detection (client-side security), and consent management. Ensighten was acquired by CHEQ (CHEQ AI Technologies Ltd.) and is now delivered as part of CHEQ's Control & Compliance / Go-to-Market Security suite; the ensighten.com domain 301-redirects to cheq.ai. This company profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Ensighten publishes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; it is a hosted SaaS console (manage.ensighten.com) with a Zendesk-based help center, so most spec-derived artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: EvolveApp INC.
providers.description: EvolveApp INC. (Evolve) is an AI-native enablement and performance platform for corporate learning and workforce training. Its product suite spans the Evolve LMS for courses, learning paths and branded academies; Evolve Generate for AI-powered course creation from raw materials; Evolve Studio for advanced authoring; an Assessment Center for skills and behavioral evaluation; an AI Knowledge Base instant-answer engine; and AI-driven Simulations for job-critical practice. Evolve serves 100+ enterprise clients and 2.9M+ learners worldwide, is SOC 2 (Type 1 and 2), ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant, and offers iOS and Android apps. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Fiix Software
providers.description: Fiix (by Rockwell Automation) is a cloud-based CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) platform for maintenance and reliability teams in manufacturing, facilities, and utilities. The Fiix API provides programmatic access to assets, work orders, purchase orders, parts, users, and maintenance data through custom client libraries, with integration support for ERP and industrial automation systems including FactoryTalk Optix.

providers.name: FreeWheel Media
providers.description: FreeWheel, a Comcast company, is an advertising technology platform for the streaming and premium video television marketplace. It gives advertisers, agencies, and media buyers direct connections to premium streaming TV inventory while helping publishers and programmers monetize their video content across linear and digital channels. Its product suites include the Advertiser Suite (media buying, planning, and campaign management via Strata), the Publisher Suite (ad decisioning, forecasting, and yield optimization for sellers), and a Marketplace connecting supply and demand. FreeWheel's platform emphasizes AI-driven optimization, real-time insights, identity, and cross-screen measurement for the converged TV ecosystem. Programmatic and operational access is delivered to partners through gated Publisher (MRM) and Marketer (SFX/Strata) platforms rather than a public self-service developer portal.

providers.name: GreenSky
providers.description: GreenSky is a financial-technology company that powers point-of-sale consumer financing. Through a network of federally insured bank partners and enrolled merchants, GreenSky enables consumers to apply for and use installment loans and revolving credit lines at the point of sale, with programs concentrated in home-improvement and elective-healthcare financing. GreenSky Servicing, LLC (NMLS #1416362) originates and services the loan program on behalf of its lending partners. Merchants enroll to offer financing to their customers and manage applications through the GreenSky merchant portal, while consumers manage accounts and payments through the customer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of ICONIQ Capital and QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network. GreenSky is a consumer/merchant fintech with no public developer API surface; this profile is enriched with identity, link, and security metadata only.

providers.name: Hanover Park
providers.description: Hanover Park is an AI-native ERP and fund administration platform for private market investors, unifying fund accounting, portfolio intelligence, and the LP experience in a single system of record. It pairs a proprietary general ledger, waterfall engine, investor portal, and portfolio management layer with AI agents that read email, propose journal entries, and extract portfolio updates, all reviewed by expert fund accountants. The platform automates capital calls, cash reconciliation, general-ledger posting, KPI collection, and reporting for venture capital, private equity, and other private-market firms. Founded in 2024 and headquartered around a modern back-office thesis, Hanover Park raised a $27M Series A led by Emergence Capital (with Lux Capital and Susa Ventures) and has grown from $1B to $15B in assets under administration. The company is SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II certified with a zero-trust, client-isolated AI architecture. No public API or developer program is published at this time; the product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application.

providers.name: LevelUp
providers.description: LevelUp (SCVNGR, Inc. d/b/a LevelUp) was a Boston-based mobile payments and customer-loyalty platform whose REST API let point-of-sale systems and e-commerce applications accept LevelUp payments, issue QR-code order tokens, manage merchant locations, and run merchant-funded loyalty and credit campaigns. The platform shipped first-party C#, Ruby and Java SDKs plus packaged point-of-sale adapters for Aloha, Micros 3700, Dinerware and Agilysys InfoGenesis. LevelUp was acquired by Grubhub in 2018 and the platform API is now RETIRED: the developer portal, API reference, sandbox and production hosts have all been decommissioned and thelevelup.com redirects to grubhub.com. This profile is a historical record reconstructed from LevelUp's surviving first-party open-source SDKs and package feeds.

providers.name: Monarch Tractor
providers.description: Monarch Tractor is a Livermore, California agricultural-technology company that builds the MK-V, a fully electric, driver-optional smart tractor, together with WingspanAI (Wingspan Ag Intelligence) — an AWS-hosted farm-management and fleet-telemetry platform that collects in-field video, machine telemetry, energy and emissions data from connected tractors and presents it to growers through web and mobile apps. The company markets an "open ecosystem" in which third parties integrate with the MK-V and WingspanAI, and has pivoted toward selling autonomy as software and licensing its autonomy stack to other equipment makers. Monarch publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the WingspanAI platform is reachable only through a customer login.

providers.name: Native Security
providers.description: Native Security is a cloud security control plane that unifies security posture and enforcement across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and OCI. The platform translates security intent expressed in natural language into enforceable architectural controls, shifting teams from reactive detection toward proactive, secure-by-design defense using built-in cloud security primitives. Capabilities include multi-cloud policy enforcement from a single definition, automated organization topology discovery and mapping, architectural segmentation and perimeter enforcement, AI-agent guardrails through architectural boundaries, and compliance automation with audit readiness. Native Security is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; product documentation and the application console sit behind authentication.

providers.name: NATIX
providers.description: NATIX Network is a decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) network building what it calls the world's largest on-street camera network to power Physical AI, autonomous driving, and real-time mapping. Drivers use the Drive& smartphone app and the VX360 plug-and-earn smart camera for Tesla to collect, validate, anonymize, and monetize multi-camera dashcam footage, earning $NATIX token rewards. NATIX packages the resulting data into training datasets, edge cases, and OpenScenario/OpenDrive simulation scenarios for AI and mapping customers, and runs an on-chain token economy with staking, governance, and xNodes. As of 2026 it reports 2.89M+ registered drivers and coverage across 33 countries. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment confirms NATIX publishes no public REST/GraphQL developer API — the surface is consumer apps, an on-chain token, and a proprietary partner Vision SDK.

providers.name: OpenEvidence
providers.description: OpenEvidence is a clinical decision-support search platform that uses generative AI grounded in peer-reviewed medical literature to answer clinical questions for verified clinicians. The product is free for U.S. licensed clinicians and is monetized through pharmaceutical advertising; partnerships include the New England Journal of Medicine, JAMA, NCCN, and the Cochrane Library. As of 2026 it serves more than 860,000 verified clinicians. OpenEvidence does not currently expose a public self-service developer API.

providers.name: Peanut App
providers.description: Peanut is a social networking app connecting women through all stages of womanhood — from fertility and pregnancy to motherhood and menopause. Founded in 2017 by Michelle Kennedy, the platform provides a safe, moderated space where more than five million women find friends, join life-stage communities and groups, ask questions, and access expert content. Peanut is a consumer mobile-first product (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech and enriched with the artifacts the company genuinely publishes (llms.txt and domain-security posture).

providers.name: People Ai
providers.description: People.ai is an AI-powered revenue intelligence platform for sales leaders, RevOps, and CROs, now operating under the Backstory brand (people.ai redirects to backstory.ai). The platform automatically captures customer-facing activity (emails, meetings, calls, chats) from existing tools such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Gmail, Outlook, Zoom, Teams, and Slack, then analyzes that activity against deal history to answer which deals are real, which are at risk, and what to do next. Core capabilities include deal-risk identification, pipeline visibility and touchpoint mapping, revenue forecasting validation, and automated CRM hygiene. People.ai is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface; integrations are delivered as managed native connectors rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Polars
providers.description: Polars is a blazingly fast, open-source DataFrame library and query engine written in Rust, with first-party bindings for Python, Rust, Node.js, and R. It provides lazy and eager execution, streaming for larger-than-memory datasets, automatic query optimization, multi-threading, and the Apache Arrow columnar memory format. Polars Cloud extends the same DataFrame API to managed and on-premise distributed compute with zero code changes. The project is developed by pola-rs and backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: PredictionIO
providers.description: Apache PredictionIO is an open source machine learning server that lets developers and data scientists build, deploy, and serve predictive engines as web services. Originally the commercial product prediction.io from TappingStone, it was acquired by Salesforce in 2016, donated to the Apache Software Foundation, and graduated as a top-level Apache project before being retired to the Apache Attic. It exposes a REST-based Event Server for collecting event data and an Engine Query API for real-time predictions, built on Apache Spark, MLlib, HBase, Elasticsearch, and Akka HTTP, with official SDKs for Python, Ruby, PHP, and Scala/Java. This profile enriches the original portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Real Estate Institute of Australia
providers.description: The Real Estate Institute of Australia (REIA), founded in 1924 and based in Canberra, is the national federation of the eight state and territory Real Estate Institutes (REINSW, REIV, REIQ, REIWA, REISA, REIT, REIACT, REINT), which between them represent roughly 85% of Australian real estate businesses and agents. REIA is a policy, research and accreditation body, not an operator of market infrastructure: it administers the REIA National Principles of Conduct that underpin state institute codes and training, awards Associate (AREI) and Fellow accreditations, runs the Australasian Auctioneering Championships (AUSTROS) jointly with REINZ and the National Awards for Excellence (NAFE), makes submissions to the Commonwealth Government, and publishes the quarterly Housing Affordability Report (HAR) and Real Estate Market Facts (REMF) series that Federal Treasury, the Reserve Bank, state treasuries and investment banks subscribe to. It sits well above the transaction rail in the Australian value chain - listings run through REA Group's realestate.com.au and Domain, settlement through PEXA, valuation through PropTrack and CoreLogic, and title through the state land registries - and REIA touches none of those pipes. Its API posture is therefore an honest absence: no developer portal, no API subdomain, no OpenAPI or OData contract, and no RESO reference anywhere on its estate, because RESO is a NAR-mandated United States construct with no Australian counterpart. What REIA sells is data, not access to it - the HAR and REMF reports are AUD 450 subscriptions and each of the 7 HAR and 15 REMF underlying datasets is a separate AUD 280 subscription, delivered as documents through a platformOS/Insites ecommerce storefront with Stripe checkout behind an email-and-password account. Policy submissions, standalone research reports and the strategic plan are freely downloadable PDFs; the quarterly numbers are not, and there is no open data.

providers.name: Remesh
providers.description: Remesh is an AI-powered market research and audience insights platform that runs live, asynchronous, and video conversations with customers or employees at scale, using machine learning to cluster, rank, and surface representative opinions from large groups in real time. Its products span live AI-moderated focus groups, employee listening, and healthcare research, with an embedded research assistant (Remy). Remesh is delivered as a hosted SaaS workspace at live.remesh.chat; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface as of this profile. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Techstars and enriched with the provider's real published identity, security, and trust artifacts.

providers.name: Rivia
providers.description: Rivia is a clinical trial intelligence platform based in Zurich, Switzerland that unifies fragmented clinical trial data from any vendor into a single, structured foundation for biotech and pharmaceutical companies. Its products include Rivia Core (data harmonization), Rivia Detect (AI agents that continuously identify and resolve data quality issues), and Rivia Spark (visual analytics with a conversational AI assistant for exploring trial data through natural language). The platform supports medical and clinical science, safety monitoring, clinical operations, and executive oversight use cases, promising go-live in under 20 days. Rivia raised a $15M Series A and is backed by investors including Earlybird and Speedinvest. The company is a sales-led enterprise platform with no public developer portal or API surface as of this profile; onboarding is via demo request.

providers.name: Royco
providers.description: Royco is a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol offering transparent, structured yield markets for capital allocators. Through Royco Dawn, users allocate capital into tranched yield markets - senior tranches prioritize base yield with first-loss protection, junior tranches accept first loss for amplified yield - or delegate allocation to independent curators via vaults, with Loop leverage and a coming secondary market and fixed-rate structures. All deposits flow through the RoycoEntryPoint gateway, deployed on Ethereum and Avalanche, with critical upgrades gated by 3-of-5 council approval and timelocks. The protocol has undergone 5 independent audits and formal verifications (Hexens, Cantina, Certora, Nethermind, Immunefi) and ships an official TypeScript SDK plus subgraphs for building frontends on top of it.

providers.name: SAP America
providers.description: SAP America, Inc. is the US subsidiary of SAP SE, headquartered in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, and serving as the Americas headquarters for the parent company's enterprise software portfolio (ERP, SCM, CRM, HCM, analytics, and cloud platform). SAP America itself does not publish a US-specific developer portal or APIs distinct from the parent SAP SE surface — all API documentation, SDKs, and OpenAPI artifacts are catalogued under the sibling `sap` repository (api.sap.com, SAP Business Accelerator Hub, SAP BTP). This repo is a subsidiary placeholder that exists to (1) record SAP America as a distinct US legal entity for partnership, public-sector, procurement, and FedRAMP / GovCloud contexts, and (2) cross-link to related US-only sibling subsidiaries — most importantly SAP NS2 (SAP National Security Services), the independent US subsidiary that operates SAP workloads in the Cloud Intelligence Enterprise (CIE), the DoD cloud environment, and the Commercially Regulated Environment (CRE) for federal, defense, and intelligence community customers. No tier-1 API artifacts (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, capabilities, plans, rate limits, FinOps) are generated in this repo per the api-evangelist no-empty-artifact rule — they are maintained under the parent `sap` repo and the per-product child repos (`sap-business-technology-platform`, `sap-successfactors`, `sap-ariba`, `sap-concur`, `sap-fieldglass`, `sap-api-management`, `sap-integration-suite`).

providers.name: Sarwa
providers.description: Sarwa is a UAE-based fintech platform and mobile app that lets everyday investors trade U.S. stocks and ETFs, invest passively through managed portfolios, and save in high-yield accounts, all in one place. The company is regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) and operates as Sarwa Digital Wealth (Capital) Limited. Sarwa is a portfolio company of 500 Global and offers consumer products (Sarwa Trade, Sarwa Invest, Sarwa Save) through its web and mobile apps; it does not currently publish a public developer API. This profile captures the company's public identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Snapdocs
providers.description: Snapdocs is a digital mortgage closing platform that connects lenders, title and settlement companies, notaries, and signing services on a single system to automate the loan closing process. The platform provides eClosing and hybrid closing workflows, Notary Connect for scheduling and coordinating signing agents, automated document quality control, and an eVault for secure eNote registration and management. Snapdocs is used across roughly one in four U.S. residential mortgage transactions and connects to the major loan origination, point-of-sale, title production, and RON systems through pre-built partner integrations rather than a public self-serve developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SV Angel and Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Swift Medical
providers.description: Swift Medical develops AI-powered wound and skin care management software for healthcare organizations across acute, post-acute, home health, and hospice settings. Its flagship Skin & Wound app captures calibrated wound images on mobile devices, applies computer-vision tissue analytics and auto-tracing to measure and classify wounds, and coordinates care through longitudinal documentation backed by the company's database of more than 32 million wound images.
