The platform emphasizes secure, compliant handling of protected health information (SOC 2 Type 2, encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, MFA) and single sign-on via Okta and Microsoft. Swift Medical does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is handled through direct engagement and enterprise SSO/EHR arrangements. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Sydney Airport
providers.description: Sydney Airport Corporation Limited (ACN 082 578 809) operates Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (IATA SYD, ICAO YSSY), Australia's principal international gateway, under private ownership by the Sydney Aviation Alliance consortium since its 2022 ASX delisting. In the travel distribution chain it is infrastructure rather than an intermediary - it sells no seats, holds no inventory, issues no PNRs, and sits outside the GDS and IATA NDC value chain entirely, monetising aeronautical charges, car parking, retail concessions and property instead. Its API posture is effectively nil - Sydney Airport publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI, and no terms of use for machine access. Its public website is backed by undocumented JSON endpoints under /_a/ that return live flight and security wait-time data with no published contract, while its only credentialed partner surface, InfoSYD, is gated behind a ForgeRock OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider at id.syd.com.au and is restricted to airlines, ground handlers and on-airport tenants. The published terms of use expressly prohibit automated retrieval, scraping and indexing of the site, so there is public data but no public interface - and no documented exit path beyond an Australian Privacy Principle 12 personal-information access request.

providers.name: UBIX Labs
providers.description: UBIX Labs is a no-code, cloud-based AI platform designed to democratize artificial intelligence for business users. The platform provides end-to-end AI capabilities including data integration, model development, deployment, and conversational AI through modular components. UBIX offers over 80 pre-built connectors and an Insights API for seamless integration with existing enterprise systems across 12+ industry verticals.

providers.name: Uno Health

providers.name: Upciti

providers.name: Zone & Company

The products are delivered as native Oracle NetSuite SuiteApps distributed through the SuiteApp Marketplace rather than as a standalone public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: AegisAI
providers.description: AegisAI is an AI-native email security platform that deploys a network of autonomous AI agents to detect and stop advanced inbound email threats — spear phishing, business email compromise (BEC), zero-day phishing, malicious attachments, and QR-code attacks — before they reach the inbox. It integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace via API in about five minutes with no MX record changes, can run in monitoring mode, provides explainable incident response with Indicators of Compromise for CISOs, and reduces false positives by up to 90%. Founded by former Google Safe Browsing, reCAPTCHA, and Web Risk leaders Cy Khormaee (CEO) and Ryan Luo (CTO), AegisAI raised a $13M seed round co-led by Accel and Foundation Capital in 2025 and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

The reference implementation lifecycle, the pack CLI for local builds, the kpack server-side builder, and a registry of distribution buildpacks together form the CNB ecosystem. providers.name: Cofertility
providers.description: Cofertility is a human-centered fertility and family-building platform built around an egg-sharing model. Through its Split program, women can freeze their eggs at no cost when they donate half of the retrieved eggs to another family who cannot otherwise conceive; its Keep program offers self-funded egg freezing at a discount where members retain all of their eggs. On the family-building side, Cofertility matches intended parents (including LGBTQ+ families and single parents) with fresh and frozen egg donors, working with 225+ clinic partners nationwide and a donor community spanning 270+ ethnicities. Founded by Lauren Makler, the company operates a consumer web platform (match.cofertility.com) plus an extensive fertility education library. It is a consumer health company with no public developer API or programmatic surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties and posture.

providers.name: Convex
providers.description: Convex Group Limited is an international specialty insurer and reinsurer founded in 2019 by Stephen Catlin and Paul Brand, headquartered in London with operations in Bermuda, Luxembourg, Guernsey and the United States. Convex writes complex commercial and specialty risk across property, casualty, marine, energy, aviation, cyber, political risk and credit, crisis management, accident and health, and equine/livestock/aquaculture, and writes property, casualty and specialty treaty reinsurance through Convex Re Limited in Bermuda and London. Convex Insurance UK Limited is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the FCA and PRA; it is a London company-market carrier rather than a Lloyd's syndicate, and it reported roughly $5.2bn of gross written premium in 2024. Convex operates a named Digital Underwriting function that publicly describes building "a suite of insurance specific APIs" for automated quote and bind on high-volume, low-complexity specialty books, delivered either through a Convex-hosted broker portal or by connecting Convex products into a broker's or client's existing portal via API. That API programme is real but entirely partner-gated: as of 2026-07-25 Convex publishes no public developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine- readable definition, no sandbox and no self-serve signup. The api.convexin.com host is live but answers every anonymous request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized, the digital.convexin.com broker application is an authenticated Unqork-hosted portal, and the Convex Quick Quote event-insurance surface is behind a broker account registration form. Integration is arranged through the Business Development team, not through documentation. No ACORD, AL3, NGDS or IVANS reference appears anywhere on Convex's public web presence.

providers.description: Dave is a U.S. consumer financial-technology company (Nasdaq: DAVE), founded in 2016 and headquartered in Los Angeles, that operates a mobile banking app serving roughly 14 million members. providers.name: Decorte Future Industries
providers.description: Decorte Future Industries (DFI) is a UK healthtech company building AI that extracts clinical health signals from sound. Its technology turns the microphone in an ordinary smartphone into a screening device, analyzing audio to detect signs of heart, breathing, brain, and gut conditions at a standard targeting in-clinic specialist examinations. DFI's first commercial product, Sonus Health, is a veterinary heart-screening platform: clinics and pet owners record 30 seconds of heart sound from dogs (cats and horses coming soon) with a phone, and AI returns heart rate, heart rate variability, murmur detection, and a composite Heart Health Score in seconds, with a full report reviewed by a board-certified veterinary cardiologist within 48 hours. Sonus Health ships as iOS and Android apps for pet owners and a web dashboard for veterinary clinics.

providers.name: Evvy
providers.description: Evvy is a women's health company offering at-home vaginal microbiome testing and personalized care. Its CLIA-certified metagenomic (mNGS) Vaginal Health Test identifies over 700 bacteria and fungi from a self-collected sample, with results reviewed by licensed clinicians who deliver personalized insights and clinician-designed treatment programs for conditions such as bacterial vaginosis, aerobic vaginitis, yeast infections, recurrent UTIs, and fertility-related concerns. Evvy also sells a line of vaginal health products including probiotics and boric-acid, hyaluronic-acid, and probiotic suppositories, plus a provider program for clinicians and a large library of science-backed educational content. Backed by General Catalyst, Evvy was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. providers.name: Fairplay

Fairplay operates as a Sociedad Financiera de Objeto Multiple, Entidad No Regulada (SOFOM E.N.R.) under Mexican CNBV and CONDUSEF supervision and is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified for information security. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and Speedinvest. Fairplay serves financing and account data to customers through a private insights dashboard; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Figures

Figures connects to 30+ HRIS and performance-review systems to enrich internal pay data, and is used by organizations including KPMG, EY, Qonto, and TotalEnergies. It is backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; Figures does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: FintechOS

It exposes a low-code development environment with Server SDK and Client SDK layers and REST APIs, documented at docs.fintechos.com, with a gated developer community and an academy for onboarding. Founded in Romania with headquarters in the United Kingdom, FintechOS is a portfolio company of Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.description: One of the largest auto insurance providers in the United States offering personal auto, motorcycle, boat, RV, home, renters, and commercial insurance. Progressive is known for its direct-to-consumer model (1-800-PROGRESSIVE and progressive.com), its independent-agent channel, the comparative rate quoting experience, and the Snapshot usage-based insurance program that prices premiums against telematics-captured driving behaviour from a plug-in OBD-II dongle or the Snapshot mobile app. Progressive also runs the ForAgents agent portal and a public Developer Portal at developer.progressive.com that hosts embedded-quoting APIs for partners — including the Embedded Direct auto quoting API, the Commercial Auto Quoting product, and the Certificate of Insurance API — alongside private B2B integrations with comparative-rater carriers, agency-management systems, and telematics providers.

providers.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a leading biotechnology company that invents, develops, and commercializes life-transforming medicines for people with serious diseases in eye disease, cancer, inflammation, infectious disease, and rare diseases. The Regeneron Genetics Center (RGC) is a wholly owned subsidiary that has sequenced over 3 million human exomes and pioneered the use of large-scale genomics to discover and validate drug targets. Regeneron open-sources bioinformatics tools including regenie (whole genome regression), CLAMMS (CNV detection), and TCRAI (T-cell receptor analysis) through its GitHub organizations at github.com/rgcgithub and github.com/regeneron-mpds.

providers.name: Roofr
providers.description: Roofr is an all-in-one roofing software and CRM built for roofing contractors, bundling aerial roof measurement reports, an instant online estimator, digital proposals with e-signature, integrated payments, material ordering, a job calendar, and pipeline/CRM tooling into one platform to help roofers win, run, and close jobs. Roofr does not publish a public developer API or self-serve documentation: the only API key it issues (under Settings and Integrations) exists to connect Roofr to Zapier, and any broader programmatic access is sales-gated behind a demo. Automation for external systems is delivered primarily through Zapier triggers (new Instant Estimator lead, proposal signed, proposal marked lost) rather than a documented REST API. Roofr is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital.

providers.name: Root Insurance
providers.description: Root is a U.S. app-first auto insurer that prices policies primarily on real driving behavior captured by smartphone telematics. The Root mobile app handles enrollment, telematics scoring, policy management, claims, and optional roadside assistance, with renters insurance as an add-on line. Root has reorganized its tech stack around APIs to power embedded auto insurance with partners such as Carvana and Hyundai Capital America; partner APIs are gated and not publicly documented. Note: Root Insurance (joinroot.com) is distinct from the unrelated Root Platform (rootplatform.com) insurtech in South Africa / UK.

providers.name: Salient
providers.description: Salient (Skwid Inc.) is an AI-native loan servicing and collections platform for consumer lenders — banks, credit unions, captive lenders, and specialty finance companies. It builds compliance-first AI voice and chat agents that automate servicing, collections, audit, insurance claims, chargebacks, and chargeoff workflows with native FDCPA, TCPA, and CFPB compliance. Its named agent products include Taylor (omnichannel servicing and collections), Marshall (automated audit), Flyn (total-loss insurance claims), Alex (chargebacks and disputes), and Melanie (chargeoffs). Founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Matrix Partners, and Y Combinator, Salient exposes a partner integration and onboarding API behind an authenticated developer portal. This profile was enriched from public web surfaces; the API reference is gated behind login so no public machine-readable specification was harvested.

providers.name: SiFi
providers.description: SiFi (الحلول المبسطة المالية) is a Saudi Arabian fintech company offering a comprehensive corporate spend-management platform for businesses in the Kingdom. Licensed by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and serving more than 5,000 clients, SiFi provides physical and virtual corporate cards with spending controls, real-time expense tracking, employee reimbursements, accounting automation, local vendor payments and international transfers (coming soon), and a cashback rewards program, delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. SiFi is backed by QED Investors. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Sovrn
providers.description: Sovrn is an advertising technology and content monetization company that helps online publishers, advertisers, and creators earn revenue from their websites and audiences. Its platform spans Ad Exchange (an omnichannel programmatic demand pipeline connecting publisher inventory to buyers and DSPs), Signal (ad-inventory and yield optimization), Commerce (affiliate and commerce-content monetization, formerly VigLink, with access to 50,000+ merchants), and Data solutions for first-party data activation. Sovrn is headquartered in Boulder, Colorado. This API Evangelist profile was created from a venture portfolio lead and enriched from Sovrn's public security, legal, and status surfaces; no public developer portal or OpenAPI was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Step
providers.description: Step is an all-in-one mobile banking platform built for teens, young adults, and families. The Step Visa Card is a secured card that builds credit history reported to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion, and teens can begin building credit before they turn 18 through parent-managed accounts. Step also offers savings rewards, cashback with partner brands, EarlyPay paycheck advances up to $250, commission-free stock investing powered by DriveWealth, early direct deposit, and the Money 101 financial education hub. Banking services are provided by partner Evolve Bank & Trust, Member FDIC. Founded in 2018 in Palo Alto by CJ MacDonald and Alexey Kalinichenko, backed by General Catalyst, and acquired by Beast Industries. Step publishes no public developer API; its programmatic surface is limited to a consumer service status page and a site llms.txt.

providers.name: The Ticket Fairy
providers.description: The Ticket Fairy is an event ticketing and audience-marketing platform for concerts, festivals, conferences, and live experiences, operating across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico, India, and Indonesia. It gives event organizers a ticketing storefront with transparent fees, embeddable widgets, white-label checkout, referral and analytics tooling, and marketed "API access" so organizers can sell tickets from their own sites. The Ticket Fairy is backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator. As of this enrichment pass the company markets API access as a white-label feature but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Tia Health
providers.description: Tia Health is a Canadian telehealth platform that connects patients with licensed Canadian providers - family doctors, nurse practitioners, specialists, and naturopaths - for on-demand virtual care by phone, video, and secure messaging. Its services span virtual walk-in and family-practice appointments, prescription renewals, sick notes, lab requisitions, and mental health therapy (via partner Focus Mental Wellness), with visits covered by provincial health plans in Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP) and paid options elsewhere. Tia Health is part of the WELL Health Technologies Corp. clinic network, one of the largest outpatient networks in Canada. As of this review Tia Health is a consumer-facing virtual-care product with no public developer portal, no documented REST/OpenAPI, and no exposed HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR configuration; interoperability in the Canadian market is stewarded federally through Canada Health Infoway's pan-Canadian FHIR (CA Core / CA Baseline) specifications, which this platform does not publicly surface.

providers.name: TipLink
providers.description: TipLink is a Solana wallet-link platform that lets anyone create a shareable link or QR code holding crypto or an NFT, so a recipient can claim digital assets without first setting up a wallet. It ships as first-party TypeScript/JavaScript SDKs (notably @tiplink/api) and Solana Wallet Adapter UI components rather than a hosted REST API, and is used for airdrops, tipping, payments, and onboarding new users to Solana. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Universe
providers.description: Universe is a no-code website builder that lets anyone design and publish a custom website from a phone, tablet, or computer, using a drag-and-drop GRID block system with built-in commerce, mail tools, analytics, and SEO. A 2023 Apple Design Award winner with more than one million sites built, Universe is a Y Combinator W18 company backed by GV and General Catalyst. Universe is a consumer creation platform and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Upwage
providers.description: Upwage is an AI interview platform that helps employers hire faster and more fairly with lower turnover. Its emotionally intelligent AI interviewer conducts 24/7 multilingual candidate screening, scoring competencies consistently to reduce bias in high-volume hiring across retail, healthcare, logistics, and staffing, with ATS integrations including Ashby, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Lever, SmartRecruiters, and Workday. Founded by Diana Tsai and Greg Call and backed by Bloomberg Beta, Upwage publishes a SOC 2 Type 2 trust center with third-party bias audits, but no public developer API surface yet.

providers.name: Vancity Community Investment Bank
providers.description: Vancity Community Investment Bank (VCIB) is a federally regulated Schedule I chartered bank headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and a wholly owned subsidiary of Vancouver City Savings Credit Union (Vancity), Canada's largest community credit union. Established to carry the cooperative "community-first" finance model into the national banking system, VCIB is a values-driven, Certified B Corporation and CDIC member that provides impact-focused commercial banking - commercial real estate and affordable-housing lending, clean-energy and green-building finance, social-enterprise banking, Impact GICs, high-interest savings, and business Visa products - to organizations driving social, economic, and environmental change. As a small impact/commercial bank rather than one of the Big Six, VCIB operates no public developer portal, exposes no first-party developer API, and publishes no downloadable API specifications. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and the 2024 Fall Economic Statement under the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, is not yet operational, so any third-party access to VCIB customer data today would be voluntary and aggregator-mediated rather than via a documented open API.

providers.name: Vertafore
providers.description: Vertafore is an insurance technology provider whose software runs a large share of the North American property and casualty distribution channel - agency management systems (AMS360 and Sagitta), the ImageRight document and content management platform, and the PL Rating personal-lines comparative rater. Vertafore exposes developer APIs across these products through the Vertafore API Developer Portal (developer.vertafore.com) and the Orange Partner Program. Access is partner-gated - it requires a Vertafore Single Sign-On (VSSO) account, a licensed Vertafore Developer Portal contract, and per-API scopes that the agency has contracted for, with applications promoted from a Sandbox to Live only after Vertafore approval. Because the reference documentation and OpenAPI live behind that login, the endpoints listed here are honestly modeled from public help content and product pages rather than pulled from an open specification.

providers.name: Web Methods
providers.description: Web Methods (webMethods) is an enterprise integration platform pioneer, founded in 1996 by Phillip and Caren Merrick in Fairfax, Virginia to connect software applications in real time using web standards such as HTTP and XML. Its 2000 IPO was one of the largest first-day pops of the dot-com era. webMethods was acquired by Software AG in 2007 for $546 million, and its integration portfolio - now including webMethods.io Integration (iPaaS), API Gateway and API Management, the Developer Portal, B2B/EDI, messaging, managed file transfer, and event-driven integration - was acquired by IBM in July 2024 as IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration. Mayfield was an early venture backer of the company.

providers.name: Wholesail
providers.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wited (Portal Educativo)
providers.description: Wited (formerly Portal Educativo) is a Chilean edtech company backed by 500 Global that delivers online academic support and homeschooling across Latin America. Its two products - Reforzamiento (tutoring, homework help, and exam prep for K-12 students in traditional schools) and Colegio Online (a complete online school for homeschoolers) - combine curriculum-aligned courses, interactive exercises, the Max AI tutoring chatbot, live teacher support (Profes Express), and a parent progress dashboard. Wited operates in Chile, Mexico, Colombia, Panama, Argentina, Brazil, Spain, and the United States. The consumer platform runs at app.wited.com against a private backend (api.wited.com); the company publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Zenline AI
providers.description: Zenline AI (Zenline GmbH / Zenline AG) is a Swiss assortment-intelligence platform for retail category teams. It blends public market data with a retailer's own product data to recommend pricing, product consolidation, and new-product launches, surfacing market white spots, sell-out trends, substitutes and variants so category managers can improve margin and portfolio performance across omni-channel retail. Backed by Seedcamp and used by European retailers including Otto Group, Conrad Electronic, Lapeyre and Fressnapf/Das Futterhaus. ISO 27001 certified. As of this enrichment pass Zenline publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: 7 Chord
providers.description: 7 Chord is a New York-based financial technology company providing AI-driven, real-time pricing and analytics for fixed income (corporate bond) markets. Its flagship engine, BondDroid, ingests 100 million-plus data points per day - firm and indicative quotes, post-trade prints, and macro and country risk factors - and distills them into risk-neutral bid, ask, and mid prices, yields, and option-adjusted spreads, including for thinly traded bonds. Founded in 2017, 7 Chord delivers BondDroid pricing in streaming, delayed, and historical bulk formats, and can run behind a client's firewall so proprietary data never leaves their environment. Its pricing powers platforms including Broadridge's LTX, TS Imagine, and PortfolioBI, and is distributed through partners such as Bonds.com and Dewey Data.

providers.name: 8fit
providers.description: 8fit is a consumer health and fitness application offering personalized home workout programs (HIIT, boxing, Pilates, yoga, and meditation), custom healthy meal and nutrition plans, and holistic wellness guidance built around sustainable habit-building rather than quick fixes. Founded in Berlin and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum, 8fit reached more than 40 million downloads before being acquired by Withings (a Gilde Healthcare portfolio company) in February 2022. Withings announced the discontinuation of the standalone 8fit app effective June 26, 2026, folding its nutrition and activity content into the Withings app and Withings+ service. 8fit is a mobile/web consumer app and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: AdaCore
providers.description: AdaCore is a software company with more than 30 years of experience building compilation, static and dynamic analysis, and formal-verification toolchains for reliable, safe, and secure software in safety- and mission-critical systems. Its product line includes GNAT Pro (Ada, C/C++, and Rust compilation), SPARK Pro (formal proof), GNAT Static Analysis, CodeSonar for C/C++, the GNAT Dynamic Analysis Suite, and the GNAT Studio IDE together with the open-source Ada Language Server and VS Code extension. AdaCore tooling is used across aerospace, defense, rail, automotive, energy, telecommunications, finance, and medical-device industries. AdaCore is a compiler and toolchain vendor and does not publish a hosted REST API or API client SDKs; this API Evangelist profile catalogs its developer tooling, packages, and public developer resources. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Aidence
providers.description: Aidence is a radiology AI company founded in Amsterdam in 2015 that builds clinical AI for the lung cancer pathway. Its flagship product, Veye Lung Nodules (now DeepHealth Lung), is a CE-marked AI solution that detects, classifies, quantifies, and measures growth of pulmonary nodules on chest CT scans, and is the AI of choice in NHS England's Targeted Lung Health Checks screening programme. Aidence was acquired by RadNet in 2022 and now operates under the DeepHealth brand; aidence.com redirects to deephealth.com/aidence. The product integrates with hospital systems over DICOM/PACS via the Veye Engine rather than a public developer REST API — no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published. This profile captures the company's identity plus its probed security and disclosure posture.

providers.name: Ambi Robotics
providers.description: Ambi Robotics is a Berkeley, California AI robotics company building parcel-sortation and induction robots for ecommerce, postal, and logistics workflows. Founded in 2018 as Ambidextrous Laboratories — a spin-out of UC Berkeley's Dex-Net Project led by Ken Goldberg — by Jeff Mahler (CTO), Stephen McKinley, David Gealy, and Matt Matl, with Jim Liefer (ex-Walmart, ex-UPS) as CEO. Its flagship products are AmbiSort A-Series (sort-to-sack small parcel sorting), AmbiSort B-Series (sort-to-gaylord parcel induction for middle-mile and reverse logistics), AmbiStack (mixed-case stacking for inbound and outbound), and AmbiVision (3D dimensioning, OCR, defect detection, and visual quality inspection). All robots run AmbiOS, the company's cloud-native "operating system for physical intelligence," comprising the AI Skill Suite (Sort, Stack, Kit, Pack, Induct apps), the PRIME-1 foundation model trained on millions of real-world operations, AmbiVision perception, AmbiAccess fleet management dashboard with heat maps and remote support, and a Sim2Real training pipeline that compresses model training by up to 10,000x. Ambi Robotics' primary commercial deployment is a $23 million expansion with Pitney Bowes, with AmbiSort A-Series and B-Series systems deployed across Pitney Bowes ecommerce hubs in the US (including the Stockton, CA hub that nearly doubled local-direct-delivery throughput in the 2021 peak holiday season, and middle-mile B-Series systems that sorted more than 3 million parcels within four months of deployment). Ambi Robotics does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for AmbiOS, AmbiSort, AmbiStack, or PRIME-1; integration with customer WMS/WES systems is performed by Ambi's solutions team. The company's public GitHub org primarily contains forks of infrastructure tooling (Ray, trimesh, FCL, EIPScanner, tinygltf, rapier, jszmq, CVXPYgen, mongoose-delete) and internal CI/CD workflow utilities — no published API spec, SDK package, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Anvyl
providers.description: Anvyl is a supply chain and production management platform (a "Production Hub") for consumer-brand and e-commerce companies, connecting brands with their suppliers to manage the purchase-order and manufacturing lifecycle in one place: issuing and tracking purchase orders, coordinating production milestones and tasks, managing suppliers and SKUs/products, and monitoring inbound shipments and logistics. Anvyl was acquired by Sage and now operates under the Sage umbrella. It exposes a token-authenticated REST API (api.anvyl.com/api/v1) documented via Stoplight, with resources such as purchase orders. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Anvyl's live public developer surface.

providers.name: AO Smith
providers.description: A. O. Smith Corporation is a global manufacturer of residential and commercial water heaters, boilers, and water treatment products. AO Smith offers connected water heater products with IoT capabilities through its iCOMM connected technology platform, enabling remote monitoring and control of water heating systems via mobile app and third-party integrations.

providers.name: Apricot
providers.description: Apricot is an AI-native clinical documentation platform for home health and post-acute care agencies, founded by home-health operator Trent Smith and headquartered in Oklahoma. Its software cuts start-of-care (SOC) and OASIS documentation time by up to 85% and QA time by up to 40%, automating medication reconciliation, wound documentation, ICD coding recommendations, and narrative generation while capturing vitals, photos, signatures, and voice notes in the home and syncing to each agency's EMR configuration. Apricot is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant and raised a Series A led by Insight Partners in 2025. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence; Apricot currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Azura
providers.description: Azura is an onchain trading platform that lets users trade any onchain asset priced in USD without managing wallets, bridging assets, or paying gas fees. Under the tagline "If it's onchain, it's on Azura," the app offers cross-chain token swaps across multiple blockchains in a single transaction, spot trading with multiple order types, token discovery and analysis, portfolio and PnL tracking, a referral system, and an Azurite rewards program, all with zero platform trading fees. Smart-contract interactions are algorithmically security-audited. Azura is a consumer-facing DeFi product (web app at app.azura.xyz) backed by Initialized Capital; it publishes user documentation and a blog but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or specification surface.

providers.name: Banking Regulation
providers.description: Banking regulation encompasses the rules, standards, and frameworks governing banks and financial institutions. Key frameworks include the Basel Accords (Basel I, II, III, IV) for capital adequacy, the Dodd-Frank Act in the US, PSD2 and CRD IV/V in Europe, and anti-money laundering (AML) / know-your-customer (KYC) requirements. Regulatory technology (RegTech) APIs and data services help financial institutions automate compliance reporting, risk management, and supervisory data submissions.

providers.name: Betr
providers.description: Betr (Betr Holdings, Inc.) is a Miami-based real-money gaming and sports media company founded in 2022 by Joey Levy and Jake Paul on a $50M Series A. Betr operates a consumer "real money gaming super app" spanning Betr Picks (real-money pick'em daily fantasy sports across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UFC and golf), a micro-betting sportsbook launched in Ohio in January 2023, a social sportsbook and social casino, Betr Arcade, and Betr Media (podcasts, creator content and digital sports programming). Betr is a business-to-consumer operator: it publishes mobile apps, a Webflow marketing site, an Intercom-hosted help center and an llms.txt discovery file, but as of this profiling round it publishes no public developer API program, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, and no SDKs. Its API hosts (api.betr.app, and a staging back-office API documentation host) are private and return 500/403 to anonymous callers.

providers.name: Better Mortgage
providers.description: Better (Better Home & Finance Company, operating as Better Mortgage) is a New York-based fintech founded in 2014 by Vishal Garg that digitizes home finance end to end. Its online platform originates purchase mortgages, refinances, home equity lines of credit (HELOC), and VA loans, and connects borrowers with title, closing, homeowners insurance (via Better Cover), and real-estate agent matching. Better was the first fintech to fund over $100 billion in home loans entirely online and markets an "AI-powered" One Day Mortgage experience. Better does not publish a general-purpose public developer API, but it operates a live OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 identity provider (backed by AWS Cognito) for partner single sign-on, discoverable at its /.well-known endpoints.

providers.name: Bilt Rewards
providers.description: Bilt Rewards (Bilt Technologies) is a fintech membership and loyalty program that lets renters and homeowners earn transferable points on rent and mortgage payments, with no fees, and redeem them for travel, everyday purchases, fitness, dining, or credit toward a future home down payment. Members also unlock benefits across 50,000+ neighborhood merchants and can use the co-branded Bilt Mastercard. Bilt operates regulated entities Bilt Payments LLC (money transmission) and Bilt Mortgages LLC (mortgage brokerage). The company is a consumer-facing app and card program; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: BioCatch
providers.description: BioCatch is a financial-fraud and financial-crime prevention platform that uses behavioral intelligence — analyzing how people physically interact with their devices — to detect threats that static rules and device recognition miss. The platform monitors account-opening fraud, account takeover, social-engineering scams, mule accounts, and money-laundering networks across the digital banking session. Marquee products include BioCatch Connect (the core telemetry and behavioral-analysis platform), Scams360, BioCatch Trust (an inter-bank fraud intelligence network), DeviceIQ / DeviceIQai device-trust assessment, mule and account-takeover protection, and Strong Customer Authentication. Integration is delivered under contract through platform components such as the Push API, Align SDK, Link, Fuse, the Insights Query Engine, and Rule Manager; developer documentation lives behind a login at docs.biocatch.com rather than a public developer portal. BioCatch serves 350+ global retail banks, protects over 680 million accounts, and analyzes roughly 18 billion sessions monthly.

providers.name: Cabinet
providers.description: Cabinet is a calendar management and scheduling automation platform built for executive assistants and the leaders they support. It brings group scheduling polls, copy-and-paste availability, unique booking links, shadow holds, and a shared meeting log into one all-in-one workspace, and integrates with Outlook and Google Calendar plus Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Trusted by over 2,000 companies, Cabinet is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and continuously monitored by Secureframe. It was founded by former executive assistant Julia Leibowitz and is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Cala Health
providers.description: Cala Health is a bioelectronic medicine company that develops wearable neuromodulation therapies for chronic disease. Its FDA-cleared Cala kIQ and Cala TRIO systems deliver TAPS (Transcutaneous Afferent Patterned Stimulation) therapy through a wrist-worn device that is physician-prescribed and clinically proven to reduce action hand tremors associated with essential tremor and Parkinson's disease. Patients manage therapy and view results through the MyCala portal, and clinicians access data through the Cala 360 provider portal. Cala Health is a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company operating in the life-sciences / medical-device sector. This profile currently exposes no public developer API; enrichment has captured the company's public security, privacy, and support surface.

providers.name: Cherry
providers.description: Cherry is a fintech platform providing point-of-sale patient financing for healthcare and elective-services providers across dental, medical aesthetics, plastic surgery, dermatology, veterinary, and other verticals. Rather than lending directly, Cherry facilitates consumer payment plans through partner lenders, offering Pay-in-4 and longer-term monthly plans (0-35.99% APR), a 60-second application with no hard credit check, upfront provider payout within 2-3 business days, and card-processing services. Cherry states it serves over 60,000 healthcare providers with an approximately 90% approval rate. Cherry is a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Cherry does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: claimsforce
providers.description: claimsforce GmbH is a Hamburg-based insurtech building AI-powered software for property and casualty claims management and underwriting. Its platform helps insurers, loss-adjusting and expert organizations, and independent adjusters digitize the end-to-end claims process - automating report and calculation generation, enabling video-based remote case assessment, optimizing adjuster disposition and route planning to cut travel time, and surfacing real-time analytics for claims handling and risk management. Named customers include Zurich Gruppe Deutschland, HanseMerkur, Concordia, Crawford, Sedgwick and Die Regulierer. The product is a private, login-only SaaS with no public API or developer portal as of July 2026. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified (TUV Rheinland) and backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Cloover
providers.description: Cloover is a climate-fintech company building an all-in-one, "Shopify of energy" platform for the residential renewable-energy transition. It connects the stakeholders of home energy - installers, homeowners (prosumers), manufacturers, energy providers and investors - so small and mid-sized installation firms can sell, quote, finance and manage solar panels, home batteries, heat pumps and EV charging in a single package. The platform pairs installer sales and operations software with embedded financing and energy management, and offers homeowners flexible subscription and financing options. Founded in 2023 and operating primarily in Germany, Austria and wider Europe, Cloover has raised sizeable seed and Series A equity plus a large debt facility and is backed by QED Investors, MMC Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital and others.

providers.name: Cookunity
providers.description: CookUnity is the first chef-to-consumer meal marketplace, connecting award-winning chefs with food lovers nationwide. Chefs craft restaurant-quality meals in local kitchens and deliver them fresh, ready to heat in two minutes, with more than 300 rotating dishes spanning a wide range of cuisines and dietary options (keto, vegan, paleo, high-protein, gluten-free and more). Subscribers choose four to sixteen meals per week on a flexible weekly plan. The company also runs a chef marketplace onboarding culinary entrepreneurs, a CookUnity for Business program for corporate, healthcare and education clients, and gift cards. CookUnity is a consumer brand and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, identity, and domain-security surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Insight Partners.

providers.name: Corgi
providers.description: Corgi is an AI-native, full-stack business insurance platform for startups, offering modular coverage (Commercial General Liability, Directors & Officers, Tech Errors & Omissions, Cyber, EPLI, and fiduciary) quoted in minutes. Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, Corgi is a licensed insurance carrier rather than a broker, underwriting and issuing policies directly with pricing tailored to a startup's stage (pre-seed, Series A, growth). Backed by Kindred Ventures and TCV, the company was reported as an AI insurance unicorn in 2026. This API Evangelist profile was seeded from Kindred Ventures' portfolio; Corgi does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Cron
providers.description: Cron was a next-generation calendar application for professionals and teams, backed by Initialized Capital and later acquired by Notion, where it was rebranded and relaunched as Notion Calendar. The product offered a fast, keyboard-driven desktop and mobile calendar with multi-account scheduling, time-zone handling, team availability, and deep Notion workspace integration (calendar events linked to Notion pages and databases). Cron is an end-user consumer product and does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, a dated changelog (retired January 2024 at the Notion Calendar rebrand), a blog, and help documentation now hosted within Notion. This profile captures Cron's public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Customs and Border Protection
providers.description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is the federal law enforcement agency within the Department of Homeland Security responsible for apprehending individuals attempting to enter the United States illegally, stemming the flow of illegal drugs and contraband, protecting agricultural and economic interests from harmful pests and diseases, protecting intellectual property, and regulating and facilitating international trade, collecting import duties, and enforcing U.S. trade laws. CBP's primary trade automation systems are the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE), the Automated Export System (AES), AESDirect, the Advance Passenger Information System (APIS / eAPIS), and the Air Cargo Advance Screening (ACAS) program. Trade integrations are predominantly delivered through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messaging via ACE, with a small set of CBP web services (e.g., the AESDirect WebLink Inquiry API) exposed for programmatic use.

providers.name: DeepIP
providers.description: DeepIP is an AI-powered patent intelligence platform that streamlines the full patent lifecycle for intellectual-property professionals, automating repetitive work while keeping a human in the loop. It supports invention capture, patentability assessment, patent drafting and drawings generation, AI review, prosecution support, freedom-to-operate (FTO) and invalidity searches, portfolio and landscape intelligence, and agentic prior-art search. DeepIP embeds directly into Microsoft Word, IP management systems, and the web browser, and works across chemistry, biology, software, mechanical, and electronic domains and multiple patent jurisdictions (USPTO, EPO, PCT, UKIPO, CNIPA, KIPO, and others). The company operates a zero-data-retention policy on U.S.-based Microsoft Azure and holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and GDPR compliance. DeepIP is backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: Descartes Labs
providers.description: Descartes Labs was a Santa Fe, New Mexico geospatial intelligence company founded in 2014 as a spin-out from Los Alamos National Laboratory. The company built the Descartes Labs Platform, a cloud-native geospatial data refinery and analytics environment combining a petabyte-scale satellite imagery archive (Landsat, Sentinel-1/2, MODIS, NAIP, PlanetScope, SkySat, commercial radar, NEXRAD weather radar, plus client-uploaded data) with a Python client library, JupyterHub-based workbench, and distributed compute for training and running deep learning and remote-sensing models at scale. Customers in agriculture, mining, energy, defense, insurance, and the U.S. government used the platform to build production geospatial machine learning pipelines covering crop forecasting, mineral exploration, infrastructure monitoring, methane detection, wildfire response, and ESG reporting. The Platform exposed a Catalog (imagery, bands, products, blobs, events), a Compute service (containerised functions, jobs, schedules), a Vector service (tabular and geospatial features), Dynamic Compute (lazy raster algebra and tiling), Auth, and a `descarteslabs` CLI. In October 2024, EarthDaily Analytics — backed by Antarctica Capital — acquired Descartes Labs and the Descartes Labs Government, Inc. subsidiary, folding the team, customers, and platform into the EarthDaily Constellation programme. The product was rebranded EarthOne in 2025; the `descarteslabs` Python package has been formally discontinued in favour of `earthdaily-earthone` (v5.x), the github.com/descarteslabs organisation has been renamed to `dlarchives`, www.descarteslabs.com is now a parked domain, and the docs.descarteslabs.com developer portal has been retired in favour of EarthDaily-hosted EarthOne documentation. This catalog entry preserves the historical Descartes Labs Platform surface as an archive — see the EarthDaily / EarthOne profile for the active product.

providers.name: Dework
providers.description: Dework is a Web3-native task-management and bounty platform for DAOs and decentralized teams. Organizations create bounties, projects, and task boards; contributors build an on-chain reputation profile, claim or apply to tasks, and get paid in the DAO's own token or stablecoins from supported wallets (Gnosis/Safe, MetaMask, Phantom, WalletConnect). Dework offers token- and Discord-role gating, two-way Discord and GitHub sync, Notion and Coordinape integrations, batch payments, reputation staking, roadmaps, and leaderboards. It aggregates bounties and grants from hundreds of DAOs. The app is backed by an Apollo GraphQL API at api.dework.xyz; product documentation lives on GitBook. Backed by Paradigm.

providers.name: EMC
providers.description: EMC Corporation (now Dell EMC, a division of Dell Technologies) provides enterprise storage, data management, and cloud infrastructure solutions. EMC products include VMAX, VNX, Isilon, and ECS storage platforms, as well as data protection and information management solutions. EMC was acquired by Dell Technologies in 2016.

providers.name: Exotec
providers.description: Exotec is a French warehouse automation manufacturer and integrator, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Croix, France, that builds the Skypod robotic automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) and the Deepsky warehouse execution system (WES) that orchestrates it. Skypod combines autonomous three-dimensional mobile robots, modular racking, picking workstations and inbound exchangers into an all-in-one goods-to-person system; Deepsky is the software layer that coordinates the robots, stations and third-party equipment and connects the installation to a customer's WMS or WCS over a RESTful web-services interface. Exotec reports more than 10,000 robots deployed across over 200 customer sites for more than 50 brands including Decathlon, Renault Group, DSV, Carrefour, Gap and Uniqlo, serving apparel, general merchandise, aftermarket parts, grocery, third-party logistics and healthcare fulfillment. The Deepsky WMS integration interface is delivered as customer-specific documentation under a commercial deployment rather than a public developer program, so Exotec publishes no open developer portal, API reference or SDK. It does publish an llms.txt at its web root and holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.

providers.name: Faks
providers.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

providers.name: Framer
providers.description: Framer is a design tool and CMS for shipping production websites without code. The Framer developer surface is centred on in-editor extensibility: the Plugin API for building tools that interact with the Framer Editor and CMS, Code Components for custom React components, Code Overrides for HOC-style mutations, and Fetch for letting designers wire site content to external APIs without code. Framer does not publish a general-purpose REST API for site management at the time of reconciliation.

providers.name: Gaia
providers.description: Gaia (Gaia Family) is a value-based family-building company that makes fertility treatment financially accessible. Founded by Nader AlSalim after his own multi-year IVF journey, Gaia replaces unpredictable cycle-by-cycle IVF billing with fixed-price, all-inclusive plans and monthly payments, backed by a protection model that offers more tries — or money back — if treatment does not succeed. It partners with 180+ fertility clinics across the US and UK, covering IVF, egg freezing, embryo transfer, hormone and lab testing, and fertility navigation, and also offers fertility benefits to employers. This profile is a company lead (no public API surface) maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Genome Medical
providers.description: Genome Medical is a telehealth-enabled genetic services provider offering expert genetic counseling, test selection and ordering support, results interpretation, and clinical trial matching for individuals with rare and hereditary conditions. It partners with health systems, life sciences organizations, and genetic testing labs to scale genetic care, reduce diagnostic backlogs, and accelerate diagnoses through a proprietary clinical platform and patient portal. Genome Medical does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Harmonic Lightwaves
providers.description: Harmonic Lightwaves (now Harmonic Inc, NASDAQ: HLIT) is a pure-play broadband and video-delivery technology company headquartered in San Jose, California, founded in 1988 as Harmonic Lightwaves. It builds virtualized broadband access (the cOS platform, Distributed Access Architecture nodes, and fiber-to-the-x solutions) and cloud-native video streaming and processing (the VOS platform and VOS360 SaaS). Harmonic exposes a VOS REST API for media management, packaging, DRM, live event and linear-TV workflows, publishes first-party client-side ad-tracking SDKs for iOS, Android and Roku on GitHub, and maintains a technical documentation library. Its developer surface is largely operator- and customer-facing rather than a self-service public developer program.

providers.name: Honeywell
providers.description: Honeywell is a Fortune 100 technology company that delivers industry-specific solutions including aerospace products and services, control technologies, performance materials, and safety and productivity solutions. Honeywell Forge is the company's connected platform for building automation, industrial IoT, and aerospace data integration.

providers.name: Insify
providers.description: Insify is a Dutch insurtech offering fully digital business insurance for freelancers, self-employed professionals (ZZP'ers) and small-to-medium enterprises in the Netherlands. Its online-first product line covers disability/income protection (arbeidsongeschiktheid, AOV), professional liability (beroepsaansprakelijkheid, BAV), business liability (bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, AVB), business inventory and goods, electronics, in-vehicle equipment and auto cover, sold and managed entirely online with no setup, advisory or cancellation fees and daily cancellation. Serving more than 40,000 entrepreneurs across professions from IT and photography to care and construction, Insify pairs instant quoting and fast claims with AI-assisted guidance (SmartGuide). Backed by Accel, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an insurance-tech provider profile; it is a consumer-facing insurer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Intermedia
providers.description: Intermedia is a cloud communications company serving over 145,000 businesses with an AI-powered platform spanning voice, video conferencing, chat, SMS, contact center, business email, productivity, file sharing, security, and archiving. The Intermedia Extend API platform exposes Voice, Meeting, Analytics, Address Book, and Contact Center APIs for embedding communications into CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, and custom business applications.

providers.name: INZMO
providers.description: INZMO is a European insurtech, founded in 2017, delivering 100% digital, embedded insurance for consumer goods and rental deposits. Its products cover mobile phones, laptops and tablets, bicycles, e-scooters, and rental deposit warranties, sold direct-to-consumer and embedded into partner checkout flows. INZMO offers partners an embedded-insurance API that adds insurance to the customer journey with real-time policy issuance, payment, and delivery of policy documents, and applies AI and large language models to streamline fraud prevention and claims handling. INZMO is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: iQIYI
providers.description: iQIYI is one of China's largest online video streaming and entertainment platforms, delivering movies, TV dramas, variety shows, animation, documentaries, and original content across web, mobile (Android/iOS), and OTT/smart-TV devices. Beyond its consumer service, iQIYI runs a SaaS / OTT developer platform that lets partners launch their own branded streaming service with a RESTful API covering Video, Channel, Album, Search, and Player resources, plus AVOD/SVOD/TVOD monetization, analytics, audience management, and DRM. iQIYI also operates the QIYU XR developer platform for VR/AR device applications and maintains an active open-source GitHub organization. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Hongshan and has been enriched from iQIYI's public developer surface.

providers.name: Kabal
providers.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

providers.name: Kamal
providers.description: Kamal is an open-source deployment tool from 37signals (DHH / Basecamp) for deploying containerized web applications to any infrastructure — bare metal, cloud VMs, or a mix — with zero-downtime rolling restarts. Originally built for Rails apps, Kamal works with any web application that can be packaged as a Docker container. It uses SSHKit to drive remote commands over SSH and pairs with kamal-proxy, a lightweight HTTP proxy written in Go that seamlessly switches request traffic between old and new containers during a deploy. Kamal is imperative and Capistrano-like in feel, with a single `config/deploy.yml` describing servers, image, registry, accessories, env, secrets, and proxy/SSL settings. Capabilities include auto-provisioning Docker on new servers, remote builds, asset bridging, accessory services (databases, Redis, cron sidecars), automatic TLS via Let's Encrypt, host- and path-based routing, and hooks for custom pre/post-deploy logic. Kamal is the operational backbone of 37signals' on-premises exit from major cloud providers and powers their ONCE product line. Kamal itself is a CLI tool, not a hosted service — there is no public REST API, no SDK, and no paid tier. The project is released under the MIT License and developed openly on GitHub under the `basecamp` organization.

providers.name: Kimpton AI
providers.description: Kimpton AI is an AI-native investment research platform for institutional portfolio managers at hedge funds, mutual funds, and sustainable equity funds. It ingests market data, SEC filings, 13F holdings, earnings, and a fund's own investment mandates and research documents, then generates daily trade proposals with citations grounded in the fund's actual holdings — keeping human managers in control of every final decision. The platform connects to custodians and OMS/portfolio systems (or accepts direct uploads) to sync positions and P&L, aggregates mandates and research in a document vault, and integrates market-data partners FactSet, Tiingo, Massive, and Plaid. It is a managed service for professional investors and does not currently expose a public developer API. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: KreditBee
providers.description: KreditBee is a Bengaluru, India digital lending platform founded in 2017 by Madhusudan Ekambaram, Vivek Veda and Karthikeyan Krishnaswamy, operated by Finnovation Tech Solutions Private Limited (CIN U74900KA2016PTC086953) and lending through its in-house RBI-registered NBFC KrazyBee Services Limited alongside partner banks and NBFCs. Its consumer products are instant personal loans from Rs 6,000 to Rs 10 lakh, business loans up to Rs 1 crore, two-wheeler loans up to Rs 5 lakh, loan against property, a flexi personal loan line, 24K digital gold, and free credit score reports, delivered through an Android and iOS app and a single-page web application that the company says serves over 7 crore registered Indian users. KreditBee publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable API description of any kind. Its only API host, api.kreditbee.in, is an AWS API Gateway behind Cloudflare that answers HTTP 403 ForbiddenException to every anonymous request and exists to serve the company's own mobile and web clients. Partner and lending-partner integrations are transacted through the /partner-with-us and /digital-lending-partners business pages rather than through any self-serve technical surface.

providers.name: LiveAuctioneers
providers.description: LiveAuctioneers is the world's largest online marketplace for fine art, antiques, jewelry, collectibles, and luxury goods, connecting bidders with thousands of vetted auction houses worldwide. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in New York, it is part of Auction Technology Group (ATG). The platform offers live and timed online bidding, absentee and proxy bids, an auction-results and price-research database, seller consignment services, and an auctioneer partner portal. It is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-marketplace company profile surfaced from the Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Llama
providers.description: Llama is Meta's family of open-weight large language models, available for download, self-hosting, and via Meta's hosted Llama API for chat completions, text generation, and embeddings. The ecosystem also includes the open-source llama-models, llama-stack, and PurpleLlama safety projects on GitHub.

providers.name: Lucis
providers.description: Lucis is a Paris-based, AI-powered preventative health platform (Y Combinator P25; backed by General Catalyst) that helps members understand their biology through comprehensive lab testing and personalised coaching. Members receive two annual lab assessments (blood, urine, and saliva) at 450+ partner labs across Europe, producing 110+ data points across 11 body systems — metabolic, cardiovascular, hormonal, nervous, and more — which an AI engine turns into personalised action plans spanning nutrition, supplementation, sleep, activity, and mental health. The platform ingests wearable data (Garmin, Withings, Oura, Strava; Apple Watch and Whoop coming soon) for ongoing monitoring. Lucis is a consumer health product; as of this profile it exposes a member web/mobile application and a compliance portal but publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Metropolis Technologies
providers.description: Metropolis Technologies is an AI-powered recognition platform that uses computer vision to make real-world physical spaces responsive, best known as the largest U.S. parking operator with checkout-free parking across 4,200+ North American locations. Founded in 2017, the company powers what it calls the "Recognition Economy" — vehicles are recognized on entry and exit so members pay automatically without tickets, gates, or lines. Metropolis scaled through the acquisitions of Premier Parking (2022) and SP Plus Corporation (2024), raised $1.6 billion in financing in 2025, and was named a TIME100 Most Influential Company of 2026. It is backed by Dragoneer. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface has been identified; this profile captures the company's public identity and security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Nirvana Tech
providers.description: Nirvana Insurance (Nirvana Tech, Inc.) is a technology-driven commercial trucking insurance provider that pairs A-rated fleet insurance coverage with an AI-powered active safety platform. Nirvana ingests telematics and connected-vehicle data from motor carriers to price risk more accurately, help fleets save up to 20% on premiums, and reduce accidents through real-time safety alerts, driver coaching, and predictive risk scoring. The company serves fleets and independent insurance agents through a digital quoting and policy-management agent portal, and is backed by General Catalyst. Nirvana raised a Series D round to expand its data-driven insurance and safety products across the trucking industry. As of this profile Nirvana operates a marketing site plus an agent sign-in portal and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Nobl9
providers.description: Nobl9 is a service-level objective (SLO) management platform that helps engineering and SRE teams define, measure, and act on reliability targets across cloud and observability tools. The platform aggregates data from Datadog, Prometheus, New Relic, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, and other sources to compute error budgets and surface reliability insights. Nobl9 exposes a suite of REST APIs for managing SLOs, annotations, budget adjustments, audit logs, and reports using access token authentication.

providers.name: Opalite Health
providers.description: Opalite Health is building the language layer for healthcare. Its platform delivers real-time, AI-powered medical interpretation across 150+ languages, validated against certified human interpreters and engineered for HIPAA-aligned, clinical-grade use. Opalite connects providers and patients with limited English proficiency in seconds — through EHR workflows and rapid healthcare deployment — to close language gaps that drive health inequities and poor outcomes. The company publishes a marketing and validation-study presence but does not operate a public developer API program; api.opalitehealth.com is a private application backend. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched with the company's real identity, compliance posture (HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, AES-256 encryption), and domain-security probes.

providers.name: OpenGamma
providers.description: OpenGamma is a derivatives and margin analytics company whose technology helps trading, risk, treasury and operations teams forecast, stress test, simulate and reduce the collateral and margin costs of trading cleared and bilateral derivatives. Its capabilities span Forecast, Stress Test, Simulate, Reduce, Allocate, Process, Explain, Validate and Comply. OpenGamma's public developer surface is Strata, its award-winning open-source (Apache 2.0) analytics and market-risk library for pricing and risk of OTC and exchange-traded derivatives, which also powers OpenGamma's commercial SaaS Analytics platform. Strata is a Java library published to Maven Central under com.opengamma.strata, with a bundled command-line tool, Javadoc reference and community forum; OpenGamma does not expose a public REST API. OpenGamma is backed by Accel and was acquired by Trading Technologies.

providers.name: OpenVPN
providers.description: OpenVPN is a secure networking company providing VPN and Zero Trust network access solutions for over 20,000 organizations worldwide, offering both the self-hosted Access Server and the cloud-delivered CloudConnexa managed service. The platform supports encrypted tunnels, identity-based access policies, content filtering, IDS/IPS, and domain-based traffic rules across major cloud providers. OpenVPN exposes an XML-RPC management API for Access Server and an OAuth 2.0 protected REST API for CloudConnexa.

providers.name: Oradian
providers.description: Oradian is an AI-native, cloud-based core banking platform that helps banks, lenders, microfinance institutions, and fintechs in Asia, Africa, and Europe replace legacy core systems and launch, operate, and scale modern banking services from the cloud. Its product, Instafin, is built API-first around an open data model, an extensible architecture, and a native Model Context Protocol surface, exposing capabilities such as ledgers, transactions, deposits, cards, loans, and applications through stable, versioned APIs, webhooks, and event streams. Oradian is independently audited to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 and aligns to CBN, BSP, and OJK regulatory requirements.

providers.name: PathAI
providers.description: PathAI is a Boston-based digital pathology company that builds AI-powered technology to improve the accuracy and efficiency of cancer and disease diagnosis. Its flagship AISight Image Management System is a cloud-native, open enterprise platform that laboratories and research centers use to power digital pathology workflows and run AI applications against whole-slide images. PathAI also develops proprietary machine-learning algorithms for biomarker analysis and biopharma research, backed by a network of 450+ pathologists who have contributed tens of millions of image annotations. For developers, PathAI publishes AISight Link, an open API framework that lets third-party algorithm developers integrate their solutions into the AISight workflow (AI Impressions, Fields of Interest, quantitative result reporting, and case-level tools). AISight Link is a partner-integration API without a public self-serve developer portal; access is arranged through PathAI (digitaldx@pathai.com).

providers.name: Pindrop Security
providers.description: Pindrop is an Atlanta-based voice security and identity company founded in 2011 by Georgia Tech researchers. Its "Real Human + Right Human" platform detects deepfakes, prevents fraud, and authenticates callers across voice, video, and digital channels for contact centers and virtual meetings. Core products are Pindrop Pulse (deepfake and synthetic-voice detection), Pindrop Protect (near real-time fraud risk assessment), and Pindrop Passport (multifactor voice, device, and behavioral authentication, including VeriCall technology). Pindrop holds 300+ patents and integrates with contact-center and meeting platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Cisco Webex, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. The company is an enterprise, sales-led vendor and does not publish a self-serve public developer portal or open API.

providers.name: Pluton Biosciences
providers.description: Pluton Biosciences is a microbial discovery company that uses a proprietary Discovery Platform - high-throughput soil microbiome screening combined with computational analysis - to find naturally occurring microbial consortia for agriculture and carbon sequestration. Its lead product is a Biological Nitrogen System: photosynthetic microbial consortia that operate at the soil surface to fix atmospheric nitrogen and mobilize phosphorus. Pluton is a research-and-product company, not an API company; it has no public developer portal. Partnership and licensing inquiries are handled directly.

providers.name: Precium
providers.description: Precium is a South African fintech that provides local payment infrastructure for global merchants expanding into Africa. Its enterprise-grade platform handles payment processing across cards, instant EFT, mobile wallets and debit orders, plus intelligent smart routing, network tokenization, automated reconciliation, cross-border settlement, and payment recovery through retries and mandates. Precium exposes a public API and a mandates API (per its status dashboard) and integrates via server-to-server, redirect, and orchestrator paths with webhook status updates, though it does not publish a public API reference or OpenAPI. Backed by Partech, QED Investors, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: ProfitWell
providers.description: ProfitWell (now ProfitWell Metrics by Paddle, following Paddle's 2022 acquisition of ProfitWell) is a free subscription analytics product that delivers accurate, real-time SaaS metrics such as MRR, churn, ARPU, LTV, retention, and cohort analysis by connecting directly to billing systems like Stripe, Braintree, Chargebee, Recurly, and Paddle. The ProfitWell API at https://api.profitwell.com/v2 provides programmatic access to subscription lifecycle events, customer data, financial metrics, and engagement data, authenticated via a bare API key passed in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

providers.name: Robust Intelligence
providers.description: Robust Intelligence is an AI security company founded in 2019 to defend ML and GenAI systems against adversarial attacks, data poisoning, prompt injection, and unsafe outputs. Its platform combined automated red teaming (Algorithmic AI Red Teaming) with runtime protection (AI Firewall) for LLM and traditional ML applications. Cisco announced the acquisition of Robust Intelligence in August 2024 and the technology now powers the Cisco AI Defense product line, with Robust Intelligence's capabilities integrated into Cisco's broader security portfolio.

providers.name: Sails Co
providers.description: Sails Co. is a full-service web, mobile, and cloud development studio (Y Combinator W15, Austin, Texas) founded by the creators of Sails.js. Sails.js is an open-source, API-driven MVC framework for Node.js — built on top of Express and Socket.io — for building production-ready, realtime web applications and data-driven REST APIs. It ships the Waterline ORM for datastore-agnostic data access, auto-generated "blueprint" REST APIs, first-class WebSocket support, and a `sails` command-line tool for scaffolding, running, and debugging apps. Sails is MIT-licensed and maintained by the Sails Co. team, which also offers professional and enterprise support for the framework.

providers.name: Sidecar Health
providers.description: Sidecar Health is a health insurance company founded in 2018 by Patrick Quigley and Veronica Osetinsky and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. It was built to bring transparency to healthcare pricing, letting members see upfront cash prices for care and share in the savings. After launching with supplemental coverage for individuals, Sidecar established its own insurance carrier in 2021 and today serves large employers with ACA-compliant major medical plans, offered both fully insured and as administrative-services-only (ASO) for self-funded employers. It covers members in 46 states across partners in 50 industries. Sidecar Health operates member, provider, broker, and employer web portals plus a mobile app, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or partner-integration documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Silicon Labs
providers.description: Silicon Labs (Silabs) is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Austin, Texas that designs silicon, software, and solutions for a more connected, IoT world. Its portfolio includes wireless connectivity SoCs and modules for Bluetooth, Bluetooth Mesh, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, and proprietary sub-GHz protocols, along with 32-bit microcontrollers, sensors, and timing devices. Developers build on Silicon Labs hardware using the Simplicity Studio IDE, the Simplicity SDK (formerly Gecko SDK), the docs.silabs.com developer documentation, and the Silicon Labs Community. Silicon Labs is a hardware and embedded-software provider rather than a web-API vendor: its public developer surface is embedded C/C++ SDKs, tools, and reference examples on GitHub (github.com/SiliconLabs), not a hosted REST API — so this profile carries identity, developer-portal, and security signals rather than API specifications.

providers.name: SimplePractice
providers.description: SimplePractice is a cloud-based practice management platform and EHR for behavioral and mental health, therapy, and wellness practices, covering scheduling, client management, telehealth, intake and clinical documentation, insurance and superbill billing, and a secure client portal (Client Secure Messaging). As of this cataloging, SimplePractice does NOT publish a public, self-serve developer API - there is no developer portal, no documented REST endpoints, no OpenAPI, and no webhooks for third parties. The only programmatic surface is the partner-only SimplePractice Enterprise scheduling integration, which lets EAPs and Managed Care Organizations view in-network provider availability and request appointments; it is delivered through customized partnerships rather than as public developer documentation. Third-party pages that advertise a "stable SimplePractice REST API" for clients, appointments, notes, or billing are unofficial and not backed by any SimplePractice developer program.

providers.name: SmartSuite
providers.description: SmartSuite is a collaborative work management platform that helps teams plan, track, and manage workflows, projects, and everyday tasks using customizable solutions, tables, records, and automations. The platform combines spreadsheet, database, project management, and workflow automation capabilities into a unified workspace. SmartSuite's REST API provides programmatic access to Solutions, Tables, Records, and Fields using token-based authentication.

providers.name: Sofia
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican digital health insurance company that modernizes traditional medical coverage for enterprises, individuals, and families. Its plans combine zero-deductible major and minor medical care, preventive care with an assigned primary-care physician, and unlimited no-cost video consultations, all managed through a mobile app and an HR administrative portal. Sofía operates its own integrated medical network (SofíaMed) of hospitals and specialists, offers add-ons such as maternity, mental health, dental, and international coverage, and reimburses claims in an average of five business days. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Sofía positions insurance as a digital-first, member-centric health experience rather than a paper policy.

providers.name: Solace
providers.description: Solace Health is a US healthcare navigation company that connects patients with human patient advocates and care coordinators whose services are covered by insurance, including Medicare. Through solace.health and the app.solace.health member portal, patients are matched with an advocate who helps them understand diagnoses, prepare for appointments, coordinate care, manage bills, and navigate the healthcare system. Solace is a consumer-facing healthcare service company; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer program, API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: sophiagenetics
