providers.description: SOPHiA GENETICS (NASDAQ SOPH) is a healthcare technology company democratizing data-driven medicine through its cloud-based SOPHiA DDM Platform, which analyzes genomic, radiomic, and multimodal data to support clinicians and researchers across oncology, hereditary disorders, rare diseases, and precision medicine. The platform spans SOPHiA DDM for Genomics, Multimodal, and Radiomics, plus Alamut Visual Plus for variant interpretation and the OncoPortal knowledge base. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS platform; no public developer API or portal is currently published.

providers.name: SRS Acquiom
providers.description: SRS Acquiom provides deal management solutions for mergers & acquisitions and loan agency transactions, operating across the entire deal lifecycle. Its services span pre-closing tax and accounting advisory, closing-phase escrow, payment disbursement and shareholder solicitation, and post-closing shareholder representation, alongside loan agency roles (administrative, collateral, and facility agent). SRS Acquiom delivers these through digital dashboards and platforms for deal transparency, backed by affiliate broker-dealer Acquiom Financial LLC (FINRA/SIPC). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently exposed.

providers.name: Sunlight
providers.description: Sunlight is an educational-spending platform that lets organizations fund learning for their people. Administrators create groups, invite registered or unregistered members, allocate a per-user education budget ("sunlight"), and let members place orders for courses, books and subscriptions from providers such as Amazon and Platzi, while an activity feed tracks what members join and buy. Its REST API is built on the JSON:API specification (media type application/vnd.api+json) with Bearer-token authentication, and exposes groups, group membership and invitations, per-user credit/budget transactions, orders, and activities. Sunlight was backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest.

providers.name: The Carlyle Group
providers.description: The Carlyle Group (NASDAQ: CG) is a global investment firm that deploys private capital across Global Private Equity, Global Credit, Global Investment Solutions (AlpInvest), and carveouts such as Carlyle Direct Lending. Carlyle does not publish a public developer API. Institutional LPs, co-investors, and portfolio companies interact with the firm through a set of private, authentication-gated portals: LP Connect for fund investors, Carlyle Direct Lending's portal for direct lending clients, the Carlyle Global Portfolio Solutions (resources.carlyle.com) portal, and brand experiences such as Carlyle & Co. Integrations with fund administrators, custodians, and placement agents run through bespoke secure file exchange and vendor-managed APIs.

providers.name: Transcarent
providers.description: Transcarent is a health and care experience company serving self-insured employers, health plans, and government and labor union clients. Its consumer-facing platform, WayFinding, combines generative AI agents with instant access to human health guides and clinicians to deliver benefits navigation, clinical guidance, virtual primary and specialty care, pharmacy care, surgery care, cancer care, weight-health programs, and 2nd.MD second opinions in a single experience. The platform is built on an API-first, cloud-native architecture with pre-built HL7 FHIR and EDI connectors that integrate with existing eligibility files and medical, pharmacy, and point-solution benefits. Transcarent exposes these integrations to enterprise partners rather than through a public self-serve developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: TRDATA
providers.description: TRDATA (TRDATA Technology Limited) is a real-time financial information and communication platform for professional traders, aggregating over-the-counter (OTC) quotes, prices, news, and analytics from market makers across fragmented fixed-income and emerging-market instruments. It covers Ukrainian, CEEMEA, and global bonds, currencies, commodities, and derivatives from local and international data providers, and bundles analytics tools such as a Bond Calculator, Bond Calendar, Swap Curves, real-time asset charts, and a TRDATA Excel add-in. More than 800 institutions -- including Societe Generale, UniCredit, Raiffeisen, BNP Paribas, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, and Commerzbank -- use the platform to read and exchange market information. TRDATA is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; access is via registration and the hosted platform.

providers.name: Ultimagenomics
providers.description: Ultima Genomics develops high-throughput, low-cost DNA sequencing platforms built on a novel semiconductor-inspired architecture, aimed at driving the cost of a genome dramatically down to unlock population-scale genomics. Its systems support germline and somatic (oncology/MRD) sequencing, single-cell and spatial workflows, methylation/epigenomics, and proteomics, and integrate with an open ecosystem of third-party library-prep providers (10x Genomics, Olink). Rather than a public REST API, Ultima exposes its developer surface as open-source bioinformatics tooling and analysis pipelines: a large GitHub organization (Ultimagen) of UG-adapted variant callers and genomics utilities (GATK, Picard, STAR forks, ugbio-utils) and AWS HealthOmics WDL workflows for running cost-effective secondary analysis in the cloud.

providers.name: Ultromics
providers.description: Ultromics is a UK-based clinical AI company, spun out of the University of Oxford and backed by GV, whose EchoGo platform applies FDA 510(k)-cleared AI to routine echocardiograms to help clinicians detect heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and cardiac amyloidosis. EchoGo integrates into existing hospital echo workflows and PACS environments, delivering results through clinical systems rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: VeeFriends
providers.description: VeeFriends is a character-driven collectibles and entertainment company founded by Gary Vaynerchuk, built around 250+ original characters that embody human values like empathy, patience, and kindness. Operated by Vee Friends, LLC out of New York, the brand spans NFT collections (Series 1, Series 2, Iconics, Book Games), Topps Chrome trading cards and a trading card game, comic books and cartoons, collectible stickers and pins, apparel and plush merchandise, and the Burn Island platform where holders burn NFTs to unlock rare collectibles, events, and prizes. VeeFriends is an a16z portfolio company and publishes no public developer API surface today.

providers.name: Veritas Software
providers.description: Veritas Technologies (originally Veritas Software) is an enterprise data management and protection vendor whose products — NetBackup, Alta, Backup Exec, and InfoScale — expose RESTful APIs for automating backup, recovery, storage provisioning, and data governance. NetBackup ships Swagger/OpenAPI-documented REST APIs served from the master server, with first-party code samples published under the VeritasOS GitHub organization. The company runs a public trust and compliance program covering SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, FIPS 140, GDPR, and CCPA. Accel is among its historical investors.

providers.name: Ylookup
providers.description: Ylookup is a London-based fintech (founded 2025, EQT Ventures-backed) building an agentic workflow engine for fund administration, corporate services, tax, audit, and deal advisory firms. Its platform embeds trusted AI agents into existing tools (Excel, PDFs, Investran, Paxus) as a centralized processing layer — no data migration required — with specialized agents for extracting data from financial documents (LPAs, debt agreements, KYC/AML and tax forms), real-time reconciliation across spreadsheets and sources, financial analysis, and four-eye review. The company reports an average 76% time saved across live processes such as fund-accounting migration, client onboarding, financial-statement preparation, and K-1 data extraction. Ylookup publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its identity and published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: Zentist
providers.description: Zentist is a cloud-based revenue cycle management (RCM) platform built specifically for dental support organizations (DSOs) and multi-location dental practices. Its flagship product, Remit AI, uses artificial intelligence to automate electronic remittance advice (ERA) and explanation of benefits (EOB) parsing, payment posting, denial and adjustment categorization, and claims status tracking, while Cavi AR drives intelligent accounts-receivable follow-up. Executive dashboards deliver practice-level and organization-wide analytics. Trusted by more than 400 DSOs, Zentist reports doubling RCM productivity and cutting the cash-to-claim cycle in half within the first 100 days. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Zentist operates as a login-gated SaaS application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: 3P Learning Pty
providers.description: 3P Learning is an educational technology company that builds blended learning software for mathematics and literacy used by schools and families worldwide. Its product family includes Mathletics, Mathseeds, Reading Eggs, Writing Legends, LiteracyPlanet and Brightpath, reaching more than 20 million students across 130+ countries. The programs pair interactive student activities with teacher dashboards, reporting and curriculum-aligned content, and integrate into school systems via single sign-on and rostering standards such as Clever and LTI. 3P Learning is backed by Insight Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. This company publishes consumer and school-facing web and mobile products but does not expose a public first-party developer API or documented API surface.

providers.name: Ambarella
providers.description: Ambarella (NASDAQ: AMBA) is a fabless semiconductor company designing low-power system-on-chip (SoC) processors for edge AI and computer vision. Its CVflow architecture accelerates deep neural networks on-device for intelligent cameras, automotive ADAS and autonomous driving, robotics, security, and industrial applications. Ambarella does not publish a public HTTP/REST API; developers engage through the Cooper Developer Platform, the CVflow SDK and toolchain (compiler, debugger, Caffe/TensorFlow support), the Model Garden on HuggingFace, Agentic Blueprints, and an Apache-2.0 set of on-device Agent Skills for Cooper Foundry. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and enriched with the provider's real public developer, security, and agent surfaces.

providers.name: Apache JMeter
providers.description: Apache JMeter is an open-source Java application designed to load test functional behavior and measure performance of web applications and services. It can simulate heavy loads on servers, networks, and objects to test performance under different load types, supporting HTTP/HTTPS, SOAP/REST, databases, LDAP, JMS, and mail protocols.

providers.name: APITemplate.io
providers.description: APITemplate.io is a templating service that auto-generates PDFs and images programmatically from HTML/CSS templates with Jinja2-style data binding. Drag-and-drop visual editor; sync and async generation with webhooks; regional endpoints in US, EU, Singapore and Australia. SDKs for Python, JavaScript, PHP, C# and Java.

providers.name: Argent
providers.description: Argent (rebranded to Ready, ready.co, in 2025) is a self-custodial smart-contract wallet company focused on Starknet and Ethereum. It builds account-abstraction wallets - the Ready / Argent X browser extension and mobile app, a seedless email and password Web Wallet, and a multisig - plus the open-source developer tooling dapps use to integrate them: the starknetkit connection SDK, session keys (@argent/x-sessions), multicall batching, get-starknet, and the Swift starknet.swift and web3.swift libraries. Argent ships no first-party REST API; integration is via these client SDKs and on-chain smart contracts, with developer documentation hosted at docs.ready.co. Surfaced as an index-ventures portfolio company and enriched here.

providers.name: Azure CLI
providers.description: Azure CLI is the official cross-platform command-line tool for managing Microsoft Azure resources and services from the terminal.

providers.name: Baseframe
providers.description: BaseFrame (baseframe.co) is a Y Combinator (W26) startup building an AI workflow discovery platform for teams and small businesses. Its privacy-first desktop application analyzes historical work patterns across email, documents, Slack, calendar, browser activity, and files using on-device local models to identify high-value, repetitive tasks and recommend concrete AI automations, then helps users set them up in the tools they already use. BaseFrame publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time; it is a consumer/desktop product with SaaS integrations (Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Office 365, Jira). Founded in 2025 by Anshul Paul and Vaibhav Agrawal.

providers.name: Beside
providers.description: Beside (operated by Interface, Inc. / Heart Hands, Inc.) is an AI-powered business phone system built for contractors, field teams, and small-to-medium businesses. Its AI receptionist answers inbound calls 24/7, captures caller details, qualifies and routes leads, books appointments, and produces automatic call summaries and searchable transcripts, alongside team phone management, shared inboxes, roles and permissions, unlimited US/Canada calls and texts, spam blocking, and integrations with CRMs such as HubSpot, Attio, and Follow Up Boss (plus 7,000+ apps via Zapier). Beside advertises forthcoming compatibility with MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, but publishes no public API today. Surfaced as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures.

providers.name: Blooming Health
providers.description: Blooming Health is an AI-powered, omnichannel care-management and community-engagement platform for healthcare and social-services organizations. It lets teams design multilingual care workflows across voice, SMS, and email in minutes — automating screening and needs assessments, service recommendations, outreach, appointment reminders, wellness check-ins, emergency broadcasts, closed-loop referral tracking, and Medicaid/SNAP recertification. The platform integrates with existing EHR/CRM systems and databases via FHIR, HL7, API, and SFTP, and is HIPAA compliant with encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access controls, audit trails, BAAs, and SOC 2 documentation available on request. Blooming Health is a healthcare portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes an enterprise integration surface but publishes no public developer portal or API reference.

providers.name: Cardboard
providers.description: Cardboard is an agentic AI video editor that runs entirely in the browser. Users import raw footage and describe the edit in natural language — "make a 60-second recap", "cut this into ads" — and Cardboard cuts, captions, reframes (vertical/square/landscape), removes silences, generates and clones voiceovers, translates and dubs across languages, and composes a first draft on a real timeline the user can refine. It is built on multimodal LLMs plus WebGPU/WebCodecs to make a genuine non-linear editor possible in the browser, with real-time collaboration and frame-pinned comments. Cardboard was founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch and is a consumer/prosumer creative application; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Chimelabs Holdings PTY LTD
providers.description: Chime Labs (Chimelabs Holdings PTY LTD) builds an AI voice receptionist and call-automation platform purpose-built for Australian trades and service businesses — plumbers, electricians, HVAC, locksmiths, pest control, cleaners and other on-the-tools operators. The AI answers missed inbound calls 24/7, qualifies and captures job details in natural Australian English, books work into scheduling and field-service systems (ServiceM8, Simpro, ServiceTitan, AroFlo, Fergus, Acuity Scheduling and Google Calendar), runs outbound calls, and turns quote calls into sent quotes automatically. Founded in 2025 in Sydney, Australia by Alexis Griveau (CEO) and Mathew Pretel and backed by 500 Global. The company operates a customer-facing SaaS product at platform.chimelabs.ai; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Civitas Learning
providers.description: Civitas Learning is a higher education technology company whose Student Impact Platform unifies student data, predictive analytics, and coordinated workflows to help colleges and universities improve enrollment, persistence, and completion outcomes. The platform consolidates data from SIS, LMS, CRM, and event systems into a data lakehouse, layers institution-specific predictive models (CivIQ) on top, and surfaces real-time, actionable insights to advisors, faculty, and administrators through products such as Explore, Inspire, Impact, Illume, College Scheduler, Degree Map, and Academic Planning. Civitas Learning serves institutions of all sizes and pairs its software with strategic advisory services. It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public operational, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Cleanly
providers.description: Cleanly was a US-based on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning startup (backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator) that has since rebranded and now operates as ByNext at bynext.co. ByNext is an app-based, on-demand laundry, dry cleaning, and home cleaning pickup and delivery service operating 7 days a week (8am-8pm) with 24-48 hour turnaround across metro markets including New York City, New Jersey, the Washington D.C. area, and Los Angeles. Booking is handled through its iOS and Android apps with real-time driver tracking, pay-per-pound or subscription pricing, and free pickup and delivery. Cleanly/ByNext exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public web and consumer-app footprint. The original cleanly.com domain now redirects to bynext.co.

providers.name: Clearscore
providers.description: ClearScore is a London-founded fintech (2015) that gives consumers free access to their credit score and report and matches them to financial products — credit cards, loans, car finance, insurance and more — through a personalised financial marketplace. It also runs ClearScore Protect (dark-web identity monitoring), DriveScore (driving-behaviour scoring) and Open Banking features, and operates across the UK, South Africa, Australia, Canada and New Zealand. Its B2B arm, ClearScore Connect, exposes credit-data and eligibility services to partner lenders through a partner-gated developer portal (docs.clearscore.com). Backed by QED Investors. This profile was surfaced as a QED portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; ClearScore's developer API is documented behind a password-gated ReadMe.io portal, so no public OpenAPI or machine-readable spec could be captured.

providers.name: creativeLIVE
providers.description: creativeLIVE (CreativeLive) is an online learning platform offering more than 2,300 on-demand courses and live interactive classes taught by working professionals across photography, video and filmmaking, graphic and web design, business and entrepreneurship, arts and crafts, audio and music production, and AI and technology. Learners access practical, skill-based instruction through a subscription, with certificates of completion available. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network; creativeLIVE exposes no public developer API, but does publish a machine-readable llms.txt course index for AI agents.

providers.name: Cyberwrite
providers.description: Cyberwrite is an AI-powered cyber insurance intelligence platform, founded in 2017, that turns raw data into explainable, defensible financial decisions for the cyber insurance market. Its proprietary 4SEEN AI engine assesses cyber risk, forecasts breaches, simulates financial impact, and recommends mitigation, giving brokers, carriers, reinsurers, MGAs, ILS investors, and corporates access to cyber risk analytics, catastrophe modeling, and risk quantification on more than 100 million companies worldwide in seconds and in eight languages. Cyberwrite delivers its scoring and analytics through an enterprise API for real-time aggregated risk management; the platform is a Gartner Cool Vendor and DIA Top 100 InsurTech, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: EchoLeads
providers.description: EchoLeads is an autonomous AI voice sales platform out of T-Hub, Hyderabad, India, that replaces manual SDR work with AI agents running a full omnichannel workflow: outbound cold calling and inbound response, real-time BANT qualification, WhatsApp Business follow-up, Instagram DM lead capture, live intent-based lead scoring, human handoff, CRM sync, and calendar booking during the call. It sells into real estate, insurance, SaaS, healthcare, financial services and e-commerce, supports English, Hindi and regional Indian languages, and claims TRAI-compliant outbound calling. It is backed by Google for Startups, T-Hub and Math Nuage (DST, Government of India). Agent-native surface is real and verified — a live llms.txt, a full llms-full.txt content index, an RFC 9116 security.txt, and an AI-crawler-permissive robots.txt. The API surface is not: a REST API is self-declared in llms-full.txt (trigger calls, retrieve transcripts, push lead scores) but the documentation page returns 502, api.echoleads.ai has no listener, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, Postman collection or MCP server is published on any host.

providers.name: Enosys Markets
providers.description: Ēnosys (formerly Flare Finance) is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform building on the Flare and Songbird networks. Its product suite spans DEX V2 and V3 automated market makers with liquidity provision, collateralized Loans, yield Farms with a token launchpad, a cross-chain Bridge, DeFi price Oracles built on the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO), the Skopos blockchain indexer, Oryy multi-signature self-custody vaults, and an NFT suite (Gallery, Ermis, Clover). Enosys interfaces are smart-contract based rather than a conventional REST API; developer integration happens through published Solidity contracts, subgraphs, and price-feed connectors in the flrfinance GitHub organization.

providers.name: FineDine
providers.description: FineDine is an AI-powered restaurant growth platform that helps restaurants increase revenue through digital menus (QR code, tablet, and web), online and in-venue ordering, reservations, a lite point-of-sale, CRM and loyalty programs, menu-engineering and pricing analytics, and an AI business agent (FineDine IQ). It markets to restaurants and hospitality operators with tiered SaaS pricing (Starter, Growth, Premium). As of this API Evangelist profiling, FineDine publishes no public developer API, SDKs, webhooks, CLI, MCP server, or OpenAPI specification — this profile captures its public commercial and content surface. FineDine is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Flightfox
providers.description: Flightfox is a managed travel platform for complex group travel, headquartered in Boulder, Colorado. It helps educational institutions, humanitarian and faith-based organizations, and corporate teams book and manage flights, hotels, and ground travel through a combination of self-serve booking software and 24/7 human travel-agent support. Flightfox emphasizes lowest-fare guarantees, bulk and group booking discounts, real-time flight tracking and travel alerts, branded booking pages, and custom reporting including CO2 emissions and flight manifests. The company was originally a Y Combinator and a16z-backed crowdsourced flight-search marketplace and has since pivoted to full-service managed group travel. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: General Legal
providers.description: General Legal is an AI-native law firm for high-growth startups and SMBs, offering flat-fee commercial, corporate, and employment legal work delivered by U.S.-barred attorneys augmented with proprietary AI workflows. The firm focuses on contract review, redlining, negotiation, and drafting with transparent flat pricing (from $250) and fast turnaround (median under three hours), positioning itself as "outside counsel that scales like software." Practice areas include technology transactions, employment, data privacy, financial regulatory, blockchain/cryptocurrency, and emerging companies / VC. Founded in 2026 by Ryan Walker (ex-Casetext CTO), J.P. Mohler, and Javed Qadruddin, the company is a Y Combinator (W26) portfolio company that raised $11.5M across pre-seed and seed rounds. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from public sources; General Legal is a legal-services company and does not currently publish a developer API.

providers.name: Gnowbe
providers.description: Gnowbe is an AI-powered workforce enablement and performance platform for enterprise learning, enablement, and alignment. It turns static content and communication into mobile-first microlearning experiences with AI-powered activation and execution tracking, so teams do not just learn but perform. Trusted by 500,000+ learners across 100+ countries, Gnowbe combines authoring, AI content creation, group-based delivery, completion and engagement analytics, and integrations (SSO/SAML, LMS/SCORM, xAPI/LRS, HR systems, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zapier's 5,000+ tools). Gnowbe is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: HostnFly
providers.description: HostnFly is a French short-term-rental (Airbnb) concierge and property-management company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Paris. It manages the full lifecycle of short-stay rentals on behalf of property owners: listing creation and optimization, multi-platform distribution (Airbnb, Booking.com, Abritel), guest screening and 24/7 communication, check-in/check-out and key handling, hotel-grade housekeeping and linen, maintenance, short-term-rental insurance, and dynamic revenue optimization. HostnFly operates on a commission-only model (from ~20% of nightly revenue, no fixed fees) and covers 340+ cities across metropolitan France and Corsica. It is a Partech portfolio company. HostnFly publishes an llms.txt agent-discovery file but does not expose a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Kitterly
providers.description: Kitterly, Inc. was a direct-to-consumer craft commerce startup that sold knitting and crochet kits, yarn, needles and notions online, and ran a monthly Kit Club subscription that shipped members a pattern plus the yarn required to complete it. Kitterly was backed by 500 Global (500 Startups) along with Manatt Ventures and the Jordan x 2080 accelerator. The company was later consolidated under the Cotton Cuts brand, a Chesterfield, Missouri based quilting fabric shop selling designer die-cut and pre-cut fabric, threads, patterns and notions, plus quilting memberships and the Puzzle Mystery Quilt program, serving roughly 4,000 members across more than 15 countries. The kitterly.com domain now redirects to cottoncuts.com. The business is a consumer retail and subscription commerce operation running on a hosted e-commerce platform, and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: KiwiCo
providers.description: KiwiCo, Inc. is a direct-to-consumer education company headquartered in Mountain View, California, founded in 2011 by Sandra Oh Lin. KiwiCo designs and ships hands-on STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art and math) project kits — branded as crates — on a monthly subscription, with distinct lines aimed at every age from infants through teens and adults, alongside single-purchase kits sold through its online store. A KiwiCo Education division supplies the same project kits and NGSS-aligned lesson guides to schools, homeschools, after-school programs and camps. KiwiCo operates as a consumer e-commerce and subscription business and publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, CLI or webhook surface, and no /.well-known/ discovery documents on any of its hosts. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: LendingClub
providers.description: LendingClub is a US consumer-finance company and digital bank, originally founded in 2006 as a peer-to-peer marketplace lender and later a national bank holding company after its 2021 acquisition of Radius Bancorp. In 2026 the company rebranded as Happen Bank, N.A. (a wholly-owned subsidiary of Happen, Inc.) and moved its public web presence from lendingclub.com to happen.com, where it offers personal loans, auto refinancing, business loans, LevelUp checking and savings accounts, the DebtIQ credit dashboard, and an institutional investing program for marketplace-lending loan buyers. LendingClub historically published a public Investor API for its retail notes marketplace; that marketplace was retired in December 2020 and the developer portal and API documentation are no longer published. As of this enrichment pass the company operates no public developer program, API reference, or SDK surface, and no OpenAPI or event specifications are available to harvest.

providers.name: Level Frames
providers.description: Level Frames is a New York City based online custom framing company founded in 2014 by Josh Hubball and Damian Sowers and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2015). The company lets customers design and order handcrafted, made-to-order picture frames from home, either by uploading a digital photo for printing and framing or by shipping in physical artwork, posters and prints. Its catalog covers custom frames, framed canvas prints, framed vinyl records, collage frames, gallery walls, personalized framed photos, and framed chalkboards, whiteboards and corkboards, alongside at-home and in-studio framing services. Level Frames operates a direct-to-consumer web storefront and publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.

providers.name: LUMICKS
providers.description: LUMICKS is a life-science instrumentation company that builds tools to directly measure molecular and cellular interactions. Its Dynamic Single-Molecule platform, the C-Trap, uses optical tweezers to resolve real-time biomolecular interactions at the single-molecule level, while its Cell Avidity platforms (Avidion and the compact z-Movi) quantify the binding strength between immune cells and their targets for immuno-oncology, CAR-T, and antibody-therapeutics research. The developer surface is client-side: the official Apache-2.0 Python library lumicks.pylake analyzes single-molecule optical-tweezer data exported from the Bluelake acquisition software (force calibration, force-distance curve fitting, kymo/scan imaging, kymotracking, population dynamics), and bluelake-scripting automates instrument control. LUMICKS publishes no hosted public web API.

providers.name: Meisterwerk
providers.description: Meisterwerk is a modular all-in-one SaaS platform for German-speaking (DACH) trades and craft businesses (Handwerk), built by MEISTERWERK APP GmbH in Berlin. It gives small and medium craft firms (1-50 employees) a single operating system for job and resource scheduling (Einsatzplanung), a native mobile app for iOS, Android and Windows, chronological job documentation with photos and chat, quoting and invoicing with e-invoice support, EU-compliant mobile time tracking with GPS, digital forms and signatures, absence/holiday planning, and configurable workflows. AI features (planning assistant, speech-to-text documentation and time entry, and the standalone "Frag Maxi" phone assistant) are built in. It integrates with lexoffice, sevdesk, bexio and orgaMAX accounting software; a public open interface (Offene Schnittstelle) is announced but not yet publicly documented. Over 8,000 active users; data is hosted on servers in Germany and the platform is GDPR (DSGVO) compliant.

providers.name: Metric
providers.description: Metric is an AI-powered financial intelligence and accounting platform built for business owners, founders, and CEOs. It replaces spreadsheets and expensive CFO teams with a real-time financial dashboard and Max, an AI co-pilot (CF-AI) that answers financial questions such as runway, hiring capacity, and spending in plain language, drawn from live financial data. Metric handles accounting and bookkeeping, payables and receivables, invoicing, eight report types, and UAE VAT compliance, and connects to QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Xero, and Shopify. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi with offices in Rawalpindi, Singapore, and Riyadh, it is backed by 500 Global and serves businesses across 190+ countries. Metric is a SaaS web application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Moxtra
providers.description: Moxtra (now operating as Moxo) is a contextual collaboration and customer engagement platform that lets businesses embed chat, video meetings, voice calls, file sharing, e-signature, digital workflows, and binder-based collaboration into their own mobile and web applications via SDKs and REST APIs. The Moxtra Developer Portal exposes 200+ REST API endpoints for managing users, binders (workspaces), messages, files, meetings, todos, and notifications. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 access tokens issued against the Moxtra (or self-branded GroupHour) authorization server.

providers.name: Newton
providers.description: Newton is a Linux Foundation open source physics engine, contributed by Disney Research, NVIDIA, and Google DeepMind. Built on NVIDIA Warp and integrating MuJoCo Warp as a backend, Newton targets roboticists and simulation researchers, providing GPU-accelerated, differentiable, OpenUSD-compatible physics simulation for AI training, robotics, gaming, and scientific research.

providers.name: Nookly
providers.description: Nookly is a personalized children's content platform that helps the adults who care for a child — parents, teachers, therapists, and early-childhood organizations — turn their intimate knowledge of that child into custom stories, songs, visual schedules, social stories, emotion cards, and behavior supports. Grounded in social-emotional learning and behavioral science, it produces developmentally appropriate, COPPA/FERPA-compliant content for children ages 2-11, with particular value for neurodivergent kids (autism, ADHD, speech delays, anxiety, and sensory processing differences). Used across homes, classrooms, and clinics in 50+ states.

providers.name: OncoC4
providers.description: OncoC4, Inc. is a privately held, late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland, founded in 2020, with subsidiaries in Nanjing, Guangzhou and Beijing, China, and Brisbane, Australia. The company discovers and develops novel biologics for the treatment of cancer, working across immune checkpoints including CTLA-4, CD24, PD-1/VEGF and the Siglec family, with monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates and CAR T-cell therapies. Its lead clinical candidate is gotistobart (BNT316/ONC-392), a next-generation anti-CTLA-4 antibody co-developed and commercialized with BioNTech under a strategic collaboration announced in March 2023. OncoC4 publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or developer documentation; its corporate website runs on the Umbraco CMS, which serves a default OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery document and JWKS for CMS member authentication.

providers.name: Ordana
providers.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Peppy
providers.description: Peppy is a global employee healthcare benefits platform, delivered through a mobile app, that connects workers with specialist clinicians across key life stages. Offered by employers as a benefit, Peppy provides unlimited access to practitioners covering women's health, men's health, fertility, pregnancy and early parenthood, menopause, and neurodiversity, alongside lifestyle support for nutrition, fitness, and mental wellbeing. Peppy operates a consumer and employer facing service and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its published web properties and security posture. Peppy is a Seedcamp portfolio company.

providers.name: Pietra
providers.description: Pietra is an AI-powered commerce platform for fast-growing consumer brands and creators. It unifies sourcing, production, fulfillment, logistics, marketing, and operations in a single platform — giving brands access to a network of 40,000+ global suppliers and factories, integrated third-party (3PL) fulfillment infrastructure, AI assistants that automate content creation and affiliate/influencer campaigns, competitive intelligence and social listening, and e-commerce software to run a direct-to-consumer business. Founded in 2019 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile, Pietra does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Pomo
providers.description: Pomo is an AI marketing platform that runs an always-on AI marketing team, turning continuous market, competitor, brand, and trend intelligence into strategy, creative direction, ad-placement planning, and launch-ready campaign workflows for lean growth, brand, and performance teams. It monitors signals daily, surfaces opportunity and whitespace, drafts approval-ready campaigns, briefs, and creatives, and supports AEO/GEO AI-search visibility and Marketing Mix Modeling. Pomo is also offered as a managed service where in-house marketing experts operate the platform on a customer's behalf. Founded in 2025 and based in Palo Alto, California, Pomo raised a $4.5M seed round led by Kindred Ventures with Databricks Ventures, SV Angel, and angel investors. There is no public developer API; the site publishes a real /llms.txt AI-discovery document but no OpenAPI, docs, or developer surface.

providers.name: Prudential plc
providers.description: Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales and listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong and roots in London going back to 1848. Its home market for this profile is the United Kingdom, but its book is almost entirely Asian and African: life protection, health and medical, savings and retirement, takaful, pensions and Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Funds, plus asset management under the Eastspring brand, across Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, India, mainland China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and a dozen African markets including Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Zambia. It is no longer a UK retail insurer at all - the UK and Europe business was demerged as M&G plc in 2019 and the US business as Jackson Financial in 2021 - so the familiar UK "Pru" brands at pru.co.uk belong to M&G, not to this company. Its API posture is that there is no public API posture. Prudential plc publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document and no partner integration surface of any kind: developer, developers, docs, api, apis, partners, portal and sandbox subdomains of prudentialplc.com all fail to resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer, /partners and /integrations on the corporate site all return HTTP 404. The group's stated technology strategy is inward-facing - AI, automation, cloud and a global AI Lab running over a hundred internal use cases - and its distribution is built on tied agency forces and exclusive bancassurance partnerships with banks such as Standard Chartered, CIMB, MSB, SeABank, Bank Syariah Indonesia and UOB, which are commercial and contractual relationships rather than published API programmes. The Pulse by Prudential health and wealth app onboards health-tech and wealth-tech partners (Babylon, Tictrac, Halodoc, Smarter Health, Prive Technologies, OVO, Google Cloud) but every announcement describes the arrangement in commercial terms and none exposes a developer programme, SDK or public API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference was found anywhere in Prudential plc's public estate. Recorded honestly as a large carrier with a fully partner-gated, non-public integration surface. One genuine machine-readable surface does exist, and it is not an API: six of the group's market operating companies - Prudential Hong Kong, Prudential Singapore, Prudential Indonesia, Prudential Vietnam, Pru Life UK in the Philippines and Prudential BSN Takaful in Malaysia - publish real first-party llms.txt documents for grounding large language models, with Prudential Vietnam declaring a per-user-agent bot access policy for gptbot, claudebot, google-extended, perplexitybot and six other crawlers. The corporate domain publishes none. Underneath that, the group runs a visibly centralised security posture: TLS 1.3 and HSTS on every market host, and one shared PowerDMARC/PowerSPF tenant with a common aggregate-report mailbox across all seven domains, at p=reject on the corporate domain and p=quarantine in the markets, with no CAA record anywhere.

providers.name: Rain Financial
providers.description: Rain is a Middle East and North Africa (MENA) cryptocurrency exchange and digital-asset platform, operated through Rain Financial Inc. and its Bahrain entity Rain Management W.L.L. Founded in 2017 by Abdullah Almoaiqel, AJ Nelson, Joseph Dallago, and Yehia Badawy, Rain became the first crypto-asset company accepted into the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory sandbox and, in 2019, the first CBB-licensed crypto-asset service provider in the region. Rain Trading Limited later received approval from Abu Dhabi Global Market's Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) to expand across the UAE. Rain lets retail and institutional customers buy, sell, store, and manage Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other cryptocurrencies against multiple fiat currencies, with a Rain Pro offering for advanced traders and the majority of customer assets held in multi-signature cold storage. The company raised seed, Series A, and a $110M Series B (Paradigm, Kleiner Perkins), and is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Rapchat
providers.description: Rapchat is a mobile-first music creation platform for artists, rappers, singers, and producers, founded in 2014. Creators use the Rapchat iOS and Android apps to find professionally-produced beats from top producers, record studio-quality vocals with effects and audio filters, write lyrics, join music challenges, collaborate, and share finished songs with a creator community. The platform reports 15M+ creators, 100M+ tracks, and over one billion plays, and offers free web-based artist tools (rap name generator, lyric generator, rhyme finder, BPM mood guide) alongside Free, Premium, and Pro subscription tiers. Rapchat is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its /api endpoint is an internal application backend (HTTP 403).

providers.name: Rialo
providers.description: Rialo is an early-stage Layer 1 blockchain building high-throughput infrastructure with configurable privacy for real-world finance and the emerging agent economy. Developed by Subzero Labs and backed by Pantera Capital, Rialo positions itself as the infrastructure for the next generation of intelligent systems, replacing the fragile stack of off-chain automation with native, event-driven execution. Its architecture spans several first-class capabilities: the Rialo Omni Account (one account that transacts across multiple networks), Rialo Interop (native, fast, cheap cross-chain interoperability), Rialo IPC (Identity, Privacy, and Compliance built in), Rialo Stream (native data feeds for DeFi and real-world assets), and an event-driven Execution Engine supporting reactive transactions and conditional automation. The project is pre-mainnet; its developer surface consists of a dev portal, gated technical documentation, an interactive playground, a Learn hub of technical demos, and an active engineering blog.

providers.name: Roadsurfer
providers.description: Roadsurfer is a Munich-based camper van, motorhome, and RV travel company founded in 2016, operating a fleet of 10,000+ vehicles across 100+ pick-up/drop-off locations in 16 countries in Europe and North America. Beyond flexible RV rentals it offers RV subscriptions, RV sales, one-way "Rallies," and roadsurfer Spots, a network of 10,000+ hand-picked European campsites. Roadsurfer is a consumer-facing brand with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and published llms.txt for the API Evangelist network. Backed by HV Capital.

providers.name: Roofstock
providers.description: Roofstock is a residential real estate investment platform and online marketplace for buying, selling, and managing single-family rental (SFR) homes. It gives individual and institutional investors research, analytics, certified property listings, and end-to-end services spanning acquisitions, property management (Mynd), portfolio accounting software (Stessa), tenant screening (RentPrep), asset management, and dispositions across dozens of U.S. markets. The company reports hundreds of thousands of users and over $10B in transacted volume. Roofstock operates a private web API (api.roofstock.com) and a GraphQL endpoint powering its marketplace applications; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, first-party SDKs, or documented API access. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Roofstock's public web surface.

providers.name: Seatti
providers.description: Seatti is a hybrid-workplace management platform that helps organizations run desk, room, and parking booking, track real office occupancy and utilization without hardware sensors, manage visitor check-ins, and coordinate team presence. It integrates deeply with Microsoft Entra ID, Outlook, and Teams, and serves 100+ companies across 30+ countries including OSRAM, Sartorius, and IKB. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech (Applicative SaaS) and enriched in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: SendCutSend
providers.description: SendCutSend is a rapid custom manufacturing service offering online sheet metal fabrication, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, CNC machining, CNC bending, tapping, hardware installation, and finishing across 175+ materials, with instant online pricing from uploaded STEP or DXF files and parts delivered in as little as a few days. Customers quote, configure, and order parts through the app.sendcutsend.com web application. The company reached a $1.01B valuation following a $110M investment co-led by Sequoia, Paradigm, and Patrick and John Collison. SendCutSend does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, pricing, and content surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shopventory
providers.description: Thrive by Shopventory is inventory management, catalog control, and reporting software for small and medium-sized retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses. Founded in 2012 out of a San Diego boutique and a graduate of the Techstars Boulder accelerator, Shopventory syncs stock, sales, and cost-of-goods data across multiple locations and sales channels, and integrates with Square, Shopify, Clover, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and QuickBooks Online. The platform offers barcode scanning, purchase-order automation, demand forecasting, bundles and component-level tracking, price-tag printing, and advanced custom reporting. The company operates as Thrive by Shopventory (thrivemetrics.com). Its former public developer API (apidocs.shopventory.com) is no longer resolvable, so this profile captures the company's live web, support, and integration surface plus probed domain-security posture rather than a public API specification.

providers.name: Skootar
providers.description: Skootar is a Thai on-demand courier, messenger, and logistics platform serving Bangkok, its surrounding provinces, and Chonburi. It offers same-day document delivery, cheque and bill collection, parcel shipping, business food delivery, and on-demand pickup-truck and moving jobs across a fleet of motorcycles, cars, and trucks, all with real-time tracking. Orders can be placed 24/7 through the website, the mobile app, or an API intended for high-volume businesses to wire delivery ordering into their own back-office systems. Skootar reports more than 130,000 business customers, 26,000+ drivers, and 9.2 million+ completed deliveries over 12 years, and is backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is published; API access is arranged through its business/enterprise channel.

providers.name: Skuad
providers.description: Skuad is a global HR and employment platform (now part of Payoneer as Payoneer Workforce Management) that lets companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage full-time employees and contractors across 160+ countries without setting up local legal entities. It provides employer-of-record (EOR) services, international payroll in 70+ currencies, contractor management and payments, benefits administration, background verification, and built-in compliance with local employment, tax, and labor laws. Skuad was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched from Skuad's public web presence. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Southern Company
providers.description: Southern Company is an Atlanta-headquartered energy holding company and one of the largest producers of electricity in the United States, serving approximately 9 million electric and natural gas customers through Alabama Power, Georgia Power, Mississippi Power, Southern Power, Southern Company Gas (Atlanta Gas Light, Nicor Gas, Virginia Natural Gas, Chattanooga Gas), Southern Nuclear, PowerSecure, Southern Linc and Southern Telecom. It sits at the vertically-integrated regulated-utility layer of the value chain — it owns generation, transmission and distribution, operates its own balancing authority rather than belonging to an ISO/RTO, and runs a FERC-approved bid-based energy auction for wholesale power in the Southeast. Its API posture is honestly closed on both sides of the sector's two-speed split. There is no consumer data mandate in Alabama, Georgia or Mississippi and Southern Company does not implement Green Button Download My Data or Connect My Data, is not listed by the Green Button Alliance, and publishes no ESPI endpoint — a customer can only export their own interval data as a spreadsheet after logging into My Power Usage, and a third party gets billing history only through a signed paper release form. On the market side the FERC-required auction clearing prices and weighted-average hour-ahead transaction prices are posted as public web pages, but they are JavaScript-rendered HTML with no CSV, no feed and no API behind them. A production Apigee API gateway is live at api.southernco.com and developer.southernco.com resolves behind an Imperva edge, so the platform machinery exists internally, but no proxy, no specification and no documentation are published to anyone outside the company.

providers.name: Spline
providers.description: Spline is a real-time collaborative 3D design tool with AI-driven object generation, web embedding, and animation. Spline does NOT publish a REST API for 3D scene generation as of May 2026; instead it exposes Code APIs (Web, SwiftUI, Kotlin) for embedding scenes, plus a real-time API for variables/data and webhooks for event-driven integrations.

providers.name: TemperPack
providers.description: TemperPack is a Richmond, Virginia based sustainable packaging manufacturer, founded in 2015 and a Certified B Corporation, that designs and manufactures curbside recyclable and compostable alternatives to expanded polystyrene (EPS) and single-use plastic for cold chain and protective shipping. Its three material platforms are ClimaCell, a starch-and-paper thermal liner for cold chain shipments; Green Cell Foam, a certified compostable starch-based insulation with EPS-level performance; and WaveKraft, paper-based cushioning produced on demand. Products span cushioning, mailers, qualified shippers and stock shippers, serving life sciences, food and beverage, pet and veterinary, wine, and packaging distribution customers from ISO 9001:2015 certified plants in Richmond VA, Lansing MI and Las Vegas NV, with in-house ISTA thermal and mechanical testing at its Proving Ground lab. TemperPack operates a customer portal for order tracking, thermal testing results, billing and WaveKraft analytics, and an e-commerce store, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition or developer portal as of August 2026.

providers.name: The Black Tux
providers.description: The Black Tux is an online formalwear company offering premium suit and tuxedo rentals and purchases for weddings and formal events. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, it pairs a direct-to-consumer online store with roughly 50 physical showrooms nationwide, home try-on, group wedding coordination with party pricing, free shipping over $200, and a perfect-fit guarantee. The storefront runs on Shopify; The Black Tux does not publish a first-party developer API. The only machine-readable surface on the domain is Shopify's managed Customer Account identity service (OIDC / OAuth authorization server discovery). This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and enriched with the verifiable public identity and web properties the company genuinely publishes.

providers.name: Thematic
providers.description: Thematic is a copyright-free music licensing platform that connects independent content creators with emerging artists. Creators get a permanent, no-cost license to use tracks in their videos in exchange for including a promotional link in the description, which activates YouTube Content ID whitelisting and prevents copyright claims across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and podcasts. Premium ($9.99/mo) and Pro ($24.99/mo) plans unlock the full catalog, podcast licensing, and unlimited downloads. Co-founded with YouTube pioneer Michelle Phan, Thematic serves 1M+ creators and 10,000+ independent artists across 220+ countries. Thematic runs a consumer web and mobile app and does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global and Lux Capital.

providers.name: Toonimo
providers.description: Toonimo is a digital adoption platform (DAP) that overlays personalized, interactive on-screen guidance onto enterprise software and websites. Using patented voice, text-bubble, and visual-cue walkthroughs, Toonimo guides end users and employees through onboarding, self-service, and complex workflows to increase conversions, accelerate software adoption, and reduce support costs. It layers on top of platforms such as Salesforce, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics, Coupa, and SharePoint, and enables subject-matter experts (not just developers) to build and maintain adoption content. Toonimo is a marketing/product company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: TransparentBusiness
providers.description: TransparentBusiness is a New York based SaaS company, founded in 2012 by Alex Konanykhin and Silvina Moschini, that sells a cloud platform for managing and monitoring remote workforces: a desktop timer, screenshot-based activity verification, timesheets, task assignment, and real-time project cost and progress reporting for distributed teams and contractors. The company also operates the SheWorks! and Yandiki talent marketplaces and the CloudWorking Academy training platform, and was later renamed Unicoin, Inc. The product is delivered as a hosted web application plus downloadable desktop timer clients; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Tynker
providers.description: Tynker is a coding platform for kids and teens ages 5-18 that makes it fun to learn programming through game-based, interactive courses, with students starting in visual block-based coding and progressing to real-world languages like Python and JavaScript. The platform powers the creativity of over 100 million students and serves thousands of schools and educators worldwide, spanning home plans for parents, K-12 school curriculum, Hour of Code activities, and Minecraft modding. Tynker is a 500 Global and Felicis portfolio company, now part of CodeHS, and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Valerie Health
providers.description: Valerie Health is an AI-powered front office platform for independent healthcare provider groups, automating referral management, fax and document classification and data extraction, appointment scheduling, and growth analytics on top of existing EMR and practice management systems. Founded by Pete Shalek and Nitin Joshi and backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures with a $30M Series A, the company operates as a HIPAA Business Associate for its provider customers and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation.

providers.name: VanHack
providers.description: VanHack is a SaaS hiring platform that connects employers with pre-screened senior software engineers from a global community of over 500,000 vetted candidates who are ready to relocate or work remotely. The platform pairs expert human recruiters with Vanna, an AI recruiter that matches candidates from natural-language job descriptions, and coordinates interviews with calendar sync, Slack, and ATS integration. VanHack reports 2,300+ hires at 520+ companies and charges a flat monthly fee with no placement fees. The company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Vela
providers.description: Vela is an AI scheduling assistant from Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch that handles the ambiguity that breaks scheduling. Added to any email thread or messaging conversation, it negotiates on the user's behalf — reading context, proposing meeting times across timezones, following up with participants, detecting calendar conflicts, rescheduling, and sending invites once scheduling is finalized. It works across Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is used by enterprise recruiters coordinating thousands of multi-party interviews a week as well as executives who need white-glove coordination at scale.

providers.name: Virgin Australia
providers.description: Virgin Australia (IATA code VA, ASX:VGN) is Australia's second-largest airline group, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Brisbane, operating a domestic and short-haul international network alongside charter and cargo services with more than 8,000 team members and the 13-million-member Velocity Frequent Flyer loyalty program. It sits on the airline side of a concentrated Australian duopoly with Qantas, and reaches travel agents and travel management companies almost entirely through GDS intermediation — Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport/Galileo — rather than through any direct machine interface of its own. Virgin Australia selected Sabre as its preferred NDC IT technology provider in October 2023 and renewed a multi-year Amadeus distribution agreement covering EDIFACT today and NDC in future, but as of July 2026 no Virgin Australia NDC endpoint, developer portal or API documentation is published anywhere on virginaustralia.com. Its API posture is honestly stated as none-published: developer.virginaustralia.com, developers., api., apis. and docs. subdomains do not resolve; /developers, /api, /api-docs, /openapi.json and /swagger.json all return 404; and the only partner surface is the Agency Hub, whose Travel Agent Main Agreement requires current IATA or ATIS accreditation, GDS access for BSP sales, and Virgin Australia's absolute discretion to approve an account. The one genuinely public programmatic-adjacent surface is the Virgin Australia app in ChatGPT, launched 10 June 2026 for flight and Velocity Reward Seat search only — it cannot book, amend, cancel or take payment, and its underlying interface is not documented.

providers.name: Wingstop
providers.description: Wingstop Inc. (NASDAQ: WING) is a US-based quick-service restaurant chain specializing in cooked-to-order chicken wings, tenders, and sides across thousands of franchised and company-owned locations. Wingstop is digital-first - digital transactions account for the large majority of systemwide sales - built on its proprietary MyWingstop ordering platform and the Club Wingstop loyalty program, with consumer ordering via wingstop.com, native iOS and Android apps, and third-party delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Wingstop does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. There is no developer.wingstop.com (the host does not resolve), and ordering, loyalty, menu, and POS integrations flow through bilateral corporate and franchisee technology programs rather than open developer endpoints.

providers.name: ACV
providers.description: ACV Auctions (NASDAQ: ACVA) operates the nation's largest online wholesale marketplace and daily auto auction platform, connecting franchise and independent dealers to buy and sell used vehicles. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Buffalo, New York, ACV pairs a mobile-first bidding app with third-party vehicle inspections and condition reports, real-time market data (ACV MAX and market insights), transportation logistics, and dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; ACV does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: AdEspresso
providers.description: AdEspresso by Hootsuite is a self-service digital advertising optimization platform for creating, managing, analyzing, and collaborating on Facebook and Instagram (and Google) ad campaigns from a single dashboard. Its tagline is "Digital Advertising Made Easy, Fast & Effective." The product lets marketers, agencies, and e-commerce teams launch split-test campaigns at scale, generate performance analytics in web/PDF/email/Excel formats, run team and client approval workflows, and learn through AdEspresso University guides, webinars, and eBooks. Originally a standalone Facebook Marketing Partner, AdEspresso was acquired by Hootsuite in 2017. It is surfaced here as a portfolio company of 500 Global. AdEspresso does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or a developer portal; it builds on the Facebook Marketing API rather than exposing its own.

providers.name: All In
providers.description: All In Food makes organic, gluten-free nut & seed snack bars on a social-impact model — every bar purchased helps fund local nutritious-food-access initiatives such as food banks, community gardens, and meal programs across the U.S. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures (a reported $4M raise) and sells through Sprouts and Starbucks as well as its own online store. While All In is a consumer-packaged-goods brand rather than a developer platform, its Shopify storefront exposes a genuine agent-native commerce surface: a canonical agents.md document, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a live hosted MCP endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp for agent-driven catalog search, cart, checkout and fulfillment, and Shopify Customer Account OpenID Connect for buyer identity. Checkout always requires explicit human buyer approval on payment.

providers.name: Almanac Health
providers.description: Almanac Health is a clinical AI company building a unified, evidence-grounded platform that delivers specialist-grade medical knowledge to clinicians at the point of care. Founded by physician-researcher Cyril Zakka, MD, whose Stanford work produced one of the first retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for clinical medicine, the platform consolidates the medical AI ecosystem into a single interface where healthcare workers reach a library of medical AI tools through an integrated LLM assistant. It is designed to run inside existing electronic health record (EHR) systems, operate under institutional governance and controls, and stay grounded in peer-reviewed evidence rather than unverified data or pharmaceutical advertising. Almanac Health raised a $10M seed round in April 2026 led by F-Prime with participation from General Catalyst (which led the pre-seed) and Lightspeed Venture Partners. The product is currently undergoing clinical validation in academic medical centers. This profile was surfaced from General Catalyst's portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Almanac Health does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
providers.description: USDA's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) protects the health and value of U.S. agriculture and natural resources by safeguarding against agricultural pests and diseases, ensuring the welfare of animals, and supporting sustainable agricultural practices. APHIS provides digital services including the eFile permitting system for import/export permits, the Agricultural Commodity Import Requirements (ACIR) portal, a geospatial hub for spatial analysis, data visualization tools, and open datasets via data.gov.

providers.name: Animoto
providers.description: Animoto is a cloud-based video creation platform, founded in 2006 and headquartered in New York City, that lets anyone turn photos, video clips, and music into professional-looking videos through a drag-and-drop web editor and a large library of customizable templates. It is widely used for marketing and social-media videos, e-commerce and product promos, slideshows, real-estate tours, and personal celebration videos, and is sold as a subscription SaaS product across free and paid tiers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of kindred-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a consumer/SMB web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Arkema
providers.description: Arkema S.A. is a French specialty materials company headquartered in La Defense, Paris and listed on Euronext Paris under ticker AKE. The group is organized around three Specialty Materials segments — Adhesive Solutions (anchored by the Bostik brand), Advanced Materials (high-performance polymers including Kynar PVDF, Rilsan polyamides, Pebax elastomers, Sartomer photocurable resins) and Coating Solutions (acrylic monomers, waterborne and solvent-borne resins, additives) — plus a smaller Intermediates business. Arkema employs roughly 21,000 people across 55 countries with about 154 production plants and 17 R&D centers, generating around EUR 9.1 billion in 2025 revenue. Strategy is anchored in materials science, decarbonization and a validated 1.5 degree SBTi pathway toward Net-Zero by 2050. Arkema does not publish a public developer portal or REST API; customer integrations and product data are exchanged through commercial sales channels, the Product Finder web UI and Safety Data Sheet downloads.

providers.name: Baton Market
providers.description: Baton Market (baton.com) is a modern online marketplace and technology-driven business brokerage for buying and selling small businesses. It combines self-serve business listings with M&A brokerage support, data-driven business valuations fueled by real financial data pulled from accounting systems, buyer discovery and matching, NDA and deal workflows, and closing support. The company positions itself as a lower-cost, faster alternative to traditional brokers, with the claim that most of its listings close at roughly half the cost of a conventional broker. Baton is backed by Bloomberg Beta. Baton Market has no publicly documented API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public web, identity, and security surface.

providers.name: Beatport
providers.description: Beatport is the leading online music store and streaming platform for electronic dance music DJs and producers, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Beatport sells high-quality downloads (lossless WAV, AIFF, and FLAC, plus AAC) of tracks, releases, and DJ tools across more than 150 electronic genres, and operates a subscription streaming tier — Beatport Streaming — that delivers catalog tracks directly into supported DJ applications and hardware including Pioneer DJ rekordbox, Serato DJ Pro, Denon DJ Engine DJ, Algoriddim djay, Virtual DJ, Traktor, and others through integration partners. The Beatport Group also operates Beatsource (open- format DJ streaming and download store), DJCity (open-format record pool), Beatport LINK and Beatsource LINK (in-app streaming for DJ software), BeatportAmp (distribution and rights management for labels, formerly Ampsuite), Plugin Boutique (audio software and plugin marketplace), Loopcloud (sample subscription for producers), Label Radar (demo submission), Beatport Live (live events and streaming), Beatportal (editorial and media), and the International Music Summit (IMS) industry conference. The company reports ten million registered users, eighty thousand labels, four hundred thousand artists, and four hundred million USD paid out to rights holders since launch. Beatport operates a v4 REST API at api.beatport.com governed by OAuth 2.0 (authorization-code grant) with an interactive Swagger-UI developer portal at /v4/docs/; access is gated to approved partners through the Beatport Partner Portal, and there is no public client-credentials tier for general developers. The API exposes the Beatport catalog (tracks, releases, artists, labels, genres, sub-genres, charts, playlists, my-beatport collections, holds, and DJ-oriented search filters such as BPM, key, and released-date) and is the same surface that powers the public beatport.com applications and third-party DJ-software integrations. Beatport does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI document, an official SDK, or a CLI; partner integration is brokered case-by-case through the Partner Portal and the business-development team.

providers.name: Beautiful Soup
providers.description: Beautiful Soup is a Python library for pulling data out of HTML and XML files, widely used for web scraping and screen scraping tasks. It provides a parse tree API with simple methods for navigating, searching, and modifying parsed HTML/XML documents. Beautiful Soup automatically handles encoding, supports multiple parsers (html.parser, lxml, html5lib), and integrates with CSS selectors via the Soup Sieve library. Current stable version is 4.14.3.

providers.name: BevSpot
providers.description: BevSpot is a Boston-based food and beverage inventory management platform for restaurants, bars, and hospitality groups. The web application streamlines back-of-house operations including inventory counting, ordering, invoice management, recipe and menu costing, and sales-driven analytics. BevSpot ingests point-of-sale data through integrations with more than a dozen POS systems (Toast, Square, Clover, Lightspeed, SpotOn, NCR Aloha, Upserve, Brink, Lavu, and others), plus accounting and vendor connections (QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Ottimate, Fintech, US Foods, Sysco). It is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. BevSpot does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, commercial, and security surface.

providers.name: Bikemap
providers.description: Bikemap is a Vienna-based cycling platform (backed by Speedinvest) offering a route planner, turn-by-turn bike navigation, and one of the world's largest communities of user-generated cycling routes across road, mountain, gravel, and e-bike riding. Riders plan routes in a web and mobile route editor, discover millions of community routes, record and share rides, download offline maps, and sync with Garmin, Wahoo, Apple Watch, and Wear OS devices. Bikemap operates a consumer product surface (web, iOS, Android) and does not publish a documented public developer API; this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Bloom & Wild
providers.description: Bloom & Wild is a British direct-to-consumer online florist and gifting brand founded in 2013 by Aron Gelbard and Ben Stanway, best known for pioneering letterbox flowers — bouquets packed flat so they fit through a UK letterbox — alongside hand-tied bouquets, plants, gift sets, gift cards and recurring flower subscriptions. Bloom & Wild Group trades as Bloom & Wild in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany and Austria, and operates the sister brands bloomon (Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark) and Bergamotte (France) on separate storefronts. The group is a certified B Corp and runs its own commerce platform — a Ruby on Rails backend fronted by Kong, an Angular multi-brand web app and native iOS and Android clients, on AWS and GCP. Bloom & Wild publishes NO public developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable API description, and no partner or corporate-gifting API: business and bulk gifting is transacted through a contact form, an account manager and invoicing, not through a programmatic surface. The application backends at api.bloomandwild.com and capi.bloomandwild.com are live but private to the brand's own clients and undocumented. What the group does publish for machines is narrow but real: an llms.txt on the UK and German storefronts that routes assistants to the correct market by delivery destination and even ships an optional agent widget specification, and an RFC 9116 security.txt served across every group storefront.

providers.name: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management
providers.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) manages the nation's offshore resources in an environmentally and economically responsible way. BOEM oversees the responsible development of U.S. Outer Continental Shelf energy and mineral resources while protecting the environment and conserving natural resources.

providers.name: Butn
providers.description: Butn is an Australian embedded-finance company that funds business cashflow at the point of transaction, plugging invoice finance, outsourced credit terms, and supplier "pay now, settle later" directly into the platforms its business customers already use. Its funding products — Butn X (invoice finance to draw cash early against receivables), Butn Terms (outsourced buyer credit where Butn carries the risk), and Butn Pay (paying suppliers upfront in exchange for extended repayment) — are designed to be embedded into partner marketplaces, accounting tools, and B2B platforms such as MYOB, Salesforce, and FoodByUs rather than sold as a standalone destination. Butn sits in the spend / accounts payable and accounts receivable financing layer of Australia's payments market, where money movement rides the New Payments Platform and the banks opened by the Consumer Data Right. Its integration and embedding are delivered through private, partner-provisioned APIs: Butn markets "plug and play" embedding for partners but does not operate a public self-serve developer portal, publish downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger definitions, or expose openly documented API reference material as of this profile.

providers.name: CAVA
providers.description: CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA) is a Washington, D.C.-headquartered Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant company that operates the CAVA brand, serving customizable bowls, pitas, salads and sides built on house-made dips, spreads and dressings. Alongside its restaurants CAVA runs a consumer packaged goods line sold in grocery stores, a digital ordering and delivery channel, a catering business at catering.cava.com, and the CAVA Rewards loyalty program delivered through its iOS and Android apps. The company listed on the New York Stock Exchange in June 2023 and reports an in-house technology program — CavaCore, its data platform, and CAVA Current, a restaurant operating system. CAVA publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its public machine-readable surface is limited to an RFC 9116 security.txt and a published llms.txt.

providers.name: Click Mechanic
providers.description: ClickMechanic is the UK's leading online car-repair marketplace, founded in 2012, that connects car owners with vetted mobile mechanics and independent garages for repairs, servicing, diagnostics, and MOTs. Customers enter their registration and symptoms to get an instant fixed-price quote, then book a vetted mechanic for same- or next-day work at home or the roadside, with payment taken only after the job is completed. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. ClickMechanic operates a consumer- and mechanic-facing web platform (Ruby on Rails on Heroku) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API catalog at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Connexion
providers.description: Connexion is an open source Python framework that automatically handles HTTP requests based on OpenAPI specifications. Connexion 3 provides AsyncApp, FlaskApp, and ConnexionMiddleware as primary entry points, with built-in routing, request and response validation, parameter parsing, security enforcement, content negotiation, error handling, lifespan, and Swagger UI integration.
