Connexion takes a contract-first, design-first approach: the OpenAPI specification is the source of truth and Python handlers are resolved from operationId or via configurable resolvers.

providers.name: Crawlee
providers.description: Crawlee is an open-source web scraping and crawling library maintained by Apify, providing a unified set of crawler classes, request queues, datasets, and key-value stores for building reliable scrapers. It is available for both JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js) and Python, offering HTTP, Cheerio, JSDOM, LinkeDOM, Puppeteer, Playwright, and Stagehand crawler implementations along with proxy and session management utilities for production-grade scraping.

providers.name: Credi2
providers.description: Credi2 GmbH is a Vienna, Austria based fintech that operates a white-label, cloud-native embedded lending platform enabling banks, card issuers, and merchants to launch Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and installment financing products under their own brand. The modular platform covers five financing products - pay per invoice (14-day BNPL), split pay (3-12 month installments up to EUR 5,000), installment loans (up to EUR 50,000 over 84 months), revolving credit lines, and subscription financing - and handles the full lifecycle including core banking operations, credit and risk management, servicing, and collections. Use cases span eCommerce and point-of-sale financing, subscription payments, installment-on-cards, and cash loans, with omni-channel integration and go-live in weeks. Credi2 is ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified and is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: depthfirst
providers.description: depthfirst is an applied AI lab building an autonomous application security platform that protects software from design through production. Its General Security Intelligence platform builds context across a company's code, infrastructure, and business logic to detect complex vulnerabilities, cut false positives, and generate merge-ready fixes. Product surfaces include a code scanner, dependency firewall, secrets detection, supply-chain mapping, and agentic pentesting, alongside in-house security models such as dfs-mini1. Backed by Accel, Meritech Capital, Forerunner Ventures, and The House Fund, depthfirst works with companies including ClickUp, Lovable, Supabase, incident.io, and Moveworks.

providers.name: Docusaurus
providers.description: Docusaurus is an open-source static site generator built by Meta for creating documentation websites. Powered by React, it supports MDX, versioning, internationalization, search, and a plugin ecosystem, making it a popular choice for open-source project documentation and developer portals.

providers.name: Ebrandvalue
providers.description: eBrandValue is a brand intelligence and social media analytics platform that converts real-time social data into actionable marketing metrics. It measures brand mindshare, tracks competitive market-share fluctuations, predicts sales weeks in advance, surfaces influencers and effective marketing tactics, and provides crisis and reputation support. The product is delivered as a SaaS web dashboard with one-click export of data and visualizations for reports and presentations. eBrandValue does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or client SDKs; access is through the hosted application. Clients include major consumer brands and financial institutions.

providers.name: Epicor
providers.description: Epicor Software Corporation provides industry-specific enterprise resource planning software for manufacturing, distribution, retail, and service industries. Epicor Kinetic, the flagship ERP platform, exposes an Open REST API built on OData v4 that gives developers service-based access to all business objects, processes, reports, BAQs, and Epicor Functions using standard HTTP methods and API key authentication.

providers.name: Ergeon
providers.description: Ergeon is a nationwide outdoor residential construction company that installs fencing (wood, vinyl, metal, and chain-link), artificial grass, wooden decks, and concrete driveways, patios, and walkways. It pairs a distributed workforce with technology — live video estimates, a 3D fence-quoting calculator at fencequoting.com, satellite site-plan tooling, and a customer portal — to deliver fast, accurate quotes plus managed installation with permit handling, financing (Wisetack), and workmanship warranties. Ergeon runs internal software and vendor integrations (Stripe, Twilio, Talkdesk, AWS, Lob) but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, status, and open-source surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Escale
providers.description: Escale is a Sao Paulo-based sales technology company founded in 2013 that builds aisa, an AI sales agent trained on millions of real sales conversations. aisa automates lead qualification, objection handling, deal personalization, and sales closure across text and voice channels for enterprise brands in financial services, banking, telecommunications, automotive finance, and education. Escale manages the full customer-acquisition funnel from demand generation through closing, having processed over 7 million leads and generated more than R$2.1 billion in GMV. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its corporate identity, trust/compliance posture, and legal properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: EZLynx
providers.description: EZLynx is an insurance agency platform combining real-time comparative rating, an agency management system (AMS), and CRM for independent property and casualty (P&C) insurance agencies. Part of Applied Systems since 2021, EZLynx offers enterprise API solutions that let agencies push and pull data, create and update applicants, contacts, prospects, and opportunities, create policy headers, retrieve policy and quote-result data, and drive high-volume automated quoting through the EZLynx Rating Engine and Quoting Automation Services (QAS). An event-driven layer emits webhooks in XML or JSON for platform changes. API access is partner and enterprise-gated (contact sales, OAuth 2.0), not a public self-serve developer program, so the API surface below is honestly modeled from EZLynx's public product and integration material rather than a published open reference.

providers.name: Farmers Business Network
providers.description: Farmers Business Network (FBN) is a direct-to-farmer ag platform combining a member network, e-commerce for crop inputs (seed, chemistry, animal health), agronomy and precision analytics, financing and crop insurance, and a sustainability / Scope-3 program (Gradable). FBN Analytics ingests precision data from 60+ monitor types and integrates with John Deere Operations Center and CNH AFS Connect to pull machine, planting, application, and harvest data into the FBN platform. FBN is a Field to Market Qualified Data Management Partner via the Fieldprint API. FBN does not publish a public developer portal; partner integrations are arranged directly.

providers.name: FieldEdge
providers.description: FieldEdge is field service management (FSM) software for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other home- and commercial-services contractors, owned by Xplor Technologies (branded "FieldEdge by Xplor"). It provides customer management, dispatching and scheduling, work orders, a technician mobile app, flat-rate pricebook, service agreements, invoicing and payments, and QuickBooks accounting sync. FieldEdge operates a partner-gated API delivered through an Azure API Management developer portal (docs.api.fieldedge.com); API products and keys are restricted to approved integration partners rather than being openly self-serve. The logical APIs listed here are honestly modeled from FieldEdge's documented product modules and its partner/integration surface - endpoint paths are modeled, not copied from a published public reference, because the reference and OpenAPI live behind the partner portal sign-in.

providers.name: Findem
providers.description: Findem is an AI Talent Intelligence platform that blends assistive AI for sourcing, marketing, executive search, and analytics with agentic AI workers for intelligent job posting, application boost, screening, and scheduling. The company also exposes Embedded AI building blocks (AI Job Board, Sourcing Copilot, Labeling Engine, Agents, and MCP) for partners to ship branded AI hiring experiences. Findem is sold enterprise-direct; ATS, HRIS, and partner integrations are gated rather than offered through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: FreeWill
providers.description: FreeWill is an online estate-planning platform that lets people create legal documents for free, including last wills, revocable living trusts (California only), advance healthcare directives, financial powers of attorney, and beneficiary designations, through a guided questionnaire. It runs a dual model: individuals use the tools at no cost, while more than 2,400 nonprofit organizations partner with FreeWill for planned-giving and legacy-gift features. Related surfaces include the Estately advisor platform and a Nonprofit Solutions offering. FreeWill was surfaced as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital and qed-investors. Enrichment found no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or API documentation — this profile is a consumer/nonprofit company record, not an API producer, with security and legal properties captured from the public site.

providers.name: GetGoing
providers.description: GetGoing is a cloud-based corporate travel and expense (T&E) management platform for small and midsize businesses, built and operated by BCD Travel. It combines self-service booking of flights, hotels, rental cars and rail with automated travel and expense policy enforcement, pre-trip approval flows, streamlined payments and invoicing, traveler safety and duty-of-care, and analytics dashboards in a single product that can be implemented in under two hours. GetGoing pairs the digital self-service experience with BCD Travel's global travel-management expertise and support, and is offered across the United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Belgium. GetGoing does not publish a first-party public developer API; programmatic travel integration is provided by the separate, authorization-gated BCD Travel Developer Hub.

providers.name: Getground
providers.description: GetGround is a London-based property investment platform that lets UK and international buy-to-let investors set up and run their rental businesses through a limited company. The all-in-one platform handles limited company formation, business bank accounts, accounting and tax filing (including Making Tax Digital), bookkeeping, buy-to-let mortgages, landlord insurance, tenant finding, and sourcing of investment properties. GetGround is backed by QED Investors and offers subscription tiers and launch packs for landlords managing single or multiple rental properties.

providers.name: Graylog
providers.description: Graylog is an open source log management platform for collecting, indexing, and analyzing log data with alerting and dashboard capabilities.

providers.name: Halter
providers.description: Halter is a New Zealand-founded agri-technology company that builds GPS-enabled, solar-powered smart collars for cattle paired with a mobile and web app, letting farmers set and move virtual fences, remotely shift and hold herds, and monitor animal location, behavior, heat and health without physical fencing or manual labor. The platform combines wearable IoT devices (including direct-to-satellite connectivity) with pasture-management and grazing-allocation tools for dairy and beef operations. Halter operates across New Zealand, Australia and the United States and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Bond Capital and DCVC. No public developer API surface has been identified; this profile captures the company identity, web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: HelloVerify
providers.description: HelloVerify is India's leading background verification (BGV) and employee screening company, delivering fast, accurate, and compliant primary-source verification for employment, education, healthcare credentialing, immigration, and enterprise workforce programs. The platform has completed 20M+ verifications for 2000+ organizations across 120+ countries, offering AI-powered background checks, customer KYC with identity and liveness, vendor due diligence (Certifier), and instant messaging-based verification (HelloV). HelloVerify operates an audited information-security and compliance program (ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, Cyber Essentials, GDPR) and serves regulators, enterprises, SMBs, and applicants worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network as a dcvc portfolio company; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Indinero
providers.description: Indinero is a Finance-as-a-Service (FaaS) provider that combines professional accountants, tax experts, and fractional CFOs with AI-accelerated workflows to deliver outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, business tax preparation, payroll, 409A valuations, and on-demand financial support. Founded in 2009 and backed by 500 Global, the company serves startups through $500M+ revenue businesses across technology, SaaS, ecommerce, healthcare, construction, crypto, professional services, and non-profits, integrating primarily with QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. Indinero is SOC 2 compliant and delivers its services through a client portal (the indinero Exchange) rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Kace
providers.description: KACE is the endpoint and systems management product line from Quest Software, originally founded in 2003 as KACE Networks (backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Sigma Partners, and Focus Ventures), acquired by Dell in 2010, and now sold as Quest KACE. The portfolio centers on the KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) for inventory, patching, software distribution, scripting, and service desk; the KACE Systems Deployment Appliance (SDA) for OS imaging and provisioning; and KACE Cloud for mobile device management and modern endpoint management. The KACE SMA ships a REST API (JSON and XML) that lets administrators programmatically manage assets, inventory, managed installations, scripting, users, and service-desk tickets on the customer-hosted appliance. This profile enriches the original Norwest portfolio lead with the real Quest KACE identity and its documented API surface.

providers.name: Kafene
providers.description: Kafene is a New York-based point-of-sale financing platform that lets retailers offer transparent lease-to-own (LTO) purchase options to prime and non-prime consumers. Founded in 2019 by Neal Desai and James Schuler, the company underwrites shoppers with an AI-driven risk model that pulls 20,000+ data points to return an approval — up to $5,000 — in seconds, then pays the merchant directly on delivery confirmation while the customer pays weekly or biweekly until ownership. Merchants originate applications from their in-store POS or by sending a text-to-apply link; consumers manage leases and payments in a self-service dashboard. Kafene raised a ~$31M Series B and reaches merchants through financing-waterfall networks such as Versatile Credit and LendPro. As of the 2026-08-01 enrichment probe Kafene publishes no public developer program, no OpenAPI/GraphQL/MCP contract, no SDKs, and no /.well-known discovery surface; its merchant and consumer surfaces are authenticated single-page web applications and integration is arranged through Kafene's partner team, not self-serve documentation.

providers.name: Kita Bisa
providers.description: Kitabisa is Indonesia's largest donation-based crowdfunding and mutual-aid platform, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jakarta. It lets individuals, nonprofits, and corporations raise and give funds transparently for medical causes, disaster relief, education, and community development, and operates a dedicated Islamic-philanthropy surface for zakat, wakaf, and qurban. The group has grown beyond crowdfunding into digital fundraising services for NGOs (ngo.kitabisa.com), a CSR and social-marketing practice for corporate partners (csr.kitabisa.com), a cooperative, and the SalingJaga mutual-protection and insurance product. Kitabisa publishes no public API or developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on any Kitabisa surface, and partner integrations are arranged through business channels. It does run a substantial first-party open source estate of 75 public Go, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions repositories, plus a public responsible-disclosure program backed by an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: La Haus
providers.description: La Haus is a Latin American proptech company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Medellín and Bogotá, Colombia, that operates the residential real-estate marketplaces lahaus.com (Colombia) and lahaus.mx (Mexico) together with an in-house brokerage. The platform lists de-duplicated, verified new-construction and resale housing from vetted developers, adds mortgage and down-payment simulators, buyer guides and an AI assistant, and takes buyers through negotiation and closing at no cost to the buyer. It has raised more than $135M in equity plus debt facilities from Kaszek, NFX, Acrew Capital, Greenspring Associates, SoftBank and Bezos Expeditions. La Haus publishes NO public developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract: the consumer sites are server-rendered applications whose /api/* paths are disallowed in robots.txt, and api.lahaus.com is a private AWS API Gateway that answers every anonymous request with MissingAuthenticationToken. Partner/portal syndication runs through access-controlled marketing feed integrations (Trovit). This profile therefore records the company's public web surface and security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Lawn Love
providers.description: Lawn Love is an on-demand lawn care and outdoor home services marketplace that matches homeowners with vetted, independent lawn care professionals across more than 120 US cities. Customers get instant online quotes and book mowing, fertilization, aeration, seeding, pre-emergent and general weed control, bush trimming, leaf removal, gutter cleaning, yard clean-up and snow removal, on either pay-as-you-go or recurring schedules, and manage jobs through the my.lawnlove.com customer app and iOS/Android apps; providers take and service work through pros.lawnlove.com and the Lawn Love for Providers apps. Lawn Love operates as part of LawnStarter. It publishes no public developer API, no developer portal and no API documentation - the api.lawnlove.com host is an undocumented, noindexed backend serving its own web and mobile clients.

providers.name: Leah
providers.description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi and legally ContractPod Technologies Limited, is a London-headquartered enterprise agentic AI company that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, procurement, and finance operations into a single autonomous system. Its Leah Agentic OS platform provides skills-based orchestration, agentic workflows, a natural-language app builder, a library of domain-specific legal, contracting, procurement, and finance agents, and the Leah Maestro enterprise orchestrator. Leah is a five-time Gartner CLM Visionary, is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and is used by enterprises including PwC, KPMG, Philips, Alaska Airlines, MUFG, and Cushman & Wakefield. Leah ships pre-built connectors and describes open REST APIs for enterprise integration, but maintains no public developer portal or published API reference — API access is unlocked through the enterprise contract.

providers.name: Magnific
providers.description: Magnific is a Spanish AI image enhancement startup, founded in 2023 by Javi Lopez and Emilio Nicolas, best known for its AI image upscaler and enhancer that hallucinates believable new detail at higher resolutions. The product line expanded from the original Upscaler into Relight (AI-driven scene relighting), Structure (compose-from-sketch), Style Transfer, Mystic (text-to-image), and Fluffy (consistent characters). Magnific was acquired by Freepik in May 2024 and continues to operate under the Magnific brand while powering Freepik's image enhancement surface. There is no publicly documented developer API for Magnific itself; access is via the web application at magnific.ai (now magnific.com) and through the Freepik AI suite, where related image generation and upscaling capabilities are exposed via the Freepik API. Customer support is handled through an Intercom-backed help center and the founders maintain a high-visibility presence on X/Twitter.

providers.name: Merbridge
providers.description: Merbridge is an open source, eBPF-based service mesh acceleration tool that replaces iptables rules with eBPF traffic interception and uses msg_redirect to shorten the datapath between sidecars and services. It is a CNCF Sandbox project and supports Istio, Linkerd2, and Kuma.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Mitchell 1
providers.description: Mitchell 1 is a division of Snap-on Incorporated providing repair information (ProDemand, TruckSeries) and shop management software (Manager SE, SocialCRM) to independent auto repair shops. Mitchell 1 is a legacy enterprise software provider, not an API-first company - it has no public, self-serve REST API reference. It does operate a gated Web-Intent / Data API integration program for approved third-party partners (shop management systems, CRM, parts and marketing platforms) to embed or link into ProDemand labor, parts, and maintenance data, fronted by a token-based (TAPE) auth flow and an Intent Registry discovery service. Access requires submitting an integration request, a Mitchell 1 review (roughly two weeks), and a signed partner agreement; no public API reference, OpenAPI document, or SDK is published. Note - Mitchell 1 (mitchell1.com, Snap-on) is a distinct company from Mitchell International (mitchell.com, part of Enlyte) - the two share a historical "Mitchell" lineage but are separately owned; Mitchell International's public developer.mitchell.com RepairCenter API belongs to the other company and is out of scope here.

providers.name: Mosaic Manufacturing
providers.description: Mosaic Manufacturing is a Toronto-based additive manufacturing company building automated, high-volume FFF 3D printing systems for factory-floor production of end-use polymer parts. Its flagship Array platform combines integrated robotics, intelligent scheduling software, and high-performance fused-filament-fabrication printers so manufacturers can cut part costs and run true production at scale. Mosaic also makes the Palette line of multi-material hardware and Canvas (canvas3d.io), a cloud/web software platform for file preparation, color/slice, print scheduling, and fleet management. As of this enrichment pass Mosaic publishes no public product API or OpenAPI-described developer surface; its developer-facing presence is the open-source MosaicManufacturing GitHub organization (3MF tooling, slicer post-processing, and firmware) plus a hosted support/knowledge-base portal.

providers.name: MyHeritage
providers.description: MyHeritage is an online genealogy and consumer DNA platform that lets families build and explore their family trees, take at-home DNA tests for ancestry and genetic ethnicity, and search more than 40 billion historical records for genealogy research. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Israel, the company also offers photo tools such as colorization, enhancement and the AI-based Deep Nostalgia animation feature, alongside DNA matching that connects relatives worldwide. MyHeritage previously operated a public FamilyGraph developer API, but that program has been retired: the developers.myheritage.com and developer.myheritage.com hosts now 301-redirect to the company homepage and familygraph.com no longer resolves to documentation, so there is no current public API surface to catalog. This profile therefore captures the company identity and its published web properties.

providers.name: NGINX Service Mesh
providers.description: NGINX Service Mesh (NSM) is a service mesh from F5 NGINX powered by NGINX Plus, designed to manage container-to-container traffic in Kubernetes environments. It provides mTLS, traffic policies via the Service Mesh Interface (SMI), traffic splitting, rate limiting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger), and integration with NGINX Plus Ingress Controller. NGINX Service Mesh exposes a control-plane REST API and a `nginx-meshctl` CLI for installation, sidecar injection, certificate management, and policy configuration. The upstream GitHub repository is archived; F5 announced End of Sale (EoS) for the NGINX Microservices Bundle as of July 1, 2023, and the project's successor for ingress and L7 routing is NGINX Gateway Fabric.

providers.name: Nu (Nubank)
providers.description: Nu Holdings (Nubank) is Latin America's largest digital bank, with tens of millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Its core product surface - credit card, account, lending, investments, and insurance - is consumer-facing through the Nu mobile app, and Nubank does not publish a general-purpose public developer portal. Nubank participates in Brazil's Open Finance (Open Banking Brasil) regime, which standardises consent-driven access to account, transaction, and payment-initiation APIs for authorised third parties; Nubank's Open Finance endpoints are registered with the Brazilian Central Bank's directory. For merchant acceptance, Nubank operates NuPay for Business, a REST API for checkout payments, refunds, OAuth2/CIBA-based authorization, beneficiary management, and webhook event notifications, hosted at api.spinpay.com.br.

providers.name: Parallel Universe
providers.description: Parallel Universe Inc. (Parallel Studios) is the Toronto-based game studio behind Parallel, a free-to-play sci-fi trading card game, and the broader Parallel Universe franchise that includes Colony, an AI agent simulation game, and Sanctuary, a third-person extraction shooter. The studio anchors the Echelon Prime web3 gaming ecosystem, where players truly own their cards and in-game items as blockchain assets and the PRIME token powers governance and rewards. Backed by a16z (Andreessen Horowitz) and Paradigm, Parallel is a consumer game franchise distributed via the web, Epic Games, Steam, the Apple App Store, and Google Play. It publishes no public developer / REST API surface today; this profile captures the studio's public web, community, and legal properties as harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Picnicai
providers.description: PicnicHealth (PicnicAI; legally Mission Health Labs, Inc.) is a San Francisco health-data company and Y Combinator alum (S14, founded 2014) that turns patients' fragmented medical records into structured, research-ready real-world datasets. Its consumer product gives patients a unified timeline of care across every provider, while PicnicResearch supplies de-identified, ontology-mapped (RxNorm, SNOMED, LOINC, ICD) real-world data to biopharma via AI extraction plus human clinical curation. The primary developer surface is a first-party R package distributed through PicnicHealth's own Posit/RStudio Package Manager for importing and visualizing research cohorts.

providers.name: Postcron
providers.description: Postcron is a social media scheduling and publishing tool that lets marketers, agencies, and small businesses plan, schedule, and automatically publish content across Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok from a single dashboard. It supports bulk uploading up to 1,000 posts from Excel or Google Docs, multi-account and team management, automatic image watermarking, a browser extension, and mobile apps for iOS and Android. Originally a Y Combinator / 500 Global-backed startup, Postcron is a consumer- and SMB-facing publishing product; it exposes an internal application API used by its own clients but does not publish a documented public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: Presentations.ai
providers.description: Presentations.ai is an AI-powered presentation platform that turns ideas, documents, and data into professional, on-brand slide decks in minutes and exports fully editable PowerPoint files. The product markets programmatic deck generation via a REST API and webhooks, no-code Zapier and Make connectors, white-label embedding, and data-source connections to Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Snowflake, and 50+ others, though it publishes no public developer documentation or API reference. Backed by Accel, the company operates under Singapore terms of service.

providers.name: Railinc
providers.description: Railinc, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Association of American Railroads, delivers IT and information services to the North American freight rail industry. Railinc's suite of APIs empowers customers to simplify and automate business processes essential to the lifecycle of freight rail operations.

providers.name: ReadSpeaker
providers.description: ReadSpeaker provides text-to-speech (TTS) cloud and embedded solutions used to add voice to websites, mobile apps, e-learning, transportation systems, and more. The speechCloud API converts text into high-quality audio in multiple languages and voices that can be returned in formats such as MP3 for use within applications.

providers.name: Relay
providers.description: Relay is an online business banking and cash-flow management platform for small and medium-sized businesses, offering up to 20-50 checking accounts, virtual and physical Visa debit/credit cards, accounts payable and bill pay, and one-way data integrations with accounting and payroll tools such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Gusto. Banking services are provided by Thread Bank, Member FDIC. Relay does not publish a public developer API; the surfaces below are product features and inbound integrations rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: Satago
providers.description: Satago is a UK financial-technology platform offering a three-in-one cash flow management solution for small and medium-sized businesses: Risk Insights (real-time credit checks, risk bands, and suggested credit limits), Credit Control (automated invoice chasing with customizable email and SMS reminder sequences, statements, and late-fee handling), and Invoice Finance (fast, flexible funding with advance rates up to 90% on single or multiple invoices, offered as both selective and full facilities). The platform synchronizes with 300+ accounting packages including Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, KashFlow, and FreeAgent to keep debtor data current. Satago sells to businesses directly and through partners; it does not currently publish a public developer API, consuming the accounting platforms' APIs rather than exposing its own.

providers.name: Savant
providers.description: Savant (heysavant.com) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an operational memory layer for AI-native enterprises. It integrates with existing company tools such as Slack, Salesforce, and Google Workspace to capture both documented and undocumented operational knowledge, including procedures, exceptions, judgment calls, and edge cases, then structures that knowledge and serves it to employees and AI agents at critical decision moments. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco by Anthony Kim (CEO) and Kevin Yu (CTO), Savant positions itself as the company brain that every AI-native enterprise runs on. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, product guides, a changelog, a status page, and support and legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API reference surface.

providers.name: ShapeCI
providers.description: ShapeCI is software for industrials — a next-generation PDM (product data management) platform enabled by modern version control that helps hardware enterprises go from design to start of production in weeks rather than years. It brings a Git-style workflow to hardware and CAD: teams and projects hold design files under version control with merge requests, documents, and the ability to review 3D models in-browser and auto-sync engineering knowledge with the model-base. A desktop Connector application lets engineers clone a project, create workstreams, and publish or sync changes. ShapeCI is currently an invite-only beta and does not publish a public developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Slidebean
providers.description: Slidebean is a pitch deck and financial modeling platform for startup founders. It combines AI-powered presentation software that auto-designs investor-ready slides with professional pitch deck design services and financial modeling assistance for fundraising. Founders use Slidebean to build, refine, and share pitch decks, model their startup finances, and prepare for investor conversations. As of this enrichment pass Slidebean operates as a consumer/SMB SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; its GitHub organization contains only forks and small internal JavaScript utilities.

providers.name: Songtrust
providers.description: Songtrust is a New York City-based music publishing administration platform and a Downtown Music company. The service helps songwriters, producers, composers, and independent publishers register their compositions and collect global publishing royalties — including performance, mechanical, digital, micro-sync, and neighboring rights — through a network of 65+ collection societies and pay sources across 240 countries and territories. Songtrust's web-based dashboard provides song registration, catalog management, writer and publisher splits, royalty statement matching, metadata enrichment, weekly song monitoring, and quarterly payouts, while letting clients retain 100% ownership of their copyrights. The commercial model is a one-time $100 sign-up fee per songwriter plus 15% of collected performance royalties and 20% of non-performance royalties — positioned as a transparent flat-rate alternative to traditional publisher deals. As of this profile, Songtrust does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or partner integration portal; the platform is consumed exclusively through the Songtrust client dashboard at app.songtrust.com. Integrations and data exchange with PROs, mechanical rights societies, DSPs, and Downtown sister companies are operated internally rather than through a documented public surface.

providers.name: Squire
providers.description: Squire is a barbershop management software platform that gives barbers and shop owners the tools to run their business: online booking and scheduling, client management and loyalty, integrated payment processing with same-day deposits, a custom-branded client mobile app, point-of-sale, inventory and business analytics. Booking is surfaced through Google, Instagram and Squire's own consumer channels. Squire operates as a closed SaaS product with login-gated web and mobile applications; no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or partner/integration program is published as of this profile. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of CRV, ICONIQ Capital and Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: STORI AI Inc.
providers.description: STORI AI is a San Francisco-based AI content-marketing platform that helps brands define their identity — archetype, tone, tagline, and colors — and turn that identity into on-brand social posts, graphics, images, videos, and go-to-market marketing materials. The product generates personalized branded content, schedules and publishes it across digital platforms, and offers analytics, content storage, and multi-brand, multi-language, team-collaboration tiers. A Product Hunt Golden Kitty Award recipient, STORI AI is a web SaaS application for marketers and brand teams; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Symbiotic
providers.description: Symbiotic is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of paradigm and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto-defi. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Telewerken
providers.description: Telewerken.be is a Belgian information platform dedicated to remote work (telewerken), operated jointly by Vias Institute and the FOD Mobiliteit en Vervoer (Federal Public Service for Mobility and Transport). The platform provides comprehensive resources on Belgian telework legislation, regulations, employer obligations, employee rights, and telework statistics. Belgium's remote work framework is governed by Collective Bargaining Agreement No. 85 (CBA 85) and the Law of 5 March 2017 on feasible and workable work. The platform serves both employers and employees navigating Belgium's structured telework policy landscape.

providers.name: Textla Inc.
providers.description: Textla is a business texting platform for sending bulk SMS marketing campaigns and two-way conversational messages to customers. It provides contact list segmentation, message scheduling and personalization, a shared team inbox for direct/two-way replies, contact management with CSV import, and real-time delivery verification and analytics, backed by US-based human support via phone, email, and live chat. The company promotes low per-message rates and reports 2B+ messages sent for 21K+ businesses. Textla is a Zapier partner for no-code automation; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: The Business of Fashion
providers.description: The Business of Fashion (BoF) is an authoritative digital media and intelligence company founded by Imran Amed in 2007, serving the global fashion and luxury industry. It publishes news, analysis, case studies and industry data, and operates subscription products including BoF Professional membership, BoF Insights research reports, events and online courses. Backed by Index Ventures. BoF publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, subscription and legal surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: The Honest Company
providers.description: The Honest Company is a consumer-goods brand selling baby, personal-care, beauty, and household products through its direct-to-consumer storefront at honest.com and through major retailers. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of iconiq-capital, ivp, and lightspeed-venture-partners. The honest.com storefront runs on Shopify and does not publish a first-party developer API; the only machine-readable API surface discoverable on the domain is Shopify's Customer Account API (OIDC/OAuth2) advertised via the store's /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile captures that authentication surface, the domain security posture, and the storefront's public web properties.

providers.name: TopKey
providers.description: TopKey is an AI-powered financial operating system purpose-built for professional short-term rental, vacation rental, and long-term rental property managers running 50-5,000+ units. It automates property-level and owner-level expense management, corporate and bring-your-own cards (BYOC), bill pay / AP, banking through partner banks (Thread Bank, Member FDIC), AI-assisted accounting, inventory, invoicing, work-order expense tracking, and revenue reconciliation. TopKey integrates deeply with property management systems (Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Streamline, Track, Hostfully) and accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite). Backed by a16z and Felicis. TopKey consumes partner APIs for its integrations but does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time; it ships a product help center and a machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Upstream
providers.description: Upstream is a no-code, full-stack platform for launching and operating DAOs (decentralized autonomous organizations), letting communities create a DAO with a Gnosis multi-signature wallet, DAO contract, and vote delegation contract without technical experience. The platform blends on-chain smart contracts (built on OpenZeppelin, audited by Upshield) with off-chain forums, proposals, polls, and events, and maintains the open-source Fortuna service that indexes ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 transfer events on Ethereum. Upstream is backed by Bloomberg Beta. The company does not currently publish a public developer API; its backend at api.upstreamapp.com is undocumented and product documentation lives at guide.upstreamapp.com.

providers.name: UrbanCompany
providers.description: Urban Company (formerly UrbanClap) is an on-demand home services marketplace that connects customers with trained, hand-picked service professionals for beauty and salon services, cleaning, appliance repair, plumbing, electrical work, painting, and pest control. The Accel-backed platform operates across 40+ cities in India as well as the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Singapore, and is delivered through its website and mobile apps. Urban Company does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: VanMoof
providers.description: VanMoof is an Amsterdam-based e-bike company that designs and sells smart electric city bikes with integrated anti-theft technology, GPS tracking, and a companion rider app. Originally backed by Balderton Capital and relaunched after its 2023 restructuring, VanMoof operates a connected-bike platform, but publishes no public developer API — the app and bike APIs are private, and existing client libraries are community-built and reverse-engineered.

providers.name: Verdant
providers.description: Verdant is an AI-native land-use permitting and planning software platform for local governments, spanning the entire process from a resident's first question through plan review to a commission's final vote. Applicants file complete, compliant applications upfront, and Verdant's AI reads documents, site plans, and diagrams to flag issues and draft staff review reports that municipal staff can approve. The platform is modular, letting jurisdictions buy only the modules they need, configured to their ordinances, workflows, and forms, and includes ordinance-research tooling to benchmark against peer jurisdictions and find gaps in local codes. Verdant is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company; it currently ships an application product for cities and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Weis Markets
providers.description: Weis Markets is a regional supermarket chain operating grocery stores in the mid-Atlantic United States, with 197 store locations across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, and West Virginia. The company operates a digital commerce platform, loyalty rewards program (Weis Rewards), mobile app, and vendor/supplier integration ecosystem using EDI and supply chain APIs. Weis Markets uses Toshiba ELERA commerce platform for unified in-store and online commerce.

providers.name: Wireshark
providers.description: Wireshark is the world's foremost and widely-used free and open-source network protocol analyzer. It lets you capture and interactively browse the traffic running on a computer network. Wireshark provides a powerful dissector framework with a Lua scripting API, C/C++ plugin architecture, TShark command-line tools, and the libwireshark library for developers building network analysis tools.

providers.name: XtGem
providers.description: XtGem is a visual mobile website builder operated by UAB XtGem of Vilnius, Lithuania, letting anyone build and host mobile sites on *.xtgem.com subdomains (10 million+ sites hosted) with a drag-and-drop builder, file hosting, community blocks (forums, blogs, guestbooks), and the XtScript templating language. XtGem publishes no public developer API, webhooks, or SDKs; its GitHub organization ships the open-source XtFramework PHP framework.

providers.name: Ziro
providers.description: Zíro (somosziro.com) is a Colombian fintech that provides interest-free credit for small retailers in the traditional commerce channel. Its platform lets distributors and manufacturers extend "crédito sin intereses" to the small shops they supply, while the supplier receives guaranteed payment and Zíro assumes the credit risk. The service bundles identity verification (Colombian cédula), automated credit evaluation, and fraud prevention into the ordering flow. Zíro is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a public marketing site and a customer-facing credit application (an Angular SPA at creditos.somosziro.com); no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server was found. The api.somosziro.com host exists but responds 403 (internal, not publicly documented).

providers.name: API Blueprint
providers.description: API Blueprint is a high-level API description language using Markdown-based syntax for designing, documenting, and prototyping web APIs. Created by Apiary and released under the MIT License, API Blueprint uses .apib files with a concise Markdown format that makes APIs accessible to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The project is no longer actively maintained (all apiaryio GitHub repos are archived as of 2024) but remains a notable specification in API design history, influencing later formats like OpenAPI.

providers.name: Arch Coal
providers.description: Arch Coal was a St. Louis-based producer and marketer of metallurgical and thermal coal, renamed Arch Resources in 2020. In January 2025 Arch Resources merged with CONSOL Energy in a merger of equals to form Core Natural Resources, Inc. (NYSE: CNR), headquartered in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania. The combined company operates the Pennsylvania Mining Complex, Leer, Leer South, West Elk, Black Thunder, and other mines across six U.S. states with 5,000+ employees, and holds stakes in East Coast marine export terminals. Core Natural Resources does not publish a public developer API. Its external digital surface is a corporate website at corenaturalresources.com plus a separate investor relations portal, both serving HTML and PDF only — the investor portal's /rss and /feed paths were probed on 2026-07-25 and every one returns HTML, not XML. Machine-readable company data is available only through third-party channels, namely the SEC's own EDGAR APIs.

providers.name: Attivo Networks (SentinelOne)
providers.description: Attivo Networks was a pioneer in identity threat detection and response (ITDR), cyber deception, and Active Directory attack protection. SentinelOne acquired Attivo Networks in 2022 and folded its technology into SentinelOne Singularity Identity, part of the AI-powered Singularity security platform spanning endpoint (EDR/XDR), identity, and cloud security. There is no standalone public Attivo API; programmatic access is delivered through the SentinelOne management console REST API (v2.1), which is scoped to a customer's console URL rather than a public developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the combined entity's public security, trust, disclosure, and compliance surface: a published RFC 9116 security.txt, a HackerOne-hosted bug bounty, and a SafeBase trust center carrying SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018, FedRAMP, and TX-RAMP certifications.

providers.name: Auto-Owners Insurance
providers.description: Auto-Owners Insurance is a mutual insurance company headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, offering auto, home, life, business, and farm insurance products through a network of independent agents. Founded in 1916, the company is consistently rated among the top mutual insurance companies in the United States. Auto-Owners provides online account management, claims filing, and agent portal services but does not currently offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Ava
providers.description: Ava is a consumer financial-technology company that helps people build credit and reduce the cost of debt. Its products include the Ava Credit Builder Mastercard (a no-interest card usable at approved subscription merchants), a Save & Build secured savings loan, and rent and utility payment reporting to the three major U.S. credit bureaus (TransUnion, Equifax, Experian). Ava operates as a mobile app on a subscription model and partners with regulated banks and lenders (including Patriot Bank, N.A. and Pier Lending) to deliver its products. This profile was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Ava is a consumer app and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Bamboo Health
providers.description: Bamboo Health (formerly Appriss Health + PatientPing) is a healthcare technology company delivering Real-Time Care Intelligence across the physical and behavioral health continuum. It operates one of the nation's largest care-collaboration networks, connecting health systems, health plans, pharmacies, and state agencies through prescription drug monitoring (PDMP), care coordination, and behavioral healthcare navigation. Flagship solutions include Bamboo Bridge, OpenBeds, Pings, NarxCare, and the PMP AWARxE state monitoring platform. Backed by Insight Partners, the company supports over a billion patient encounters annually. Bamboo Health does not publish a public developer API; integrations are delivered through EHR workflows and partner/state programs. Security posture is documented in a public Trust Center (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF, HIPAA, NIST 800-53).

providers.name: Bigfinite
providers.description: Bigfinite (now Aizon) is a B2B SaaS provider of AI-powered manufacturing intelligence for pharmaceutical manufacturers and CDMOs. The platform turns GxP manufacturing process data into ML-driven recommendations to improve yield, reduce deviations, and prevent batch loss without replacing existing MES, LIMS, or historian systems. Its product stack spans Aizon Execute (intelligent electronic batch records), Aizon Unify (a GxP manufacturing data platform with ALCOA++ integrity), Aizon Predict (operationalized ML for yield optimization, CPV, and predictive quality), and Aizon Agentic Studio (a natural-language application builder). Aizon runs single-tenant on AWS and maintains ISO 27001, ISO 27017, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11 compliance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from public web surfaces; the company publishes no public API.

providers.name: CADDi
providers.description: CADDi is a Tokyo-headquartered manufacturing-technology company that builds an AI Data Platform for industrial manufacturers. Its two products, CADDi Drawer and CADDi Quote, aggregate scattered 2D engineering drawings and supply-chain data into a single searchable asset, offering keyword and drawing-similarity search, automatic extraction of dimensions, text and shapes, and AI-assisted quotation and sourcing. The platform serves procurement, engineering, sales, production, quality, and leadership teams across automotive, robotics, and precision-machinery sectors, and connects to ERP, CAM, CAD, and quality systems via batch and CSV imports. CADDi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Atomico and DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Clearco
providers.description: Clearco (formerly Clearbanc) is a Toronto-based fintech that provides non-dilutive, revenue-based working capital to ecommerce and direct-to-consumer brands. Founders connect the sales, advertising and banking platforms they already run on — Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Square, BigCommerce — and Clearco underwrites from that data, funding inventory and marketing spend as a cash advance or as invoice funding, in as little as 24 hours, without equity dilution. The company was founded in 2015 as Clearbanc, rebranded to Clearco in 2021, and reports having deployed more than $3.3 billion to over 10,000 businesses.

providers.name: Cleardata
providers.description: ClearDATA is healthcare's dedicated cloud security, compliance, and operations partner, helping providers, payers, health-tech software companies, medical device makers, and life sciences organizations build and run on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud in a HIPAA- and HITRUST-aligned way. Its offering spans Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) with 300+ healthcare-specific safeguards, Managed Detection & Response (MDR), automated Cloud Compliance, and Cloud Operations, delivered through the CyberHealth platform and managed/professional services. ClearDATA is an AWS Level 1 MSSP and Microsoft Gold Partner, and maps controls to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, NIST, ISO, PCI, and GDPR. ClearDATA is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; ClearDATA does not publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Crux OCM
providers.description: CruxOCM builds AI-powered automation software for industrial control-room operations in the energy-infrastructure sector. Its Industrial Automation Hub (IAH) delivers closed-loop automation on top of existing SCADA and DCS systems to increase pipeline throughput, cut operating and energy costs, and improve safety without replacing installed control infrastructure. The product family includes pipeBOT, gatherBOT, draBOT, maxOPT, leanOPT, and powerOPT, supported by a Deployment Manager, Log Analyser, and real-time Status Dashboard. Founded by control-room engineers and operators (CEO Vicki Knott, co-founder Roger Shirt) and headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, the company raised a $17M Series A led by Microsoft's M12 and serves midstream operators including ONEOK, Delek US, Enbridge, HF Sinclair, and Alliance Pipeline. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Curve
providers.description: Curve is a London-based fintech, founded in 2015 by Shachar Bialick, that consolidates multiple debit and credit cards into a single smart card and mobile wallet. Its "over-the-top" banking platform lets customers spend from any linked Mastercard or Visa card, switch the funding source of a past purchase up to 120 days later with "Go Back in Time", avoid foreign-exchange fees, earn cashback, and pay in instalments with Curve Flex. Premium tiers (Curve Pay X / Pro / Pro+) add insurance, lounge access, and richer rewards. Curve is backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest among others. Curve does not publish a public developer API — it acts as an open-banking consumer to aggregate customer account balances rather than exposing a provider API.

providers.name: DapperDox
providers.description: DapperDox is an open-source API documentation generator that creates beautiful, customizable reference documentation from OpenAPI specifications. It supports theming, overlays, and cross-referencing across multiple API specifications, making it suitable for teams managing complex API ecosystems. DapperDox is a developer tool rather than a hosted service, so it does not expose its own public web API.

providers.name: Dragoneye
providers.description: Dragoneye is a computer vision platform designed to democratize access to advanced image and video recognition technologies. It enables developers to build and deploy custom models tailored to their specific use cases without the need for coding or data labeling. By automating the entire process from model specification to deployment, Dragoneye eliminates the traditional complexities associated with computer vision development.

providers.name: Duco
providers.description: Duco is an AI-powered operational data automation platform for financial services. It helps banks, asset managers, brokers, asset servicers and market infrastructure firms normalize, validate and reconcile any data in the cloud — cutting the time spent on manual data work, reducing operational risk and accelerating front-, middle- and back-office processes. The no-code platform ingests data from any source (including unstructured documents via Adaptive Intelligent Document Processing), then transforms, matches, reconciles and publishes it with full audit and control. Duco's Agentic Workspace layers agentic AI over these operations so agents can handle repetitive extraction, matching and exception-labelling work under human oversight. Use cases span securities and derivatives reconciliation, ETD clearing, OTC confirmations, custody, cash accounts, crypto holdings and transaction/regulatory reporting (EMIR, CFTC, MiFID II, ASIC, MAS, T+1). Customers include HSBC, Deutsche Bank, ING, Santander, Northern Trust and Fidelity Digital Assets. Duco is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Gartner
providers.description: Gartner is a global research and advisory firm providing information, advice, and tools to business leaders across IT, finance, HR, customer service, sales, marketing, supply chain, and legal functions. Gartner does not publish a public developer API; this repository tracks the company and any partner or technical artifacts that surface over time.

providers.name: Grandhood
providers.description: Grandhood is a Danish digital pension provider that lets companies set up and run a modern workplace (company) pension scheme entirely online, without the traditional adviser meetings and paperwork. Employers register with MitID, invite employees, and activate a plan; employees enroll, get built-in digital pension counselling, choose an investment profile, consolidate scattered pension savings, and see real-time savings, returns, and insurance coverage in the Grandhood mobile app. Pensions bundle both long-term savings and present-day insurance protection. Pricing is a simple fixed monthly amount per employee (65-95 DKK/month) plus investment costs, with no deposit-percentage fees and free pension advice. The underlying pension administration is backed by Velliv, Denmark's third-largest pension company. Grandhood is based in Copenhagen (Esplanaden 14B, 1263 København K; CVR 44147750) and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Grandhood publishes consumer web and mobile-app products; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: HTTPX
providers.description: HTTPX is a fully featured HTTP client for Python 3 with sync and async APIs, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 support. It is broadly compatible with the popular requests library while adding modern features such as strict timeouts, type annotations, direct WSGI and ASGI transport, SSL verification, cookie persistence, proxy support, and multipart uploads.

providers.name: Latent Health
providers.description: Latent Health (branded "Latent") is an enterprise pharmacy intelligence company that applies a clinical agentic engine to the medication-access workflow for hospital and health-system pharmacy teams. The platform spans four stages — Identify (care-gap detection, eligibility screening, site-of-care routing), Access (prior authorization, clinical review, appeal generation, benefit routing, payer outreach), Capture (340B eligibility auditing, leakage analytics, financial dashboards), and Engage (patient outreach, queue management, outcomes analytics). It ingests patient charts and EHR data, claims, payer policies, and drug labels, and is described as chart-native and EHR-agnostic across Epic and Cerner. The company reports deployment across 50+ health systems covering 2M+ patients annually, and raised an $80M Series A led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital. Latent Health publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs as of this profile; it is an enterprise platform sold to health systems, and its public surface is limited to marketing, case studies, press, and a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: LeaseLock
providers.description: LeaseLock is an insurtech platform for rental housing that replaces the traditional cash security deposit with lease insurance. Its Zero Deposit program embeds coverage into the lease through a signed addendum, removing thousands of dollars of move-in cost for residents while protecting owners and operators against unpaid rent and damage. LeaseLock Shield applies AI to ledger data, market trends and lease profiles to underwrite risk, and LeaseLock Central gives property teams a portal for claims, support tickets and training. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Dallas, Texas, the company says it integrates with all major property management systems, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference or client SDKs — integration is arranged as a managed engagement. Its public engineering output is two open-source PostgreSQL extensions, pgasync and pgflow.

providers.name: Liveu
providers.description: LiveU is a provider of cloud-based, IP-bonded live video contribution, production, and distribution technology for broadcasters, sports, news, public safety, and enterprise. Its portfolio spans field encoders (the LU-series and the Q Era LU900Q), the LiveU Central cloud management platform, LiveU Studio and Nexus production tools, the LiveU Matrix distribution grid, DataBridge and LU-LINK connectivity, and the LiveU Solo streaming line. LiveU pioneered bonded-cellular transmission that aggregates multiple LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, and satellite links into a single reliable, low-latency video feed. This profile was surfaced as a venture-capital portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; LiveU publishes marketing, support, and training surfaces but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or open API documentation was found - the LiveU Central API is available to customers behind authentication.

providers.name: M2P Fintech
providers.description: M2P Fintech is Asia's largest API infrastructure company, powering banking, lending, and payment solutions for fintechs, banks, NBFCs, and enterprises. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Chennai, India, M2P operates across 30+ countries and processes 20+ billion transactions for 50+ million end customers. Its modular, cloud-native, API-first product suite lets businesses embed financial services — core banking (Turing CBS), card issuance (credit, debit, prepaid, forex), UPI, cross-border payments, loan origination and management (Finflux), merchant management, BNPL, microfinance, KYC (Syntizen), reconciliation (Recon360), fraud and AML monitoring, 3DS access control, and neobanking — with up to 5X faster go-to-market.

providers.name: Makersite
providers.description: Makersite is an AI-powered Product Lifecycle Intelligence platform that helps manufacturers manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance by connecting products to deep-tier supply chain, material, and chemical data. The platform automates lifecycle assessments (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, supports eco-design and cost optimization, and produces regulatory reporting such as EU Taxonomy and CBAM. It integrates with enterprise CAD, ERP, and PLM systems (PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Autodesk, ANSYS). Makersite is a portfolio company of Partech. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: NAVER Z
providers.description: NAVER Z Corporation is the South Korean metaverse subsidiary of NAVER, headquartered in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, with additional offices in Los Angeles and Tokyo. The company builds immersive digital experiences spanning ZEPETO, its avatar-based metaverse and social app launched in 2018; ZEP, a spatial collaboration and virtual-space platform launched in 2022; and Sticker.ly, a sticker creation and sharing app launched in 2019. NAVER Z's public developer surface is ZEP Script: a first-party JavaScript SDK, CLI, and build toolchain (published on npm under the official @zep.us scope) that creators use to build in-space apps and mini-games, documented in the ZEP Guidebook at docs.zep.us with a dedicated ZEP Script API reference. NAVER Z publishes no REST/OpenAPI web API or OAuth program; ZEPETO Studio remains a Unity-based content-creation tool rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Palm
providers.description: Palm is an AI cash flow forecasting platform for corporate treasury and finance teams. It sits above existing Treasury Management Systems (TMS) and ERPs, unifying visibility across cash positions and forecasting liquidity directly from bank and transaction data. Palm learns the timing and size of recurring cash flows from historical transactions to keep a rolling 13-week-and-longer forecast current automatically, and combines ERP data, bank transactions, and 25+ AI models to improve forecast accuracy by over 60%. The product spans AI cash forecasting, what-if scenario modeling, continuous forecast-vs-actual variance analysis, automated daily cash positioning across banks and currencies, surplus-cash investment identification, board-ready treasury reporting, and a "Pulse" anomaly-detection assistant. Palm is a speedinvest portfolio company. It integrates with TMS (Coupa, FIS, ION, Kyriba), banks (Citi, HSBC, J.P. Morgan), investment platforms, data warehouses, and ERPs (SAP, IFS), but does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Perfios
providers.description: Perfios is a Bangalore, India-headquartered financial technology (SaaS) company providing an AI-driven operating system for banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and insurers, serving over 1,000 financial institutions globally. Its platform spans four product families: Perfios Analyse (bank statement, ITR, GST, payslip, credit-card and financial-statement analysers), Perfios Verify (KYC/KYB, video KYC, liveness detection, OCR, digital signature and onboarding via OneSDK), Perfios Lens (portfolio monitoring, PFM, credit assessment memos, due diligence), and Perfios Protect (document tamper detection, deepfake detection, and insurance fraud detection). Perfios also runs a digital public infrastructure (DPI) stack for Account Aggregator FIU/FIP roles. Its data-aggregation, decisioning, and verification capabilities are delivered to partners programmatically; public developer documentation is gated behind partner access. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Rallyware
providers.description: Rallyware is an AI-powered sales performance and workforce enablement platform that guides distributed sellers, distributors, and field teams toward the next best action using real-time performance data, adaptive learning, gamification, and behavioral insights. It replaces fragmented enablement tools with a single orchestration system for large field and direct-selling organizations, and offers open APIs, webhooks, and pre-built connectors for CRM, POS, WFM, inventory, and HR systems. API access is provisioned to enterprise customers rather than published through a public developer portal.

providers.name: RatedPower
providers.description: RatedPower, part of Enverus (ENVERUS RATEDPOWER S.L.U., Madrid, Spain), is a cloud software platform for the design and engineering of utility-scale renewable energy projects. Its pvDesign product automates solar photovoltaic (PV) plant layout, energy-yield simulation, battery energy storage system (BESS) and hybrid plant design, substation and grid-connection engineering, earthwork estimating, and bankable proposal documentation. The platform is delivered as a browser-based SaaS application (login at ratedpower.enverus.com) and reports 64,000+ projects designed and 5.1 TW of simulated capacity. No public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal is published; enterprise automation access exists only behind the authenticated application. This profile was seeded as a Techstars portfolio lead and has been run through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Science Corporation
providers.description: Science Corporation is a neurotechnology company founded in 2021 by former Neuralink president Max Hodak, developing brain-computer interfaces and implantable neural devices to restore vision, cognition, and mobility (its PRIMA retinal implant and biohybrid BCI are its marquee programs). Its developer-facing surface is the Synapse Protocol, a flexible gRPC / Protocol Buffers standard API — paired with the Neural Data Transport Protocol (NDTP) — for discovering neural interface devices on a local network, configuring on-device signal chains (broadband source, spike detector, electrical/optical stimulation, disk writer, camera nodes), and streaming high-throughput neural data over UDP. Official client libraries ship for Python (science-synapse, including the synapsectl CLI), TypeScript, and C++, all generated from the open protobuf definitions in the sciencecorp GitHub org.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is an enterprise carbon and ESG data management platform helping large organizations measure, manage, report, and reduce their carbon emissions and broader sustainability performance across Scope 1, 2, and 3 following the GHG Protocol. Its platform centralizes sustainability data across an organization and its value chain to produce audit-ready data from a single source, covering carbon accounting, ESG disclosure, value-chain engagement with supplier portals and automated data collection, audit and assurance trails, and business intelligence with dashboards and scenario modeling. Sweep supports compliance with the CSRD, ISSB, GRI, CDP, SFDR, TCFD, UK SRS, the GHG Protocol, and US state regulation including California SB 253 and SB 261, with vertical solutions for asset managers, asset owners, private markets, banks, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and consumer goods. Sweep was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape 2026 for Carbon Management and recognized in the Verdantix 2026 Green Quadrant. The platform exposes data ingestion via API and SFTP and integrates with ERP, procurement, and HRMS systems, but Sweep does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repos — API access is delivered through customer engagements rather than a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Tenneco
providers.description: Tenneco is a global manufacturer of automotive components and systems, including clean air, powertrain, and ride performance systems for OEM and aftermarket markets. Through its DRiV aftermarket division, Tenneco serves mechanics, distributors, and retailers with digital catalog and parts lookup capabilities.

providers.name: Vertice
providers.description: Vertice is an intelligent procurement platform built for the modern enterprise with agentic workflows, AI insights, and expert buyers that empower finance and procurement teams across 30+ countries to buy smarter and scale faster. The platform covers SaaS purchasing and contract management, cloud spend optimization (AWS, GCP, Azure), and integrates with ERPs, CLMs, ticketing platforms, communication tools, TPRM systems, and SSOs to centralize procurement workflows. Vertice processes over $30B in spend with proven 20%+ savings for customers including ARM, Blackberry, Factorial, and Santander.

providers.name: Vistra Corp
providers.description: Vistra Corp (NYSE: VST) is an Irving, Texas integrated retail electricity and power generation company and the largest competitive power generator in the United States, operating roughly 41,000-44,000 MW of natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar and battery storage capacity alongside a retail business serving nearly 5 million residential, commercial and industrial customers across 16 states and the District of Columbia through TXU Energy, Dynegy, Ambit Energy, Energy Harbor, Homefield Energy and U.S. Gas & Electric. Its home market is the United States, where it sits on both sides of the competitive value chain, a merchant generator selling into ERCOT, PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, MISO and CAISO, and a retail electricity provider (REP) reselling that power to end customers. Its API posture is honestly none. No developer portal, no API subdomain and no machine-readable contract of any kind was found: developer., developers., docs., api. and data. on vistracorp.com do not resolve; /developers, /api, /docs, /data, /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /.well-known/openid-configuration all return 404; and TXU Energy's 758-URL sitemap contains no developer or API page. The United States has no consumer energy data mandate. Green Button is an NAESB/NIST ESPI standard adopted voluntarily, and TXU Energy appears on the US Department of Energy's list of "Utilities Committed to Implementing Green Button", a 2012-era commitment list and not evidence of a live endpoint. The only customer-data surface found is Download-My-Data-style export behind the TXU Energy MyAccount login, whose interval readings are themselves sourced from Smart Meter Texas, the shared ERCOT meter-data platform operated by the transmission and distribution utilities (Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, TNMP) rather than by Vistra. Because Vistra is a retailer and generator and not a wires company, the third-party interval-data API in its home Texas market belongs to Smart Meter Texas and not to Vistra. Vistra likewise publishes no open market or grid data of its own; ERCOT, the other ISOs/RTOs and the EIA publish the market data about Vistra's fleet. Both sides are therefore closed at the company boundary. Not to be confused with Vistra Limited (vistra.com), the unrelated corporate-services and fund-administration firm that does run a real API developer portal at devportal.vistra.com.

providers.name: ABILITY Network (Inovalon)
providers.description: ABILITY Network is a healthcare SaaS business acquired by Inovalon in 2018 and now delivered as part of the cloud-based Inovalon ONE Platform. It provides US healthcare providers with software for medical billing and claims management, eligibility verification, revenue cycle management, clinical quality reporting, patient access, and workforce/staffing and care coordination. Inovalon pairs these provider-facing applications with large national datasets and analytics to support data-driven healthcare across payers, providers, pharmacies, and life-sciences organizations. Developer access to Inovalon ONE APIs is offered through the authenticated Inovalon developer portal at developer.inovalonone.com, which exposes sandbox, staging, and live environments.

providers.name: ablefy
providers.description: ablefy (formerly elopage) is a German all-in-one sales and monetization platform for coaches, creators, trainers, consultants, and online educators. It provides conversion-optimized checkout with 12+ payment methods (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, cards, Apple/Google Pay) across multiple currencies, an integrated LMS for online courses, memberships and subscriptions, community and live events, e-ticketing, automated invoicing with international tax/OSS compliance, and an optional reseller (merchant-of-record) model. Sellers can automate workflows through the ablefy API, webhooks, and access-token authentication, plus a Zapier integration and email-marketing connectors. The platform reports 80,000+ sellers, 6M+ customers serviced, and over EUR 2 billion in processed transactions across 13+ years of operation.

providers.name: AMPAworks
providers.description: AMPAworks builds AI-powered smart-shelf inventory management for healthcare and defense supply chains. Its platform pairs computer-vision cameras and rolling kiosks that image inventory to auto-count stock in real time with software that tracks supplies 24/7, automates reordering, and gives teams live visibility to prevent stock-outs. The company reports outcomes such as $15M in cost reduction, 25,000 hours saved on hand counting, and 72% fewer stock-outs across more than 28 healthcare and operational organizations. Backed by 500 Global, AMPAworks operates from offices in Santa Monica CA, Buffalo NY, Hackensack NJ, and Ann Arbor MI.

providers.name: Apache Sqoop
providers.description: Apache Sqoop is a command-line tool designed for efficiently transferring bulk data between Apache Hadoop and structured data stores such as relational databases. It supports parallel import and export of data, incremental loads, and direct database connectors for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and DB2. Note: Apache Sqoop has been retired to the Apache Attic as of 2021. Users are encouraged to migrate to Apache Spark or Apache NiFi.

providers.name: AtomBeam
providers.description: AtomBeam Technologies is a Moraga, California software company founded in 2017 that sells "Compaction" — a machine-learning approach to shrinking machine-generated data that replaces recurring bit-level patterns with codewords drawn from a trained codebook, rather than compressing bytes. Its Neurpac product is an on-premises, protocol-agnostic bidirectional compaction tunnel that reduces IoT, telemetry and file payloads by roughly 75% while encrypting and obfuscating them in transit; Neurcom and PCM are earlier-stage research products. AtomBeam licenses the software to IoT device and gateway makers, satellite and LPWAN operators, telcos, and the US Department of Defense, and has raised capital through Regulation A and Regulation CF crowdfunding on StartEngine. There is no public developer API program: the customer-facing surface is the login-gated AtomBeam Customer Portal (codebook generation and simulation) plus a Jira Service Management support portal.

providers.name: Butternut Box
providers.description: Butternut Box is a London-headquartered direct-to-consumer pet nutrition company that cooks and delivers fresh, gently-steamed dog food on a personalised subscription. Customers complete an online profiling wizard covering their dog's breed, age, weight, activity level and health needs, and Butternut Box calculates a portioned meal plan from human-quality meat and vegetables, batch-cooks it at low temperature, freezes it, and ships it on a recurring schedule. Founded in 2016 and certified as a B Corporation, the company operates nine locale storefronts covering the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Belgium (Dutch and French), Germany, Italy, Sweden and Denmark, and runs its own production facility alongside a React / React Native / Ruby on Rails engineering stack.
