Marey generates cinematic image-to-video and text-to-video with precise creative controls — pose transfer, camera control, motion transfer, and trajectory control — and is trained exclusively on licensed data, which Moonvalley markets as a "commercially safe" model for professional production. Marey launched publicly in July 2025. A first-party public API is announced but currently waitlist-only; developers can run Marey today through inference partners fal.ai and ComfyUI. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst.

providers.name: MTN OPS
providers.description: MTN OPS is an American-owned outdoor performance nutrition and lifestyle brand founded in 2014 and headquartered in Fruit Heights, Utah. The company develops, manufactures, and sells energy and nutrition supplements (pre-workout, protein, hydration, creatine, and energy bars) alongside apparel and gear for hunters, tactical professionals, military, and outdoor athletes, running a "Conquer Hunger" program that donates one meal for every order placed. MTN OPS is a direct-to-consumer, internet-first retailer operating on the Shopify platform and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes no bespoke developer API; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify New Customer Accounts OIDC discovery documents and a Shopify-generated agent-commerce llms.txt. This profile was surfaced as a Norwest portfolio lead and enriched from the provider's live public surface.

providers.name: Nauto
providers.description: Nauto is a predictive AI platform for commercial fleet safety. Using in-vehicle AI dash cams and computer vision, it monitors driver behavior in real time, delivers predictive collision alerts before incidents occur, scores driver risk with its VERA system, and powers driver coaching, exoneration, and incident intelligence. Nauto also supports DVIR, IFTA, and ELD fleet-compliance workflows across trucking, delivery, construction, passenger transit, and field-service fleets. Backed by Greylock, Playground Global, and SoftBank Vision Fund, Nauto is SOC 2 Type 1/2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: Ophelia Health
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company providing private, evidence-based medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid use disorder from home. Founded in 2019 by Zack Gray and Mattan Griffel and headquartered in New York City, Ophelia connects patients with licensed clinicians for video visits, prescribes Suboxone (buprenorphine + naloxone) sent to a local pharmacy, and provides ongoing care-team support seven days a week. The subscription service accepts most major insurance plans, including Medicaid, and is licensed to provide care across 49 states and Washington, D.C. Ophelia is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner API program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Papernest
providers.description: Papernest is a French technology company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Paris, that provides a digital platform for managing, switching, and cancelling household subscriptions — energy, telecom and internet, mobile plans, and home insurance — through a single interface. Built around the moment people move home, the service is free to end users and monetized through commissions from supplier partners across France, Spain, Italy, and the UK, having helped more than 3 million customers. Papernest does not publish a public developer API; it runs a private B2B partner integration program and maintains an official GitHub organization of archived open-source utilities.

providers.name: Pear Suite
providers.description: Pear Suite is a care management platform built for community health workers, care navigators, doulas, and community-based organizations, describing itself as an operating system for community-based work. The platform provides custom assessments and care pathways, goal and outcome tracking, patient communication over phone, SMS, and encrypted email, client and population-level analytics, and billing and claims integration, connecting community health initiatives with health plans and health systems. Pear Suite reports serving 2,500+ community workers across 300+ organizations nationwide.

providers.name: Pendulumlife
providers.description: Pendulum (pendulumlife.com) is a direct-to-consumer probiotics and metabolic-health company founded by PhD scientists from Johns Hopkins, Harvard, Berkeley and Stanford. It sells next-generation probiotic supplements such as Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, Glucose Control (a medical probiotic clinically shown to improve A1C in type 2 diabetes) and Polyphenol Booster. Surfaced as a portfolio company of felicis and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Enrichment finding: the site is a Shopify-hosted storefront and Pendulum publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or documentation; the only machine surface is Shopify's platform customer-account OIDC discovery endpoint.

providers.name: Physiohome
providers.description: Physiohome, operating as Ameen (رعاية أمين), is a Saudi Arabia-based, tech-enabled provider of home rehabilitation and physical therapy services. Founded in 2021 out of a Ministry of Health sector accelerator, the company delivers physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, nutritional therapy, and personal training for adults and seniors in patients' homes and rehabilitation centers. Its platform manages the full care journey from assessment and treatment planning through session tracking, provider equipping, and reporting, with 100+ active service providers operating across nine cities and a wider network of 700+ providers. Ameen offers iOS and Android apps, an online booking flow, and a patient portal, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. It is a portfolio company of Sanabil 500 (500 Global) and Saudi Venture Capital.

providers.name: Play Versus
providers.description: Play Versus (PlayVS) is North America's leading scholastic and collegiate esports platform, operating competitive gaming leagues for middle schools, high schools, and colleges alongside an esports curriculum and college recruitment services. The platform partners with major publishers including Riot Games, EA, Blizzard, and Psyonix, and runs its competitions and rosters through the app.playvs.com web application. PlayVS is a consumer/education product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface; this profile captures its published identity, support, and policy properties. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Plink
providers.description: Plink is a personalized commerce and card-linking platform that turns everyday payment transactions into intelligent, permission-based savings and engagement experiences for banks, merchants, and consumers. Its technology enriches transactions in real time, applying business rules and automated actions across payments, digital banking, and customer engagement, and exposes an API that lets any payment network make its transactions "smart" while keeping consumers anonymous. Plink says it has personalized over 700 million transactions and reaches 350+ banks, hundreds of thousands of merchants, and 10+ million consumers through an invitation-only network. The company operates a merchant/business portal and a consumer savings program (Fancoins) built on a PCI-compliant, tokenized card-linking structure.

providers.name: Prenuvo
providers.description: Prenuvo operates a preventive healthcare screening service built around whole-body MRI imaging paired with blood biomarker panels and personalized results reviews. A single scan captures on the order of a billion data points while screening for hundreds of conditions across major organ systems, without radiation or contrast agents, and completes in under an hour. Blood panels measure 80+ biomarkers tied to inflammation, hormone levels, and metabolic health, with optional advanced imaging for brain, heart, and body composition. Prenuvo runs clinics across the US, Canada, Australia, and the UK, and works with research institutions including Mount Sinai, UCLA, Johns Hopkins, Stanford, and Penn. Prenuvo does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Propel
providers.description: Propel, Inc. is a Brooklyn-based fintech company, founded in 2014, that builds financial tools for Americans with low income. Its free consumer app, Providers (formerly Fresh EBT), is used by more than five million people each month to check their SNAP/EBT balances instantly across 49 states, Washington D.C., and U.S. territories, secure their benefits card with locking and fraud monitoring, find exclusive offers and discounts on groceries, phone plans, internet, utilities, and healthcare, receive alerts about benefit policy changes, browse local job and gig-work listings, and predict deposit dates. Propel is a consumer-facing mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it operates a public status page and a signed RFC 9116 security.txt for coordinated vulnerability disclosure. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Nyca Partners, Kleiner Perkins, JPMorgan Chase, Salesforce Ventures, the Financial Health Network, and Flourish Ventures.

providers.name: Provus
providers.description: Provus (Provusinc) is an agentic AI Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) platform built specifically for services organizations — professional services, consulting, and asset-based services firms. The platform turns unstructured inputs such as emails, RFPs, and call notes into structured, accurate services quotes, and runs a set of AI agents (Quote Optimizer, Deal Predictor, Proposal Response, Deal Rescue, and Provus Admin) that monitor deals, optimize pricing, assess risk, and protect margin. Provus ships two products — CPQ Express for growing teams and Enterprise Services CPQ for large organizations — with native connectors to Salesforce, HubSpot, Kantata, NetSuite, and DocuSign. It is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and reports managing over $5B in enterprise services revenue across customers including Thoughtworks, Trace3, and Prolifics. Provus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration is delivered through native prebuilt connectors, and product help documentation is hosted on a Document360 knowledge base at docs.provus.ai.

providers.name: Quantum Metric
providers.description: Quantum Metric is a continuous product design and digital experience intelligence platform that captures and quantifies every user session across web and mobile, replaying interactions and surfacing friction, errors, and conversion opportunities in real time so that product, engineering, and customer-experience teams can prioritize work by quantified business impact. The platform exposes data-export and integration APIs to customers within their authenticated instance; during enrichment no public, unauthenticated developer portal or OpenAPI definition was discoverable (developer.quantummetric.com and docs.quantummetric.com redirect to the marketing site and the help center returns a maintenance page).

providers.name: Ridecell
providers.description: Ridecell is an AI-powered asset intelligence and orchestration platform for automotive leasing, fleet, and finance companies. Its five intelligence modules (Client, Spend, Supplier, Asset, and Operational Intelligence) and the "Maya" AI agent monitor fleets, flag invoice overcharges, track garage/supplier performance, optimize vehicle remarketing and residual value, and resolve idle-vehicle inefficiencies. The platform processes 12M+ events daily across 500K+ assets, 100+ connected systems, and 14+ countries. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital. Ridecell does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; this profile captures its public information, security, and compliance surfaces.

providers.name: Roger
providers.description: Roger (operated by Sanos Services GmbH, Berlin, Germany) is a B2B SaaS practice-management platform for dental clinics. It layers automation and AI onto existing German dental practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM Z1, Charly, Dampsoft, Evident and Dento Office, adding patient recall, digital intake forms, WhatsApp/SMS communication, AI-assisted documentation with billing-position capture, digital treatment-plan signing, factoring with default protection and instant payout, and outsourced ZMV/reception staffing. The product is DSGVO/GDPR-compliant and hosted in Germany. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery, Roger publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Route
providers.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Rupa Health
providers.description: Rupa Health (now a Fullscript company) is a healthcare platform that lets functional and root-cause medicine practitioners order, track, and receive results from specialty and functional lab tests across hundreds of lab companies through a single unified dashboard. It provides a lab test catalog, patient result portals, practitioner ordering and billing, phlebotomy coordination, and educational resources (Rupa University, the Root Cause Medicine podcast, and a lab reference guide). Rupa integrates with a range of EHR/EMR systems used by independent practitioners but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal at this time. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Ruzuku
providers.description: Ruzuku is a hosted online course platform for coaches, authors, and subject matter experts to create, teach, and sell online courses and learning communities. Ruzuku does not publish a documented public REST API or developer program. Its programmatic surface is exposed exclusively through a Zapier integration - authenticated with an API Key, API Secret, and Site URL generated under Account then Integrations then Configure Zapier - that offers event triggers (enrollments, lesson and course completions, quiz and assignment submissions, comments, cancellations) and a small set of student enroll, unenroll, and lookup actions. The APIs modeled below are honest logical groupings of that Zapier-mediated surface, not endpoints from a public Ruzuku API reference.

providers.name: Ryland Group
providers.description: The Ryland Group was one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and a leading mortgage finance company before merging with Standard Pacific Corp in October 2015 to form CalAtlantic Group, Inc., which was subsequently acquired by Lennar in 2018. During its operation, Ryland Homes built homes across 17 states and provided financial services including consumer mortgage loans, title, and escrow services. The company's technology stack included Akamai, Amazon CloudFront, ASP.NET, Fiserv for financial services, and Microsoft Dynamics for CRM and ERP.

providers.name: Seer
providers.description: Seer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SEER) is a Redwood City, California life-sciences company pioneering proteomics, the large-scale study of proteins. Its Proteograph Product Suite pairs engineered nanoparticles with automated sample preparation and mass spectrometry to profile tens of thousands of proteins across biological samples at scale, and its cloud-based Proteograph Analysis System (PAS) software processes and interprets the resulting proteomic data for pharmaceutical, biopharma, and academic research. Seer exposes no public developer API; its software surface is the login-gated PAS platform delivered to customers of the Proteograph suite.

providers.name: Spill
providers.description: Spill is a UK-based employee assistance programme (EAP) that delivers mental health support to employees directly inside the tools teams already use, such as Slack and Microsoft Teams. The platform offers same-day, message-based counselling, structured multi-session therapy courses for specific mental health conditions, drop-in group sessions, manager mental-health training, and self-guided wellbeing content, all through a single subscription. Spill serves over 600 companies on month-to-month terms and is backed by Seedcamp. It is a B2B software-as-a-service wellbeing product rather than an API provider; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK has been published.

providers.name: Sumeria
providers.description: Sumeria is a French fintech and mobile-first banking service created by Lydia Solutions in 2024 as a consumer spinoff of the Lydia payment app. It offers free online banking accounts with automatic expense categorization, thematic sub-accounts for budgeting and savings, virtual and physical debit cards with no foreign-exchange fees, an interest-bearing balance, and an AI assistant named Sia for account management and financial guidance. Sumeria is a business-to-consumer banking product; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time, so this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Summer Health
providers.description: Summer Health is a pediatric health company offering families fast, board-certified pediatric care. Its flagship consumer service provides comprehensive at-home blood work for children ages 8-18 (one blood draw covering 74 biomarkers) reviewed by board-certified pediatricians over video, alongside text-based urgent-care messaging with pediatric clinicians. The service is HSA/FSA eligible and LegitScript-approved. Summer Health is a consumer-facing telehealth offering and does not currently publish a public developer program, API documentation, or third-party integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tab
providers.description: Tab (tab.travel) is a London-based payment platform built specifically for independent tourism and hospitality businesses — hotels, hostels, tour operators, retreat centers and activity providers. It lets these merchants take card payments wherever their guests are, from in-advance deposits and online booking pages to in-person, on-the-move transactions via a mobile app, and to plug into an existing booking engine, PMS or OTA ecosystem. Tab natively handles 140+ currencies, pays out weekly in the merchant's local currency, and advertises transparent pricing from 2.9% per transaction with no hidden fees. Founded in 2015 by Mark Datta and backed by Y Combinator (W2015), Tab also operates a consumer-facing social-commerce guide for discovering and booking travel. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Tab does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs or API documentation.

providers.name: Teal Health
providers.description: Teal Health, Inc. is a women's health company behind the Teal Wand, the first and only FDA-approved at-home self-collection device for cervical cancer screening in the United States. Its end-to-end telehealth service pairs the self-collection kit with virtual Teal medical providers who prescribe the kit, review Roche cobas HPV lab results, and support patients aged 25-65 throughout the screening experience. Now available in all 50 states, Teal Health runs a HIPAA-compliant direct-to-consumer telehealth platform and is a consumer of third-party healthcare APIs (Healthie for scheduling/telehealth, Candid for billing) rather than a publisher of a public developer API.

providers.name: Teamtailor
providers.description: Teamtailor is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and employer branding platform that helps companies attract, engage, and hire candidates with customizable career sites, recruitment workflows, candidate communications, and analytics. The platform supports collaborative hiring, GDPR compliance, and a marketplace of integrations. Teamtailor's API follows the JSON:API specification with regional base URLs and uses token-based authentication with Public, Internal, and Admin key permission levels.

providers.name: Terapify
providers.description: Terapify is an online therapy platform for the Spanish-speaking market, connecting individuals in Mexico and Latin America with certified psychologists for private, secure video-call sessions. Founded in 2019 and backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator, the platform matches patients to therapists via a therapeutic-affinity test, offers individual and couples therapy, parent orientation, and workplace mental-health programs for companies, plus mindfulness, yoga, and breathing resources. It operates as a consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) product and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: UBS Bank USA
providers.description: UBS Bank USA (BUSA) is a Utah state-chartered industrial bank and FDIC-insured depository institution headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, established in 2003 and reporting roughly $122 billion in total assets. It is the primary US banking vehicle of UBS Wealth Management Americas, providing FDIC-insured deposit sweep programs, securities-based lending, mortgages, and credit cards almost exclusively to the high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth advisory clients of parent UBS Group AG. It is supervised by the FDIC, the Utah Department of Financial Institutions, and the CFPB. Unlike a fintech or a Banking-as-a-Service provider, UBS Bank USA exposes no first-party public developer API surface of its own; its services are delivered through UBS Financial Advisors rather than self-serve APIs. The only live UBS developer portal (developer.ubs.com) belongs to UBS Switzerland and serves Swiss and EU products (key4 mortgages, QR-bill, PSD2, TWINT, bLink, KeyPort/EBICS), not this US entity. US consumer-permissioned data access, where available, is mediated by third-party aggregators rather than a documented BUSA API.

providers.name: VALID8 Financial
providers.description: VALID8 Financial is a Verified Financial Intelligence (VFI) platform founded in 2017 in Seattle that turns raw banking evidence and accounting records into reconciled, evidential-grade transaction data for forensic accountants, CPA firms, law firms, bankruptcy trustees, and government investigators. The AI-powered platform automates extraction and verification of financial evidence across use cases including forensic investigations, financial crime, expert witness support, transaction advisory, bankruptcy and restructuring, and family law. A Techstars portfolio company, VALID8 is SOC 2 Type II audited, HIPAA compliant, and GDPR aligned with a Vanta-hosted trust center, but does not currently publish a developer portal or public API documentation; customers sign in through regional portals (us/ca/eu/uk/aus.valid8.io).

providers.name: Vitrue Health
providers.description: Vitrue Health is a London-based, Techstars-backed digital health company providing an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) and workplace ergonomics platform. Its VIDA product uses camera-based AI assessments to automate Display Screen Equipment (DSE) compliance, deliver personalized pain-management pathways, and give employers analytics through a VIDA Co-Pilot dashboard, reporting an average 34% reduction in MSK pain. The platform integrates with HR systems, learning management systems, and SSO/provisioning identity providers, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Zenbu 2
providers.description: Zenbu is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) developer-tools startup building a fully hackable desktop interface for managing AI coding agents. The macOS app is a customizable client for the "Pi" coding agent, letting developers run multiple agents in parallel across Git worktrees, review changes, and extend the app at runtime through plugins. Zenbu is built on Zenbu.js, the company's open-source TypeScript framework for building extensible ("hackable") applications, which handles plugin loading, cross-process state sync, RPC, and hot reloading. The framework and its scaffolding tooling are published to npm under the zenbu-labs organization. Zenbu does not currently expose a hosted HTTP/REST developer API; its developer surface is the client-side Zenbu.js framework, its plugin model, and its command-line scaffolders. Founded by Rob Pruzan (ex-Vercel Next.js core, co-author of React Scan).

providers.name: Zensurance
providers.description: Zensurance is a Toronto-based digital commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2016 that sells small-business and freelancer coverage online across every Canadian province, placing risk with Canadian carriers rather than underwriting it. Its book is commercial property and casualty — general and commercial general liability, professional liability and errors and omissions, cyber liability, directors and officers, commercial property, commercial auto, builder's risk, and a long tail of trade- and profession-specific packages — sold through a quote-to-bind web flow marketed as an instant online price with licensed broker support and claims advocacy behind it. It sits in the thin digital-broker layer beneath Canada's Big-Few carrier oligopoly, in a market with no open-insurance mandate — OSFI supervises federally-regulated insurers prudentially while FSRA, the AMF, and the other provincial regulators own market conduct, and Consumer-Driven Banking excludes insurance outright. Its API posture reflects that. Zensurance publishes no public, self-serve developer portal, no reference documentation, and no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI definition. The company's partnership page advertises "seamless API integrations and co-branded white-label tools" for distribution partners, but the only route to that surface is a partnership application form — the integration is partner-gated and privately negotiated. A first-party host at api.zensurance.com answers on the public internet (HTTP 200, returning a bare version string, with a /health endpoint) but it is the undocumented backend for Zensurance's own quoting and policy application, not a published product API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML, NGDS, or agency-management-system integration claim appears anywhere on the company's public web properties. The one machine-addressable surface the company does publish for automated consumers is an llms.txt at www.zensurance.com/llms.txt — a 178KB marketing index of its pages, blog posts, and FAQs (which inadvertently lists its zenstage.wpengine.com staging host rather than the production domain). It describes insurance products for AI assistants; it documents no API.

providers.name: 2ULaundry
providers.description: 2ULaundry is a laundry and dry cleaning pickup-and-delivery service headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina and backed by Techstars. Customers schedule pickups through a mobile app, leave color-coded bags at their door, and receive cleaned items back within one to two business days. Services include residential wash-and-fold, delicate garment care, dry cleaning, and household linens, plus commercial laundry solutions for Airbnbs, spas, gyms, salons, and healthcare facilities. The company operates its own processing facilities and a fleet-based delivery network across its Southeast US markets. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Techstars portfolio and enriched; 2ULaundry is a consumer service company and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Aceiss
providers.description: Aceiss is a security monitoring and access-visibility platform that gives CISOs and risk managers continuous insight into who has access to their GitHub organizations and repositories. It monitors user access across repositories, detects unauthorized or anomalous activity in real time, and produces governance and compliance reporting mapped to frameworks such as NIST, CIS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CSA STAR, HITRUST, and SOC 2. Aceiss installs from the GitHub Marketplace as a read-only app requiring admin privileges and exposes an API for integrating its real-time access data into existing systems, with spreadsheet and PDF export. The company is backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Ara
providers.description: Ara (Ara Labs, Inc.) is a digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising network that finances, installs, and operates rich-media displays across mobility, municipal, parking, and retail settings. It describes itself as the largest U.S. owner-operator of rideshare and taxi car-top digital billboards, running a long-term partnership with Uber alongside in-car, storefront, and parking/municipal kiosk screens. Ara owns the hardware and content-management operations under a monthly subscription model so fleet owners, retailers, parking operators and municipalities avoid cap-ex and operational overhead, and it also sells self-serve NYC taxi-top ad time by the hour or day. Its own site names Founders Fund, Coatue, Rosecliff Ventures, iHeart Media and Kellogg's as investors. Ara publishes NO public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation site or machine-readable specification. Contract discovery in August 2026 found a live private backend at api.arascreens.com (Ruby on Rails on Heroku) that answers every route with an HTTP Basic challenge, a React driver/operations application at app.arascreens.com, and a third-party signage CMS front end at cms.arascreens.com — all credentialed product infrastructure, none of it a developer offering.

providers.name: Avant Arte
providers.description: Avant Arte is a global online art marketplace for discovering and collecting limited edition prints, sculptures and digital works produced in close collaboration with leading contemporary artists. Founded in the Netherlands, the platform works directly with 250+ artists on exclusive editions and release "draws", offering authentication, custom framing, gift cards, and expert collector support. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures in the marketplaces sector. Avant Arte does not publish a public developer API; this profile has been enriched from its public web, security, and organizational surfaces.

providers.name: Buildforever
providers.description: BuildForever is a consumer software company building products that feel personal, magical, and deeply human. Its first product, Extra (extra.email), is a free AI email app for iPhone, Mac, and Gmail that automatically organizes the inbox into smart categories, summarizes what matters in a daily digest, cleans up subscriptions and unwanted senders, answers natural-language questions about your mail, and drafts replies in your own tone. Founded and led by CEO Naveen Gavini (formerly SVP/CPO at Pinterest), BuildForever is backed by Abstract Ventures, Felicis, and DST Global, with angel investors including Ben Silbermann, Guillermo Rauch, and Paul Buchheit. The company does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its consumer product surface and identity.

providers.name: Clarity AI
providers.description: Clarity AI is a sustainability technology and fintech company that provides AI-powered extra-financial intelligence for financial decision-making. Its platform delivers ESG risk ratings, climate and physical-risk analytics, regulatory-compliance reporting (EU Taxonomy, SFDR, MiFID II, ESMA fund naming, Pillar 3), impact and UN SDG alignment, and retail-banking climate engagement tools. Clarity AI reports coverage of 300K+ listed and private companies, 450K+ funds, and 400+ sovereigns, and serves asset managers, asset owners, banks, wealth managers, and corporates. The company exposes its data through a web application, data feeds, APIs, and emerging AI agent / MCP integrations, though its developer surface is gated behind an enterprise platform login rather than a public developer portal. Clarity AI is a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clivi
providers.description: Clivi is Mexico's largest digital clinic for diabetes and obesity care, delivering fully online telehealth treatment that combines endocrinologists, internists, nutritionists, and psychologists with continuous glucose monitoring and GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Saxenda, Rybelsus). Founded in 2020 and based in Mexico City, Clivi serves patients nationwide through WhatsApp-based virtual care, home medication delivery via its Farmacia Clivi digital pharmacy, and tiered treatment plans (Clivi Pro, Plus, Total, and Zero). Backed by 500 Global and other investors, Clivi operates as a consumer healthtech service; it publishes no public developer API, but does expose an llms.txt content index for AI agents.

providers.name: Croissant
providers.description: Croissant is the workspace infrastructure layer for distributed teams, letting companies find, book, and manage on-demand access to 700+ coworking spaces across 100+ cities without long-term leases. Founded in 2015, the platform pairs instant workspace booking with spend governance, centralized policy controls, vendor consolidation, and usage-intelligence reporting, giving finance and people teams real-time control over where and how their people work. Croissant serves early-stage, scaling, and enterprise organizations, and exposes Slack, HRIS, stipend, and ERP integrations plus a custom API and integrations on its enterprise tier.

providers.name: CStorePro
providers.description: CStorePro is a convenience-store back-office and retail-management software platform for independent and chain c-store operators. Founded as CStorePro and later rebranded to CStore Essentials (CSE), it is now part of PDI Technologies and marketed as PDI Essentials. The platform provides back-office operations, pricebook and inventory management, lottery and fuel tracking, automated financial reporting and reconciliation, Skupos scan-data submission for tobacco manufacturer rebates, tobacco loyalty (Skupos Engage), and GasBuddy Business Pages reputation management. It connects directly to POS systems including Gilbarco, Verifone, and NCR for automatic sales and inventory sync. There is no public developer API or documented API program at this time; the product is delivered as a hosted web and mobile application.

providers.name: Douglas Elliman
providers.description: Douglas Elliman Inc. (NYSE: DOUG) is a residential real estate brokerage founded in 1911 and headquartered at 575 Madison Avenue, New York City. It is one of the largest brokerages in the New York metropolitan area and among the largest in the United States, with roughly 6,000 agents across New York, Florida, California, Texas, Colorado, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Nevada, New Jersey, Vermont, the Mid-Atlantic, and international outposts in France and Monaco. Its home market is the United States. In the value chain Douglas Elliman sits on the SELL side as a licensed brokerage and MLS participant — it consumes MLS listing data under IDX and broker agreements rather than originating a syndicated feed — and it extends into development marketing, property management, commercial brokerage, title and escrow (Douglas Elliman Title), relocation, and PropTech venture investment through New Valley Ventures. Its API posture is honest and thin: no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or OData $metadata contract, and no published access path of any kind. developer.elliman.com, developers.elliman.com, and docs.elliman.com all resolve to the marketing homepage via a wildcard catch-all rather than to a portal, and api.elliman.com exists as an IIS/ASP.NET host that returns HTTP 403 at its root with no documentation behind it. On RESO, Douglas Elliman Real Estate is listed as a Class D member (Brokers, Agents and Appraisers) on the RESO membership roster but does NOT appear in the RESO certified-organizations directory — it is a RESO member, not a RESO-certified data provider, and it publishes no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData endpoint, and no UPI surface. The single public engineering artifact the company ships is a GitHub fork of a third-party .NET RETS client library, which is consumer-side evidence that Elliman pulls MLS data in rather than producer-side evidence that it exposes any.

providers.name: Ellis
providers.description: Ellis is a modern business immigration platform and law firm that helps company People and HR teams secure U.S. work visas and green cards for skilled talent. The platform combines licensed immigration attorneys with software for centralized case management, document storage, status tracking, and program analytics, covering employment-based visas (H-1B, TN, O-1, L-1, J-1, E-1/E-2, E-3), green cards (EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, EB-2/EB-3 PERM), and naturalization. Ellis is a Kindred Ventures portfolio company. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Ellis publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable artifacts at this time.

providers.name: Ferrum Health
providers.description: Ferrum Health is a healthcare AI governance company whose AI Governance Suite lets health systems deploy, validate, orchestrate, and monitor clinical AI models securely behind their own firewall, without protected health information leaving the health system. The vendor-neutral, privately deployed platform integrates once with existing EMR, PACS, and worklist infrastructure, then routes every clinical AI model — FDA-cleared, CE-marked, open-source, or homegrown — through a single secure path via its Deployment Fabric, curates 60+ applications in its Model Hub across radiology, cardiology, oncology, neurology, and musculoskeletal specialties, and continuously links predictions, ground truth, and outcomes for bias and drift detection through its Observability Lens. It is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR aligned, and is used by Sutter Health, Carle Health, and 250+ sites.

providers.name: grasp
providers.description: Grasp is a members-based, AI-powered learning platform based in London, England that builds personalized, AI-curated short courses. Learners discuss a goal with an AI mentor, which co-creates a syllabus and assembles a structured "learning path" from the clearest, most credible resources on the web - organized into focused, roughly hour-long lessons with clear outcomes and practice exercises. Grasp is delivered as a client-rendered React single-page app with a 14-day free trial and a single monthly membership; a selection of public courses and lessons is browsable without an account, and a sister product, Grasp Concepts, lives at concepts.grasp.study. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and point-nine.

providers.name: Grow Therapy
providers.description: Grow Therapy is a mental-health platform that connects individuals with licensed therapists and prescribers, offering virtual and in-person talk therapy plus medication management in one insurance-integrated experience. The company operates a two-sided marketplace: a client-facing product for finding, booking, and paying for care (with insurance verification and an average session cost around $21 for covered clients) and a provider portal that gives clinicians scheduling, billing, telehealth, and practice-management tooling. Grow also partners with employers, physicians, and payors on B2B mental-health access. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Grow Therapy publishes a public Statuspage but does not expose a public developer API, so this profile captures its company identity, operational transparency, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Haven Connect
providers.description: Haven Connect is an affordable-housing software company (founded 2014, San Jose, CA) that streamlines the affordable-housing application and waitlist process for both property managers and low-income applicants. Its web platform lets property managers publish waitlists, collect and screen online applications, and automate waitlist updates — eliminating paper forms and manual data entry — while giving applicants a single portal to find and apply for affordable housing. Haven Connect is a Techstars Impact portfolio company and has raised roughly $2.9M. It is a SaaS product company with no public developer API; this profile captures its public website, support, and commercial surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HealthEngine
providers.description: HealthEngine is Australia's largest consumer healthcare marketplace and patient-engagement platform, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. Its consumer app and website let millions of Australians search a national directory of primary-care providers and book, manage, and attend appointments (including telehealth) across GP, dental, allied-health, and specialist practices. For practices, HealthEngine sells a SaaS suite - GP Complete, Patient Connect, Online Booking, Appointment Reminders and Recalls, Featured Listings, online payments, patient reviews, and Scripts - that plugs into the practice's existing software. It maintains private, real-time integrations into 25+ Australian practice management systems (Best Practice / Bp Premier, MedicalDirector Pracsoft, Zedmed, Cliniko, Genie, Gentu, Medtech, Nookal, PracSuite, Dental4Windows, and others) so appointment availability and bookings sync directly with the front desk. Home market is Australia. HealthEngine does NOT publish a public developer portal, REST OpenAPI, or HL7 FHIR endpoint - its API surface is a set of gated, partner-only PMS integrations rather than a self-serve developer program, so this profile is an honest identity stub with no public machine-readable contract to harvest.

providers.name: Immersed
providers.description: Immersed is a spatial-computing company that turns AR/VR headsets into portable multi-monitor workspaces for remote work, coding, and collaboration. Its free desktop agent streams up to five virtual screens into headsets such as Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro, GalaxyXR, and Pico, adding solo focus environments plus multi-user telepresence with screen sharing and whiteboarding. Immersed is also building Visor, its own lightweight 4K-per-eye standalone headset. The company is Techstars-backed. Immersed publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, product, security, and llms.txt surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jakarta EE
providers.description: Jakarta EE is the open source successor to Java EE, providing a set of specifications for enterprise Java development. Jakarta EE is developed under the Eclipse Foundation and includes specifications for web services, messaging, persistence, security, and other enterprise computing needs.

providers.name: Kaiber
providers.description: Kaiber (Kyber Corp., dba Kaiber) is an AI creative studio for generative video and audio. Its web and mobile apps let creators turn text prompts, images, and music into stylized videos through features such as Canvas, Beat Sync, Auto-Clip, and an Editor timeline, sold via credit-based monthly subscription plans (Starter, Creator, Pro, Visionary) plus day passes and one-time credit packs. Kaiber does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network, surfaced originally as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures.

providers.name: Latent Labs
providers.description: Latent Labs is a London- and San Francisco-based frontier AI lab founded in 2023 by Dr. Simon Kohl, a former senior research scientist on DeepMind's Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold 2 and co-lead of DeepMind's protein design team. The company builds generative AI foundation models to make biology programmable, with the goal of enabling biotech and pharmaceutical partners to computationally generate and optimize therapeutic molecules. Latent Labs emerged from stealth in February 2025 with $50M in total funding ($40M Series A co-led by Radical Ventures and Sofinnova Partners, plus 8VC, Kindred Capital, Pillar VC, Flying Fish, Isomer, and angel investors including Jeff Dean, Aidan Gomez, and Mati Staniszewski). The company's proprietary model family includes Latent-X (atom-level de novo protein binder design for macrocycles and mini-binders), Latent-X2 (drug-like antibodies with low ex vivo immunogenicity), and Latent-Y (described as the first lab-validated agent for drug design). Models are accessed through the Latent Labs Platform (platform.latentlabs.com) — a no-code web application with a free tier and daily credits — and, for Latent-X2, via API for commercial partners. There is no public OpenAPI spec, SDK, or open-source release at this time; programmatic access is gated through partnerships@latentlabs.com and wet-lab validation is performed in-house at the company's San Francisco facility.

providers.name: LaunchRock
providers.description: Launchrock is a hosted launch-page and customer-acquisition tool for early-stage founders. It provides a drag-and-drop WYSIWYG builder for pre-launch marketing pages, email capture forms, viral referral and social-sharing mechanics, and simple survey questions, so a founder can stand up a "coming soon" site and collect a waitlist of early users before a product ships. The platform pairs the builder with an education layer of founder courses, masterclass videos and how-to guides on customer acquisition, plus a community of mentors and founders. Launchrock is operated as one product line of the Startups.com platform, alongside Fundable, Bizplan and Clarity.fm, and is bundled into the Startups Unlimited subscription; its help content is served from the Startups.com knowledge base. Vevo, HotelTonight and theCHIVE are cited as sites that launched on the platform. Launchrock was originally a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. As of this profile Launchrock publishes no public API, developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI description, SDKs, CLI, webhook catalog or sandbox; delivery is entirely through the hosted web application.

providers.name: Lendable
providers.description: Lendable Ltd is a UK consumer lending fintech founded in 2014 and headquartered in London, offering unsecured personal loans directly to borrowers through a fully digital application. The company underwrites with technology and data analytics rather than relying on a credit score alone, describing its approach as looking at all of an applicant's data together to produce a personalised quote in minutes without paper forms or branch visits. Lendable distributes through the major UK price-comparison platforms including ClearScore, Compare the Market, MoneySuperMarket, Experian, TotallyMoney, TransUnion and Go.Compare. It is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA reference 720261, company number 08828186) and is a CIFAS member. Lendable publishes no public developer API or developer portal — its public technical surface is an RFC 9116 security.txt, an llms.txt, and a set of first-party open source PHP/Symfony engineering libraries on Packagist and GitHub.

providers.name: LiveIntent
providers.description: LiveIntent is a people-based email marketing and identity platform serving more than 2,500 businesses. It connects marketers and publishers through email-native audience targeting, publisher inventory monetization (LiveTag and native ad blueprints), and identity resolution across the digital ecosystem, including its HIRO first-party data solution and email reactivation services. Its primary public developer surface is the open-source LiveConnect first-party identity library (npm live-connect-js) rather than a REST API, plus partner data integrations with Segment, Oracle, Adobe, Merkle and LiveRamp. LiveIntent has agreed to be acquired by Zeta Global. Backed by Battery Ventures and Bullpen Capital.

providers.name: MAI
providers.description: MAI is an AI performance-marketing platform that runs autonomous AI agents to create, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns 24/7 on behalf of brands. Founded in December 2024 by former Google Ads and Instacart engineering leaders, MAI natively connects to a company's advertising accounts and first-party data to deliver real-time performance analysis, attribution modeling, cross-channel budget allocation, automated campaign creation, and bid optimization. Its agents currently manage millions of dollars of Google Ads spend each month for e-commerce and consumer brands. MAI raised a $25M seed round led by Kleiner Perkins with participation from Gaorong Ventures and UpHonest Capital. MAI is a managed SaaS product accessed through its web application; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mainspring Energy
providers.description: Mainspring Energy is a Menlo Park, California power-infrastructure company that designs, manufactures, and deploys the Linear Generator, a modular, fuel-flexible onsite power generation system. Its technology delivers firm, dispatchable, and low-emission electricity for data centers, utilities, and industrial and enterprise facilities, running today on natural gas and biogas with a seamless transition to zero-carbon fuels such as hydrogen and ammonia. Backed by Khosla Ventures and other investors, Mainspring has more than one gigawatt of Linear Generator capacity in late-stage development and operation. Mainspring is a hardware and power-systems company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Meritfirst
providers.description: MeritFirst is a skills-based hiring platform that replaces resume- and credential-based recruiting with practical, real-world assessments. Candidates prove their craft through work samples (Build, Try, Get Seen) and companies evaluate and match them on demonstrated ability rather than pedigree. MeritFirst exposes a hosted, authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents and tools can manage assessments, review candidates, and analyze hiring data. Backed by 8VC and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Miyokos
providers.description: Miyoko's Creamery (miyokos.com) is a plant-based dairy company in the planetary-health sector, backed by Obvious Ventures, making vegan butter and cheese from cultured cashews, oats, and legumes. The company does not publish a first-party developer REST API; its digital surface is a Shopify-hosted storefront. That storefront exposes a genuine agent-commerce surface: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile at /.well-known/ucp, a hosted shopping MCP endpoint for search/cart/checkout, Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth for identity, and an /llms.txt with agent instructions. This profile was enriched by probing that public surface.

providers.name: NoScrubs
providers.description: NoScrubs (NoScrubs, Inc., dba NoScrubs Laundry Delivery) is an on-demand wash-and-fold laundry pickup and delivery service operating across US metros including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, Dallas-Fort Worth, Miami, Phoenix, Austin, and Houston. Customers schedule a pickup through the NoScrubs mobile app or website; trained laundry professionals ("Scrubbers") collect laundry from the doorstep within a two-hour window, professionally wash, dry, and fold it using hypoallergenic unscented detergents, and return it the same day in as little as four hours. NoScrubs also offers monthly subscription plans, gift cards, and a wash-and-fold service for businesses. It is a consumer service company with no public developer API; the site publishes an llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: Over
providers.description: Overworld is an open-science AI research lab building interactive world models - AI-generated video environments that respond in real time to text prompts and controller input at game-level framerates. Its open-source World Engine is a Python inference library that loads Waypoint world models and LoRA adapters from HuggingFace to generate playable, promptable worlds locally or in the browser. Founded by Louis Castricato (CEO) and Shahbuland Matiana (Head of Mathematical Research), both formerly of CarperAI and Stability AI, the team operates openly and publishes its infrastructure as public open-source repositories. Overworld does not currently expose a hosted REST API; its primary developer artifact is the first-party world_engine Python SDK.

providers.name: Photobucket
providers.description: Photobucket is a consumer image and video hosting service founded in 2003 and now operated by Photobucket Inc. of Seattle. It provides cloud photo/video storage, organization, and private group sharing through subscription plans (My Bucket and +Group Buckets, each including 1TB of storage) alongside a free tier. Historically one of the largest image-hosting platforms on the early social web, Photobucket opened a public developer API in 2008, but no current public/documented API surface could be found during enrichment: the developer portal is bot-blocked, the GitHub organization holds only forks and hiring challenges (no official SDK), and the app runs as a single-page application with no published /.well-known/ discovery documents. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: Skopenow
providers.description: Skopenow is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) platform built to modernize digital investigations. Founded in 2015 and backed by Techstars, it fuses public records, consumer data, crime data, news, and online content with AI-powered fraud and threat-detection models to generate intelligence reports on entities, uncover and visualize networks between people and organizations, and surface operational risks. Its product suite spans Grid, Pre-Check, Workbench, Link Analysis, and Rabbit, serving global security, insurance, government, law enforcement, legal, and media teams — more than 1,500 organizations, including a fifth of the Fortune 500. Skopenow ships as a login-gated web application rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: SkyFoundry
providers.description: SkyFoundry, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, develops SkySpark, an analytics and informatics platform that connects, stores, analyzes, and visualizes data from smart devices, automation and control systems, meters, and sensors to "find what matters" in large equipment and facility datasets. SkySpark automatically detects issues, patterns, deviations, faults, and cost-reduction opportunities across intelligent buildings, industrial, agriculture, energy, government, and healthcare facilities, and has been applied to over 15,000 buildings spanning more than a billion square feet. SkySpark is a native Project Haystack server: external applications integrate through the Haystack HTTP REST API (ops such as read, hisRead, hisWrite, pointWrite, watchSub/watchPoll, eval, commit, and nav) with Zinc, JSON, Trio, and CSV data formats, and authenticate using the Haystack SCRAM (SHA-256) handshake with bearer authTokens. The company sells through a network of 140+ OEM, systems-integrator, and value-added-distributor channel partners rather than a self-service public SaaS.

providers.name: Superb
providers.description: Superb is a Denmark-based all-in-one Guest Experience Management (GXM) platform for restaurants, cafes and bars, bringing reservations, point of sale, payments, gift cards, online takeaway, guest CRM and marketing together in a single system. Superb does not publish a self-serve, documented public developer API. Guest bookings are taken through a hosted reservation widget, and third-party systems connect through Superb's catalog of pre-built connectors (accounting, payments, staff and stock management, marketing) plus a partner portal at partner.superbexperience.com. Any programmatic reservation, guest, booking or CRM access is partner-gated and arranged directly with Superb. The APIs listed below are logical capability groupings modeled from Superb's public product and help-center material - they are marked endpointsModeled because Superb does not publish endpoint-level REST documentation.

providers.name: Tock
providers.description: Tock is a restaurant and hospitality reservations, events, and ordering platform used by restaurants, wineries, bars, and hotels to manage bookings, prepaid experiences, waitlists, and guest data. Tock is owned by American Express (acquired from Squarespace in 2024). Tock exposes a partner and enterprise-gated data API and webhook program rather than an open self-serve developer API - access is limited to Premium and Premium Unlimited plans and is provisioned by request to Tock. The documented surface consists of a twice-daily Data Exports API for historical reservation and guest data, a Guest Profile Ingest API for adding and updating basic guest information and tags, and real-time reservation and guest-profile webhooks. Reservation records cannot be created or manipulated through the API. Data-model reference documentation is published publicly at api.exploretock.com, but concrete endpoint paths, methods, and OpenAPI definitions are only shared with approved partners; the API entries below are modeled from the public data model and API FAQ.

providers.name: Tracera
providers.description: Tracera (formerly ESG Flo) is an AI-powered corporate sustainability and ESG data platform that automates the collection, verification, auditing, and reporting of sustainability data with finance-grade accuracy and traceability. The platform extracts audit-ready metrics from raw data across PDFs, spreadsheets, and ERP systems for 900+ metrics, supports reporting frameworks including CSRD, SEC, GRI, and CDP, and serves Fortune 2000 enterprises across manufacturing, real estate, construction, retail, technology, and healthcare (customers include EnerSys, La-Z-Boy, Sauder Woodworking, and Putzmeister). Founded in 2022 and based in New York, Tracera raised a $12M Series A in April 2025 led by Foundry with Rho Ignition, Tola Capital, and Contour Venture Partners ($17.25M total). Enrichment probing found no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or event surface; the website is bot-gated by a SiteGround captcha.

providers.name: Vallor
providers.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Adaptive Shield
providers.description: Adaptive Shield (now CrowdStrike Falcon Shield) is a SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform that continuously monitors, remediates, and governs SaaS application security configurations and identity risks. Acquired by CrowdStrike, the platform covers 200+ SaaS integrations with over 3,500 built-in security checks, helping organizations detect misconfigurations, manage human and non-human identities, discover shadow applications, and maintain compliance across their entire SaaS stack. The REST API (v1) enables programmatic access to alerts, user inventory, device inventory, integrations, security checks, and compliance data.

providers.name: Almanac Health
providers.description: Almanac Health is a clinical AI company building a research-validated clinical decision support platform, delivered as Almanac Chat, that brings specialist-grade, evidence-based answers to clinicians at the point of care. Founded by physician-researcher Cyril Zakka, MD, the platform is designed to work within existing electronic health record (EHR) workflows, is governed by institutional controls, and is grounded in peer-reviewed research rather than pharmaceutical promotion. In April 2026 the company raised a $10 million seed round led by F-Prime with participation from General Catalyst and Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web, trust, and security surface; Almanac Health does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Alude
providers.description: Alude is a Brazilian proptech (real estate technology) SaaS platform that digitizes the day-to-day operations of imobiliárias (real estate agencies), brokers, and property managers. Serving more than 20,000 agencies, the platform bundles rental management with automated payment collection and reporting, instant CPF/CNPJ tenant background screening (análise de ficha), legally valid electronic signatures without digital certificates, fast fire-insurance (seguro incêndio) issuance, automated property capture and lead generation, and capitalization bonds as an alternative to traditional rental deposits. Alude is LGPD-compliant, free to try without a credit card, and backed by Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and MAYA Capital. It operates as an end-to-end web application rather than a public API-first product; no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Amperecloud
providers.description: Amperecloud (Amperecloud GmbH) is a German renewable-energy management software company whose cloud platform provides an operating system for monitoring, operating, and commercially managing solar, wind, and other renewable-energy assets at scale. The platform brings asset performance monitoring, maintenance and ticket management, commercial and technical asset management, and virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities into a single system, supported by migration, consulting, and custom-integration services. It is used by more than 300 customers worldwide managing over 8,000 installations and 10+ GWp of capacity. Added to the API Evangelist network as a point-nine portfolio company; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published, so this profile captures verified company identity and a domain-security probe pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Anzen
providers.description: Anzen Technologies builds AI-powered market access software for commercial insurance agencies. Its flagship product, Anzen Pro, automates the commercial insurance quoting workflow: intelligent market matching predicts which carriers are most likely to respond to a submission based on historical quoting data, automated submission routing delivers each submission to a carrier's preferred channel (email, portal, or form), and submission intake extracts data from ACORDs, emails, and PDFs to generate branded client proposals in seconds. Anzen reports recovering roughly 80% of the time agency teams spend on administrative tasks and serves 200+ agencies while reducing errors-and-omissions exposure. The company holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and anchors its security program on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Backed by a16z. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Aquant.io
providers.description: Aquant is an agentic AI platform purpose-built for organizations that build, sell, and service complex equipment. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, the company turns service content — equipment manuals, service histories, parts and warranty data, and case notes — plus the expertise inside technicians' heads into AI agents that help field technicians, call-center staff, and self-service customers diagnose issues, surface verified troubleshooting steps, predict equipment failure, and act faster across the entire service lifecycle. Access is available by web, mobile, API, and voice. Aquant serves medical-device, industrial, food-equipment, high-tech, printing, and energy manufacturers, with customers including Siemens Healthineers, The Home Depot, Sysmex, and 3D Systems. The company has raised roughly $113M and is backed by Insight Partners and Lightspeed. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Axios
providers.description: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js with automatic JSON data transformation and request/response interceptors.

providers.name: Blackrock Neurotech
providers.description: Blackrock Neurotech is a Salt Lake City, Utah based neurotechnology company that designs and manufactures implantable brain-computer interface (BCI) systems and the research instrumentation around them. Its platform pairs Utah Array microelectrode arrays and the next-generation Neuralace interface with the NeuroPort, Cerebus and CerePlex Direct neural signal processors, the CereStim stimulation system, and the Central software suite for acquisition, visualization and offline spike sorting. The company reports more than 19 years of human clinical study, 1,000+ research institutions served and 2,000+ published studies using its hardware. Blackrock does not publish a public web API: its programmatic surface is a set of device and file-format libraries distributed as downloads and GitHub source (cbSDK C++ API, cbMEX MATLAB API, CereStim API, brPY/brpylib Python data loader, and the NPMK MATLAB toolkit). Enrichment probing on 2026-08-02 found no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP, agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known/ discovery surface on any Blackrock host.

providers.name: BlockChalk
providers.description: BlockChalk was a location-based neighborhood messaging service founded in 2009 by Stephen Hood, the former product lead for Delicious, and Dave Baggeroer of the Stanford Institute of Design. Users with GPS-enabled smartphones left short public messages called "chalks" pinned to a specific geographic point, and read the chalks other people had left on their block, so neighbors could ask, answer, praise, gripe, report potholes and lost pets, announce garage sales and organize locally. The company raised $1M in seed financing in May 2010 from Joshua Schachter, Battery Ventures, Founder Collective, Harrison Metal, Mitch Kapor, Josh Stylman, Tom McInerney and David Liu. BlockChalk published a small read-only public API on its developer page, offering XML, JSON and RSS interfaces that returned nearby chalks for a supplied latitude and longitude, later joined by a versioned GeoRSS endpoint. The product and the company are retired: blockchalk.com holds an active domain registration but its delegated nameservers no longer resolve, and no BlockChalk host answers on the public internet. This profile preserves the historical API surface as documentation.

providers.name: Boxabl
providers.description: BOXABL Inc. is a Las Vegas, Nevada manufacturer of factory-built, foldable homes, founded in 2017 and trading on Nasdaq under the ticker BXBL. Its homes are assembled on a production line in a climate-controlled factory rather than on site, then folded to 8.5 by 20 feet for shipment by truck, rail, sea or air and unfolded on the pad in about two hours. The Casita is the current production model, sold as a studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom in unit-only or turnkey configurations, with a Baby Box travel trailer and a multi-unit Developer Series catalog alongside it. BOXABL publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract; its machine-readable surface is an agent-facing llms.txt, a permissive AI-crawler robots.txt, and an RFC 9116 security.txt pointing at a real responsible-disclosure and bug bounty policy.

providers.name: Carefull Corporation
providers.description: Carefull is a financial safety platform that protects the personal finances of older adults and their family caregivers from fraud, scams, and identity theft. It monitors bank accounts, credit cards, and investment accounts across 12,000+ financial institutions (via Plaid, MX, and Finicity) to detect suspicious activity, duplicate billing, and unusual withdrawals in real time. The service bundles $1M identity theft insurance, dark web and credit-file monitoring, home-title monitoring, a ScamCheck message tool, a secure document Vault and LegacyKit, and view-only access for trusted contacts. Carefull is offered direct to consumers (about $29.99/month with a free trial) and B2B to banks, credit unions, wealth advisory firms, and employers. It is SOC 2 certified. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile enriches the company as a network lead; Carefull publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface (all /.well-known/* paths return the SPA HTML shell).

providers.name: Choco
providers.description: Choco is an AI-powered digital ordering platform that simplifies how restaurants order from their food suppliers and distributors. Serving tens of thousands of distributors and over one hundred thousand buyers across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, Choco lets restaurateurs place orders and chat with all their suppliers in one app while converting orders into a supplier's preferred format (email, WhatsApp, text, fax, or direct ERP integration). Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

providers.name: Clean Harbors
providers.description: Clean Harbors is the largest provider of environmental and industrial services in North America, delivering hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, emergency response, industrial cleaning, environmental remediation, and used-oil and solvent recycling through its Safety-Kleen subsidiary. Clean Harbors does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface; programmatic interfaces are limited to the authenticated customer portal at clhsaas.cleanharbors.com (CLH SaaS) for service requests, manifests, and reporting, and partner-mediated EDI feeds. Customers also use the EPA e-Manifest system for federally regulated hazardous-waste manifest tracking.

providers.name: Construction Monitor
providers.description: Construction Monitor aggregates building-permit data from county and municipal sources nationwide and resells it as construction leads, contractor intelligence, and historical permit research. Programmatic access is offered through a REST + JSON API backed by Elasticsearch and a weekly data-dump option delivered over secure FTP. Both channels are account-managed; partners receive credentials and a documented endpoint contract directly from Construction Monitor.

providers.name: DeepScribe
providers.description: DeepScribe is a San Francisco, California ambient AI medical scribe company that automates clinical documentation and coding for specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2017 (incorporated 2019) by Matthew Ko, Kairui Zeng, and Akilesh Bapu, DeepScribe captures the natural conversation between clinician and patient and produces structured clinical notes inside the provider's existing EHR workflow. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and is deployed across more than 1,500 healthcare organizations, with reported traction of 8 million+ visits captured and a 99.92% note-satisfaction rating. Core products include the AI Medical Scribe (ambient documentation), SmartPrep (pre-visit intelligence), AI Coding (E/M, ICD-10, and HCC automation), Customization Studio (provider-specific note personalization), and DeepScribe Assist (point-of-care insights). DeepScribe ships bi-directional EHR integrations with Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, AdvancedMD, drchrono, ModMed, Flatiron (OncoEMR), Ontada (iKnowMed Generation 2), and Objective Medical Systems, with a focused practice in oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, neurology, orthopedics, urology, and value-based care. The company partners with AWS, Anthropic, Deloitte, and Panda Health for infrastructure, model, and go-to-market support. DeepScribe is sold as enterprise SaaS through a contact-sales motion; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and authentication into the clinician workspace happens through canvas.deepscribe.ai.

providers.name: DocSend
providers.description: DocSend is a secure document sharing and analytics platform, now part of Dropbox, used by sales, marketing, and fundraising teams to share pitch decks, sales collateral, and confidential documents through trackable links. It provides page-by-page viewer analytics, granular access controls (email verification, passcodes, expiration, watermarking), virtual data rooms, and e-signature. DocSend was surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures, DCM Ventures, and Uncork Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Enrichment confirmed a live, OAuth-secured hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at mcp.docsend.com backed by RFC 8414 authorization-server discovery, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), and PKCE.

providers.name: Document Crunch
providers.description: Document Crunch is an AI risk intelligence platform for the construction industry. Its construction-specific AI, CrunchAI, reads contracts, subcontracts, specifications, and project documents to surface risky clauses, obligations, and flow-downs with cited sources, and its Project Assist capability automates document reviews, drafts submittals and RFIs, and answers document-grounded questions across the project lifecycle from pursuit through closeout. The platform is used by general contractors, subcontractors, and specialty trades to track risk, align teams on standards, and act on contractual exposure. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, the company is backed by Fifth Wall. This API Evangelist profile is an enriched company lead; Document Crunch does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Eve
providers.description: Eve (branded EveOS) is an AI operating system purpose-built for plaintiff and personal-injury law firms, founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Mateo, California. The platform works alongside attorneys across the entire case lifecycle - intake and lead qualification, document and medical-record review, medical chronology generation, case and risk analysis, damages calculation, and case management - bringing every case, attorney, and dollar into one place. Eve integrates with practice-management systems such as Clio, is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Menlo Ventures. Eve is a closed SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: First Horizon
providers.description: First Horizon Corporation is a Fortune 500 financial services holding company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. Through First Horizon Bank it provides commercial, private, consumer, and mortgage banking, wealth management, and capital markets services across the southern United States. First Horizon operates a real API Banking developer portal for Treasury Management clients, exposing RESTful products for money movement, ACH origination, real-time account information, and routing-number lookups, secured with OAuth 2.0 and a sandbox for build-and-test integration. Onboarding is partner/relationship gated and no OpenAPI/Swagger specifications are publicly downloadable — this repository captures the documented API surface honestly, humanURL-only.

providers.name: Fraud.net
providers.description: Fraud.net provides AI-driven fraud prevention and risk management APIs. The Public API offers pre-authorization Cart Check, Transaction Check, post-event Update, and supporting device, identity, and email risk signals powered by the Collective Intelligence Network.

providers.name: Gilion (formerly ArK)
providers.description: Gilion (formerly ArK) is an AI-powered financial platform, headquartered in Stockholm, that sits between founders and investors to streamline how growth capital is allocated. For companies it offers non-dilutive growth funding for SaaS and technology businesses, including a Growth Loan and Seasonal Credit, underwritten by AI models of a company's trajectory. For banks, funds, and investors it offers an agentic-AI investment platform covering sourcing, due diligence, monitoring, and portfolio reporting. Gilion was rebranded from ArK and is backed by Creandum. The company publishes a public Trust Center (SOC 2 Type 2, CSA STAR, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) but does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile tracks its security, compliance, and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GitHub CLI
providers.description: GitHub CLI (gh) is the official command-line tool for GitHub, bringing pull requests, issues, actions, and other GitHub features to the terminal.

providers.name: GlossGenius
providers.description: GlossGenius is a business management platform for the beauty, wellness, and health services industry, combining appointment scheduling, integrated payment processing (flat 2.6% rate), point of sale, marketing, client management, staff and payroll tools, and AI agents that answer booking inquiries and follow up with clients.
