It serves solo professionals and multi-location businesses such as salons, spas, barbershops, and medspas, powering more than 120,000 appointment-based businesses. GlossGenius was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GlossGenius publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and public link surface only.

providers.name: GORGIE
providers.description: GORGIE is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand making a sparkling, zero-sugar energy drink with functional benefits from green tea, natural flavors, Biotin, B Vitamins, and L-Theanine — only 5 calories, no preservatives. Built by a women-led team on a mission to make wellness fun, GORGIE sells its variety of flavors through a Shopify-powered online store at getgorgie.com and on retail shelves including Target, supported by a store locator, wholesale program, and an Instagram/TikTok community. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods brand it exposes an ecommerce storefront and customer-account surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: GraniteShares
providers.description: GraniteShares is an independent exchange-traded fund (ETF) issuer that builds alternative, single-stock and thematic investment products for investors who want differentiated exposure. Its lineup spans 2x leveraged and inverse single-stock ETFs (such as NVDL for NVIDIA and TSLR for Tesla), YieldBOOST options-income ETFs, autocallable ETFs, physically-backed gold and broad commodity ETFs, and diversified income and equity strategies across U.S. and European markets. GraniteShares publishes no public developer or data API program; this API Evangelist profile catalogs the company's public web surface and the machine-readable discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 member authentication for its Umbraco-powered site) that were probed from its domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures.

providers.name: Indie Hackers
providers.description: Indie Hackers is an online community where founders of profitable businesses and side projects share their stories, strategies, and revenue numbers to help each other build successful companies.

providers.name: Issa
providers.description: Issa Compass is a software platform that simplifies Thailand visa applications, operated by Issara Platforms Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) and Issa Systems Co, Ltd. (Bangkok). The platform helps users identify which Thai visa they qualify for and manages the end-to-end application process: a two-minute eligibility questionnaire, document verification and pre-qualification checks, real-time tracking of requirements against thousands of criteria, and a money-back guarantee if a pre-qualified application is rejected. Supported visa types include the Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), Long-Term Resident (LTR), Retirement, Spouse, and Student visas. Issa is a portfolio company of 500 Global. There is no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Jifiti
providers.description: Through our white-labeled platform, banks and lenders embed their loans at any point of sale, giving merchants access to the most competitive business and consumer loan programs from lenders their customers trust. Jifiti provides a fast, secure, and stable API for embedded lending and Buy Now Pay Later solutions.

providers.name: Jitterbit
providers.description: Jitterbit is a modern enterprise iPaaS platform infused with AI for API integrations. The Jitterbit Developer Portal provides resources for creating connectors, plugins, templates, and recipes to extend the Jitterbit Harmony platform.

providers.name: Kaizen
providers.description: Kaizen Labs is a New York City civic-technology company building a modular platform that helps local, state, and federal government agencies serve constituents simply, securely, and at scale. Founded in 2022 by Nikhil Reddy and Kj Shah, the platform spans permitting and licensing, recreation reservations and registrations, parking management, tolls and transit fare collection, e-billing and tax payments, DMV and judicial-court services, and AI-assisted case management — reaching roughly 40 million residents across 50+ agencies in 17 states. Kaizen has raised about $35M from NEA, Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. The company publishes no public developer API surface; this profile is enriched from its public website, llms.txt, and security & compliance disclosures.

providers.name: Lica
providers.description: Lica is an AI research company building a substrate to train and evaluate AI models to be capable design partners across expressions of taste and consumption. Its research spans spatial reasoning and composition, layout generation and editing, vector-graphics (SVG) understanding, personalization and brand identity, and animation generation. Lica publishes the LICA dataset of layered graphic-design compositions and GDB (Graphic Design Benchmark), a real-world benchmark that scores frontier models on designer workflows across layout, typography, infographics, template semantics and animation. The company is backed by Accel, South Park Commons and Village Global. As of July 2026 Lica ships no public API, developer portal or API reference; product access is an email waitlist and its public developer surface is the lica-world GitHub organization, including the first-party DesignMCP MCP server.

providers.name: Max Retail
providers.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

providers.name: Octave Bioscience
providers.description: Octave Bioscience is a precision neurology company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that develops blood-based multi-protein biomarker tests for chronic neurological disease. Its commercially available Octave Multiple Sclerosis Disease Activity (MSDA) Test measures a panel of serum proteins to produce a quantitative disease activity score used alongside clinical and imaging assessment, and is available across the United States through a strategic collaboration with Quest Diagnostics. The company is also developing a Multiple Sclerosis Disease Progression (MSDP) test and a Parkinson's disease biomarker assay supported by a Michael J. Fox Foundation grant. Octave publishes a public trust center documenting HITRUST, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, HIPAA and GDPR posture, but operates no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Orionsec
providers.description: Orionsec (ORION Security) is a data loss prevention (DLP) platform that uses AI-powered, context-aware agents to detect and prevent data exfiltration across endpoints, SaaS, web, cloud, email, on-premises systems, storage, and print. Rather than relying on static policies, ORION analyzes data classification, lineage, identity, environment, and external relationships to cut false positives and deploy in minutes. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and IBM Ventures and maintains a public trust center documenting SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR posture. As of this profile, Orionsec does not publish a public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pensive
providers.description: Pensive is an AI grading platform for educators at schools and universities. Its "AI Grader" helps instructors evaluate student work — grading assignments and returning feedback at scale — alongside an AI tutor product for students. Pensive serves distinct teacher, student, and administrator surfaces, publishes case studies with university instructors, and maintains a SOC 2 trust center. It is a seed-stage company backed by Mayfield. As of this profiling Pensive operates a private, authenticated web product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pricerunner
providers.description: Pricerunner is a product price-comparison platform founded in 1999 and owned by Klarna since 2022 (operated by Klarna Technologies AB). It helps shoppers compare prices and products across thousands of retailers in 13 countries (Sweden, Denmark, the UK, Norway, USA, Germany, Austria, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands and Spain). Pricerunner markets a product-and-price-data API for retailers and businesses covering product search, competitor analysis, price history and automatic price matching across roughly 126 million daily-updated prices, but access is gated behind a sales contact form, with no public developer documentation, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve onboarding published.

providers.name: Primodium Inc.
providers.description: Primodium Inc. (primodiumxyz) is a developer-focused studio building fully on-chain applications and games on Ethereum and Solana. It ships two on-chain games — Primodium, a space-based factory-building game, and Primodium: Empires, a turn-based prediction-market game — both built with MUD and Phaser, alongside a suite of open-source developer libraries and infrastructure: Reactive Tables (a strictly-typed reactive table library for MUD apps), a Solana DEX Indexer Stack exposing a GraphQL API over Hasura/Timescale, a tRPC transaction-sponsoring DEX server, an off-chain MUD indexer, and gasless-transaction relayers. All tooling is published open-source under the MIT license via the primodiumxyz GitHub organization and the @primodiumxyz npm scope.

providers.name: Prophet Security
providers.description: Prophet Security is a cybersecurity company building an agentic AI Security Operations Center (SOC) platform. Its product, Prophet AI, uses autonomous AI agents to automate alert triage, investigation, response, and threat hunting across the security operations lifecycle. The platform ingests from SIEMs, EDRs/XDRs, identity providers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), email and network security, threat intelligence, and case-management tools to deliver full-context investigations inside existing analyst workflows. Prophet Security is a Series A company founded in 2023, backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. It is SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR aligned. Prophet does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server; integration is via read-only connections into a customer's own security tooling.

providers.name: Pump.fun
providers.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin launchpad and livestreaming platform that lets anyone deploy a token with a bonding-curve market in seconds; tokens that reach a target market cap graduate to PumpSwap, the project's own AMM. The project does not publish a formally documented public REST API - the canonical integration surface is the on-chain Solana programs for token creation, bonding-curve trades, and PumpSwap liquidity, plus the open-source pump-fun-sdk client. Most "Pump.fun APIs" used in the wider ecosystem are third-party indexers (Bitquery, Helius, Jupiter, Tatum) wrapping that on-chain activity.

providers.name: Rapidminer
providers.description: RapidMiner (now Altair RapidMiner / Altair AI) is a data science and machine learning platform that unites data preparation, machine learning, and predictive model deployment in a visual, low-code environment. The developer surface is centered on the official `rapidminer` Python package for interacting with Altair AI Studio and Altair AI Hub — reading and writing data, running and scheduling processes, managing git-based versioned projects and connections, and calling deployed Web API and Scoring endpoints — plus a Java/Python extension SDK for building custom operators. AI Hub authenticates via OAuth (offline token against a Keycloak-style authentication server). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Earlybird; RapidMiner was acquired by Altair, now part of Siemens.

providers.name: Responsys
providers.description: Oracle Responsys (Oracle Responsys Campaign Management) is a B2C cross-channel marketing orchestration platform, originally founded as Responsys and acquired by Oracle in 2014, now part of Oracle Marketing. It lets marketing teams design and deliver targeted, personalized customer experiences across email, mobile push, SMS, display, and web channels, unifying data from disparate sources into precisely targeted audiences delivered in near real-time. Responsys exposes a REST API (v1.3) and a legacy SOAP API for managing profile lists and recipients, profile extension tables, supplemental tables, campaigns, programs, folders, the content library, triggered email/SMS/push messages, events, and account settings. This profile catalogs the public Oracle Responsys developer surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rockstar Games
providers.description: Rockstar Games is an American video game publisher headquartered in New York City and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive Software (NASDAQ: TTWO). Best known for the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption franchises, Rockstar operates online services for GTA Online and Red Dead Online, the Rockstar Games Launcher PC client, and the legacy Rockstar Games Social Club identity / authentication platform. Rockstar does not publish a public developer portal; its HTTP API surface is internal and consumed only by first-party clients (game executables, the Rockstar Games Launcher, and Rockstar's mobile companion apps). The most visible public-facing API is its OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 identity provider at signin.rockstargames.com, which exposes standard /connect/authorize, /connect/Token, /connect/introspect, and /.well-known/jwks endpoints. Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S and will include a "significant online mode" succeeding GTA Online.

providers.name: Sable Bio
providers.description: Sable Bio is a London-based drug-safety intelligence company building an AI-augmented platform, Sable Target Intelligence, that helps toxicologists, informaticians, and drug discovery scientists assess and mitigate target safety risk earlier in the drug development process. The platform aggregates and quantifies clinical, genetic, experimental, and literature evidence into a unified Target Safety Intelligence surface so safety teams can systematically prioritize and de-risk drug targets faster than traditional manual review. The company is headquartered in East London (Runway East Aldgate) and is backed by Episode One, Seedcamp, and MMC Ventures. Sable Bio was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass it operates a public marketing and product site with a Vanta-hosted trust center but does not yet publish a developer-facing API, documentation, or data-access surface.

providers.name: SecurityPal
providers.description: SecurityPal AI is a cybersecurity assurance management platform that pairs AI agents with certified human experts to automate security questionnaires, vendor risk assessments (TPRM), audit response preparation, Trust Center management, and broader GRC workflows for regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, technology, and manufacturing. The platform advertises 700+ native integrations (Salesforce, Okta, Jira, Slack, Microsoft Teams, HubSpot, Zendesk, Google Workspace, and more) and offers three service tiers (Basecamp self-serve AI, Summit AI-plus-concierge, and Everest fully managed). SecurityPal is a Craft Ventures portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, domain-security posture, and Trust Center.

providers.name: Soketi
providers.description: Soketi is a next-gen, Pusher-compatible, open-source WebSocket server. It implements the Pusher protocol so existing Pusher SDKs and applications can drop-in replace Pusher Channels with self-hosted Soketi. Written in Node/TypeScript with Rust adapter; deployed via npm, Docker, Kubernetes, or systemd. Open source under MIT license.

providers.name: Somethings
providers.description: Somethings is a teen mental health support platform that connects adolescents with Certified Peer Specialist Mentors through a mobile app for iOS and Android. Rather than traditional therapy or AI chatbots, teens can call or chat anytime with trained mentors who have personal lived experience overcoming challenges like anxiety, depression, self-harm, eating disorders, and ADHD, backed by clinical supervision. The service is HIPAA-compliant and sold to health plans, insurers, employers, and directly to parents. Somethings is a venture-backed company in the API Evangelist network; it operates a consumer/clinical mobile product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: SPREAD
providers.description: SPREAD is a Berlin-based, AI-native engineering intelligence platform for complex product development and manufacturing. It connects fragmented product lifecycle data across PLM, CAD, ERP, requirements, and simulation systems into a unified engineering ontology, so teams building automotive, defense, and industrial products can find issues earlier and ship faster. The platform surfaces a set of engineering intelligence solutions — Requirements Manager, Product Explorer, Error Inspector, and Action Tower — on top of SPREAD Studio, a low-code environment for building custom analyses, with 40+ connectors to systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP, Polarion, JIRA, CATIA, and Creo. Customers include Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Ford, Bosch, Audi, and Daimler Truck. Backed by HV Capital; added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Sycamore
providers.description: Sycamore (Sycamore Labs, Inc.) is a Palo Alto, California company building a "trusted agent operating system for the enterprise" — a platform for large organizations to build, deploy, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents across their existing systems with enterprise-grade security, human oversight, and organizational intelligence that compounds over time. Its stated pillars are a progressive trust system where agents earn autonomy through demonstrated reliability, adaptive system generation from natural language, continuous learning from outcomes, and collective multi-agent coordination. The company emerged from stealth in March 2026 with a $65M seed round led by Coatue and Lightspeed. As of this profile Sycamore is pre-product with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this repo captures its public company identity, security posture, and machine-readable llms.txt.

providers.name: Venice
providers.description: Venice is an enterprise privileged access management (PAM) platform built for the AI era, delivering zero standing access across human, machine, and AI-driven identities. Founded by Rotem Lurie (CEO) and Or Vaknin (CTO) and operating out of Tel Aviv and New York, Venice discovers and controls privileged access across the enterprise and removes standing privileges entirely, so that only the right identities reach critical systems and only for the moments they should. The company emerged from stealth in February 2026 with $33M in funding led by IVP with participation from Index Ventures. As an early-stage security vendor it publishes a marketing site, blog, and a public trust center, but does not yet expose a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Virgin Pulse
providers.description: Virgin Pulse is a corporate health and employee wellbeing platform that in 2024 merged with HealthComp and rebranded as Personify Health, operating today at personifyhealth.com. The company delivers a personalized health platform that unites wellbeing, healthcare navigation and advocacy, benefits administration, third-party administration (TPA), and rewards into a single employee experience for enterprises, health plans, and health systems. Integration with Personify Health is handled through an authentication-gated developer portal (developer.personifyhealth.com) and a partner marketplace (marketplace.personifyhealth.com); there is no publicly documented, open API specification. This profile was seeded as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched from the company's live public surface (llms.txt, status page, developer portal, and DNS/TLS probes).

providers.name: Wiselayer
providers.description: WiseLayer is an AI-powered accounting automation platform that provides named "digital workers" (AI agents) for finance and accounting teams, automating tasks such as accruals, vendor communications, payroll accounting, bank reconciliations, depreciation and amortization, lease accounting, and prepaid expenses. The platform emphasizes transparent, explainable AI ("AI that shows its work") with natural-language interaction, automated email digests, and 300+ integrations into ERPs, billing, procure-to-pay, and HRIS systems. WiseLayer was acquired by BlackLine (NASDAQ: BL) and its product is now offered as Verity Accruals by BlackLine. WiseLayer was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. The company operates a SaaS application at app.wiselayer.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Wiz
providers.description: Wiz is a cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) that provides agentless security across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and containers, covering CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, vulnerability management, DSPM, and threat detection in a unified security graph. The Wiz GraphQL API exposes inventory, issues, vulnerabilities, configurations, and reporting using OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication.

providers.name: Zinier
providers.description: Zinier is a no-code field service management platform that helps enterprises schedule and manage their workforce, assets, and customers, powered by generative AI. Its office and field experiences pair ready-to-use productivity tools with a no-code Task Builder for building custom workflows, and an Integration Marketplace advertising 1,000+ out-of-the-box connections to ERP, CRM, and EAM systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, IBM, and Infor. Zinier targets asset-intensive field-service operations, from scheduling and dispatch through mobile task execution and customer communication. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and ICONIQ Capital. No public developer API, API reference, or OpenAPI surface is published today — integration is delivered through the marketplace and end-user product documentation.

providers.name: 8Tracks
providers.description: 8tracks was a San Francisco-based internet radio and social music-streaming service that let people create and share handcrafted playlists ("mixes") of at least eight tracks, discover mixes by mood, activity, genre, and tag, and play them back through the web, iOS, and Android apps. Founded in 2008, it grew to more than eight million monthly listeners by 2014 before declining. 8tracks published a public REST API (v2/v3) that exposed mix discovery, playback token sessions, track skip/report events, and user likes/favorites, but stopped issuing new API keys in February 2015. The company ceased operations on December 31, 2019, briefly relaunched under BackBeat Inc. in April 2020, and the service has been inactive since. This profile documents the historical API surface and web properties.

providers.name: Arena Club
providers.description: Arena Club is a technology-first trading-card and collectibles platform founded in 2022 by entrepreneur Brian Lee and baseball Hall-of-Famer Derek Jeter, operating as Arenaclub.com, Inc. The company combines AI- and computer-vision-assisted card grading, an insured physical vault with 24/7 surveillance and climate control, a digital "Showroom" where collectors organize vaulted cards into collections, and an online marketplace for buying, selling and trading slabbed sports and trading-card-game cards. Members submit cards for grading and vaulting, browse and transact in the marketplace, open digital packs, and can retrieve physical cards from the vault on demand. Arena Club ships web and native iOS/Android apps but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Arrived
providers.description: Arrived is a real estate investment platform that lets individuals buy, own, and sell fractional shares of income-producing residential properties without the work of being a landlord. Investors browse curated single-family rentals, vacation rentals, funds, and real-estate debt offerings, invest in minutes, and receive passive rental income through dividend distributions plus potential appreciation while Arrived handles acquisition and property management. The company reports roughly 981K registered investors, $445M invested, and $95M distributed. Arrived is a consumer-facing investing product with a web and mobile app; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Autonomous Cyber
providers.description: Autonomous Cyber is the maker of FUZZ-E, an AI-powered platform for offensive cybersecurity marketed as "The AI Platform for Hacking." It equips commercial and government red teams with deep reconnaissance to uncover hard-to-find bugs and compromise networks, adaptive tooling that responds to AI-enabled defenses by building custom capabilities per engagement, and integrated intelligence workflows that consolidate data and toolkits inside the platform. The company states it operates strictly in the American national interest. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta; no public developer API is currently documented.

providers.name: Back
providers.description: Back is a Berlin-based employee experience and internal service platform that gives HR, IT, Finance, and Office teams one place to receive, automate, and resolve employee requests. It brings conversations from Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email into a single shared inbox, answers common questions with a self-service knowledge chatbot, and automates lifecycle journeys such as onboarding, offboarding, and leave with approvals, forms, and integrations. Founded in 2018 and backed by Point Nine and Seedcamp, Back is used by companies including Loom, Netlify, Choco, Pleo, Marley Spoon, and Statista. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Back offers an API for custom integrations on select plans, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or reference at time of enrichment.

providers.name: Bank of Hawaii
providers.description: Bank of Hawaii is a state-chartered commercial bank organized under the laws of the State of Hawaii in 1897, a member of the Federal Reserve System and FDIC-insured. It is the principal banking subsidiary of Bank of Hawaii Corporation (NYSE: BOH), a Honolulu-headquartered regional financial services company serving Hawaii, Guam, and other Pacific islands with consumer, commercial, and wealth-management banking. As a regional US institution, Bank of Hawaii publishes no first-party public developer portal and exposes no documented public API surface; probes of developer.boh.com and developers.boh.com do not resolve. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and consumer-permissioned data access to Bank of Hawaii accounts is available in practice only through third-party aggregators (for example Plaid), not through a direct bank-operated API. No Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership and no published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture were found at the time of this record.

providers.name: Camber
providers.description: Camber is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) and medical billing software platform purpose-built for specialty care providers, including ABA (applied behavior analysis) therapy, physical therapy, and ENT and allergy clinics. The platform automates the full claims lifecycle — creation and submission, pre-submission scrubbing and eligibility verification, payment posting and reconciliation, and denial management and prevention — using a rules engine and AI trained on billions of dollars in real claims data, combined with human review where judgment matters. Founded in 2019 (rebranded from Juniper to Camber in 2025), the New York-based company is backed by Craft Ventures, a16z, and Y Combinator, and processes over a million claims annually for hundreds of specialty care providers across all 50 states.

providers.name: CHAMP Cargosystems
providers.description: Champ.aero, also known as CHAMP Cargosystems, is a company that provides comprehensive IT solutions for the air cargo industry, offering a range of software applications and services to manage all aspects of air cargo operations, including booking, handling, accounting, customs clearance, and messaging, primarily through their flagship product called "Cargospot.".

providers.name: ChannelMeter
providers.description: ChannelMeter is a creator management and payments platform for multi-channel networks, agencies, and brands. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Francisco, it provides an all-in-one suite for creator discovery, onboarding, contract management, analytics, and automated global payouts. Its Creator Pay product moves money to creators across 21+ currencies and 50+ countries, and Creator Cash offers cash advances to creators. ChannelMeter reports having processed over $1B in payments to more than one million creators, working with Stripe and Fifth Third Bank for financial services. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Cloudpost Networks
providers.description: CloudPost Networks is a Santa Clara, California device-security company founded in 2015 that rebranded as Ordr (ordr.net). It builds an AI-powered device intelligence and network-security platform that discovers, classifies, and secures connected devices across IT, IoT, OT, and IoMT environments, tying device identity to behavioral analytics so organizations can detect risk and automatically apply micro-segmentation and enforcement policies. Ordr serves 500+ healthcare, banking, and manufacturing organizations and integrates with vendors such as Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, and Fortinet. It maintains SOC 2 Type 2 compliance. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published.

providers.name: Coachup
providers.description: CoachUp is the nation's leading private sports coaching marketplace, founded in 2012 in Boston by Jordan Fliegel, Arian Radmand, and Gabe Durazo. It connects athletes of all levels — and the parents of young athletes — with vetted, background-checked private and small-group coaches across basketball, soccer, football, baseball, running and track and field, volleyball, swimming, softball, tennis, lacrosse, fitness, and dance. Coaches are discoverable by sport and location, sessions average $40–$60 per hour, and every session is backed by $1 million liability insurance. The platform has hosted more than 13,000 coaches serving over 100,000 athletes, with Boston, New York, Los Angeles, Dallas, and Chicago among its top training markets. CoachUp is backed by General Catalyst, Point Judith Capital, and Techstars. As of this profile CoachUp exposes only a consumer web and mobile experience with no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Collective Medical
providers.description: Collective Medical is a full-continuum, real-time care collaboration network for healthcare, connecting hospitals, health systems, post-acute providers, health plans, and payers so care teams can coordinate around complex, high-risk, and vulnerable patients across the entire patient journey. Founded in Utah and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Kleiner Perkins, the platform is known for its real-time event notifications, ADT-based care-coordination alerts, and shared clinical insights used by emergency departments and care-management teams. Collective Medical was acquired by PointClickCare in 2020 and is now fully integrated into PointClickCare; its former developer, login, support, and legal surfaces are served through PointClickCare properties (developer.pointclickcare.com and pointclickcare.com). This profile tracks the Collective Medical brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Component Model
providers.description: The WebAssembly Component Model is a broad-reaching architecture for building interoperable WebAssembly libraries, applications, and environments. It defines components as portable, sandboxed units of code that can compose with each other across language and runtime boundaries. The model introduces interfaces, worlds, and the WebAssembly Interface Type (WIT) language, along with a canonical ABI, binary and text formats, and a concurrency model. The Component Model underpins the WebAssembly System Interface (WASI) Preview 2 and is the foundation for portable Wasm on browsers, servers, edge, and embedded environments.

providers.name: Countable
providers.description: Countable was a civic-engagement technology company backed by Canaan Partners (seed, partner Joydeep Bhattacharyya) that built a digital platform helping citizens understand what Congress was doing in Washington and contact their elected representatives directly, later extending the same advocacy tooling to organizations and brands. As of this enrichment pass the Countable brand is no longer operating independently: both countable.com and countable.us HTTP 302 to https://www.myactionable.com/, the home of Actionable, a self-service advocacy campaign platform made by CSAG that offers petitions, pledges, lawmaker-message campaigns, supporter video collection, lead capture, polling and in-platform real-time campaign reporting on a $29.99/month self-service plan. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDK, package, webhook catalog, MCP server or /.well-known discovery surface was found on either the legacy Countable hosts or the successor Actionable host during this pass.

providers.name: FlowGPT
providers.description: FlowGPT is a community platform for discovering, sharing, and chatting with AI prompts, characters, and chatbots. Backed by DCM Ventures, it operates as a ChatGPT prompt and AI-character marketplace where creators publish prompts, roleplay characters, and AI apps across categories such as programming, marketing, business, and entertainment, and users engage them through free chat, leaderboards, bounties, and paid membership tiers. FlowGPT publishes user- and creator-facing product documentation (guide.flowgpt.com) but does not currently expose a public developer REST API, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK; programmatic access today is limited to unofficial community wrappers over its internal endpoints.

providers.name: GroundTruth
providers.description: GroundTruth is a location-intelligence performance advertising platform (formerly xAd) that helps brands and agencies plan, launch, and measure omnichannel ad campaigns tied to real-world behavior. Its Ads Manager, proprietary Blueprints location-mapping technology, and Dynamic Intent Prediction AI turn visitation, behavioral, and demographic signals into targeting and store-visit and sales attribution across verticals including QSR/restaurants, CPG, auto, retail, healthcare, education, travel, and political. GroundTruth is backed by Emergence Capital and IVP and became part of ZeroToOne.AI in 2026. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; GroundTruth exposes a self-serve advertiser platform (ads.groundtruth.com) but publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: HandUp
providers.description: HandUp is a San Francisco-based public-benefit crowdfunding platform that makes giving to nonprofit organizations and the people they serve easy, secure, and transparent. Launched in 2013 and backed by 500 Global and Version One Ventures, HandUp partners with 501(c)(3) nonprofits whose mission is to serve people experiencing poverty and homelessness. Donors give directly to individual campaigns or to pooled funds such as the National Fund and the HandUp Fund; partner nonprofits then distribute the donations to cover basics like food, clothing, and housing, and report progress and metrics back to donors.

providers.name: Hometap
providers.description: Hometap is a Boston-based fintech founded in 2017 that offers homeowners a home equity investment (HEI) — an alternative to home equity loans and HELOCs. In exchange for a share of a home's future value, homeowners receive cash up front with no monthly payments, no interest, and no income or debt-to-income requirements, settling any time within a 10-year term via sale, refinance, or buyout. Homeowners manage their investment and track equity through the free Hometap Home Equity Dashboard. The company has helped more than 26,000 homeowners and completed over $1 billion in investments, and is backed by investors including General Catalyst. Hometap does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public web properties and identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Intrinsic
providers.description: Intrinsic is a Mountain View, California industrial robotics software company spun out of Alphabet's X "moonshot factory" and led by CEO Wendy Tan White. Its mission is to make industrial robots radically easier to program, use, and innovate with so that automation is accessible to a much broader range of businesses. Intrinsic's flagship product is Intrinsic Flowstate, an all-in-one web-based developer environment for designing, building, simulating, and deploying production-grade robotics solutions, paired with Intrinsic Intelligence — a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities including pose estimation, motion planning, grasp planning, and sensor-guided control — and IntrinsicOS, a robot operating system that spans cloud to edge. Developers extend Flowstate by writing Skills and Services in Python and C++ via the open-source Intrinsic SDK (Apache-2.0), or compose them visually via behavior trees in the Flowstate Process Editor. The platform integrates deeply with ROS through Intrinsic's 2022 acquisition of Open Source Robotics Corporation (OSRC) — the commercial arm of Open Robotics — while ROS, Gazebo, and Open-RMF stewardship remain with the independent OSRF non-profit. Flowstate is currently in a gated beta / trusted-tester program; production access is granted to enterprise customers, systems integrators, and participants in programs such as the AI for Industry Challenge. Pricing is not publicly disclosed and there is no self-service developer signup.

providers.name: Invaluable
providers.description: Invaluable is the world's leading online marketplace for fine art, antiques and collectibles, founded in 1986. The platform aggregates live and timed auctions from more than 5,000 premier auction houses across 53 countries, giving collectors worldwide a single place to discover, bid on, and win items — with over 260,000 items listed at any time and an archive of 66+ million price records. Invaluable also operates AuctionZip and a Private Label / Connect white-label offering, and provides a partner-only Catalog Upload API that lets auction-management software companies add, edit, and delete lots in timed and live sales directly from their own systems. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: JobAdder
providers.description: JobAdder is a cloud-based recruitment and applicant tracking platform used by staffing agencies and in-house talent acquisition teams to manage jobs, candidates, placements, and client relationships. The platform offers a comprehensive REST API that exposes recruitment workflows including job posting, candidate search, application tracking, and analytics. The JobAdder API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with region-specific base URLs returned in the token response.

providers.name: JobNimbus
providers.description: JobNimbus is a CRM and project management platform built for contractors, particularly in roofing, restoration, and home services industries. The platform enables lead tracking, job scheduling, estimating, invoicing, document management, and workflow automation. JobNimbus exposes a REST-like Open API supporting GET, PUT, and POST requests with JSON payloads, authenticated via API keys generated from the user dashboard.

providers.name: Jobvite
providers.description: Jobvite, part of Employ Inc., is an applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruiting platform that helps enterprises source, hire, and onboard talent. The platform combines candidate relationship management, recruitment marketing, branded career sites, and onboarding workflows. Jobvite provides REST APIs that facilitate real-time data exchange in JSON for candidate records, requisitions, applications, and the Onboard New Hire endpoint.

providers.name: Juniper Behavioral Health
providers.description: Juniper Behavioral Health (now operating as Camber, camber.health) is a healthcare revenue-cycle-management (RCM) software company for specialty and behavioral health providers. Founded in 2021 and backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and Craft Ventures, the company automates medical billing, claims processing, denial management, and payment analytics so behavioral and specialty clinicians (ABA, PT, ENT, allergy) can collect more from insurance and spend less time on administrative overhead. Their platform is built on AI systems trained on more than $2.5B in claims data. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from the public Camber website; the company exposes a customer web application (app.camber.health) and a published responsible-disclosure policy but no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Kindred
providers.description: Kindred is a members-only home exchange platform where verified members swap their real homes with one another instead of paying for traditional accommodation. The service runs on a credit economy — members earn one night of travel credit for every night they host, and new members start with five nights of credit. Kindred verifies every member and home, provides professional cleaning before and after each stay, and includes up to $100K in damage protection. There are no membership fees; travelers pay only a cleaning and service fee per trip. The platform operates across 190+ cities in North America and Europe and is backed by a16z, Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Index Ventures, and NEA. Kindred is a consumer travel product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Komiser
providers.description: Komiser is an open-source, cloud-agnostic resource manager for analyzing and managing cloud cost, usage, security, and governance across multi-cloud environments including AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, Linode, Scaleway, Tencent, MongoDB Atlas, and Kubernetes.

providers.name: Lateral
providers.description: Lateral was a Berlin- and Hobart-based AI research software company founded in 2013 that built machine-learning powered content recommendation and document navigation tools. Its early product was a conceptual text-matching and recommendation API that let developers insert documents and retrieve semantically similar content, with pre-populated corpora covering arXiv, PubMed, Wikipedia, news and SEC filings. The company later pivoted to an LLM-assisted research workspace for navigating information across large document sets, and published open-source research on hyperbolic-space word embeddings (Poincare embeddings, hyperplane hashers, WARP recommenders). Lateral was permanently shut down on 26 June 2025; the team pointed users to a successor open-source research platform at coordination.network. The public API, its documentation host and the application host are all retired, so this profile documents a historical API surface and the client libraries that remain published.

providers.name: Lore
providers.description: Lore is a multichain wallet for groups to win together, a co-ownership platform that lets collectives launch shared, multi-signature Safe wallets across Solana, Ethereum, Base, Blast, and Arbitrum. Its Co-Ownership Framework is an equity-tracking system over shared Vaults that lets a group start small and grow both assets and members over time, using Proposals, Group Deposits, Exits, Distributions, and Valuations to manage on-chain treasuries and investment clubs together. Lore provides a consumer application and documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Matterworks
providers.description: Matterworks is a Boston-based life-sciences AI company building foundation models for biochemical omics. Its Large Spectral Model is trained on billions of small-molecule, lipid, peptide, and protein mass-spectrometry spectra across millions of biological contexts, and its Pyxis platform turns raw omics data into quantitative, untargeted biochemical annotations and predictions used for asset and target discovery, mode-of-action elucidation, and life-science R&D pipeline decisions. Matterworks positions biochemical omics as explaining orders of magnitude more biological variation than sequence data alone. The product is accessed through the Pyxis web application (app.matterworks.ai, Auth0 sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Oasis Security
providers.description: Oasis Security is an enterprise Non-Human Identity Management (NHIM) and agentic access management platform that discovers, governs, and secures non-human identities — service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, and AI agents — across cloud and on-premises environments. The platform focuses on understanding access intent rather than static roles, enabling enterprises to adopt AI and automation securely at scale. Oasis targets enterprise security teams through a sales-led (demo-request) motion rather than a self-service developer product, and does not publish a public API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; its product documentation is a login-gated knowledge base.

providers.name: Pluang
providers.description: Pluang is an Indonesian multi-asset investment and trading platform that lets retail users invest across a single app in US stocks and ETFs (fractional from $1), Indonesian stocks, cryptocurrencies with staking, mutual funds (Reksa Dana), physical gold and silver, options, and leveraged crypto futures. Features include Auto Invest dollar-cost averaging, the Pocket portfolio bundling tool, TradingView-powered charting, USD yield products, and the Aura AI recommendation assistant. Pluang operates under OJK and Bappebti regulatory oversight across its subsidiaries and reports 12M+ users. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface. Surfaced as an accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Prax Health
providers.description: Prax Health is a healthcare platform that helps nurse practitioners launch and grow their own independent practices. It provides an all-in-one back office that handles business formation, regulatory and clinical compliance, medical billing, insurance credentialing, an integrated EHR, and ongoing practice consulting. The company's stated mission is to put healthcare back in the hands of providers by removing the administrative and operational burden that keeps clinicians from practicing independently. Prax Health is a venture-backed company (Canaan Partners) and operates a consumer/clinician web application rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it exposes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: ProductNow
providers.description: ProductNow turns data agents can't reach into living docs — context that travels everywhere. The platform connects to a company's scattered data sources — code repositories, sales systems, financial records, legal documents, and support tickets — and indexes them into searchable documentation that stays current automatically, then surfaces that knowledge to AI agents and teams through Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, and other enterprise tools via Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, with version history, access controls, and knowledge graphs. ProductNow is SOC 2 Type II certified and is backed by Sierra Ventures.

providers.name: QwikCilver
providers.description: QwikCilver is India's largest gift card and prepaid commerce company, founded in 2006 and acquired by Pine Labs in 2019. It powers gift card issuance, distribution, and redemption for retailers, banks, and enterprises, and operates the consumer and corporate gifting marketplace Woohoo (woohoo.in), which sells digital and physical gift cards from 300+ brands. Its API platform (hosted on woohoo.in) lets partners programmatically browse catalogs, place bulk gift card orders, activate and redeem cards, check balances, and run reward, incentive, and channel-engagement programs. QwikCilver is an Accel portfolio company in the consumer / fintech sector.

providers.name: Regression Games
providers.description: Regression Games builds AI agents and bots for video games. Its platform lets studios create bots for QA testing, multiplayer simulation, game balancing, and NPC behavior with minimal code. The Unity SDK (gg.regression.unity.bots / RGUnityBots) adds AI-driven automated playtesting, UI and screenshot regression testing, replay and validation, and CI/CD integration for Unity projects, while the earlier rg-bot JavaScript/TypeScript/Python libraries let developers program bots for Minecraft and Capture-the-Flag tournaments. Distribution is via open-source SDKs and templates on GitHub rather than a hosted public REST API. Backed by a16z and NEA ($4.2M seed, 2022).

providers.name: Stance
providers.description: Stance is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand best known for expressive, performance-oriented socks, plus underwear and related apparel sold under the "Feel good, do good" tagline. The company operates a Shopify-hosted online storefront at stance.com with licensed collaborations (MLB, NBA, Disney, and others). Stance publishes no developer product API; its only public machine-facing surface is the Shopify Customer Account API (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0) exposed for customer sign-in at account.stance.com. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and Shasta Ventures and enriched from live probes of its public well-known discovery documents and storefront pages.

providers.name: Storefront
providers.description: Storefront (thestorefront.com) is an online marketplace for renting short-term commercial retail space, connecting brands, e-commerce businesses, and artists with space owners to launch pop-up shops, showrooms, galleries, product launches, and events. The platform lists tens of thousands of spaces across 50+ cities in North America, Europe, and Asia, with flexible day/week/month rentals and a secure booking-and-payment flow, 24-hour support, and a Priority Pass membership. Storefront was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal (api.thestorefront.com is private/401), so this profile captures company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Tem
providers.description: Tem (Tem-Energy Limited) is a UK-based energy technology company building AI-native transaction infrastructure for a modern energy market. Its RED platform is a modern utility that removes wholesale market markups to cut business electricity costs by up to 30%, provides transparent line-by-line billing from half-hourly meter data, and gives generators fairer earnings with renewable-energy traceability across 6,000+ sites. Backed by a February 2026 GBP 55M Series B led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. The customer-facing platform runs at app.tem.energy behind an OIDC login; the platform API at api.tem.energy is a private AWS API Gateway with no publicly documented developer surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Tier
providers.description: Tier (now operating as Dott following the 2024 merger of TIER Mobility and Dott) is a European micromobility operator providing shared e-scooters and e-bikes across more than 400 cities in Europe and the Middle East. The company exposes a partner-facing Dott Partner API — an API-Key-gated data feed (including GBFS-style vehicle-availability data) governed by its published API Licence — alongside consumer rider apps for iOS and Android. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Amsterdam, Tier/Dott was backed by Northzone, Point Nine, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: TOPdesk
providers.description: TOPdesk is a Netherlands-based service management vendor offering an ITSM and Enterprise Service Management platform used by IT, facilities, HR, and customer service teams for incident management, change management, asset management, self-service portals, and shared service workflows. The TOPdesk REST API uses application password authentication (basic auth) and exposes resources for incidents, changes, assets, persons, operators, and locations for building integrations against on-premises and SaaS TOPdesk environments.

providers.name: Tradeblock
providers.description: Tradeblock (operated by Astrolab, Inc. d/b/a Tradeblock, founded 2019) is a mobile-first, peer-to-peer sneaker trading marketplace that lets collectors use their sneakers as currency. Members build a Closet and Wishlist, browse a feed of public and private trade offers, and swap sneakers with other collectors, balancing uneven trades with cash. Every trade routes through Tradeblock's authentication centers, where shoes are verified for authenticity before shipping to each party. The service also surfaces supply-and-demand signals for individual sneaker models. Tradeblock is a consumer app (iOS, Android, and web) backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Trinity Ventures, and DCVC; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Treasury
providers.description: Treasury (treasury.app) is a consumer investing and personal-finance education platform that bills itself as "the first investing platform built for learning as a community" and a "non-judgmental investing community." It pairs creator-led learning communities (workshops, coaching, and discussion forums), commission-free brokerage investing accounts with fractional and recurring investments, and self-guided courses on investing, personal finance, and retirement. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and other investors, Treasury has introduced tens of thousands of new investors to the market. It has no traditional public REST/OpenAPI developer platform, but it does expose an agent-native surface: a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at treasury.app/mcp guarded by an OAuth 2.1 authorization server (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, scope mcp:connect).

providers.name: UNIX System Call
providers.description: Core UNIX/POSIX system calls providing low-level operating system interfaces for process management, file operations, interprocess communication, and system control.

providers.name: Wintrust Financial
providers.description: Wintrust Financial Corporation is a Rosemont, Illinois-based financial holding company operating a network of chartered community banks (Wintrust Bank, N.A. and its affiliates) primarily across Illinois, Wisconsin, Indiana and Florida, plus specialty lending, wealth management and mortgage businesses. Wintrust does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; its programmatic surface is delivered through commercial treasury management. Wintrust describes "API banking" that connects businesses directly to its secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) for account balance and activity reporting, payment files (Positive Pay, ACH, wires, EDI, lockbox) and data-format translation (NACHA, EDI 820, BAI2). Consumer and small-business account data is reachable to third parties through open-banking aggregators — Plaid is the confirmed aggregator supporting Wintrust / iBusinessBanking access.

providers.name: Yubi
providers.description: Yubi (formerly CredAvenue) is an Indian debt and credit technology company operating a full-stack digital marketplace that connects enterprises, lenders, and investors across India's credit ecosystem. Its product suite spans Yubi Loans for corporate borrowing, Yubi Co.Lend for bank/NBFC co-lending partnerships with one-time API integration, Yubi Pools for securitisation and ABS deal-making, Yubi Invest for fixed-income and debt investing, and Yubi Flow for supply-chain financing. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Chennai, the company reached unicorn status in 2022 and exposes self-serve APIs for co-lending and loan-origination data exchange through its developer portal at developer.go-yubi.com. This profile was seeded from the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio and enriched from Yubi's public web surface.

providers.name: Zidisha
providers.description: Zidisha is a nonprofit direct person-to-person microlending and crowdfunding platform that connects funders in wealthier countries directly with low-income entrepreneurs in developing countries, with no local intermediary taking a cut. Founded in 2009 and backed by Y Combinator, Zidisha lets entrepreneurs apply for funding, communicate directly with their backers, post updates, and repay at zero interest so that funds recycle into new projects. The platform focuses on agriculture, retail, transportation, and small-business growth across regions including Kenya, Indonesia, Burkina Faso, and beyond. Zidisha operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or integration surface; this profile tracks its public web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 1Huddle
providers.description: 1Huddle is a Newark, New Jersey workforce training platform that uses science-backed, quick-burst mobile games to onboard, upskill, and engage employees. Founded by Sam Caucci, the platform offers a mobile library of 3,000+ skill games across 16 workforce skill areas, an on-demand game marketplace, and personalized content, with clients including Loews Hotels, Novartis, Madison Square Garden, PIMCO, and the U.S. Air Force. 1Huddle integrates with LMS, HRIS, authoring, and reporting tools (Microsoft Teams, Slack, Workday, Salesforce, Cornerstone, and more) and exposes flexible SSO, User Feeds, and Reporting APIs through a partner program rather than a public self-service developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: 1touch.io
providers.description: 1touch.io is an enterprise data-security and data-intelligence vendor whose Kontxtual platform (previously shipped as Inventa) performs automated, near real-time discovery, classification, mapping and cataloging of sensitive data across cloud, on-premises, SaaS and IBM z/OS mainframe environments. The platform combines passive network analysis, ML/NLP classification and an LLM-driven contextual graph to deliver enterprise DSPM, attribute-based access control, access intelligence, DLP for streaming data, mainframe security posture management, cryptographic discovery and AI security. The technology is also OEM-distributed by IBM as Guardium Discover and Classify. Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, NYSE: PSTG) completed its acquisition of 1touch.io on 2026-05-11. Product documentation is published to a MadCap Central portal that requires a customer login, and no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is available.

providers.name: 24Symbols
providers.description: 24Symbols is a digital reading subscription service, often described as a "Spotify for books," giving readers unlimited access to a catalog of more than 500,000 e-books across Spanish, English, German, Italian, Portuguese, and French for a flat monthly fee. Founded in Madrid and backed by Seedcamp, the platform lets subscribers read on smartphones, tablets, e-readers, and the web, build personal bookshelves, track reading progress, and follow other readers and authors through its social reading community. Alongside its consumer premium plan, 24Symbols offers B2B "reading space" solutions that let hotels, telecoms, media outlets, educational institutions, and loyalty or employee programs license library access for their audiences. The company operates as a consumer- and business-facing subscription product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface; this profile captures its verifiable identity and public web properties.

providers.name: 28 labs
providers.description: 28labs Inc. operates She's Well (sheswell.co), a consumer fertility-care platform that bundles egg freezing, fertility testing, IVF coordination, clinic visits, labs, medications, and concierge nurse support into a single transparent subscription plan starting at $249/month over up to 60 months. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a business-to-consumer digital-health service with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: About.me
providers.description: About.me is a personal homepage and online-identity platform that lets anyone create a free, one-page website in minutes to showcase their work, links, bio, and story on a claimable about.me/username profile page. Founded in 2009 and acquired by Vistaprint (Cimpress) in 2013, the service has evolved to add an AI "Virtual Twin" that lets visitors chat with an AI version of the page owner to answer questions, capture leads into a CRM, and schedule appointments automatically. About.me offers free, Standard, and Pro tiers with custom-domain connection, portfolio media, Google Analytics, and branding controls. It does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Aino World Inc.
providers.description: Aino World Inc. builds Aino, an AI-powered spatial analytics platform for architecture, urban planning, and real estate development teams. Aino automates site research by pulling zoning, parcel, transit, demographic, and environmental data from 10+ sources (Google Maps, Regrid, Rentcast, OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps, Microsoft Planetary Computer, Kontur.io, and the US Census), runs GIS-free spatial analysis, and generates presentation-ready maps and dashboards inside a shared, collaborative workspace. Coverage spans 400+ cities with thousands of reusable data layers and CAD/GeoJSON (DXF) exports. Backed by 500 Global. Programmatic API access is offered on the enterprise Business tier.

providers.name: Aladdin B2B
providers.description: Aladdin B2B is a business-to-business matchmaking and meetings platform that helps enterprises, event organizers, government trade-promotion agencies, and trade shows create qualified B2B meetings that lead to transactions. Combining human expertise with artificial intelligence, Aladdin matches buyers and sellers based on their stated needs and hundreds of intelligent signals, then organizes pre-qualified, structured meetings and gives both parties the context they need beforehand. The platform is delivered through the Aladdin mobile app and the Aladdin Wish Chrome extension, with particular strength across the Middle East and Africa. Aladdin B2B is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Aledade
providers.description: Aledade is a physician-led public benefit corporation and national leader in value-based care, partnering with independent primary care practices, community health centers, and health systems. It pairs data analytics, guided clinical workflows, integrated care solutions, and payer contracts to help primary care organizations succeed in accountable care organizations (ACOs) and value-based payment models, improving patient outcomes while supporting the business sustainability of independent practices. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of gv, ivp, and lightspeed-venture-partners.

providers.name: Aluna
providers.description: Aluna is a digital respiratory health company behind an FDA-cleared, portable Bluetooth spirometer and companion mobile app that let people with asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis measure lung function (FEV1) at home and share the results with their care teams. The platform pairs a hospital-grade sensor with a gamified app and machine-learning analytics to encourage proper technique, track symptoms, triggers, and medications, and surface trends that help clinicians intervene before an exacerbation. Founded by Charvi Shetty and Inderjit Jutla out of UC Berkeley's bioengineering program, Aluna raised a $15.3M Series B and is a Matrix Partners portfolio company; the product is now operated under Huma Therapeutics. Aluna publishes consumer, clinical-provider, and clinical-trial surfaces but no public developer API.

providers.name: Amalan
providers.description: Amalan (amalan International) is an Indonesian financial-services technology company headquartered in Jakarta and registered with Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK). It helps distressed consumers and small-business owners restructure and refinance credit-card debt, personal loans (KTA), online loans (pinjol), and mortgages back toward creditworthiness. Its consumer platform provides a debt-relief negotiation program, amalanPROTECT protection against unethical debt collectors, Credit Score by amalan credit-score checks and history reports, and Credit Checkup loan-rejection consultation. Amalan is not a lender and does not take deposits or originate loans. It is backed by 500 Global. The company runs a consumer web app and marketing/blog site but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Apache MINA
providers.description: Apache MINA is a network application framework that helps develop high-performance and high-scalability network applications. It provides an abstract event-driven asynchronous API over various transports such as TCP/IP and UDP/IP via Java NIO. MINA includes sub-projects for SSH (SSHD), FTP (FtpServer), and XMPP (Vysper) protocols.

providers.name: App Onboard
providers.description: AppOnBoard, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based technology company founded in 2016 that builds AI-driven creative and advertising tools for app and game marketers. Its best-known product is Buildbox, a no-code platform for making games and apps without programming, and its current flagship is Quvy, an AI ad-creation and testing platform that generates static, video, and concept ad variations and predicts their performance against synthetic audiences before any real ad spend. Quvy targets marketers, indie and studio game developers, SaaS companies, and brands that want to replace slow, expensive A/B testing and agencies with fast simulation-based creative optimization. AppOnBoard is backed by 500 Global; its original apponboard.com domain now redirects to the Quvy product at quvy.com. This profile carries the company identity and website properties; AppOnBoard publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Askria
providers.description: Askria (askRIA) is an AI-powered due diligence and deal-management platform that provides decision infrastructure for private capital. It builds digital twins of investment funds and runs three AI agents: Discovery for thesis-matched company sourcing and outreach, Due Diligence for auto-scoring deals against custom frameworks while surfacing gaps and inconsistencies, and Portfolio for post-investment metric tracking and performance monitoring. The platform generates Investor Readiness Scores and streamlines the funding lifecycle for both investors and founders under a usage-based pricing model. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Atom Learning
providers.description: Atom Learning is a UK edtech company providing an online, adaptive exam-preparation and learning platform for children aged 7 to 16. Its consumer product, Atom Home, delivers personalised practice, unlimited mock tests with instant marking, and progress tracking for 11+ grammar and independent-school entrance exams (GL, CEM, CSSE, ISEB), CAT4, Key Stage 2 SATs, and GCSE revision. Its schools product, Atom School, gives teachers curriculum-mapped resources and assessment tools and is used by over 1,000 schools. Founded by educators and assessment specialists, Atom has supported hundreds of thousands of families as a lower-cost alternative to private tutoring. The company was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a consumer web/app product surface but no public developer API.

providers.name: Audiodraft
providers.description: Audiodraft is a Helsinki-founded global audio branding and custom music production company that helps brands design, create, and manage their sonic identity across advertising, video, games, and campaigns. Its service is organized around three offerings — ANALYZE (data-driven audio strategy and brand-attribute analysis), CREATE (custom music, sound design, and voice-over production), and MANAGE (brand-fit validation and sound testing) — drawing on a crowdsourced community of thousands of composers and sound designers across 100+ countries. Audiodraft has worked with brands and agencies including Nokia, Red Bull Media House, Finnair, Fortum, and TBWA. It is a creative audio-branding services provider and does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: AvantStay
providers.description: AvantStay is a technology-enabled luxury vacation rental management and hospitality company operating professionally designed short-term rental homes built for group travel across premium destinations throughout the United States. Beyond curated beachfront villas, desert estates, and mountain cabins, AvantStay runs a full-service homeowner property-management program through its Lighthouse owner portal, a 24-hour guest concierge, and a real-estate brokerage for buyers acquiring investment vacation homes. It is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass AvantStay publishes a consumer booking website and homeowner portal but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Bambee
providers.description: Bambee is an outsourced human-resources platform for American small and mid-sized businesses. Every membership pairs the company with a dedicated HR manager who audits existing HR practices, drafts compliant policies and employee handbooks, and guides owners through hiring, onboarding, corrective action, and terminations. Bambee also offers guided payroll and staff training, positioning itself as an all-in-one HR compliance solution that starts at a low monthly membership. The company is backed by QED Investors and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Bambee does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this record captures its public web and security surface.

providers.name: Becton Dickinson
providers.description: Becton Dickinson (BD) is a global medical technology company that develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices, instrument systems, and reagents. In October 2025, BD launched the BD Incada Connected Care Platform, an AI-enabled, cloud-based platform built on AWS that unifies data from nearly 3 million connected BD devices including infusion pumps, patient monitors, and pharmacy robotics. BD also produces the Pyxis medication management system and integrates with EMRs via HL7 FHIR standards for clinical data exchange.

providers.name: BillionToOne
providers.description: BillionToOne is a molecular diagnostics company using proprietary single-molecule Quantitative Counting Template (QCT) technology to detect disease at the DNA level from cell-free DNA. Its Unity prenatal screening suite (Unity Complete, Unity Confirm, and Unity fetal antigen tests) delivers non-invasive prenatal testing from maternal blood at nine weeks, and its Northstar oncology line (Northstar Select and Northstar Response) provides liquid-biopsy therapy selection and real-time treatment-response monitoring. BillionToOne integrates with electronic medical records through a collaboration with Epic and delivers results through its provider and patient portals. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Birches Health
providers.description: Birches Health is a fully virtual behavioral addiction treatment provider specializing in gambling disorder and related compulsive behaviors such as sports betting, day trading, video gaming, and pornography. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the company delivers confidential online care from licensed gambling counselors, peer mentors, financial coaches, and group therapy across all 50 states. Birches Health partners with 18+ state governments that have legalized sports betting and 100+ national insurance plans (including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Aetna, and Blue Cross Blue Shield) so most clients pay $0-25 per session, with a core program completed in about 12 weeks. The company has raised approximately $20M from AlleyCorp, General Catalyst, and Will Ventures. Birches Health does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Blockpartyapp
providers.description: Block Party is a consumer privacy tool — a browser extension (Chrome, Firefox, and Edge) that helps people deep-clean and secure their social media presence. It scans connected accounts for privacy and security exposures, then automates bulk cleanup across Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn: deleting old posts, likes, and comments, untagging photos, removing connections, stripping location data, and tightening privacy settings. Founded by Tracy Chou, Block Party (also branded Privacy Party) is a consumer-facing application and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Blomma
providers.description: Blomma is an AI-powered career coaching platform that pairs artificial intelligence with emotional intelligence to act as a private thinking partner for professionals. Through chat-based coaching, guided reflection, goal-setting with built-in accountability, a personal journal, and a growth dashboard, Blomma helps founders, people leaders, and ambitious professionals turn abstract aspirations into concrete, trackable goals, and can personalize coaching from uploaded performance reviews and development plans. It is delivered as a consumer subscription through web and mobile apps, with custom team plans for organizations, and does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Bloom Institute of Technology
providers.description: Bloom Institute of Technology (formerly Lambda School) is an online coding bootcamp founded in 2017 that trains learners for AI-driven tech careers through part-time and full-time programs in Full Stack Web Development, Backend Development, and Data Science, plus corporate "AI for Developer Productivity" training. It is known for its income-share and deferred-tuition model ($0 upfront with a job-contingent payment plan) and a tuition-refund guarantee. The company reports 4,000+ graduates since 2017. It is a venture-backed consumer education company (backed by GV) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Boards
providers.description: Boards is a mobile-first collaboration and duplication platform for network marketing and direct sales teams. It lets leaders turn what works for them into a simple, repeatable system that new team members can follow, sharing content, training, and workflows so a business can scale beyond its founder. The product centers on team alignment, faster onboarding of new members, and giving distributors a single place with everything they need to succeed, alongside a Success Academy for training and a brand and referral program. Boards is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; its surface is a consumer web and mobile app.

providers.name: Bolster
providers.description: Bolster is an executive search and recruiting platform that pairs experienced recruiters with an AI-powered talent platform to place full-time executives, board members, and fractional or interim leaders for high-growth companies, startups, and venture capital firms. Bolster emphasizes speed (typically five days to a first interview), transparent flat-fee pricing, and a data-driven approach informed by analysis of more than 280,000 executives across 30,000+ companies, with 350+ placements and a 40% repeat-client rate. It is backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: BorrowMyDoggy
providers.description: BorrowMyDoggy is a UK-based platform that connects dog owners with trusted local borrowers for dog walking, sitting, boarding, and holiday care. Owners who cannot always be with their dog are matched with nearby dog lovers who want to spend time with a dog without the full-time commitment, so dogs get more walks, company, and care. Membership is free to join, with optional Premium tiers for owners and borrowers that unlock messaging, insurance cover, and a 24/7 vet line. The company operates a consumer web and mobile application built on Ruby on Rails; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from public web surfaces.

providers.name: BossTax
providers.description: BossTax is a mobile bookkeeping and tax-filing app for 1099 workers, freelancers, and independent contractors.
