Founded in 2022 and based in Stamford, Connecticut, BossTax lets self-employed users track expenses by photographing receipts, automatically categorize deductions, log expenses hands-free by voice, manage separate business banking, and file federal, state, and local taxes with a licensed tax professional for a single flat fee with no subscriptions. BossTax is an IRS-authorized Electronic Return Originator (ERO) and is backed by Bloomberg Beta and Boyd Street Ventures. The company ships iOS and Android consumer apps; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time, so this profile tracks the company identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Botika
providers.description: Botika is an AI fashion-photography platform that helps online clothing and e-commerce brands replace traditional model photoshoots with generative AI. It turns flat-lay, mannequin, and basic on-model product photos into studio-quality images featuring fully AI-generated fashion models, poses, and on-brand backgrounds. Founded by Eran Dagan and Yarin Didi Meir and backed by an $8M seed round with participation from Seedcamp, Botika ships a web console, a native Shopify app, and an iOS app, cutting photoshoot costs by up to 90% and speeding time-to-market roughly 3x. A public API is on the company roadmap but is not yet released, so this profile currently captures company identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Boxbee
providers.description: Boxbee is an on-demand storage and reusable moving-box rental service operating across California, including the San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Oakland, Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, and San Diego. It offers valet pickup-and-delivery storage, rentable reusable plastic moving crates for consumers and businesses, and an online inventory system for managing stored items. Boxbee originated as a 500 Startups and Google Ventures-backed app-based valet self-storage startup founded in 2012; after the by-the-box operation was sold, the brand continued as a regional storage and moving-supply provider. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Brandback
providers.description: Brandback is a Berlin-based embedded resale infrastructure company (legal entity Arbor Technologies GmbH) that lets online retailers and fashion brands integrate resale directly into their baskets, product listings, and checkouts. Shoppers see an item's future resale value before they buy, resell it later in a single click, and receive store credit, while Brandback's AI handles pricing recommendations, condition checks, customer service, shipping, disputes, and payouts. Retailers can launch a white-label resale marketplace with no upfront cost and integrate with any e-commerce platform. Founded in 2023 and backed by $7.4M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Earlybird VC, Brandback reports a 9.5% average conversion-rate lift with customers including Replay Jeans and Sandqvist.

providers.name: Brightmoney
providers.description: Bright Money (Bright) is a San Francisco-based financial technology company that describes itself as the world's first AI Loan Assistant. Its consumer mobile app helps people pay off credit-card debt faster, build credit history, and access affordable credit through products including Bright Builder (a secured 0% APR credit line reported to the major bureaus), Bright Plan debt-payoff and budgeting, Smart Round-Ups automated savings, rent reporting, personal loans up to $10,000 through network partners, and cash advances up to $750 for all credit scores. Bright is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: Brigit
providers.description: Brigit is a consumer financial technology company whose mobile app helps people manage everyday money with instant cash advances of up to $500 with no credit check, interest, or late fees, a Credit Builder account, and a Finance Helper for budgeting, spending analysis, bill tracking, and overdraft prediction. The app also bundles identity-theft protection and a deals-and-offers marketplace, and is offered on paid monthly subscription tiers. Brigit reports more than 12 million users. This API Evangelist profile is a company lead surfaced from venture-capital portfolios (Canaan Partners, DCM Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners); Brigit is a direct-to-consumer app and does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record is enriched at the identity and web-property level.

providers.name: Cabela's
providers.description: Cabela's is a specialty retailer of hunting, fishing, camping, and outdoor recreation merchandise, operating retail stores and an e-commerce platform. Cabela's is a subsidiary of Bass Pro Shops following the 2017 acquisition, and continues to operate under its own brand with retail locations and a consumer-facing web storefront.

providers.name: Cadence Design Systems
providers.description: Cadence Design Systems is a multinational electronic design automation (EDA) software and hardware company. Cadence provides tools for designing integrated circuits, systems on chips, printed circuit boards, and pharmaceutical drugs, with a portfolio that includes Virtuoso, Spectre, Genus, Innovus, JasperGold, Xcelium, Palladium, Allegro, OrCAD, and AI tools such as Cerebrus and ChipGPT.

providers.name: Caer
providers.description: Caer, Inc. is the company behind YUMI (helloyumi.com), a direct-to-consumer children's nutrition brand that makes nutritionally-engineered organic snacks for babies, toddlers, and kids. The product line includes toddler bars, squeezable smoothies-to-go, freeze-dried smoothie melts, super/breakfast bars, and soft-baked cookies, all formulated as function-first, nutrient-dense, organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, and clean-label. YUMI sells through its own WooCommerce storefront, Amazon, and select retail, offering one-time purchases and recurring subscription memberships. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was seeded as a venture-portfolio stub; it is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Capella University
providers.description: Capella University is an accredited online university owned by Strategic Education, Inc. (SEI), offering competency-based bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees plus graduate certificates across business, counseling and therapy, education, health sciences, information technology, nursing, psychology, and social work. Capella is regionally accredited by the Higher Learning Commission and delivers coursework through two learning formats — FlexPath, a self-paced competency-based model, and GuidedPath, a structured-timeline model — serving working adults and professional learners entirely online.

providers.name: Catch&Release
providers.description: Catch&Release is a UGC creator platform and content-licensing marketplace that helps brands and agencies discover, license, and clear rights for "found content" — real videos, photos, and footage created by everyday people and creators — for use in advertising and marketing campaigns. Its workspace lets marketing teams search and curate licensable moments, send content calls to its creator community, negotiate offers, and handle the legal clearance and rights packages, while creators earn passive income by licensing clips from their camera rolls. The platform pairs a brand/agency workspace (collections, storyboards, teams) with a creator community, using an access-first, pay-for-what-you-use model. Added to the API Evangelist network from an Accel portfolio lead.

providers.name: CHAOSS
providers.description: CHAOSS (Community Health Analytics in Open Source Software) is a Linux Foundation project that develops metrics, methodologies, software, and practitioner guides for measuring and improving open source community health and sustainability. It produces a metrics catalog organized into focus areas (Common, DEI, Risk, Value, Evolution) and metrics models, along with open source software (Augur, 8Knot, GrimoireLab) that ingests data from Git, GitHub, GitLab, mailing lists, and other community platforms to compute the metrics. CHAOSS-aligned SaaS services such as OSS Compass and Bitergia Analytics also expose the metrics for adopters who do not want to host the software themselves.

providers.name: Choice Hotels
providers.description: Choice Hotels International (NYSE: CHH) is a United States hotel franchisor headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland, operating 7,575 hotels with 656,825 rooms open across 49 states, the District of Columbia and 50 countries and territories as of December 31, 2025. Its brands include Comfort, Quality, Clarion, Sleep Inn, Econo Lodge, Rodeway Inn, MainStay Suites, Suburban Studios, WoodSpring Suites, Everhome Suites, Cambria Hotels, Ascend Hotel Collection and the Radisson Americas brands. Choice sits on the supply side of the travel distribution chain as a franchisor rather than an owner: its proprietary choiceEDGE central reservation system pushes rate, inventory and availability to ChoiceHotels.com, the Choice Privileges mobile apps, the global distribution systems (Sabre, Amadeus), the OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com) and metasearch (Kayak, Tripadvisor), while its proprietary choiceADVANTAGE property management system runs the majority of its franchised properties. API posture is honestly none-published — no public developer portal, no published API reference, no machine-readable contract, and no exit path. A TIBCO Mashery API gateway answers at api.choicehotels.com but every probed path returns ERR_596_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND, and developer.choicehotels.com is an unprovisioned Mashery CNAME returning 404 under a mashery.com certificate. All real integration is reached through gated franchisee and vendor channels (connect.choicehotels.com, choicecentral.com, the SkyTouch /CONNECT interface program) that require a commercial agreement.

providers.name: Ciao
providers.description: Ciao (meetciao.com) is a home-sharing platform that connects travelers with locals, letting members rent homes at local rates within a private, trust-based community of travellers while homeowners earn income from their properties. The service emphasizes affordability, community trust, and authentic local experiences over commercial short-let alternatives, and operates across major European cities including London, Lisbon, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, and Tbilisi with 20,000+ community members and 1,000+ available homes. Ciao is a Seedcamp portfolio company; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Ciao is a consumer mobile/web product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Clanbeat
providers.description: Clanbeat is an Estonian education-technology company whose app supports student and staff well-being by nurturing social and emotional learning (SEL) through co-creation. The platform provides well-being tracking, quality reflections, meaningful connections between students and educators, and tools to co-create SEL curriculum. It is used by international schools, educators, students, and fitness and lifelong-learning communities to evidence group emotional well-being and bring classes closer together. Clanbeat is delivered as a hosted web and mobile application at app.clanbeat.com; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or partner integration surface at this time.

providers.name: CLAP
providers.description: CLAP (주식회사 디웨일 / Dwhale Inc.) is a South Korean SaaS company offering an AI-powered, customizable performance management platform for enterprises. It covers the full performance lifecycle — multi-rater evaluations and calibration, OKR-style goal setting and alignment, continuous feedback and 1-on-1 meetings, and CLAP AI for diagnostics, feedback drafting, and automation — with tailored reporting and tool integrations. CLAP serves 1,000+ companies and claims to cut the HR time spent on performance management by up to 80%. The company is headquartered in Gangnam, Seoul, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. CLAP publishes no public API or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and web properties.

providers.name: Clerky
providers.description: Clerky is an online legal service that helps startup founders handle their legal paperwork safely and efficiently. Designed by startup attorneys formerly at a Silicon Valley law firm, Clerky provides software and guided workflows for Delaware incorporation and post-incorporation setup, fundraising (SAFEs, convertible notes, board consents), hiring (offer letters, consulting agreements, equity compensation), commercial documents (NDAs), and ongoing corporate maintenance. Clerky is a Y Combinator portfolio company. It is a legal document assistant rather than a law firm, and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic integrations.

providers.name: Cloudflare.com
providers.description: cloudflare-com is an alias profile for Cloudflare. The canonical company profile lives at the cloudflare repository in the API Evangelist Network; this entry exists so that the ".com" form of the brand resolves into the same canonical record. Cloudflare's developer surface includes a single unified REST API at api.cloudflare.com covering DNS, zones, SSL/TLS, Workers, KV, Durable Objects, Queues, R2, Pages, Stream, Email Routing, Zero Trust, WAF, Magic Transit, Spectrum, Load Balancing, Analytics, and Account Management. Authentication is via API tokens with scoped permissions or legacy global API keys.

providers.name: CloudTrucks
providers.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: CodeKarma
providers.description: CodeKarma is a production intelligence platform that maps 100% of production traffic directly to source code, giving engineering teams and AI agents code-level visibility into how software actually behaves in production. Its products include KarmaLens (an IDE plugin for JetBrains and VS Code surfacing dead code, method frequency, and performance hotspots), KarmaDomain (live API-level dependency graphs across microservices, databases, and async systems), KarmaPulse (an operations command center with API health, error drift, and AI root cause analysis), and KarmaIQ (an MCP server that feeds production context to AI coding agents such as Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Claude). Deployed as managed SaaS or bring-your-own-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), CodeKarma is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and collects only behavioral telemetry — no PII, payloads, or request bodies. Founded by Anantharam Vanchi Prakash and Priyanka Nahata, based in Bengaluru, India, and backed by Prosus, Accel, Xeed Ventures, SenseAI Ventures, and Stargazer Ventures.

providers.name: Complori
providers.description: Complori is a Berlin, Germany based online education company that teaches children and young people to code through live, small-group video classes led by qualified coaches in a protected digital space. Its programs span programming with Minecraft, Python, JavaScript game development, app development, and financial literacy, backed by a learning platform with challenges and exercises, a mobile learning app, completion certificates, flexible family-friendly scheduling, and holiday camps. Complori operates a B2C consumer education service (with parents as the decision-makers) rather than a developer-facing API product, and runs an education scholarship program to broaden access across socioeconomic backgrounds. Backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: CraftCoffee
providers.description: Craft Coffee is a direct-to-consumer specialty coffee company operating since 2011 that sources, roasts, and ships freshly roasted coffee to subscribers across the United States. Its storefront offers flexible, commitment-free coffee subscriptions plus one-off bags, gift subscriptions, and a preference-matching engine that recommends blends and single-origin coffees (Into the Black, Streetlight, Sumatra, Throwback, and more) based on customer taste. The business runs on a Shopify commerce stack with Shopify Customer Accounts for authenticated login; it is a consumer e-commerce brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company for ongoing discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: Cryptio
providers.description: Cryptio is an enterprise-grade crypto accounting, reporting, and audit platform that provides an institutional system of record for digital assets. It ingests and normalizes transaction data across 150+ blockchains, exchanges, custodians, and DeFi protocols, then automates sub-ledger accounting, cost-basis and gain/loss calculation, reconciliation, tokenization compliance, and loan management. Cryptio syncs into traditional ERP and accounting systems (NetSuite, Xero, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle Fusion, SAP, Sage) and is used by 400+ institutions including exchanges, banks, asset managers, and DeFi enterprises to produce audit-ready financial reporting for digital assets.

providers.name: Cyral
providers.description: Cyral is a data security and governance platform (founded 2018, Milpitas CA; acquired by Varonis in March 2025) that provides an agentless, stateless data-layer sidecar for monitoring and governing access to data repositories such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Amazon S3, Kafka, and Oracle. Cyral was built API-first: its Control Plane exposes a REST API secured with OAuth2 client-credentials, fully automatable through the official Cyral Terraform provider (cyralinc/cyral) and supporting Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, and Okta. Following the Varonis acquisition, cyral.com now redirects to Varonis' Database Activity Monitoring product, but the first-party developer tooling remains published on the cyralinc GitHub organization and the Terraform Registry.

providers.name: DIY
providers.description: DIY.org is a safe, ad-free creative platform where kids turn ideas into real games, apps, and websites — guided by AI tools like Vibe Coding and KidsGPT and reviewed by human moderators. Serving over 500,000 young creators, it pairs game-building templates, AI image and art tools, badge-based learning, and 75+ standards-aligned courses with parent and classroom dashboards, SSO, and safety controls. Originally a maker community for kids, DIY is backed by Kleiner Perkins and Slow Ventures.

providers.name: DoNotPay
providers.description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy platform, founded in 2015 by Joshua Browder and marketed as the "robot lawyer." It offers a web-based consumer product with 100+ AI-assisted tools that help people cancel subscriptions and free trials, dispute parking tickets and traffic violations, file chargebacks and refunds, negotiate and lower bills, find unclaimed money, fight robocalls, generate virtual cards for safe trial signups, and automate customer-service interactions. DoNotPay is a direct consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; it is tracked here as an API Evangelist company profile.

providers.name: Double
providers.description: Double is a New York-based future-of-work company that pairs busy executives and founders with highly vetted, US-based remote executive assistants, augmented by an AI copilot (Mingo) that helps assistants summarize tasks, draft communications, prompt follow-up questions, and report time. Founded in 2018 by the former Sunrise Calendar team (Alice Default, Christophe Lamperti, Pierre-Elie Fauche), Double delivers operations, marketing, scheduling, inbox, and administrative delegation through a managed platform and shared secure workflows built around a per-client 1Password vault. Double is not a public API provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Duroflexworld
providers.description: Duroflex (duroflexworld.com) is one of India's most trusted sleep-solutions brands, selling mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, pillows and mattress protectors direct-to-consumer with up to a 10-year warranty, free shipping and EMI options. The online store runs on Shopify and exposes real agent-facing commerce surfaces discovered by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline: a hosted Storefront MCP server at /api/mcp (catalog search, cart, product details, and shop policy/FAQ tools that conform to the UCP catalog capability) and a Shopify Customer Account API secured with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, advertising an agent-oriented customer-account-mcp-api scope. Surfaced originally as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead, the profile is now enriched with its MCP, well-known OIDC discovery, authentication, scopes and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Dyrt
providers.description: The Dyrt is a camping discovery and booking platform for the United States, covering public and private campgrounds, RV parks, glamping, cabins, and free dispersed camping. It is a community-driven service built on user-contributed reviews, photos, and campground details, layered with trip-planning tools, real-time availability, and direct booking for many locations. Its Dyrt PRO subscription adds offline maps, cancellation ("Scan Canceled Sites") alerts, curated free-camping data, and discounts at 1,000+ campgrounds. The Dyrt also offers free listings, dashboards, analytics, and marketing tools for campground owners. It has been featured by the New York Times, NPR, National Geographic, and Forbes. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; The Dyrt publishes a consumer web/mobile product and does not expose a documented public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Eksab
providers.description: Eksab is a Cairo-based daily fantasy sports and football-prediction platform for the MENA region. Founded in 2017 by Aly Mahmoud, it lets fans predict the scores and outcomes of live football matches, earn points based on the accuracy of their picks, and win prizes through free and paid competitions. The platform has grown to over 700,000 registered users making more than a million picks each month, and in 2022 became the exclusive fantasy sports partner of the Egyptian Premier League. Eksab is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), 4DX Ventures, and others across roughly $3.7M in seed funding. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Eksab is a consumer mobile/web product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Enplug
providers.description: Enplug is a cloud-based digital signage and content-management platform that powers communications on screens across retail, hospitality, corporate, and public-venue locations, with content apps for social feeds, dashboards, video, wayfinding, and menus managed from a central web dashboard. Enplug was acquired by Spectrio, and enplug.com now redirects to Spectrio's Enplug acquisition page; the legacy Enplug cloud login remains live at login.enplug.com. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead; Enplug exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Evaneos
providers.description: Evaneos is a French online marketplace for tailor-made travel, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Paris. It connects travelers directly with a curated, continuously-evaluated network of 600+ expert local travel agencies across 160+ destinations, who design fully customized itineraries. A certified B Corp since 2022, Evaneos champions an ethical model in which at least 85% of each trip's cost benefits local economies, and it has served more than 800,000 travelers at a 97% satisfaction rate. Backed by Partech, the company runs a coordinated vulnerability disclosure program but publishes no public product API; its GitHub organization hosts internal DevOps, security, and AI tooling.

providers.name: Expansive
providers.description: Expansive is a Mexican real estate crowdfunding platform (crowdfunding inmobiliario) that lets individuals invest collectively in vetted real estate projects from as little as 1,000 MXN, earning returns backed by real guarantees. It operates as a regulated collective financing institution (IFC) under Mexico's Fintech Law and is supervised by the CNBV (Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores). Expansive handles project vetting, funding, quarterly investor reporting, and payouts through its web platform and investor app (app.expansive.mx). The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It is a consumer-facing fintech investing product; it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Eye Security
providers.description: Eye Security is a European (Netherlands-founded) cybersecurity company delivering enterprise-grade Managed Detection and Response (Managed XDR), 24/7 incident response, security awareness training, EU-native log retention (Eye Log), and bundled cyber insurance to the mid-market. Rather than building its own detection stack, Eye Security combines the human expertise of European security analysts with vetted EDR/ITDR technologies, integrating with a customer's existing tech stack. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a VC-portfolio stub under the mis-expanded legacy name "eEye Digital Security"; the wired domain (eye.security), HackerOne program, and Bessemer backing identify the live company as Eye Security. Eye Security operates internal control-plane APIs (api.control.eye.security, portal, agent) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal, so this profile carries identity and security posture artifacts rather than API specifications.

providers.name: Farther
providers.description: Farther is a technology-driven wealth management and registered investment advisory (RIA) firm that pairs human financial advisors with a proprietary "Intelligent Wealth Platform." The firm has recruited more than $23 billion in client assets and positions itself among the fastest-growing US financial services firms (Inc. Magazine, Deloitte Technology Fast 500). Services span financial and retirement planning, investment and portfolio management, tax-intelligent optimization, trust and estate planning, generational wealth, small-business services, Farther Asset Management, and institutional offerings. The client experience runs through a single-page web/mobile application at app.farther.com and integrates account aggregation via Plaid. Farther does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures the firm's public web, security, and identity surface. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Featurespace
providers.description: Featurespace is an enterprise financial-crime prevention company founded in 2008 out of the University of Cambridge and acquired by Visa (announced September 2024). Its flagship ARIC Risk Hub applies Adaptive Behavioral Analytics and Automated Deep Behavioral Networks to risk-score events in real time, detecting payment fraud, scams, and money laundering while reducing false positives for banks, payment processors, merchant acquirers, insurers, and gaming operators. The platform processes 100bn+ events per year across 180+ countries. Featurespace does not publish a public, unauthenticated developer API; its ARIC documentation portal and mobile SDKs are gated behind customer access.

providers.name: Fig
providers.description: Fig (Fig Loans) is a socially conscious, CDFI-certified fintech lender founded in 2015 and based in Texas that offers small-dollar installment loans as a responsible alternative to payday loans, along with credit-builder loans that help underserved borrowers establish and improve their credit. Loans typically range from a few hundred dollars over four-to-six-month terms, and Fig reports repayment to the three major consumer credit bureaus so on-time payments build credit history. Fig operates across a growing set of U.S. states including Texas, Missouri, Ohio, Utah, Florida, Illinois, and California, and partners with CDFIs and nonprofits on community-lending programs. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars, Fig is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a company; it is a consumer-facing lender and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Flarion
providers.description: Flarion is a data-processing acceleration company that speeds up distributed compute engines — Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Ray — without code or infrastructure changes. It ships an Arrow-native, DataFusion/Polars-based execution engine written in Rust that installs as a plugin in about six minutes, plus intelligent workload caching (query, data-block, and buffer caching) and a performance-monitoring platform for job metrics, resource tracking, anomaly detection, and failure prevention. Flarion runs on-premises or on Databricks, AWS EMR, GCP Dataproc, Azure HDInsight, and Anyscale, with an agentless architecture that requires no access to customer data, delivering roughly 3x performance and 60% cost savings. Flarion is a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures. The company exposes a product console and a legal/SLA surface but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Flarion Technologies
providers.description: Flarion is a data-processing acceleration company that speeds up distributed data engines without code changes or infrastructure migration. Its plug-and-play engine replaces row-by-row JVM execution with a native, vectorized runtime built in Rust on Apache Arrow and DataFusion, delivering roughly 3x performance and up to 60% cost savings. Flarion ships three capabilities across Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Ray: a Data Processing Accelerator, Workload Caching that eliminates redundant recomputation, and a Performance Monitoring platform with anomaly detection and failure prevention. It integrates with managed services including Databricks, AWS EMR, GCP Dataproc, and Azure HDInsight via simple Spark configuration (dropping in a JAR), with usage-based pricing billed per accelerated CPU-hour. Flarion is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this profile the company exposes a product console and marketing/legal surface but no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Flock Freight
providers.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: Food Market Hub
providers.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

providers.name: Fort
providers.description: Fort is a Y Combinator (W26) hardware startup building a screenless wearable that automatically tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Founded by three former Tesla engineers, the device uses heart rate and motion sensing to detect gym sessions, workout classes, sleep, and recovery without requiring the wearer to manually log reps, sets, or exercises, then delivers actionable feedback on how lifestyle factors affect strength progress. Fort is styled as jewelry rather than performance gear, ships in three finishes with 7+ day battery life, and pairs with Fort Foundations, an expert-led training program built around core movement patterns. The product is currently available for pre-order and has no public developer API or programmatic surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and commercial presence.

providers.name: fuboTV
providers.description: Fubo (fuboTV) is a live TV streaming service focused on sports, offering more than 100 live channels covering the NFL, NBA, MLB, soccer, Formula 1, NASCAR and major broadcast networks (ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX), alongside news, entertainment and on-demand content. The service includes cloud DVR, multi-device streaming and no-commitment monthly plans. fuboTV was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a direct-to-consumer streaming brand and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, legal, security and identity surface.

providers.name: Fueloyal
providers.description: Fueloyal is an automotive IoT and connected-vehicle platform company that builds proprietary IoT gateway hardware and software for fleet management, fuel management, predictive maintenance, dual dash cameras, EV services, and OEM connected-vehicle solutions. Its products help fleets and vehicle manufacturers monitor, connect, and service vehicles, with an OEM connected-platform and marketplace for delivering connected-vehicle services and mobile apps. Backed by Techstars, Fueloyal was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Gatheround
providers.description: Gatheround (formerly Icebreaker) is a video meeting platform for engaging, interactive, and inclusive virtual gatherings — team all-hands, onboarding, workshops, learning sessions, and community events. It layers structured agendas, breakout rooms, group shares, Q&A, polls, quizzes, and photo booths on top of video, with recording, moderation, upvoting, and ready-made templates aimed at people-operations, community, and team leaders. Founded in 2018 and backed by Bloomberg Beta and Salesforce Ventures, Gatheround was acquired by Donut in December 2024. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Geniebook
providers.description: Geniebook is a Singapore-based educational technology company (Geniebook Pte Ltd, incorporated 2016) offering an AI-powered online learning platform for primary, secondary, and JC students. Its product suite includes GenieSmart (AI-personalised worksheets generated from a library of 300,000+ MOE syllabus-aligned questions, using algorithms co-developed with A*STAR), GenieClass (live and recorded online classes taught by experienced teachers), and GenieAsk (real-time moderated teacher chats for after-school academic support), plus a CAMPUS physical-tutoring offering and PSLE/JC preparation programmes. Geniebook serves more than 220,000 students across Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. It is a consumer (B2C) learning application delivered via web and mobile apps; no public developer API is published.

providers.name: GenM
providers.description: GenM (now operating as Acadium) is a digital marketing career and apprenticeship platform that connects emerging marketers with mentors and businesses. The platform offers free digital marketing courses (SEO, social media, email, and content marketing), hands-on MicroTasks for portfolio building, three-month remote apprenticeships, and Acadium Plus, an eight-week program that leads to full-time hiring. Businesses use Acadium to crowdsource marketing work and mentor emerging talent while growing their operations. GenM was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company operates a consumer/business web application at app.acadium.com and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Gobble
providers.description: Gobble is a meal-kit delivery service that ships chef-prepped dinner kits designed to be cooked in about fifteen minutes, marketed as "restaurant-level delicious in minutes." The company preps and portions seasonal ingredients before shipping them in refrigerated boxes to customers' doorsteps, and offers three flexible subscription plans - Classic, Lean & Clean (650 calories or less, low carb, lean proteins), and Vegetarian - with no long-term commitment. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Gobble operates a direct-to-consumer subscription business and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation. This profile captures its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GoPillar
providers.description: GoPillar (operated by CoContest Italy Srl, Rome, Italy) is a crowdsourced architectural and interior design marketplace where homeowners, businesses, and small construction firms launch online design contests and receive dozens of proposals from a global community of 70,000+ registered architects and designers. Clients set a project timeline, brief the community, message participating designers, and select the winning concept, with follow-on one-to-one and offline executive-project services. GoPillar also runs GoPillar Academy, an e-learning platform offering professional BIM, 3D, and design courses plus custom corporate training for architecture and construction firms. GoPillar is a consumer/SMB web platform and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GoTenna
providers.description: goTenna is a mobile mesh networking company that builds off-grid, long-range communication hardware and software. Its consumer goTenna Mesh and professional goTenna Pro devices pair with smartphones over Bluetooth to relay text messages, GPS locations, and data across a decentralized VHF/UHF radio mesh with no cell towers, wifi, or satellite dependency. The Aspen Grove mesh protocol stack and the Radio SDK (RSDK) let third-party developers embed goTenna radio connectivity into Android, iOS, and Linux JVM applications for public safety, defense, and outdoor use. goTenna exposes no public REST/web API; developer integration is via the native RSDK, which requires an SDK app token obtained from goTenna.

providers.name: hampr
providers.description: hampr is an app-based, on-demand laundry pickup and delivery service founded by Laurel Hess and backed by Techstars. Members bag their dirty laundry, tap the hampr mobile app, and a local independent "washr" collects, professionally washes, dries, folds, and returns it to their door within 24 hours at flat-rate per-load pricing with free pickup and delivery. hampr operates across 16+ US states with 1,500+ washrs, 11,000+ members, and 300,000+ loads completed, and also runs hampr for business, a commercial laundry solution for salons, spas, gyms, and short-term rentals. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; hampr is a consumer/commercial mobile service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Helpling
providers.description: Helpling is an online marketplace that connects households with vetted, insured independent cleaners for on-demand and recurring home-cleaning services. Founded in Berlin and operating across 200+ cities in Germany and other European markets, the platform lets customers compare cleaner profiles and ratings, book and reschedule appointments, and pay online, with liability insurance covering each booking. Helpling operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile app product (iOS and Android) plus separate provider and agency portals; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. It was surfaced through the point-nine venture portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Herbie, Herbie Plan
providers.description: Herbie is an AI-powered estate planning platform and law firm that lets individuals and partner organizations create wills, trusts, and related legal documents online. Its agentic engine encodes the principles, laws, and practice of estate planning into a system that drafts and assembles documents at scale, paired with an AI copilot for natural-language guidance and optional attorney review through Herbie Legal. Herbie is offered directly to consumers and as an embeddable "estate planning as a service" offering for wealth management firms, insurance companies, and employers. Herbie was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hey
providers.description: heycater! is a B2B catering marketplace that connects companies with vetted catering partners across Germany and the United Kingdom, letting businesses request, compare, and book corporate food services through a single platform. Its service lines span heykantine! (daily office meals for teams of 50+), Meetings & Catering (event catering from 10 people drawing on 700+ vetted caterers), hey! Events (full-service event planning for ~100+ guests), and a Pantry Service for office beverages and snacks. The platform serves 2,500+ companies, including Spotify, Airbnb, Meta, and Salesforce, and has fulfilled more than 250,000 catering orders, returning comparable quotes within 48 hours at no cost. heycater! does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: hobbyDB
providers.description: hobbyDB is a database and marketplace for collectibles — a platform that lets anyone catalog, offer, buy, and sell just about any collectible (Funko Pops, action figures, trading cards, die-cast, and more) at any time, from anywhere, in auction-style or fixed-price formats. It pairs a community-curated reference database of collectible items and variants with personal collection-management tools (lists, condition and grading tracking, pre-orders, trades, and import/export) and a peer-to-peer marketplace for transactions between collectors. hobbyDB is a Techstars-backed company.

providers.name: Home From College
providers.description: Home From College (H\FC) is an AI-powered growth platform that connects college students with paid work from consumer brands. Students earn money and build professional experience through microGIGs (quick paid tasks such as app installs, surveys, product feedback, and social sharing with instant payment) and GIGs (larger, ongoing opportunities including content creation, brand-ambassador roles, product testing, and internships), while brands reach and activate Gen Z talent for marketing campaigns. Backed by GV, Home From College runs a two-sided marketplace across a student mobile app and a brand-facing web platform. No public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Honeyhomes
providers.description: Honey Homes is a home-maintenance membership service that pairs each member with a dedicated, vetted handyman who handles repairs, upgrades, seasonal upkeep, and preventive maintenance around the house. Members book visits, add tasks, receive photo updates, and stay connected to their handyman and team through a companion mobile app. Founded in 2021 by Vishwas and Avantika Prabhakara and backed by Khosla Ventures, the company operates as a licensed, bonded, and insured General Contractor and serves select California and Texas markets including the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; the company exposes a consumer mobile app but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Hykso
providers.description: Hykso, Inc. is the company behind FightCamp, an at-home boxing and kickboxing training system that pairs a free-standing bag, quick-wrap gloves, and wireless motion-tracking punch trackers with an on-demand library of trainer-led workouts. The Hykso punch trackers began as standalone wearable sensors that measure punch count, speed, and output for boxers and gyms, and now power FightCamp's real-time performance stats and workout scoring. This profile is a company stub in the API Evangelist network; Hykso/FightCamp is a direct-to-consumer connected-fitness brand and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Hyperganic
providers.description: Hyperganic is a Munich- and Singapore-based deep-tech software company building algorithmic engineering technology for additive manufacturing (3D printing). Its flagship product, HyDesign, is a browser-based application for creating, customizing, and optimizing 3D-printed latticed parts, combining implicit (meshless) modeling with validated materials and cloud simulation. Capabilities include lattice grading, TPMS structures, shell/offset and emboss/skin editing, image modulation, meshless linear-elastic simulation, topology optimization, and Lattice Boltzmann CFD. It serves lightweighting, thermal management, metamaterials, mass customization, tooling, and bioengineering use cases across aerospace, automotive, and sports. Backed by HV Capital. Hyperganic does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Imerso
providers.description: Imerso is a construction management and quality-control software company that connects the onsite as-built reality to BIM models. Using 3D laser scanning (including a free Imerso Capture mobile app for Leica BLK360 scanners) and in-house AI models, its Site Checker automatically compares the built status of a jobsite against BIM plan specifications, surfacing deviations, progress tracking, and as-built data grouped by traffic-light categories. The platform targets general contractors and BIM teams for automated site supervision, progress reporting, and issue detection, and promotes 100% open data with direct integrations into tools such as Autodesk Construction Cloud. Imerso is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: Immigram LTD
providers.description: Immigram is a UK relocation and immigration platform that helps IT specialists, engineers, founders, and entrepreneurs move to the United Kingdom, primarily via the Global Talent Visa (Tech Nation endorsement route) as well as Skilled Worker, settlement (ILR/naturalization), family, US O-1, and Spanish Startup visa paths. The company pairs immigration legal expertise with an AI-assisted platform that scores eligibility in advance, collects and reviews applicant data into a case, and tracks the process through a live dashboard with data-driven guidance and support. Founded in 2019 and backed by the 500 Global accelerator, Immigram is a services/SaaS provider and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Interintellect
providers.description: Interintellect is the world's leading salon platform, a creator-led cultural center for intellectual conversation founded in March 2019 by art philosopher Anna Gat. The platform lets people attend and host high-quality salons and discussions online and offline, across philosophy, technology, poetry, history, and the arts, building community around shared intellectual interests. It supports independent thinkers and hosts through ticket revenue, training, and a peer community, with paid membership tiers granting event access, members-only sessions, community forums, and global in-person gatherings. Interintellect is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta; it publishes no public API or developer platform, so this profile carries identity and website-property signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Irhythmtech
providers.description: iRhythm Technologies is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: IRTC) digital healthcare company specializing in ambulatory cardiac monitoring for the detection and management of heart arrhythmias. Its Zio service pairs a wearable single-lead ECG biosensor patch (Zio monitor and Zio AT) with FDA-cleared AI/deep-learning algorithms, qualified cardiac technician verification, and cloud-based data analytics to produce end-of-wear diagnostic reports for clinicians. The platform includes the ZioSuite clinician portal for report interpretation and patient management, the MyZio patient app for symptom logging and education, EHR integration, and telehealth workflows. iRhythm was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; enrichment is limited to public identity, trust, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Italic
providers.description: Italic is a direct-to-consumer home goods brand founded in 2018, bringing Mediterranean-inspired beauty to everyday living. The company sells premium bedding, bath towels and robes, beach cabana towels, cashmere throws, decor, and kitchenware (chef knives and flatware), organized into themed collections such as Havana, Amalfi, and Riviera. Italic operates a membership program, "Italic Bold," and runs a Shopify-based storefront with a customer help center, wholesale and trade programs, and an active blog. Backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Kindred Ventures, Italic is a consumer e-commerce retailer with no public developer API surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Jobbatical
providers.description: Jobbatical is a global mobility and immigration platform that helps companies manage international employee relocations, work visas, residence permits, and cross-border compliance across 45+ countries. It combines AI-powered case automation with expert immigration support to streamline eligibility assessments, visa and permit applications, renewal tracking, and settlement services for HR and mobility teams. The product centralizes case management, document processing, visa form automation, real-time status tracking, and renewal alerts, and offers pay-as-you-go or pre-purchased credit (FlexyPocket) pricing. Backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Join
providers.description: Join (Join Stories, join-stories.com) is an AI video commerce platform that helps e-commerce brands create, distribute, and measure short-form video across their sales channels. Its products include shoppable video embedded on product and collection pages, user-generated content (UGC) activation from social media, video analytics with A/B testing, an AI Studio that generates video and images from product data, and interactive web stories. Deployment is a single embed snippet with native integrations for Shopify, PrestaShop, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WooCommerce, and headless storefronts. The company is backed by Canaan Partners and Seedcamp.

providers.name: JusticeText
providers.description: JusticeText is an AI-powered discovery and evidence-review platform built for public defenders and criminal defense attorneys. It transcribes and translates audio and video evidence (body-worn camera, dashcam, jail calls, and courtroom proceedings) in more than 100 languages, syncs multiple camera angles into unified timelines, generates AI summaries of lengthy materials, and produces court-ready exhibits with clipping, redaction, and closed captioning. Its MirandaAI assistant surfaces connections across discovery, builds timelines, and flags inconsistencies. JusticeText is backed by 500 Global and Bloomberg Beta. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; JusticeText ships a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Kixeye
providers.description: KIXEYE Inc. is a video game developer and publisher founded in 2009 and headquartered in Victoria, British Columbia, with staff across Canada and the United States. KIXEYE creates, develops, and publishes massively multiplayer online real-time strategy (MMORTS) games for browsers, tablets, and smartphones, including Battle Pirates, War Commander, War Commander: Rogue Assault, and Rise of Firstborn. An early innovator in the free-to-play genre, KIXEYE operates long-lived live-service game worlds with monthly events, alliances, and competitive leaderboards for millions of players worldwide. KIXEYE is part of the Stillfront Group. KIXEYE publishes no public developer program or partner API; its api.kixeye.com host is a private game-services backend that exposes an OpenID Connect discovery document and JWKS for token verification. The company does maintain a public GitHub organization of open-source infrastructure libraries (chassis, kixmpp, janus, scout) used to build its own cloud services.

providers.name: KLA
providers.description: KLA Corporation (formerly KLA-Tencor) is a leader in process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. KLA delivers advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, and computational analytics for the semiconductor industry. KLA does not publish a public developer portal or open API program; customer-facing software and tool APIs are provided to KLA customers under contract and are not publicly available.

providers.name: Komodor
providers.description: Komodor is an autonomous AI SRE platform for Kubernetes observability, troubleshooting, and operations across multiple clusters. The platform surfaces cluster events, deployment timelines, dependency maps, and remediation runbooks to help platform and SRE teams diagnose incidents faster. Komodor exposes a REST API plus a Terraform provider for managing clusters, services, monitors, and policies, authenticated with API keys generated from the User Settings page.

providers.name: LIFT Aircraft
providers.description: LIFT Aircraft is an Austin, Texas experiential aviation company founded by former Boeing engineer Matt Chasen, built around HEXA — an amphibious electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft with eighteen independent electric motors and propellers, a 432lb carbon fibre airframe, a triply redundant autopilot flown with a single three-axis joystick, an autonomous ballistic parachute, and enough redundancy to fly and land safely with up to six motors disabled. Because HEXA is compliant with the FAA's powered ultralight classification, no pilot's licence is required, and LIFT sells flight as a paid experience rather than selling aircraft — a short training session followed by a solo flight from waterfront bases in Austin and other US cities. The company has raised over $25 million from venture capital, accredited investors and US government grants, has worked with the US Air Force Agility Prime programme and the US Army, and has begun the FAA type certification process for a commercial edition. LIFT publishes no developer REST API or OpenAPI; its only machine-readable surface is a live, unauthenticated Model Context Protocol endpoint and an llms.txt served by its Wix-hosted site.

providers.name: Liveboard
providers.description: LiveBoard is a tutor-management platform that helps tutoring businesses, academies, and independent tutors run their operations end to end. It combines branded virtual classrooms (video calls, screen sharing, an interactive whiteboard, recording, and file sharing) with session scheduling and attendance tracking, tutor/student/parent management, calendar-based billing with online payments, auto-invoicing, payroll, and progress reporting. Liveboard says it serves 200,000+ tutors and companies across 200+ countries, scaling from solo tutors to organizations with thousands of tutors. It is a consumer/SaaS product with no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface at this time; integrations are teaching-focused (Wacom pen tablets, a LaTeX formula editor, and the Desmos graphing calculator). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LocBox Labs
providers.description: LocBox Labs is associated with Hownd, Inc. (formerly FetchRev), a Tempe, Arizona automated promotions and local-merchant marketing platform that helps restaurants, health and beauty businesses, family entertainment centers, and retail merchants generate new and repeat customers. The platform runs automated marketing across web popups, email drip campaigns, social media, a MyHownd consumer mobile app, buy-now buttons, and guest-WiFi capture on a pay-per-visit billing model. The merchant application runs at app.locbox.com. This provider was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface could be found on the provider's public properties.

providers.name: Marin Software
providers.description: Marin Software is a performance marketing and digital advertising management platform used by e-commerce brands, agencies, and enterprise marketers to plan, automate, and optimize paid media at scale across paid search, paid social, retail media, and app advertising channels. Its product line includes MarinOne (campaign management and automation), Marin Connect (marketing data collection and unification), Marin Ascend (cross-channel optimization), Marin for Agencies, and managed services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Sapphire Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Marin publishes a marketing site, help center, and application login but no public API developer portal or specification.

providers.name: Markable
providers.description: Markable (markable.ai) is an all-in-one monetization platform for affiliate creators and social-commerce influencers. It turns social posts into revenue with smart affiliate deeplinks across Amazon, Target, and Walmart, a shop-in-bio storefront, storefront sync for product collections, Instagram auto-DM replies, AI-generated collages and captions, viral-product discovery, and performance analytics. It is offered as an iOS app and a desktop web app, with a creator performance/boosting program. Markable is backed by Partech. No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Melodics
providers.description: Melodics is a New Zealand-based interactive music-learning application that teaches drums, MIDI keyboards, and pad controllers (finger drumming) through gamified, real-time lessons. It connects to electronic instruments and MIDI controllers to give immediate feedback on timing and accuracy, offering guided learning paths, song tutorials, and structured daily practice for beginner through advanced players across desktop and mobile. Melodics is a consumer edtech product and a portfolio company of 500 Global; it publishes no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mero
providers.description: Mero is a Canadian SaaS platform for commercial building cleaning operations that uses smart sensors and analytics to automatically log, validate, and prove cleaning activity without manual input from janitorial staff. Its product is organized into three modules: Validate (hands-free proof that cleaning was completed), Dispatch (occupancy- and supply-driven scheduling), and Inspect (in-app QA and inspection tooling). Mero serves janitorial companies, property managers, and commercial facilities, with data captured across roughly 100M square feet at customers including Harvard, Colliers, and Toronto Pearson Airport. The company advertises a data-integration API and a Zapier connector to send and receive data with other tools, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; API access is gated behind a sales demo.

providers.name: Mineral Forecast
providers.description: Mineral Forecast is a geosciences AI company (backed by Techstars) that helps mineral exploration and mining teams identify the best drilling targets. Its explainable-AI geoscientific platform ingests exploration data to accelerate prospecting and site targeting across base metals, ferrous and industrial metals, industrial minerals, precious metals, and rare earth elements. Products include an AI geosciences platform, AI targeting, AI geological explainability analytics, and a Geo-Insights Hub, positioned as a human-centered decision-support tool for experienced geologists worldwide. As of this enrichment pass Mineral Forecast operates a B2B product and marketing website with no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface; engagement is via request-a-demo and sales.

providers.name: MLOps
providers.description: MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) is an engineering discipline that unifies machine learning development with operations to deploy, monitor, govern, and maintain machine learning models in production. MLOps.org publishes an end-to-end reference for designing, building, and managing reproducible, testable, and evolvable ML-powered software, including the CRISP-ML(Q) process model, the MLOps Stack Canvas, MLOps principles, and ML model governance practices. This index curates the canonical references, frameworks, and ecosystem resources for practicing MLOps across data engineering, ML pipelines, and model serving.

providers.name: MyFavorito
providers.description: MyFavorito is a fan-empowered sports sponsorship platform that turns fan loyalty into revenue for sports clubs. Fans choose their favorite club, brands activate campaigns, and clubs earn money through a digital marketplace that connects sponsors, clubs, and supporters. The platform combines sponsorship, fan engagement, and CRM tooling for grassroots clubs, top clubs, and brands. Backed by 500 Global and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api/developer/docs host, OpenAPI, well-known, or llms.txt), so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Naluri
providers.description: Naluri is a digital health and corporate wellness platform operating across Southeast Asia. It delivers Employee Assistance Programmes, chronic disease management (mental health, obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol), health coaching and consultations, performance workshops, and Mental Health First Aid training for employers, insurers, and individuals. The company reports serving over one million members and 200-plus companies, and states it is certified for HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO/IEC 27001. No public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Neara
providers.description: Neara is a physics-enabled digital twin platform for electric utilities and network operators. It builds a single, physics-accurate 3D model of a utility's entire network from LiDAR, GIS, and imagery, then runs engineering-grade simulations across vegetation management, wildfire and flood mitigation, severe-weather response, clearance and conductor-clash analysis, pole utilization and FEA, asset inspection and lifecycle management, and transmission and distribution network design. Utilities use Neara to plan, harden, and operate their grids at scale — forecasting and backcasting resilience, prioritizing risk, and optimizing capital spend across millions of assets. Founded in Australia, Neara operates regionally across ANZ, the USA, and Europe.

providers.name: Newoldstamp
providers.description: Newoldstamp is an email signature management platform that lets companies create, brand, and centrally manage professional email signatures across their teams. It provides a signature generator with customizable templates, department- and role-based signature deployment, email signature marketing banners and campaigns, click analytics, and integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and popular email clients. Newoldstamp also operates Pearl Diver, a website-visitor identification product. Founded in 2016 and backed by 500 Global, it serves marketing, sales, and IT teams that want consistent branded email signatures at scale. The company exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: NexMind
providers.description: NexMind (operating as NexLaw) is a legal AI platform for U.S. litigators and law firms, offering secure, hallucination-free AI that drafts, summarizes, and researches legal work up to 10x faster. Its products include NeXa (AI legal research and drafting assistant), ChronoVault (evidence centralization and automated case timelines), TrialPrep (trial preparation workspace for arguments and witness outlines), and a real-time Courtroom Assistant, with capabilities spanning citation-backed legal deep research, deposition and document analysis, case chronology building, legal memo drafting, and contract and breach analysis. NexLaw is a direct-to-user SaaS product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Noosh
providers.description: Noosh is a marketing execution and print/procurement management platform that gives enterprise marketing teams visibility and control over campaigns spanning direct mail, print, and point-of-sale (POS) materials. The software coordinates collaborative marketing workflows, agency and supplier performance tracking, vendor diversity management, and cost, quality, time, and sustainability data, and integrates with procurement and other enterprise systems. Noosh was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Noosh operates a customer-facing web application (Procurement Portal and Administration Portal) but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: OnStation
providers.description: OnStation is a digital stationing platform for road and highway construction projects, replacing paper station logs and manual chaining with GPS-based field documentation. Its iOS and Android mobile app lets crews, inspectors, and project managers identify exact station locations, drop and share flags, capture timestamped photos and notes, and complete forms in the field without extra hardware. A cloud Data Portal aggregates that field documentation into searchable, exportable DOT-ready reports for compliance and dispute resolution, while Active Worksite alerts drivers through Waze and OEM systems when crews are working. OnStation offers pre-built integrations with construction and survey systems including HCSS HeavyJob, Trimble and Bad Elf GNSS receivers, TransTech density gauges, FleetWatcher e-ticketing, and ESRI GIS, but does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners and Techstars.

providers.name: OpenSponsorship
providers.description: OpenSponsorship is a two-sided sports sponsorship and influencer marketing marketplace that connects brands with a network of more than 25,000 professional athletes, teams, sports creators, and health and wellness influencers across 150+ sports. Brands pay a monthly subscription to search the roster, post campaigns, submit proposals, manage contracts, and track ROI, while athletes and their agents join for free with OpenSponsorship taking a commission on secured deals. The platform layers AI-based matching, social-content search, campaign management, and reporting on top of a managed service that handles matching, outreach, contracts, and reporting. OpenSponsorship exposes no public developer API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Optimyzee
providers.description: Optimyzee is an AI-powered ad management platform that structures and optimizes Google Ads search campaigns in minutes, acting like a senior PPC specialist. It analyzes a website and its keywords to generate an optimized campaign structure, keyword plans, and responsive search ad copy, then validates ads against Google Ads standards in real time to improve click-through rate, conversion rate, and Quality Score while lowering cost-per-click. It targets business owners, marketing agencies, and individual marketers. Backed by 500 Global and Triple S Ventures, it is a consumer-facing SaaS product with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Opto
providers.description: Opto (Opto Investments) is an end-to-end private markets investment platform built for wealth managers - RIAs, family offices, and private banks. The platform helps advisors build, fundraise for, and manage private investment programs across asset classes including infrastructure, private credit, private equity, real estate, and venture capital. Opto covers the full workflow: modeling allocations and automating operations to build a program, creating client materials and streamlining subscriptions to fundraise, and deploying capital with automated post-trade reporting to manage it. The company connects to existing custodians, investment-management tools, and reporting providers, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; access is through the advisor application and partner program.

providers.name: Ordr
providers.description: Ordr provides AI-powered security for connected devices, delivering a Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) platform that discovers, classifies, and secures IT, IoT, OT, and IoMT devices across enterprise networks. The platform combines device intelligence, risk and vulnerability management, network segmentation, and zero-trust enforcement to move organizations from visibility to action. Ordr integrates with existing security and networking infrastructure (Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Fortinet, Aruba, Juniper) and serves healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, government, and retail sectors. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and enriched from Ordr's public web surface; Ordr does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Owler
providers.description: Owler is a crowdsourced competitive- and business-intelligence platform that maintains real-time profiles on more than 20 million public and private companies, tracking firmographics, funding, and news across 45M+ competitive relationships contributed and validated by a community of 5M+ business professionals. It is delivered as web and mobile apps (Owler Community, Pro, and Max), a Chrome extension, and CRM and collaboration integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft Teams, ChatGPT). Its "Owler API" is an enterprise data-licensing offering — a competitive relationship graph, dynamic firmographics, and content monitoring — sold via sales contact rather than a self-serve public developer API; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface. Owler was acquired by Meltwater in 2021. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Norwest Venture Partners portfolio.

providers.name: Owner.com
providers.description: Owner.com is an all-in-one, done-for-you digital platform for independent restaurants - an AI-built website with SEO, commission-free online and direct ordering, a branded mobile app, email/SMS and push marketing, automated campaigns, a loyalty and rewards program, plus delivery and catering management and reporting - sold as a per-location monthly subscription. Owner.com is a closed SaaS product operated as a managed service for small and independent restaurant operators. It does NOT publish a public or partner developer API, SDK, or developer portal, and exposes no documented, self-serve, programmatic endpoints. It advertises "POS integrations" (Toast, Clover, Square) and payment integrations (Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay), but these are configured by Owner.com's own team as part of onboarding rather than offered as documented API surfaces to third-party developers. As of this writing there is no programmatic API to model - this entry is documented honestly as a no-public-API provider.

providers.name: Oze
providers.description: Oze is an African fintech platform on a mission to help small businesses grow, with a stated vision of building 100 million profitable businesses. Operating across Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda, and Madagascar, Oze offers a Business App for bookkeeping, invoicing, inventory management, and online sales; no-collateral SME loans; and lending-management software that banks and microfinance institutions use to issue loans to small businesses. The company reports serving over 300,000 businesses. Oze is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. At the time of this enrichment pass Oze publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Panjiva
providers.description: Panjiva is a supply chain intelligence platform owned by S&P Global Market Intelligence that delivers data-driven insights for the global trade community. It combines global import/export shipment records with machine learning analytics to profile companies, map supply chains, benchmark competitors, surface sales leads, and assess counterparty and supply-chain risk. Panjiva covers roughly 9 million companies and more than 2 billion shipment records spanning an estimated 35% of global trade flows. Trade data is also delivered programmatically to CRM systems, quantitative models, and research workflows through S&P Global's XpressFeed data-feed service and is surfaced inside S&P Capital IQ Pro. Access is enterprise and subscription based; Panjiva does not publish a public self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Peerspace
providers.description: Peerspace is an online marketplace for booking unique venues and spaces by the hour — event spaces, meeting rooms, photo and film studios, production locations, and unconventional rooms and residences — connecting space owners (hosts) with people who need distinctive locations for events, meetings, photo shoots, and productions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network. Peerspace operates a consumer marketplace with web and mobile apps but does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, security posture, and legal and support surface.

providers.name: Perennial Labs
providers.description: Perennial is an on-chain (EVM) perpetual-derivatives protocol — a composable, fully on-chain primitive for permissionless perpetual markets, liquidity provisioning (LPs up to 50x), vaults, collateral accounts, and intent-based order flow with off-chain solvers. Built by Equilibria and backed by Polychain, its developer surface is Solidity smart contracts (MultiInvoker batching) plus first-party TypeScript and Python SDKs and a subgraph, rather than a hosted REST API. The v2 protocol has been audited by Zellic and Sherlock and runs an Immunefi bug-bounty program (up to $500k). The hosted application (perennial.finance) has since been sunset, but the protocol contracts, documentation, and SDKs remain published.

providers.name: Photoshop
providers.description: Adobe Photoshop provides API capabilities through Adobe Firefly Services and the Photoshop API, allowing developers to automate photo editing, apply Photoshop actions, manipulate layers and smart objects, generate renditions, and leverage AI-powered image editing at scale.

providers.name: Pilot
providers.description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for startups and small businesses, pairing purpose-built financial software with a team of finance experts and former operators. Its offerings include monthly bookkeeping, corporate tax preparation and filing, R&D tax credit studies, fractional CFO and COO support, and stock administration. Pilot serves venture-backed startups and growing SMBs, integrating with accounting and payroll tools to deliver accurate books and financial reporting. Pilot is backed by CRV, Foundry Group, Index Ventures, SV Angel, Techstars, and Union Square Ventures. As of this profile Pilot does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its product is delivered as a managed service through its web application.

providers.name: Pixc
providers.description: Pixc is an ecommerce enablement company that builds Shopify apps automating the visual busywork of running an online store — product photo resizing and AI framing, background removal and retouching, AI-generated alt text for SEO, AI lifestyle imagery, and automated visual merchandising of collections. Founded in 2014 and backed by 500 Global, Pixc also runs a professional bulk product photo-editing service (pay-per-image credits with an optional Pixc Member subscription) and serves 32,000+ Shopify merchants. Pixc is an app developer and photo-editing service; it exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Plixi
providers.description: Plixi is an AI-powered Instagram growth platform that helps influencers, businesses, e-commerce brands, and content creators gain authentic followers through organic automation rather than bots or fake accounts.
