The service combines paid advertising, micro-interactions, and niche audience-data clustering with a machine-learning targeting feature (AI-Match) that lets users train the algorithm by rating accounts. It provides a real-time analytics dashboard, optional expert account management (Plixi Experts), and a subscription model across Basic, Pro, and Experts tiers. Plixi is a consumer SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pluto
providers.description: Pluto (Pluto Health, trypluto.com now pluto.health) is an AI-powered clinical intelligence and care-delivery platform that unifies fragmented health data from roughly 90% of US health systems. It aggregates medical records, insurance data, and social determinants of health, then applies AI-driven clinical intelligence to surface care gaps, coordinate preventive care, screenings, vaccines and at-home lab testing, and match patients to clinical trials. Pluto offers turnkey, white-label, or API-based deployment of its clinical operations. It is backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Power
providers.description: Power (withpower.com) is a clinical-trial search and matching platform that helps patients find and enroll in research studies. It maintains a database of tens of thousands of active clinical trials searchable by condition, location, and drug type, and connects patients, providers, research coordinators, and trial sponsors. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Anthemis and CRV; no public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: PreFix
providers.description: PreFix is a Techstars-backed residential home-maintenance service company operating in Austin, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Denver. For a flat monthly membership, homeowners get a dedicated neighborhood Home Manager who handles general repairs, twice-yearly 30-point preventive maintenance, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, painting, appliance and garage-door work, and vetted contractor management through a single email, call, or text. Customers manage their homes through the HomeHub member portal. PreFix operates a consumer home-services business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and demand-side intelligence.

providers.name: Prodigal
providers.description: Prodigal is an AI company building purpose-built agents and intelligence for the loan-servicing and debt-collections industry. Its products include proAgent (end-to-end collections automation across voice and digital), PIE (an intelligence layer trained on more than half a billion consumer-finance interactions), proCollect (omnichannel digital orchestration), proScore (propensity-to-pay scoring from 500+ consumer attributes), proPay (an AI-native self-serve payment portal), proNotes (automated call notes), proInsight (QA automation, scorecards, and revenue analytics), and proAssist (real-time agent assistance). Prodigal serves auto finance, collections, healthcare revenue-cycle management, and lending, integrating with dialers and contact-center platforms such as Five9, Genesys, NICE, TCN, and DialConnect. It is backed by Accel and Menlo Ventures. Prodigal exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: Raisin
providers.description: Raisin is a fintech savings and investment marketplace that gives consumers access to high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and cash deposit products from a network of banks and credit unions through a single account and login. Founded in Berlin (originally as WeltSparen / SavingGlobal) and operating in the US, Germany, and across Europe, Raisin connects more than one million customers with partner banks, handling onboarding, KYC, account management, and deposit brokerage. Its sister entity Raisin Bank provides a Banking-as-a-Service platform for fintechs. Raisin exposes no public, self-serve developer API or documentation portal; integrations are partner-only and its consumer surface is web and mobile apps. Backed by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead.

providers.name: RedCircle
providers.description: RedCircle is a podcast advertising, hosting, and monetization platform founded in 2018 that turns podcast host-read endorsements into measurable results for brands and creators. For podcasters it provides podcast hosting, RSS distribution to directories, dynamic ad insertion, a cross-promotions marketplace, instant payouts, automated transcript and video generation, and audience analytics. For brands it operates a fully managed host-read ad platform that pairs proprietary data with authentic creator voices to run and measure campaigns at scale. RedCircle also documents OpenRAP, its remote ad-pipeline / VAST configuration for dynamic ad insertion. The platform is offered as SaaS tiers (Growth, Pro, and Enterprise) rather than as a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Remoov
providers.description: Remoov is a San Francisco-based full-service removal, resale, donation, and recycling company that helps households and businesses declutter by picking up unwanted furniture and goods, then reselling them on consignment (via reperch.com), donating them to charities, or recycling them responsibly. Customers schedule a pickup, receive a quote, and earn a share of resale proceeds. Remoov also serves realtors, stagers, property managers, and living communities as partners. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; Remoov publishes a consumer web app and help desk but no public developer API.

providers.name: Resourcify
providers.description: Resourcify (Resourcify GmbH) is a Hamburg, Germany based digital platform for waste management and circular-economy operations, describing itself as "the operating system for a circular future." Its cloud software helps enterprises digitize and optimize their waste streams end to end - automating waste and recycling operations, optimizing cost, CO2 and recycling rates, tracking compliance, and running take-back systems - across manufacturing, construction, retail, healthcare, and airports. The platform connects waste producers with a network of recyclers and haulers, captures waste data and documentation, and reports on sustainability and material recovery. Resourcify is backed by Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: RESTful APIs
providers.description: Representational State Transfer (REST) is an architectural style for designing networked applications. RESTful APIs use HTTP methods to perform CRUD operations and communicate between client and server using stateless, cacheable requests with standard conventions. This collection covers RESTful API design principles, best practices, standards, tools, and the OpenAPI Specification ecosystem.

providers.name: RESTful Microservices
providers.description: An architectural style that structures an application as a collection of loosely coupled, independently deployable services that communicate via REST APIs using HTTP methods and standard web protocols. This collection covers RESTful microservices patterns, tools, service mesh technologies, API gateways, observability, and the ecosystem of frameworks and platforms for building, deploying, and scaling microservice architectures.

providers.name: Rexnord
providers.description: Rexnord was a global industrial company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with two strategic platforms — Process and Motion Control (bearings, couplings, gear drives, industrial chain, and conveyor systems) and Water Management (plumbing components for commercial, industrial, municipal, and institutional settings). In 2021, Rexnord's Process and Motion Control segment merged with Regal Beloit to form Regal Rexnord Corporation, while the water management business was acquired by Zurn Elkay. Rexnord does not offer a public developer API or data services.

providers.name: Rinse
providers.description: Rinse is a laundry and dry cleaning delivery service that picks up customers' clothes from home, professionally cleans them, and returns them on a recurring or one-off schedule. It runs a wash & fold and dry cleaning model in which uniformed valets handle evening pickup and delivery (typically 7pm-10pm) across major U.S. metros including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington D.C., Boston, Seattle, and Austin, plus Toronto. Rinse emphasizes convenience, garment care, sustainability, and employing its valets as W-2 employees with benefits. The company is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rinse publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: SAIB & Co.
providers.description: SAIB (Save & Co.) is a Seoul-based Korean intimate cosmetics and wellness brand focused on female empowerment, offering premium condoms and solid feminine cleansing products made with proprietary, health-conscious ingredients such as CranProB. The brand donates 10% of sales revenue to campaigns supporting gender equality and women's rights. SAIB sells direct-to-consumer through a Cafe24-hosted storefront (saibnco.com); its only programmatic surface is the Cafe24 Unified Commerce Platform (UCP) storefront, which exposes an OpenID Connect discovery document and an OAuth 2.0 / OIDC storefront API for this mall. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SAVA
providers.description: SAVA (sava.health) is a health-monitoring company developing a minimally invasive, continuous multi-molecule biosensor worn just beneath the skin. The platform is designed to capture real-time molecular data - glucose, lactate, ketones, sodium, histamine, urea, alcohol, and cortisol - and surface it through a connected mobile app, aiming to shift healthcare toward preventative monitoring and personal wellness. The company is early stage and pre-launch, operating a waiting-list model for early access to its device rather than a public product. It publishes no first-party developer API or health-data API; its marketing site is built on Wix and exposes the Wix Site MCP endpoint and a published llms.txt for agentic access to public site content only. Backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: Scripbox
providers.description: Scripbox is an Indian direct-to-consumer wealth management and mutual fund investment platform operated by Scripbox Wealth Managers Private Limited. It helps families pursue financial freedom through personalized mutual fund recommendations shaped by expert advisors and data-backed algorithms, offering both regular (commission-based, zero monthly fee) and direct (advisory-fee) plans. The platform bundles portfolio construction and monitoring, financial planning, goal-based investing, tax-saving tools such as its Smart Withdraw algorithm, and multi-channel support. As of this enrichment pass, Scripbox operates purely as a consumer application and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Sepasoft
providers.description: A manufacturing execution system (MES) is used to control, track, and document the transformation of raw materials into finished goods in real-time. MES systems are capable of tracking production by the second and, in some cases, less than one second.

providers.name: Signal Sciences
providers.description: Signal Sciences is a web application and API protection (WAAP) company whose Next-Gen Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) defend web apps, APIs, and microservices against the OWASP Top 10, account takeover, and malicious bots without the tuning burden of legacy WAFs. Founded in 2014 by Andrew Peterson, Nick Galbreath, and Zane Lackey and backed by CRV, Index Ventures, and others, Signal Sciences was acquired by Fastly in October 2020 for approximately $775M and is now sold as the Fastly Next-Gen WAF. The product retains its own control plane and REST API at dashboard.signalsciences.net/api/v0, which remains live for existing customers and lets developers programmatically manage corps, sites, requests, events, custom signals, rules, redactions, lists, rate-limited sources, thresholds, virtual patches, and workspace alerts. Product documentation now lives on the Fastly developer documentation site.

providers.name: Simbel
providers.description: Simbel is a Paris-based HR technology company (founded 2021, backed by Speedinvest) offering a smart, unified training management suite that combines a Training Management System (TMS) and a Learning Management System (LMS) in one platform. It helps HR and L&D teams automate the full training lifecycle, from need assessment and request approvals through session organization, e-learning delivery, real-time reporting, and legal compliance (BPF, Qualiopi, BDES). Simbel connects to major HRIS and learning tools such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Lucca, Payfit, BambooHR, 360Learning, and Docebo through pre-built integrations. As of this enrichment pass Simbel publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connectors rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Smore
providers.description: Smore is a newsletter and flyer builder purpose-built for educators, schools, and districts, letting teachers and administrators create accessible, mobile-friendly digital newsletters from customizable templates to keep families and staff informed. The product emphasizes WCAG AA accessibility, translation for multilingual families, and engagement analytics on opens and clicks. Smore is now part of SchoolStatus, the family-engagement platform. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Smore publishes no public developer program, API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface — this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture only.

providers.name: Solvely Ai
providers.description: Solvely is an all-in-one AI study platform for students from K-12 through graduate level, trusted by more than 10 million students across 5,000+ universities worldwide. It combines multi-model homework help with step-by-step solutions, an AI note taker that transcribes lectures into structured notes, a quiz maker, an essay writer, math and equation solvers (algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics), auto-generated flashcards and study guides, mock exams, an exam predictor, and cheat sheets. Solvely is available on the web, iOS, Android, and as a Chrome/Edge browser extension, with free and paid (Solvely Unlimited) tiers. It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Spate
providers.description: Spate is an AI-powered consumer trend forecasting and market intelligence platform for beauty, wellness, and food and beverage brands. It analyzes hundreds of billions of search signals and hundreds of millions of social posts across TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and Google to predict emerging trends, benchmark competitors, surface whitespace opportunities, and track viral content and sentiment. Used by 200+ brands including Sephora, L'Oreal, P&G, Unilever, and e.l.f. Beauty across marketing, R&D, sales, and retail teams. Spate is a consumer-facing SaaS analytics product and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: SpeedyBrand
providers.description: SpeedyBrand (Speedy) is an AI-powered content marketing and SEO platform that helps businesses generate SEO-optimized blog posts, social media content, AI images, and Google Ads, along with keyword research, competitor analysis, technical SEO audits, and backlink recommendations. It generates content in 49+ languages across 100+ regions and offers one-click publishing plus integrations with WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Zapier, Google Search Console, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Speedy targets small businesses and enterprises seeking to scale organic traffic. The product is a no-code SaaS web application; no public developer API or API documentation is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Speero
providers.description: Speero (سبيرو) is Saudi Arabia's online marketplace for authentic automotive spare parts, accessories, and professional vehicle services. The platform helps car owners find OEM and aftermarket parts for their specific make and model across all major categories (engine, brakes, suspension, lighting, AC, exhaust, and more) and book maintenance, detailing, paint and dent repair, tinting, and tire care at trusted workshops across the Kingdom. It supports browse-by-vehicle, installment payment options, and WhatsApp-based customer support. Speero is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer marketplace and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose a machine-discovery surface (llms.txt, RFC 9116 security.txt, and an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset).

providers.name: Storetasker
providers.description: Storetasker is a curated freelance marketplace that connects direct-to-consumer and e-commerce brands with vetted, expert Shopify developers, designers, and marketers for projects and ongoing retainers. Founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars, the platform has helped over 30,000 brands hire trusted Shopify talent across 200+ countries, handling expert matching, communication, project management, and payments. Storetasker operates as a two-sided hiring marketplace rather than a public API provider — as of this pass it publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tendo Systems
providers.description: Tendo (Tendo Systems) is a healthcare technology company founded in 2020 by siblings Dan and Jen Goldsmith, building software, analytics, and healthcare marketplaces on a next-generation platform that connects patients, clinicians, and providers across the fragmented care experience. Its application suite spans Tendo Insights (clinical quality and financial analytics), Tendo QDI (clinical documentation integrity and workflow optimization), Tendo Outreach (targeted patient engagement), and Care Connect, a shoppable bundled-procedure marketplace built on its 2023 acquisition of MDsave. Tendo does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or open developer portal; its documentation and support portals are gated behind authentication. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Time Warner
providers.description: Time Warner was a Fortune 500 American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate, one of the largest media companies in the world until its acquisition by AT&T in 2018. It operated major brands including HBO, CNN, Turner Broadcasting, Warner Bros., and DC Comics. After the AT&T acquisition it was rebranded as WarnerMedia. In 2022, WarnerMedia merged with Discovery Inc. to form Warner Bros. Discovery. Time Warner did not offer a public developer API platform.

providers.name: TMRW Life Sciences *
providers.description: TMRW Life Sciences is a medical technology company that builds the world's first and only FDA-cleared automated platform for the safe management and storage of frozen eggs and embryos used in IVF and fertility treatment. Its cryo-storage hardware combines robotic specimen handling with digital tracking, chain-of-custody monitoring, and real-time visibility for fertility clinics and their patients, replacing manual, paper-based handling of irreplaceable reproductive tissue. Deployed at clinic networks including CCRM Fertility, Pinnacle Fertility, RFC, and IVIRMA North America. TMRW is a private company backed by GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a Security & Trust program (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27018) but does not expose a public developer portal, API, or specification surface.

providers.name: Trend
providers.description: Trend (branded "Trend by soona") is a user-generated content (UGC) platform that connects brands with a network of vetted independent creators to produce custom photo and video content — product and lifestyle photography, testimonial, unboxing, and product-in-action videos — optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and Amazon. Brands post a creative brief, hire creators from a network of 3,700+, and receive full licensing and distribution rights to the delivered content. Pricing is credit-based with no subscriptions or contracts. Trend is part of soona.co. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal — the surface is a brand/creator web application, not a programmable API.

providers.name: Trendsi
providers.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

providers.name: Trezy
providers.description: Trezy is a Franco-Dutch fintech SaaS (Trezy SAS, founded 2021 in Paris by Quentin Lacointa) offering AI-driven cash flow management for small and medium businesses across Europe, the US, and Canada. It connects to 2,000+ banks via PSD2/Open Banking to deliver real-time cash position, automatic AI transaction categorization, 95%-accurate 12-month cash flow forecasting, real-time P&L, 27+ financial KPIs, supplier cost analysis, and OCR-based document management from a single platform starting at a free tier. Trezy also offers dedicated plans for external CFOs (DAF) and accounting firms, and integrates with QuickBooks Online and Pennylane. Backed by Seedcamp and Playfair Capital (with Kima Ventures and Discovery Ventures) in a €3M seed round. Trezy publishes an llms.txt corpus and an /.well-known/ai-plugin.json manifest but does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Venue
providers.description: Venue is an all-in-one internal communications platform that makes it easy for teams to host, organize, and share all hands, webinars, AMAs, and fireside chats. It combines HD live streaming, recording, automatic transcription and summarization, branded Q&A, engagement tracking, and Channels for centralizing events and videos. Aimed at internal comms and employer-brand teams at companies like Shopify, PwC, Wealthsimple, and Yelp, Venue is a Toronto-based, Accel- and Y Combinator-backed productivity company. As of this enrichment pass Venue publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface — this profile captures its identity, website properties, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Verax
providers.description: Verax AI is an enterprise AI security platform that gives organizations real-time visibility and control over how employees and agents use generative AI. Its flagship product, Verax Protect, discovers shadow AI usage across every LLM tool, enforces identity- and role-aware access policies, and applies content-aware data-loss prevention to stop sensitive data from leaking into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and other AI services. Verax Control Center adds monitoring and governance for LLM-based products running in production. Verax deploys via an endpoint agent and integrates with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace for identity. Founded in 2023 (Dallas, Tel Aviv, London) and backed by TQ Ventures, Seedcamp and others.

providers.name: Visibly
providers.description: Visibly is a UK-based workforce compliance management platform that helps enterprises with large, distributed and subcontracted workforces automate their HSEQ (health, safety, environment and quality) obligations. It centralizes worker onboarding, competency and certification tracking, real-time compliance monitoring and alerts, audit and project reporting, and safety broadcast communications, with integrations into existing HR, ERP, LMS and SharePoint systems and mobile-first workflows for field workers. It is used across construction, manufacturing, FMCG, energy, public services, infrastructure and logistics by organizations including Network Rail, National Grid, EDF, Scottish Power, NHS and Danone. Backed by Creandum and Seedcamp.

providers.name: VWR International (Avantor)
providers.description: VWR International, now part of Avantor, is a global distributor of laboratory supplies, chemicals, equipment, and services for the life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research industries. With over 180 years of history, VWR serves more than one million customers in over 30 countries. The company operates as Avantor's distribution and procurement platform, providing laboratory consumables, reagents, instruments, and cold chain solutions. VWR/Avantor offers e-procurement integrations and eProcurement APIs to support laboratory supply chain automation for enterprise customers through EDI, OCI/PunchOut, and catalog integration.

providers.name: Whatifi
providers.description: Whatifi is a visual financial modeling and scenario planning platform for small and medium businesses, letting founders, fractional CFOs, VFX and gaming studios, and startups model, forecast, and share runway, staffing, capacity, and profit scenarios without spreadsheets or formulas. The product uses an event-based canvas of 30+ pre-built business logic "Events" to build and compare "what if" forecasts in real time, and connects to accounting and banking data through integrations with Excel, Google Sheets, Xero, QuickBooks, Plaid, Railz, and OpenAI. Whatifi is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Whatifi publishes a marketing site, a Notion-hosted help center, and a web application, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Whole Foods Market
providers.description: Whole Foods Market is an American multinational supermarket chain owned by Amazon, exclusively selling products free from hydrogenated fats and artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives. Acquired by Amazon in 2017, Whole Foods integrates with Amazon Prime for delivery, pickup, and member discounts. Supplier integrations are handled through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the Whole Foods Supplier Portal.

providers.name: Wishup
providers.description: Wishup is a remote-work outsourcing platform that matches businesses with pre-vetted virtual assistants, bookkeepers, and automation specialists, typically onboarding a trained professional within 60 minutes. Its managed talent handles inbox and calendar management, CRM and social-media work, bookkeeping, project management, and AI-driven workflow automation across industries such as healthcare, e-commerce, real estate, startups, nonprofits, and legal services. Wishup runs a client-facing Employee Management App for task tracking and real-time feedback, but publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Xtime
providers.description: Xtime is Cox Automotive's service experience platform for franchised auto dealerships, combining online appointment scheduling, service-lane check-in, multi-point vehicle inspection, customer communications, service marketing, and payments into one fixed-operations workflow. Part of Cox Automotive since 2014 alongside Dealertrack, VinSolutions, Kelley Blue Book, and vAuto, Xtime integrates with DMS and dealer-website partners through the Cox Automotive ecosystem; it publishes no public self-serve API or developer portal, with partner integration handled via the Cox Automotive Integration Platform.

providers.name: Zaapi
providers.description: Zaapi is an all-in-one conversational AI and chat-commerce platform built for Southeast Asia's micro, small, and medium-sized e-commerce sellers. Founded in 2021 by Wilfried Buiron and launched in Thailand, Zaapi unifies customer conversations from Facebook, Instagram, LINE, WhatsApp, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, email, and a seller's own website into a single shared inbox, then layers AI agents, automations, broadcast campaigns, and analytics on top to turn those channels into revenue. It is backed by Partech, Global Founders Capital, and Flourish Ventures. As of this profile Zaapi exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; webhook connectivity was signalled on the product roadmap but is not yet published.

providers.name: ZenBusiness
providers.description: ZenBusiness is a business formation and compliance platform that helps entrepreneurs start, run, and grow their companies. It offers LLC and corporation formation, registered-agent service, annual-report and compliance management, EIN/tax filing, business banking and bookkeeping, domain registration, and website building, alongside an AI business guide called Velo. ZenBusiness is a direct-to-consumer/SMB service with no publicly documented developer API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zoca
providers.description: Zoca is an AI-powered marketing platform built specifically for local beauty and wellness businesses such as salons, spas, and clinics. It packages its automation as three AI agents: a Discovery Agent that improves online ranking and visibility, a Win Agent that converts inquiries and leads into confirmed appointments, and a Loyalty Agent that drives repeat bookings and client retention. Zoca also offers free self-serve tools including a Local Business Demand Tracker, a Local Website Grader, and a Google Business Profile Optimizer. The company reports serving 1,000+ businesses, facilitating 120,000+ appointments, and generating $10M+ in customer revenue. Zoca is a portfolio company of Accel. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or documented API surface.

providers.name: 1stdibs
providers.description: 1stDibs is an online marketplace for luxury antiques, vintage and modern furniture, fine art, jewelry, watches, and fashion. It connects a global network of vetted sellers and design dealers with buyers seeking curated, authenticated high-end goods, backed by purchase-protection and authenticity guarantees. 1stDibs does not operate a public REST/OpenAPI developer program; its documented machine-facing surface is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, registered as com.1stdibs/1stDibs, that lets agents browse and search the marketplace.

providers.name: Agentic Data Intelligence
providers.description: Agentic Data Intelligence SA (ADI) is a Swiss-headquartered startup building the control plane for AI data analytics: a thin semantics-and-control layer that sits between AI agents and data. ADI automatically generates machine-readable semantics and an enforceable contract (rules) that governs how copilots and agents conduct data analysis, improving governance, accuracy, and consistency while lowering inference cost. It never sees the underlying data, generating the contract from schema and context and running analysis locally. The Starter Edition targets coding agents and IDEs (Claude Code, Cursor, Manus) delivered via SKILL.md files, plugins, and MCP Servers; the Enterprise Edition extends cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt). Backed by Electric Capital and supporting the Open Semantic Interchange (OSI) initiative. Currently in limited alpha, accepting first partners via a waitlist.

providers.name: Anagram
providers.description: Anagram (operated by Enigma Analytics, Inc.) is a security-awareness and human-risk training platform for enterprises, positioned in the defense and government sector and backed by General Catalyst. The product replaces check-the-box compliance training with engaging, gamified experiences proven to change risky behavior: role- and geography-adaptive phishing simulations (Smart Phishing), developer-designed secure-coding challenges for engineering teams, and a real-time AI coaching layer (Anagram Agent). Anagram is not currently a public API provider — this profile captures the company identity, product surface, and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Apis Partners
providers.description: Apis Partners is a London-headquartered private equity asset manager investing in tech-enabled financial infrastructure and financial services businesses across Europe and Growth Markets. With additional offices in Dubai and Singapore, the firm backs companies in payments, digital banking, insurance technology and lending, taking minority positions with governance rights. Apis manages approximately $2.3 billion in assets under management and reports over $1 billion in portfolio realizations, with portfolio companies reaching more than 244 million people. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the firm is an investor rather than an API producer, so it exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Approve.com
providers.description: Approve.com is a cloud-based procurement platform founded in 2019 in Israel that lets businesses stand up a proper purchase-order process quickly, streamlining purchase requisitions, multi-step approvals, real-time budgets, and vendor onboarding with real-time spend controls and insights. Tipalti acquired Approve.com in April 2021 and now operates it as Tipalti Procurement (Tipalti Approve). Its Procurement REST API is still served from the approve.com domain (production https://triggers.approve.com, sandbox https://triggers.sandbox.approve.com), authenticating with an x-api-key header and exchanging JSON with ISO 8601 dates; the purchase-orders API exposes GET and Update purchase-order operations so an external system can stay in sync with Tipalti.

providers.name: Atlys
providers.description: Atlys is a digital visa application platform that helps travelers obtain tourist, business, and transit visas on time for 150+ destinations, backed by a guarantee. Founded in 2020 by Mohak Nahta and headquartered in San Francisco, Atlys asks travelers a short set of questions and then automates form-filling, document compilation (itineraries, cover letters, NOCs, flight and hotel confirmations), payment, and appointment booking against official government and embassy requirements that are refreshed monthly. It covers e-visas, visa-on-arrival, Schengen, US, UK ETA and more, and serves travelers from India, the United States, the United Kingdom, the UAE, Australia, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Atlys Enterprise adds group processing (up to 1,000 travelers), HRMS/payroll integrations (Workday, Rippling), concierge support, and secure passport logistics for corporate travel teams. Atlys is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Sequoia, Accel, and others, having raised over $40M across multiple rounds.

providers.name: Brevis
providers.description: Brevis is a highly efficient ZK coprocessor and zkVM that empowers smart contracts to read from the full historical on-chain data across all supported blockchains and run customizable computations in a completely trust-free way. Developers build application circuits with the Brevis SDK (available in Go and TypeScript), implementing a Data Access Module to specify the historical blockchain data needed, an App Circuit for the computation logic, and an App Contract to receive ZK-verified or coChain-verified results on-chain. Brevis also operates ProverNet, an open marketplace for zero-knowledge proofs, and Pico, an open-source high-performance zkVM. Backed by Polychain.

providers.name: Bridgetown Research
providers.description: Bridgetown Research is an AI-powered research and analysis platform that helps organizations analyze businesses with speed and precision. Its AI agents conduct expert interviews, gather primary and secondary data at scale, and execute 300+ of the most common analyses to power autonomous market research and commercial due diligence. The platform serves private equity and venture capital firms, professional services firms, and corporate strategy and development teams, who access it either through a SOC 2-compliant SaaS platform with interactive generative-search reporting or via an email-driven workflow that returns PDF reports. Bridgetown Research also exposes a REST API (documented on Apidog at docs.bridgetownresearch.com) for creating research projects and managing experts, expert actions, and scheduled calls. It is backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: CarMax
providers.description: CarMax (NYSE: KMX) is the largest retailer of used cars in the United States, operating an omnichannel business that spans brick-and-mortar stores, carmax.com online purchasing, home delivery, financing, appraisals, and trade-ins. CarMax does not publish a public developer portal, but its engineering organization operates an extensive internal API program built around distinct API roles (Data Access Layer, Business Logic Layer, Server-Driven UI, Backend for Frontend). Public-facing APIs documented by the CarMax Engineering Blog include a Store Locations API and a Vehicle Inventory API, and CarMax has publicly discussed a Server-Driven UI API that controls vehicle search filters across web and mobile. Partner and syndication integrations are handled case by case rather than through a self-service portal.

providers.name: ClassWallet
providers.description: ClassWallet is a patented digital wallet and public-funds disbursement platform used by government agencies, school districts, and program administrators to distribute, control, and reconcile public money. Recipients access and spend allocated funds online or in-store while administrators get spending controls, approved marketplaces, reimbursement workflows, direct vendor payments (DirectPay), and audit-ready reporting and compliance. ClassWallet powers K-12 education programs, Education Savings Accounts (ESAs), scholarships and grants, government assistance, and vocational rehabilitation initiatives. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes product and program surfaces but no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Comcast
providers.description: Comcast Corporation is a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable (Xfinity) and NBCUniversal, providing video, internet, voice, wireless, and entertainment services to residential and business customers. Comcast publishes a public developer program centered on the Firebolt application platform for connected TV experiences, along with authentication and content ingest endpoints used by NBCUniversal media partners. The Firebolt SDK family is used by app developers to write apps once and deploy across Xfinity X1, Xfinity Flex, Sky Q, and other Comcast set-top boxes and connected devices.

providers.name: Cometa
providers.description: Cometa (getcometa.com / cometaedu.com) is a Mexican education technology company that provides an operating system for private schools. More than 500 private schools in Mexico use Cometa to run and automate their operations across a set of integrated modules: Cobranzas (tuition collections with WhatsApp and email payment reminders and dashboards), Tienda en linea (an online store for uniforms, materials and services with vendor management), Admisiones y Reinscripciones (admissions and re-enrollment workflows), Comunicaciones (AI-assisted, multi-channel family communications with engagement analytics), Calificaciones (grade entry and SEP-compliant report cards and digital credentials), and Gestion Escolar (attendance, incident logging and administrative workflows). Cometa is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was surfaced as a stub in the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Cometa publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation surface.

providers.name: Defense Logistics Agency
providers.description: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that manages a global supply chain spanning roughly five million items in nine supply chains plus storage, distribution, fuel, construction, and disposition missions. DLA operates an extensive catalog of business applications used by suppliers, the military services, and federal partners. Most DLA applications require account registration and operate behind authentication; public-facing surfaces include the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS), the DLA Disposition Services storefront, the FedMall procurement marketplace, and federated logistics search tools.

providers.name: DoubleDutch
providers.description: DoubleDutch was a San Francisco mobile event technology company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Its Developer Platform (DDDP) let event organizers and third-party developers build React Native extensions that install into any DoubleDutch event app, with a Firebase-backed data layer, a UI component library, an admin/CMS client, and a command-line interface — all published as official @doubledutch npm packages. DoubleDutch was acquired by Cvent in 2019 and its technology now lives under Cvent's mobile event apps product; www.doubledutch.me redirects to Cvent. The developer surface (GitHub org, the doubledutch.github.io documentation site, and the npm packages) remains published but is unmaintained. There is no public REST OpenAPI — the platform is a client-side extension SDK rather than a hosted web API.

providers.name: Efficient Capital Labs
providers.description: Efficient Capital Labs (ECL) is a fintech providing fast, flexible non-dilutive, revenue-based capital to global B2B SaaS and AI companies. Founded in 2022 and backed by QED Investors, ECL turns predictable recurring revenue (ARR) into upfront growth capital without dilution, using its AURA AI underwriting engine for cross-border funding decisions in days rather than months. Its product suite spans Non-Dilutive Capital, ECL Flex (capital, payments, and financial insights), ECL Flow (cross-border payments with up to $1M/month free transfers), and Embedded Finance that lets platforms embed ECL financing into their own experience. ECL reports $200M+ deployed across 250+ founders globally with an 80%+ return-customer rate.

providers.name: Feign
providers.description: Feign (OpenFeign) is a declarative Java HTTP client binder inspired by Retrofit, JAX-RS, and WebSocket. It turns annotated interfaces into templated HTTP requests with pluggable encoders, decoders, error handlers, and HTTP transports. The OpenFeign organization maintains a large set of modules covering serialization (Jackson, Gson, Moshi, FastJSON2, JAXB, SAX, SOAP), HTTP transports (OkHttp, Apache HttpClient, Java 11 client, Ribbon), JAX-RS contracts, resilience (Hystrix), logging (SLF4J), form encoding, GraphQL, and metrics.

providers.name: Good Dog
providers.description: Good Dog is a marketplace that connects people looking for a dog with a vetted national network of ethical breeders, animal shelters, and rescues. The platform screens every source against standards developed with veterinary experts, requires all payments to be processed securely on-platform to protect both buyers and sellers, and supports new owners with a Learning Center, lifetime access to Care Specialists, puppy training resources, and pet insurance options. Over 250,000 families have found their dog through Good Dog. It is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or integration program is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Graylark
providers.description: Graylark is an AI-powered geolocation intelligence company serving law enforcement, government, and enterprise customers. Its technology extracts location data from ordinary images at varying levels of precision, marketed under the GeoSpy brand (geospy.ai). The platform offers Global Search (1-50 km accuracy with worldwide coverage), Street Search (meter-level precision across 1,000+ cities), and Property Search (100+ million records for matching a scene to a specific structure). Graylark positions these capabilities for investigations, fraud detection, insurance validation, and journalistic verification of visual content. Access is gated to qualified government and enterprise organizations via a contact-sales/licensing model; the company publishes no public self-service API, developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time. Backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Happy5
providers.description: Happy5 is a Jakarta-based employee performance management platform, operated by Happy5 For The World Pte. Ltd. and founded in 2013, that unifies goal and OKR management, project tracking, and 360-degree performance reviews in one tool for HR teams. It automatically surfaces the goals hit, projects delivered, and milestones completed inside every performance review, and integrates with tools teams already use such as Jira, Asana, Slack, and Google Sheets. Its customers span major Indonesian banks, startups, and SMEs. Happy5 is a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or client SDKs; this profile captures its verified public identity and web properties as a lead.

providers.name: HomeVision
providers.description: HomeVision is an AI-powered collateral underwriting and appraisal quality-control platform for mortgage lenders and appraisal management companies (AMCs). Its MIRA platform pairs machine intelligence with human review to transform unstructured appraisal content — narrative commentary, sketches, photos and addenda — into structured, review-ready data using OCR, large language models, natural language processing and computer vision, and integrates with popular LOS and AMS platforms plus external data such as public records and MLS. Founded in 2019 and based in San Francisco, HomeVision is backed by Initialized Capital and Newark Venture Partners, and offers private API integration to customer order-management systems (no public developer portal).

providers.name: Kompyte
providers.description: Kompyte is a competitive intelligence and sales enablement platform, part of Semrush, that automates the tracking of competitors across their websites, pricing pages, product releases, content, ads, social channels and review sites. Captured changes are scored and summarized into AI-generated daily digests and continuously updated sales battlecards, so revenue teams can see what rivals changed and how to respond in live deals. Kompyte also supports win/loss capture and delivers intelligence into the tools sellers already use through CRM, chat, sales-enablement and file-storage integrations including Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Highspot, Showpad, Trello, Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive. Kompyte publishes no public developer API, developer portal or API documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: Konfig
providers.description: Konfig was a developer-tools startup that generated SDKs, API documentation, interactive demos, and tutorials from OpenAPI Specifications and Postman Collections, delivered primarily through the konfig-cli command-line interface and GitHub Actions automation. The company was sunset in December 2024; founder Dylan Huang announced the closure in a "Closing My Startup" blog post on November 25, 2024. The flagship konfig generator repository's GitHub description now reads "SDK & API Docs Generator. Sunset as of December 2024." This index is retained as a historical record of the platform and the consolidation of the SDK-generation category around Stainless, Fern, and Speakeasy.

providers.name: Kudos
providers.description: Kudos is a consumer credit-card rewards and smart-shopping assistant operated by Kudos Technologies, Inc., founded in 2021 by Tikue Anazodo and Ahmad Ismail. Its browser extension and iOS/Android apps sit at online checkout and recommend which of a shopper's connected cards to use to maximize points, cash back, and card benefits. Kudos Boost pays cashback at 15,000+ stores, redeemable as Amazon gift cards or PayPal cash, and the product bundles free credit-score access, a wallet and credit-management hub, a best-card cheatsheet, weekly insights scores, a Dream Wallet planner, and an Explore card-comparison and Test Drive tool. Kudos is backed by QED Investors. As of July 2026 Kudos publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; its only machine-readable public surface is mobile app-association metadata at app.joinkudos.com.

providers.name: Lara AI
providers.description: Lara AI is an AI agent for People and HR teams, built by SIGMA PEOPLE S.R.L. in Argentina and sold across Latin America. Lara talks to every employee in the messaging tools they already use — WhatsApp, Slack, Microsoft Teams and Google Chat — and covers five modules: Employee Experience (continuous listening, custom surveys and people analytics), Helpdesk (an AI help desk the company says automates over 80% of employee FAQs and requests), Onboarding (end-to-end automated flows for new hires), Comunicaciones (personalised, scheduled and segmented employee communications) and People Analytics (dashboards and reports built from people data). It integrates with HR platforms including SAP, BambooHR, Oracle, Buk, Humand, Mandu and Rex+, and targets retail, consumer goods, technology, consulting, banking and finance, education and manufacturing. Lara AI publishes a marketing site, a Spanish help centre and a real llms.txt, but no public API program — there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or SDK.

providers.name: Latana
providers.description: Latana is a Berlin-based brand tracking and consumer-insights platform that measures brand awareness, brand perception, purchase consideration and ad awareness for global consumer brands. Rather than buying responses from incentivized survey panels, Latana collects non-incentivized micro-surveys through advertising placements to reach everyday consumers, then applies Bayesian modelling and machine-learning quality assurance to project the sample onto real-world populations, including small and hard-to-reach markets. The product is delivered as a dashboard covering brand health tracking, competitor benchmarking, purchase funnel tracking and brand strategy planning, sold per market per year across Essential, Pro and Custom tiers. Customers include Unilever, Amazon, IKEA, Uber, PVH and Emma Sleep. Latana is backed by Balderton Capital. As of July 2026 Latana publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API description; delivery is through the app.latana.com dashboard, dashboard data export and a Latana Slack app.

providers.name: Leaft Foods
providers.description: Leaft Foods is a New Zealand food-technology company, founded in 2019 by John Penno and Maury Leyland Penno and headquartered in Rolleston in the Selwyn district near Christchurch, that extracts Rubisco — the protein that drives photosynthesis and the most abundant protein on Earth — from green leafy crops such as lucerne. Its proprietary platform turns leaves into a neutral-tasting, highly digestible protein sold as the Leaft Blade consumer beverage, as a Rubisco protein isolate ingredient for food manufacturers, and as an Alfalfa Protein Concentrate for pet nutrition. The company raised a US$15M Series A led by Khosla Ventures. Its digital surface is a Shopify storefront that publishes a real agent-facing commerce API — a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) discovery document, an MCP endpoint for catalog, cart and checkout, an llms.txt / agents.md agent instruction set, and OpenID Connect discovery for customer accounts.

providers.name: Lunabill
providers.description: LunaBill is an AI revenue cycle management (RCM) platform for hospitals, health systems, and RCM/BPO firms, built by LunaHealth Technologies, Inc. and backed by Y Combinator. A coordinated team of AI agents works the entire accounts receivable queue end to end — placing real calls to payers and waiting on hold, navigating IVR phone trees, checking payer portals (Availity, Waystar), working denials, filing appeals, and resubmitting claims — while running inside the EHR and clearinghouses a provider already uses (Epic, Cerner, GoRev, Waystar, Availity) and leaving a full audit trail on every claim. Pricing is performance based (1.5% of net collections recovered, nothing upfront). LunaBill is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type I (Type II in progress). It does not currently publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through EHR and clearinghouse connectors rather than a documented API surface.

providers.name: MindMeld *
providers.description: MindMeld is an open-source conversational-AI platform for building deep-domain voice interfaces and chatbots, originally developed by the GV-backed startup MindMeld (formerly Expect Labs), acquired by Cisco in 2017 and open-sourced in 2019. Distributed as the `mindmeld` Python framework (Apache-2.0), it provides tooling for every step of a modern conversational workflow — domain and intent classification, entity recognition and resolution, and dialogue management — along with reusable application Blueprints for use cases such as food ordering, video discovery, and home-assistant experiences. MindMeld powers the Webex Assistant and other Cisco conversational products.

providers.name: Monese
providers.description: Monese is a London-founded fintech that provides mobile money accounts to consumers across Europe. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) rather than a traditional bank, Monese lets over two million users open an account in minutes and then spend, send, and save money directly from a smartphone app. Its product surface covers multi-currency and local accounts, international money transfers, physical and virtual debit cards, budgeting and savings tools, and credit-building features. Monese is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nines
providers.description: Nines was a teleradiology and medical-imaging AI startup founded in 2017 and backed by Accel and 8VC (a $16.5M Series A in 2019), co-founded by CEO David Stavens. It built FDA-cleared AI algorithms — NinesAI Emergent Triage (for intracranial hemorrhage and mass effect) and NinesMeasure (a lung-nodule algorithm) — alongside a live teleradiology practice. On 2022-02-18, Sirona Medical acquired Nines' AI technology, clinical data pipeline, machine-learning engines, and key personnel, folding the FDA-cleared devices into RadOS, Sirona's cloud-native Radiology Operating System (reporter, viewer, PACS, worklist, and platform AI). The nines.com domain now redirects to sironamedical.com. There is no public developer API today; a RadOS "Amplify" SDK (TypeScript/Python, REST + streaming APIs, event subscriptions) is on Sirona's roadmap as an early-access program for design partners.

providers.name: Pavilion
providers.description: Pavilion is a government purchasing platform that helps public-sector buyers find vendors, get quotes, and buy what they need without the guesswork. It connects procurement teams at 3,500+ SLED (state, local, and education) agencies with qualified vendors, surfaces the most direct compliant route to purchase based on each agency's rules and existing cooperative contracts, and lets vendors claim a free supplier profile to get discovered. The product is 100% free for public agencies. Pavilion is a SaaS marketplace backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Pipy
providers.description: Pipy is a high-performance, programmable network proxy designed for cloud, edge, and IoT environments. Written in C++ with an embedded JavaScript engine (PipyJS), it provides a small footprint, broad CPU architecture support, and a modular filter-based architecture for protocol conversion, traffic recording, message signing, and other networking tasks. Pipy is developed by Flomesh.

providers.name: Prime Roots
providers.description: Prime Roots is a Berkeley, California foodtech company making koji- and plant-based deli meats and bacon marketed as "the clean deli meat" — no preservatives, nitrates, or celery salt. It sells direct-to-consumer and through foodservice, running its online store on Shopify. That storefront exposes a native agent-commerce surface: an llms.txt / agents.md agent guide, a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP, https://ucp.dev) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted MCP endpoint at /api/ucp/mcp for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Prosus Ventures portfolio company and enriched from its live public discovery surfaces.

providers.name: PSD Citywide
providers.description: PSD Citywide is a SaaS provider of enterprise asset management (EAM) and public-sector software for North American municipalities and government organizations. Its integrated Citywide platform spans asset management, maintenance and work-order management, GIS integration (ESRI-powered mapping), permitting, planning and licensing with citizen portals, multi-year budgeting and forecasting, facility/space management (Spaces), and a field mobile app, alongside asset-management advisory and grant services. The homepage references a "robust API" for integration and customization, but no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found during enrichment; end-user product documentation is published in a HappyFox-powered help center. Added to the API Evangelist network via the norwest-venture-partners portfolio.

providers.name: Reynolds and Reynolds
providers.description: Reynolds and Reynolds is one of the automotive industry's largest Dealership Management System (DMS) providers, running the ERA-IGNITE and POWER platforms that operate the core of thousands of franchised car dealerships - sales and desking, F&I, service and repair orders, parts inventory, CRM, and dealership accounting. Reynolds does NOT publish an open, self-serve developer API. All programmatic access to DMS data flows through the Reynolds Certified Interface (RCI) program, a certification-gated, contract-and-NDA partner program run by Reynolds Data Management. RCI provides secured, real-time, bi-directional interfaces so certified third parties can read from and write back to a dealer's Reynolds DMS. There is no public developer portal, no public API reference, and no published OpenAPI. The APIs below are logical groupings of the DMS data domains exposed through RCI; endpoints are modeled, not sourced from public documentation.

providers.name: ScreenPoint Medical
providers.description: ScreenPoint Medical is a Netherlands-based healthcare AI company, founded in 2014 by Professor Nico Karssemeijer and Professor Sir Michael Brady, that develops Transpara Breast AI for earlier detection of breast cancer in 2D (FFDM) and 3D (DBT) mammography. Transpara is vendor-agnostic, integrates into PACS and reading workflows via medical-imaging (DICOM) pipelines rather than a public developer API, and is FDA cleared (K241831, K232096) and CE marked (0344). The product is used in over 200 clinics across 25+ countries and is backed by three randomized controlled trials (including MASAI in The Lancet). The company is backed by Insight Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline: no public developer/API surface exists, but real security-disclosure and compliance posture were captured.

providers.name: SellerX
providers.description: SellerX is a Berlin-based consumer-brand builder, founded in 2020, that acquires, operates and scales everyday consumer products into omnichannel global brands. Originally one of Europe's largest Amazon FBA aggregators, it merged with KW Commerce in 2021 and with the US aggregator Elevate Brands in 2023, and has since repositioned itself from an aggregator into a brand builder. The group operates 20+ brands and 25k+ products across 10+ countries from hubs in Berlin, London, Manila and Dongguan, and has raised more than $750M in equity and debt from Sofina, L Catterton, Cherry Ventures, Felix Capital, 83North, an ADIA subsidiary, BlackRock and Victory Park Capital. SellerX sells consumer goods to consumers through marketplaces and its own channels; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: Sighten
providers.description: Sighten was a San Francisco software company, backed by Obvious Ventures, that built a cloud platform for the residential and commercial solar industry — covering system design, proposal generation, sales, and financing workflows used by solar installers, dealers, and finance providers. The Sighten business was acquired (by GoodLeap) and folded into EverBright; the original sighten.io domain now redirects to goeverbright.com. EverBright operates as a residential solar and home-battery financing platform, connecting homeowners with local installers through lease and Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) products and the MyEverBright monitoring portal. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation is published for the Sighten or EverBright brand; a partner-facing platform (engine.goeverbright.com) and a protected API host (api.goeverbright.com, HTTP 401) exist but are not publicly documented. This profile records the company's current, honest public surface after enrichment.

providers.name: SportsAPI
providers.description: SportsAPI.com is a sports data API comparison and directory platform that helps developers find and evaluate sports data providers. It enables side-by-side comparison of live scores, statistics, odds, and fantasy sports APIs filtered by pricing, sport coverage, data categories, and vendor features. The platform covers providers for football, soccer, basketball, baseball, cricket, horse racing, and more.

providers.name: Stessa
providers.description: Stessa is a financial reporting, accounting, and management platform for rental property owners and small-to-mid-size landlords, headquartered in San Francisco and operated as a brand of Roofstock alongside Mynd and RentPrep. The platform helps owners track unlimited properties and portfolios with automated bank and credit card feeds, transaction categorization, mileage tracking, receipt scanning, Schedule E-ready tax reporting, online rent collection, tenant screening through RentPrep, e-signature leasing with 50+ legal templates, maintenance request tracking, and property-specific Stessa Cash Management accounts with high-yield APY and FDIC insurance up to $3M per entity. Stessa is delivered as a web app and iOS/Android mobile apps with three tiers — Essentials (free), Manage, and Pro — and serves more than 350,000 landlords. Bank, credit card, and payment data flows in through aggregator partners (Plaid-style open banking) rather than a public Stessa API, and the only developer-facing GitHub presence is an org with a handful of forked Ruby and Vue.js utilities. There is no public Stessa REST API, no developer portal, no SDKs, and no published webhooks; the Stessa community has open feature requests for a public API to pull reports and transactions, but none has shipped.

providers.name: Syncloop
providers.description: Syncloop is an advanced API development and management platform that enables organizations to design, deploy, and manage APIs efficiently. The platform provides a low-code/no-code API builder with support for REST, SOAP, and third-party integrations, running on cloud or on-premise infrastructure. Syncloop offers built-in authentication, rate limiting, monitoring, analytics, and a developer portal for API discovery and documentation.

providers.name: Tacto
providers.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.

providers.name: TigerBeetle
providers.description: TigerBeetle is an open-source (Apache 2.0) distributed financial accounting and transactions database, purpose-built for high-throughput, mission-critical double-entry bookkeeping and online transaction processing (OLTP). It is NOT an HTTP/REST API and ships no OpenAPI - the database is accessed over a custom binary wire protocol on TCP (default port 3000) via official client libraries for .NET, Go, Java, Node.js, Python, Ruby, and Rust. The "API" is the set of client operations - create_accounts, create_transfers, lookup_accounts, lookup_transfers, get_account_transfers, get_account_balances, query_accounts, and query_transfers - that use fixed-size, cache-line-aligned structs for zero-deserialization performance. TigerBeetle is self-hostable; a fully managed service is also offered to select enterprise partners via sales@tigerbeetle.com.

providers.name: Vega Health
providers.description: Vega Health is a Durham, North Carolina healthcare AI company founded by Dr. Mark Sendak, formerly of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation. Its platform installs in a health system's own environment (cloud or on-prem) to integrate, evaluate, monitor, and scale clinical AI solutions, alongside a curated marketplace of vetted health AI solutions and commercialization support for academic AI research. Launched October 2025 with a $4M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes a SafeBase trust center (SOC 2, HIPAA) but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Winden
providers.description: Winden (Winden Technologies, Inc.) is a US fintech offering an AI-powered business credit card built to maximize cash back on every purchase. Its Visa commercial card advertises 2% unlimited cash back, and its Scout AI automatically hunts for discounts and promo codes at checkout. Alongside the card, Winden bundles business banking-style services: virtual cards with custom spend limits and merchant locks, free domestic ACH and wire transfers, invoicing and payment management, an AI CFO for accounting and cash-flow projections, 24/7 concierge support, and integrations with common accounting and payroll software. Winden is a consumer/SMB financial product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Worktrace AI
providers.description: Worktrace AI is an enterprise workflow-automation platform that helps organizations discover, reimagine, and automate repetitive work. A desktop application observes work across existing tools to identify high-ROI AI automation opportunities, surfaces process-optimization recommendations aligned with company KPIs, and generates blueprints for building automations on third-party platforms such as n8n, Crew AI, and Asteroid. The 8VC-backed company targets financial services, healthcare, high tech, insurance, logistics, and telecom, and publishes a Vanta trust center covering SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. No public API or developer documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Xfactor.io
providers.description: Xfactor.io is an AI-powered revenue operations platform founded by Mike Carpenter and backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Its Growth AI engine, together with the Xfactor Central, OpenInsights, and Simulation products, builds a live digital twin of a company's go-to-market operations — connecting CRM, pipeline, usage, and financial data so revenue teams can test decisions through simulation before rolling them out. The platform is delivered as a closed B2B SaaS application (app.xfactor.io) and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or client SDKs; security posture is documented on a Secureframe trust center with a SOC 2 Type II attestation.

providers.name: Zibo
providers.description: Zibo (operating as Azibo) is a financial services and property-management platform for independent landlords and rental property owners. The company offers a free-to-use platform that bundles rent collection, tenant screening, online rental applications, lease agreements and eSignatures, document storage, maintenance and messaging, banking, and rental-property accounting. Azibo monetizes through interest on cash balances, card-transaction fees, paid lease/eSignature and screening products, and renter subscriptions such as credit-boost programs. The product is delivered as a SaaS web application (app.azibo.com) that integrates third-party providers including Stripe, Plaid, TransUnion, Latchel, and signNow; it does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. Zibo was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Akita Software
providers.description: Akita Software was an API observability and analysis platform that used passive traffic monitoring to automatically map APIs, detect changes, and identify issues without requiring code changes or proxies. Akita was acquired by Postman in November 2023 and its technology has been integrated into the Postman platform as Postman Live Insights. The Akita agent is now available as the open-source Postman Insights Agent.

providers.name: All Sports API
providers.description: All Sports API is a fast, reliable, and comprehensive sports data API providing livescore feeds, fixtures, standings, and historical data for major sports worldwide. The platform offers JSON pull-based APIs for football (soccer), basketball, cricket, and tennis, with hockey, baseball, and American football available as additional sports. The API base URL is apiv2.allsportsapi.com and uses API key authentication with sport-specific endpoints accessed via the met query parameter. All Sports API also provides free embeddable widgets (results, fixtures, standings, livescore) and WordPress plugins. Plans include a 14-day free trial.

providers.name: America First Credit Union
providers.description: America First Credit Union is a federally chartered, NCUA-insured credit union headquartered in Riverdale, Utah, founded in 1939. With roughly $19 billion in assets, more than one million members, and about 124 branches across seven western states (Utah, Idaho, Oregon, New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, and California), it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, America First operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. It provides no self-serve, publicly documented API surface; consumer-permissioned account data access is handled through third-party data aggregators and its core banking provider rather than a direct first-party API. No public FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is documented on its public website as of this bootstrap. This record is an honest identity profile with no fabricated API surface.

providers.name: Astrix Security
providers.description: Astrix Security is a cybersecurity company providing identity security for AI agents and non-human identities (NHIs) — the API keys, OAuth apps, service accounts, SSH keys, and MCP servers that fall outside traditional human IAM. Its platform lets enterprises discover a real-time inventory of every AI agent and NHI with business and risk context, secure them by remediating excessive privileges, misconfigurations, and abnormal or malicious activity, and deploy agentic AI safely via an Agent Control Plane that provisions short-lived, tightly scoped credentials. Founded by Alon Jackson and Idan Gour and headquartered in Boston, Astrix is backed by CRV, Bessemer Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, F2, and Anthropic. The company was acquired by Cisco and ended standalone sales of new licenses effective June 30, 2026.

providers.name: Ataraxis
providers.description: Ataraxis AI is a precision-medicine company building clinical AI foundation models that make disease predictable, beginning with oncology. Founded in 2022 by Jan Witowski, MD, PhD, and Krzysztof Geras, PhD (both formerly of NYU), Ataraxis trains multi-modal AI on hundreds of millions of pathology images to assess disease aggressiveness and predict cancer recurrence, treatment response, and survival. Its first product, Ataraxis Breast, is an AI-native, clinically validated prognostic and predictive test suite for breast cancer (Recurrence Risk, Chemotherapy Benefit, and Neoadjuvant Response) delivering same-day results without exhausting physical tissue. The company is backed by Obvious Ventures, AIX Ventures, and Giant Ventures, and advised by Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. Ataraxis operates a clinician portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Axion
providers.description: Axion (formerly Axion Ray) is an AI platform for manufacturing quality intelligence that helps global manufacturers detect, diagnose, and resolve product quality and warranty issues faster. It unifies customer, service, field, and telematics data to deliver early problem detection, root-cause analysis, and improvement tracking, reducing warranty costs and investigation time. Customers include Daikin, Harley-Davidson, SharkNinja, Cummins, and Schneider Electric. Founded by Daniel First, Axion has raised Series A (led by Bessemer Venture Partners) and Series B (led by Salesforce Ventures). Axion is an enterprise SaaS product with no publicly documented API or developer platform at this time; this profile captures its company identity, legal, and security/compliance surface.

providers.name: Bold
providers.description: Bold (Age Bold, Inc.) is an AI-enabled healthy-aging company founded in 2019 by Amanda Rees and Hari Arul that combines age-friendly virtual care with senior-focused exercise and nutrition programs for Medicare members. The platform delivers personalized at-home programs — live and on-demand classes, balance and fall-prevention regimens, pain and mobility programs, nutrition coaching, and telehealth visits with clinicians — to adults 65 and older, distributed through Medicare Advantage plans, provider groups, and the CMS ACCESS program rather than sold as a developer platform. Bold reports its balance programs lower fall risk and its pain programs reduce joint pain among participating members, and states its platform is HIPAA compliant and requires no lengthy IT integration for plan partners. The company has raised roughly $27M, with a $17M Series A led by Rethink Impact alongside Andreessen Horowitz Bio + Health, Khosla Ventures, Samsung Next, GingerBread Capital, and Primetime Partners. As of this enrichment pass Bold publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or partner API surface — integrations are handled through its partnerships team.

providers.name: Boletia
providers.description: Boletia (Boletia Mexico SA de CV) is a Mexican event ticketing, registration, and access-management platform headquartered in Monterrey, Nuevo Leon. Event organizers use Boletia to create and promote events, sell tickets online, manage attendee registration, assign numbered seating, publish billboards (cartelera) and venue pages, and control event-day access and check-in. The platform spans concerts, comedy and stand-up, sports, expos and congresses, festivals, theater, and workshops across Mexico, and provides the payment and infrastructure backend that powers ticket sales for its event organizers. Boletia is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Brokk
providers.description: Brokk (Brokk, Inc.) builds AI tooling for large codebases. Rather than a hosted REST API, Brokk ships open-source developer tools centered on "bifrost" — a Tree-sitter-backed multi-language static-analysis engine that gives coding agents structured code intelligence (symbols, definitions, references, call graphs, usage analysis) across 12 languages. Bifrost runs as a CLI, a workspace-aware language server (LSP), and a stdio MCP server, and is published to crates.io (brokk-bifrost) and PyPI (brokk-bifrost-searchtools). The company, founded by Jonathan Ellis (Apache Cassandra / DataStax) and backed by Mayfield, also ships the core Brokk application, the brokk-cli launcher, and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) tooling (anvil, mjolnir).
