providers.name: Brown & Brown
providers.description: Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE: BRO) is a Daytona Beach, Florida headquartered insurance brokerage and risk-management intermediary founded in 1939, and one of the largest independent brokers in the United States. Following the 2025 acquisition of Accession Risk Management Group (Risk Strategies and One80 Intermediaries), it reports through two segments: Retail — property and casualty insurance, employee benefits, private client, captive solutions and financial/wealth services — and Specialty Distribution — programs, wholesale brokerage and MGA/binding-authority businesses including Arrowhead. As a distributor rather than a carrier, Brown & Brown places risk with insurers instead of underwriting it, and its US home market has no federal insurance regulator and no open-insurance mandate. Its API posture reflects that honestly: Brown & Brown publishes no public developer portal and no self-serve API. developer.bbrown.com, developers.bbrown.com, docs.bbrown.com and api.bbrown.com do not resolve, and every /developers, /api, /partners and /integrations path returns 404. Every discoverable application subdomain is a login wall — agent, client and vendor portals behind Microsoft Entra ID SSO or third-party sign-in. The only real programmatic surface is partner-gated: the Arrowhead Programs "Enterprise API" (EAPI), a quoting integration distributed through comparative raters and aggregators such as CoverHound, Tarmika, Semsee and DAIS, with no public documentation, base URL or specification. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference is published on any Brown & Brown first-party property; carrier data exchange runs, as it does across US retail brokerage, through the agency management system layer — Brown & Brown is a publicly referenced Vertafore AMS360 agency — and IVANS agency download rather than through any API Brown & Brown itself exposes. In July 2026 the company announced an AI-first transformation with Anthropic, McKinsey and Accenture, deploying Claude across 23,000 teammates and Claude Code across its software engineering organization; that is internal adoption and has so far produced no external API, developer portal or agent-facing surface. The only machine-readable documents Brown & Brown publishes are two RSS feeds — the blog and investor news releases.

providers.name: Bruce
providers.description: Bruce is a curated professional intro network for licensed real estate, mortgage, title & escrow, and insurance professionals, built by Tanda Technologies, Inc. and founded by Jesse Chor. Rather than a directory, review site, or CRM, Bruce verifies each member's license and role, then lets them log intros and build a portable, verifiable track record. The Bruce Card is each member's living profile — stats, deals, intros, and market rank — that replaces the resume and the "trust me" claim with a sharable credential. Bruce also runs an AI-hosted editorial publication at blog.bruce.bot that profiles verified members in interview-style stories. Backed by Initialized Capital; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: C2FO
providers.description: C2FO is a fintech company operating the world's largest on-demand working capital platform, connecting enterprise buyers with their suppliers to enable early invoice payment. Through dynamic discounting, supply chain finance, and marketplace-based funding, suppliers name the discount rate at which they are willing to be paid early while buyers put idle cash to work or free up liquidity. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Union Square Ventures, C2FO serves a global network of businesses across supply chains. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and legal surface.

providers.name: Candy Fanatics (fka Candy Digital)
providers.description: Candy Digital (branded simply as "Candy") is a digital collectibles platform operating at candy.io under the tagline "Crave. Collect. Connect." It is best known for officially licensed Major League Baseball (MLB) digital trading cards and NFT drops, sold through a consumer-facing, wallet-native web application for buying, collecting, and trading licensed digital collectibles. Founded in 2021 and backed by investors including Insight Partners, the company runs an active consumer product (e.g. the 2026 MLB Base Series drops). The former candy.com domain has since been divested and is now listed for acquisition via Hilco Digital Assets; the live brand and product run at candy.io. Candy Digital is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a public API program, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — this profile captures its real public web surface.

providers.name: Colibri
providers.description: ColibrITD (Colibri) is a French quantum-computing deep-tech company founded in 2019 in Paris by Dr. Laurent Guiraud and Hacene Goudjil, with a mission to make quantum computing accessible to any enterprise. It develops quantum software for scientific and industrial applications, including QUICK (a quantum multiphysics simulation platform), QUICK-PDE (a Qiskit function for solving partial differential equations), the H-DES hybrid differential-equation solver, and MPQP (Multi-Platform Quantum Programming) - an open-source Python library for building quantum circuits and executing them across IBM Qiskit, Eviden myQLM, Google Cirq, AWS Braket, and Microsoft Azure Quantum backends. ColibrITD serves the semiconductors, finance, defense, aerospace, automotive, and energy industries. Its primary developer surface is the MPQP Python SDK (PyPI + GitHub) and its documentation, rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: Courier Health
providers.description: Courier Health is the patient experience platform for life sciences and biopharma. It gives pharmaceutical patient services, market access, and field reimbursement teams a single command center to manage the patient journey from prescription through long-term treatment adherence, using AI-generated patient summaries, workflow automation and orchestration, and integration of data across systems and partners. The company reports gains in patient starts, six-month persistency, and team productivity, and delivers the product as a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II SaaS platform. Courier Health is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: d-Matrix
providers.description: d-Matrix builds ultra-low-latency, energy-efficient AI inference infrastructure for generative AI in the datacenter. Its memory-centric compute architecture, next-generation I/O, and stacked-DRAM approach are delivered through the Corsair inference accelerator (chiplet-based, supporting models up to 100B parameters), the JetStream accelerator-to-accelerator communications platform, the SquadRack disaggregated rack-scale solution, and the 3DIMC 3D digital in-memory compute technology. Founded by Sid Sheth and Sudeep Bhoja and headquartered in Santa Clara, the company has raised roughly $450M (including a $275M Series C) from investors such as Qatar Investment Authority, Temasek, and SK Hynix. d-Matrix also maintains the open-source dmx-compressor (DMX) PyTorch toolkit for co-designing models to its inference hardware. This API Evangelist network profile tracks d-Matrix as a compute-hardware provider; it does not currently publish a public web API.

providers.name: DataGrail
providers.description: DataGrail is a San Francisco-based data privacy platform founded in 2018 by Daniel Barber and Ignacio Zendejas that helps enterprises automate privacy operations and manage regulatory compliance risk across GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regimes. The platform combines a Live Data Map for real-time visibility into where personal data lives across an organization's SaaS and cloud footprint, a Request Manager for orchestrating Data Subject Requests (access, deletion, opt-out) across thousands of downstream systems, a Consent solution for cookie and tracker compliance with automated enforcement, a Risk Management module for privacy and AI risk assessments (PIA, DPIA, AI risk), and an embedded agentic AI named Vera that surfaces context-aware recommendations across the platform. DataGrail exposes a documented public REST API at /api/v2 covering authentication, assessments, privacy requests, opt-out requests, integrations, webhooks, integration files, and consent audit logs, alongside an open-source ecosystem on GitHub that includes mobile Consent SDKs for iOS and Android, a Google Tag Manager consent template, and a Terraform AWS ECS module for deploying Request Manager Agents. The company serves enterprise customers including Salesforce, HubSpot, Okta, Netgear, and Dexcom, advertises 2,000+ pre-built integrations across CRM, marketing, communications, HR, data, e-commerce, and support platforms, holds patents on its Live Data Map and Smart Verification technology, is SOC 2 and ISO certified, and is backed by Felicis Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, Okta Ventures, Basis Set Ventures, Cloud Apps Capital, Operator Collective, Thomson Reuters Ventures, and Third Point Ventures.

providers.name: Diligencesquared Inc
providers.description: DiligenceSquared is an AI-powered commercial due diligence and market research platform serving private equity firms, credit investors, and corporate clients. It deploys AI voice agents to run hundreds of simultaneous investor-grade expert interviews, then organizes the findings into structured, fully source-traceable market intelligence for investment decision-making. Backed by Y Combinator, the company operates a customer web application at app.diligencesquared.com and publishes a Vanta-hosted trust center. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: DriveNets
providers.description: DriveNets is a networking software company that applies the disaggregated cloud model to telco-grade and AI networking. Its DriveNets Network Cloud runs DNOS, a cloud-native distributed network operating system, across shared white-box hardware to serve core, aggregation, access, peering, DCI, and AI-fabric use cases. The Network Cloud AI fabric delivers Ethernet-based GPU-cluster interconnect positioned as an alternative to InfiniBand. Founded in 2015, DriveNets powers disaggregated backbones for operators including AT&T, Comcast, Orange, and KDDI. Device management is exposed programmatically via NETCONF/gNMI over OpenConfig and DriveNets YANG models, with a first-party drivenets.dnos Ansible collection for automation; there is no public REST API.

providers.name: FeezBack
providers.description: FeezBack is an Israeli open-banking fintech, founded in 2016, that builds the technological infrastructure and consumer products enabling financial players to compete in Israel's open-banking ecosystem. Its products cover account-to- account payment initiation (direct bank payments with no card-processing fees integrated into sales and point-of-sale flows), aggregated financial data for underwriting and risk assessment, and financial analysis for investment portfolio and risk allocation. FeezBack holds a Bank of Israel financial information service provider (AIS) license and a payment initiation (PIS) approval, and is ISO 27001 certified for information security. The company describes an API-based integration model for partners but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Hippocratic AI
providers.description: Hippocratic AI builds safety-focused generative AI agents for non-diagnostic healthcare tasks, powered by its Polaris constellation architecture. Polaris 5.0 is a multi-trillion-parameter constellation of specialized models clinically validated by U.S.-licensed clinicians. Hippocratic AI sells agents such as Nurse Co-Pilot and AI Front Door to health systems, payors, and life-sciences organizations through enterprise sales rather than a self-service public API.

providers.name: Jobandtalent
providers.description: Jobandtalent is an AI-powered workforce marketplace that connects companies with reliable staff for temporary and permanent roles across logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, retail, and hospitality. Its platform combines a worker-facing mobile app for finding shifts and jobs with an employer-facing business platform for recruitment, shift planning, attendance management, and performance coaching. Founded in Spain and backed by Atomico, Jobandtalent operates across Europe, the US, and Latin America. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and compliance surface; the company publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Justos
providers.description: Justos is a Brazilian digital auto insurance insurtech founded in 2020 and headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Operating as a managing general agent (MGA), Justos uses smartphone-collected driving data (telematics) to reward safe drivers with lower, usage-based pricing — advertised as up to 30% cheaper than traditional plans — plus weekly bonuses and perks like gas vouchers, maintenance, and ride credits. Its products are distributed digitally through a consumer mobile app and a broker (corretor) portal, with claims tracked in-app and 24/7 support. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Kaszek, SoftBank Latin America and GGV; its auto insurance is underwritten by Companhia Excelsior de Seguros (SUSEP code 05690). No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Kickstarter
providers.description: Kickstarter is a public-benefit crowdfunding platform where creators launch funding campaigns for creative projects — film, music, art, design, games, technology, publishing, and more — and backers pledge money to help bring them to life on an all-or-nothing funding model. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, it has channeled billions of dollars in pledges to hundreds of thousands of successfully funded projects. Kickstarter does not currently operate a public developer API program or developer portal; its GraphQL and REST endpoints power its own web and mobile clients and are not documented for third-party integration. The company does maintain an active open-source GitHub organization (including its iOS and Android app source), a help center, and a company blog. This API Evangelist profile tracks Kickstarter's public developer, security, and platform surface for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: KNL
providers.description: KNL (KNL Networks Oy) is a Finnish defence-technology company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Oulu, Finland, that builds long-range, GNSS-independent HF radio communication systems for military, naval, and critical-communications operators. Its Cognitive Networked HF (CNHF) platform is a family of software-defined radios — CNHF Manpack, CNHF1 Radio, CNHF Vehicular, and CNHF Evolve — that perform continuous spectrum estimation and automatically switch to the next best channel to sustain IP data links over thousands of kilometres in jammed, contested, or infrastructure-denied environments. Radios are operated through a web-based CNHF User Interface providing role-based access, webmail, XMPP-interoperable instant messaging, mapping, and spectrum analysis. KNL was acquired by Telenor Maritime at the end of 2020 and now operates as Telenor's dedicated defence and security connectivity business. The company holds ISO 9001, AQAP 2110 (NATO), and ISO/IEC 27001 certifications and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Lamudi
providers.description: Lamudi is an online real estate classifieds marketplace focused exclusively on emerging markets, founded in 2013 and today operating consumer property portals in the Philippines (lamudi.com.ph), Indonesia (lamudi.co.id) and Mexico (lamudi.com.mx). The platform lets buyers, renters, sellers and landlords search and list houses, condominiums/apartments, land, commercial space and offices, filtered by geography, property group and operation (buy/rent). Search results pages carry area market statistics, interactive maps and nearby points of interest, alongside country-specific features such as Philippine foreclosures and home-loan comparison, Indonesian KPR mortgage simulators, and Mexican Infonavit-eligible listings and bank repossessions. Agencies and developers publish inventory through the pro.lamudi.com professional portal. Lamudi operates as part of LIFULL Connect, which supplies its legal notice, privacy policy and contact surface. Lamudi publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; its notable machine-readable surface is a first-party llms.txt on each country site that documents the URL grammar of its search, new development and project pages for AI agents.

providers.name: Lantum
providers.description: Lantum (formerly Network Locum, founded 2012 in Shoreditch, London) is a United Kingdom healthcare workforce-management company whose Connected Scheduling platform helps NHS primary- and secondary-care organisations build digital staff banks, manage rotas and e-rostering, run automated timesheets and payments, and fill clinical shifts from a verified network of 30,000+ locum clinicians. It serves over 2,000 primary-care organisations, GP practices, PCNs, GP federations, and integrated care systems across the UK. Lantum is a practice-management and workforce platform rather than a clinical-data interoperability vendor, and it does NOT publish a public developer portal, a documented REST API, or an HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement. Its product is delivered through a gated web and mobile application (lantum.com), onboarded via sales and demo request, with any system integrations (for example to GP clinical systems) handled through private partner arrangements rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Lenskart
providers.description: Lenskart is a direct-to-consumer eyewear company operating an omnichannel retail business across prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses and eye-care services. It sells through localized storefronts (India, United States, Singapore and other markets) and mobile apps, and merchandises its own house brands including Vincent Chase, John Jacobs, Lenskart Studio and Lenskart Boost alongside third-party labels. The digital experience layer includes 3D/AR virtual try-on and look comparison, a saved-prescription and prescription-history profile, order tracking and a loyalty program. Lenskart is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this enrichment pass Lenskart publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition or client SDKs; the developer- and docs-named subdomains that resolve are gated behind Cloudflare and return 403 to unauthenticated clients, so no API surface could be verified.

providers.name: Lenus eHealth
providers.description: Lenus eHealth is a Copenhagen-headquartered health and fitness technology company that builds a coaching platform for online health and fitness coaches, positioning itself as a growth partner rather than a consumer fitness app. Coaching partners run their businesses through the Lenus web dashboard and branded consumer mobile apps: client onboarding and screening, training and nutrition programming, habit and progress tracking, in-app messaging, content delivery, subscription billing and business analytics. The company also operates Lenus Academy, a certified education program for online coaches, and in the United States offers a GLP-1 weight management program delivered with independent medical partner Beluga Health. Lenus operates from 20+ offices including Copenhagen, Berlin, London, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Madrid, New York and Toronto, and is backed by EQT Ventures. The platform is closed and invitation-based: as of July 2026 Lenus publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications, and access is available only to coaching partners under a partnership agreement.

providers.name: Leona
providers.description: Leona is a healthcare communication company building an AI co-pilot for doctors and medical teams who run their practices over WhatsApp. Patients keep messaging WhatsApp as they always have, while the clinician side moves into Leona, where work conversations are separated from personal ones, categorized and prioritized, summarized for context, and voice notes are transcribed. Teams delegate chats by role, keep internal notes on a patient that the patient never sees, and reuse templates for repeated answers. Founded by Caroline Merin (CEO, formerly COO at Rappi), Tom Chokel (CTO, formerly CTO at Modern Fertility) and Arela Solis (Head of Operations), Leona launched publicly in December 2025 and serves physicians across Latin America. It ships as iOS, Android and web clients and publishes no public developer API, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Luminal
providers.description: Luminal is an AI inference-optimization company that compiles machine-learning models ahead-of-time into optimized native code for GPUs and ASICs, aiming to deliver the fastest, highest-throughput inference available. Its core product is an open-source, high-performance general-purpose inference compiler written in Rust (the "luminal" crate), built around static computation graphs, a compile-time-checked GraphTensor API, composable neural-network modules, and pluggable graph compilers. Luminal ships two deployment paths: Luminal Cloud, a managed serverless inference service with automatic scaling, and licensed on-prem deployment with dedicated support and custom optimization. The company is backed by Felicis.

providers.name: Mangomint
providers.description: Mangomint is salon and spa business management software covering scheduling, point of sale, payroll, marketing, memberships, and forms. Mangomint has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification. Its only documented programmatic surface is outbound webhooks (appointment booked/updated/canceled, sale completed, form submitted) that Mangomint staff configure by hand over chat support once a customer supplies a receiving endpoint URL; payload schemas and authentication are not published. A small set of one-off, vendor-built integrations (Shopify, Mailchimp, Docovia, Doxy.me, WaiverForever, Gift Up!) are toggled on from the Mangomint dashboard, and there is no listed Zapier app. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: Maryland Transit Administration
providers.description: The Maryland Transit Administration (MDOT MTA) supports open transit data initiatives and makes resources available to developers and applications. It primarily uses the General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) and GTFS-RT to convey schedule, geographic, fare, vehicle position, and trip update data for Local Bus, Light Rail, Metro Subway, MARC Train, and Commuter Bus services in a standardized format.

providers.name: Mia-Platform
providers.description: Mia-Platform is an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that harmonizes infrastructure, applications, and data for intelligent engineering at scale. It provides an API-first platform for building and managing microservices and cloud-native applications.

providers.name: Mission Lane
providers.description: Mission Lane is a consumer fintech founded in 2018 that offers the Mission Lane Visa credit card (issued by WebBank) to help millions of Americans with limited or rebuilding credit gain access to transparent, fair credit. Operating as a remote-first company backed by QED Investors, it combines modern data science and machine-learning underwriting with the discipline of an established financial institution, and partners with Plaid for open-finance connectivity. Mission Lane provides a mobile app and a web account dashboard for cardholders but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner API program; its engineering surface (BentoML model services, MLOps tooling) is internal.

providers.name: Murphy
providers.description: Murphy is a Barcelona-based fintech building AI voice and omnichannel agents that automate debt collection and servicing for banks, fintechs, utilities, telecoms and debt collection agencies. Founded in 2024 by Borja Sole and Marc Sanchez, the platform runs 24/7 AI agents across voice, SMS and email in 15+ languages, handling inbound and outbound recovery with human escalation, behavioural personalisation and fully audited, compliance-bounded interactions (ISO 27001, GDPR and EU AI Act aligned). Murphy claims materially higher recovery rates and 50-70% lower operational cost. It raised roughly $15M (seed + pre-seed) led by Northzone with ElevenLabs, Lakestar, Seedcamp and Enzo Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Napatech
providers.description: Napatech is a Danish provider of programmable FPGA-based SmartNICs and network-acceleration hardware used for high-speed network monitoring, cybersecurity, and telecom/5G workloads. Its Link-Capture and Link-Inline software, together with the NTAPI/NTPL developer SDK, let applications capture, filter, and process network traffic at line rate with zero packet loss. The developer surface is a C/C++ hardware SDK (NTAPI) plus the NTPL programming language rather than a web/REST API; integrations ship as open-source additions to DPDK, VPP, Open vSwitch, Scapy, and Zeek via the napatech GitHub organization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: NOCD
providers.description: NOCD is a virtual mental-health provider specializing in the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder. Through its web and mobile applications the company matches members with licensed therapists trained in Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy, delivers live video sessions, and provides between-session messaging, a peer community, and in-app therapeutic tools. NOCD is in-network with a large number of US health plans and serves children, adolescents, and adults. The product is delivered as an end-user clinical service — the company operates a private mobile/web application backend at api.treatmyocd.com but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Node-Fetch
providers.description: node-fetch is a lightweight module that brings the Fetch API to Node.js for making HTTP requests. It is a client library, not an API service, and provides a window.fetch-compatible interface for server-side JavaScript.

providers.name: Odaseva
providers.description: Odaseva is an enterprise data security, backup, and governance platform purpose-built for large, complex Salesforce environments. It provides data backup and recovery, archiving, seeding and anonymization/masking, encryption and key management, privacy and data-residency controls, and data governance for regulated enterprises. Odaseva holds SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, HITRUST, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, TISAX, IRAP, MLPS 2.0, and CSA STAR Level 2, with independent audits by Ernst & Young. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; Odaseva sells to enterprises and does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Petsapp
providers.description: PetsApp is a veterinary client engagement and practice communication platform used by more than 1,000 veterinary practices worldwide, with millions of pets registered and millions of dollars in payments processed. It gives clinics two-way SMS and in-app messaging, appointment booking, video consultations, digital payments, wellness and health-care plan management, automated reminders, and a lightweight CRM for building client relationships. PetsApp does not publish a public developer portal or open API; API access and documentation are offered privately to technology and PIMS integration partners through its partner program, and its public docs subdomain is a Jira Service Management customer help center rather than API reference documentation.

providers.name: Pontem
providers.description: Pontem is a Web3 product development studio building with the Move language on Aptos and other Layer 1 blockchains, in partnership with Aptos Labs. Its product portfolio spans the Pontem Wallet (a browser-extension and mobile crypto wallet for APT, MOVE, ETH, SOL and more), the Liquidswap decentralized exchange and AMM, the Lumio L2 VM-abstraction framework, and a Move developer tooling suite that includes the Move Code Playground, the IntelliJ Move IDE plugin, the ByteBabel Solidity-to-Move bytecode translator, and the Dove Move package manager. Pontem publishes first-party TypeScript SDKs, an embeddable Liquidswap web-component widget, wallet adapters, and CLIs. Backed by Pantera Capital, Animoca Brands, and Aptos Labs.

providers.name: Rafay Product Documentation
providers.description: Rafay product documentation, API references, Kubernetes platform guides, and resources covering the Rafay Kubernetes Operations Platform (KOP), GPU PaaS, AI workloads, and ecosystem integrations.

providers.name: Rappi
providers.description: Rappi is a Colombian-founded pan-Latin American super-app headquartered in Bogotá, with regional hubs in São Paulo and Mexico City. Founded in 2015 by Simón Borrero, Sebastián Mejía, and Felipe Villamarín, and accelerated through Y Combinator's W16 batch, Rappi operates across Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru, and Uruguay. The platform bundles on-demand delivery (restaurants, groceries via "Súper" and Turbo Fresh, pharmacies, retail, alcohol) with consumer fintech (RappiPay, RappiCard, RappiCash) and adjacent services such as RappiTravel and the RappiPrime subscription. Rappi's developer surface is operated through its Partners program at dev-portal.rappi.com, where approved restaurants, retailers, and middleware providers obtain OAuth 2.0 client credentials to integrate with a REST API for menu and catalog management, store availability, order lifecycle events, financial reconciliation, and webhook subscriptions. Access is not self-serve — a Rappi business contact must approve onboarding, after which partners receive development-environment credentials and an integration path to production. SoftBank-backed since 2019, Rappi competes regionally with iFood, Uber Eats, and DiDi Food, with fintech ambitions overlapping Nubank, Mercado Pago, and regional neobanks.

providers.name: RippleHire
providers.description: RippleHire is an enterprise, AI-powered talent acquisition and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) that automates recruitment workflows end to end - demand creation, sourcing, employee referrals, candidate management, interviews, offers, and onboarding. Built on behavioral science, AI agents, and no-code configuration, it helps large organizations hire faster at scale across 50+ countries. Its RHConnect framework provides API-first and no-code integrations with HRMS, job boards, communication, and assessment tools. RippleHire is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Simpleclosure
providers.description: SimpleClosure is a business-dissolution and wind-down platform for founders, startups, and business owners, positioning itself as "the shutdown standard." It guides a company through the full closure process end to end - from the first decision to wind down through the final state and federal filings - covering entity dissolution (Delaware corporations, LLCs, S-corps), final tax returns, creditor and vendor notifications, asset liquidation, distributions to stakeholders, and compliance obligations. The company offers software plus expert handling, with tailored solutions for lawyers, investors, and financial services firms managing portfolio-company or client wind-downs. SimpleClosure was named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list and operates a customer application at app.simpleclosure.com. It is a services-and-software company rather than a developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sonnet Insurance
providers.description: Sonnet Insurance is a Canadian direct-to-consumer digital property and casualty insurer launched in 2016 and a member of the Definity family of companies, underwriting its own auto, home, condo, tenant, landlord and pet policies through Sonnet Insurance Company. It sells auto, home, condo, tenant and landlord coverage in Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island, and home-only coverage in British Columbia and Alberta, positioning itself as "Canada's original digital-first home and auto insurance company" with a fully online quote-and-buy flow and licensed agents for support. Sonnet is an explicit direct writer -- its own FAQ states that "a third party -- even a licensed broker -- cannot purchase a Sonnet policy on your behalf" -- so it operates no broker or agency distribution channel and therefore no ACORD/AL3 agency-download path. Its API posture is closed -- no developer, developers, docs or api subdomain resolves in DNS, every first-party developer path probed returns HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, Postman collection, webhook catalog or partner technical onboarding surface is published. The only third-party integrations Sonnet describes -- the Kanetix.ca (RATESDOTCA) quote-and-buy partnership and the Sonnet Connect brand referral program -- are privately negotiated commercial arrangements with no public technical documentation. Two machine-readable surfaces do exist and are captured here. Sonnet serves a real llms.txt at www.sonnet.ca/llms.txt that declares per-agent AI-Training, AI-Generation, AI-Summarization and AI-Crawling directives (Allow for OpenAI, Google-DeepMind and Anthropic) alongside a curated reference-content index -- an AI consent signal rather than an API contract. And the secure.sonnet.ca quote-and-buy application is driven by an undocumented first-party REST/JSON surface under /api/v1 covering quoting, binding, policy servicing, payments and identity; it is observable from Sonnet's own public JavaScript bundle but carries no documentation, no specification and no third-party terms of use, so it is recorded as observed evidence, not as an integratable API.

providers.name: Stellar Sleep
providers.description: Stellar Sleep (Y Combinator S23, backed by Initialized Capital) is a mobile app that helps people with chronic insomnia sleep better using psychology rather than medication. Its personalized program is based on CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia), the first-line treatment recommended by sleep experts, delivered through iOS and Android apps published by Merlin Collective, LLC. Started at Harvard Innovation Labs in 2021, Stellar Sleep also offers clinician and employer programs, with clinical-system integrations arranged by its team. It is a consumer digital-health product with no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface.

providers.name: StoragePug
providers.description: StoragePug builds marketing websites, online rental/reservation flows, and lead-management dashboards for self-storage facility operators. StoragePug has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification of its own. Its documented programmatic surface runs the other direction: StoragePug is a licensed integration partner that consumes property-management-system APIs - primarily SiteLink's API, with additional PMS partners such as CallPotential and OpenTech Alliance/StorageTreasures - to pull unit rates, availability, and tenant data into the facility websites it builds, and to push back online rentals, reservations, and payments. No webhook system, API key management screen, or Zapier app for StoragePug itself was found. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: SundaySky
providers.description: SundaySky is an enterprise video personalization platform that uses AI to create, edit, and deliver dynamically personalized videos at scale. The platform lets organizations tailor video content to individual viewers using customer data and real-time rendering, serving customer experience, marketing, sales, and learning-and-development teams — with particular traction in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, telecom, and healthcare. Its products include SundaySky Studio for content creation, the SundaySky Player, a Landing Page Builder, and analytics and reporting. The company operates a customer-facing help center and a public service status dashboard, but does not publish an open, self-serve developer API program; platform access is delivered to enterprise customers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Thorin
providers.description: Thorin is an applied-AI startup incubated and backed by 8VC (Joe Lonsdale), building a workbench for company agents. Its product at app.thorin.com pairs a personal agent that acts as your delegate with project agents that own shared team workflows, connecting business systems (Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, Gong, Salesforce, Affinity, and MCP) and organizing company context into feeds that power reusable skills and scheduled automations. Thorin observes work across email, chat, meetings, and documents to build a real-time model of how a business operates, then automates recurring processes such as deal flow, deal-prep briefs, and inbox switchboards. Seed-stage, based in San Francisco. This profile documents Thorin's product and documentation surface; no public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Thrive Market
providers.description: Thrive Market is a membership-based online grocery retailer headquartered in Marina del Rey, California, selling organic and natural food, pantry staples, frozen meat and seafood, beauty and personal care, baby, pet and household products directly to consumers across the United States. Members pay an annual or monthly fee in exchange for below-retail pricing, and the company operates its own Thrive Market private label alongside thousands of third-party brands. It filters its catalog by diet, ingredient, certification and social value, accepts EBT/SNAP for grocery purchases, and funds free memberships for lower-income families through its Thrive Gives program. Thrive Market is a direct-to-consumer commerce company: it ships a website and mobile apps to shoppers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Upkid
providers.description: Upkid is a childcare staffing marketplace that connects early childhood programs such as daycares and preschools with qualified, pre-vetted substitute and full-time teachers. Programs post shifts and roles while educators find flexible teaching opportunities through the Upkid web and mobile apps, with an ATS-style Hiring Hub for full-time childcare hiring. Upkid operates across metro areas in Georgia, Utah, and Arizona and is a Techstars portfolio company. Upkid publishes no public API or developer portal; its web app is a client of a Firebase backend.

providers.name: Upshift
providers.description: Upshift is a San Francisco fractional car subscription service — "a 2-car garage, in your pocket." Members choose 4, 8, or 12 driving days a month and get a premium Toyota hybrid delivered clean, fueled, insured, and maintained, then picked up when they are done, with plans from $399/month including insurance, delivery, and maintenance. A 500 Global and URBAN-X portfolio company, Upshift publishes no public developer program or API surface; the member experience runs through its iOS/Android apps and go.upshiftcars.com.

providers.name: Valid.it
providers.description: Valid.it (Validit.ai) is an AI-based fraud prevention SaaS that lets enterprises, governments, and financial institutions validate users' statements remotely and in real time through a standard smartphone, laptop, or tablet camera. Its patented physio-behavioral AI combines computer vision, signal processing, and PPG bio-signal analytics to detect deepfakes, synthetic identities, and deceptive intent across onboarding, KYC/AML, insurance claim verification, security vetting, and HR screening — delivered as a standalone web-based solution or via API integration. A Techstars portfolio company; no public developer portal or API documentation is published.

providers.name: Ventas
providers.description: Ventas, Inc. is an S&P 500 healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT) and one of the largest owners of senior housing communities, medical office buildings, life science research facilities, and health system facilities in the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom. Ventas operates the Ventas OI proprietary data platform for operational intelligence across its portfolio of approximately 1,400 properties. Ventas does not offer a public developer API; data access is available through financial data providers and SEC EDGAR filings.

providers.name: Vida Health
providers.description: Vida Health is a San Francisco-based virtual care company founded in 2014 that combines an AI-powered mobile app with a national network of licensed clinicians, coaches and therapists to prevent, manage and reverse chronic cardiometabolic and behavioral health conditions including obesity, diabetes, hypertension, depression and anxiety. Vida sells a turnkey enterprise programme to employers and health plans, layering GLP-1 prescribing and clinical oversight on top of behavioral coaching, and its platform ingests real-time readings from more than 100 connected devices and consumer health apps to feed outcome reporting back to its enterprise buyers. Vida publishes no public developer portal or API documentation: the API host api.vida.com is live but returns 401 on every path, and data/EHR integration for health plans and employers is arranged through enterprise sales rather than self-service onboarding.

providers.name: WellTheory
providers.description: WellTheory is a virtual autoimmune care platform that provides whole-person support for people living with autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, pairing members with a dedicated care team for nutrition, lifestyle, and clinical guidance across more than 100 conditions. The company sells to employers and health plans as a covered benefit as well as direct to consumers, and is backed by Accel and General Catalyst. WellTheory publishes no public developer API surface today; its api.welltheory.com backend and docs are private/internal.

providers.name: Wukong Education
providers.description: WuKong Education is an online education company headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand that delivers live online classes in Chinese language, math, and English ELA for kids, taught by certified teachers to students across more than 100 countries and regions. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, it is a consumer edtech business with a student classroom portal but no public developer portal or documented APIs.

providers.name: xTool
providers.description: xTool is a Shenzhen-based digital-fabrication brand, spun out of Makeblock and backed by HongShan, making CO2, fiber, and diode laser cutters and engravers, laser welders, and DTF printers for makers and small businesses, driven by its xTool Creative Space (XCS) desktop software. xTool sells through a Shopify storefront and runs a support and academy portal, a user community, and the Atomm maker-project platform, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: ZenMaid
providers.description: ZenMaid is scheduling and business-management software for maid and house cleaning services - booking, calendar/dispatch, automated SMS and email communication, GPS-verified clock-in/out on a cleaner mobile app, online payments and invoicing, payroll, and reporting. ZenMaid has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification of its own. Its only documented programmatic surface is a Zapier integration (triggers - New Customer Created, Appointment Booked, Appointment Cancelled, Appointment Updated, Contact Created/Updated, One-Time Service Created/Updated, Recurring Service Created/Updated/Cancelled, Invoice Created, Invoice Paid; actions - Create Appointment, Create Booking, Create Cleaner, Create Customer) built and maintained by ZenMaid against a private, undocumented backend API. No API keys, base URL, endpoint reference, payload schema, or SDK are published for third-party developers; the public GitHub organization (github.com/zenmaid) has no public repositories. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: Afiniti
providers.description: Afiniti is an enterprise contact center AI company whose patented behavioral pairing technology matches inbound customers with the agent most likely to produce a desired business outcome, measured against a continuously alternating ON/OFF control benchmark. In 2026 the company extended pairing into what it calls Outcome Orchestration, a unified AI decisioning platform spanning four products: Afiniti Pairing, Afiniti Orchestrator, Afiniti Intelligence and Afiniti Agents. Afiniti sits as a decisioning layer above existing CCaaS, ACD, IVR/IVA, CRM and workforce platforms rather than replacing them, and is deployed at telco, financial services, insurance, healthcare and travel/hospitality enterprises. Integration reaches customers through host platform ecosystems (Genesys AppFoundry, NICE CXexchange/DEVone, Five9) and through the Afiniti Link partner program, which advertises APIs and SDKs to certified partners but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Agency
providers.description: Agency (agency.inc) builds Kai, an autonomous AI co-worker for customer success — an AI agent that works a company's entire book of B2B SaaS accounts, monitoring product usage, surfacing churn and expansion signals early, and running personalized onboarding, adoption, and renewal outreach so revenue and customer-success teams have command over their book. Agency raised a $20M Series A led by Menlo Ventures with participation from Sequoia Capital, Felicis, Snowflake Ventures, and Databricks Ventures. It is a demo-led enterprise product and does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Agreena
providers.description: Agreena is a Copenhagen-based agtech and climate finance company, founded in 2021, that helps farmers transition to regenerative agriculture and monetize the resulting soil-carbon outcomes. Its AgreenaCarbon platform combines farmer enrollment, a satellite-, AI-, and soil-sampling-based digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV) engine, and Verra-certified carbon credit issuance. Agreena also offers standalone remote-sensing products such as a field-boundary-detection API for agrifood supply-chain monitoring. The platform spans roughly 5 million hectares and 2,500+ farmers across ~20 European countries. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and HV Capital and is being enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Agreena publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI surface at this time.

providers.name: Airhelp
providers.description: AirHelp is a passenger-rights platform that helps air travelers claim compensation for delayed, cancelled, and overbooked flights under regulations such as EU 261, UK 261, and similar laws worldwide. It handles the full claims process on a "no win, no fee" basis, managing paperwork, airline negotiations, and legal escalation on the passenger's behalf, and offers an AirHelp+ membership adding fast-track claims, flight-disruption assistance, and airport lounge access. AirHelp operates a consumer web funnel and mobile apps plus a network of travel-brand, corporate, and affiliate partnerships, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling rather than API client libraries. This profile was seeded as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from AirHelp's public web surface.

providers.name: Akeana
providers.description: Akeana is a semiconductor IP company building high-performance RISC-V processor system IP, with the stated mission of elevating RISC-V to world-class performance levels. It licenses customizable processor cores across three families (the ultra-low-power 100 Series for deeply embedded controllers, the 1000 Series for high-performance edge AI and automotive compute, and the ultra-high-performance 5000 Series for data center, networking, and mobile application processors), plus hardware accelerator IP, AMBA-compliant interconnect fabric IP (AXI, ACE, CHI), and system IP (interrupt controllers, IOMMU, PCIe, UCIe). Backed by Kleiner Perkins and Mayfield, Akeana partners with Samsung Foundry, Canonical, Innatera, Axiomise, and proteanTecs. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

providers.name: Allswell
providers.description: Allswell is an online mental health platform providing virtual, trauma-informed therapy for the LGBTQ+ community. Licensed therapists with master's degrees in social work, counseling, or marriage and family therapy deliver individual telehealth sessions alongside peer support groups and skills-building resources, covering trauma, anxiety, depression, identity exploration, and relationship dynamics. Allswell serves clients in Maryland, DC, and Virginia, accepting Medicaid and major insurance plans as well as cash-pay. Backed by Techstars, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Angi
providers.description: Angi (formerly Angie's List, founded 1995) is a digital home services marketplace connecting homeowners with home service professionals for repair, maintenance, and improvement projects. Angie's List merged with IAC's HomeAdvisor in 2017 under parent ANGI Homeservices Inc.; in March 2021 the consumer brand and parent company were both renamed Angi, with HomeAdvisor continuing as the pro-facing "Angi Leads" lead-generation business. IAC fully spun off its stake in April 2025, making Angi Inc. (NASDAQ: ANGI) an independent public company. Angi does not operate a self-serve public developer portal or publish an API reference. It does offer a gated, partner-only lead-delivery mechanism: Angi Ads/Angi Leads pushes new homeowner leads as JSON to a webhook URL a pro's CRM provides (authenticated with an X-API-KEY header), and an OAuth-style "Sign in with Angi" account-linking flow used by a short list of approved CRM/field-service partners (ServiceTitan, Jobber) to receive lead and booking data. Both require a direct arrangement with an Angi Ads Client Success Manager rather than self-serve API keys.

providers.name: Argus Investor
providers.description: Argus Research Company is an independent equity research firm founded in 1934, providing institutional-quality investment research, stock ratings, and analyst recommendations for 500+ publicly traded companies. The firm publishes fundamental research, earnings estimates, target prices, and Buy/Hold/Sell ratings across all major sectors including healthcare, technology, financial services, and industrials. Research is distributed to institutional clients and through financial data platforms including Bloomberg, Fidelity, Schwab, and Interactive Brokers.

providers.name: Atlas Card
providers.description: Atlas is a technology company (not a bank) that offers an invite-only luxury lifestyle membership built around a premium metal charge card, issued by Lead Bank. Membership pairs a CNC-milled steel Atlas Card with no preset spending limit and a concierge-driven mobile app that delivers curated restaurant reservations, luxury hotel bookings, access to sold-out concerts and sporting events, points-based travel rewards, and thousands of dollars in annual travel and lifestyle credits. Atlas Card is a consumer fintech product with a full monthly-payment charge structure and an annual membership fee; it does not publish a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and enriched with the identity, well-known discovery, and domain-security surface it exposes publicly.

providers.name: Atmee.ai
providers.description: Atmee.ai is a consumer platform for creating and video-calling AI avatars and personas, made by Atmanity (founded 2024). Anyone can build custom AI avatars or browse thousands of community-created personas across comedy, companion, productivity, and lifestyle categories, then hold real-time voice and video conversations with them. The platform includes identity verification with a Verified badge, a creator monetization program that pays people when others talk to their persona, and LoRAvatar, an adaptation method that personalizes avatars while preserving identity-specific details like wrinkles, tattoos, and facial textures. A developer API is documented as "coming soon"; today Atmee is a finished consumer product rather than a developer toolkit. Backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Backstory
providers.description: Backstory (formerly People.ai, rebranded April 2026) is an AI revenue intelligence platform for sales leaders, CROs, and revenue teams. It automatically captures customer interactions across email, meetings, calls, chat, and CRM records, maps that activity to open deals, and reconstructs what is actually happening inside a deal or account — flagging which deals are losing momentum, where decision-makers are missing, whether a forecast is defensible, and the recommended next step. It integrates with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Gmail, Outlook, Zoom, Teams, and Slack without requiring reps to change their workflow. Backstory is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API today (the product API is enterprise/partner gated), though it has stated an "open APIs and MCP" vision for agent workflows.

providers.name: Bold Security
providers.description: Bold Security provides real-time, on-device (endpoint) data security. Its on-device AI classifies data interactions across every application in real time and detects and prevents user- and AI-agent-driven data exfiltration before sensitive data leaves the endpoint, without requiring policy configuration or cloud round-trips. The platform gives security teams visibility into data movement, intent and risky-behavior analysis, and full-context investigation across employees and AI agents. Bold Security is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 compliant, and is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, specification, or SDK; this entry captures its identity, security posture, and public properties.

providers.name: Boldfit
providers.description: Boldfit is an Indian direct-to-consumer fitness and sportswear brand selling workout equipment (pull-up bars, resistance bands, massage guns, yoga mats and lifting gear), performance footwear (running, trekking, walking, cricket and badminton shoes) and athletic apparel for men and women. The brand positions itself around fitness and performance, partnering with athletes, and sells primarily to the Indian market through a Shopify-hosted online store at boldfit.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Boldfit does not run a public developer program or API; the only programmatic surface is the Shopify Customer Account OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect layer exposed on the storefront.

providers.name: BrightInsight
providers.description: BrightInsight is a regulated digital health platform for biopharma and medtech. Its cloud-based, microservices platform captures, transmits and analyzes data from CE-marked and FDA-regulated medical devices, combination products, apps and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) in compliance with global security, privacy and regulatory requirements. The platform integrates with 400+ medical devices across 50+ manufacturers, connects to EHRs in 500+ U.S. provider networks, and is available in 48 countries. Founded in 2017 (formerly Flex Digital Health) and based in Alviso, California, BrightInsight is used by top biopharma and medtech companies to build and launch commercial regulated digital health solutions. It is a sales-led enterprise platform with no public developer portal or public API; integration is delivered under managed engagements.

providers.name: Certa
providers.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Chatter Research
providers.description: Chatter Research (now Chatter by Stingray) is a customer feedback and experience management platform built for modern retailers. It engages shoppers in AI-driven conversational text-message and QR-code surveys that deliver higher response rates and real-time feedback, then uses the Stingray-Chatter AI (trained on 7000+ retail topics) to categorize free-text replies into topics and sentiment. Role-based dashboards surface NPS/CSAT, benchmarks, topic explorers, and NPS boosters so store teams can save lost sales, drive loyalty enrollment, and generate online reviews. Founded in 2016 and acquired by Stingray, the company is a former 500 Global portfolio company. The product is a SaaS dashboard with a help center and CSV data exports; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: checkout51
providers.description: Checkout 51 is a consumer cash-back rewards service, delivered as a free mobile app and website, that lets shoppers earn money back on everyday grocery and gas purchases. Members browse weekly offers, buy participating brands at any store, then upload a photo of their receipt to claim cash back; balances are paid out by check once they reach a $20 threshold. The company earns revenue from partner brands that fund the offers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Slow Ventures portfolio company; it operates a consumer app plus a partner/brands program, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Chi Longevity
providers.description: Chi Longevity is a Singapore-based longevity medicine and healthy-aging clinic that focuses on biological-age optimization rather than reactive medicine, built on The Maier Method developed by co-founder Professor Andrea Maier. The practice combines precision health mapping (blood panels, genetic and cognitive testing, cardiovascular and metabolic analysis), flagship and specialised longevity programmes, cognitive and physical training, a branded NMN supplement, and ongoing support through health coaching, physician and dietitian consultations, and a client portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is currently published, so this profile carries the company identity, domain-security posture, and published web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Cocos Capital
providers.description: Cocos Capital is an Argentine investech and online broker (ALyC, founded 2021 in Buenos Aires) offering a 100% digital investment platform for retail investors. Through its mobile app and website, users open an account and trade Argentine stocks, CEDEARs, sovereign and corporate bonds, mutual funds, the MEP dollar, US stocks via an international account, and crypto, with a fast onboarding experience aimed at making investing accessible to everyone ("Invertir es para todos"). Cocos is registered as an ALyC and regulated by Argentina's Comision Nacional de Valores (CNV), settles through the BYMA group, and has surpassed 300,000 accounts. Cocos publishes no official public API for developers; the client libraries that exist (e.g. pyCocos) are unofficial, community-built and reverse-engineered from the app, so they are recorded here as third-party and unsupported.

providers.name: Conicle
providers.description: Conicle is a Thai education-technology company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Bangkok that offers an all-in-one corporate learning platform (ConicleX) letting organizations build, assign, and track online courses, in-house training, and skill-development pathways for their employees. The cloud-based learning management system serves more than 50 leading enterprises — including Honda, Coca-Cola, Unilever, McDonald's, Sansiri, and The Mall — and over one million learners across the banking, retail, healthcare, energy, insurance, and consumer-product sectors. Conicle has raised Series A funding led by InVent (the corporate venture arm of Intouch Holdings), with backing from 500 Global and Stormbreaker Ventures. Conicle publishes a shared design-system web-components library used across its properties but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Curative
providers.description: Curative is a health insurance and healthcare services company founded in 2020 that reengineered the employer-based health plan around simplicity, engagement, and cost transparency. Its fully insured and level-funded plans give members a competitive monthly premium with zero copays, deductibles, or out-of-pocket costs, starting each member with a baseline visit that tailors a preventative care plan. Curative serves more than 1,200 employer clients and over 165,000 members, reached profitability, and achieved unicorn status ($1.275B valuation) following a $150M Series B round backed by DCVC. Curative operates as a HIPAA-regulated health plan; it has no public developer/API program, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, its member/provider web surface, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Deepjudge
providers.description: DeepJudge is an AI-powered legal knowledge search and intelligence platform for law firms and in-house legal teams, founded by ex-Google search engineers and legaltech veterans. It unifies scattered institutional knowledge across document management systems, SharePoint, HighQ, OneDrive, email, and intranets into a single governed, permission-aware search layer, then layers LLM-agnostic AI agents and workflow automation on top. Products include DeepJudge Knowledge Search, AI Workflows, Negotiation Intelligence, Multi-Document Chat, Matter & Client Overview, and SuperSearch for cross-matter analysis. The platform can be hosted in DeepJudge's cloud, the customer's cloud, or on premises, supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) for governed AI access to firm knowledge, and does not train on customer data. DeepJudge is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified.

providers.name: DSG Sports Analytics
providers.description: DSG Sports Analytics, operated by Data Sports Group, is a sports data provider offering live scores, statistics, historical data, fixtures, player and team information, and odds across more than 80 sports including soccer, basketball, American football, cricket, tennis, ice hockey, e-sports, and Olympic disciplines. The DSG Sports Data API delivers this content in JSON and XML over HTTPS using credential-based authentication.

providers.name: Emirates SkyCargo
providers.description: Emirates SkyCargo is the air cargo division of Emirates Airline, headquartered at Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates, moving general freight, pharmaceuticals, perishables, live animals, valuables, mail and courier traffic across a network of more than 140 destinations on six continents using both freighters and passenger-aircraft bellyhold capacity. In the shipment chain it is the airborne carrier leg sitting between the freight forwarder and the ground handler, and it books almost exclusively through intermediaries rather than shippers directly. Its API posture is advertised but not published: Emirates SkyCargo states on its own Digital Booking Channels page that it offers "a direct API connection to your in-house system" covering booking creation, amendments, cancellations and track and trace, yet there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document, no base URL and no self-serve signup anywhere on skycargo.com. Access is obtained only by emailing SkyCargoAPISupport@emirates.com to negotiate a host-to-host connection, by integrating through the CargoWise transport management system, by submitting Freight Forwarding Requests over EDI, or by booking through the WebCargo, CargoAi, Pelicargo and cargo.one marketplaces, which themselves require IATA/CASS accreditation. The one standard the organization documents on its own surface is IATA e-AWB: agents must sign the IATA Multilateral e-AWB Agreement before submitting FWB and FHL cargo messages over EDI messaging. This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: F.N.B. Corporation
providers.description: F.N.B. Corporation (NYSE: FNB) is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and the parent of First National Bank of Pennsylvania, an FDIC-insured, state-chartered commercial bank. With roughly $50 billion in total assets at year-end 2025, FNB is a regional super-community bank operating around 350 branches across seven states and Washington, D.C. (Pennsylvania, Ohio, Maryland, West Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia), offering commercial banking, consumer banking and wealth management through its eStore digital platform. On open finance, FNB exposes NO first-party public developer portal or documented API: the developer/api subdomains of fnb-online.com redirect to the marketing homepage and no developer documentation is published. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (notably Plaid), not a first-party FNB API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or public CFPB Section 1033 posture is documented by the institution as of this profile.

providers.name: Flowscope
providers.description: Flowscope is an AI-native process-automation firm (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) that deploys agents to observe how a business actually runs, map and redesign its workflows, then ship the automation into production on top of existing systems in days rather than months. It positions itself as the AI team for mid-market operating businesses that do not have one, selling services-as-software with outcome-aligned pricing rather than a self-serve developer API. Founded in 2025 in San Francisco by Samuel Mirpuri (ex-McKinsey QuantumBlack) and Javier Leguina (founding engineer, ModelML), Flowscope runs forward-deployed agents that shadow employees, baseline the process, redesign the work, and write back into legacy systems of record while a human core keeps judgment and accountability in the loop.

providers.name: FranConnect
providers.description: FranConnect is a franchise and multi-location management platform used by 1,500+ brands across roughly one million locations, covering franchise development and sales, franchisee/unit information management, field operations and audits, financials and royalties, and CRM. Its FranConnect Sky product exposes a RESTful API - organized by module (Franchise Sales "fs", CRM "cm", Info Manager "fim", Finance "manage-finance", and Admin "admin") - that lets customers import and export data between FranConnect Sky and third-party applications. All API calls are made over HTTPS and authenticated with an Authorization-Token header. API access is not open/self-serve - it is gated behind a FranConnect Sky customer or partner account, with credentials provisioned by FranConnect, and the reference documentation portal (docs.franconnect.net) requires a signed-in account.

providers.name: Getbasis
providers.description: Basis (getbasis.ai) is an AI-powered accounting platform that builds autonomous agents purpose-built for accountants. Its agents execute accounting workflows end-to-end across tax, audit, advisory, and client accounting services (CAS), shifting accounting professionals from doing the work to reviewing it. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security and compliance for accounting firms — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 certifications, AES-256 encryption, strict tenant isolation, and US-only hosting. Basis is backed by Khosla Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It is a product company with no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time.

providers.name: Goodr
providers.description: Goodr is an Atlanta-based sustainable surplus food management and hunger-relief logistics company founded in 2016 by Jasmine Crowe-Houston. Goodr helps businesses divert edible and inedible food waste from landfills by scheduling pickups, donating surplus edible food to local nonprofits, and providing donors with the tax deductions and impact reporting tied to those donations. Alongside its food-waste solutions, Goodr runs hunger-relief programs including pop-up grocery markets, meal delivery, student snackpacks, and community grocery stores. The company reports more than 30 million meals served and 4 million pounds of food diverted from landfills for enterprise partners such as Amazon, Google, NASA, and Fulton County. Goodr operates through a partner portal rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Insta360
providers.description: Insta360 (Arashi Vision Co., Ltd) is a consumer and professional imaging company best known for its 360-degree and action cameras (the X, GO, ACE, Link, and Pro/Titan lines). For developers, Insta360 runs a first-party developer program through its Insta360Develop GitHub organization and a VitePress developer-documentation site. Cameras expose on-device HTTP control APIs: consumer models implement Google's Open Spherical Camera (OSC) API over the camera Wi-Fi AP, and the Pro/Titan line adds a JSON-over-HTTP command API (ProCameraApi) for capture, live streaming, and file access. Native SDKs wrap this surface for C++ (camera control and media stitching/editing), Android, and iOS so third-party apps can connect to, configure, capture from, and post-process footage from Insta360 hardware.

providers.name: Kinside
providers.description: Kinside is a modern child care marketplace that connects families with licensed child care providers by surfacing real-time availability across thousands of providers, helping parents find care in minutes rather than months. Beyond the consumer marketplace, Kinside serves child care providers with enrollment and scheduling tools, employers with child care benefit programs, and government agencies seeking community child care supply-and-demand data. Backed by Initialized Capital and Techstars, the company operates alongside UrbanSitter in the family-care benefits space. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from venture-portfolio discovery; Kinside does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time, so this entry captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Locale
providers.description: Locale is a no-code workflow automation platform that lets operations, data, and engineering teams build, run, and monitor automated workflows without writing glue code. Its visual builder chains together apps and actions — HTTP requests, AI Actions, run-your-own code, email, Slack, PostgreSQL, Sendgrid, and Fireflies.ai — with flow controls such as conditional branching, delays, and list iterators, then passes data between steps to orchestrate real business processes. Workflows can be built, connected, debugged, and published from the Locale app, and the platform positions itself as an operational automation layer for teams that want internal alerting and process automation without a heavy engineering lift. Locale is backed by a16z. This profile was enriched from Locale's public documentation surface (docs.locale.ai); Locale publishes no first-party public REST API or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Lyric
providers.description: Lyric is an AI-powered supply chain software company, founded in 2022 and backed by Insight Partners. Its Lyric Studio platform lets enterprises model, plan, and optimize their supply chains across four composable layers — Data (enterprise-grade data management and integrations), Algorithms (advanced supply chain science), Workflows (flexible, composable processes), and Models & Apps (ready-to-use applications). The platform spans network modeling, transportation optimization, inventory management, forecasting, routing, and scheduling. Lyric does not publish a public developer API surface; its product documentation at docs.lyric.tech is gated behind a Lyric Studio login. It does operate a public SafeBase security and trust portal documenting SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and CSA STAR Level 1 posture plus a responsible disclosure program.

providers.name: Manticore Games
providers.description: Manticore Games is a San Mateo-based game developer and publisher, and the studio behind Core — a free, Unreal Engine-powered game-creation platform and metaverse where a global community of creators builds, publishes, and plays multiplayer games and experiences. Core exposes a rich Lua scripting API (namespaces, types, and events for Players, Weapons, Abilities, Storage, Leaderboards, Chat, UI, and World) that lets creators program game logic directly in the editor. Manticore is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Medzoomer
providers.description: Medzoomer is an on-demand prescription delivery platform that connects pharmacies, healthcare providers, and patients through a secure, HIPAA-compliant network of verified couriers. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, the company handles last-mile medication logistics, including controlled substances (Schedule II-V), with tamper-evident packaging, FDA/TSA-approved envelopes, and real-time order tracking. Pharmacies and couriers operate through dedicated web and mobile applications, and the platform is backed by Techstars, UnitedHealthcare Accelerator, and other investors. Medzoomer operates a private pharmacy integration API but publishes no public developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Menlo Security
providers.description: Menlo Security is a cybersecurity company that secures the enterprise browser, positioning the browser as the point of control for protecting both human users and AI agents. Its cloud-native Secure Enterprise Browser and Menlo Cloud Security Platform apply remote browser isolation to prevent zero-day phishing, ransomware, and malware from ever reaching the endpoint. The platform spans AI agent security and governance, AI Adaptive DLP (data loss prevention), file security for downloads and uploads, zero-trust remote access to private applications, and threat prevention. Menlo Security is headquartered in Mountain View, California and is backed by investors including General Catalyst, Vista Equity Partners, JPMorgan, American Express Ventures, and HSBC. Menlo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface; administration is handled through its cloud console and a customer support portal.

providers.name: Moonfare
providers.description: Moonfare is a digital investment platform that gives individual professional and high-net-worth investors access to private equity and venture capital funds that were historically reserved for institutions. The platform pools investor commitments into Luxembourg-based feeder funds, applies rigorous due diligence (approving only a small fraction of screened funds), and offers products spanning direct fund investments, portfolio-of-funds, co-investments, secondaries, and open-ended funds, with a digital secondary market for institutional-style liquidity. Moonfare handles capital calls, distributions, reporting, and administration through a technology-enabled onboarding and portfolio experience. Moonfare does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Motilal Oswal
providers.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL) is a diversified Indian financial services company offering equity and derivatives broking, wealth management, asset management, mutual funds, IPO access, investment banking, private equity, and home finance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The public surface is a consumer/corporate investing website built on Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services; no public developer API or OpenAPI is published (algorithmic/partner trading access sits behind a partner login).

providers.name: Nexthop AI
providers.description: Nexthop AI is a networking infrastructure company building next-generation, highly efficient AI and cloud networking for hyperscalers and neo-cloud operators. Founded by former Arista Networks operations leader Anshul Sadana, it designs scale-out and scale-across Ethernet switches, a networking software portfolio, and optics and cables engineered to lower the cost per token of large GPU clusters by improving power efficiency, cost, reliability, and speed of deployment. The company raised a $500M Series B led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Andreessen Horowitz at a $4.2B valuation and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio lead. It publishes no public web/REST API surface; this profile captures company identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Revie
