providers.description: Revie is an AI-powered customer review collection and WhatsApp marketing automation platform for e-commerce businesses, with a focus on the Latin American market. It requests and collects product reviews over WhatsApp (in text, photo, video, and voice-note formats) after a purchase, then applies AI sentiment analysis and keyword grouping to surface customer feedback in a dashboard. Revie also powers WhatsApp marketing campaigns, customer segmentation, and discount incentives, and integrates with Shopify, Tienda Nube, and VTEX storefronts. The company exposes no public developer API or SDK; its product is delivered as installable storefront apps.

providers.name: Riff
providers.description: Riff is an Oslo, Norway based enterprise software company building AI agents for supply chain, procurement, planning, and logistics operations. Its agents automate repetitive back-office work such as chasing supplier order confirmations, updating order and delivery status, matching invoices, and monitoring deliveries, while keeping actions deterministic, auditable, and team-controlled rather than purely generative. Riff integrates non-disruptively with existing ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Infor, and Microsoft, is EU-based with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned and GDPR compliant data handling, and was founded by veterans of Cognite. The company raised a $16M Series A backed by Northzone and other investors. Riff has no public developer or API program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Sahi
providers.description: Sahi is a high-performance Indian stock trading platform built for active retail traders, operated by Aaritya Broking Private Limited (SEBI INZ000317632) and based in Bangalore. Founded by Dale Vaz (former Swiggy CTO) and Manish Jain (former Kotak Securities executive), Sahi offers futures & options trading, equity/stock trading, IPO applications, and ETF investing at a flat brokerage of Rs.10 per executed order. The mobile-native platform emphasizes millisecond order-execution latency, an in-house charting tool (Sahi Charts), real-time stock scanners, AI-backed market intelligence, and SEBI-registered research. Sahi is an Accel portfolio company. It does not currently publish a public developer API, but it does publish a machine-readable /llms.txt.

providers.name: Secuvy
providers.description: Secuvy is an AI data filtering and data security platform that combines data discovery, classification, data security posture management, privacy automation, and AI governance into a single product. The platform automates detection and classification of sensitive data across hybrid and multi-cloud environments and prevents regulated data from leaking into AI tools, assistants, and inference pipelines. Secuvy offers more than 250 connectors covering AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, MongoDB, and on-premise systems like Windows File Servers, SharePoint, and NFS. Authentication options include OAuth, SAML, and API key based integration, and developers can build custom connectors against any system with a public API. Public API reference documentation was not located during research; technical detail is provided through Secuvy's sales and onboarding teams.

providers.name: Serve First
providers.description: Serve First is a UK-based AI-driven customer experience (CX) platform that unifies reviews, surveys, receipts, in-location feedback terminals, operational audits, and mystery shopping into a single dashboard. It turns real-time customer feedback into role-based, actionable insight, with sentiment analysis and unified reporting across retail, hospitality, facilities management, health & wellness, and franchise businesses. Serve First also provides Client Connect journey/workflow automation and Martyn's Law public-protection compliance management. Serve First does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures company identity plus verified security and compliance posture (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 via a Sprinto-hosted trust center).

providers.name: Shield AI
providers.description: Shield AI builds autonomous defense systems anchored by Hivemind, an AI-powered autonomy stack that pilots aircraft and robotic platforms without GPS or communications. Hardware products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff ISR aircraft, the Nova quadcopter, and the announced X-BAT AI-piloted VTOL fighter. Hivemind itself is delivered as a layered platform: EdgeOS (real-time C++ autonomy middleware), Pilot (autonomy behavior catalog), Forge (autonomy factory for build, sim, and test), and Commander (C2 and fleet integration). In 2025 Shield AI introduced Hivemind Enterprise, a partner-facing SDK for building, evaluating, testing, and deploying mission autonomy on customer platforms. There is no public, self-service API; access to Hivemind SDKs and developer tooling is gated through partnership and is subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR).

providers.name: Squadle
providers.description: Squadle is a food safety and operational compliance platform for multi-unit restaurant and foodservice operations. It combines IoT remote temperature monitoring (its Remote Temperature System) with digital food-safety checklists, shift management, and patented ZeroTouch technology that automates temperature logging and triggers corrective actions. The platform reports 3.3B+ completed tasks and 100M+ temperatures measured. Squadle was acquired by Crunchtime and now operates as part of the Crunchtime Operations Execution platform; the squadle.com domain redirects to crunchtime.com/squadle. No public API or developer platform is currently published.

providers.name: TeamViewer
providers.description: TeamViewer is a global provider of remote connectivity, remote access, and remote support software used by IT teams, MSPs, and enterprises to manage devices, deliver IT support, and connect operational technology across desktops, mobile devices, and IoT endpoints. The TeamViewer Web API is a RESTful API that uses OAuth 2.0 bearer token authentication and JSON to programmatically manage users, devices, groups, sessions, session reports, and meetings within a TeamViewer company account.

providers.name: Twingate
providers.description: Twingate is a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platform that replaces legacy VPNs with software-defined perimeters, providing identity-based, least-privilege access to private resources without exposing them to the public internet. The Twingate Admin API is a GraphQL API authenticated via API key (X-API-KEY header) that enables programmatic management of remote networks, connectors, resources, users, groups, service accounts, devices, policies, and DNS filtering profiles.

providers.name: Vouch
providers.description: Vouch is a San Francisco, California business insurance broker and risk advisor purpose-built for high-growth startups and the venture ecosystem. Founded in 2018 by Sam Hodges and Travis Hedge and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital, SVB Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Y Combinator, and MS&AD Ventures, Vouch offers a tailored portfolio of commercial coverages — Directors & Officers (D&O), Errors & Omissions (E&O / Tech E&O / Professional Services E&O), Cyber, Employment Practices Liability (EPL), General Liability, Business Property, Fiduciary, Crime, and contract-required coverages — sold to technology, healthcare and life sciences, financial services, and professional services companies. The business model is broker-of-record commissions and, since 2021, a Vouch-owned insurance carrier underwriting select lines. Vouch is best known in the developer community for its embedded insurance program, which lets ecosystem partners (Carta, StartupOS, and similar founder platforms) pre-fill applications, surface quotes, and bind coverage inline via Vouch's partner API. Public developer documentation, an OpenAPI specification, and a self-serve sandbox are not exposed; the partner API and Vouch Corporate documentation (hosted on GitBook) are gated to onboarded venture, technology, and service-provider partners contracted through hello@vouch.us.

providers.name: Wikifolio
providers.description: wikifolio (wikifolio Financial Technologies AG) is a European social- and copy-trading platform that lets everyday investors follow, compare, and invest in the strategies of experienced traders. Traders build virtual portfolios ("wikifolios") that are published transparently; in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland the best-performing wikifolios can be securitized as exchange-listed wikifolio certificates that investors buy through their bank or broker. The platform surfaces thousands of trading ideas with published rules, fees, and live performance tracking. wikifolio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it does not appear to publish a public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Zarna
providers.description: Zarna builds autonomous AI associates for private capital firms — private equity, growth equity, private credit, family offices, and investment banks. The platform captures deal information from CIMs, emails, meetings, CRMs, and virtual data rooms into a structured institutional memory, then runs a swarm of specialized agents (Scribe for capture and logging, Memo for screening memos and briefs, Analyst for mandate-fit scoring, and Experts for warm-intro network mapping) that deliver finished work directly into Outlook, Teams, and Slack. Zarna integrates with 30+ deal tools including DealCloud, Affinity, Salesforce, and SharePoint, deploys into VPC or on-premises single-tenant infrastructure, and is SOC 2 Type II certified. A Y Combinator Fall 2025 company founded by an ex-AEA Investors team.

providers.name: Zorus
providers.description: Zorus is a cybersecurity company that provides DNS web protection and filtering built for managed service providers (MSPs), managed security service providers (MSSPs), and IT teams. Its Archon agent delivers DNS filtering without requiring per-router DNS changes, layered with CyberSight behavioral user analytics, geo-IP and network filtering, zero-trust device isolation, and SaaS inventory and usage visibility. Zorus is delivered as a multi-tenant SaaS platform administered through a partner portal (portal.zorustech.com), positioned as an alternative to Cisco Umbrella, WebRoot DNS, and WebTitan. Zorus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation; its API surface (api.zorustech.com) sits behind the authenticated product portal. This profile captures the company's public web properties and probed security posture.

providers.name: 410 Labs
providers.description: 410 Labs is a lean product studio based in Baltimore, Maryland, founded in 2010 by Dave Troy and Matthew Koll with the mission of helping people communicate and access information in new and better ways. The company is best known for Mailstrom, a web-based inbox management and email cleanup tool that groups messages by sender, subject, time, and size so users can act on thousands of related emails at once across Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Apple, AOL, Exchange, and any IMAP mail service. 410 Labs also built the Chuck iPhone app for fast on-the-go email triage, and earlier products Shortmail and Replyz. It is a consumer productivity software company that does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties for the API Evangelist network. 410 Labs was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: ALLSALE Corp.
providers.description: ALLSALE Corp. operates ALLSALE, a TikTok Shop growth and creator-marketing automation platform for consumer brands. It runs three AI agents — a Creator Discovery Agent that finds and engages relevant TikTok creators, a Budget Optimization Agent that recommends budget allocation and commission adjustments, and a Performance Analyst Agent that tracks GMV and predicts results — automating the full workflow from creator discovery and outreach through performance tracking and ROI analysis. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company and reports 100K+ creators engaged and $50M+ in customer revenue generated across its brand clients. Plans run from a $399/month Starter tier to a $599/month Pro tier, with custom Enterprise pricing offering unlimited messaging, multi-brand support, and white-label options.

providers.name: API Dynamics
providers.description: APIDynamics is an AI-driven API security and observability platform that empowers enterprises to gain real-time visibility and secure every API endpoint with intelligent, automated analytics. The platform provides adaptive MFA, real-time risk scoring, Zero Trust enforcement, API discovery, shadow and zombie API detection, BOLA/BFLA detection, sensitive data tracking, and anomaly detection — all within a unified dashboard.

providers.name: Associated Bank
providers.description: Associated Bank, N.A. is the primary banking subsidiary of Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE ASB), a nationally chartered commercial bank and the largest bank holding company headquartered in Wisconsin, based in Green Bay. With roughly $50 billion in total assets following the April 2026 acquisition of American National Corporation, Associated operates a full-service Midwest banking franchise of more than 200 locations across Wisconsin, Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri and Nebraska, offering consumer, business, commercial and wealth-management services. Associated does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Its digital banking runs on a core-provider stack (Jack Henry), and consumer-permissioned data access is delivered through third-party aggregators (Plaid, Tink/TrueLayer) rather than a direct first-party API. Its commercial treasury customers use the login-gated Associated Connect platform. No FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is publicly documented as of this review.

providers.name: Blocks
providers.description: Blocks is a cloud cost-optimization service that guarantees up to 20% savings on AWS spend by aggregating the purchasing power of hundreds of companies into group-buying negotiations, then layering automated cloud management on top. Its AI-powered DevOps agent, Major Tom, continuously monitors connected AWS accounts through read-only billing access, surfaces cost-saving and security findings in Slack, and can propose Terraform fixes without requiring root or code access. Onboarding is a one-click read-only AWS cost-data integration with no long-term contracts and no infrastructure changes. Blocks is backed by Speedinvest and is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it currently exposes a marketing and product surface rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Branchtrack
providers.description: BranchTrack is a browser-based authoring platform for building interactive branching scenarios and conversation simulations used in corporate learning and development. Instructional designers and L&D teams create decision-tree simulations with no coding or design skills, then deploy them inside existing LMS platforms or embed them into courses authored in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Adobe Captivate, Gomo, and Lectora. Simulations export as SCORM and xAPI (Tin Can) packages and can be shared as responsive, mobile-native experiences with learner analytics and completion tracking. BranchTrack is a portfolio company of Seedcamp. The platform exposes no first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; third-party embedding is available via the Embedly oEmbed provider, and LMS delivery via SCORM/xAPI.

providers.name: Calo
providers.description: Calo is a food-tech company founded in Bahrain in 2019 that operates a personalized meal-subscription and delivery service. Nutritionist-designed, chef-prepared meals are portioned to each customer's health goals and lifestyle, with 80+ new meal options rotated weekly and flexible pause/cancel anytime. Built by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers around proprietary nutritional algorithms, Calo has expanded to seven markets across the GCC and beyond (Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman), ordered through its consumer apps. Calo is backed by 500 Global. It is a consumer-facing product with no public developer API or documented client SDKs.

providers.name: Cardinal Health
providers.description: Cardinal Health is a Fortune 15 global integrated healthcare services and products company that provides pharmaceutical distribution, medical-surgical product distribution, and customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. Cardinal Health does not publish a public developer portal, but it exchanges high volumes of B2B trading data with customers and suppliers via standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 810, 855, 856, 846, 832, 867) over AS2, SFTP, and private API channels. Third-party EDI platforms such as Orderful, Crossfire, SPS Commerce, Zenbridge, DataTrans, Alluvia, ConnectPointz, and Spark Shipping offer managed connectors into Cardinal Health for order-to-cash, inventory, and supply-chain automation.

providers.name: CareFusion (BD)
providers.description: CareFusion is a medical technology brand, acquired by BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) in 2015, best known for the Alaris infusion system and the Pyxis automated dispensing product line. CareFusion does not expose a public developer API; instead, its devices and dispensing systems interoperate with hospital EMRs and pharmacy systems over HL7 v2 messaging, smart-pump interoperability middleware, and vendor-managed integration services. The Alaris Infusion Interoperability program wirelessly transmits orders from EMRs (such as Epic and Cerner) into Alaris large-volume and syringe modules and returns infusion status back to the EMR in near real time, using the Alaris Guardrails drug library as a safety layer.

providers.name: ChipAgents
providers.description: ChipAgents is the Agentic AI Chip Design Environment, helping semiconductor engineers iterate on chip design and verification up to 10x faster by collaborating with AI agents inside their favorite code editor. The platform spans design and verification workflows, coverage analysis, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA), surfaced through a project dashboard and the ChipAgents CLI, and is powered by the company's first model, Renoir. ChipAgents is delivered as a managed, authenticated web application (agent.chipagents.ai) rather than a public API; the company holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and is backed by Micron, Samsung, MediaTek, and Bessemer Venture Partners, with a team drawn from Cadence, Synopsys, and Mentor Graphics.

providers.name: Cladwell
providers.description: Cladwell is a smart-closet and outfit-planning consumer application that helps people build capsule wardrobes and get more wear out of the clothes they already own. The service digitizes a user's closet, then uses AI styling ("Ask Cladwell") together with weather and personal preferences to recommend daily outfits, reduce over-buying, and encourage sustainable, intentional dressing. With more than one million app downloads, Cladwell is delivered primarily as iOS/Android and web apps (app.cladwell.com) with a subscription model; it currently exposes no public developer API. Founded and led by CEO Erin Flynn, it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Confide *
providers.description: Confide is a confidential messaging application that lets people communicate digitally with the same level of privacy and security as the spoken word. Messages are end-to-end encrypted, ephemeral (they disappear after being read), and screenshot-protected so recipients cannot capture or forward them. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, and Windows across 200+ countries and 15 languages, with a free tier for individuals and small groups and a Confide Plus subscription that unlocks unlimited attachments, message retraction, incognito mode, nicknames, and themes. Confide is a consumer product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record backed by GV in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Daffy
providers.description: Daffy (the Daffy Charitable Fund) is a modern donor-advised fund (DAF) platform that helps people be more generous, more often. Co-founded by Adam Nash, Daffy lets members set aside money for charity, invest it tax-free across ETFs, individual stocks, and 300+ crypto assets, and then recommend grants to any of 1.7M+ eligible US charities on their own timeline. It offers flat-rate membership pricing starting at $3/month, family funds for up to 24 members, advisor integration, and Daffy for Work employer giving. Daffy Charitable Fund is a tax-exempt public charity under IRC 501(c)(3). Backed by Ribbit Capital, it operates as a consumer fintech app with no public developer API surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Enjamb Labs
providers.description: Enjamb Labs builds an AI-agent platform for pharmaceutical drug development. Its browser-based "integrated research environment" runs specialized agents across the full R&D lifecycle -- clinical evidence synthesis, trial design and statistical programming, and regulatory submission preparation -- while connecting to the systems pharma teams already use (Benchling, Veeva, Medidata, SAS) so no data migration is required. The workspace bundles Word/Excel/PowerPoint editors, Python and R compute environments, and 100+ scientific integrations, and emphasizes auditability, traceability, and human review, keeping each output attached to its sources, files, code, and decisions. Backed by Y Combinator and Founders, Inc., Enjamb reports early usage across major pharmaceutical companies including Johnson & Johnson, Merck, AbbVie, Bristol Myers Squibb, and Sanofi.

providers.name: Fiveable
providers.description: Fiveable is an Advanced Placement (AP) exam preparation platform covering all 38 AP subjects. It provides study guides, unit-organized subject review hubs, practice questions modeled on real AP exam formats, AI-scored free-response questions (FRQs), cheatsheets, key-term glossaries, and AP score calculators that predict likely exam outcomes. Fiveable serves three audiences - secondary students cramming and reviewing for AP exams, teachers seeking classroom and assessment materials, and schools needing district-wide exam-prep support. The platform blends traditional study resources with AI-powered scoring and feedback. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Fiveable publishes a consumer web application but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Game Theory
providers.description: Game Theory is a Bengaluru-based recreational sports and fitness membership platform operating 25+ centers across the city. Its consumer mobile app offers unlimited multi-sport coaching for kids and All Access adult memberships spanning 8+ sports — swimming, badminton, basketball, football, pickleball, squash, and table tennis — alongside pay-per-use slot booking, live game feeds, and corporate wellness programs. A Techstars-backed company, Game Theory publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer platform.

providers.name: GLORRI, INC.
providers.description: Glorri is a cloud-based applicant tracking system (ATS) and recruitment automation platform for talent acquisition teams. It spans the entire hiring process, from sourcing candidates across multiple channels and job boards, to automating recruiting workflows and candidate communication, AI-assisted applicant screening, and analytics on team performance and hiring efficiency, with GDPR-compliant data handling. Glorri markets plans (Pay as you go, Flex, Corporate, and Enterprise Plus) for companies of different sizes, with custom integrations and a branded career page available on higher tiers. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Glorri publishes a web application and marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Grailed
providers.description: Grailed is a peer-to-peer online marketplace for buying, selling, and discovering luxury, designer, vintage, and streetwear fashion for both men and women. Founded in 2013 and owned by GOAT Group, the platform lets independent sellers list clothing, footwear, accessories, and jewelry while Grailed facilitates the transaction, offering digital listing verification by trained moderators, purchase protection on qualifying orders, secure third-party payment processing (card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna), and a community trust and seller-rating system. Grailed does not publish a public developer API; it exposes a consumer web and mobile experience, an agent-facing /llms.txt, and a RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug bounty program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Gronda
providers.description: Gronda is a professional community and learning platform for chefs and hospitality professionals, offering 70+ masterclasses and 20,000+ exclusive restaurant recipes from leading chefs, a chef directory and creator program, and team and culinary-school plans. Members share culinary creations, follow world-class chefs, and access PRO subscription content through the Gronda web and mobile apps. Backed by Speedinvest, Gronda was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and profiled through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; it is a consumer/community product that does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Insurify
providers.description: Insurify is an insurance comparison marketplace licensed in all 50 U.S. states with real-time API integrations into 120+ carriers (500+ across the carrier network), covering auto, home, renters, pet, commercial auto, life, motorcycle, and travel. Consumers get side-by-side quotes in roughly two minutes and can buy online or through licensed agents. Insurify's Evia AI agent (Expert Virtual Insurance Agent) is a voice-and-chat agent that handles end-to-end shopping conversations with bind-ready quotes and renewal-cycle re-shopping. In February 2026 Insurify launched the insurance industry's first ChatGPT app via OpenAI's app library.

providers.name: Intenseye
providers.description: Intenseye is an AI-powered workplace safety platform that applies computer vision to a facility's existing CCTV cameras to detect unsafe conditions and behaviors in real time and prevent Serious Injuries and Fatalities (SIF). Its Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) product surfaces hazards, compliance gaps, and operational risks across manufacturing, logistics, food & beverage, and other high-risk industries, and can trigger Hard Stop emergency alerts. Intenseye offers cloud, private cloud, and on-premise deployment, is SOC 2 / AICPA certified and GDPR-aligned, uses AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS in transit, and does not use facial recognition. Backed by Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Point Nine. Intenseye publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; product access is through its dashboard and login. It maintains a public GitHub organization of mostly open-source forks and workshops rather than first-party client libraries.

providers.name: Joya Communications
providers.description: Joya Communications Inc. is the consumer software company behind Marco Polo, a video chat application for asynchronous, personal video messaging with the people who matter most. Marco Polo positions itself as a privacy-first alternative to social media, with no ads, no public feeds, and no social engagement metrics, and offers a Marco Polo Plus subscription with premium features. Joya Communications is venture-backed (Battery Ventures) and, as a consumer mobile app company, does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Machinations
providers.description: Machinations is a visual platform for designing, simulating, and balancing game economies, tokenomics, and other complex systems. Studios and designers model resource flows as interactive node-and-connection diagrams, run Monte-Carlo simulations to predict outcomes, and balance economies before a single line of production code is written. The product spans Design, Predict, and Balance modules plus an AI Builder that generates runnable diagrams from natural-language descriptions and a spreadsheet integration. It is used by studios such as Amazon Games, Hasbro, and Zynga and taught at MIT, NYU, and Berkeley. Machinations is a Seedcamp portfolio company; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Memoir
providers.description: Memoir, operated by Tachyon Labs, Inc., is an AI-powered marketing automation platform in Y Combinator's Spring 2026 (S26) batch. It connects to a company's development and product tools such as GitHub, Linear, and Slack and turns shipped product updates into multi-channel marketing content: social posts, blog posts, changelogs, demo videos, and customer updates generated in the company's brand voice. The product is organized around "Memory" (Atlas) for building context about a company and "Motion" (market-motion) for producing and distributing content as teams ship features. Memoir is a marketing SaaS product; as of this profile it exposes only a private authenticated backend (api.trymemoir.ai returns 401) and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Modern Fertility
providers.description: Modern Fertility is a women's health company offering at-home fertility and hormone testing along with pregnancy, ovulation and prenatal products. Its flagship Modern Fertility Hormone Test lets people measure reproductive hormones from home and review results with providers. The company was acquired by telehealth provider Ro and is now operated as part of Ro: modernfertility.com redirects to ro.co/fertility and the brand's products, accounts, legal terms and security program are served under the parent Ro platform. Modern Fertility exposes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks it as a consumer health brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Moviation, Inc.
providers.description: Moviation, Inc. is a Seoul-based advanced air mobility and premium travel company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. It operates Vonaer, an AI-powered luxury mobility platform that orchestrates on-demand travel across private aviation (jets and helicopters), luxury ground transportation (limousines), super yachts, and curated experiences, with planned expansion into electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) urban air mobility (UAM). Moviation currently runs air-taxi service with conventional helicopters and has partnered with hybrid-eVTOL developer Plana to build out an advanced air mobility (AAM) ecosystem in South Korea. The company reaches customers through the consumer Vonaer app and a concierge membership program; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Multiverse
providers.description: Multiverse is a British education-technology company (founded 2016 by Euan Blair and Sophie Adelman, headquartered in London) that operates an AI-adoption and workforce-upskilling platform. It delivers apprenticeships and training programmes in AI, data, software engineering, and digital skills, pairing on-the-job learning with expert coaching so employers can close skills gaps and build future-ready teams. Backed by investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and StepStone Group, Multiverse serves enterprise clients across the UK and US. The company exposes no public developer API; its digital surface is a marketing site, a learner/employer login, a help centre, a community hub, a blog, a service status page, and a trust centre.

providers.name: Netskope
providers.description: Netskope is a security service edge (SSE) and SASE platform delivering cloud-native Secure Web Gateway, CASB, Zero Trust Network Access, data loss prevention, and threat protection from its NewEdge global network. The Netskope REST API v2 provides tenant-level programmatic access to events, alerts, incidents, policies, IoCs, SCIM provisioning, and configuration so SOC and platform teams can automate SOAR, SIEM, and IGA workflows using service-account bearer tokens in the Netskope-Api-Token header.

providers.name: NEURA Robotics
providers.description: NEURA Robotics is a German deep-tech company building cognitive and humanoid robots for industry, business, and everyday life. It develops robots such as the 4NE-1 humanoid and the MAiRA, MiPA, LARA, and MAV cognitive cobots, powered by its proprietary AI system AURA. Its Neuraverse ecosystem is a connected platform and app marketplace that links robots, developers, and partners so AI models, applications, and hardware come together to make the robots smarter. NEURA Robotics is backed by HV Capital. As of this profile the company exposes no public, documented developer API: neuraverse.com is a gated single-page application portal, and no OpenAPI, developer documentation, or well-known discovery endpoints are published on its public surface.

providers.name: Oferteo
providers.description: Oferteo (oferteo.pl) is a Polish online services marketplace that connects people and businesses seeking services (Zlecający) with local contractors and service providers (Wykonawcy). Clients post a request across hundreds of categories — construction and renovation, IT, legal, health, events, transport and more — and matched providers respond with competitive quotes. The platform layers on verified reviews, a buyer-protection program (Ochrona Zlecających), and native iOS/Android apps for both sides of the marketplace. Oferteo operates nationwide across Poland and reports tens of millions of submitted requests and offers, millions of registered clients, and hundreds of thousands of registered providers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; this profile currently carries verified identity, website link-properties, and infrastructure/security probes.

providers.name: One
providers.description: OnePay (formerly One / One Finance) is a Walmart-backed consumer fintech that delivers a single mobile app combining banking, high-yield savings, a CashRewards debit card, a credit-building card, buy-now-pay-later, investing, cryptocurrency trading, and tax filing. Banking services are provided through partner banks Coastal Community Bank and Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The product is consumer-facing with no public developer API; a partner/developer portal exists behind authentication at developer.onepay.com. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Paycor
providers.description: Paycor is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) platform that provides payroll, HR, benefits administration, talent management, time and attendance, and workforce analytics for small and mid-sized businesses. The platform serves HR and finance teams with a unified system of record for employees, pay, time, and benefits data. Paycor exposes a Public REST API authenticated via OAuth 2.0 with authorization at secure.paycor.com and resource endpoints at apis.paycor.com (production) and apis-sandbox.paycor.com (sandbox).

providers.name: Pinscreen
providers.description: Pinscreen is an American AI and VFX production company founded in 2015 by Hao Li (MIT TR35 winner and professor of computer vision at MBZUAI), headquartered in Los Angeles with a branch in Abu Dhabi (UAE). It builds advanced generative AI for film production and interactive experiences, including AI lip sync, face reenactment, face swaps, de-aging, voice cloning, and photoreal 3D avatar digitization, and is known for developing the world's first real-time deepfake technology. Its Avatar Neo product generates a photoreal, riggable 3D avatar from a single photo (exportable as GLB/FBX with animation rigs) and is offered to developers as the Avatar Neo SDK: Unreal and Unity engine plugins backed by an avatar-generation API that can be deployed anywhere. Customers include Netflix, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros, Miramax, Apple, Google, Adobe, and DARPA. Backed by Lux Capital and Middle East investors.

providers.name: PulseMCP
providers.description: PulseMCP is a community platform and directory dedicated to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — the open protocol for connecting AI assistants and agents to external tools, data, and systems. Founded by Tadas Antanavicius (MCP Steering Committee) and Mike Coughlin in early 2025, PulseMCP curates searchable directories of MCP servers and clients, publishes use cases, runs the "Agentic Loop" newsletter, and operates a Discord community for builders. It also exposes a public PulseMCP Registry API (api.pulsemcp.com, v0.1) implementing the Generic MCP Registry API specification with PulseMCP-specific enriched metadata such as popularity, security analyses, and compatibility data. The PulseMCP GitHub organization additionally maintains MCP servers, the AIR collaboration framework, and shared agentic-engineering templates and artifacts. Access to the API requires contacting PulseMCP for a key and tenant ID; the directory and content are free to browse.

providers.name: Resolve Systems
providers.description: Resolve Systems (resolve.io) is an enterprise IT automation and AIOps platform that helps IT and operations teams automate incident resolution, service-desk workflows, and cross-domain remediation at scale. Its "Agentic Resolution Fabric" combines a Knowledge Agent (contextual answers across chat, portals, and collaboration tools), an Automation Agent (autonomous cross-domain workflows that remediate, configure, and orchestrate IT processes in real time), and Agent Assist (enriched diagnostics, related incidents, and next-best actions). Product lines include Resolve Actions, Actions Pro, Actions Express, and Barista, spanning IT process automation (ITPA), robotic process automation, and agentic service management. The company positions itself around cutting manual tickets by up to 90% and reports large aggregate customer savings. Resolve is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. This profile was enriched from public web sources; Resolve does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API, OpenAPI definition, or open developer portal — integration and automation are delivered through the platform's connectors and customer-gated documentation.

providers.name: Roam
providers.description: Roam (withroam.com) is a nationwide assumable-mortgage marketplace that helps homebuyers and sellers transact on homes carrying low-rate, legally assumable FHA and VA loans. A qualified buyer can take over a seller's existing mortgage, inheriting the original interest rate, remaining balance, and terms, which in a 6%+ market against sellers' 2-3% loans can save buyers hundreds of thousands in interest. Roam manages the end-to-end assumption process from buyer qualification and lender coordination through paperwork and a 45-day close, and offers proprietary secondary financing so buyers can put as little as 5% down. It is a proptech company backed by Fifth Wall and IVP. Roam publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Salesape
providers.description: SalesAPE.ai (operated by AI AGENT GROUP LTD, a UK-registered company) builds AI sales assistants that automatically engage and qualify inbound leads across email, SMS, web chat, and WhatsApp. Its AI agents respond to prospects 24/7, qualify them, and book sales appointments so human teams focus on closing. SalesAPE connects to CRMs and automation tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and Zapier (100+ integrations), logging and summarizing conversations back into the CRM. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass SalesAPE publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI; it exposes a customer app, a hosted status page, and standard legal pages. Sector: enterprise; AI.

providers.name: SiteJabber
providers.description: SiteJabber is a consumer review platform (rebranded as SmartCustomer at smartcustomer.com) where shoppers read and write reviews about online businesses and services across categories like clothing, electronics, and dating. Operating for over twenty years, it emphasizes consumer protection through review moderation and verification, and offers a browser extension that surfaces business ratings while users browse. On the business side it is an official Google Review Partner that distributes verified reviews to Google Seller Ratings, Google Business profiles, and Google Shopping Ads, and provides review-collection widgets and e-commerce integrations. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API or API reference was found on the provider's surface.

providers.name: Skupos
providers.description: Skupos is a retail technology platform for the convenience store industry that connects independent c-store retailers, distributors, and consumer brands through a single data network. Its SaaS platform delivers scan-data automation, back-office and financial management, tobacco scan-data incentives, digital loyalty and funded promotions, and GasBuddy integration. Founded in 2016 and backed by Insight Partners, Skupos was acquired by PDI Technologies in 2023 and now operates as part of the PDI Essentials product suite. Skupos runs an authenticated production API at api.skupos.com but publishes no public API specification, developer portal, or client SDKs.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: Stllr Network
providers.description: Stllr Network is an AI-powered user-generated-content (UGC) and creator-marketing platform for the Arab world, connecting brands with a network of nano and micro content creators and influencers across categories such as beauty, entertainment, tech, lifestyle, parenting, gaming, fashion, fitness, and cooking. Its products include Remix, an AI tool that scales creator videos into multiple ad variations; Premier, a managed service that handles creator outreach and ad-campaign management; and pay-as-you-go video Packages (PAYG). The platform is brand- and consumer-facing, billed in Saudi Riyal (SAR), and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Switchyards
providers.description: Switchyards is a membership-based neighborhood work club — a 24/7 network of coffee-shop-style workspaces built for focused solo work close to where members live. Each club pairs a bustling cafe with quiet library spaces for deep work, plus bookable phone booths and meeting rooms, free locally roasted coffee and organic tea, and fast internet. Membership runs about $100/month for unlimited access across all locations, and the company is expanding from its Atlanta roots into neighborhoods across the Southeast and beyond. Switchyards is backed by Bullpen Capital and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Sync API
providers.description: Sync API is an enterprise API platform for the in-app mobile advertising ecosystem, delivering performance, transparency, and control for marketers. The platform provides a bidder platform and suite of APIs for user acquisition, mobile user growth, and user re-engagement. It enables data-driven, ROI-focused mobile advertising across 1.2 billion global audiences in 50+ countries, with 500+ robust API integrations and advanced algorithms for LTV forecasting and in-app event conversion tracking.

providers.name: Teespring
providers.description: Teespring is a creator-commerce and print-on-demand platform, founded in 2011, that lets creators design, launch, and sell custom apparel and merchandise with no upfront cost or inventory, handling production, payment, and fulfillment on the creator's behalf. Backed by a16z, the company rebranded to "Spring" in 2021 and now operates as Amaze Commerce (part of Amaze Holdings): its consumer storefront lives at spri.ng while the creator/merchant SaaS platform runs at amazecommerce.com and amaze.co. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, /.well-known discovery surface, or llms.txt; this profile therefore captures verified company identity and published site properties only.

providers.name: The Mom Project
providers.description: The Mom Project is a talent marketplace that connects skilled professionals (with a focus on mothers and caregivers) to remote, hybrid, and onsite roles at family-friendly employers. The platform pairs a community of hundreds of thousands of vetted candidates with thousands of companies through job matching, curated talent search, and managed hiring services such as pay-per-hire and access plans. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, The Mom Project operates a consumer/employer web product and consumes third-party APIs (for example a Docusign eSignature integration for hiring workflows) but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable API surface of its own.

providers.name: Wave AI
providers.description: Wave AI (WaveAI) is a Sunnyvale, California AI music company founded in 2017 by David Loker, Dr. Maya Ackerman, and Chris Cassion, building foundational generative AI models for music and songwriting. Its flagship product LyricStudio is an AI-powered lyric-writing assistant used by millions of artists and creators to generate genre- and topic-aware lyrical suggestions, rhymes, and full songs, and MelodyStudio adds generative vocal-melody and chord generation. The company is backed by 500 Global, Horizon 3 Venture Capital, Kilowatt Capital, and angel investors. Wave AI ships consumer web applications rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with a domain-security probe and verified public link properties.

providers.name: WizerMe
providers.description: WizerMe (Wizer) is an edtech platform used by more than 700,000 teachers to build interactive, self-grading digital worksheets. Educators turn existing PDFs and documents into engaging assessments with multiple-choice, video, audio, open-response, and puzzle question types, record video or audio instructions, apply differentiation rules, monitor student work in real time, schedule availability and time limits, and sync grades with Google Classroom. Students submit answers as text, audio, or video. Wizer offers a free tier (Wizer Create) and a premium tier (Wizer Boost) plus school and district plans, and is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface is currently published.

providers.name: AfterHour
providers.description: AfterHour is a social copy-trading and investing community for retail investors, founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco. The mobile app lets verified traders connect their real brokerage accounts and share live, proven positions — more than $300M in live trades every day — so members can follow top traders, copy trades, discuss tickers in real-time stock chat rooms, receive alerts, and track their own portfolios. AfterHour is backed by Founders Fund and General Catalyst. This provider was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: ANN Inc.
providers.description: ANN Inc. is the former parent company of Ann Taylor and LOFT, specialty retailers of women's apparel, shoes, and accessories. ANN Inc. was acquired by Ascena Retail Group in 2015 and subsequently sold to Sycamore Partners in December 2020 for $540 million, alongside Lane Bryant and Lou & Grey brands. The brands now operate under KnitWell Group (formerly Premium Apparel LLC), a Sycamore Partners holding company that also owns Talbots. Ann Taylor and LOFT offer affiliate programs for digital publishers.

providers.name: Arrcus
providers.description: Arrcus is an AI-native networking software company that builds policy-driven routing, switching, and AI fabric spanning the edge, datacenter, and cloud. Its flagship ArcOS network operating system runs on merchant-silicon hardware and is complemented by ArcRR (scale-out route reflector), ArcIQ (analytics and visibility), ACE / ACE-AI (the Arrcus Connected Edge control and AI-networking platform), AINF (Arrcus Inference Network Fabric), and the TGAX AI switch. Arrcus targets GPU cluster connectivity for AI training and low-latency inferencing networks that reduce token cost. The company is venture backed by General Catalyst and Lightspeed Venture Partners. It exposes a login-gated customer portal and academy rather than a public developer API; no public OpenAPI, SDKs, or hosted API surface were found during enrichment.

providers.name: ARRIS Group
providers.description: ARRIS Group was a global telecommunications equipment company providing entertainment and communications solutions including broadband, video, and wireless products for service providers and consumers. ARRIS was acquired by CommScope in 2019, combining their broadband technology expertise with CommScope's infrastructure solutions. The combined company offers cable modem equipment, set-top boxes, network infrastructure, DOCSIS technology, and related telecommunications hardware and software platforms for cable operators, telcos, and internet service providers worldwide.

providers.name: Backbone
providers.description: Backbone is a mobile gaming company that makes the Backbone One controller — a snap-on gamepad for iPhone and Android — and the Backbone app, a mobile gaming platform that unifies a player's game library across cloud gaming, console Remote Play, and streaming services with game discovery, capture, and social features. The company sells hardware and accessories through a Shopify-hosted storefront (backbone.com) that exposes an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint and Shopify Customer Account OIDC. Backbone is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. This profile was enriched from Backbone's public web surface; the company publishes no first-party developer API.

providers.name: Billables Ai
providers.description: Billables AI is a San Francisco based legal technology company that builds AI-powered automatic time tracking software for lawyers, consultants, and professional services firms. Its platform passively captures billable activity as people work across the tools they already use — Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Zoom, Adobe, and the Chrome and Edge browsers — then uses AI to draft time entries, assign the correct client and matter, and write narrative descriptions, learning and adapting to each user over time. Privacy is user-controlled, with only the individual able to view or edit their own time records before they are submitted. The company is venture-backed (Series A) and was surfaced through the Wing Venture Capital portfolio.

providers.name: Binadox
providers.description: Binadox is a SaaS spend management and optimization platform providing usage monitoring, license optimization, shadow IT discovery, and cloud cost management to help organizations reduce wasted SaaS and cloud spend while gaining complete visibility into their software and infrastructure portfolio. Binadox integrates with AWS, Azure, GCP, and 100+ SaaS applications.

providers.name: Blackbird Labs
providers.description: Blackbird Labs is a New York-based hospitality technology company building a payments and loyalty platform for restaurants and their guests. Its flagship product, Blackbird Pay, is a blockchain-powered payment network that charges restaurants roughly 2% per transaction and settles automatically at the table, while diners earn $FLY loyalty rewards by checking in and can redeem points across participating restaurants. Payments run over Flynet, a layer-three transaction protocol built on Coinbase's Base, and membership is represented by an NFC-tapped NFT. Founded by Resy and Eater co-founder Ben Leventhal, Blackbird is backed by Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Coinbase Ventures, and Amex Ventures. Blackbird operates as a consumer mobile app and a merchant platform and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Capitolis
providers.description: Capitolis is a financial technology company for the capital markets that helps banks and institutional investors optimize how capital is used across their trading portfolios. Its two flagship offerings are a Capital Marketplace that connects banks with origination capabilities to institutional providers of capital, and a Portfolio Optimization service that offsets redundant and offsetting derivatives positions to reduce capital requirements, counterparty exposure, and systemic risk. By combining technology with financial expertise, Capitolis aims to create a safer, more efficient financial system and broaden access to more diversified pools of capital. The platform is delivered as a secure, login-gated web application to regulated financial institutions rather than as a public developer API.

providers.name: Citus Data
providers.description: Citus Data is the company behind Citus, an open source extension that turns PostgreSQL into a distributed database. Rather than forking Postgres, Citus adds sharding, distributed tables, reference tables, and a distributed query planner so applications can scale out across many nodes while keeping full SQL, ACID transactions, and the entire Postgres ecosystem. It is used for multi-tenant SaaS applications, real-time analytics dashboards, and microservices architectures. Founded in San Francisco and acquired by Microsoft in 2019, Citus is developed in the open on GitHub and is also offered as a managed cloud service (Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL); its reference documentation is hosted on Microsoft Learn. Citus is consumed over the standard PostgreSQL wire protocol and SQL, so it exposes no REST/HTTP API, no OAuth surface, and no language SDKs of its own.

providers.name: CloudNuro
providers.description: CloudNuro is an enterprise SaaS management and FinOps platform that combines SaaS discovery (shadow IT), SaaS subscription and license optimization, user lifecycle and compliance management, SaaS-Chargeback and cost allocation, and Cloud FinOps for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. It offers 400+ pre-built connectors to leading SaaS, IaaS, IAM, ITSM, HR, and security platforms. CloudNuro is SOC 2 Type II certified and has been recognized by Gartner in the SaaS Management Platforms market guide.

providers.name: Crozdesk
providers.description: Crozdesk helps businesses find and compare software across all major software categories. The platform indexes 43,000+ products across 377+ categories with expert reviews, user ratings, and AI-powered recommendations to guide software purchasing decisions. Vendors can list and advertise their products through the SoftwareSelect vendor portal.

providers.name: Cyence
providers.description: Cyence is a cyber risk analytics and modeling solution — originally an independent InsurTech startup (backed by IVP and others) and acquired by Guidewire in 2017 — that helps insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and managing general agents quantify, underwrite, and manage cyber insurance risk in financial terms. It combines internet-scale data collection, data science, and economic loss modeling to produce exposure signals, breach-probability estimates, and portfolio accumulation and catastrophe scenarios. Cyence data and scores are delivered to carriers through Guidewire Cloud and are available via a REST API for pricing, risk selection, and underwriting workflow automation. API access is partner-gated through a Guidewire account rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Databook
providers.description: Databook is an AI-powered decision system for enterprise sales teams, combining verified market intelligence with structured reasoning to give sellers visibility into their largest deals. The platform pairs an "Outside-In Radar" of signals beyond the CRM with an advanced reasoning engine, a dynamic Customer Context Graph modeling every buying group, guided sales agents tuned to specific KPIs, a CRO dashboard for leadership, and a Value Coach for executive narratives. It serves enterprise revenue organizations across cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, and software. Databook is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Threshold Ventures; it publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Dreamforge
providers.description: DreamForge.ai is an AI-powered game creation platform for building, iterating on, and publishing 2D and stylized 3D games directly in the browser. Creators use AI to generate gameplay systems, game-ready art and textures, animation, and playable web builds, then share public play pages under dreamforge.ai/play. The platform pairs a creator-facing web studio (including an Asset Studio) with a consumer application distributed on Steam, iOS, and Android. Founded in 2025 and based in Miami, Florida, DreamForge is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). DreamForge supports stylized 3D world generation, textures, voxels, and billboarding workflows; native 3D model generation is not currently provided. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Dtexsystems
providers.description: DTEX Systems (DTEX) is a cybersecurity company delivering a risk-adaptive insider risk management platform. Its DTEX InTERCEPT product and Platform v7 unify insider threat detection, data loss prevention (DLP), user activity monitoring (UAM), and AI/agentic risk governance through behavioral intelligence rather than intrusive content inspection. The platform correlates human behavior across endpoints to surface early-warning indicators along the insider threat kill chain, uses OCSF-aligned connectors and standardized schemas to export enriched telemetry to SIEM, SOAR, and ITSM tooling, and ships agentic defenders (Triage Guardian and Threat Hunter) to automate investigations. DTEX is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and serves enterprise and government customers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network; no public developer program, OpenAPI, or self-serve API documentation is currently published — integration is via the enterprise platform and OCSF connectors.

providers.name: EDITED
providers.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Enfusion
providers.description: Enfusion is a cloud-native, front-to-back investment management platform for hedge funds and asset managers, unifying portfolio management (PMS), order and execution management (OEMS), pre- and post-trade compliance, a unified IBOR/ABOR accounting book of record, and analytics on a single SaaS database. It serves over 1,000 clients across 30 countries, offers direct connectivity to 300+ liquidity sources via FIX, and maintains a 4M+ instrument security master. Enfusion was acquired by Clearwater Analytics (CWAN) in 2025; the enfusion.com domain now redirects to cwan.com, where Enfusion is offered as a product line. There is no public developer portal or open API specification: the platform API and knowledge base are gated behind the client web application and Zendesk help center. This profile was surfaced as an ICONIQ Capital portfolio lead and enriched from public marketing, support, and legal surfaces.

providers.name: Fishbrain
providers.description: Fishbrain is a Stockholm-based consumer technology company behind the largest social network and mobile app for recreational anglers, with a community of around 20 million fishermen and roughly 14 million logged catch locations. The app blends a social feed, a digital catch logbook with AI-powered species recognition, depth charts (from Garmin), local fishing reports with weather and bait intelligence, an AI-driven fishing-spot prediction map, and a searchable database of fishing regulations covering seasons, bag limits, and size rules. Fishbrain monetizes through a Fishbrain Pro subscription and is backed by Northzone and Seedcamp. It exposes no public developer API — api.fishbrain.com is a private backend for the iOS/Android apps — so this profile captures the company's public security, engineering, and web surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Flannel
providers.description: Flannel is a simple overlay network that satisfies the Kubernetes networking requirements. It runs a small single binary agent called flanneld on each host and is responsible for allocating a subnet lease to each host out of a larger preconfigured address space. Flannel does not expose its own HTTP/REST API; it stores network configuration in either the Kubernetes API or etcd directly and is managed via configuration files, kubectl, and Helm.

providers.name: fomo
providers.description: fomo (FOMO Labs Inc.) is a social-first cryptocurrency trading platform available as a mobile app and web platform. It lets mainstream retail investors trade memecoins, altcoins, and stablecoins across multiple blockchains without managing wallets, paying gas fees, or transferring assets manually, wrapping on-chain trading in a social layer where users discover tokens, follow top traders, view real-time buy alerts, copy trades, and compete on leaderboards. Onboarding is quick with Apple Pay funding, and trading is multichain and gasless. Founded in 2025 by former Deutsche Bank and dYdX team members (CEO Paul Erlanger, Se Yong Park, Prashan Dharmasena), the New York company reports 500,000+ active traders, 625,000+ total users, and $4B+ in trading volume. In June 2026 it raised a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark at a $550M valuation. fomo is a consumer-facing product and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: GEODNET
providers.description: GEODNET (Global Earth Observation Decentralized Network) is a Web3/DePIN blockchain-based RTK (Real-Time Kinematics) GNSS correction network. It incentivizes operators to deploy permanent GNSS reference stations ("Satellite Miners") that broadcast real-time correction data, letting nearby devices achieve centimeter-level positioning accuracy. Station operators earn GEOD token rewards, with a target of 100,000 evenly distributed base stations worldwide — roughly twenty times larger than existing CORS networks. The correction data fuels robots, drones, autonomous vehicles, precision agriculture, construction, surveying, and consumer mapping. Developer-facing surfaces are the GEODNET Console web platform, the RTK coverage service, and DAO governance; the GEOD token spans Polygon and Solana. This profile was seeded as a Multicoin Capital portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: GovGuard
providers.description: GovGuard is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) GovTech company building AI infrastructure for government agencies, starting with Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request automation. Its AI agents route incoming public-records requests, search across municipal archives (emails, meeting minutes, PDFs, and shared drives), flag personally identifiable information and other exempt material for redaction against the relevant state exemption codes, and draft response letters for clerk review while maintaining a complete audit trail. Agencies retain full ownership and control of all records and metadata, and GovGuard states that it does not train models on client data. The company was founded by Aditya Sabharwal and Gleb Hulting and is based in San Francisco.

providers.name: illoca
providers.description: illoca is an AI-native design engine built for professional architects and design studios, delivered through its product Tracing Paper. It helps architects move from early ideas to editable 2D and 3D designs with more speed and control, supporting sketches, redlines, prompts, floor plans, massing studies, iterative refinements, and exports for professional design workflows. Tracing Paper is built for controllable architectural ideation and iteration with editable outputs that hand off into BIM/CAD tools such as Autodesk Revit and Rhino. illoca is a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners (sector: ai-ml). As an application-first company it currently exposes a marketing site and web application rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Island
providers.description: Island is the developer of the Enterprise Browser, a Chromium-based browser purpose-built for the enterprise that embeds security, data protection, and governance directly into the last mile of work. The platform unifies an Enterprise Browser, Enterprise AI, and an Enterprise Network (SASE) so organizations can control how users interact with SaaS and internal applications, enforcing data-loss prevention, privileged access, insider-risk controls, and zero-trust policy at the browser layer, and replacing VDI/DaaS for many contractor and BYOD scenarios. Island is a private cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and other investors. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published; administration is via the management console at management.island.io.

providers.name: Jetstream
providers.description: Jetstream (jetstream.security) is a security-first AI governance platform for enterprises, backed by Redpoint Ventures. It helps organizations discover, control, and monitor AI systems at scale across five capabilities: AI Visibility (discovering and inventorying AI agents, models, tools, and workflows across environments), AI Design Control (documenting how agentic systems are assembled), Agentic Identity (binding human and AI identities to responsible owners), Runtime Governance (enforcing real-time behavioral compliance against approved designs), and AI FinOps Accountability (tracking usage and spend by model, agent, and workflow). The company positions governance as an accelerator for AI adoption, addressing shadow AI, cost control, accountability, and compliance. No public API, SDK, CLI, or developer portal is published as of this profile; the company pursues SOC 2, FedRAMP High, and DoD IL5 compliance.

providers.name: Jib
providers.description: Jib is an open-source container image builder from Google that builds optimized Docker and OCI images for Java applications without requiring a Docker daemon or writing a Dockerfile. It is available as plugins for Maven and Gradle, and integrates directly into the Java build process to produce reproducible container images.

providers.name: Keep Financial
providers.description: Keep Financial Technologies, Inc. is a compensation technology company that provides a vesting cash bonus platform. Employers deliver upfront cash to employees that is earned (vests) over a customizable time period with a legally enforceable right to repayment, automating signing bonuses, retention bonuses, annual and performance bonuses, spot bonuses, tuition reimbursement, M&A retention packages, and severance. The platform serves compensation, HR, finance, legal, and executive leaders across healthcare, construction, logistics, technology, retail, hospitality, manufacturing, and other industries. Keep Financial was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; it operates a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Klar
providers.description: Klar is a Mexican digital financial services platform (neobank) headquartered in Mexico City with engineering in Berlin, serving roughly 7 million customers. Regulated by Mexico's CNBV, Klar offers a deposit account with yield, a no-annual-fee credit card, a secured (garantizada) credit card, the metal Platino card, personal loans, investment products, and Chubb-underwritten life and fraud insurance, plus cashback and interest-free-months (MSI) benefits. It also runs Klar Empresarial for business customers, partnered with Uber to launch the Uber Card in Mexico, and announced the acquisition of mortgage fintech Yave. Klar's product surface is delivered entirely through its consumer mobile app and website; as of this profile Klar publishes NO public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or sandbox, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or webhook surface could be found. Third-party access to Klar accounts is generally brokered through Latin American open-finance aggregators (Belvo, Pluggy, Plaid) rather than a first-party Klar API. Klar does operate a public GitHub organization (klar-mx), but its repositories are internal infrastructure and DevOps tooling and forks, not client libraries for a Klar API.

providers.name: Ko
providers.description: ko is a simple, fast container image builder for Go applications that does not require Docker, producing small images by building Go binaries and layering them on a minimal base image for deployment to Kubernetes.

providers.name: Kustomize
providers.description: Kustomize is a Kubernetes-native configuration management tool that lets you customize untemplated YAML files for multiple purposes, leaving the original YAML intact and usable as-is, using a template-free approach to configuration customization.

providers.name: LabLabee
providers.description: LabLabee is an AI-powered enablement, testing and troubleshooting platform for telecom teams, positioning itself as "the Copilot for Telco Engineers." The platform delivers on-demand, hands-on labs, sandboxes, learning paths and skill tests covering 4G/5G and Open RAN, IMS, network OAM, SDN and IP networking, telco cloud (OpenStack, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker), DevOps and GitOps automation (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD), Linux, IAM and cybersecurity, and Industry 4.0 and IoT. Three AI capabilities sit on top of the lab catalog: AI Ask (search across telecom standards, vendor documentation and enterprise knowledge), AI Test (automated test execution and configuration validation) and AI Troubleshoot (automated trace analysis and root-cause identification). LabLabee serves telcos, universities, system integrators, network vendors and industrial private-network operators. Founded by Samir Tahraoui (CEO) and Mahfoud S. A. Mebarek (CPO), the company is backed by Accel, Kima Ventures, Reach Capital, Brighteye Ventures and 500 Global, and has been recognized as Best Telecom Startup by the World Communication Awards and with the TM Forum Growth Challenge Award. As of this enrichment pass LabLabee publishes no public developer program - no API documentation, API reference, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI or public package artifacts were found on any of its surfaces.

providers.name: Logstash
providers.description: Open source server-side data processing pipeline that ingests data from multiple sources, transforms it, and sends it to a specified destination. Part of the Elastic Stack.

providers.name: MadeThis
providers.description: MadeThis (madethis.com) is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) startup based in San Francisco that markets itself as "Your AI Co-Founder" — a platform of AI employees that build, market, and run a business on the founder's behalf. A user describes a business idea and MadeThis autonomously handles website and app development, Stripe-based payment and billing setup, ad-campaign creation and optimization, 24/7 AI customer support, email automation and cold outbound, market and competitor research, and code generation and deployment, iterating on founder feedback. It targets e-commerce, SaaS, agencies, online courses, coaching, and service businesses across Starter, Growth, Scale, and Enterprise tiers. As of this enrichment pass MadeThis publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation — it is a consumer/SMB SaaS product, so most API-oriented artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Maker
providers.description: Maker (the Maker Protocol / MakerDAO) is a decentralized finance protocol on Ethereum that issues the Dai and USDS stablecoins against on-chain collateral, governed by holders of the MKR governance token. a16z crypto is a long-standing backer, having acquired a significant share of the MKR supply. The protocol is transitioning to the Sky ecosystem (Sky Protocol, USDS, and the SKY token). Its developer surface is on-chain: Ethereum smart contracts documented for integrators, a Chainlog contract registry, and a governance Vote Data API, rather than a traditional hosted REST/OpenAPI product. This profile captures Maker/Sky's public developer, documentation, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: METYCLE
providers.description: METYCLE is a Cologne, Germany-based digital B2B marketplace and AI-powered trading platform for the international secondary (scrap) metal industry, connecting suppliers and buyers of recycled metals - copper, aluminum, zinc, nickel, lead and magnesium - across borders. Operated by METYCLE GmbH and led by managing directors Rafael Suchan and Sebastian Brenner, the company raised a 14.1M euro Series A round to expand its platform for transparent, sustainable global metal trade and to advance circular-economy sourcing of secondary metals. Its customer platform supports biddable listings, product discovery and trade execution. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; METYCLE currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Milo Credit
providers.description: Milo (formerly Milo Credit) is a Miami-based financial technology company and licensed mortgage lender that pioneered crypto-backed lending. Milo lets cryptocurrency holders access cash or finance U.S. real estate without selling their digital assets, offering crypto-backed mortgages with up to 100% financing, self-custody mortgages, and crypto-backed loans funded in as little as 24 hours, with rates starting around 7%. The company was an early portfolio investment of QED Investors and operates as a consumer-facing lending platform rather than a developer/API-first company. As of this enrichment pass Milo publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; its public surface is a consumer web application (app.milo.io), a marketing site, a blog, an FAQ, and a hosted trust/security center. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Moai.cash
providers.description: Moai.cash is a Telegram-native cryptocurrency super app operated by Sloika Industries, Inc. that bundles digital-wallet, payments, and Web3 financial services into a familiar messaging interface. It advertises zero-fee transactions, support for 1,000+ tokens, multi-chain deposits, token swapping, peer-to-peer money transfers, prediction markets for real-world events, and an on-chain lottery (Megapot). The company promotes an embedded-apps "API" that lets third-party applications run inside the Moai experience (payment processing, wallet management, token operations, lending/borrowing, real-world assets, Web3 gaming, and tokenized stocks), but that API is gated behind an email access request with no public documentation, OpenAPI specification, base URL, or self-service developer portal at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mobagel
providers.description: MoBagel is an AI and automated machine learning (AutoML) company founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with offices across seven global locations. Its flagship Decanter AI platform lets business users build machine learning models and generate predictions without a data science background, spanning AutoML, automated time-series forecasting (AutoTSF), MLOps, DataOps, and a generative-BI suite (Generative BI, Generative ETL, Generative Expert) now surfaced through the 8ndpoint product and a family of vertical AI agents for marketing, supply chain, finance, and manufacturing.
