Their myVoyage platform integrates financial wellness tools to help participants plan, invest, and protect their financial futures. Voya does not offer a public developer API but provides account connectivity through open banking aggregators such as Plaid.

providers.name: Waymo
providers.description: Waymo is the autonomous driving subsidiary of Alphabet, originally spun out of the Google Self-Driving Car Project. The company develops the Waymo Driver, a full Level 4 autonomous driving stack combining custom lidar, radar, and camera sensors with proprietary perception, prediction, and planning models. Waymo One operates a commercial robotaxi service in Phoenix, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Austin, and other expanding US markets, with announced launches in Tokyo and London. The company has logged tens of millions of rider-only miles and reports significantly fewer serious-injury crashes than human-driven benchmarks. Waymo does not publish a traditional public developer API. Its primary developer-facing artifacts are the Waymo Open Dataset, the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, the Waymax JAX-based driving simulator, and a robust research publication catalogue spanning perception, behaviour prediction, planning, simulation, and end-to-end driving. Consumer access is through the Waymo One mobile app.

providers.name: Web3Auth
providers.description: Web3Auth (now MetaMask Embedded Wallets) is a non-custodial threshold-key wallet and authentication platform. It provides client SDKs (Web, React, Vue, iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Unreal, Node.js) and a backend Auth Network for OAuth-anchored MPC key shares. Public HTTP surface is limited and SDK-first.

providers.name: WebinarJam
providers.description: WebinarJam is a live webinar platform for marketing, training, and sales events, while its sibling product EverWebinar provides automated and evergreen webinar replays. Both products share a REST API that lets integrators retrieve webinars, register attendees, manage registrants, and drive marketing automations. The WebinarJam/EverWebinar API uses an API key (requiring approval) included in request payloads, with separate base paths for each product family.

providers.name: Werf
providers.description: Werf is an open-source CNCF sandbox project providing a complete GitOps-based CI/CD solution for Kubernetes. It implements the full application delivery lifecycle — building images, managing dependencies, deploying Helm charts, and cleaning up container registries — using Git as the single source of truth (Giterminism). Werf integrates natively with all major CI systems, Buildah, Helm, and Kubernetes.

providers.name: 3PAR (HPE 3PAR StoreServ)
providers.description: 3PAR is an enterprise storage platform, now part of Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE acquired 3PAR in 2010), that powers mission-critical applications with HPE 3PAR StoreServ and Primera arrays. For developers and automation engineers, 3PAR exposes the HPE 3PAR Web Services API (WSAPI) — a REST interface that manages storage provisioning, virtual volumes, hosts, ports, CPGs, snapshots, and remote copy on 3PAR/Primera/Alletra arrays, offering a more flexible and programmable alternative to the 3PAR Command Line Interface. HPE publishes first-party client libraries (Python, Ruby, PowerShell) plus Ansible, Puppet, Chef, OpenStack Cinder, and Docker volume integrations against WSAPI. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead (Mayfield, Menlo Ventures backed the original 3PAR before its IPO and HP acquisition) and enriched from HPE's public developer surface.

providers.name: Adalo
providers.description: Adalo is a visual no-code app builder that lets users design, build, and publish native iOS, Android, and web applications without writing code, combining a drag-and-drop canvas with AI-assisted generation and hosted Postgres-backed collections. The platform supports external data sources, pre-built feature templates, and 2,000+ integrations via Zapier and Make, hosting over a million apps. The Adalo API provides REST access to app collections and push notifications, secured with a per-app Bearer API key.

providers.name: AirGarage
providers.description: AirGarage is a full-service parking management platform that helps property owners operate their parking lots and garages as revenue-generating real estate assets. The company combines proprietary data, full-service operations, and proactive pricing strategy: license plate recognition and aerial cameras capture real-time occupancy and compliance data, dynamic pricing automatically adjusts rates based on demand, aggregator marketing lists spaces across channels, on-the-ground teams handle real-time enforcement, and a managed driver-support operation processes mobile payments. Property owners get a real-time dashboard with transparency into revenue, occupancy, and market trends, on a revenue-share model with no long-term contracts. AirGarage is a portfolio company of a16z.

providers.name: Albertinvent
providers.description: Albert Invent builds Albert OS, an AI operating system for chemists and R&D teams that unifies electronic lab notebooks, structured molecular-level experimental data, chemical drawing, and safety/compliance data (safety data sheets for roughly 400,000 substances) with chemistry-trained AI models built on a foundation of 15 million molecular structures. The platform helps materials, formulation, and specialty-chemical teams capture proprietary experimental data and accelerate discovery, training custom predictive models on each customer's own chemistry. Albert Invent is a scientific R&D / developer-tools SaaS company backed by Homebrew; its APIs and developer surface are not publicly documented (product documentation at docs.albertinvent.com is access-gated).

providers.name: Arq
providers.description: Arq (formerly DolarApp) is a Latin American cross-border fintech app that gives travelers, investors, and professionals digital dollar and digital euro accounts at real market rates without hidden fees. Founded in 2021, the mobile-first platform offers currency conversion, a borderless payment card, global accounts to send and receive international payments, bill payment, PIX transfers, stock and ETF investing, and high-yield Trade and Save accounts, plus ARQ Premium and Prestige tiers. Arq raised $70M from Sequoia Capital and Founders Fund and serves over 2 million users across the Americas. Arq is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public identity and web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atlantic Money
providers.description: Atlantic Money is a London-based fintech, founded in 2020 by Robinhood alumni and backed by Index Ventures, offering international money transfers at a flat GBP 3 fee with the live mid-market exchange rate and no FX markup. The service supports transfers across ten currencies with direct bank deposits and standard or express delivery, for both consumers and businesses, and is authorized and regulated by the UK FCA as a payment institution. Atlantic Money is a consumer- and business-facing mobile and web application; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface, so this network profile is limited to company identity, website property links, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Beengo
providers.description: Beengo operates as Appfront (appfront.ai), an all-in-one restaurant engagement and eCommerce platform backed by 500 Global. The platform gives restaurants branded online ordering, dine-in scan-and-pay, loyalty and CRM, SMS/push/email marketing campaigns, gift cards and payments, branded native iOS/Android apps, and data analytics. It integrates with major point-of-sale systems (Toast, Revel, SpeedLine, Square, Clover, PAR/Brink, Oracle Hospitality MICROS, NCR) and third-party delivery (DoorDash, Postmates). No public developer program, OpenAPI, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company identity, web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Blindmate
providers.description: Blindmate is a friend-based dating app that inverts the swipe model: instead of writing their own profile, a single person's friends answer questions about them, and matches are made through character-first "Blindchats" that surface compatibility before appearance. Founded in Germany and available on iOS and Android in German, English, and Spanish, the app reports over one million users and positions itself around trust, reduced harassment, data privacy, and green-energy infrastructure. Blindmate is a Speedinvest portfolio company; it is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures its web, security, and policy surface rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: BloomNation
providers.description: BloomNation is a flower-delivery marketplace that connects consumers with independent local florists for same-day and next-day delivery of handcrafted floral arrangements across 40+ U.S. cities and the UK. Customers shop florist-designed bouquets for occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, and get-well, then pay with credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, or Afterpay. Distinctive features include BloomSnap photo delivery confirmation and video message cards. BloomNation also runs a florist-facing SaaS side (point-of-sale, website, and order management, now part of Promenade) that powers member shops. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bloomon
providers.description: Bloomon is a flower and gift delivery service that lets customers order one-off bouquets or sign up for a recurring flower subscription delivered on a chosen cadence. It offers seasonal hand-tied and letterbox arrangements, gifting options, gift vouchers, and add-ons, with delivery across the United Kingdom and other European markets. Bloomon is part of the Bloom & Wild Group (confirmed via its published .well-known/security.txt, which points to bloomandwild.com). The company operates a consumer-facing e-commerce and subscription website rather than a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile therefore captures its web, security, and discovery surface rather than a machine-readable API.

providers.name: Brandywine Realty Trust
providers.description: Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE: BDN) is a publicly traded, fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) headquartered at Cira Centre in Philadelphia. The company owns, develops, leases, and manages a roughly 22 million square foot portfolio of office, life science, mixed-use, multifamily, retail, and education properties concentrated in the Greater Philadelphia, Austin, and Washington, D.C. markets. Brandywine is the developer behind Schuylkill Yards, uCity Square, Uptown ATX, Broadmoor, and Discovery Point, and has delivered roughly $2.6 billion and 12.1 million square feet of ground-up developments, master-planned communities, and adaptive reuse projects over a 30+ year operating history.

providers.name: Can Capital
providers.description: CAN Capital is a small business financing company that provides short-term working capital loans, equipment financing, and ecommerce loans to small business owners across the United States. One of the earliest alternative small-business lenders, the company has facilitated more than 190,000 funding transactions totaling over $8 billion in working capital, underwriting on business performance and daily/weekly revenue rather than traditional credit criteria. Borrowers apply online, receive fast funding decisions, and manage their accounts through a self-service client portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network; CAN Capital publishes a marketing site, application flow, and customer portal but no public developer API or discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Carrot Fertility
providers.description: Carrot Fertility is a global fertility and family-building benefits platform for employers and health plans, providing members with comprehensive reproductive and family-forming support across more than 195 countries. Carrot covers fertility care and preservation (egg, sperm, and embryo freezing), IVF and other assisted reproduction, surrogacy, adoption, pregnancy and postpartum support, low- and no-cost fertility options, gender-affirming care, and menopause and midlife care. Delivered as a B2B employee benefit with member and provider portals, Carrot pairs concierge care navigation with a network of clinics and experts. The company is HIPAA-compliant and maintains SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, and HITRUST attestations. This API Evangelist profile tracks Carrot as a healthcare provider surfaced from the Uncork Capital portfolio; Carrot does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Cedar
providers.description: Cedar is a healthcare financial technology company whose patient financial experience platform unifies billing, payments, insurance coverage, and support for health systems, hospitals, and clinician-services groups. Its products include Cedar Pay (pre-visit, post-visit, and financing patient payments), Cedar Cover (benefits and financial assistance, including Medicaid enrollment), Cedar Support (AI-powered patient support and call-center automation via Kora AI), and Cedar Intelligence (a proprietary AI system for personalized patient engagement). Cedar reports having served over 50 million patients and processed billions of dollars in patient payments. The company is backed by a16z, Founders Fund, QED Investors, and SV Angel. Cedar publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or GitHub organization; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and security-posture surface.

providers.name: Cino
providers.description: Cino (getcino.com) is a European consumer fintech that offers the first shared virtual card that splits and pays a group bill at the same time. Members connect their existing debit or credit cards, create a group with configurable split ratios, and each person is charged only their proportional share at the moment of payment with no pre-funding required. The shared card works online and in person for one-off or recurring expenses, integrates with Apple Pay and Google Pay, supports per-transaction and monthly spending limits, and positions itself as a replacement for bill-splitting tools like Splitwise, Tricount, PayPal, and Tikkie. Cino is available across 29 European countries and is a portfolio company of Balderton Capital. This is a consumer mobile app with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Clair
providers.description: Clair Inc is a New York-based financial technology company that provides free, compliant On-Demand Pay (earned wage access) as an embedded service inside the payroll, time-and-attendance and workforce-management platforms employees already use. Rather than selling a consumer app, Clair partners with platforms — Gusto Embedded Payroll, Check, 7shifts and others — and connects to them over a partner REST API that transmits employee, employment and attendance data, which Clair's underwriting engine uses to originate 0% APR earned wage advances through its FDIC-insured partner bank, Pathward N.A. Partners embed a Clair-hosted user experience (a WebView component, distributed for iOS as Swift packages) so employees can take an advance, review history and handle loan servicing without a separate login. Clair has raised roughly $218M in total capital, including a $23.2M Series B in May 2025.

providers.name: Clearing
providers.description: Clearing (WTUK Limited trading as Clearing) is a cross-border financial infrastructure provider offering multi-currency accounts, global payments, cross-currency liquidity, and digital-asset settlement to businesses operating internationally. It is a regulated electronic money institution: authorised by the UK FCA under the Electronic Money Regulations (ref 900536), licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore as a Major Payments Institution (PS20200445), and registered with FINTRAC in Canada. This record was surfaced as a stub via VC-portfolio tagging (sector originally recorded as healthcare); on enrichment the clearing.com domain resolves to this fintech/payments company, and no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Cowboy
providers.description: Cowboy is a Brussels-based mobility company that designs and manufactures premium connected electric bicycles for urban commuting. Its lineup — the Cruiser, Cruiser ST, Cross, and Cross ST — pairs a lightweight frame with removable batteries, integrated GPS tracking, crash detection, and its proprietary AdaptivePower motor assistance, all managed through the Cowboy mobile app. The company sells direct-to-consumer and through a network of 125+ service centers and mobile technicians across 40+ European cities, complemented by leasing, business, and student programs. Backed by Index Ventures, Cowboy operates a Shopify-based storefront and a connected-bike app platform; it does not publish a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the company's real identity, legal, support, and security surfaces.

providers.name: Desjardins Group
providers.description: Desjardins Group (Mouvement Desjardins) is the largest cooperative financial group in North America, founded in 1900 in Lévis, Quebec by Alphonse Desjardins. It is a federation of caisses populaires (member-owned credit unions) rather than a share-capital chartered bank, comprising the Fédération des caisses Desjardins du Québec and its subsidiaries, the caisses in Quebec and the Caisse Desjardins Ontario Credit Union, regulated in Quebec by the Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF). It holds roughly CAD $470 billion in assets and serves more than 7.8 million members and clients with personal, business, wealth-management and insurance products. On open finance, Desjardins publishes no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specification; developer.desjardins.com and other API-portal subdomains do not resolve, and consumer financial-data access is delivered today through third-party aggregators (Flinks, Plaid, Finicity, Tink) via screen-scraping/aggregator connectivity rather than a documented Desjardins API. Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework is legislated (Budget 2024/2025, overseen by the FCAC) but not yet operational; as a cooperative outside the Big Six, Desjardins may opt in to Phase 1 rather than being mandated.

providers.name: Dialogus
providers.description: Dialogus is a frontier AI voice lab building infrastructure for enterprise-grade voice agents that resolve, trace, and control every live conversation across phone systems, internal workflows, and customer systems. Its platform connects voice agents to phone systems, internal tools, databases, CRMs, and messaging channels, with human escalation flows, monitoring, and compliance built in. Agents run a Listen, Reason, Act, and Report loop that detects turns, silence, and intent, constrains the model with workflow state and policies, executes approved tools, and produces auditable transcripts and outcomes. Dialogus targets live customer support, phone order-taking into the POS, and past-due collections, and positions itself as SOC 2 compliant for live operations. Founded by ex-Google, Meta, and Microsoft engineers, it is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: dopay
providers.description: dopay is a digital payroll platform operating in Egypt that lets employers register employees and disburse salaries in minutes through a single system, including permanent, temporary, and seasonal workers across construction, agriculture, hospitality, retail, healthcare, education, and manufacturing. Supervised by a bank and regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt, dopay digitizes cash-based wage payments and pairs core Salary Disbursement with an Early Pay earned-wage-access product that lets employees withdraw part of their salary before payday. Originally a Techstars-backed fintech focused on banking the unbanked, dopay is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a business web app and login but no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Edison Scientific
providers.description: Edison Scientific is an AI research company building Kosmos, an autonomous "AI Scientist" for R&D teams in drug discovery and biopharma. Kosmos reads scientific literature, analyzes experimental data, generates and tests hypotheses, and executes research workflows autonomously, collaborating with scientists through tools like Slack and Teams. The model-agnostic platform spans the drug development lifecycle from target identification through clinical development and filing, learning from proprietary organizational and scientific data. Edison Labs publishes open science research including the PaperQA line of multimodal deep research agents. The company is backed by Spark Capital and maintains an enterprise Trust Center with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Ejari Co.
providers.description: Ejari (ايجاري) is a Riyadh-based property-technology and fintech company transforming the rental market in Saudi Arabia with a rent-now, pay-later (RNPL) model. Ejari pays a tenant's full annual rent to the landlord up front, then lets the tenant repay in twelve calm monthly installments, replacing the Kingdom's traditional single-cheque annual rent requirement. Founded in 2022 by Yazeed Al-Shamsi, Fahad Albedah, Mohammed Alkhelewy and Khalid Almunif, the company operates across 17+ Saudi cities and is building toward a full-service, Sharia-compliant real-estate super app. Ejari is backed by 500 Global and won the 2024 KPMG Global Tech Innovator competition.

providers.name: El-Dokan
providers.description: El-Dokan (El Dokan Software) is a Cairo, Egypt-based enterprise eCommerce software company founded in 2019 that provides an API-first, headless and composable commerce platform for the MENA region. Its 300+ REST API endpoints and developer tools let brands and retailers make any digital experience shoppable across web, mobile apps, POS, and multi-vendor marketplaces, supporting B2C, D2C, B2B, and marketplace models with 100+ payment, shipping, SMS, and ERP integrations and MENA localization. Customers include Procter & Gamble, Misr Pharmacies, Mobily, Zahran, Switch Plus, and Appetito. El-Dokan raised a $550,000 pre-seed round in 2022 backed by Flat6Labs, EFG EV, 500 Global, and Hala Ventures. Public API documentation (data model, getting started, and API reference) is gated behind a get-access signup.

providers.name: Endl
providers.description: Endl is a financial-technology company offering "the operating account for borderless businesses." The platform lets consulting firms, agencies, contractors, marketplaces, and importers/exporters collect payments in 9+ currencies, send to 160+ countries, hold balances in USD, EUR, GBP and regulated stablecoins, and spend through physical and virtual Visa corporate cards with spend controls — all from a single dashboard. Endl positions itself against Wise, Payoneer, Revolut, Deel, Mercury and Airwallex, and is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently advertised; the product is dashboard-first.

providers.name: Fastwork
providers.description: Fastwork is Thailand's leading freelance and services marketplace, connecting businesses and individuals with roughly 200,000 vetted service providers across about 300 categories — including design and graphics, web and app development, AI development and automation, marketing and advertising, writing and translation, photography and video, and lifestyle services. An escrow-based "Fastwork Guarantee" holds payment until work is delivered, protecting both buyers and freelancers. The platform serves individuals, SMEs, and enterprises with a dedicated business portal, and is expanding from Thailand into Indonesia and Vietnam. Fastwork is backed by 500 Global and Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Finoa
providers.description: Finoa is a Berlin-based, BaFin-regulated digital asset infrastructure provider serving institutional investors, asset managers, family offices, venture capital funds, and regulated crypto service providers. Its platform combines qualified custody, in-custody staking, and prime brokerage across 170+ digital assets and 12 Layer-1 networks, with security and governance controls built for institutional and regulatory requirements. Finoa exposes a gated institutional API surface (api.finoa.io) and a client platform (login.finoa.io / app.finoa.io) rather than a public self-serve developer program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Fiverr
providers.description: Fiverr is a global online marketplace for freelance digital services, founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, and publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FVRR). The platform connects businesses and individuals with freelancers offering "gigs" across hundreds of categories including graphic design, writing and translation, programming and tech, video and animation, digital marketing, music and audio, and AI services. Fiverr also operates Fiverr Pro and Fiverr Enterprise for vetted talent and managed teams, Fiverr Workspace for freelancer business tooling, and an affiliate partnership program. Fiverr does not currently publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI-described API; its programmatic surfaces are limited to the consumer marketplace and partner/affiliate integrations. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched with the public identity, security, and discovery signals available.

providers.name: Get
providers.description: Get (useget.com) is a Singapore-based fintech company offering a mobile banking and financial-literacy platform for children, teens, and their families. The Get app pairs separate kid and parent accounts with prepaid Visa cards, parental spending controls, automated weekly allowances, a chore-based reward system, real-time spending analytics, and savings-goal folders, so young people can practice using real money tools in a safe, supervised environment. Get sells consumer subscription tiers (Get Core and Get Plus) plus a family account, and operates under a Payment Services exemption in Singapore. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification is published at this time; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Giftly
providers.description: Giftly is a digital gifting platform that lets anyone send a flexible monetary gift redeemable at a specific local or national business, or as cash. Senders pick a place or category, customize the card design and tagline, choose a gift amount up to $1,000, and deliver it by email, text, print, or mail. Recipients redeem a Giftly gift as a Visa or Mastercard gift card by mail, as a credit to their bank account, or as a credit to their PayPal account; gifts never expire and carry no inactivity fees. Giftly also runs a corporate and business program for companies sending gifts at scale. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital; Giftly publishes a consumer web product and a business portal, but no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Highbeam
providers.description: Highbeam is a business banking and finance platform built for modern consumer brands (direct-to-consumer and e-commerce). It brings together operating and high-yield accounts, a charge card that pays cashback on advertising spend, working capital and credit lines, automated bill pay, and spend intelligence, alongside Luma, an applied-AI finance assistant. Banking services are delivered through partner banks (Thread Bank, member FDIC) and Airwallex. Highbeam is based in New York City. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this entry captures the company identity, its public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Hubble
providers.description: Hubble (hubblehq.com) is the UK's largest flexible-workspace marketplace, connecting businesses with private offices, coworking desks, day offices, meeting rooms, and on-demand workspace across thousands of buildings in the UK and beyond. Founded in 2014 by Tushar Agarwal and Tom Watson, the platform lets companies configure, deliver, and manage all their space in one place on flexible one-to-24-plus-month terms, and was acquired by Yardi in January 2025. Hubble runs a consumer-facing web platform and internal backend API rather than a published public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web, security, and discovery surface.

providers.name: iContact
providers.description: iContact is an email marketing and marketing automation platform (now part of Cision) that helps small and mid-market businesses build email campaigns, manage contacts and lists, automate drip sequences, and measure engagement. The iContact REST API v2.2 provides programmatic access to contacts, lists, segments, campaigns, messages, and reporting data using a combination of HTTP headers (API-AppId, API-Version, API-Username, API-Password) for authentication.

providers.name: Invicti
providers.description: Invicti is an enterprise web application security solution providing automated vulnerability scanning, DAST, and API security testing. The Invicti platform includes API Discovery capabilities that help build a complete inventory of an organization's internal and external API assets.

providers.name: Ipsy
providers.description: IPSY is a personalized beauty subscription company founded in 2011 by Michelle Phan, Marcelo Camberos, and Jennifer Goldfarb. Members take a detailed beauty quiz and receive monthly curated "Glam Bag" drops of deluxe samples and full-size makeup, skincare, hair, and fragrance products across tiers (Original, Boxycharm, and Ultimate). IPSY operates as a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership platform under the BFA Industries umbrella; it exposes no public developer API, running on internal GraphQL and REST services with Auth0-based consumer identity. This API Evangelist profile tracks IPSY's public web, security, and identity surface rather than a documented developer program.

providers.name: Ixlayer
providers.description: Ixlayer is a direct-to-patient healthcare technology company that helps biopharmaceutical companies transform the patient experience through an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Its unified platform spans virtual patient onboarding and intake, telehealth for primary and specialty care, at-home and in-center lab testing with mobile phlebotomy, prescription fulfillment (retail, specialty, and home delivery), benefits verification and claims, connected care with provider directories and scheduling, and the ixAI patient concierge for AI-powered support and care coordination. Ixlayer says it has powered more than 1,100 nationwide programs and enabled over 4 million patient care journeys, and states its services are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. The company is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: KareInn
providers.description: KareInn is a UK-based digital care management and care-home planning software provider whose cloud platform helps residential and nursing care providers streamline operations, evidence CQC compliance, and improve resident care. The product suite spans a care-management dashboard with occupancy and management reporting, a customizable care-plan builder, clinical policy and procedure workflows, care-delivery task assignment and monitoring, pre-admissions and occupancy pipeline management, event and incident tracking, and a resident and family engagement portal. KareInn integrates with partner systems including Civica/Coldharbour income processing, Camscope electronic medication management, and Ally Cares acoustic monitoring, and is positioned as an NHS assured supplier. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio lead; KareInn does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or a machine-readable discovery surface — the artifacts below capture its public product, commercial, and policy pages only.

providers.name: Klippa
providers.description: Klippa is a document AI platform whose flagship product, DocHorizon (rebranded as Doxis AI.dp following the SER acquisition), provides OCR, document classification, conversion, verification, fraud detection and anonymization for 50+ document types. Klippa also publishes dedicated APIs for receipts, invoices, IDs/passports and expense management. EU-hosted, GDPR / ISO 27001 certified.

providers.name: Knight Fintech
providers.description: Knight Fintech is a Mumbai-based banking technology company that sells digital lending infrastructure to Indian banks and NBFCs. It positions itself as "India's leading digital lending infrastructure platform", stating it powers 500+ financial institutions across co-lending, digital lending, treasury management, supply chain finance, embedded finance and credit line on UPI, alongside a Knight Aurix product line. The company describes its approach as cloud-first, API-driven middleware that integrates with legacy core banking systems without displacing them. It is enterprise sales-led: there is no public developer portal, no published API documentation, no SDKs and no self-service signup — evaluation runs through a scheduled demo.

providers.name: Lansweeper
providers.description: Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform that automatically scans and inventories hardware, software, users, and cloud resources across on-premises, cloud, and OT environments. It provides a unified technology asset intelligence platform used for IT asset management (ITAM), cybersecurity asset management (CAAM), software asset management, and compliance. The Lansweeper Data API is a GraphQL endpoint that exposes the technology asset intelligence stored in your Lansweeper sites using Bearer token authentication.

providers.name: LastPass
providers.description: LastPass is a password and identity-management platform offering personal and enterprise vaults, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and directory provisioning. The LastPass Enterprise API and Provisioning API let admins programmatically manage users, groups, shared folders, policies, and events. SCIM and SAML endpoints integrate with identity providers; an MFA SDK supports adaptive authentication for custom apps.

providers.name: Lovepop
providers.description: Lovepop is a Boston-based consumer greeting-card and gifting company, founded in 2014 and known for its intricate laser-cut 3D pop-up cards inspired by Vietnamese "kirigami" paper engineering. The company sells directly to consumers through its Shopify-powered storefront at lovepop.com and through retail partners, offering pop-up greeting cards, gift boxes, flowers, and personalized gifting. Lovepop was accelerated by Techstars and appeared on ABC's Shark Tank. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this pass Lovepop publishes no first-party developer API, SDKs, or developer portal, and its public digital surface is a standard Shopify commerce storefront (including Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth well-known documents served on the domain).

providers.name: Moneyfellows
providers.description: Money Fellows is an Egyptian fintech, founded in 2018 and regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt, that digitizes the traditional rotating savings and credit association (ROSCA / "gam'eya") model as a mobile app. Members join Money Circles to save together and access interest-free funds on flexible 6, 10, or 12-month plans of up to 1.2M EGP, and can spend and save through a prepaid Money Fellows Mastercard. The service is Sharia-compliant (Official Fatwa No. 46205 from the Egyptian Dar Al Iftaa) and has served millions of users while raising roughly $60M across its funding rounds, including a 2025 Series B first close backed by investors such as Partech. Money Fellows is a consumer mobile application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Montenegro Open Data
providers.description: Montenegro Open Data is a national government open-data portal for Montenegro running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 894 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: MoonLake AI
providers.description: Moonlake AI Inc. is a San Francisco based company building world models and simulation infrastructure for embodied AI. Its platform turns an image, video, or text description into physically accurate, simulation-ready 3D models of the world — assets shipped with baked-in physics and articulation (joints, ranges, drive limits) that export directly to USD, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and MuJoCo. Teams generate sim environments and digital twins in hours instead of weeks via a hosted generation API. Moonlake is backed by Threshold (formerly DFJ), AIX Ventures, and NVIDIA's venture arm, and was named to the CB Insights AI 100 in 2026.

providers.name: Nabu
providers.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: NoBroker
providers.description: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt Ltd is an Indian proptech company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bengaluru, that operates a brokerage-free real estate marketplace connecting property owners directly with tenants and buyers across Indian metros. Beyond listings for flats, houses, villas, plots, PGs and commercial space, NoBroker sells adjacent home services — rental and lease agreement drafting, legal assistance, packers and movers, painting and cleaning, home loans and rent payments — and operates NoBrokerHood, a gated-community and housing-society management / ERP product covering visitor management, billing, accounting and complaints. NoBroker became India's first proptech unicorn in 2021. The company ships software only as an end-user web and mobile product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable specification, and its application endpoints under /api/v1..v5 are explicitly disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Noodle
providers.description: Noodle is a Brazilian fintech building financial infrastructure for the creator economy. It provides automated payouts to creators, influencers, and vendors; FastPay early access to future earnings; noodleOS, a unified platform for campaigns, creator data, payments, and asset tracking; global payouts powered by Ebanx; foreign-exchange settlement; and credit and capital products underwritten in part on a creator's social presence. Backed by QED Investors, Noodle serves media companies, agencies, and platforms that pay content creators. The company references API-based integrations but publishes no public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Omnitracs
providers.description: Omnitracs is a commercial fleet management, telematics, and transportation-management provider, now part of Solera Inc. (acquired 2021, operating under Solera Fleet Solutions). Its Omnitracs One platform and the Omnitracs Roadnet routing platform serve roughly 15,000 fleet customers with ELD / Hours-of-Service compliance, telematics and GPS positioning, driver workflow and messaging, routing and dispatch, and video safety. Omnitracs exposes real integration APIs and web services (Roadnet Web Services, the Services Portal Entity Management web services, and the SOAP/XML Event Subscription Service that streams positions, messages, HOS, and critical events), but access is partner- and customer-account gated - there is no open, self-service public developer portal. API credentials (a username/password with API access) and the integration developer wiki are provisioned to contracted customers and integration partners. Endpoints documented here for gated surfaces are honestly modeled from public integration notes, not from an open reference.

providers.name: Onecard
providers.description: OneCard is a mobile-first metal credit card from India's FPL Technologies, a fintech unicorn that reimagines credit and payments with full-stack, in-house technology. OneCard is issued in partnership with banks including Bank of Baroda, CSB Bank, Federal Bank, SBM Bank, South Indian Bank and Indian Bank, and emphasizes simplicity, transparency and giving control back to the user. FPL Technologies also operates OneScore (credit-score monitoring) and Wizely (savings). Backed by QED Investors, OneCard is a consumer-facing product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Opal
providers.description: Opal is a marketing planning and content calendar platform that gives marketing teams a single visual workspace to plan campaigns, build editorial and content calendars, manage creative workflows and approvals, and connect strategy to execution across channels and markets. It is used by enterprise brands such as Target, Starbucks, GM, and SAP, and pairs a unified planning calendar with a "Gem" AI co-pilot plus prebuilt integrations to tools like Salesforce, Snowflake, Google Analytics, Google Sheets, and Zapier. Opal publishes a public marketing site, pricing, and a security/trust posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) but does not expose a public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: OpenFX
providers.description: OpenFX is a cross-border payment infrastructure provider delivering real-time foreign exchange liquidity and settlement for institutional clients across emerging markets. Backed by Accel and Northzone, it pairs traditional-finance reliability with blockchain-rail speed to settle fiat and stablecoin payments in minutes across 40+ currency pairs and 25+ local payment rails, and exposes a programmatic Trading API (REST, FIX and Streaming) to automate quotes, trades, deposits and withdrawals. Serves remittance companies, FX on/off ramps, payment service providers and stablecoin infrastructure providers.

providers.name: Paradigm Health
providers.description: Paradigm Health is an AI-native clinical trial platform connecting biopharma sponsors with a research-ready provider network spanning roughly 2,100 care locations across the United States. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, the company operates infrastructure implemented at healthcare provider organizations to make clinical research part of routine care. Its Study Conduct platform captures data directly from electronic health records and other structured and unstructured sources, algorithmically evaluates FDA-defined data points in real time, and transmits the critical safety and efficacy signals needed for regulatory determinations to trial sponsors and the FDA. Paradigm serves both trial sponsors (protocol optimization, feasibility and site selection, patient identification and enrollment, data collection and delivery, post-approval evidence) and research sites. The company acquired Flatiron Health's Clinical Research business, announced a research collaboration with the U.S. FDA, and is backed by ARCH Venture Partners, General Catalyst, and GV. Paradigm currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity, legal, and published security/compliance surface.

providers.name: Podia
providers.description: Podia is an all-in-one creator platform for selling online courses, digital downloads, coaching, webinars, and memberships, with a website builder, blog, communities, and built-in email marketing. As of this review, Podia does NOT offer a public or partner developer API and does not expose webhooks. The company's own help center states plainly that "Podia does not offer a public API or webhooks," and directs builders to Zapier as the only supported integration path. The logical resources below (products, customers/audience, community, and sales) are therefore documented as endpointsModeled - they reflect the objects and events Podia surfaces through its Zapier app, not a first-party REST API. There is no published base URL, authentication scheme, or OpenAPI description to catalog.

providers.name: Preql
providers.description: Preql (preql.ai) is an enterprise data platform that automates data cleaning, reconciliation, and semantic modeling to deliver the trustworthy context layer that AI agents and business analytics depend on. Its agentic platform combines Agentic Semantic Modeling, Data Cleaning Agents, and AI-Powered Reporting to automatically resolve data mismatches, schema drift, and anomalies across ERP, CRM, HR, and expense systems without manual intervention, serving finance, operations, revenue, and executive decision-making at large enterprises. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Felicis, and added to the API Evangelist network. Preql does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public company identity, help center, and web properties.

providers.name: Prodigy Finance
providers.description: Prodigy Finance is a fintech lender providing collateral-free, no-cosigner postgraduate education loans to international master's students at top business, engineering, and STEM schools worldwide. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, it uses a borderless, forward-looking credit model based on a borrower's projected future earnings rather than local credit history, funding students from more than 150 countries. Prodigy Finance operates consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) applications, an accounts portal, and a customer help center, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Quantcast
providers.description: Quantcast is a San Francisco-headquartered digital advertising and audience intelligence company founded in 2006. Its flagship offering is the Quantcast Platform, an AI-driven demand-side platform (DSP) for programmatic display, video, CTV, audio, mobile, and native advertising, powered by the company's proprietary Audience Graph and Ara AI engine. Quantcast also operates Quantcast Measure, a free audience measurement product that has tagged millions of digital properties to produce demographic, psychographic, and cross-device audience insights. For programmatic access, Quantcast exposes a developer portal at developers.quantcast.com built around a GraphQL API (v2) for reporting, campaign management, and audience operations on the Quantcast Platform, secured via OAuth 2.0 client credentials. A server-to-server Conversion API augments the browser-side Live Tag for offline and signal-loss-resilient conversion tracking. Quantcast Choice, the company's IAB TCF v2-compliant Consent Management Platform, was acquired by InMobi in August 2023 and is now operated as part of InMobi CMP; legacy Quantcast Choice mobile SDKs remain published under the quantcast GitHub organization for reference. Quantcast also open-sources the Quantcast File System (QFS), a C++ distributed file system, and mobile/Roku measurement SDKs.

providers.name: Raenest
providers.description: Raenest (formerly Geegpay) is a global money platform for freelancers, creators, remote workers, students, and businesses in Africa and beyond. It provides multi-currency accounts in USD, GBP, EUR, USDT, and USDC, virtual and physical Visa cards, international payment collection from 190+ countries, smart invoicing tools, US stock investing, stablecoin support, and a rewards program. Raenest is delivered through its mobile and web apps (app.raenest.com); as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. Backed by QED Investors and Techstars.

providers.name: Salido
providers.description: SALIDO is a hospitality technology company providing a unified restaurant point-of-sale (POS) and payment processing platform for full-service, casual, upscale, and fine-dining operators. The system combines front-of-house and back-of-house operations, table and floor-plan management, menu and inventory tools, real-time analytics and multi-location reporting, and a mobile manager app, with an in-house payment processor (EPX). Originally a 500 Global / 500 Startups portfolio company, SALIDO was acquired by First Data and is now backed by North American Bancard (NAB). No public developer API or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Spirl
providers.description: Spirl is a non-human identity and access management (IAM) startup that in 2025 rebranded to Defakto (defakto.security); spirl.com now redirects to the Defakto site. The company secures automated systems — workloads, services, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and AI agents — by replacing static secrets and hardcoded credentials with short-lived, cryptographically verifiable identities built on open workload-identity standards (SPIFFE/SPIRE style). Co-founded by Eli Nesterov (ex-ByteDance infrastructure) and Danny Oliveri, it targets the enterprise gap where organizations run millions of non-human identities protected only by static secrets. Defakto was named a 2025 Gartner Cool Vendor in Identity-First Security. It is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site, blog, and security page but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, CLI, or developer portal — access is via demo request, so there is no API surface to enrich at this time.

providers.name: StarRocks
providers.description: StarRocks is a high-performance, open-source (Apache 2.0) OLAP / lakehouse engine. Clients run SQL via the MySQL protocol, while the FE HTTP server exposes REST endpoints for management and Stream Load is an HTTP-based ingestion API. CelerData provides the managed cloud offering.

providers.name: Susquehanna International Group (SIG)
providers.description: Susquehanna International Group (SIG) is a privately held global quantitative trading firm founded in 1987 by a group of college friends who began trading on the Philadelphia Stock Exchange, leveraging quantitative skills and poker-derived decision science. Headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, the firm employs more than 3,500 people across 17+ offices worldwide and operates as one of the largest options market makers globally. SIG's businesses span Quantitative Trading, Predictions, Institutional Sales, Growth Equity (Susquehanna Growth Equity / SGE), Sustainable Investments, Asia-focused Venture Capital (notably an early and large stake in ByteDance), and the River's Edge promotional arm. SIG does not operate a public developer portal, expose external trading APIs, or publish open-source repositories under a public GitHub organization; all technology is internal to the trading and quantitative research platform. Public surface is limited to sig.com (company / careers / insights), the SGE site, and corporate communications.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed company (originally launched as "Sweep — AI-powered junior developer") that has pivoted from being a GitHub App which turned issues into pull requests into an AI coding assistant delivered primarily as a JetBrains IDE plugin, with autocomplete-only support for VS Code and Zed. The current Sweep product pairs a proprietary "Tab model" next-edit autocomplete with an in-IDE Agent for chat, inline editing, AI commit messages, and AI code review across IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, Android Studio, RustRover, RubyMine, CLion, and Aqua. The plugin indexes the local codebase for context, supports Remote MCP Servers with OAuth, web search and fetch tools, and ships under a commercial credit-based pricing model (Free Trial, Basic $10/mo, Pro $20/mo, Ultra $60/mo) with enterprise SOC 2 and zero-data-retention options via contact sales. Sweep has no public developer REST API, no SDK, and no documented webhooks; the company's primary distribution surfaces are the JetBrains Marketplace, the VS Code Marketplace, and the Zed extension registry, and its open-source footprint on GitHub has narrowed to research forks (SWE-bench, SGLang), tokenizer/diff utilities (bpe-qwen, difflib-rs), and the now-legacy sweepai/sweep repository that documented the original GitHub PR agent. Sweep is profiled here as an AI developer-experience vendor rather than as an API provider.

providers.name: Terminal
providers.description: Terminal (terminal.io) is a talent platform for hiring vetted remote and nearshore software engineers for full-time, contract, and contract-to-hire roles. It combines AI-fluency assessment and technical vetting (accepting roughly the top 7% of applicants) with Employer of Record (EOR) services that handle HR, payroll, and benefits across 180+ countries, sourcing engineers from Latin America, Canada, and Europe. Terminal is a B2B staffing and hiring platform rather than an API provider — it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by 8VC and Lightspeed Venture Partners; added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Tone
providers.description: Tone is a full-stack royalty management platform for music rights owners — independent labels, distributors, and royalty teams. It centralizes royalty accounting, income tracking, and contract management, then pays artists directly through integrated global payouts. The platform processes large royalty periods quickly, provides near-real-time sales intelligence with timeline views and customizable charts, models deal structures with a contract simulator (reserves, deductions, escalations), automatically associates costs with the applicable royalty periods, and gives artists transparent dashboards into their earnings. In-app artist payouts are powered by Airwallex for secure multi-currency international payments, letting labels pay artists and partners worldwide without juggling separate banking tools. Tone is backed by QED Investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC-portfolio lead; Tone is a SaaS application and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Torch
providers.description: Torch (Redfish Labs, Inc. dba Torch Leadership Labs) is a leadership development and executive coaching platform that pairs expert human coaches with AI to help mid-market and enterprise organizations grow leaders and navigate change. Its offerings include Change Coaching (leaders-turned-coaches trained in Torch's change approach), the Spark AI coaching agent (always-on AI guidance for practicing conversations and turning insight into progress), and Organizational Intelligence (real-time visibility into change patterns and people dynamics). Torch focuses on AI transformation, organizational restructuring, organizational resilience, and leadership growth, and counts Airbnb, Reddit, Tripadvisor, FICO, and Twitch among its customers. Torch is a SaaS product with SSO (SAML), Zoom, and Slack integrations but publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Vuori
providers.description: Vuori is a California-based performance athletic apparel and activewear brand founded in 2015 in Encinitas, offering men's and women's clothing built for training, running, yoga, and everyday wear. The direct-to-consumer business runs on a Shopify storefront at vuoriclothing.com plus a growing retail footprint, and is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners (and later SoftBank Vision Fund). Vuori publishes no public developer API or developer portal; it exposes a consumer web/mobile storefront, a help center, and a brand blog. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's real public web surface — its security.txt vulnerability-disclosure contact, domain-security posture, and customer-facing pages — rather than a developer program, which does not exist.

providers.name: Wayhome
providers.description: Wayhome (formerly Unmortgage) is a London-based property technology company founded in 2016 by Nigel Purves and Josef Wasinski. It offers "Gradual Homeownership" — a part-buy, part-rent alternative to a traditional mortgage in which a customer buys at least 5% of a home and pays rent on the remainder, gradually increasing their ownership stake over time. Wayhome pairs aspiring homeowners with institutional investors (including Allianz), letting people who can afford rent but cannot secure a conventional mortgage move into a home of their choice with a deposit as low as 5%. Wayhome is authorised and regulated in the United Kingdom. It is backed by fintech venture investors including Anthemis, Augmentum Fintech, Allianz X and Accelerated Digital Ventures. Wayhome operates as a consumer-facing service and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Youtrip
providers.description: YouTrip (You Technologies Group, you.co) is a Singapore-based fintech that operates a multi-currency mobile travel wallet paired with a prepaid Mastercard, letting consumers hold and spend in over 150 currencies with no foreign-exchange fees and competitive in-app exchange rates. Launched in 2018, the company also runs YouBiz, a business account and corporate card product for SMEs, and offers international transfers to more than 40 countries. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, YouTrip processes billions of dollars in transactions annually across Singapore, Thailand, and Australia. As of this enrichment pass YouTrip exposes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or GitHub organization; consumer-facing account access is available only indirectly through open-banking aggregators.

providers.name: Zoho Meeting
providers.description: Zoho Meeting is an online meeting, video conferencing, and webinar platform from Zoho that lets teams host secure meetings, presentations, and recorded webinars from any device. The Zoho Meeting REST API enables programmatic scheduling, management, and reporting of meetings and webinars, including registrant handling and session lifecycle. Authentication uses Zoho's OAuth 2.0 (Zoho-oauthtoken) with domain-specific API endpoints.

providers.name: Zscaler
providers.description: Zscaler is a cloud security platform delivering Zero Trust Exchange services including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler exposes REST APIs across its product suite for configuration, policy management, and reporting, authenticated via API keys, OAuth 2.0, or session-based authentication depending on the product and cloud (zsapi).

providers.name: Aclima
providers.description: Aclima is a San Francisco-based environmental intelligence company that maps and analyzes air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions at hyperlocal, block-by-block resolution. Using a network of roving (vehicle-mounted) and stationary sensors, Aclima measures multiple pollutants and climate gases simultaneously at up to 100,000x greater resolution than traditional monitoring, then translates billions of scientific measurements into environmental intelligence for governments, companies, and communities. Its professional analytics software, Aclima Pro, delivers visualization and automated analytics for emissions reduction and public-health programs, while its free air.health app maps address-level air and climate insights for the communities Aclima serves. Co-founded by CEO Davida Herzl, Aclima is backed by DCVC and is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Adaptigent
providers.description: Adaptigent (formerly GT Software) is a technology company founded in 1982 that specializes in mainframe integration and API enablement solutions. Their flagship product, Adaptive Integration Fabric (formerly Ivory Suite), empowers enterprises to expose legacy mainframe systems as modern REST and SOAP APIs without writing any code. Using a patented no-code, drag-and-drop environment, the platform enables integration of IBM z/OS and z/VSE mainframe applications with modern distributed systems, supporting both inbound and outbound integration flows in real time. Adaptigent serves industries including finance, government, manufacturing, and healthcare, offering a usage-based subscription pricing model.

providers.name: AdMagica AI
providers.description: AdMagica.ai is an AI-powered creative advertising platform founded in 2023 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom, that helps e-commerce brands, marketers, and creators generate high-performing ad creatives and manage campaigns at scale. Its "AI marketing agents" automate ad-creative generation, campaign management, and multi-channel publishing to networks such as Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Instagram, replacing expensive agency and design workflows with template-driven, product-specific ad production. The platform is an end-user marketing SaaS; it currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Alif
providers.description: Alif Semiconductor is a Silicon Valley fabless semiconductor company building secure, ultra-low-power 32-bit microcontrollers and fusion processors for edge AI/ML. Its Ensemble, Ensemble Gen AI, and Balletto product families pair Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A cores with dedicated Ethos-U55 neural processing units, hardware AI acceleration, wireless connectivity, and a multilayered security architecture so machine-learning and generative-AI workloads can run directly on battery-powered devices. Developer resources center on Zephyr-based SDKs, CMSIS device family packs, VS Code project templates, evaluation kits, datasheets, reference manuals, and the Conductor configuration tool rather than a hosted web API. The company is backed by Kleiner Perkins.

providers.name: Appify
providers.description: Appify is an enterprise application platform that lets organizations build, extend, and migrate line-of-business software without traditional development. The company markets a model-driven, AI-native platform — apps are described in natural language and the platform generates the data model, UI, permissions, workflows, and analytics — plus an "Unshackle" AI agent that extends systems of record such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle, or replicates an existing SaaS application on Appify-owned infrastructure. Appify states 40+ enterprise integrations, 12+ industries in production, and 20M+ transactions processed, and its published pricing includes "REST API access" and "unlimited apps, objects, endpoints" as standard capabilities. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification is published; the API surface sits behind the tenant login.

providers.name: AppNeta
providers.description: AppNeta is a network performance monitoring (NPM) platform for the distributed, cloud-connected enterprise, now delivered as a Broadcom product under its IT Operations Management / Network Management portfolio. AppNeta Performance Manager continuously measures network paths, delivery quality, usage, and end-user application experience across SaaS, cloud, and internet paths using a combination of active (synthetic) and passive monitoring from distributed monitoring points. It exposes a RESTful API (v3 for AppNeta Classic and v4 for AppNeta with Intelligent Alarms) for programmatic access to monitoring policies, web paths, web applications, alarm connectors, and event/observer integrations, authenticated with API access tokens. As of February 2026 the API interface and documentation were upgraded from Swagger to OpenAPI 3.0. AppNeta was originally an independent, Battery Ventures-backed company before joining Broadcom.

providers.name: Arc
providers.description: Arc (arc.dev, formerly CodementorX, and sister to the Codementor mentorship marketplace) is a remote talent marketplace that connects companies with vetted freelance and full-time software developers, designers, marketers, and product managers across 190 countries. Arc screens applicants down to roughly the top 2%, and partners with Deel and Remote for cross-border payroll and compliance. Arc operates as a hiring platform and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Aspect Health
providers.description: Aspect Health is a digital health company offering a science-backed program for women managing PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome). Its PCOS program combines continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), personalized coaching from board-certified health coaches, at-home lab testing for inflammation, hormonal, cardiovascular, and metabolic markers, and the Aida AI dietitian, all delivered through a mobile app. Additional programs cover weight loss, general women's health, and a 21-day check up, with HSA/FSA-eligible plans. Aspect Health is a Techstars-backed company and operates as a consumer (B2C) health platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Beamy
providers.description: Beamy is a SaaS discovery and governance platform that helps organizations identify unauthorized cloud applications (shadow IT), manage their SaaS portfolio, track spending, enforce security policies, and ensure compliance. Beamy uses browser extension-based detection and integrates with SSO, expense management, and ITSM systems to provide comprehensive SaaS visibility and control. The platform serves IT, security, and procurement teams seeking to reduce SaaS sprawl and govern their cloud application landscape.

providers.name: Biobot
providers.description: Biobot Analytics is a wastewater epidemiology company that operates a wastewater intelligence platform, analyzing sewage samples to detect and track more than 50 human health indicators — including pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, measles, norovirus), substances (fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, buprenorphine), and public-health threats (HIV, mpox, poliovirus, Candida auris) — before they surface in conventional reporting. Founded from MIT research and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Biobot serves federal, state, and local government agencies, pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, and healthcare systems through dashboards, CSV exports, map visualizations, and enterprise data integrations. Biobot does not publish a public self-serve developer API; data access is arranged directly with the company.

providers.name: bttn
providers.description: bttn (bttn Inc., trading online as bttnusa.com) is a Seattle, Washington based business-to-business e-commerce marketplace and wholesale distributor of medical supplies, lab equipment and pharmaceuticals, selling name-brand consumables to clinics, dental, veterinary and physical-therapy practices, clinical laboratories, home-healthcare providers and other healthcare buyers across the United States. Founded in 2021 by JT Garwood and Jack Miller and backed by Tiger Global, the company operates a self-serve online storefront carrying 60,000+ catalog products with bulk and volume pricing, same- or next-business-day shipping, quote requests, purchase-order and invoice payment, shopping lists, quick-order pads and recurring reorder tooling. The storefront is a BigCommerce commerce back end fronted by a Catalyst/Next.js application. bttn publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its e-commerce surface is buyer-facing only.

providers.name: Caremessage
providers.description: CareMessage is a healthcare technology non-profit that operates one of the largest patient engagement platforms serving low-income and underserved populations across the United States. Since 2013 the platform has reached more than 20 million patients and is used by roughly 1 in 7 federally qualified health centers plus 200+ free clinics. Its products include 1:1 direct messaging, appointment lifecycle messaging, population outreach, health coaching, closed-loop referrals, Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) workflows, and Wellness Copilot, an AI-backed diabetes-management automation. CareMessage does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API reference; access to the platform is through its web application and a login-gated help center. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched from CareMessage's public web surface.

providers.name: Circle Medical
providers.description: Circle Medical is a San Francisco-based online and in-person primary care clinic offering telemedicine and clinic-based visits with same and next-day availability. Founded through Y Combinator, the company operates 20+ physical locations and provides virtual appointments across multiple US states through Circle Medical Care of California, an independent medical practice. Its 400+ board-certified physicians, physician assistants, and nurse practitioners treat primary care, mental health (ADHD, anxiety, depression), hormone and sexual health, urgent care, weight loss (GLP-1s), sleep, and dermatology. Circle Medical is a HIPAA-covered, patient-facing digital health provider; it publishes no public developer API or SDK program, and this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CircuitLab
providers.description: CircuitLab, Inc. is an in-browser schematic capture and circuit simulation platform that lets engineers, students, educators, and hobbyists design and analyze analog and digital electronics systems before building a physical prototype. Running entirely in the browser with no installation, it offers schematic capture, mixed-signal SPICE-style simulation (DC, AC, transient, frequency-domain), custom device models and symbols, expression-based parameters, and shareable, exportable documentation. CircuitLab also publishes an electronics curriculum (CircuitLab Academy, the Ultimate Electronics textbook), community forums, and an electronics Q&A. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. At the time of this enrichment pass CircuitLab publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API description, so this profile captures its public web identity only.

providers.name: Community Labs
providers.description: Community Labs is an independent research organization founded in 2022 by Tate Berenbaum, oriented toward a single belief: access to the future of intelligence should not be gate kept by the hardware people can afford. The company raised a $30M seed round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, originally operating as a native software development company and venture studio accelerating developer tools and adoption of the Arweave permaweb, and has since refocused on local and consumer-hardware AI inference research. Its open source surface spans Hypura, a storage-tier-aware LLM inference scheduler for Apple Silicon that exposes an Ollama-compatible HTTP API, Autolab, an autonomous research orchestration framework, and the labscommunity GitHub organization of Arweave developer libraries including ArweaveKit, Arweave Wallet Kit, and the Arweave Storage SDK.

providers.name: Connect-RPC
providers.description: Connect is a slim framework for building browser-friendly and gRPC-compatible HTTP APIs from Protocol Buffer schemas. Servers built with Connect speak the Connect protocol, gRPC, and gRPC-Web simultaneously, while clients can switch between protocols without changing code. Connect provides type-safe SDKs for Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, and Python, plus the Buf-generated `protoc-gen-connect-*` code generators. The project is open source under the Apache 2.0 license and is maintained by Buf.

providers.name: Continuous Delivery Foundation
providers.description: The Continuous Delivery Foundation (CDF) is a Linux Foundation project that hosts vendor-neutral open source projects for continuous integration, continuous delivery, and DevOps. It is the home of CDEvents, Jenkins, Spinnaker, Screwdriver, Ortelius, JayeX, and was previously the home of Tekton (now a CNCF graduated project) and other CD-focused tooling.

providers.name: Cooler Heads
providers.description: Cooler Heads Care, Inc. is a San Diego medical device company founded in 2018 by Kate Dilligan that makes Amma, an FDA-cleared Portable Scalp Cooling System (PSCS) used to reduce chemotherapy-induced hair loss. Amma circulates chilled fluid through a fitted cap to constrict scalp blood vessels and limit chemotherapy delivery to hair follicles, and is designed to be portable enough that patients can keep cooling outside the infusion chair. The company sells to infusion centers and oncology practices and publishes patient, provider, reimbursement and training material on its own site. It ships no developer API, SDK or public API documentation; its only machine-readable public surface is the Wix-platform site MCP endpoint and llms.txt served from its own host.

providers.name: Ctrl
providers.description: Ctrl (Ctrl, Inc., a Delaware corporation) is an AI-powered workspace for revenue and sales teams that consolidates the tools and data a rep needs — CRM, email, calendar, and messaging — into a single actionable view. Founded in 2021 by Omri Sagzan and Aviv Nahum and based in Tel Aviv and London, Ctrl automates the manual work of updating records across apps such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Slack, and helps teams codify and replicate their winning sales playbooks. The company raised a $9M seed round led by LocalGlobe and Earlybird in 2023 and was acquired by Sana Labs in October 2024. Ctrl is a UI/workspace product surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs.

providers.name: Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board
providers.description: The Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board (DNFSB) is an independent organization within the executive branch of the United States Government chartered to provide recommendations and advice to the President and the Secretary of Energy on public health and safety issues at Department of Energy defense nuclear facilities. The DNFSB publishes recommendations, letters, technical reports, weekly site-representative reports, and rulemaking notices through its public website and FOIA reading room. The agency does not publish a developer-oriented API; programmatic users rely on document downloads, RSS feeds, and Federal Register integrations.

providers.name: Dependency Injection
providers.description: A design pattern in which objects receive their dependencies from external sources rather than creating them internally, promoting loose coupling, easier testing, and clear composition roots. Effective use of this practice reduces bugs in production and supports a culture of quality-driven development.

providers.name: Design Patterns
providers.description: Reusable solutions to commonly occurring problems in software design, including the Gang of Four catalog (creational, structural, behavioral) and core API design patterns such as HATEOAS, idempotency keys, webhooks, and sagas.

providers.name: Design Standards
providers.description: Design Standards encompasses the frameworks, guidelines, and best practices used in product, interface, and system design to ensure consistency, usability, and accessibility. Includes API design guidelines, naming and format conventions, accessibility conformance, deprecation policy, and governance practices.

providers.name: Digbi Health
providers.description: Digbi Health is a digital therapeutics company delivering a precision-biology virtual clinic for food-related and inflammatory illnesses — obesity, cardiometabolic disease, type 2 diabetes, digestive disorders (IBS, GERD), MSK chronic pain, PCOS, sleep and mental health. Its FoodRx program combines host-genetics and gut-microbiome testing with app-based coaching, precision nutrition, and pre/probiotic therapies, delivered to members through health plans and employers. Digbi Health is backed by Accel. The company operates a consumer-facing storefront and member app rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the public web, agent, and security surfaces observable at digbihealth.com.

providers.name: DLT Payments
providers.description: DLT Payments (DLTPAY) is a Web3 payments company offering a stablecoin wallet that enables businesses to send and receive instant payments in stablecoins across multiple blockchain networks — Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, and BNB Chain — with zero exposure to cryptocurrency price volatility. The product targets merchants and businesses that want the settlement speed and low cost of blockchain rails without the FX risk of holding volatile tokens. DLT Payments is a Techstars portfolio company. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public web surface; no public API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation was discovered at enrichment time.

providers.name: DomScan
providers.description: Domain intelligence API for domain availability, DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, valuation, security checks, email posture, social handle checks, and monitoring workflows. Offers REST API, machine-readable contracts, a hosted MCP server, and llms.txt.

providers.name: Dorsata
providers.description: Dorsata is a women's health technology company based in Arlington, Virginia that reimagines the electronic health record (EHR) experience for obstetrics and gynecology providers, life sciences, and health plans.
