Its flagship Dorsata Prenatal platform overlays a practice's existing EHR with an ACOG-aligned prenatal flowsheet and a clinical rules engine that surfaces the right guidance at the right point of care, improving diagnosis, treatment, and documentation while reducing physician burnout. Additional products include Dorsata Insights, which gathers standardized real-world clinical data from women's health providers (including populations historically underrepresented in clinical studies), Dorsata Pathways, and an Adnexal Mass solution. The platform serves 300+ practice sites and thousands of clinical users across roughly 20 states, documenting hundreds of thousands of pregnancies. Dorsata raised a $5.2M Series A with participation from QED Investors, Women's Health USA, LabCorp, Fool Ventures, and Gore Range Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Dorsata as a healthtech company; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: DVC
providers.description: DVC (Data Version Control) is an Apache 2.0 open-source CLI and Python library for versioning datasets, models, pipelines, and ML experiments on top of Git. It is not a network service — there is no DVC REST API.

providers.name: Edyoucated
providers.description: Edyoucated is a German SaaS company offering an AI-powered corporate learning and skills-management platform for mid-to-large enterprises. The product combines a learning management / learning experience system (central management of training, mandatory compliance training, seminar administration, AI-assisted content creation, blended learning, and learning analytics) with skills management (skill cataloging, assessments, gap analysis, expert identification, and career guidance) to give organizations a common language for skills and personalized learning pathways. It also offers consulting for custom skill-taxonomy development. Customers include Deutsche Bahn, BASF, Shopware, and Finanz Informatik. Edyoucated is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer/API surface, developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation.

providers.name: Ennoble Care
providers.description: Ennoble Care is a physician-led home-based healthcare provider delivering primary care, palliative care, and hospice care to seniors in the comfort of their own homes. Founded to bring the doctor back to the housecall, the company offers in-home primary care and chronic disease management, post-acute care transitions, advance care planning, bereavement services, and respite care across 13 states and Washington, DC (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Virginia). Ennoble Care is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile has been enriched by the API Evangelist network; Ennoble Care is a healthcare-services company and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Enzo Biochem
providers.description: Enzo Biochem, Inc. (operating as Enzo Life Sciences) is a life sciences company specializing in labeling and detection technologies for biomedical research and drug development. Trading under the tagline "Scientists Enabling Scientists," Enzo develops and manufactures research reagents and assays including AMPIVIEW RNA probes for in-situ hybridization and FISH, antibodies, ELISA immunoassays, immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, and CELLESTIAL cell-based assays. Its biopharma arm provides drug discovery services, target identification and validation, assay development, in vitro toxicology, and GMP manufacturing. Products are sold through an online catalog and account portal at enzo.com rather than a public developer API. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub company lead and enriched with the identity, website, and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: Eudia
providers.description: Eudia is an enterprise augmented-intelligence platform for in-house legal, compliance, and procurement teams at large organizations and government agencies. Its "Enterprise Brain" ingests a company's contracts, policies, precedents, and prior decisions and codifies the judgment of its legal experts into governed AI workflows, while "Expert Digital Twins" let business teams self-serve governed legal guidance without direct attorney involvement. Products span compliance automation, contracting, decision self-service, mergers and acquisitions, and litigation support, with connectors into Microsoft, Google Drive, SharePoint, Box, Salesforce, DocuSign, OnIt, and LinkSquares. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, Eudia raised a Series A of up to $105M led by General Catalyst with Sierra Ventures, Floodgate, and Defy Partners. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity, trust, and security posture.

providers.name: Eunice
providers.description: Eunice is a London-based AI fintech building institutional-grade due diligence and monitoring infrastructure for digital assets and private markets. Its platform automates token due diligence, classification, risk analysis, and disclosure requirements — including an AI-powered MiCA whitepaper library for streamlining compliance with the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation — and delivers insights through a dashboard and API to exchanges, funds, custodians, issuers, and regulators. Founded in 2021 by Yi Luo, a second-time fintech entrepreneur and former VC, Eunice raised $8M in combined Seed and Pre-Seed funding led by Moonfire Ventures and Speedinvest with participation from Openspace Ventures in 2026, and counts Coinbase, Crypto.com, Copper, and Zodia Custody among its clients.

providers.name: Excalidraw
providers.description: Excalidraw is an MIT-licensed virtual whiteboard with a hand-drawn aesthetic. Primary surfaces are the hosted web app at excalidraw.com and the @excalidraw/excalidraw npm package for embedding the canvas in other apps. There is no public REST API. Excalidraw+ is the commercial managed offering.

providers.name: ezCater
providers.description: ezCater is a corporate and workplace catering marketplace that connects businesses with a nationwide network of local restaurants and caterers. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Boston, the platform lets organizations order food online for meetings, events, and recurring team meals, and layers workplace-food management on top: meal programs, per-team and per-location spend controls, group ordering, delivery coordination, and centralized invoicing and reporting. ezCater serves companies of every size across the United States and is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. The company does not publish a public developer API; integrations are arranged through its enterprise and partner sales channels. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and trust surface.

providers.name: FIGS
providers.description: FIGS, Inc. (NYSE: FIGS) is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. FIGS designs and sells premium scrubwear and non-scrubwear offerings — lab coats, underscrubs, outerwear, footwear, compression socks, loungewear, and accessories — directly to healthcare professionals through its Shopify-based online store at wearfigs.com. FIGS is a consumer e-commerce and retail brand with a customer help center and investor-relations presence; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Finley (Concord)
providers.description: Finley (Concord) is Finley Technologies, a cloud-based loan administration and debt-capital-management platform for credit funds, banks, and private credit operators. The software digitizes 200+ credit-agreement fields and covers loan servicing (KYC, money movement, notice delivery), portfolio and borrowing-base monitoring, syndicated-loan management, and backup / credit administration, plus Finley AI for automating calculations, compliance checks, and notices. Finley is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and is delivered as a hosted web application at app.finleycms.com with product documentation at docs.finleycms.com. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is published at this time.

providers.name: FitOn
providers.description: FitOn is a consumer digital fitness and wellness platform offering free, on-demand workout classes (cardio, strength, yoga, Pilates, HIIT), guided meditation, personalized meal plans and nutrition tracking, recipes, and social challenges. FitOn serves 15 million+ members with celebrity and world-class trainers across mobile, web, and connected-TV apps (Apple TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV). Its FitOn Health arm delivers an enterprise wellness benefit to employers, health plans, and brokers. FitOn is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass FitOn publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; consumer and B2B integration is handled through partnership programs rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: Genopets
providers.description: Genopets is a free-to-play, move-to-earn NFT game built on the Solana blockchain that gamifies an active lifestyle. Players nurture a digital pet — a Genopet — that evolves from real-world physical activity tracked via step counting, then battle, craft, stake, and trade in-game NFTs and Habitats. The economy pairs the GENE governance token with the in-game KI utility token earned by moving. Genopets is developed by a studio backed by Pantera Capital and operates a consumer mobile/web game rather than a public developer API; no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: GetHarley
providers.description: GetHarley is a UK-based telehealth and skincare platform delivering personalised, medical-grade skincare through online consultations. Patients answer questions about their skin concerns, book a video consultation, and are matched with one of a network of over 1,000 licensed dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and plastic surgeons, who recommend a tailored regimen of medical-grade products delivered to the patient. GetHarley operates both a patient-facing storefront and a practitioner platform used by clinicians to manage recommendations, orders, and client relationships. Backed by Index Ventures, the company addresses concerns such as acne, fine lines, pigmentation, and ageing. As of this profile, GetHarley does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an MCP server; this record captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ground
providers.description: Ground News is a news aggregation platform, built by Snapwise Inc. and backed by Techstars, that helps readers see every side of every story. It gathers coverage of each news event from across the political spectrum and pairs every story with media bias ratings, factuality assessments, and source-ownership transparency. Signature features include the Blindspot Feed that surfaces stories disproportionately covered by the left or right, a per-story bias-distribution bar, local news customization, daily briefing newsletters, browser extensions, and iOS/Android apps. Ground News does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company's public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Gruve
providers.description: Gruve Inc. is an AI-driven enterprise services and technology company that helps large organizations adopt and secure artificial intelligence. Its portfolio spans private AI infrastructure (PulseAI, deployable in under two weeks for data sovereignty), AI-powered cybersecurity (AI SOC, digital forensics and incident response, and managed AI security services), Data & AI strategy and infrastructure, and Customer Experience delivered on Salesforce. Gruve targets enterprises of roughly 5,000 to 50,000 employees and serves CXOs, IT, security, and data leaders globally. Backed by Mayfield, the company operates a public trust center (SafeBase by Drata) attesting SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Gruve is a services and platform provider and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: gVisor
providers.description: gVisor is an application kernel written in Go that implements a substantial portion of the Linux system surface. It provides an additional layer of isolation between running applications and the host operating system, intercepting and handling application system calls in user space to reduce the attack surface of the host kernel.

providers.name: HELP
providers.description: This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-linked lead of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The website pointer on this record resolves to Venturz (operated by GoVenturz, LLC), an all-in-one business operating system for founders that bundles 15+ tools — website builder, CRM, email marketing, payments, and analytics — behind a single dashboard alongside an "AI co-founder" assistant, a founder community, a startup academy, and Venturz Capital funding. As of this enrichment pass Venturz publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface, so no machine-readable API artifacts could be harvested. See x-identity-note regarding the stub name versus the linked brand.

providers.name: heva
providers.description: heva is an AI-native healthcare and medical-tourism platform that connects patients with vetted medical practices, specialists, and providers across borders, with an initial focus on Spanish-speaking markets. The platform offers practice discovery by specialty and location, deposit-based online appointment booking, a conversational AI booking assistant (Heva AI), an online store for purchasing procedures and services, and secure payments via Stripe. Provider-facing tools cover practice management, patient acquisition, communications, and appointment coordination, delivered through the web and native iOS and Android provider apps. heva is a Techstars-backed company building "care without borders."

providers.name: Hostie
providers.description: Hostie is an AI-powered virtual concierge for restaurants that answers every call, text, email, and message in the restaurant's own voice so operators never miss a guest and staff can stay focused on in-room service. The conversational AI platform handles phone volume, captures reservations and takeout orders, fields private-event inquiries, and unifies guest communication across calls, texts, emails, Instagram, and Google Maps, with live call transcripts, multilingual support (20 languages), guest history, and data ownership. Restaurant partners include Tonchin, Trader Vic's, Flour + Water, The Slanted Door Group, and The Stinking Rose Group. Hostie raised a $12M Series A led by Obvious Ventures (July 2026), bringing total funding to $16M. Hostie is a business SaaS product and does not currently publish a public API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Jest
providers.description: Jest is a delightful JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity. It works with projects using Babel, TypeScript, Node, React, Angular, Vue and more. Jest provides snapshot testing, parallel execution, built-in mocking, and code coverage out of the box.

providers.name: Juno
providers.description: Juno is a Brazilian B2B payments fintech, acquired by EBANX in October 2021, that provides a complete billing and payments platform for Brazilian companies. Founded in 2014 in Maringá, Paraná, Juno powers more than 35,000 small and medium businesses with online sales and collections via Pix, boleto bancário, boleto_pix, and credit cards, plus marketplace payment split, recurring subscriptions, and a digital business account (Conta Juno) with Banking-as-a-Service capabilities. Juno is a participant of the Brazilian Interbank Payments Chamber (CIP). The company exposes a public REST API v2 through the Juno Developer Academy at integracao.juno.com.br, secured with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, plus HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and native mobile Direct Checkout SDKs for Android and iOS for PCI-safe card data encryption.

providers.name: Keepit
providers.description: Keepit is a SaaS backup and recovery platform providing independent cloud-to-cloud data protection for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other SaaS applications.

providers.name: LeapYear Technologies
providers.description: LeapYear Technologies built an enterprise platform for differentially private analytics and machine learning, letting organizations compute over highly sensitive data and share it across internal silos and external partners with mathematically proven privacy guarantees. LeapYear Core was licensed, self-hosted software rather than a public multi-tenant API: customers ran their own server and reached it through a first-party Python client, with every computation drawing down a quantified privacy exposure budget enforced by the server. Snowflake announced its intent to acquire LeapYear on 2023-02-07 and closed on 2023-02-10 for USD 62.0 million in cash, primarily for talent and developed technology, folding the differential privacy capability into its Global Data Clean Room offering. The company no longer operates independently, leapyear.io is now a Snowflake-controlled redirect, and the only surviving first-party documentation is the Python client API reference on its readthedocs host.

providers.name: Listings API
providers.description: REST API and agent-native platform for managing business listings, citations, reviews, Google Business Profile posts, and local analytics across major publisher directories (Google, Facebook, Bing, Yelp, TripAdvisor). A facade over Synup's federated GraphQL backend, with first-party Python and Node SDKs, a hosted MCP server, and llms.txt.

providers.name: MANTL
providers.description: MANTL is an account and deposit origination software company for banks and credit unions. Its omnichannel platform lets financial institutions open consumer and business deposit and loan accounts across online and in-branch channels, integrating with existing core banking systems to modernize onboarding and accelerate deposit growth. More than 100 institutions raise over $1 billion in deposits monthly through the platform. MANTL was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public API or developer portal — this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and system-status surfaces.

providers.name: Minoan
providers.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: Numero
providers.description: Numero is an all-in-one donor database and call-time platform built for political campaigns at the federal, state, and local levels. It combines a fast, filterable donor CRM with auto-deduplication and pledge tracking, a mobile call-time dialer with one-click SMS, email, and voicemail follow-up plus virtual local numbers, prefilled one-click contribution forms with access to a large 1-click donor network, event and RSVP fundraising tools, and a deliverability-focused email platform. Campaigns use Numero to identify prospect donors, run efficient candidate call time, and raise money faster. Numero is backed by Initialized Capital. It currently exposes no public developer API surface; api.numero.ai serves the web application backend only.

providers.name: Nurix
providers.description: Nurix AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for sales and customer support, delivering AI voice and chat agents that qualify leads, resolve support issues, and automate back-office operations across voice, chat, and messaging channels. Its products include NuPlay (customer-facing conversational AI agents) and NuStack (a workflow automation engine), backed by a library of 400+ pre-built integrations spanning CRM, contact-center (CCaaS), e-commerce/order-management, messaging, and scheduling systems. Nurix is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API surface — engagement is via sales/demo and pre-built connectors rather than self-serve API keys or developer documentation.

providers.name: Olive Technologies
providers.description: Olive is an AI-native vendor evaluation and technology procurement platform that runs the full RFP lifecycle in a single workspace — from requirements management and stakeholder collaboration through AI-powered comparative vendor scoring and final selection. It maintains vendor intelligence across more than 12,000 vendors and 380+ categories, and is built for IT leaders, procurement teams, and consultancies who need unbiased, structured software sourcing. Olive is a Techstars-backed company; by design it takes no fees from vendors, funding the platform through buyer subscriptions instead. Olive has no public developer API surface — no documentation, SDKs, or API reference are published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Ophelia
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company delivering online treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD) through medication-assisted treatment (MAT). Founded in 2020 and based in Philadelphia, Ophelia combines evidence-based buprenorphine/naloxone (Suboxone) prescriptions with virtual clinical care, delivering diagnosis, prescriptions sent to local pharmacies, ongoing clinician support, and insurance coordination entirely remotely. Patients can be seen within 1-3 days and most pay under $10/month. Ophelia is a consumer-facing healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: PartySlate
providers.description: PartySlate is a Chicago-based dual marketplace and SaaS platform for the events industry, connecting people planning weddings, galas, corporate events, birthdays, and holiday parties with the leading venues, event professionals, and vendors across the country. The photo-rich platform lets vendors showcase their work through millions of real event photos, build networks of industry partners, and connect directly with prospective clients, while PartySlate Pro provides venues, planners, and vendors an AI-powered SaaS suite to organize, search, and share their photo portfolios with Canva integration and content-management tools built for events. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Prized
providers.description: Prized is an AI-powered platform that lets non-technical operations, support, and finance teams build, deploy, and share secure internal tools without engineering. Users describe a workflow in natural language (or bring their own coding agent such as Claude Code) and Prized builds real software on company data that is pre-connected and scoped, with least-privilege database access per tool, credential isolation, outbound-traffic proxying, and an audit trail on every access. Tools deploy behind corporate authentication and connect to 20+ services including Salesforce, Postgres, Slack, Stripe, and Notion. Prized is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company founded by Hudson Griffith and Marinos Eliades, both formerly of Gander (YC F24, acquired by Archer Aviation). Added to the API Evangelist network via the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched from the company's public web surface.

providers.name: Prosper Health
providers.description: Prosper Health is a telehealth provider focused exclusively on autistic and neurodivergent adults, offering virtual autism diagnostic assessments and ongoing affirming, strength-based therapy delivered by licensed psychologists and therapists who specialize in adult autism. Its adult-validated, telehealth-native assessment (an alternative to the child-oriented ADOS) runs entirely online across two psychologist sessions plus a feedback session, with results reported within roughly two weeks. Prosper Health accepts major insurers (Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford, United) across 20-plus US states. It is a direct-to-consumer clinical care company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its web, security, and identity properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Qevlar AI
providers.description: Qevlar AI is an autonomous Security Operations Center (SOC) platform that investigates every security alert the way a top analyst would — without playbooks, without hallucinations, and without adding headcount. Founded in 2023 by Ahmed Achchak and Hamza Sayah and headquartered in Paris, France, the company runs a proprietary graph-based AI orchestrator (not an LLM agent) that delivers deterministic, evidence-based investigations across the full security stack. As soon as an alert fires from SIEM/EDR tools, Qevlar autonomously pulls, enriches, and analyzes internal and external data, then returns a conclusive malicious/benign verdict, a full investigation report, and recommended remediation — typically in under three minutes, closing up to 80% of tickets automatically. The SaaS platform is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, hosted in the EU (Belgium) on GCP, and connects via API to 50+ security tools (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Cortex, Google SecOps, and more). It is trusted by Fortune Global 500 enterprises and leading MSSPs/MDRs across Europe and the US. Backed by EQT Ventures and Partech.

providers.name: Qlik Mashups
providers.description: APIs and resources for building custom visualizations and analytics applications using Qlik Sense mashups.

providers.name: Repeat
providers.description: Repeat is a lifecycle and retention marketing platform for consumer packaged goods (CPG) and e-commerce brands, now operated as a product of Stamped. It connects to a brand's Shopify store to ingest historical and incoming orders, predicts replenishment and reorder "Moments" for each customer, and automates personalized post-purchase campaigns across email, SMS, and direct mail. Repeat surfaces product predictions as reusable components inside Klaviyo, Postscript, and Attentive flows, and generates events that enrich customer profiles for segmentation and personalization. Founded in 2018 in Venice, California by Kim Stiefel and Sarah Wissel and backed by Battery Ventures and Techstars, Repeat is documented through a customer-facing Help Center rather than a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Samu
providers.description: Samu (samu.ai) is an AI-powered conversation-intelligence and sales-analytics platform built for sales managers and revenue leaders across Latin America. It automatically records and transcribes customer interactions across WhatsApp, phone calls, video calls, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, then analyzes them to surface actionable coaching insights. Features include an AI "Samu Score" that evaluates call quality against customizable criteria, custom data extractors (e.g. competitor mentions or company size), analysis using SPICED, BANT, and SANDLER sales frameworks, and auto-generated CRM notes, tasks, and meeting summaries. Samu integrates bidirectionally with HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, and other CRMs, and emphasizes high-accuracy Spanish-language transcription. Programmatic inbound/outbound API access is available on the Enterprise plan, though no public developer documentation is published. Samu is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Sesame
providers.description: Sesame is a direct-to-consumer telehealth marketplace that connects patients with board-certified clinicians for affordable, transparent, cash-pay virtual and in-person care. Patients browse and book pay-per-visit appointments starting around $34 across urgent care, prescription refills, weight loss and GLP-1 treatment, mental health, women's health, dermatology, pediatrics and more, with no insurance required and up-front pricing. The company also offers a SesamePlus membership, a mobile app, provider tooling for listing a practice, and Sesame @ Work employer plans. Sesame is backed by General Catalyst, GV, Matrix Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass Sesame publishes a consumer web and mobile experience but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; its public GitHub organization hosts internal utility libraries rather than first-party client SDKs.

providers.name: Sondermind
providers.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Suzy
providers.description: Suzy is an AI-driven consumer insights platform that unifies quantitative surveys (Suzy Insights), qualitative research (moderated Suzy Live IDIs and AI-moderated Suzy Speaks voice interviews), real-time cultural trend intelligence (Suzy Signals), and on-demand access to 1M+ verified consumers protected by BIOTIC fraud detection (Suzy Audiences). Its AI Suite adds screeners, summaries, themeing, and predictive heatmaps so enterprise brand, product, marketing, shopper, and insights teams can validate ideas and move at the speed of culture. Surfaced as a foundry-group portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Suzy publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Tooth Fairy
providers.description: Toothfairy is a UK dental telehealth platform billing itself as the world's first dentist on-demand, pairing registered dentists with a consumer mobile app to deliver teeth straightening with clear aligners, prescription teeth whitening, and same-day emergency video dental consultations 24/7, plus employer dental plans for businesses. The company is health-regulated in the UK, backed by Seedcamp, and ships its product as iOS and Android apps with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: trawa
providers.description: trawa (operated by Future Energy Services GmbH) is a Berlin-based energy management company that helps mid-sized businesses procure and manage electricity. It pairs AI-optimized green-electricity sourcing on the wholesale market with cloud energy-management software that gives customers real-time visibility into consumption, costs, and CO2 emissions, alongside battery storage and smart control of energy-consuming assets such as CHP plants and charging stations. Founded in 2022, trawa is backed by Balderton Capital and Speedinvest. The platform is delivered through a customer web portal and a trust center; no public developer API was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: US Capitol Visitor Center
providers.description: The US Capitol Visitor Center (CVC) serves as the main entrance for visitors to the United States Capitol, providing resources and information to enhance the visitor experience. The Center offers guided tours of the Capitol building, allowing visitors to explore the historic rooms and learn about the legislative process. It also houses exhibits and educational materials that highlight the history and significance of the Capitol and its role in American democracy. The CVC operates under the Architect of the Capitol and offers free guided tours, specialty tours, virtual tours, and educational programs for students and visitors from around the world.

providers.name: WeStock
providers.description: WeStock is a shopper-marketing platform that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands drive product trial, build first-party retail audiences, and manage trade and shopper marketing strategy from a single dashboard. It combines digital rebates and promotional campaigns, paid social advertising (primarily Meta), in-store sampling and demos, retail media management across Amazon, Walmart, and Instacart, email/SMS automation, and influencer marketing, alongside a consumer discovery web app used by 600,000+ shoppers to browse new products. Campaign data — trials, conversions, and repeat behavior — is unified in one place. A Techstars-backed company; its public surface is a marketing site and login-gated dashboard, with a private backend API (api.westock.io) that is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Zatanna
providers.description: Zatanna is a Y Combinator (W2026) startup based in San Francisco that creates APIs for software that doesn't have any. It reverse-engineers the back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software — ERPs (SAP), PMS/POS systems, insurance portals, and marketplaces — by observing real workflows, reconstructing the underlying request sequences, and hosting them as clean, callable APIs. Rather than relying on slow browser automation or computer-use agents, Zatanna gives AI agents faster, cheaper, and more reliable integrations, with a reliability layer that handles session management, authentication, and change detection. The agent-facing surface is a hosted, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at api.zatanna.ai.

providers.name: Agentero
providers.description: Agentero is a digital insurance network and insurtech platform, founded in 2017 and based in Oakland, California, that gives independent property & casualty insurance agents market access to 100+ national and regional carriers alongside modern agency technology. Its unified command center lets agents get appointed, quote and bind policies, manage carrier appointments, and reconcile commissions from a single portal, with no startup fees or minimum-volume requirements. Agentero also offers an AI Appetite Checker that matches risks to the right carriers and Producerflow, a compliance and producer-management solution for carriers, MGAs, and agencies. Agentero is a portfolio company backed by Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: AllCare
providers.description: AllCare is a Philippines-based digital employee-benefits and healthcare membership platform for freelancers and small-to-medium enterprises. It aggregates worker benefits that individuals and small teams would otherwise struggle to access, bundling HMO coverage, group life insurance, 24/7 teleconsultation, dental and optical care, mental-health counseling, annual physical exams, and productivity perks into flat-rate membership packages. Its SME Benefits Package is sold on an annual per-employee basis (minimum five employees) and is managed through a web dashboard for enrollment, member management, and benefit utilization. AllCare is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare/insurtech company profile.

providers.name: Appriss Inc.
providers.description: Appriss Inc. was a Louisville, Kentucky data and analytics holding company whose business units were broken up in 2021: Appriss Insights was sold to Equifax in a $1.825 billion deal, and Appriss Health was rebranded as the independent company Bamboo Health. The surviving Appriss Retail business (apprissretail.com) is an AI-powered retail loss-prevention platform that helps retailers combat total retail loss across in-store and online channels through returns-fraud prevention, shrink and exception analytics, and case and audit management. Its products include Appriss Engage (returns and claims management), Appriss Secure (shrink and exception analytics), Appriss Incident (case and audit management), and the Sidekick AI collaborator. Appriss Retail publishes no public developer API program — its APIS Online portal is an authenticated Asset Protection Information System (customer login), not a developer API surface.

providers.name: Arvist
providers.description: Arvist AI is a Chicago-based computer-vision platform for warehouse and supply-chain operations that turns existing cameras, scanners, and WMS/ERP data into automated quality control, safety and compliance monitoring, load verification, inbound shipment inspection, and freight-claims management. The system deploys on-premise edge servers, integrates with 80+ leading WMS and ERP platforms without new hardware, and detects damage, defects, unsafe behavior, and outbound shipping errors in real time. Backed by Techstars, Arvist is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I compliant. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from Arvist's public web surface; the company currently publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Astrix
providers.description: Astrix Security is a non-human identity (NHI) and AI agent security platform. It gives enterprises a real-time inventory of every AI agent, MCP server, service account, OAuth app, API key, SSH key and IAM role across their environment, then detects excessive privileges, misconfigurations, anomalous activity and policy violations and drives automated remediation. Its Agent Control Plane provisions secure-by-design AI agents with short-lived, precisely scoped credentials. Astrix became part of Cisco in 2026 and ended standalone sales of new licenses effective June 30, 2026. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures. Sector: cybersecurity. This is a company profile — Astrix publishes no public developer API, so the profile carries identity, security-posture, and compliance signals rather than API specifications.

providers.name: Brandwatch
providers.description: Brandwatch is a leading consumer intelligence and social media analytics platform providing access to trillions of consumer conversations. The platform offers six distinct APIs for analysis, data upload, consumer research, social metrics, publishing, and engagement. Businesses use Brandwatch to track brand mentions, monitor competitors, analyze sentiment, and integrate social data with existing analytics and CRM systems for strategic decision-making.

providers.name: BRICK Schema
providers.description: BRICK is an open-source community-driven ontology standard for standardizing semantic descriptions of physical, logical, and virtual assets in buildings and the relationships between them. Using Semantic Web (RDF/OWL) technology, BRICK v1.4.4 enables interoperability across building management systems, reducing the cost of deploying analytics and energy efficiency initiatives. It supports HVAC, lighting, fire, security, and other building subsystems under a unified extensible vocabulary with SHACL-based validation.

providers.name: Carlisle Companies
providers.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated (NYSE: CSL) is a global diversified manufacturer of highly engineered building envelope products and solutions, serving commercial and residential construction, insulation, roofing, waterproofing, and specialty markets. Carlisle's primary operating segment is Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM), which includes brands such as Carlisle SynTec Systems, Hunter Panels, Henry Company, MB Technology, and WIP Industrial. Carlisle does not publish a public developer API; distributors and direct contractors transact through the Carlisle Customer Success Portal, and commercial trading partners integrate with Carlisle using standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 855, 856, 810) over AS2/SFTP.

providers.name: Centivo
providers.description: Centivo is a primary-care-centered health plan administrator for self-funded employers, founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City. Sold through benefits brokers and consultants, it serves mid-market employers (roughly 50 or more employees) and covers about 77,000 members across 160 businesses. Members get $0 primary care to encourage early intervention, and employers typically save 15-30% versus traditional fully-insured plans through a primary-care-first model, the cost advantages of self-funding, and directly negotiated health-system partnerships. Centivo operates member, employer, provider, and referral portals plus iOS/Android member apps; it does not publish a public developer API. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and JPMorgan Chase's Morgan Health.

providers.name: Clover Security
providers.description: Clover Security is a Tel Aviv-based product security company (founded 2023) that builds design-led AI security agents for the software development lifecycle. Its agents plug into the tools engineering teams already use — GitHub, Cursor, Confluence, Jira, and Slack — to automate security design reviews, run continuous threat modeling, detect design-to-implementation drift, and keep agentic and spec-driven development secure by default. Clover has raised $36M from Notable Capital, Team8, and Silicon Valley CISO Investments, serving enterprise, fintech, and banking customers including Lemonade, Plaid, Notion, Udemy, and ServiceTitan. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of ggv-capital and enriched from the company's public web surface; Clover exposes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Coin98
providers.description: Coin98 is a crypto super-app built around a non-custodial, multi-chain wallet spanning 80+ blockchains across iOS, Android, a Chrome browser extension, Telegram, and web. Its product surface includes the Coin98 Super Wallet, an AI wallet with autonomous agents (Cypheus), the SwapX DEX aggregator routing across 50+ DEXs, on-chain perpetual futures (Coin98 Perps), the Fusion Visa debit card, PowerPool C98 staking, the Zen hardware card, Coin98 Markets data, and a token distribution Vault. For developers, Coin98 publishes a Developer Guide and the Coin98 Adapter — a React/Next.js wallet-connection SDK with useWallet and useWalletModal hooks and prebuilt connect UI — plus a Connect SDK and Telegram Mini App SDK, integrating dApps with the wallet across 40+ chains. Surfaced originally as a multicoin-capital portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Comply365
providers.description: Comply365 is an enterprise SaaS provider of operational content, safety, and training management software for highly regulated, safety-critical industries including airlines, defense, rail, and MRO (maintenance, repair, and overhaul). Its AI-powered platform unifies three mission-critical products: ContentManager365 for authoring, managing, and distributing controlled operational documentation and manuals; SafetyManager365 for safety reporting, investigation, and root-cause analysis; and TrainingManager365 for workforce readiness and compliance training. Comply365 helps regulated operators shorten document change cycles, maintain regulatory compliance, and connect frontline teams to the current, approved content they need. The company is an Insight Partners portfolio company and is an ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified organization.

providers.name: Corvus (Travelers)
providers.description: Corvus by Travelers is a cyber-insurance provider offering Smart Cyber Insurance and Smart Tech E&O coverage alongside data-driven cyber risk management. Now part of Travelers, Corvus underwrites cyber policies using threat intelligence and AI-driven data, and pairs coverage with continuous threat monitoring, vulnerability detection, a cyber risk dashboard, and 24/7 incident response and claims support. The business is broker-focused, distributing through appointed brokers via its Broker Hub and broker sign-in portal. Corvus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Corvus Insurance
providers.description: Corvus Insurance — now operating as Corvus by Travelers — is a cyber-insurance managing general agency and insurtech company that pairs property and casualty underwriting with security-focused data science. It offers Smart Cyber Insurance and Smart Tech Errors & Omissions coverage, a Cyber Risk Dashboard that continuously scans policyholders' external attack surface for vulnerabilities and delivers threat intelligence and remediation guidance, 24/7 incident response and claims support, and broker tooling for collaborative quoting and renewal management. Founded in 2017 and backed by Insight Partners and Obvious Ventures, Corvus was acquired by Travelers in 2024 and now operates as a Travelers company. The public site exposes marketing, broker resources, and a broker portal, but no public developer API program.

providers.name: Cowbell Cyber
providers.description: Cowbell is a cyber insurance provider (insurtech) that delivers adaptive, continuously-underwritten cyber liability coverage and cyber-risk management services to small businesses and the middle market. Its platform pairs insurance products with proprietary risk analytics — Cowbell Factors, a continuous risk-rating model that benchmarks an organization's exposure against peers — and closed-loop resilience services delivered through the Cowbell console for policyholders, agents, and brokers. Product lines include Cowbell Prime 100 / Prime 100 Pro (small business), Prime 250 / Prime One (middle market), Prime Plus (excess), Technology Errors & Omissions, Management Liability, plus the Cowbell Rx marketplace, Cowbell Connectors, and Cowbell Insights. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Cowbell publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal — the console at console.cowbellcyber.ai is an authenticated quoting/policy application for agents and insureds, not a documented programmatic API.

providers.name: Crabi
providers.description: Crabi is a Mexican digital auto-insurance company (insurtech) offering fully online vehicle policies purchasable in about fifteen minutes from a mobile device. Coverage spans material damage, theft, third-party civil liability, medical expenses, and roadside and legal assistance across 27 Mexican states, sold and serviced through its mobile apps, online quoter (cotizador), and customer login portal. The company is regulated in Mexico by the CNSF and CONDUSEF and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Crabi publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Culture Biosciences
providers.description: Culture Biosciences is a South San Francisco TechBio company that builds cloud-connected bioreactor systems and bioprocess development services for cell culture. Its platform pairs automated single-use bioreactors (250mL bench-scale and 5L, plus the Stratyx mobile bioreactor) with Console, a cloud-native software product for real-time monitoring, experiment management, data analytics, and remote collaboration. Through its Nexxys services group the company runs clone/strain/construct screening, process characterization, process development, and bioprocess modeling and simulation for customers working on synthetic biology, protein therapeutics, and viral vectors. Culture Biosciences lets teams outsource and scale bioreactor experiments without scaling their own lab infrastructure. Backed by DCVC, Northpond Ventures, Synthesis Capital, S32, and Cultivian Sandbox Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company operates the Console cloud platform but does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Dalma
providers.description: Dalma is a French insurtech offering pet health insurance for dogs and cats, reimbursing veterinary bills (up to 100%, no deductible, EUR 2,500 annual ceiling) with fast payouts (50% within 30 seconds) and unlimited teleconsultations with veterinarians via its mobile app. Founded in Paris and backed by Northzone, Dalma insures 60,000+ pets across France and has expanded to Germany. It is a direct-to-consumer insurance brand with a member app (app.dalma.co) and a quote/subscription funnel; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Deduce
providers.description: Deduce is a New York City-based identity intelligence and fraud-prevention company focused on detecting stolen and synthetic identities, including the rapidly growing class of AI-generated identities used to bypass traditional Know Your Customer and onboarding controls. The company operates the Deduce Identity Graph, an activity-backed U.S. identity network the firm describes as covering 185 million weekly active users and 1.5 billion daily events, used to deliver real-time multi-contextual risk and fraud signals during new account opening, login, and checkout. Deduce sells a real-time API-based fraud-risk scoring product, a Multicontextual Identity Insights service, and a browser-based dashboard for traffic segmentation, anomaly detection, and forensic review, with pre-built integrations into common identity platforms (Auth0, Microsoft Entra External ID / Azure AD B2C, ForgeRock / Ping, Gluu) alongside a native REST API. The company sells to banks, fintechs, lenders, BNPL providers, retail, travel, and payments platforms; its commercial model is enterprise contracts, and its developer documentation, OpenAPI definitions, and integration guides sit behind an authenticated portal, with no public GitHub repositories, no public SDKs, and no published machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Doctolib
providers.description: Doctolib is a European e-health company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France, operating across France, Germany, Italy and the Netherlands. It provides an online medical appointment-booking platform and practice-management software used by patients and by hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals and facilities. Its product surface spans appointment booking, telehealth/video consultation, patient messaging, clinical software, patient billing, and the Doctolib Connect integration and single-sign-on layer. Doctolib exposes a partner/integration API via an authentication-gated developer portal (developers.doctolib.com); it publishes an RFC 9116 security.txt and runs a public YesWeHack bug-bounty program, an Atlassian Statuspage, and an open-source GitHub organization, but does not publish a public OpenAPI specification, first-party API SDK, or hosted MCP server.

providers.name: Fable
providers.description: Fable Security is an AI-powered human risk management (HRM) platform that helps security teams reduce incidents by changing employee behavior. It combines behavioral interventions (targeted nudges and AI-generated content), phishing simulations, short-form video awareness briefings, and human-risk reporting into a single platform positioned as a modern replacement for legacy security-awareness training. Fable's AI Studio, Composer, and Briefing Agent generate custom video and audio content - including deepfake and voice-fake simulations - and produce audience-targeted briefings from emerging threats in minutes. The platform reports on human risk and compliance across the workforce and integrates with an organization's identity framework, workspace, and security tooling. Fable serves healthcare, financial services, and technology customers including Sisense, SanDisk, Red Hat, PennyMac, Genesys, and Dayton Children's Hospital, and is backed by Greylock and Techstars.

providers.name: Fable Security
providers.description: Fable Security is a human risk management (HRM) platform that uses AI to reduce employee-driven security risk. The product combines phishing simulations and resilience testing, bite-sized security awareness and compliance training, behavioral interventions (AI-generated video briefings, nudges, and chat), human-risk reporting and analytics, rapid threat-response briefings for emerging threats, and secure AI-enablement programs. Fable is used across healthcare, financial services, and technology organizations to measure employee risk, deliver targeted training, and change unsafe security behavior. The company is backed by Redpoint Ventures. Note: Fable Security does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures the company's public web, security posture, and product changelog surface.

providers.name: Fabric Technologies
providers.description: Fabric Technologies operates Fabric by Gerber Life, a direct-to-consumer financial services platform built for parents and families. The company offers term life insurance with an instant online quote and application flow, UGMA custodial investment accounts and 529 college-savings plans for children, and digital estate-planning tools including free wills. Fabric is backed by Gerber Life, part of Western & Southern Financial Group, and was originally venture-funded by Bessemer Venture Partners. The platform emphasizes fast, accessible, mobile-first family financial planning spanning protection, wealth-building, and legacy planning. Fabric is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Factris
providers.description: Factris is a European fintech that provides invoice financing (factoring) for small and medium-sized enterprises, converting unpaid B2B invoices into working capital within 24 hours. Its services span invoice financing, debtor management and collections, credit insurance, and credit-risk assessment, delivered through the self-service FAB platform where customers upload invoices and track payments. Factris operates across the Netherlands, Lithuania, and other European markets and has financed over two billion euros in receivables. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is being enriched in the API Evangelist network; Factris publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Foodspark
providers.description: Foodspark is a data-as-a-service platform that delivers real-time grocery, restaurant, and food-delivery data extracted from 100+ platforms including DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Instacart, McDonald's, Starbucks, and many others. Foodspark sells access to curated food and grocery datasets rather than a publicly documented self-serve API.

providers.name: GirnarSoft
providers.description: GirnarSoft is an India-based enterprise software engineering and IT services company headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, with a second delivery centre in Gurugram. Founded in 2007 by IIT Delhi alumni Amit and Anurag Jain, it is the technology arm of the CarDekho Group and built the consumer marketplaces CarDekho, BikeDekho, Gaadi, ZigWheels and PriceDekho. The firm sells outsourced product engineering rather than a product API: staff augmentation, dedicated teams and software outsourcing across web and mobile development, QA and test automation, business intelligence, data science, AI/ML, cloud and DevOps, plus AI-augmented engineering pods and agentic-AI automation. It works in banking, insurance, automotive, retail and e-commerce, edtech, SaaS, travel and government/PSU, and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: Gousto
providers.description: Gousto is a British meal-kit retailer founded in 2012 by Timo Boldt and James Carter and headquartered in Shepherd's Bush, London. It delivers recipe boxes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients and step-by-step recipes to homes across the UK, using proprietary data science, ERP, courier-integration and warehouse-automation systems to run its subscription operation. A SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company, Gousto does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public digital surface (website, engineering blog, GitHub organization, and coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Government Accountability Office
providers.description: The Government Accountability Office (GAO) is the United States government's supreme audit institution. It provides Congress with auditing, evaluation, and investigative services, and publishes reports, testimonies, and other products examining federal programs and policies.

providers.name: Healthcare.com
providers.description: Healthcare.com (HealthCare, Inc.) is a privately held, non-government health insurance marketplace and distribution platform founded in 2014. Consumers use healthcare.com to find, compare and enroll in ACA/under-65 individual health plans, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, and specialty coverage; distributors, FMOs, MGAs and agents use its Autopilot machine-learning enrollment acquisition platform, which matches high-intent shoppers to distributor partners with predictive scoring and value-based lead pricing. Its Pivot Health subsidiary develops and markets proprietary short-term medical, fixed indemnity and supplemental gap products with A-rated carriers. Insurance is sold through Healthcare.com Insurance Services, LLC. As of this profiling pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: Hibernate ORM
providers.description: Hibernate ORM is a powerful object/relational mapping solution for Java applications, providing a framework for mapping an object-oriented domain model to a relational database.

providers.name: instabridge
providers.description: Instabridge is a global internet connectivity company operated by Degoo Backup AB in Stockholm, Sweden, and backed by Balderton Capital and Creandum. Its mobile apps give users access to a crowdsourced map of roughly 20 million free WiFi hotspots and to prepaid eSIM mobile-data plans covering 190+ countries with no roaming fees. With more than 200 million app downloads, Instabridge combines community-shared WiFi, pay-as-you-go global data, a data-saving browser, VPN, and cloud storage, and runs a distribution-partner program for prepaid top-up resellers. It is a consumer app company with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Last Energy
providers.description: Last Energy is an American developer and operator of micro-modular nuclear power plants, founded in 2019 in Washington, D.C. by Bret Kugelmass as a commercial spinout of the Energy Impact Center. Its flagship PWR-20 is a 20 MWe pressurized water reactor assembled from a few dozen factory-made, steel-encased modules that ship to site and are installed rather than constructed in place. Last Energy sells power rather than reactors: it designs, finances, owns and operates plants under long-term power purchase agreements for energy-intensive customers including data centers, metals, chemicals, cement, pulp and paper, and food and beverage. The company has announced projects in Texas, South Wales, Poland and Romania, entered nuclear site licensing in the United Kingdom, partnered with Texas A&M and DP World, and raised roughly $164M across a $40M Series B and a $100M Series C. Last Energy publishes a marketing site and a gated customer/whitepaper portal, but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Metalshub
providers.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online. Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nannostomus
providers.description: Nannostomus provides a sex offender search API covering 771k+ offender records across all 50 U.S. states and 14 territories. It supports search by state and name, with monthly per-state record updates, deduplication, and 99.9% uptime backed by cloud infrastructure. A free tier covers up to 100 requests per month with tiered pay-as-you-go pricing beyond that.

providers.name: Nebex
providers.description: Nebex operates Nebra Exchange, an exchange platform for the global space economy that connects commercial space suppliers, sovereign buyers such as governments and space agencies, and financial institutions. The platform aims to standardize space-commerce infrastructure so demand can find supply faster, workflows can be coordinated across multilateral participants, and capital can participate through transparent structures, facilitating complex transactions from demand to delivery including sourcing, coordination, and settlement. Founded by Tejpaul Bhatia (CEO) and Anand Subramanian (COO), both formerly of Axiom Space, Nebex is backed by GV. The company currently offers early, invite-based access to the Nebra Exchange platform and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK program.

providers.name: Neptune Networks
providers.description: Neptune Networks operates Neptune, an institutional fixed-income pre-trade data platform that delivers real-time dealer axes and bond inventory directly into buy-side workflows. Aggregating structured data from 34 global banks, the network surfaces roughly 110k bonds per day at around $2.2T daily gross notional across 33 currencies, helping asset managers identify liquidity opportunities before they trade. Originally an independent, bank-owned utility backed by Anthemis, Neptune is now operated as RealQ, the data-solutions arm of Liquidnet Fixed Income (part of TP ICAP Group). Connectivity is institutional and permissioned - a browser web app, OMS/EMS integrations, FIX, a REST API, FTP/SSH drop copy, and AWS cloud data transfer - with no public developer portal, published OpenAPI, or open SDKs.

providers.name: Newfront Insurance
providers.description: Newfront is a technology-native insurance brokerage ("a brokerage for the 21st century") serving startups through Fortune 500 enterprises, and now part of WTW. It places business insurance (property, casualty, cyber, executive risk, workers' compensation, surety, aviation, M&A and global programs) alongside Total Rewards services (employee benefits, compensation, retirement/401(k), HR, payroll and benefits compliance), pairing brokerage expertise with in-house software such as the Navigator benefits platform, RiskPulse analytics, and contract/coverage-gap review tools. Newfront reports roughly 20% of U.S. unicorns as clients and $3.1B in annual premiums placed. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks; client and employee interaction happens through the authenticated app.newfront.com application. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and enriched with company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: OnePay
providers.description: OnePay is a Walmart-backed financial technology company that delivers mobile banking and money services through a single consumer app, with banking provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank (Members FDIC). The app bundles everyday checking and high-yield savings, a Credit Builder loan and credit score monitoring, the OnePay CashRewards Mastercard credit card, buy-now-pay-later (OnePay Later, powered by Klarna/WebBank), a digital wallet, commission-free stock and ETF investing (cleared by DriveWealth), crypto buying (powered by Zero Hash), free tax filing, global transfers (powered by MoneyGram), and cash back tied to Walmart. Originally launched as ONE (One Finance), OnePay is backed by Ribbit Capital and Walmart. It operates a gated developer/partner surface at developer.onepay.com (currently access-controlled) rather than a public API program.

providers.name: Orus
providers.description: Orus is a French online insurance broker ("l'assurance professionnelle en ligne") offering professional-liability and business insurance to independent professionals and small businesses across France. Products include RC Pro (professional liability), Multirisque Professionnelle, Assurance Décennale (ten-year construction liability), Assurance Bureau (office insurance), Mutuelle Santé TNS (self-employed health), and Prévoyance TNS (income protection), serving sectors from consultants and construction to hospitality, retail, and wellness. Backed by Partech and Speedinvest, Orus operates a self-service quote-and-buy app (app.orus.eu) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at this time. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched via public web and domain probes.

providers.name: Player's Health
providers.description: Player's Health is an insurance and athlete-safety technology company founded in 2016 and based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, serving youth sports organizations, fitness facilities, schools, and collegiate athletic programs. The platform combines specialty insurance products (general liability, sexual abuse and molestation liability, accident medical, directors and officers, equipment and property, cyber, and employee benefits) with athlete-safety and risk-management tooling including coach credentialing and background checks, injury and incident reporting, investigations, mental-health support, and training. Player's Health operates login-gated web portals for claims, certificates of insurance, and safety/compliance (SafetyHub) rather than a public developer API. It is a Techstars-backed company surfaced through the API Evangelist network and profiled here for discovery.

providers.name: Plus Simple
providers.description: +Simple (Plus Simple) is a French digital insurance underwriting agency (agence de souscription) founded in 2015 and headquartered in Marseille. Operating as one of France's largest wholesale insurance brokers, it runs a fully digital extranet platform that lets partner insurance brokers prospect, price, underwrite, issue, and manage professional insurance contracts across more than 1,200 covered activities and 30+ niche product lines, including RC Décennale (ten-year construction liability) coverage. +Simple distributes on a 100% brokerage model in partnership with carriers such as Hiscox, Allianz, Wakam, QBE and Beazley, serving a network of 8,000+ partner brokers. The company is backed by Anthemis and Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time (its broker and insured portals are authenticated web applications, not open APIs).

providers.name: Realtyna
providers.description: Realtyna provides real estate technology including IDX, RESO Web API integrations, MLS data routing, and a WordPress-based property platform (WPL). Their API Plugin exposes the WPL platform via a RESTful, JSON-based HTTP interface for building custom front-ends and mobile applications. Realtyna also offers MLS API, Organic RESO API, and the MLS Router API for enterprise MLS integration.

providers.name: Red 6
providers.description: Red 6 (Red Six Aerospace, Inc.) is a defense technology company founded in 2018 that builds outdoor, high-speed augmented reality for military aviation training. Its flagship product, ATARS (Advanced Tactical Augmented Reality System), pairs the EVE (Enhanced Visual Environment) helmet-mounted display — 160-degree field of view, 18,000 nits, 10ms latency, full color — with an AI-driven multiplayer network so real pilots in real aircraft can fly and maneuver against synthetically generated adversaries in real time, in daylight. A companion system, ARCADE (Augmented Reality Command and Analytic Data Environment), handles mission planning, briefing and three-dimensional debrief. ATARS has been integrated or trialed on the USAF F-16 and MC-130, the RAF Hawk T-2, Boeing's AH-64E Apache CATT, and the Lockheed Martin / Korea Aerospace Industries T-50/TF-50. Red 6 is ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certified. It publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract — its software surface is delivered through defense programs and OEM integrations rather than a self-serve developer platform.

providers.name: Reynolds American
providers.description: Reynolds American Inc. is the second-largest tobacco company in the United States and a subsidiary of British American Tobacco (BAT). Its subsidiaries include R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Company (Camel, Newport, Pall Mall), American Snuff Company (Grizzly, Kodiak), Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company (Natural American Spirit), and R.J. Reynolds Vapor Company. Reynolds American does not offer a public developer API or data services.

providers.name: Safely
providers.description: Safely (SafelyStay, Inc.) is an InsurTech company providing short-term rental insurance, guest screening, and travel insurance for vacation rental property managers and their guests. The Safely Protection Policy offers up to $1,000,000 in short-term rental insurance covering guest-caused accidental and intentional damage, theft, pet damage, and bodily injury liability, while its guest screening verifies guests before check-in. Safely connects to property management systems through turnkey partner integrations (Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Track, Streamline, Escapia, Lodgify, and more) rather than a public developer API. A Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network; this profile was enriched by the pipeline, which found no public API surface.

providers.name: Silo Finance
providers.description: Silo Finance is a decentralized, non-custodial lending protocol built around isolated money markets. Each market pairs a single collateral asset with a borrowable asset in its own risk silo, so the failure or manipulation of one asset cannot cascade into unrelated markets — the isolation model that distinguishes Silo from pooled lenders. The protocol is delivered as onchain smart contracts (Silo V1, V2 and V3) deployed across Ethereum and other EVM chains, with an application at silo.finance, developer and protocol-architecture documentation at docs.silo.finance, third-party security audits, and an open GitHub organization publishing the contracts, subgraph and indexer. Silo Finance is backed by Electric Capital and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a DeFi lending provider.

providers.name: Simplyinsured
providers.description: SimplyInsured is a small-business health insurance brokerage and online enrollment platform. It aggregates medical, dental, and vision plans from major carriers, provides unbiased plan recommendations, and lets small employers compare, quote, and enroll their teams entirely online at no cost to the business. Founded in 2012 and backed by Y Combinator, SimplyInsured is frequently embedded as the health-insurance offering inside partner payroll and HR platforms. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing web application and a support/help surface but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sofía
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican health insurance company (aseguradora) offering medical coverage for individuals, families, and businesses, delivered primarily through a mobile app with plans that carry no deductibles. Regulated in Mexico by the CNSF, Secretaría de Salud, and CONDUSEF, and backed by Index Ventures. This is a consumer/enterprise insurance provider surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; a live probe of the public surface found no developer program, API, or /.well-known/ discovery documents, so this profile remains identity-only pending any future API exposure.

providers.name: Spot Runner
providers.description: Spot Runner is an AI-driven advertising technology company (backed by Battery Ventures) focused on contextual media planning for Connected TV (CTV) and online video. Its platform uses proprietary MicroModeling AI through tools such as ContextPlanner and ContextDeals to match advertiser creative to the most relevant, brand-suitable premium video ad opportunities across leading streaming networks, publishers, and TV OEMs, and to send Deal IDs directly to a buyer's DSP seat. Spot Runner also markets an "Agentic Agency" of multi-agent creative tooling for SMBs and DTC brands. The public surface is a marketing site plus an advertiser login portal; there is no published developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK. The site does expose a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access, advertised via its /llms.txt.

providers.name: SquareTrade (Allstate)
providers.description: SquareTrade, an Allstate company, provides consumer product protection plans and extended warranties for smartphones, electronics, appliances, furniture, and other goods, marketed in North America as Allstate Protection Plans. It serves more than 140 million customers through partnerships with major retailers and mobile carriers across the US, Europe, Japan, and Australia, handling plan registration, claims filing, same-day repairs, and in-home service. SquareTrade was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its digital surface is consumer- and partner-facing (plan portal, claims, partnerships).

providers.name: StoreCash
providers.description: StoreCash, operated by G Cards, Inc., is a Los Angeles-based cashback and payments company whose mobile app (iOS and Android) lets shoppers earn instant, unlimited cashback on everyday purchases at hundreds of online and in-store retailers. Users buy a store card for a purchase amount, receive cashback immediately, then redeem the digital card at checkout like a gift card. The product works with debit and credit cards, stacks with existing store promos, and offers sign-up, referral, and birthday bonuses under a free-trial-then- subscription model. StoreCash also markets a plug-and-play cashback API to businesses and banks to power their own loyalty and engagement, though that B2B API is contact-sales only and not publicly documented. The public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access.

providers.name: Substack
providers.description: Substack is an independent newsletter and media platform that lets writers, podcasters, video creators, and other culture makers publish directly to readers and monetize through paid subscriptions. Founded in 2017 by Chris Best (CEO), Jairaj Sethi (CTO), and Hamish McKenzie (CWO) and headquartered in San Francisco with a New York City office, Substack provides built-in subscription billing, paid posts, podcasting, chat, video, Notes, and a cross-publication recommendations network. Creators keep 90 percent of subscription revenue (less credit card fees) and own their mailing lists and content. The platform reports more than five million paid subscriptions and tens of millions of weekly active readers. Substack does not offer a general-purpose public REST API for managing publications, posts, or subscribers. It does publish a narrowly scoped official Developer API (released April 2026) that allows token-authenticated lookup of public Substack profiles by LinkedIn handle, gated by an application and Terms-of-Use process. Read access to public content is otherwise available via per-publication RSS feeds, and the broader integration ecosystem relies on reverse-engineered, unofficial JSON endpoints used by the Substack web application.

providers.name: SVT Robotics
providers.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Tap
providers.description: TAP (Training All People, Inc.) is a next-generation technician training platform for advanced and precision manufacturers. TAP combines online courses (pneumatics, electrical fundamentals, robotics, safety, and semiconductor basics) with immersive VR simulations that replicate real factory equipment and procedures, plus in-simulation quizzes, VR scenario assessments, and workforce skills-profiling dashboards. The platform lets manufacturers evaluate, standardize, and upskill their technician workforce at scale while minimizing disruption to production. Customers include Northrop Grumman, ACC, SUNY, and Dallas College. Backed by 8vc and surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; TAP currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TaTiO
providers.description: TaTiO is a recruitment and candidate-assessment platform that replaces traditional resume-based screening with immersive, AI-driven virtual job simulations. Candidates perform real job tasks - a forklift pre-shift check, a customer service call - so employers see how they actually work rather than how they describe themselves, producing a prediction score, a skills snapshot, and a report drawn from roughly 150 data points per candidate. The platform aims to increase application and engagement rates, reduce hiring mismatches, and integrate with existing hiring tools (ATS) so candidate status syncs automatically. TaTiO is a Techstars-backed company; its public website runs on Wix and exposes a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access.

providers.name: Tvscientific
