providers.description: Uniko is a Mexican gift registry (mesa de regalos) SaaS platform for weddings, events, and baby showers, letting couples convert gifts into cash deposited directly to their bank account. The platform bundles a personalized wedding website, save-the-date digital invitations, WhatsApp-based guest confirmation, and planning tools, and also offers store-credit gift registries for ecommerce shops. Uniko is a 500 Global portfolio company; it is consumer-facing and publishes no public API or developer documentation.

providers.name: Up&Up
providers.description: Up&Up (legal name Homevest Inc.) is a New York-based rental housing platform that lets renters build wealth while they rent. Instead of a traditional security deposit, renters contribute to an Up&Up Wallet that grows through their own contributions, a share of monthly rental profits, and appreciation in the home's value; at lease end they can buy the home, transfer the wallet to another Up&Up rental, renew, or cash out. Founded by Michael Wong, Ryan Brown, and Ben Wong, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Up&Up operates a consumer web application and a private backend at api.upandup.co, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Worldover
providers.description: Worldover is the AI operating system for chemicals and cosmetics companies, replacing fragmented ERP, PLM, QMS, LIMS, and regulatory tools with one AI-orchestrated system custom-built around each team's workflows. Powered by Willow, its chemical and regulatory intelligence engine, it runs AI agents for demand planning, regulatory monitoring, quality, formulation R&D, supply chain, SDS authoring, and PLM updates. Headquartered in London and backed by Index Ventures, Chalfen, and EF, Worldover serves beauty brands, manufacturers, ingredient providers, distributors, and pharma and supplements companies. No public developer API is published.

providers.name: Zed
providers.description: Zed is a BSP-supervised fintech building a premium consumer credit card for Southeast Asians, headquartered in Manila with an engineering team in San Francisco. Its flagship product is the Zed Card, a Titanium Mastercard with no foreign transaction fees, no annual fees, flexible installments, and an accompanying mobile app that offers real-time statements, spend notifications, and unlimited self-destructing virtual cards for online purchases. The company raised a $16.5M Series A led by Accel with participation from Valar Ventures and fintech operators from Nubank, Square, and Mercury. Zed is a consumer-facing financial product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Academia
providers.description: Academia (Academia.edu, Academia Inc.) is a San Francisco based platform for sharing and discovering academic research, founded in 2008 by Richard Price. Registered researchers upload papers, build public profiles, follow research interests and track readership analytics across a corpus of tens of millions of documents, and the company also runs the Academia journals program and sells Academia Premium subscriptions for advanced search, mentions, reader analytics and bulk PDF downloads. Academia publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; the /v0 JSON endpoints its own web client calls are explicitly disallowed to crawlers in robots.txt. It does publish an RFC 9116 security.txt with a named security contact and a disclosure posture, and a long per-crawler robots.txt that names AI and agent user-agents individually.

providers.name: Actualyze AI
providers.description: Actualyze AI is an enterprise AI governance and management company building tools that give organizations the visibility and control they need to adopt AI at scale without slowing their teams down. Founded by Rafi Khardalian (CEO) and Sean Lynch (CTO) — veterans of building and operating distributed systems at global scale — the company designs for regulated industries from day one, embedding compliance, defense-in-depth data protection, comprehensive audit logging, and continuous monitoring into the platform rather than bolting it on. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Aisin
providers.description: Aisin Corporation is a Japanese global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Kariya, Aichi. Part of the Toyota Group, Aisin manufactures automatic transmissions, drivetrain components, body, chassis, and electronics for major automakers.

providers.name: Anixter International
providers.description: Anixter International was a leading global distributor of network and security solutions, electrical and electronic solutions, and utility power solutions. In June 2020, Anixter was acquired by Wesco International for approximately $4.5 billion, creating a combined company with over $17 billion in annual revenue. Anixter now operates as Wesco Anixter, providing B2B distribution, supply chain services, and digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout catalogs, and procurement system integrations.

providers.name: Arbor
providers.description: Arbor is a consumer energy savings service operating in deregulated electricity markets across 13 states in the U.S. Northeast, Midwest, and Texas. The Arbor app analyzes a household's current electricity supply rate, matches the customer with vetted alternative suppliers, and automatically switches them to a lower-cost plan when one becomes available, all without changing the utility provider, interrupting service, or charging the customer. Arbor earns revenue through referral fees from energy suppliers rather than from consumers. Founded in 2022 by Andrew Meyer (previously co-founder of Swell Energy), Arbor is backed by First Round Capital, Obvious Ventures, Spring Tide Capital, and Blisce. Arbor is a consumer-facing application and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Astronergy
providers.description: Astronergy (Chint New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.) is the photovoltaic cell and module manufacturing arm of China's CHINT Group. Founded in 2006, it is one of the earliest private Chinese enterprises in the PV sector and is ranked among the world's largest module suppliers. It designs, manufactures and sells high-efficiency crystalline-silicon PV cells and modules — notably the n-type TOPCon ASTRO N series in bifacial and monofacial form — for utility-scale power stations, commercial and industrial rooftops, and residential systems. Astronergy sells into more than 140 countries and regions and operates manufacturing bases and sales centers in markets including Germany, Spain, the USA, Brazil and Turkey. Its public web surface is a marketing and product-download site: datasheets, installation manuals, warranty and certification PDFs, a module-authenticity checker and a PV Planner yield calculator. It publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Aurora Networks
providers.description: Aurora Networks is the broadband and access networks brand of Vistance Networks, Inc. (Nasdaq: VISN), the company CommScope renamed itself to in January 2026 after divesting its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment to Amphenol. Aurora Networks builds end-to-end access network infrastructure for global cable and broadband service providers: HFC and PON access systems, cable headend optics platforms, CMTS and CCAP gear, Distributed Access Architecture (DAA) devices, optical hubs, nodes and passives, RF and RFoG equipment, and video processing, security and delivery systems. Its ServAssure NXT family adds network performance management, alarm handling and service assurance software on top of that hardware estate. The brand originates with Aurora Networks, Inc., founded in Santa Clara, California in 1999 as a pure-play optical transport supplier to cable operators, backed by Battery Ventures among ten investors across roughly $60M raised, and acquired by Pace plc for $323M in 2013 before passing through ARRIS and CommScope. Aurora Networks is a network equipment vendor rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, no public API reference, and no machine-readable API specification. Product and integration documentation, including the ServAssure NXT web service and message-bus integration surfaces, sits behind authenticated customer support portals.

providers.name: AvoMD
providers.description: AvoMD (Avo) is a clinical AI platform that integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) systems to power AI copilots for healthcare workflows. It combines EHR data with trusted clinical knowledge bases to support decision-making, documentation, and care delivery across inpatient and outpatient settings. Avo's product line includes Chart Assist, an AI Scribe for ambient clinical documentation, and AI Consult, serving rural and small hospitals, large and mid-size hospitals, and ambulatory care, in partnership with medical societies and knowledge partners. The company is SOC 2 Type II compliant and backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Bayapay Sdn Bhd
providers.description: BayaPay Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian fintech (incorporated 2021, registration 202101021154 / 1421454-H, based in Subang Jaya, Selangor) building programmable, permission-based business and vehicle expense management on an open-loop prepaid Mastercard. Its flagship BayaFuel FuelFleet programme gives fleet operators, SMBs, corporate teams and gig workers real-time spend controls, customizable limits, fraud deterrence and digitized expense tracking across fuel, travel and operational spend. The reloadable prepaid card is issued under license from Instapay Technologies Sdn Bhd (a Bank Negara Malaysia e-money issuer and Mastercard Asia/Pacific licensee), and BayaPay is one of the first Full Functional Open-Loop payment solutions in the APAC region. A 500 Global portfolio company. The public site is Wix-powered and exposes an agent-accessible llms.txt and a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint; no bespoke BayaPay developer/payments API is publicly documented at this time.

providers.name: Bayes Impact
providers.description: Bayes Impact is a nonprofit organization that builds open-source AI and data-science tools for public services, governments, and nonprofits, with a mission to empower people in need and those who help them. Surfaced through Y Combinator, it has served over 10 million beneficiaries across three continents. Its flagship open-source project, Bob (formerly Bob Emploi), delivers personalized, data-driven career and job-search advice to jobseekers through a Python/Flask RESTful JSON API whose data structures are defined in Protocol Buffers. Other projects include the Bayes Platform agent framework for public services, the Encompass geographic-access analysis tool, and a range of civic data-science tooling.

providers.name: Beacons.ai
providers.description: Beacons.ai is an all-in-one creator business platform for creators, talent managers, and brands. It combines link-in-bio pages, creator websites, media kits, digital storefronts, email marketing, affiliate monetization, analytics, and creator-brand collaboration tools into one integrated product. Beacons helps creators build an owned web presence, grow and own their audience, monetize through products, affiliate links, and sponsorships, and manage creator-business workflows from a single place, with dedicated tooling for talent managers and brands running creator partnerships. Beacons.ai was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Beacons publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, product, and identity surface.

providers.name: Besoundbreast
providers.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Bluecoat (Symantec)
providers.description: Blue Coat Systems was a web-security and network-forensics vendor best known for its ProxySG secure web gateway appliances, SSL Visibility, WebPulse/Global Intelligence Network threat intelligence, and cloud web security (the Web Security Service). Bain Capital led a consortium that took Blue Coat private in 2015; Symantec acquired the company in 2016, and Broadcom acquired Symantec's enterprise security business in 2019. Blue Coat's technology now ships inside Broadcom's Symantec Enterprise Cloud portfolio as Cloud Secure Web Gateway (Cloud SWG), Secure Web Gateway (ProxySG/ASG), SSL Visibility, CASB (CloudSOC), and DLP. Product documentation and REST APIs are published on the Broadcom TechDocs portal.

providers.name: BNP Paribas
providers.description: BNP Paribas is a leading international banking group providing a wide range of financial services to individuals, businesses, and institutions worldwide. The company offers APIs through its CIB Developer Portal covering capital markets, payment services, securities services, and open banking integrations for corporate and institutional clients.

providers.name: Bureau of Indian Affairs
providers.description: The Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA) is the oldest bureau in the U.S. Department of the Interior. Its mission is to enhance the quality of life, promote economic opportunity, and carry out the federal responsibility to protect and improve the trust assets of American Indians, Indian tribes, and Alaska Natives. The BIA administers services directly or through contracts, grants, and compacts with 574 federally recognized tribes serving approximately 2.5 million people. BIA publishes geospatial datasets, directories, and forms through the Indian Affairs GIS Open Data portal, the Tribal Leader Directory, and official agency websites.

providers.name: Chowbus
providers.description: Chowbus is a Chicago-headquartered restaurant technology company founded in 2016 by Linxin Wen and Suyu Zhang. It began as an online food ordering, payment and delivery marketplace for Asian restaurants and has since pivoted to a cloud-based, AI-assisted restaurant operating platform: point of sale, self-ordering kiosks, handheld and tablet ordering, kitchen display systems, waitlist and reservations, online ordering, branded restaurant websites and mobile apps, loyalty, gift cards, SMS marketing, a promotions engine, multi-location management, and an AI suite covering digital ads, social media, creative assets and review insights. Chowbus states it serves 9,000+ restaurants across all 50 U.S. states and Canada with 24/7 bilingual (EN/ZH/ES) support, and raised an $81M growth round in March 2026 led by Prysm Capital and Left Lane Capital. Its POS advertises two-way third-party delivery integration with 45+ marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub and others), and partner-side aggregators such as Deliverect publish Chowbus POS connectors — but as of August 2026 Chowbus publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract, SDK, or sandbox. Its only machine-readable public agent surface is a hand-authored bilingual llms.txt at chowbus.com/llms.txt; a JSON API host (pos-api.chowbus.com) is live and returns a structured error envelope but is undocumented and gated.

providers.name: CMA CGM
providers.description: CMA CGM is a Marseille-headquartered French container shipping, logistics, and port operator and the third-largest ocean carrier in the world. Founded in 1978 by Jacques Saadé and led today by Chairman & CEO Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group operates a fleet of 593 vessels with 4.5 million TEU of capacity calling 420 ports across 160 countries on 257 maritime services. The group includes maritime brands ANL, APL, CNC Line, Containerships, Comanav, and Mercosul Line; terminal operator CMA Terminals and Terminal Link; the CEVA Logistics contract logistics and freight forwarding business (acquired 2019); CMA CGM Air Cargo; Brittany Ferries and La Méridionale passenger ferries; and the CMA Média portfolio (La Provence, La Tribune, BFM-RMC, Brut). Through api-portal.cma-cgm.com the group exposes a DCSA-aligned REST API surface — Track and Trace v1 (DCSA v2.2.0), Schedules, Booking Request, Quotation, and Invoice — plus a parallel EDI catalog (EDIFACT IFTSAI, IFTMBF, IFTSTA, INVOIC) and group-level digital initiatives including ZEBOX (startup accelerator), Traxens-based IoT smart containers, and a strategic AI partnership with Mistral.

providers.name: Dance
providers.description: Dance is a Berlin-based electric mobility subscription company that offers e-bikes and e-mopeds as an all-in-one monthly subscription. A single fixed monthly fee bundles the vehicle together with on-demand repairs and maintenance, fast replacements, and theft protection, so members can ride without owning or servicing the hardware themselves. Dance operates in Berlin, Hamburg, and Paris, with product lines including the Dance One and Dance One Step e-bikes and the Dance Moped. Founded in 2020 by SoundCloud co-founders Alexander Ljung and Eric Quidenus-Wahlforss with Jimdo co-founder Christian Springub, Dance is a consumer-facing, app-based service backed by HV Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, help, and security surface.

providers.name: Daupler
providers.description: Daupler provides a cloud-based Response Management System (RMS) for utilities, public works, and service organizations that automates and coordinates emergency and service-request response. Its product suite spans Daupler Answering (after-hours call center), Dispatch Assist and AI-driven call management, Callout crew notification, Notify mass notification via SMS/email/phone, Engage customer portal, Event Detection for multi-incident coordination, and Analytics for incident and team-performance insight. Daupler serves water, sewer, electric, multi-utility, trash-collection, and public-works operators. The RMS is built on RESTful services and integrates with CMMS, work-order, AMI, IoT sensor, billing, CIS, CRM, OMS, GIS, and citizen-request systems, though Daupler exposes no public self-serve developer API or documentation. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: District Cover
providers.description: District Cover is a commercial insurance managing general agent and surplus-lines broker focused on urban businesses. It underwrites flexible commercial coverage for city-based retailers, restaurants, bakeries, laundromats, dry cleaners, salons, law and medical offices, and multi-location mid-market operators, using block-level risk scoring drawn from crime and fire analytics rather than broad ZIP-code assessments. The platform supports real-time submissions, multi-location quoting, and property-only endorsements, and is distributed to brokers through a licensed producer network operating across multiple U.S. states. District Cover publishes no public API or developer program; broker access is delivered through a hosted Insly portal.

providers.name: Ejara
providers.description: Ejara is a Cameroon-based, regulated fintech platform giving people across Francophone Africa and its diaspora access to digital savings and investment products through a mobile app. Founded in 2020 in Douala by Nelly Chatue-Diop, Baptiste Andrieux, and Tierno Tall, Ejara lets users save from as little as 1,000 CFA francs in BEAC-guaranteed savings plans earning up to 5% annual interest, and buy, sell, and self-custody cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins using blockchain-based non-custodial wallets. The company is licensed by COSUMAF in the CEMAC zone (SGP-06/2021) and registered with France's Autorite des marches financiers (AMF-E2022-056), and raised an $8M Series A led by Anthemis and Dragonfly. Ejara operates as a consumer mobile application on iOS and Android rather than a public API provider; this profile tracks its developer surface, including open-source blockchain libraries on GitHub, for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Enurgen
providers.description: Enurgen is a solar energy software company whose DUET platform uses 3D physics-based modeling to optimize photovoltaic assets across their entire lifecycle. The platform spans three products - Design, Construction, and Operations - helping large-scale solar developers, independent power producers, EPC engineers, and asset managers improve energy yield estimates, validate construction against expected performance, and monitor plants in production to close the gap between forecasted (P50) and actual field output. Enurgen is a Techstars-backed company; customers include Scatec, Potentia, Lightsource, Eni, and Kiewit. The company operates a customer web application at app.enurgen.com but does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile is an enrichment pass that captures the company's public web properties and domain security posture.

providers.name: Evie Networks
providers.description: Evie Networks is an Australian electric-vehicle charging infrastructure company, founded in 2017 and backed by the St Baker Energy Innovation Fund, that owns and operates one of the country's largest DC fast and ultrafast public charging networks across 300+ locations in every state and territory. It sits downstream of the electricity retail market as a charge point operator (CPO) and e-mobility service provider, buying energy and reselling it as charging sessions to drivers and fleets, and it also builds and operates charging assets for site hosts, councils, dealerships and commercial property owners. Its API posture is closed: as of 2026-07-27 there is no developer portal, no published API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no named support for the EV charging interoperability standards (OCPP, OCPI, ISO 15118). Evie is not a designated data holder under Australia's Consumer Data Right energy regime — the CDR Register's public energy data-holder brand summary lists 84 brands and Evie is not among them — so the statutory data mandate that produced identical APIs across Australian banks and energy retailers does not reach the EV charging layer at all. A live production API host exists at api.goevie.com.au serving the Evie Charging mobile app, but it is undocumented, unadvertised and returns a Google Cloud Endpoints 404 to anonymous callers. Neither consumer charging-session data nor network/market data is published through any documented public interface; charger location data reaches developers only through third-party aggregators.

providers.name: Fluid
providers.description: A responsive front-end framework for building flexible and adaptive web layouts.

providers.name: Freed
providers.description: Freed is a San Francisco-based AI medical scribe and clinician assistant designed to reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers. The product listens to patient visits and generates SOAP-style clinical notes, visit summaries, patient instructions, referral letters, and ICD-10 / CPT coding suggestions, then transfers the finalized note into the clinician's EHR via a browser-resident agent. Freed was founded in 2023 by former Facebook engineers Erez Druk (CEO) and Andrey Bannikov (CTO) after Druk's wife, a practicing family physician, experienced the daily toll of manual charting. The company is consumer self-serve: clinicians sign up for a 7-day free trial and then a monthly Starter, Core, Premier, or custom Groups plan with no enterprise sales required. As of 2025 Freed reported more than 20,000 paying clinician users and raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia Capital, bringing total funding to $34M. The platform is HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and HITECH-ready; patient recordings are not stored. Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Fuse
providers.description: Fuse Energy is a UK retail energy supplier providing gas and electricity to homes and businesses, alongside EV charging, solar and battery storage tracking with grid export, and smart home energy management. The company emphasises savings against the UK price cap, a fast (~3 minute) online sign-up, automated supplier switching, and 24/7 customer support including an AI assistant called "Plugs". Fuse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer/business energy web and mobile experience and does not publish a public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Fuse Energy
providers.description: Fuse Energy (Fuse Energy Supply Limited) is a UK-based residential and business energy supplier providing gas and electricity on variable, fixed, and multi-rate tariffs, alongside EV charging, solar and battery export tracking, multi-property account management, and an in-app AI energy assistant called Plugs. The company positions itself around beating the UK energy price cap, sign-up in under three minutes, and 24-hour customer support. It operates a consumer- and business-facing web and mobile app experience and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Glen
providers.description: Glen is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building a shared organizational learning and memory system for fleets of AI agents. The platform acts as a centralized store that every AI agent in a company can read from and write to, so that when one agent learns something the whole organization gains access to it. Glen preserves decisions, customer insights and operational procedures with full audit trails, applies role-based access control per observation at recall time, and connects to coding agents, PR assistants, bug bots and sales agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It integrates with the tools where work already lives (code repositories, pull requests, issues, documentation and meetings) to give both agents and humans unified organizational context, aiming to eliminate knowledge silos, reduce new-hire ramp time and retain institutional knowledge through employee turnover. The company is pre-launch and operating a waitlist; its primary integration surface is an MCP server rather than a traditional REST API.

providers.name: Goals
providers.description: Goals (playgoals.com, formerly goals.co) is a free-to-play competitive football (soccer) video game studio backed by Northzone. It positions itself as a gameplay-first football game — "No scripts, no excuses, just football" — with fast, skill-based competitive matches, unique player squads, card-pack collection, ranked leaderboards, and multiple game modes across Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and the Epic Games Store. A companion app lets players manage squads and open packs. This profile was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company (consumer sector) and added to the API Evangelist network; the studio publishes a consumer game and a community surface (Discord, guides, leaderboards) but no public developer API.

providers.name: Hugo
providers.description: Hugo is a mobile-first, usage-based car insurance company that lets drivers turn coverage on and off from their phone and pay in short intervals rather than a large upfront down payment. Through the Hugo app and web portal, customers can activate liability or comprehensive coverage in minutes, get instant proof of insurance, auto-reload their balance, and extend protection as needed. Hugo positions itself as a modern, micropayment alternative to traditional insurers for budget-conscious and gig-economy drivers, and is a seed-stage InsurTech company backed by Canaan Partners. Hugo operates in select U.S. states with expansion underway. Hugo is a consumer insurance application and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Humanitru
providers.description: Humanitru is an integration-first CRM and fundraising platform built for nonprofits, museums, zoos, aquariums, botanic gardens, and food banks. Rather than forcing organizations into an all-in-one ecosystem, Humanitru consolidates donor, membership, ticketing, email marketing, accounting, and volunteer data from more than 40 partner tools into a single 360-degree view, then layers automated insights, reporting, and donor-engagement workflows on top. The company positions itself around data consolidation and retention, citing customer outcomes such as increased active donors and improved donor retention, and pairs the platform with one-on-one support staffed by former fundraisers and database managers. Humanitru (formerly operating as Totem Insights) is a Techstars portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation; all connectivity is delivered through its curated native integration catalog.

providers.name: Hutchinson
providers.description: Hutchinson SA is a French global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Paris, a subsidiary of TotalEnergies. Hutchinson designs and manufactures anti-vibration systems, sealing systems, fluid transfer, precision rubber components, and aerospace systems for the automotive, aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors.

providers.name: Ideal Invest
providers.description: Ideal Invest (operating as Pravaler) is a Brazilian fintech founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sao Paulo that provides private student financing for higher education. Through its Pravaler platform, students can split tuition payments across roughly twice the duration of a course, with a 100% digital, low-bureaucracy application, competitive monthly interest rates, and no ENEM requirement. Pravaler works with a network of 500+ partner higher-education institutions and has financed more than 400,000 students, channeling over R$12 billion into Brazilian education. The company is backed by Ribbit Capital. As of this enrichment pass Pravaler exposes a consumer web platform (simulation, application, digital signature) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: IgniteTech
providers.description: IgniteTech is a global, AI-first enterprise software company (headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operating remote-first across 30+ countries) that acquires, revitalizes, and supports mission-critical enterprise software and embeds AI-powered capabilities across its portfolio — an operating model the company brands "AI-DNA." Its Native AI products include Eloquens AI (automated, context-aware email response), MyPersonas (AI digital clones of key employees that answer repetitive questions via a video chat-style interface), and Adminio AI (meeting scheduling through intelligent email orchestration). The IgniteTech Unlimited software library spans acquired enterprise brands such as GFI Software, Khoros (Communities and Care), Jive, DNN, Gensym, Computron, GRID (supply chain, via the Suuchi acquisition), Knova, AnswerHub, ACORN, TradeBeam, and SalesBuilder. Led by CEO Eric Vaughan, the company positions itself as an AI enterprise software company rather than only a software holding company.

providers.name: Infusionsoft (Keap)
providers.description: Infusionsoft, now branded as Keap, is a sales and marketing automation CRM built for small businesses that combines contact management, email marketing, e-commerce, pipeline automation, appointments, and invoicing in a single platform. Keap exposes REST APIs (v1 and v2) and a legacy XML-RPC API for managing contacts, companies, opportunities, orders, products, tags, emails, and campaigns, all authenticated via OAuth 2.0 authorization code and refresh token grants.

providers.name: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority
providers.description: The Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) performs the global coordination of the DNS Root, IP addressing, and other Internet protocol resources. IANA maintains the protocol registries, top-level domain delegations, time zone database, and language subtag registry that the Internet relies on. Bulk registry data is published as machine-readable files distributed via rsync and FTP rather than through a public REST API.

providers.name: InventoryQuant
providers.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

providers.name: Invesdor
providers.description: Invesdor is a pan-European crowdinvesting and digital investment platform that connects private and professional investors with companies raising capital through equity, subordinated loans, and bonds, with minimum tickets starting around EUR 250. Founded in Finland in 2012 and expanded through mergers with Finnest, Kapilendo, and Oneplanetcrowd, Invesdor now serves more than 180,000 investors across Europe and has channeled over EUR 600 million into more than 1,000 renewable-energy, scale-up, and SME financing rounds. It operates as a regulated investment firm under the EU Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP) regime. Invesdor does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, investor, and legal surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kissmetrics
providers.description: Kissmetrics is a product and behavioral analytics platform that tracks individual user activity across web and mobile, surfacing funnels, cohorts, retention, and revenue reports tied to identified people. The platform helps product, marketing, and growth teams understand user journeys and pinpoint conversion drop-off. Kissmetrics provides REST APIs for querying reports, exporting segments, and ingesting events, authenticated via HTTP Basic auth.

providers.name: Lindus Health
providers.description: Lindus Health is a next-generation contract research organization (CRO) that runs clinical trials end to end for biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors. It pairs Citrus, an AI-assisted trial operating system connecting patient identification through final data capture, with centralized patient identification and enrollment (AI-powered EHR querying, digital pre-screening, centralized patient support), flexible site models spanning site-based, hybrid and fully virtual delivery, and integrated clinical services from protocol design through database lock. Its platform surface covers EDC, eSource, ePRO/eCOA, eConsent and CTMS. The company operates across the US, UK and Europe with APAC partnerships, employs over 160 staff, and works in cardiometabolic, respiratory, psychiatry, women's health and dermatology. Commercial engagements are performance-based with milestone pricing. Lindus Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal or API documentation; its public technical footprint is two open-source CDISC clinical-data repositories.

providers.name: Meanwhile
providers.description: Meanwhile is the first BMA-licensed innovative life insurer in Bermuda, offering whole life insurance policies denominated entirely in Bitcoin rather than fiat. Its BTC Life product lets customers pay premiums in Bitcoin that grow at a guaranteed rate in Bitcoin terms, borrow tax-free against up to 90% of policy value after one year, and pass a full day-one death benefit to beneficiaries without managing wallets or seed phrases. The company is backed by Pantera, Bain Capital Crypto, Sam Altman, Northwestern Mutual, and Framework Ventures, and raised $82M in October 2025. Meanwhile publishes no public developer API, portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: MediaCaption API
providers.description: A credit-billed REST API for retrieving public YouTube transcripts, with single and bulk transcript jobs, job-level webhooks, and AI transcription/translation capabilities. Backed by a public OpenAPI 3.1 contract with bearer/X-API-Key authentication.

providers.name: MIT
providers.description: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) operates an internal developer portal that exposes APIs for the institution's information systems. The MIT developer environment publishes APIs such as the Roles API for managing institutional roles and authorizations. Access to the developer portal and most APIs requires MIT authentication via Shibboleth / Touchstone single sign-on, making the catalog primarily available to community members, partners, and authorized integrators rather than to the general public.

providers.name: MOO
providers.description: MOO is a London-founded online print and design company that produces premium custom business cards, postcards, flyers, stickers, notebooks, packaging, and branded promotional merchandise for individuals and businesses. Backed by Index Ventures, MOO combines a browser-based design experience with commercial printing, and sells tiered business plans (Business, Advanced, Enterprise) with team management and design services. MOO does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; its developer-style subdomains resolve to the main storefront rather than an API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Nibbles PBC
providers.description: Nibbles PBC is a public benefit company building consumer financial and insurance products that make pet ownership easier. Its flagship product is the Nibbles credit card, a Mastercard that bundles built-in pet insurance and pet- focused rewards for cardholders. The company operates a consumer web application and account portal at nibbles.com (formerly reached via the nibbl.es short domain) covering sign-up, sign-in, card management, insurance policies, and rewards. Nibbles PBC was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; its public surface is a consumer product site, help center, and legal agreements. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Novi
providers.description: Novi Connect is an AI shopping optimization platform for consumer packaged goods (CPG) and retail brands. Its AI Shopping Optimizer structures and optimizes product data feeds so that AI systems, agentic search, and commerce assistants can accurately understand, trust, and recommend products, while its Product Authority Builder verifies and distributes product data through direct feeds with major retailers and marketplaces. Novi Connect is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Greylock.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Open Podcast API
providers.description: The Open Podcast API is an initiative aiming to provide a feature-complete synchronization API specification for podcast (web) apps and user-focused servers. The specification covers synchronization of subscriptions, listening progress, favorites, queues, and device state across compliant clients and self-hosted servers, with the goal of giving listeners portable control of their podcast data.

providers.name: Orbio
providers.description: Orbio Earth is a climate-tech company (founded 2021; Dover, Delaware, USA and Cologne, Germany) that turns open satellite data into industrial methane intelligence for the energy sector. Its platform detects, quantifies, and tracks methane emissions from oil-and-gas infrastructure globally at asset level with a roughly 5-day revisit rate, using multispectral imagery (Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9, EMIT) and machine learning, plus Bayesian uncertainty estimation. Customers — oil-and-gas operators and private-equity firms — use it for super-emitter identification, historical trend and root-cause analysis, and compliance with emerging methane regulation. Platform access is offered via the web application or a sales-gated data API integration; there is no public self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK. Orbio also publishes the open-source Project Eucalyptus methane-detection pipelines on GitHub for research use.

providers.name: Overstory
providers.description: Overstory provides AI-powered vegetation intelligence for electric utilities and grid operators. The platform fuses high-resolution satellite and aerial imagery with machine learning to detect vegetation encroachment, hazard trees, and wildfire risk along power line corridors, helping utilities prioritize trimming, optimize vegetation management spend, and improve grid reliability (SAIDI). Overstory was founded as 20tree.ai and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company. As of this profile the company delivers its intelligence through a customer platform and services rather than a public developer API; no public API documentation, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Pacto
providers.description: Pacto is a Mexican fintech company modernizing payment acquisition for banks and hospitality businesses, moving them "de lo legacy a lo digital" (from legacy to digital). Pacto builds point-of-sale (POS) software and payment terminals: a miniPOS terminal and "Ordena y Paga" (order-and-pay) terminals plus value-added modules for banks, and a full restaurant POS suite (Pacto POS, Pacto GetNet, Order & Pay QR ordering, bill splitting, inventory, and reporting) for restaurants, cafes, bars, and fast-food counters. Backed by 500 Global and Banco Santander's GetNet, Pacto helps traditional financial institutions and merchants accept digital card payments and manage operations. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Pacto publishes a marketing site, blog, and pricing but no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Pitzi
providers.description: Pitzi is a Brazilian insurtech (founded around 2013) that sells mobile phone protection insurance, covering devices against theft, robbery, cracked screens, and accidental damage. Customers subscribe to monthly device-protection plans and file claims through an online customer portal to get their phone repaired or replaced, with support offered via a help center, email, and WhatsApp. Pitzi also distributes through a partner program and is backed by DCM Ventures and QED Investors. It operates as a direct-to-consumer and partner-distributed fintech/insurtech in Brazil. No public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: RoxyAPI
providers.description: Multi-domain spiritual intelligence API exposing 164+ endpoints across 12 domains (Western Astrology, Vedic Astrology, Numerology, Tarot, Human Design, Forecast, Biorhythm, I-Ching, Crystals, Dreams, Angel Numbers, Location/Timezone) under a single API key. Powered by the proprietary Roxy Ephemeris engine verified against NASA JPL Horizons DE441. Offers REST API, OpenAPI 3.1 contract, per-domain remote MCP servers, llms.txt, and an AGENTS.md agent playbook.

providers.name: Runwise
providers.description: Runwise provides wireless smart-control systems that automate heating, cooling, water, and gas infrastructure in multifamily and commercial buildings. Its retrofit hardware and cloud platform replace legacy boiler, steam, and HVAC controls, cutting heating, cooling, and water bills by roughly 23% with same-day installation. Runwise reports more than 10,300 buildings under management and over $175 million in cumulative utility savings for customers. The company is backed by Fifth Wall, Initialized Capital, and Menlo Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Runwise's public web presence; as of this pass no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface has been identified.

providers.name: SafeShepherd
providers.description: Safe Shepherd is a consumer privacy and identity-protection service that proactively removes an individual's personal information from the internet and from marketing and data-broker databases. It continuously scans public websites and private databases for a subscriber's personal data, sends real-time email alerts when records are found, and submits opt-out and deletion requests on the subscriber's behalf (with manual removal instructions where automated removal is not possible). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public site is a consumer product with no developer/API surface.

providers.name: SchemaSure
providers.description: Structured data extraction API that converts unstructured text or HTML into JSON guaranteed to validate against a caller-supplied JSON Schema, or returns a typed error at no charge. Access is gated by x402 pay-per-call micropayments (USDC on Base), with no accounts or API keys.

providers.name: Squint
providers.description: Squint is a Manufacturing Intelligence platform that uses AI and augmented reality to help industrial and frontline operations teams lower downtime and improve quality at scale. Its mobile app captures and digitizes tribal knowledge from video and real work, orchestrates workflows and work assignments across employees and locations, provides AI-powered troubleshooting and expert guidance, and delivers analytics on performance across teams and sites. Founded by Devin Bhushan, Squint began in manufacturing and serves automotive, food and beverage, oil and gas, heavy industrials, equipment, consumer packaged goods, and energy customers, expanding into healthcare and hospitality. Backed by Menlo Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Squint exposes no public developer API; its documentation and application are gated behind a Squint workspace login.

providers.name: Studocu
providers.description: Studocu (operated by StudeerSnel B.V., Amsterdam) is a global online learning platform and study-materials marketplace where students access, share, and upload course documents, lecture notes, summaries, and exam prep across thousands of institutions and subjects. The platform layers AI study tools on top of its crowdsourced document library — an Ask AI chat, AI Notes generation, and an AI Quiz Generator — alongside course organization, study lists, and a Premium subscription for unlimited downloads and full document access. Backed by Partech and Point Nine, Studocu was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public security, trust, and web-property surface.

providers.name: Syneos Health
providers.description: Syneos Health is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Syneos Health API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TLA Plus Foundation
providers.description: The TLA+ Foundation is an independent nonprofit hosted by the Linux Foundation, dedicated to fostering the adoption of the TLA+ specification language in industry, academia, and education. Created by Leslie Lamport, TLA+ is a high-level formal specification language based on set theory and temporal logic for modeling concurrent and distributed systems. Inaugural members include Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Oracle. The Foundation funds research and development, maintains the TLC model checker, TLAPS proof system, and TLA+ Toolbox IDE, and coordinates community resources including the VS Code extension, CommunityModules, and formal verification examples. The current stable release is v1.7.4 (The Xenophanes release).

providers.name: TrueCare24
providers.description: TrueCare24 is a nationwide care platform providing care professionals and services for home and business. Its offerings span in-home care, on-demand healthcare staffing, visiting nurses, behavioral health and counseling, and workplace health programs including flu vaccination, diabetes screening, and COVID-19 testing and vaccination services. A 500 Global portfolio company, TrueCare24 operates customer dashboards and a provider portal but publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Vornado Realty Trust
providers.description: Vornado Realty Trust (NYSE: VNO) is a fully integrated Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) focused on owning and operating premier office and retail properties in New York City. With nearly 20 million square feet of office space and over 2.4 million square feet of Manhattan street retail, Vornado is among the largest commercial real estate companies in the United States. The company also owns residential units, marketplaces, and advertising signage in Times Square and Pennsylvania Station.

providers.name: Waffle Labs
providers.description: Waffle Labs, Inc. (Waffle Insurance) is a consumer InsurTech company and licensed digital insurance agency, founded at MIT and accelerated through Barclays Techstars and MIT Delta V. Waffle offers an all-in-one, mobile-first platform that lets consumers get quotes and bind coverage in under 90 seconds across renters, pet, home & auto, term life, personal cyber, and travel insurance in all 50 US states, partnering with vetted carriers rather than underwriting risk itself. The company also runs an embedded-insurance program that lets partners offer Waffle products through a no-code embed. Waffle is a consumer/partner product with no public developer program or API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zenysis
providers.description: Zenysis is a health intelligence infrastructure company that helps governments and organizations across low- and middle-income countries turn fragmented, messy health data into actionable insight. Its flagship Harmony Analytics Platform is open source (AGPL-3.0) and transforms, cleans, enriches, and integrates data from many disparate sources for analysis, visualization, and decision support. Zenysis powers national health information systems, disease surveillance, and program monitoring. There is no public hosted API product; Harmony is self-hosted and exposes its own REST (Flask-Potion) and GraphQL interfaces on a per-deployment basis. This repo was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the company's public web and GitHub presence.

providers.name: 80,000 Hours
providers.description: 80,000 Hours is an independent nonprofit, founded in 2011 by Benjamin Todd and William MacAskill out of Oxford, that provides free research and support to help people use their careers to help solve the world's most pressing problems. The name refers to the roughly 80,000 hours a typical person works over their lifetime. It publishes an evidence-based career guide, in-depth problem profiles, a long-form podcast, and one-on-one advising, and runs a curated high-impact job board at jobs.80000hours.org. Since 2016 it has ranked helping navigate the transition to advanced AI as its top priority. It is a content and career-advice organization rather than an API producer; no public developer API is published, though it does serve a machine-readable llms.txt index of its content.

providers.name: Ajax
providers.description: Ajax is an AI-powered timekeeping platform built specifically for law firms. It automatically captures attorney work across applications, documents, emails, phone calls, and video meetings, then generates OCG-compliant, voice-matched time-entry narratives and syncs them with one click to practice-management and billing systems. Ajax integrates with SurePoint, Clio, MyCase, Filevine, PracticePanther, Centerbase, Actionstep, and Soluno, and positions itself around recovering otherwise-lost billable hours. The company is SOC 2 aligned, encrypts data in transit and at rest, does not train models on customer data, and enforces rolling data deletion. Ajax is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a product/SaaS company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Alcove
providers.description: Alcove is an AI-powered procurement and project management platform built for interior designers, contractors, event planners, and purchasing agents. It consolidates product details, quotes, financials, and order tracking into a single hub, automatically tracking orders across vendors and projects, managing tasks and timelines, calculating profitability and markups, and offering a purchasing service with Designer Net discounts. An AI assistant surfaces financial insights, suggests markups, reviews approvals, and powers filtering. Alcove is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site and web application but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Allocate
providers.description: Allocate is a technology platform positioned as an "operating system for private markets," enabling wealth advisory firms, family offices, and asset managers to source, transact, and manage private-market investments across venture capital, growth equity, buyouts, and private credit. The platform offers white-label fund creation for advisors, AI-powered portfolio management with document aggregation, curated manager access, and SPV infrastructure for aggregating smaller commitments. Allocate reports over $4.9B in assets on platform, 370+ wealth advisory firm clients, and 1,500+ manager relationships. It is a private company backed by investors including Anthemis, a16z, Portage, and M13. Allocate does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this API Evangelist profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Alogent
providers.description: Alogent is a banking and financial technology provider that delivers cloud-native software to banks and credit unions across three product families: payments and deposit automation (Unify omni-channel check capture across branch, mobile, and ATM/ITM), intelligent check fraud detection and mitigation (Alogent Shield and Shield+), and enterprise content and loan document management (FASTdocs, AccuAccount, and the Alogent Document Portal). The platform emphasizes workflow automation, compliance controls, real-time transaction processing, and AI-assisted fraud prevention for financial institutions of all sizes. Alogent is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. No public developer portal or API documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Amulet
providers.description: Amulet is an agentic AI platform for post-sales and customer success teams, backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026). It connects to a company's existing stack — CRM, support desk, product analytics, calls, and email — reads every ticket, call, and usage trend across the entire book of business, and puts AI agents to work monitoring account health and surfacing risk, renewal, expansion, and adoption signals with the supporting evidence attached. Teams can ask natural-language questions about any account (in-app or from Slack), deploy scheduled agents from templates for renewals, onboarding, and QBRs, and audit every agent run, with anything customer-facing held for human approval. As of this profile Amulet does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures the company's public web surface (product, pricing, legal) as a network stub.

providers.name: AOne
providers.description: AOne is a Malaysia-based learning-centre management software company (operating publicly as AOneSchools) whose all-in-one platform is used by 4,000+ tuition centres, preschools, enrichment centres, sports academies, and language centres to automate billing, LHDN e-invoicing, attendance tracking, student and class management, and parent communication across connected web and mobile apps. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. The company's public surface today is a marketing website (aone.com.my) and a customer login/app at app.aoneschools.com; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface is currently published.

providers.name: Atom Power
providers.description: Atom Power, Inc. is a Charlotte, North Carolina electrical technology company founded in 2014 that invented the Atom Switch, the world's first commercial UL-listed digital solid-state circuit breaker. The company builds SiC (silicon carbide) power modules, solid-state switchgear and panel-level Level 2 electric-vehicle charging hardware for commercial, industrial, data-center and grid-edge deployments, paired with cloud software for energy management, load balancing and charger operations. Atom Power previously ran an "Atom Cloud" developer portal on Azure API Management at developers.atompower.com with a gateway at api.atompower.com; both hostnames are now dangling CNAMEs to deleted Azure API Management instances, so no public API contract is currently reachable.

providers.name: Avant
providers.description: Avant is a Chicago-based financial technology company that provides consumer credit products to middle-income U.S. consumers, primarily unsecured personal loans of roughly $2,000-$35,000 (9.95%-35.99% APR, 24-60 month terms) for debt consolidation, emergencies, home improvement, and other needs, alongside the Avant Credit Card issued through WebBank. Founded in 2012 and backed by investors including QED Investors and 500 Global, Avant operates a mobile-first lending and card-servicing platform with a customer help center, personal-finance blog, and SCRA support for military members. Avant is a consumer-facing product company and does not publish a public developer API or portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and support surfaces.

providers.name: Bhub
providers.description: BHub (bhub.com) is a Brazilian accounting and financial back-office company serving small and medium-sized businesses across Brazil. It combines bookkeeping and tax accounting (contabilidade), financial business-process outsourcing (BPO financeiro) covering accounts payable/receivable and reconciliation, tax consulting (consultoria tributaria), and corporate/legal structuring (societario), delivered through its online client hub at app.bhub.ai. Specialized divisions Agrocontar (agribusiness) and Quality Associados (nonprofit/third sector) extend its sector coverage. Backed by QED Investors, BHub reports processing tens of millions of invoices and reconciling billions of reais annually. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; BHub currently exposes an internal application backend (api.bhub.com) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: BizzyCar
providers.description: BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS platform for automotive dealerships that automates service recall management, customer outreach and mobile service. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Saint Peters, Missouri, the company ingests VIN-level open-recall data from OEM partners, matches it against a dealer's market area and DMS records, then uses AI-driven outreach (SMS, email, voice) to book service appointments and dispatch mobile service vans. Products include Recall Outreach, Recall Scout, Recall Radar, Service Engine, Mobile Service and Fleet IQ. BizzyCar is primarily an API *consumer* rather than an API producer: it ships pre-built connectors into dealer management systems (Dealertrack, DMS Plus, Open/Mate, Asbury, PBS, Tekion, Fortellis, Reynolds & Reynolds) and service schedulers (Xtime, TCC, DealerFX, Affinitiv, Update Promise), but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract of its own.

providers.name: Black Unicorn Factory
providers.description: Black Unicorn Factory (BUF) is a Los Angeles based pre-IPO business accelerator that prepares companies led by founders from underrepresented communities for direct listings on national stock exchanges, positioning equity rather than debt as the route to capital. Its programs run a four-step readiness pathway — foundation and readiness assessment, compliance and corporate structure, SEC filing and disclosure, and market readiness — alongside the New Black Wall Street pre-IPO program and the Follow Me For Equity (FMFE) platform, an iOS and Android application through which individuals earn stock in participating pre-IPO companies by completing verified social engagement tasks instead of investing cash. Black Unicorn Factory is a private company whose shares appear on secondary marketplaces; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Blend Financial
providers.description: Blend Financial Inc., doing business as Origin Financial (useorigin.com), is a consumer wealth management and personal finance platform that unifies income, net worth, spending, investments, assets, and liabilities into a single application. Origin pairs AI-powered budgeting and spend tracking with investment tools, estate and tax planning, and access to CFP professional advice; investment advisory services are provided through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, a subsidiary of Blend Financial Inc. The company is a consumer (B2C) product backed by 500 Global, Felicis Ventures, Founders Fund, and other investors, and also offers employer-sponsored financial wellness. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network it is a company profile; Origin publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Blue White Robotics
providers.description: Blue White Robotics Ltd. — operating as Bluewhite — is an Israeli off-road autonomy company founded in 2017 by Ben Alfi, Yair Shahar and Aviram Shmueli, headquartered in Tel Aviv with a US operation in Fresno, California. Bluewhite builds an OEM-agnostic autonomy stack that retrofits conventional vehicles into unmanned ground vehicles: Pathfinder, an aftermarket autonomy kit combining control, intelligence and perception modules over a distributed CAN network, and Compass, a cloud fleet-operations SaaS that lets operators remotely supervise, task and monitor an autonomous fleet. The company began in permanent-crop agriculture — autonomous spraying, mowing and harvest support across roughly 150,000 US acres for 20-plus growers — and has since extended the same GPS-denied navigation and perception stack to defense and homeland-security ground robotics. Elbit Systems' FUSE acquired 100% of Blue White Robotics in 2026. Bluewhite markets a Software SDK and an "API platform" for OEM and system integration, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; the Compass operator platform sits behind a Keycloak/OIDC login and integration access runs through a contact-sales form.

providers.name: Bluefish AI
providers.description: Bluefish AI is an enterprise AI marketing platform built for Fortune 500 brands to gain visibility and control over how they are represented across AI channels. The platform spans AI monitoring of brand reputation in AI-native experiences, generative engine optimization (GEO) to improve performance across AI search, GEO measurement frameworks, and agentic commerce tooling for AI-driven buying journeys. It serves search, content, brand, and PR teams. Founded by martech veterans whose prior advertising technologies are now owned by Microsoft and Meta, and backed by enterprise and AI investors including Bloomberg Beta and Threshold Ventures. Bluefish does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Boltzbit
providers.description: Boltzbit builds General Learning Intelligence (GLI) — AI systems that organizations can own, train, and control, learning continuously from proprietary data rather than depending on static, vendor-controlled models. Its product suite forms an operating system for AI-native software: BoltzHub, a marketplace where creators sell AI-powered apps and consumers subscribe to them; BoltzAgent, a self-learning assistant for research-backed chat, document editing, and production-ready code generation; BoltzLearn, an LLM fine-tuning platform for building custom models from your own data; and BoltzCloud, a multi-cloud deployment backbone across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Boltzbit is backed by Speedinvest. The company references an API product surface but does not yet publish public API documentation, an OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile will be enriched as those surfaces are released.

providers.name: Brandcast
providers.description: Brandcast is a no-code digital customer experience and website platform, founded in 2013 and backed by Shasta Ventures, that fuses web design, content creation, and brand asset management into a single system. Business and marketing teams use its Design Studio to build and maintain branded websites, sales proposals, brochures, and content programs, with Salesforce integration for personalized, trackable sites. The Brandcast API opens the Design Studio to developers to create websites from templates and update site content, authenticated with an API key sent in the x-api-key header over HTTPS. Brandcast's website product has since been rebranded as "Sites" and joined Vev; the developer API portal remains at developer.brandcast.io.

providers.name: BrightPlan
providers.description: BrightPlan is a San Jose, California based financial wellness company that sells a Total Financial Wellness platform to enterprise HR and benefits teams, combining a self-service digital financial planning application, an AI-powered financial wellness coach, and access to human CFP fiduciary advisors. BrightPlan LLC is an SEC-registered investment adviser, and the product is delivered to employees as an employer-sponsored benefit rather than as a self-serve consumer subscription. The employee experience runs at my.brightplan.com and web.brightplan.com with iOS and Android apps; employer value is framed around benefits engagement, retention, and measurable financial wellbeing. BrightPlan markets HRIS and benefits-system integration to employers but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Brit + Co
providers.description: Brit + Co is a lifestyle and entertainment media platform founded by Brit Morin that publishes content and creative education for a primarily women audience. It covers self-care, food, home and DIY, travel, relationships, celebrity and entertainment news, horoscopes, shopping guides, and games, and operates a learning platform (learn.brit.co) offering more than one hundred creative online classes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures. It is a consumer media and e-learning brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Calvis
providers.description: Calvis is a multi-agency security guard marketplace that connects businesses with vetted, state-licensed, background-checked security guards from multiple professional agencies across 40+ US cities. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, the platform pairs on-demand booking with AI-powered deployment matching, real-time GPS tracking and geofencing, live AI coaching delivered to guards through an earpiece, and automated incident reporting and site analytics. Businesses book unarmed, armed, event, retail, construction, corporate, residential, hospital, cannabis, and school security through the web platform and iOS/Android apps, while security professionals join the network to find work. Calvis is backed by Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Cameo
providers.description: Cameo is a consumer marketplace for personalized video messages from celebrities, athletes, musicians, comedians, and creators. Fans book a custom shout-out by sending a short script with personal details, and the talent records and delivers a bespoke video, typically within seven days, for occasions like birthdays, milestones, and celebrations. Cameo also runs Cameo for Business for branded talent content, sells gift cards, and offers a Red Carpet Rewards loyalty program. Cameo does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; this profile tracks the company's public web, help, and security surface.

providers.name: Caretta
providers.description: Caretta is a Y Combinator-backed (W26) startup building a real-time AI platform for sales teams. Its assistant joins reps in live calls to take notes and surface relevant answers to information requests, questions, and objections in real time, drawing on an organizational knowledge layer it calls "Caretta Nous" that is built from company documentation, websites, internal playbooks, and top-performer conversations. After calls it supports teamspaces with analysis, morning briefs, and follow-up Q&A, and integrates with tools such as Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, and Notion. The company raised $1.3M in pre-seed funding. As of this profile Caretta publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification; this entry captures its public identity and trust surface.

providers.name: Casper
providers.description: Casper (Casper Sleep Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer sleep and home goods brand that sells mattresses, bedding, pillows, and sleep accessories online at casper.com and through retail partners. Its casper.com storefront runs on Shopify and exposes a modern agentic-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md with agent instructions, the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile, a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for AI agents to search, cart, and check out, and Shopify Customer Account API OpenID Connect authentication. Casper was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP and Slow Ventures and enriched from its live public agent/commerce surface.

providers.name: CERPRO
providers.description: CERPRO is a Berlin-based industrial software company building AI-powered quality-assurance and process automation for small and medium-sized manufacturers. Its flagship product, QualiSpec, uses computer-vision and large-model AI to automatically extract features, dimensions, tolerances and drill-hole specifications from technical drawings (PDF, JPG, DXF) and generate inspection reports and quality documents in customized templates such as VDA, EMPB and inspection plans. This removes manual copy-paste and data-entry work from quality control, cutting documentation time by up to 70-90% and reducing errors while creating a unified data foundation that connects OEMs and suppliers. Since launching in December 2024 the software has been adopted by more than 100 SMEs across aerospace, medical devices and mechanical engineering. CERPRO is a Techstars portfolio company and raised a ~EUR 2M pre-seed round in 2025. The product is delivered as a cloud SaaS platform (platform.cerpro.io) hosted on AWS in Germany, with an ISO 27001 certified, GDPR/BDSG-compliant data-security posture.

providers.name: Certivity
providers.description: Certivity is a Munich-based RegTech company, founded in 2021, that operates an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform for regulated industries such as automotive, aerospace, and connected vehicles. Its product, Certivity Core, turns complex regulations, standards, and internal documents into structured, machine-readable, engineering-ready requirements with full traceability and real-time monitoring of legal changes across 50+ jurisdictions. The platform digitizes and structures regulatory content from publishers such as ISO, IEC, CEN, CENELEC, ASTM, UL, and SAE using a proprietary ingestion pipeline and a regulatory knowledge graph, and integrates directly into engineering workflows (including Jama Connect) via an official API. Backed by Earlybird, High-Tech Gruenderfonds, UVC Partners, and Almaz Capital, Certivity added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

providers.name: Circulo de Belleza
providers.description: Círculo de Belleza is an authorized distributor of professional beauty products in Mexico, operating an e-commerce storefront at circulodebelleza.com. It sells salon-quality hair care, hair color, nail, barbershop, and facial/spa supplies from 40+ professional brands (L'Oréal Professionnel, Olaplex, Wella, Schwarzkopf, Matrix, Alfaparf Milano) at professional pricing with no minimum purchase, same-day fulfillment, and nationwide Mexico delivery. The store is built on Shopify and exposes a native agent-commerce surface: a published llms.txt/agents.md, OpenID Connect and OAuth authorization-server discovery documents, and a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search, cart, and buyer-approved checkout.

providers.name: Clark
providers.description: Clark ("Dein Versicherungsmanager") is a Germany-based digital insurance manager that lets consumers view, compare, optimize, and manage all of their insurance policies in one mobile app and web platform. Founded in Frankfurt in 2015, Clark pairs a licensed insurance brokerage with automated tariff comparison across more than 180 insurance providers and free expert consultation, covering health, liability, property, life, mobility, and retirement products. The company operates across Germany, Switzerland, France, and the UK, serves over 700,000 customers, and is backed by venture investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners. Clark exposes no public developer API or developer portal; it is a consumer-facing insurtech rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Cline
providers.description: Cline (formerly Claude Dev) is an open-source autonomous coding agent. The Cline VS Code extension has 5M+ installs; JetBrains is in early access; the Cline CLI is also available. Edits files, runs commands, uses the browser, and federates to multiple LLM providers. An MCP Marketplace extends Cline with custom tools. There is also a hosted/managed offering (Cline.bot) with free and paid tiers plus enterprise sales.

providers.name: Clockster
providers.description: Clockster is a frontline staff-management super-app for food & beverage and retail businesses, consolidating attendance and time tracking, shift scheduling, automated payroll, earned wage access, business communication, tasks and checklists into a single mobile-first platform. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Singapore with offices across Kazakhstan and Indonesia, Clockster serves more than 1,300 SMEs across Central and Southeast Asia — including brands such as KFC, Hardee's and Costa Coffee — and is backed by 500 Global, I2BF Global Ventures and Quest Ventures. It is delivered as iOS, Android and Huawei mobile apps plus a web console and currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Codi
providers.description: Codi is a managed flexible office-space provider (office-as-a-service) operating in San Francisco and New York City. Codi delivers fully-managed private offices for teams, bundling furniture, cleaning and restocking, tech and network management, vendor coordination, room booking, and an AI office assistant into a single turnkey monthly subscription — positioned as an alternative to traditional commercial leases, coworking, and short-term space marketplaces such as Regus, Breather, and Peerspace. Codi was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation — its digital surface is a members' web app and a hosted help center.

providers.name: Comfi Holdings Limited
providers.description: Comfi (Comfi Holdings Limited) is a UAE-based financial technology company providing B2B working capital solutions for small and medium enterprises and trading businesses. Its three core products are invoice discounting (turning outstanding invoices into immediate cash), Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) for flexible B2B credit terms, and automotive dealer inventory financing. Comfi positions itself around speed — "capital in hours, not weeks" — and reports 1,000+ SMEs served, 15,000+ invoices financed, and $100M+ capital deployed across the UAE market. Eligibility requires a UAE-registered B2B business with at least six months of operating history and AED 100,000+ monthly revenue. Backed by 500 Global. No public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal was found at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Concepts
providers.description: Concepts is a digital sketching and design application built by TopHatch, Inc., offering an infinite, flexible canvas for thinking, planning, illustration, and design across iOS, Android, and Windows. It blends vector and raster drawing with precision tools, adjustable brushes, layers, and a dynamic tool wheel aimed at designers, illustrators, architects, and product teams. Concepts was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer creative application it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or agent surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties along with a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Confidential Computing Consortium
providers.description: The Confidential Computing Consortium (CCC) is a Linux Foundation project that brings together hardware vendors, cloud providers, and software developers to accelerate the adoption of confidential computing.
