The company emerged from stealth in October 2025 and is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital, Greenoaks, Neo, Elad Gil, and others at a reported ~$1.3B valuation. Named customers include DoorDash, Cognition, Harvey, and Mercor.

providers.name: Asepha
providers.description: Asepha is an AI workflow automation platform built specifically for pharmacies, positioning itself as "the context graph for the therapy-start journey" with a stated vision to make medication delays impossible. Its AI agents automate repetitive pharmacy operations across automated prescription data entry, back-office work, 340B management (TPA matching, accruals, purchase-order automation), medication reconciliation (Best Possible Medication History), a conversational voice call assistant, benefits verification and prior-authorization (BV/PA) automation, REMS compliance reporting, and medication therapy review. The company reports outcomes such as a 32% reduction in manual labour cost within one month and tasks completed 4x faster than baseline. Asepha is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and HIPAA compliant, with AES-256 encryption at rest. Founded by CEO Eunice Wu, PharmD and CTO Can Uncu, the company operates from New York, NY and Toronto, ON, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Asepha publishes no public API, developer portal, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Atrandi
providers.description: Atrandi Biosciences (founded 2016 in Lithuania as Droplet Genomics) is a life-sciences tools company building droplet-microfluidic platforms and its patented Semi-Permeable Capsule (SPC) technology for single-cell analysis. SPCs isolate individual cells while letting reagents diffuse freely, enabling complex multi-step single-cell genomics, multiomics, and microbial whole-genome sequencing workflows. Atrandi ships instruments (Flux, Onyx, Styx), application kits, and consumables used by 200+ research groups worldwide. The company is a wet-lab instrumentation and consumables vendor and publishes no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and enriched with verified public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Baby2Body
providers.description: Baby2Body is the flagship consumer wellness app from Body Collective, a female-focused health and wellness company founded by sports psychologist Melinda Nicci. The app delivers personalized fitness, nutrition, and mental-health support across the fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and broader women's-health stages, paired with an AI health coach named Bella, on-demand programs (prenatal fitness, meal plans, labor prep), expert-backed articles, and a stage-specific newsletter. Baby2Body reports over two million users and is backed by 500 Global. This profile has been enriched from the company's public consumer surfaces; no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: BallerTV
providers.description: BallerTV (Baller, Inc.) is a Pasadena, California sports media company that live streams and provides on-demand replays and highlights of youth and amateur sports, including basketball, volleyball, soccer, lacrosse, softball, and football, from thousands of tournaments and showcases nationwide. Subscribers range from families following athletes to NCAA and professional scouts using the footage for recruiting and scouting. The platform includes a Game Finder for locating events, purchasable athlete highlight reels, and BTVision, an AI-powered ball-tracking streaming technology that improves the basketball viewing experience. BallerTV is a consumer streaming product delivered through its website and iOS/Android apps; it does not publish a public developer API or SDK program. This profile was surfaced as an index-ventures portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: Bank OZK
providers.description: Bank OZK is a regional bank headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, tracing its charter to 1903 and today operating roughly 265 offices across Arkansas, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Texas, and New York. It is a state-chartered commercial bank and the wholly owned subsidiary of Bank OZK holding company, publicly traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol OZK, with about $40.8 billion in total assets as of year-end 2025 and a national reputation in commercial real estate lending. Bank OZK runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; it is not a documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participant and has not published a specific CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture. Consumer-permissioned account data is reached only indirectly through third-party aggregators, with Plaid documented as the supporting aggregator. This is an honest identity-only profile with no public API surface.

providers.name: BECU
providers.description: BECU (Boeing Employees' Credit Union) is a member-owned, not-for-profit state-chartered credit union founded in 1935 and headquartered in Tukwila, Washington (NMLS ID 490518). Originally serving Boeing employees, it is today one of the largest credit unions in the United States, offering consumer and business deposit accounts, lending, mortgages, and investment services across the Pacific Northwest and nationally through digital channels. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, BECU exposes no public first-party developer API or developer portal; its digital banking runs on established core and fintech vendors (FIS, LPL/Client Point, ICE/Ellie Mae for mortgage), and consumer-permissioned data access for third-party fintech apps is intermediated through data aggregators rather than a documented, self-serve BECU API. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and no mandated open-banking API contract applies here; the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule is the emerging framework that will shape BECU's future data-access posture.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: Beyond Math
providers.description: BeyondMath is an AI company that has built what it calls the world's first foundational AI model of physics. Its Generative Physics Engine runs full-fidelity, engineering-grade simulations covering fluid, thermal, and structural analysis directly from uploaded geometry, without pre-meshing or preprocessing, and returns results up to 1000x faster than traditional CFD/FEA solvers while generalizing across unseen geometries without retraining. The platform lets engineering teams explore thousands of design variations in minutes rather than months across automotive, aerospace, energy, defense, semiconductor, construction, telecommunications, and electronics. Founded by Alan Patterson (CEO) and Darren Garvey (CTO), the company raised an $18.5M seed round and partners with NVIDIA and AWS. Access is gated behind a waitlist for the Generative Physics Studio; on-premise and private-cloud enterprise deployment is offered. No public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI is published at this time.

providers.name: Boston Heart Diagnostics (Eurofins Scientific)
providers.description: Boston Heart Diagnostics is a specialty cardiovascular diagnostics laboratory, part of Eurofins Scientific, that has been improving patient outcomes since 2007 through a combination of integrated diagnostics, advanced lipid and metabolic testing, genetic risk evaluation, personalized reporting, and a scientifically designed nutrition and lifestyle program. It serves clinicians and patients through a provider portal and a patient portal (mybostonheart.com) rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the identity and security-posture fields below are captured from the provider's public web presence.

providers.name: BridgeU
providers.description: BridgeU is an education technology company providing a university and careers guidance platform for international schools. Used by more than 1,200 partner schools across 150+ countries, the platform helps students from Grade 9 onward explore careers, research over 26,000 global universities, build shortlists, and manage applications in one connected system, with analytics dashboards for counsellors and AI-assisted guidance. BridgeU is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass; integration with school systems (for example ManageBac+) is handled via partner single sign-on rather than an openly documented API.

providers.name: Bristle
providers.description: Bristle (Bristle Health) is a consumer health company that makes the world's first at-home oral microbiome saliva test, helping people measure, understand, and improve their oral health. Customers order a mail-in saliva collection kit, and Bristle sequences the oral microbiome to report on bacteria associated with cavities, gum disease, and bad breath, then pairs the results with guidance and a line of targeted oral-care products including probiotics. Bristle also works with dental professionals who offer microbiome testing to their patients. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted storefront at bristlehealth.com and is backed by Initialized Capital. There is no first-party public developer API; this profile captures Bristle's public web, commercial, and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Briza
providers.description: Briza helps insurance carriers stop losing premium to slow integrations and submission errors, treating carrier API reliability as a manufacturing discipline. A team of Six Sigma Black Belts, Briza applies Kaizen principles to API connectivity across commercial insurance, focusing on submission integrity and moving premium reliably between distributors and carriers. Briza is a 500 Global portfolio company. The team also maintains open-source developer libraries under the briza-insurance GitHub org, including illogical (a JSON DSL rules engine) and wegood (a validation library). Briza does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Bureau of International Labor Affairs
providers.description: ILAB strengthens global labor standards; enforces labor commitments; promotes equity; and combats child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.

providers.name: C the Signs
providers.description: C the Signs is a London-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2016 by Dr Bea Bakshi and Dr Miles Payling, that uses artificial intelligence to help clinicians detect and refer patients at risk of cancer at the earliest, most treatable stage. Registered as an MHRA Class I medical device, its clinical decision support platform analyzes more than 1,000 validated, evidence-based data points across signs, symptoms and risk factors to recommend the right investigations or urgent referrals in under 60 seconds. The platform is used widely across the UK's NHS and health systems, has helped identify over 70,000 patients with cancer across 100+ cancer types at reported 99% sensitivity, and is backed by an $8M Series A investment from Khosla Ventures. It has no public developer API; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Caresense Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: CD Baby
providers.description: CD Baby is an independent music distribution and publishing administration service for songwriters, performers, and independent record labels. Founded in 1998 and now part of Downtown Music Holdings under Virgin Music Group, CD Baby services over 50 million music assets from creators in hundreds of countries across six continents. The platform distributes music to 150+ digital service providers including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Pandora, Tidal, TikTok, Amazon, Shazam, and Deezer, and is a flagship member of YouTube's Preferred Distributor Program plus a preferred partner with Apple and Spotify. Services include digital distribution, physical CD and vinyl manufacturing, publishing administration, cover song licensing, sync licensing through CDB Boost, YouTube and social monetization, performing rights organization (ASCAP, BMI, SOCAN) registration assistance, and promotion tools via SymphonyOS, HearNow, Show.co, Managed Ads, Groover, Laylo, and Internet Radio Airplay. Pricing is a one-time fee ($9.99 single, $14.99 album) with artists retaining over 90% of earnings. CD Baby has paid out more than $1 billion to artists. CD Baby has no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release; all distribution and reporting workflows are exposed only through the artist member portal at members.cdbaby.com.

providers.name: Charlie Finance
providers.description: Charlie (Charlie Finance Co.) was a Pasadena, California fintech company that operated a mobile banking app and debit-card program built specifically for Americans aged 62 and older. Founded in 2021 by Kevin Nazemi, the service offered Social Security deposits paid up to several days early, a FraudShield protection layer tuned to scams that target seniors, 3% high-yield savings, no monthly fees or minimums, a fee-free Allpoint ATM network of 55,000+ machines, custom photo debit cards, and seven-day-a-week human customer support. Charlie is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and raised a $7.5M seed round followed by a $23M Series A. The company discontinued service and permanently closed its debit-card program on January 22, 2026. Charlie is a consumer neobank and does not publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services
providers.description: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services, now operating as CPS Solutions, LLC, is a healthcare company with more than 50 years of experience providing pharmacy and hospital solutions across the care continuum. It serves independent hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and specialized health facilities with specialty pharmacy, pharmacy management, telepharmacy (24/7/365 support), 340B program compliance, supply chain management, rehabilitation services, and consulting. The company operates two proprietary SaaS platforms — CPS Optimizer for pharmacy management and TherigySTM for specialty pharmacy management — supported by 2,500+ healthcare professionals serving 800+ customers across the United States and Puerto Rico. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Comun
providers.description: Comun (Común) is a fintech company providing digital banking and money-transfer services designed for Latino immigrants in the United States. Through a bilingual (Spanish/English) mobile app, users open an FDIC-insured U.S. checking account with a valid national ID and no SSN required, get a Visa debit card, receive early direct deposit up to two days ahead of payday, and send international remittances to 17+ Latin American countries via the app or WhatsApp. Banking services are provided through Community Federal Savings Bank; remittance and P2P rails run on UniTeller and Cross River Bank. Comun is backed by Costanoa Ventures and Redpoint Ventures. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; Comun operates as a consumer neobank and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Covalto
providers.description: Covalto (formerly Credijusto) is a Mexican digital bank for small and medium-sized businesses, headquartered in Mexico City. It offers business and personal checking accounts, fixed-rate investment products, quick working-capital credit (Agil Covalto), factoring, leasing (arrendamiento), and fiduciary trust services (fideicomisos). Covalto acquired a regulated Mexican banking license, making it one of the first fintechs in Mexico to become a fully licensed bank. Its digital surface spans online banking, digital account opening, and a credit application flow. Covalto is backed by QED Investors. As of the latest review it publishes no public API developer portal; its developer documentation at docs.covalto.com is gated behind Google Identity-Aware Proxy for internal use.

providers.name: Crosslend
providers.description: CrossLend is a Berlin-based fintech providing digital debt technology for the private lending and securitisation space. Its platform offers Portfolio Analytics for loan-level data validation, granular portfolio insights and automated reporting, and Securitisation-as-a-Service that digitises and automates the issuance of financial instruments, including SPV setup, legal and compliance frameworks and audit-proof reporting. CrossLend serves banks, asset managers and institutional lenders across Europe, and is backed by Earlybird and Northzone. The company exposes no public developer API surface today; this profile tracks its identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Crossoverhealth
providers.description: Crossover Health is an advanced primary care provider that delivers integrated, team-based healthcare for employers and their members through its proprietary Care Platform. Its services span primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation, and occupational medicine, delivered through on-site and near-site health centers and a 50-state virtual provider network. Crossover Health is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been found on its web properties.

providers.name: Deposco
providers.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

providers.name: Descomplica
providers.description: Descomplica is a Brazilian online education (edtech) company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, offering a digital learning platform for ENEM and vestibular exam prep, K-12 (Escolar), undergraduate and graduate (Pós-graduação) degrees, public-exam (Concursos) preparation, and corporate training. The platform delivers live and recorded classes, study plans, tutoring, exercises, and support materials to millions of Brazilian students, and is MEC-authorized. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; the company operates consumer and corporate learning products but does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Duetto Research
providers.description: Duetto Research is a hospitality technology company whose cloud platform, marketed as Duetto, delivers a Revenue & Profit Operating System (RP-OS) for hotels, casinos, and resorts. The platform pairs real-time dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, group and block business management, and profitability benchmarking so revenue teams can optimize rates and total property profit across more than 20,000 properties in over 100 countries. Its marquee products include GameChanger (dynamic pricing and rate optimization), ScoreBoard (forecasting and reporting), BlockBuster (group business), Advance (AI-driven rate recommendations), GameTime (select-service revenue management), and HotStats (profitability benchmarking). Duetto connects with the property management systems, booking engines, and channel managers hotels already use through a large partner-integration ecosystem rather than a self-serve public developer API. Backed by Battery Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Enable
providers.description: Enable Medicine is a healthcare and life-sciences data company that licenses an integrated, AI-ready index of clinical, spatial, cellular, and molecular data. Its research platform helps biopharma companies, academic institutions, and healthcare providers run spatial-biology analysis — spatial proteomics, cell phenotyping, tumor-microenvironment characterization, immune profiling, and biomarker identification — across 20+ disease areas over harmonized datasets spanning 10M+ patients and 125M+ cells. The platform is delivered through a login-gated web application at app.enablemedicine.com; no public developer API is currently documented. Backed by initialized-capital, insight-partners, lightspeed-venture-partners, menlo-ventures, norwest-venture-partners, and sierra-ventures.

providers.name: Entera
providers.description: Entera is an AI-powered SaaS and services platform for single-family rental (SFR) real estate investing, describing itself as the operating system for single-family real estate. It helps operators, funds, new-construction companies, agents, and service partners buy, sell, and operate homes at scale across 34+ U.S. residential markets. The platform spans acquisitions (asset discovery, underwriting, diligence coordination), dispositions (pricing, buyer targeting, offer management), transaction enablement, market data and intelligence, and expert brokerage services. Entera is backed by investors including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and Bullpen Capital. As of this enrichment pass Entera exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI/SDK surface; this profile captures its published company, legal, and brand properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: EquityZen
providers.description: EquityZen is a New York-based financial technology platform and marketplace for investing in shares of private, late-stage, venture-backed companies before they IPO. Founded in 2013, it connects accredited investors seeking access to pre-IPO equity with employees and early shareholders of private companies who are looking for liquidity, transacting through EquityZen-managed funds and secondary-market share sales. The platform handles the sourcing, legal, and administrative work of private-company share transfers. EquityZen publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: eSpark
providers.description: eSpark is a K-5 adaptive learning platform that extends a district's core reading and math programs with differentiated, standards-aligned practice in reading, math, and writing. The platform uses adaptive lesson sequencing that adjusts difficulty to each student's performance, interest-based content, and real-time feedback to deliver personalized instruction, and it reports back to teachers and administrators on student progress. eSpark serves 10,000+ schools and districts nationwide and rosters students through Clever, ClassLink, Google Classroom, and QR-code sign-in. eSpark was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, so this profile captures company identity, its public web properties, and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Estateguru
providers.description: Estateguru is a pan-European property-backed crowdfunding and P2P lending platform headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia. Founded in 2013, it connects retail and institutional investors with short-to-medium-term business loans secured by registered mortgages on real estate, operating across Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Finland, Germany, Spain and Portugal. The platform has facilitated over EUR 935 million in funding for 150,000+ investors from more than 100 countries and holds an EU ECSPR crowdservice-provider licence. Estateguru operates as a consumer investment product through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or agent surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Speedinvest and enriched with its genuinely published company link properties.

providers.name: Fay
providers.description: Fay (Fay Health, Inc.) is a digital-health marketplace that connects members with registered dietitians and nutritionists and handles the insurance billing so nutrition counseling is covered — often at little or no out-of-pocket cost. The platform offers telehealth consultations, personalized meal planning, and support for chronic condition management, backed by iOS and Android apps and a member help center. Fay reports 4,000+ registered dietitians, 700+ accepted insurance plans, and 100,000+ members. It is backed by Forerunner Ventures and General Catalyst and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; Fay publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Ferra
providers.description: Ferra is a smart home strength-training system for adults aged 50 and over, built by Aroleap Fitness Private Limited in Bengaluru, India. It pairs a compact wall-mounted adaptive-resistance machine with a mobile app that queues a short guided daily workout of seven functional movements, adapts the weight in real time, tracks progress, and lets users share achievements with family. The service is sold as a no-lock-in monthly subscription (Individual, Duo, and Family tiers) billed through UPI auto-debit. Ferra is a consumer product with no public developer platform or API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Fidocure
providers.description: FidoCure is a translational precision-medicine service for canine cancer, developed by One Health Company and backed by a16z. It combines next-generation genomic sequencing of a dog's tumor at a CLIA-certified (human-grade) lab with tumor profiling and an AI-driven data platform to identify cancer-driving mutations, then recommends personalized targeted therapeutics that veterinarians can prescribe. FidoCure has guided treatment for thousands of dogs across roughly 1,350 clinics and maintains the largest proprietary canine cancer dataset, underpinning peer-reviewed research with Stanford, the Broad Institute, Tufts, and the University of Georgia. FidoCure operates as a veterinarian-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, portal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: FLORA
providers.description: FLORA is a Brooklyn, New York-based applied AI / HCI company building a browser-based "infinite canvas" creative workspace for professional creators. Founded in 2024 by Weber Wong out of NYU's Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP), FLORA unifies 50+ third-party text, image, and video AI models inside a single node-based visual workspace where designers, filmmakers, photographers, and creative agencies wire prompts, references, characters, and outputs into reusable generative workflows. The platform integrates leading image models (FLUX.2, FLUX Kontext, Stable Diffusion 3.5, Nano Banana, Recraft, Seedream, Minimax Hailuo) and video models (Veo 3, Sora 2, Runway Gen-4 Turbo / Gen-3 Alpha / Act-Two, Pika, Kling, Luma Ray 2, Seedance, Marey) alongside reasoning models such as Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-5.4, and ships a creative agent named FAUNA for ideation, iteration, and workflow scaffolding. FLORA is used at agencies and studios including Pentagram, Milk, and MSCHF; the company raised a $6.5M seed led by Mike Volpi at Hanabi Capital with Menlo Ventures, a16z Games Speedrun, Long Journey Ventures, Company Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Embedding VC, and angels including Justin Kan (Twitch) and Gabe Whaley (MSCHF), and operates in-person from the Domino Refinery in Williamsburg. The product is sold direct to creative professionals via a free tier and paid subscription (Pro from ~$16/month); there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release — FLORA's surface area is the in-app canvas and FAUNA agent, with model access mediated by the platform rather than exposed to third-party developers.

providers.name: Focused Space, Inc.
providers.description: Focused Space, Inc. operates focused.space, a consumer productivity platform built around "body doubling" — a neuroscience-backed technique where people work silently alongside others to more easily enter and sustain a flow state. The service combines 100+ weekly live sessions hosted by real humans (available 24/7) with a custom focus-video platform, a goal-setting and task-tracking app, and a community aimed at creatives, builders, remote workers, and people with ADHD. Focused Space is a 500 Global (and E14 Fund) portfolio company. It ships web, iOS, and Android apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Folx Health
providers.description: FOLX Health is a virtual healthcare platform built for and by the LGBTQIA+ community, delivering clinician-led care through a predominantly queer and trans network of providers. Its consumer services span gender-affirming hormone therapy (HRT), PrEP and sexual & reproductive health, primary care, mental health and therapy, and fertility and family building, plus care navigation, a peer community platform, and secure provider messaging. Members access care through the web and iOS/Android apps with same or next-day appointments and insurance acceptance. FOLX is a direct-to-consumer digital health company and, as of this profile, does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This entry was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Foodsmart
providers.description: Foodsmart is a telenutrition company that pairs the nation's largest network of registered dietitians with a digital food-benefits platform, delivering personalized nutrition care via telehealth to more than three million members. The company partners with health plans and employers to reach Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial members, combining one-on-one dietitian counseling with meal planning, grocery ordering, and SNAP benefits enrollment. Foodsmart's "Foodscription" model connects clinical nutrition guidance to affordable, healthy food access to improve outcomes and lower the cost of diet-related chronic disease. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Foodsmart exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Gankster
providers.description: Gankster is a consumer competitive-gaming social platform — a web and mobile "looking for group" (LFG) network that helps players team up, practice, and compete across titles including Valorant, League of Legends, Dota 2, Counter-Strike 2, Rocket League, Fortnite, and World of Warcraft. It matches players by rank, playstyle, and reputation to find duos, five-stacks, and fill players, and lets teams organize scrims, tournaments, and recruitment. Gankster operates entirely outside the game client (no overlays or client modifications) and ships the Gankster Duos mobile app on iOS and Android. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and raised $4.25M for its all-in-one competitive gaming platform. Gankster does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Goin
providers.description: Goin is a European consumer fintech platform, backed by Anthemis and based in Barcelona, Spain, that helps more than 700,000 users across Europe grow their money and spend less. The app bundles automated savings (fixed daily, weekly or monthly rules and goal-based portfolios), investing, buying and selling of cryptocurrencies, cashback and rewards at hundreds of online and physical stores, gift cards and coupons, and a browser extension that surfaces discounts while shopping. Bank accounts are connected securely under Europe's PSD2 open banking regulation, and a referral program rewards users for inviting friends. Goin is a business-to-consumer mobile product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks Goin as a portfolio lead and captures its public web, help, and legal presence.

providers.name: Goldbelly
providers.description: Goldbelly is a curated online marketplace for gourmet food and food gifts, shipping America's most iconic and legendary regional foods, restaurant dishes, and desserts nationwide directly to consumers' doors. The platform connects hundreds of independent restaurants, bakeries, food artisans, and specialty makers with customers through a consumer e-commerce storefront, gift and corporate-gifting programs, subscriptions, and gift cards. Goldbelly is a consumer marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, help, seller, and policy surfaces. Backed by Y Combinator.

providers.name: Greator
providers.description: Greator (formerly GEDANKENtanken, founded 2012) is Germany's largest personal- development platform, headquartered in Cologne and serving roughly 234,000 customers. It runs a B2C ecosystem of free content (masterclasses, podcasts, a YouTube channel, magazine articles and personality tests) alongside paid, certified training programs such as The School of Life, Momentum Mastery, the Finance Academy and TheKey speaking training. Greator also produces live events including the annual Greator Festival (15,000+ attendees, 400+ speakers) and operates Greator Business, a B2B corporate offering. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Greator publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Guidelight Health
providers.description: Guidelight Health is a mental healthcare provider delivering evidence-based day treatment programs — Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHPs) and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOPs) — for people managing anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, and personality disorders. Care combines group therapy, individual psychotherapy, and medication management, offered in-person and virtually across Colorado, California, Massachusetts, North Carolina, and Washington. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company operates a patient-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; its client portal runs on the third-party Kipu (kipuworks.com) EHR platform, so there is no first-party API, SDK, or developer surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Harmonycares
providers.description: HarmonyCares is a physician-led, value-based, in-home primary care organization headquartered in Troy, Michigan, and one of the nation's largest house-call practices. It brings primary care, palliative care, and ancillary services such as in-home laboratory, radiology, and comprehensive health assessments directly to older adults living with serious and complex chronic conditions. Operating across roughly a dozen states, HarmonyCares supports more than 70,000 patients through value-based arrangements with Medicare Advantage plans and Medicare ACO programs. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a General Catalyst portfolio company; it publishes a public marketing site, a patient portal, and corporate policy documents, but no public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Heartbeat Health
providers.description: Heartbeat Health is a New York-based modern cardiology practice delivering remote and virtual cardiovascular care. The company combines early detection, home-based cardiac diagnostics, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification and evidence-based care coordination to proactively identify, treat and manage moderate-to-high cardiovascular risk. It serves hospitals and health systems, payors and employer groups, providers and ACOs, and in-home care providers, reporting outcomes such as 90%+ of patients reaching target blood pressure and a 53% reduction in cardiac readmissions. Backed by Optum Ventures, DaVita Venture Group and Echo Health Ventures, it is a care-delivery organization rather than a public API provider; no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: Inspire
providers.description: Inspire (Inspire Clean Energy) is a consumer clean-energy company on a mission to transform the way people access clean energy and accelerate a net-zero carbon future. It gives residential customers access to renewable energy for their home electricity supply through flat-rate subscription plans designed to deliver predictability and reduce exposure to electricity rate volatility. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface — this is a non-API consumer brand.

providers.name: Jaipur Robotics
providers.description: Jaipur Robotics is a Manno, Switzerland based deep-tech company building advanced computer vision and deep learning solutions for the waste-to-energy sector. Its product, Jaipur Intelligence, applies patent-pending image recognition to plant bunkers and truck unloading bays to detect oversized and dangerous items, map the calorific value (LHV) of incoming waste in real time, and track crane operations — helping operators cut emissions, improve waste mixing and combustion stability, and minimize unplanned shutdowns. The company operates a gated customer application at app.jaipurrobotics.com and is backed by Techstars, Innosuisse, Venture Kick, CSEM and others. It currently publishes a marketing site and a customer login only; there is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Joyful
providers.description: Joyful Health provides AI-assisted revenue recovery for healthcare organizations, combining automated claim investigation with expert billing teams to recover unpaid and denied insurance claims. Its platform runs inside an organization's existing revenue-cycle-management (RCM) systems rather than replacing them, covering denial investigation and root-cause analysis, claims recovery and appeals management, historical accounts-receivable (A/R) assessment, payer follow-up, documentation review, and financial insight to prevent future denials. The company operates a customer application at app.joyfulhealth.io and maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center. Joyful is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; Joyful does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: jQuery
providers.description: jQuery is a fast, small, and feature-rich JavaScript library that makes HTML document traversal and manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax much simpler with an easy-to-use API that works across a multitude of browsers. Only about 30kB minified and gzipped, available as an AMD module, and CSS3 compliant. jQuery 4.0 is the current release; jQuery 3.x receives critical updates only.

providers.name: Kriptos
providers.description: Kriptos is an AI-driven unstructured data security platform that automatically discovers, classifies, and labels documents across endpoints, servers, and cloud storage, then feeds that business and risk context into the DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, and IAM tooling an organization already runs rather than replacing it. The platform spans data discovery and classification, data compliance and risk management, data access governance across Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, insider threat management with UEBA, DSPM, and AI governance covering shadow-AI monitoring for tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini. Classification results are written back as native Microsoft Purview and Google Drive labels. Founded in Ecuador and backed by Techstars, Kriptos reports more than 1.2 billion documents classified for over 150,000 users, with customers concentrated in banking, insurance, healthcare, and utilities across Latin America. Kriptos is a sales-led product and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: Lumosity
providers.description: Lumosity is a consumer brain-training platform built by Lumos Labs that offers cognitive games and personalized daily workouts targeting memory, attention, problem solving, flexibility, and processing speed. The service adapts difficulty to individual performance, tracks progress over time, and is delivered through the web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the company was surfaced through VC-portfolio discovery; probing its public surface found no developer portal, public API, or documented programmatic integration — it is a direct-to-consumer product with no API surface at this time.

providers.name: M7 Health
providers.description: M7 Health is an AI-powered workforce operations platform for healthcare, focused on nurse scheduling and labor optimization. The platform forecasts staffing demand, auto-balances schedules, fills open shifts, and deploys staff to close coverage gaps while reducing premium labor spend, administrative burden, and nurse turnover across hospitals and health systems. Surfaced as a portfolio company of threshold-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer or API surface was found — the product is delivered as an enterprise SaaS engaged via a sales demo.

providers.name: Magic Moment
providers.description: Magic Moment is a Tokyo-based AI sales-automation company whose platform captures real business facts from deals, emails, and calls and turns them into actionable insight for sales forecasting and execution. Its flagship products — Magic Moment Playbook and Playbook Capture — layer AI over existing CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot) through no-code bidirectional sync, plus a Revenue Platform performance model and the Magic Moment X managed service. The company is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. It does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; CRM integration is delivered as no-code sync rather than a documented API.

providers.name: Manex AI
providers.description: Manex AI (Manex AI GmbH) is a European enterprise AI company that builds Kosmos, an Autonomous Enterprise AI Platform for industrial and manufacturing OEMs and their suppliers. Kosmos models the domains a business runs on and lets AI agents, workflows, and applications act on full enterprise context instead of fragments. On top of Kosmos, Manex ships purpose-built autonomous suites: Blackbelt (computer-aided quality / CAQ), Takt (manufacturing execution / MES), and Gemba (shopfloor operations), plus Horizon, a distribution platform that makes a solution built at one site instantly available to every other. Manex serves aerospace, automotive, chemistry, electronics, semiconductors, pharma and biotech, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and home-appliance manufacturers. Made in Europe and built for the strictest compliance standards, the platform runs in cloud, on-premise, or hybrid environments with customer-controlled data residency, GDPR options, ISO 27001 and TISAX certification, enterprise access control, and full audit history. Manex AI is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: Marley Spoon
providers.description: Marley Spoon is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and grocery company that delivers weekly recipe boxes with pre-portioned ingredients to households, operating the Marley Spoon and Dinnerly brands across markets in the United States, Australia, and Europe. It runs a consumer web and mobile storefront for menu selection, subscription management, and delivery; there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. The company's public GitHub organization hosts only a few internal Ruby infrastructure forks (no client SDKs or specs). Enrichment surfaced no API surface: no /.well-known discovery documents, no security.txt, and no llms.txt. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead and remains a company stub with security/identity signals probed rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Medely
providers.description: Medely is a healthcare workforce orchestration platform and staffing marketplace that connects healthcare facilities with a network of qualified nurses and allied health professionals. What began as a marketplace to match facilities with per-diem talent has grown into a full workforce management platform, helping hospitals, surgery centers, skilled nursing facilities, and other providers fill open and per-diem shifts, support their core clinical teams, and maintain high-quality patient care. Medely offers credentialing, scheduling, and flexible workforce management tools, and holds the Joint Commission's Gold Seal of Approval for its staffing services. The company is backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital. Medely does not currently operate a public developer program or documented API; its GraphQL backend at api.medely.com powers the first-party web and mobile applications only.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mobilize
providers.description: Mobilize (mobilize.io) is a community and learning software platform purpose-built for associations and professional networks, now operating under the Forj brand (forj.ai). The platform unifies member community and continuing education in one place through its products Forj Connect (peer-to-peer and group member communication), Forj Learn (a learning management system for continuing education, certification, and social learning), and Journey by Forj (a combined community-and-learning experience). Mobilize was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a member/admin web application (app.mobilize.io) and a Zendesk help center but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, so this profile carries verified company identity and link properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Motivo
providers.description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations. It connects pre-licensed and post-graduate mental health professionals with 1,500+ vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states, enabling organizations to expand their workforce, reduce burnout, and meet licensure requirements. The fully-managed platform handles supervisor vetting, compliance and documentation, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video sessions, and payment processing, and includes group supervision, peer consultation, webinars, and workforce-development resources. Motivo serves behavioral health centers, treatment facilities, health plans, and digital health companies. As of this profile Motivo publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its platform is delivered as a managed SaaS product and it consumes third-party APIs (e.g. Google Calendar) internally.

providers.name: myLaurel
providers.description: myLaurel is a New York-based healthcare company delivering acute and transitional care in patients' homes. Its hybrid model pairs hands-on clinical teams with virtual technology support to prevent unnecessary hospitalizations, free critical hospital bed space, improve patient outcomes, and lower the total cost of care for both health systems and health plans. Reported results include a 49% reduction in 30-day readmissions, an average 1.5-day length-of-stay reduction, a 97 Net Promoter Score, and 3:1+ ROI within 90 days. myLaurel is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile has been enriched from the company's public web surface; it currently exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: Naborforce
providers.description: Naborforce is an on-demand home care and companionship platform that connects older adults with vetted, friendly local helpers called "Nabors" for non-medical assistance such as errands, rides to appointments, meal preparation, light housekeeping, technology help, and social companionship. Families and older adults book help on demand through the Naborforce website and iOS/Android apps on a pay-as-you-go basis with no long-term contracts. Naborforce is a Techstars-backed company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass Naborforce operates as a consumer-facing (B2C) service and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Nave Bank
providers.description: Nave Bank is a digital-first business bank based in Puerto Rico, offering FDIC-insured deposit accounts, business savings, and business loans through an easy-to-navigate online and mobile banking platform. Its product surface centers on business checking ("Cuenta Nave Business"), interest-bearing savings, real-time payments, ACH and wire transfers, and mobile check deposit, with a bilingual (Spanish/English) experience and human customer support. Nave was surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Nave Bank publishes a consumer/business banking website and help center but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Om1
providers.description: OM1 is an AI-powered healthcare analytics and real-world data company that generates real-world evidence from clinical, EMR, and claims data. Its PhenOM foundation model is trained on billions of patient-years to identify patient phenotypes, accelerate diagnosis, and predict future medical events, risks, and responses to treatment. OM1 delivers clinical registries, automated observational studies, patient-finding and outcomes-prediction solutions, and curated real-world datasets covering hundreds of millions of patients to life sciences, biopharma, payer, and provider organizations. OM1 does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation surface.

providers.name: Ontruck
providers.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe. Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: OWASP
providers.description: The Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) is a nonprofit foundation that works to improve the security of software through community-led open source projects, hundreds of chapters worldwide, and educational resources. OWASP does not provide a centralized public API, but maintains many open source projects, standards (such as the OWASP Top 10 and ASVS), and tools (such as ZAP) that include APIs.

providers.name: OZON.ru
providers.description: OZON is one of Russia's largest e-commerce marketplaces, offering retail across electronics, apparel, groceries, and more, plus its own logistics and fulfillment network (FBO/FBS). For developers, OZON exposes the OZON Seller API, a POST-based RPC-over-HTTP JSON API at https://api-seller.ozon.ru that lets marketplace sellers manage products, prices, stock, warehouses, orders, returns, analytics, and finances programmatically. Authentication uses two headers, a numeric Client-Id and a secret Api-Key issued in the seller cabinet. OZON was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from live probes of its API host and public developer documentation.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Parallel Learning
providers.description: Parallel Learning is a special education services and staffing platform that connects K-12 schools and districts with a nationwide network of licensed clinicians for the remote delivery of specialized student support. Through its proprietary, HIPAA/FERPA-compliant Pathway platform it delivers virtual psychoeducational and neurodevelopmental assessments, speech-language therapy, behavioral and mental-health counseling, specialized instruction in reading, writing, and math, and executive-function coaching, pairing secure teletherapy with progress tracking and clinical oversight so districts can meet compliance requirements and improve student outcomes. The company serves thousands of students across dozens of states and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PeopleOne Health
providers.description: PeopleOne Health is a nationwide provider of value-based, employer-funded advanced primary care, delivering comprehensive physical and mental health services with no copays, deductibles, or coinsurance for members. Its model pairs dedicated care teams with a prevention-first approach to lower total cost of care for self-funded employers while improving member health outcomes, and it was named a 2024 Best Nationwide Primary Care Provider by the Validation Institute. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, PeopleOne Health operates as a healthcare services provider rather than an API platform: member access is delivered through a healow-based patient portal and a member portal, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Phil
providers.description: PHIL (PHILRx) is a healthtech company operating a digital hub and direct-to-patient platform that helps pharmaceutical brands maximize prescription starts, insurance coverage, affordability, and medication adherence. Its all-in-one platform connects pharma manufacturers, patients, and healthcare providers to streamline the prescription access experience, run affordable direct-to-patient and cash-pay programs, and improve commercial performance across the medication access journey. PHIL is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Plenna
providers.description: Plenna is a women's healthcare provider operating a network of integrated medical clinics across Mexico City, redefining health for women across every life stage. Its services span gynecology, maternity and prenatal care, fertility, menopause, contraception, gynecological surgery, psychology, nutrition, laboratory studies, vaccines and lactation support, delivered across six physical clinics (Tlalpan, Coapa, Del Valle, Polanco, San Angel and Satelite) and through Portal Plenna, a patient portal and iOS/Android mobile app for scheduling appointments, virtual consultations, test results, prescriptions and pregnancy tracking. Plenna is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Popular (Banco Popular)
providers.description: Popular, Inc. (NASDAQ: BPOP), operating as Banco Popular, is a publicly traded financial holding company founded in 1893 and headquartered in Hato Rey, San Juan, Puerto Rico. It is the largest bank in Puerto Rico and operates through two chartered depository segments: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico (BPPR), serving Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Popular Bank (formerly Banco Popular North America), a New York state-chartered commercial bank serving mainland U.S. markets including New York, New Jersey, and Florida. Popular is FDIC-insured and regulated as a U.S. bank holding company. On its open-finance and API posture, Popular does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications for its U.S. institutions (popular.com); consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available indirectly through third-party data aggregators such as Plaid, Tink, and Finicity rather than a direct bank API. This identity record reflects that honest reality — an aggregator-only access model with no documented first-party API surface, FDX membership, or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access program. (Note: the separate apiportal.popularenlinea.com open-banking portal belongs to Banco Popular Dominicano / Grupo Popular, a distinct Dominican Republic company, not to Popular, Inc.)

providers.name: Porter Airlines
providers.description: Porter Airlines is a Canadian carrier headquartered in Toronto, operating as Porter Airlines (Canada) Limited and Porter Airlines Inc. under IATA designator PD, IATA ticketing plate 451, and ICAO code POE. It is the challenger to the Air Canada / WestJet duopoly in Canada, flying an Embraer E195-E2 and De Havilland Dash 8 fleet across domestic, transborder and sun destinations, and it joined IATA as a member in 2026 following IOSA certification. Porter sits in the distribution chain as a conventional GDS-intermediated carrier: agencies reach its inventory through the GDSs (Sabre is named explicitly in Porter's agency terms, and Travelport is the channel Duffel uses to resell Porter content) or through Porter's own ticketless Travel Agency Portal on flyporter.com. Porter's API posture is honestly stated as none-published. There is no developer portal, no public or partner API documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC endpoint of any kind. The developer, developers and apis subdomains do not resolve; api.flyporter.com resolves but does not answer on 80 or 443; docs.flyporter.com redirects to an internal Google Drive. Every well-known spec path returns 404 and the whole site sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge with ai-train=no content signals. Access is accreditation-gated: an agency must hold ARC accreditation or an IATA Passenger Sales Agency Agreement, register on flyporter.com, and accept Porter's Agency Terms and Conditions, which assert Porter ownership of all Porter Data, prohibit scraping and redistribution, and revoke all data rights the moment an appointment is suspended or terminated. There is no exit path beyond a written PIPEDA access request to Porter's Privacy Officer.

providers.name: PortF
providers.description: PortF is an AI-powered portfolio monitoring platform for private equity, venture capital, and institutional investors. It automates investment data collection and reporting by extracting qualitative and quantitative data from emails, documents, and 25+ connected systems (Excel, OneDrive, SharePoint, SSO, Salesforce, FIS Global, Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and NetSuite), then consolidates financial, ESG, and impact data into a single source of truth with real-time analytics, IRR benchmarking, and agentic reporting workflows. Founded by Alex Lu and headquartered in London, PortF is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Poshmark
providers.description: Poshmark is a social commerce marketplace where people in the US, Canada, Australia and India buy and sell new and secondhand fashion, accessories, home goods, beauty products, and electronics. Sellers list items from their closets, share and cross-promote listings across the community, host live selling shows, and ship using prepaid labels while Poshmark handles payments and buyer protection. Founded 2011, IPO 2021, acquired by Naver in 2023. Poshmark runs a consumer web and mobile marketplace backed by internal APIs but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PowerReviews
providers.description: PowerReviews provides ratings and reviews software and APIs for collecting, syndicating, and displaying user-generated reviews, questions, and answers to help shoppers make better purchase decisions and drive e-commerce conversion. The platform supports product catalog, review submission, display, and analytics use cases.

providers.name: Produce Pay
providers.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Provide
providers.description: Provide is a financial services division of Fifth Third Bank offering banking and financing built specifically for owners of professional practices — dental, medical, veterinary, optometry, childcare, financial advisory, funeral, and insurance businesses. The company provides conventional and SBA loans to start, acquire, or expand a practice, alongside a full suite of customized banking products. Provide was acquired by Fifth Third Bank and operates as a specialty lending and banking brand. Surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Qventus
providers.description: Qventus is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered automation platform for hospital operations. Its "AI teammates" combine machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to streamline care-coordination workflows across surgical growth and operating-room utilization, perioperative and pre-admission-testing coordination, inpatient capacity and discharge planning, and care-gap and coding automation. Qventus sells to health systems and hospitals as a B2B SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Mayfield, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Radish Health
providers.description: Radish Health is a healthcare company that provides employers with a modern employee health benefit, pairing each member with a dedicated care team and physicians who handle medical issues directly or coordinate specialist referrals. The service emphasizes direct-access primary care over phone, video, and in-person visits, with rapid response times and appointment coordination aimed at reducing employer healthcare costs while improving the patient experience. Radish Health is delivered through patient-facing web and mobile apps (iOS and Android) and an employer benefits program; it is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Radish Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation — this profile captures its identity, legal/support surfaces, and domain security posture only.

providers.name: RadixArk
providers.description: RadixArk is a deep-tech AI-infrastructure company on a mission to make frontier-level AI infrastructure open and accessible to everyone ("Build AI for all"). Backed by a $100M seed round announced in May 2026, RadixArk builds open-source infrastructure and managed tooling for training and serving modern AI models at scale. Its flagship open-source projects are SGLang, a fast and flexible inference/serving engine for large language and vision-language models, and Miles, an enterprise-facing reinforcement-learning framework for LLM and VLM post-training (with a companion Miles Diffusion framework for large-scale diffusion training). RadixArk also operates a managed platform at platform.radixark.com serving developers, enterprises, and research labs. The company does not yet expose a public REST/HTTP API; this profile captures its open-source packages, identity, and security posture pending an API surface.

providers.name: RangeForce
providers.description: RangeForce is a cloud-based cyber range and hands-on cybersecurity training platform that helps organizations build, measure, and validate the defensive skills of their security teams. Through browser-based, real-tool exercises and simulated attack scenarios, RangeForce lets blue teams practice detection, incident response, and threat hunting in realistic environments and benchmark individual and team readiness. Founded in Estonia and backed by Techstars, the company serves enterprises, government agencies, and managed security service providers. RangeForce does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference.

providers.name: Refyne
providers.description: Refyne is an Indian financial wellness platform and the country's first earned wage access (EWA) provider, letting employees draw a portion of their already-earned salary before payday at 0% interest through their employer's payroll. Founded in 2020 and backed by QED Investors, Refyne serves 500+ organizations across 23 industries and more than 8 million employees, and operates additional products including RuPay credit cards, the MoneyGuru financial-literacy service, and an employee privilege/discount club. The company operates under RBI compliance and holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications. Refyne is primarily a B2B2C mobile and payroll-integrated platform and does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: RenoFi
providers.description: RenoFi is a home-renovation financing platform that partners with credit unions and lenders to offer renovation-specific loans underwritten against a home's projected after-renovation value (ARV) rather than its current equity, letting homeowners borrow significantly more without refinancing their first mortgage. RenoFi is not itself a lender: it originates and prepares applications, performs renovation underwriting, and connects homeowners, contractors, realtors, and credit-union partners to its lending network for RenoFi Home Equity Loans and HELOCs. The company maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source Ruby infrastructure libraries (GraphQL and Salesforce tooling) but publishes no public product API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal.

providers.name: Revivn
providers.description: Revivn provides an integrated hardware lifecycle platform for managing end-of-life IT equipment. The company handles secure device pickup, certified data sanitization and destruction, and redistribution of usable hardware to underserved communities through nonprofit partnerships.
