This is a B2B SaaS product with a private, authenticated product API (api.adonis.io) and a customer app (app.adonis.io); it does not currently operate a public developer program, OpenAPI documentation, or API portal.

providers.name: Universal Electronics
providers.description: Universal Electronics Inc. (UEI) is a global leader in universal control and sensing technologies for the smart home, known for its QuickSet software platform, UEI TIDE smart thermostats and sensors, the Nevo white-label control platform, and the One For All retail remote-control brand. QuickSet Cloud provides device discovery, interoperability, and entertainment control via a device knowledge graph spanning roughly one million devices across 12,000 brands, with web APIs and native SDKs (Linux, Android, RDK, Android TV) offered to OEM and service-provider partners through a gated developer portal at developer.quicksetcloud.com. Surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company; UEI publishes no public self-serve API.

providers.name: Ursa Major Technologies
providers.description: Ursa Major Technologies Inc. is an American aerospace and defense propulsion manufacturer founded in 2015 by Joe Laurienti, a former SpaceX and Blue Origin propulsion engineer, and headquartered at 19750 Co Rd 7 in Berthoud, Colorado, with additive manufacturing operations in Youngstown, Ohio. The company designs, builds and hot-fire tests liquid rocket engines, solid rocket motors and in-space propulsion systems for space launch, hypersonics and U.S. and allied defense customers. Its product line includes the 5,000 lbf Hadley oxygen-rich staged-combustion liquid engine — the first Ursa Major engine to reach flight qualification for hypersonic missions — and Draper, a storable, throttleable, restartable engine for tactical hypersonic strike, missile defense and rapid in-space maneuver, alongside a solid rocket motor line validated through static fire and a chemical propulsion capability for tactical satellite bus systems. Ursa Major was the first American company to successfully fire an oxygen-rich staged combustion engine; it states it has delivered more than 100 engines and logged over 100,000 seconds of hotfire testing, with engines and motors more than 80 percent 3D printed by mass. The company is AS9100D, ISO 9001 and CMMC Level 2 certified. Ursa Major is a hardware manufacturer selling to government and prime-contractor customers: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, developer portal or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: wacai
providers.description: Wacai (挖财, Hangzhou Wacai Network Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fintech and personal-finance company founded in 2009, best known for its "挖财记账" personal accounting and bookkeeping app and its internet wealth-management platform. Beyond its consumer apps, Wacai operates a partner-facing open API gateway (挖财开放平台) at open.wacai.com that exposes services through a single JSON-over-HTTPS entry point using appKey/appSecret signed requests, with official client SDKs published for Java (Maven Central), Node.js, PHP, Go, and C#. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Walker & Co.
providers.description: Walker & Company Brands is a health and beauty products company founded in 2013 by Tristan Walker, best known for Bevel, an end-to-end shaving and grooming system designed for people of color, and for the Form hair-care line. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and others, the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2018 and now operates as a consumer brand whose direct-to-consumer storefront runs on Shopify at getbevel.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company with no first-party developer API program; it was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio lead. This profile captures its real public web surface (storefront, security.txt, well-known documents, P&G legal and vulnerability-disclosure programs) rather than an API product.

providers.name: Westlake Chemical
providers.description: Westlake Chemical (now Westlake Corporation) is a global manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, building products, and specialty chemicals. The company produces ethylene, polyethylene, PVC, chlor-alkali, epoxy resins, and fabricated building products serving packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction markets worldwide.

providers.name: Yazaki
providers.description: Yazaki Corporation is a Japanese global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Tokyo. Yazaki is a leading manufacturer of automotive wiring harnesses, connectors, instrumentation, and electrical distribution systems for global automakers.

providers.name: ZF Friedrichshafen
providers.description: ZF Friedrichshafen AG is a German global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Friedrichshafen. ZF designs and manufactures driveline, chassis, active and passive safety, and ADAS technology for passenger cars and commercial vehicles. ZF acquired TRW Automotive in 2015.

providers.name: Aboon
providers.description: Aboon is a digital 401(k) retirement-plan platform and third-party administrator (TPA) that helps financial advisors and employers design, launch, and manage workplace retirement plans. It pairs AI-powered workflows with dedicated human plan consultants to generate customized 401(k) proposals in minutes, streamline recordkeeper onboarding, handle digital plan contracting and census intake, and run ongoing compliance testing and Form 3(16) administration. Aboon markets partnerships with major recordkeepers (American Funds, Empower, John Hancock, and others) and serves a network of advisors nationwide. It is a fintech company backed by Bain Capital Ventures. No public developer/API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Accolade
providers.description: Accolade is a personalized healthcare and benefits navigation platform for employers and health plans. It pairs members with a care team of advocates, registered nurses, physicians, and mental-health specialists to help them understand their benefits, find in-network care, book appointments, and manage chronic and complex conditions. Accolade combines this human advocacy with virtual primary care, expert medical opinion, and mental-health services delivered through its member web and mobile apps. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Accolade is a member-facing benefits platform and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Alinea Health
providers.description: Alinea Health is an AI-powered clinical trial recruitment intelligence platform that analyzes global trial registry data (ClinicalTrials.gov, ISRCTN, EU CTR) alongside patient availability to detect enrollment risk before it causes delays and to match eligible patients to appropriate studies for sponsors, CROs, sites, and healthcare providers. The platform surfaces at-risk trials, benchmarks sites, and visualizes enrollment pipelines, positioning delay prevention as protecting $1.1M-$1.7M per month in trial spend. The company advertises enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and custom data pipelines with end-to-end encryption and SOC 2 compliance, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; access is gated behind a partner platform and an early-access program. Backed by General Catalyst, with offices in Toronto and Barcelona.

providers.name: Amentum
providers.description: Amentum Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: AMTM) is a global advanced engineering and technology solutions company serving U.S. federal customers across defense, intelligence, energy, space, and civilian missions, with allied work in the United Kingdom and Australia. The company was created from the spin-off of AECOM's Management Services business in 2020, and on September 27, 2024 completed a Reverse Morris Trust transaction with Jacobs Solutions to merge Jacobs' Critical Mission Solutions (CMS) and Cyber & Intelligence (C&I) businesses into Amentum. Post-merger Amentum reports approximately $14.4 billion in fiscal year 2025 revenue, a $47.1 billion backlog, ~53,000 employees in 80 countries, and is headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia. The business is organized around six capability areas — Mission Modernization & Sustainment, Space Systems, Digital Transformation, Sustainability & Environment, Advanced Energy Solutions, and Data Analytics & Cyber. Most delivery occurs under contract through classified, CAC-gated, or program portals; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or REST API has been identified.

providers.name: APAC Financial Services
providers.description: APAC Financial Services (Apacfin) is a Mumbai-based, Reserve Bank of India registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) that provides customized MSME business loans to underbanked and underserved micro, small, and medium enterprises across India. APAC offers tech-enabled, largely paperless digital onboarding, quick disbursal with minimal documentation, and a mobile app (APACM) for loan tracking, EMI payments, and service requests. The lender reports roughly Rs 2,479 Crore of assets under management across 226 branches in six states, serving more than 52,000 customers, and carries an ICRA A (Stable) credit rating. APAC is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published; customer and partner interaction is via the mobile app and hosted customer/complaint portals.

providers.name: Baba
providers.description: Baba Care, Inc. is a healthcare company that provides patient advocacy and care-navigation services for Medicare beneficiaries in the United States. Operating under the tagline "Healthcare simplified," Baba pairs each member with a dedicated advocate who handles their healthcare headaches — coordinating care, benefits, and administrative tasks — with the service covered by Medicare. The member experience is delivered through a login-gated web application at baba.care; the company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Bank Jago
providers.description: PT Bank Jago Tbk is a technology-based digital bank in Indonesia, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX: ARTO) and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital and GoTo. Rather than a branch network, Bank Jago is delivered through the life-centric Jago mobile application and is deeply embedded into partner ecosystems — Gojek/GoPay for payments, and Bibit/Stockbit for investing — via API-based integrations. Its Open API payment surface is exposed through Indonesia's national SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) programme, administered through the ASPI developer directory, rather than a self-hosted public developer portal. Bank Jago is regulated by the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) and Bank Indonesia. This API Evangelist profile is compiled from public sources as a fintech company lead; the bank publishes no self-hosted OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Baubap
providers.description: Baubap is a Mexican fintech offering instant personal microloans through an Android mobile app. Founded in 2018 in Mexico City by Roberto Salcedo and Luis Villarreal, it grants loans from $500 to roughly $9,000 MXN in minutes with no credit-bureau check and no income verification, using its own AI/ML-based alternative-scoring model to serve underbanked and no-credit-history borrowers. On-time repayment unlocks progressively larger amounts and helps users build a positive credit history. Baubap operates as a regulated SOFOM registered with CONDUSEF and supervised by CNBV, complying with Mexican data-protection and financial-security regulations. It has no public developer API; this profile captures the company's identity, its published /llms.txt, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Belong Home
providers.description: Belong is a residential property management platform and rental marketplace that helps homeowners rent out their homes and helps residents find and live in professionally managed homes. Marketed as "Property Management Made Loveable," Belong pairs AI-driven pricing and operations with a human care team to deliver guaranteed rent, resident screening and placement, listing distribution across 26+ sites (Zillow, Apartments.com, and more), 24/7 maintenance via a network of Pros, rent collection, and financial tools for both homeowners and renters. The company operates across a growing set of US markets including the SF Bay Area, Seattle, Arizona, Florida, and the East Coast, and is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Belong is a consumer and homeowner-facing product; no public developer API, SDK, or machine documentation surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Bloomy
providers.description: Bloomy (bloomylearning.com) is an AI-powered adaptive learning platform for K-12 students, founded by Alex Southmayd and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch). The product diagnoses each student's knowledge gaps, builds a personalized standards-aligned learning path across English Language Arts, Math, and Writing, and delivers Socratic AI tutoring plus mastery-based practice, requiring 90%+ mastery before a student advances. It integrates third-party diagnostic/assessment data (i-Ready, NWEA MAP) and provides a real-time teacher dashboard. Bloomy serves traditional districts, charter schools, homeschools, and microschools, and sells to families via monthly or annual subscriptions (with ESA/EFA fund eligibility in some states). As of this profile Bloomy publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation; this record captures its verified public identity and legal/account surface only.

providers.name: Buildah
providers.description: Buildah is an open-source, Linux-based command-line tool for building OCI-compliant container images without requiring a full container runtime or daemon. It allows building images from scratch or using Dockerfiles, with fine-grained control over image layers. Buildah supports rootless builds in unprivileged environments and integrates seamlessly with Podman and Skopeo as part of the containers organization. It is commonly used in Kubernetes-based CI/CD pipelines to avoid Docker-in-Docker complexity.

providers.name: Cambly
providers.description: Cambly is an online English-language learning platform, founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, that connects English learners in more than 190 countries with native-speaking tutors over on-demand video chat. Its consumer products include Cambly (adult learners), Cambly Kids (ages 4-15), Cambly Pro, and Cambly for Organizations/Business. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, and Y Combinator, the company operates a marketplace connecting students and tutors with weekly payouts. Cambly does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public company surface, GitHub organization, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CapsoVision
providers.description: CapsoVision, Inc. (Nasdaq: CV) is a commercial-stage medical technology company headquartered in Saratoga, California that develops advanced imaging and artificial-intelligence technologies for gastrointestinal disease detection and screening. Its CapsoCam Plus single-use capsule endoscope captures a 360-degree panoramic view of the small-bowel mucosa without external receiver equipment, and is paired with CapsoCloud, an account-gated cloud application, and CapsoView review software for physician image review and reporting. A next-generation CapsoCam Colon system is in development. CapsoVision publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification; CapsoCloud is an end-user clinical web and mobile application whose JSON backend is private to the product.

providers.name: Careship
providers.description: Careship (operated by Care Companion GmbH, Berlin) is a German senior-care marketplace that connects elderly people and their families with vetted, non-medical everyday helpers ("Alltagshilfen") from their own neighborhoods. The platform covers companionship, shopping, household support, mobility and leisure, light personal care, and dementia support, and helps families finance care through statutory long-term care insurance (Pflegekasse). Careship operates across 20+ German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, and Dresden. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum; it is a consumer care-services business with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Carta Healthcare
providers.description: Carta Healthcare, Inc. is a San Francisco based clinical data management company that applies a "Hybrid Intelligence" model — proprietary AI paired with certified human clinical abstractors — to extract, validate and submit structured clinical data on behalf of hospitals and health systems. Its product family covers Voyager (the underlying AI data platform trained on electronic medical record content), Lighthouse and Atlas (AI-assisted clinical registry abstraction and submission, including the ACC NCDR, STS/ACC TVT and Vascular Quality Initiative registries), Navigator (clinical data intelligence and analytics), Harbor (cohort selection and clinical trial matching) and outsourced expert abstraction services. Carta Healthcare is an NCDR certified software vendor and has completed a Type 2 SOC 2 examination with an unqualified opinion covering security, availability and confidentiality. The company sells and integrates directly with hospital EMR environments under enterprise agreements; it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract on its public web surface.

providers.name: Cartesi
providers.description: Cartesi is a Linux-based optimistic rollup protocol that lets developers build decentralized applications by running rich off-chain computation inside a sandboxed Linux virtual machine. The core of the stack is the Cartesi Machine, a deterministic RISC-V emulator that boots a real Linux userland so dApps can be written in any language (Rust, Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++) using familiar libraries, then settle results on Ethereum and other EVM chains through Cartesi Rollups smart contracts. Cartesi Rollups 2.0 is the current major version, packaging an application-specific rollup as the combination of the Cartesi Machine, the Cartesi Rollups Node middleware (Rust + Go), and a set of Solidity rollup contracts that handle settlement, consensus, and data availability. The DAVE permissionless fraud-proof system provides Stage-2 trust minimization, while the Cartesi CLI (the successor to Sunodo) packages scaffolding, build, and local devnet workflows. Cartesi is stewarded by The Cartesi Foundation and the CTSI token governs the network. Cartesi is fully open source under Apache-2.0 and LGPL-3.0 licenses on github.com/cartesi; there is no proprietary SaaS product, but the Rollups Node ships several developer-facing surfaces — the Rollup HTTP API used by application backends, the Inspect HTTP API for read-only queries from frontends, a GraphQL reader for advance-state inputs / outputs / vouchers / notices / reports, and a JSON-RPC node API for operations.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: China Southern Air Logistics
providers.description: China Southern Air Logistics Co., Ltd. (南航物流, CSAL) is the air cargo and logistics arm of China Southern Airlines, established in December 2018 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It combines the airline's freighter fleet with passenger belly capacity into an integrated air logistics network, and sells express (CZ Speed), standard, special cargo, whole-aircraft charter, intermodal truck and door-to-door products through its Tang (唐翼) online cargo system at cargo.csair.com, where agents and shippers book capacity, query freight rates, track air waybills, manage dangerous-goods accounts and request invoices. As of this profile the company publishes no developer program, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification; system-to-system integration is arranged bilaterally with agents and forwarders.

providers.name: Chinese Medicine Online
providers.description: Chinese Medicine Online (中医在线) is a Beijing-based traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) continuing-education and academic-exchange platform, founded in 2015 and operated by Beijing Universe In Nutshell Technology Co., Ltd. (北京果壳宇宙教育科技有限公司) on behalf of the Beijing TCM Online Education Center (北京中医在线教育中心). Through its web platform at tcmmooc.com and its iOS/Android app, it publishes recorded and live video continuing-education courses from national TCM masters and senior practitioners, runs the 经方学社 (Classical Formulas Society) learning community and 精医社 membership, livestreams academic conferences, and sells course material through a paid knowledge marketplace. The company states a catalogue of roughly 19,600 courses from 3,900+ TCM experts and around 4 million registered users, the majority of them licensed practitioners. It has since extended into AI and SaaS for grassroots clinics, including the "Yi Yin" (伊尹) TCM classical-reasoning large language model launched in Songxian, Henan in September 2025, and clinic workflow tooling (prescription, patient and follow-up management). The platform is delivered strictly as an end-user web and mobile product — it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Cignara
providers.description: Cignara is an enterprise AI platform that replaces traditional customer support (FAQ bots and IVR menus) with governed voice and chat AI agents that serve, sell, and grow. Its agents handle inbound and outbound phone and chat conversations end to end across 32+ languages, pulling customer context, applying business policy, executing transactions (checkout, scheduling, refunds, retention), and offering a real-time human copilot for support teams. The platform emphasizes in-region data sovereignty and hallucination-free, policy-bound actions grounded in each enterprise's own knowledge base. Founded 2026 (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) in San Francisco; legal entity ShopAdvisor Inc.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Claritypediatrics
providers.description: Clarity Pediatrics is a virtual pediatric telehealth clinic that diagnoses and treats ADHD, anxiety, and childhood obesity in children ages 5-17, currently serving families in California and Texas. It combines clinical evaluations, medication management, and evidence-based behavioral programs — Behavioral Parent Training (BPT) and RUBI for ADHD, the SPACE program and a Teen Anxiety Program for anxiety, and lifestyle medicine for obesity — delivered by licensed multispecialty clinicians through video visits and weekly group sessions. It is a direct-to-consumer healthcare platform (parent app + provider referral) with no public developer or API surface at this time. Backed by Homebrew; added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Comerica
providers.description: Comerica Incorporated is a Texas-headquartered super-regional financial services holding company providing retail, small-business, commercial, and wealth-management banking across the United States, with market concentrations in Texas, California, Michigan, Arizona, and Florida. As of July 2026 Comerica publishes NO first-party developer API portal: developer.comerica.com, api.comerica.com, and related developer subdomains do not resolve, and directory trackers (Open Banking Tracker, API Tracker) list no documented API products, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, SDKs, or Postman collections. Consumer and small-business account data is reached indirectly through US open-finance aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs — the CFPB-recognized standard-setting body for the Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule — rather than a Comerica-published endpoint. Commercial treasury, cash-positioning, ACH/wire initiation, and reporting are delivered through Comerica's Cash Management and Commercial Information Management platforms under direct customer contract (host-to-host files, portal, and BAI/ISO 20022 feeds), not a public REST API. Note: Fifth Third Bancorp completed its all-stock acquisition of Comerica in February 2026, so Comerica's future digital and API surface is being integrated into Fifth Third's platform.

providers.name: Conceive
providers.description: Conceive is a telehealth platform for fertility and pregnancy support. It offers 24/7 text access to fertility and pregnancy nurses, coaches, and dietitians, personalized fertility coaching, fertility test interpretation, virtual video visits with providers, expert-led community events, and an educational library. Membership is delivered through Conceive Plus and Conceive Premium tiers. The company is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As a consumer telehealth app it publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its published identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Conexus Credit Union
providers.description: Conexus Credit Union is Saskatchewan's largest credit union, a member-owned cooperative financial institution headquartered in Regina with over $10 billion in consolidated assets under management, more than 140,000 members, roughly 30 branches, and over 800 employees across the province. As a provincially regulated Saskatchewan credit union it operates under a cooperative charter, with member deposits guaranteed by the Credit Union Deposit Guarantee Corporation (CUDGC). In November 2024 Conexus announced its intent to explore a merger with Cornerstone and Synergy credit unions. Conexus does not publish a first-party public developer API or a developer portal; developer.conexus.ca does not resolve, and /developer and /api on the corporate site return 404. Consumer financial-data access is provided through third-party aggregators (notably Plaid in Canada) via screen-scraping and connection-based data sharing rather than a first-party API. Digital and online banking are delivered through core-banking and fintech partners (banking.online.conexus.ca), and investing runs through the credit-union system's Aviso Wealth / Qtrade and Thrive Wealth partners. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, overseen by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC), is legislated but not yet operational, so Conexus's open-finance access remains voluntary and aggregator-mediated today.

providers.name: Conservation Labs
providers.description: Conservation Labs is a Pittsburgh-based smart water technology company, backed by Techstars, Amazon, RET Ventures and SustainVC. Its flagship product, H2know, is a clamp-on acoustic smart water monitor that measures a building's inbound pipe every second and uses patented sound-detection technology and machine learning to translate those signals into accurate water-flow estimates, leak alerts and water-usage insights delivered through a companion mobile and web app. The company also offers Sustainable Machines, an edge-to-cloud platform for machine condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Conservation Labs serves residential homes, commercial real estate, restaurants and hotels, and industrial operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a consumer-facing app but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook documentation.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Dawn
providers.description: Dawn (Sleepedy, Inc. dba Dawn) is a digital-health company offering a clinician-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) program delivered through a mobile app. The service pairs users with licensed sleep coaches and therapists for weekly video sessions and between-session chat, daily 5-7 minute sleep lessons, live sleep-performance insights, and weekly progress reports, with the goal of treating primary and chronic insomnia and reducing reliance on sleep medication. Dawn is in-network with major U.S. insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and offers an employer/enterprise workplace-wellness program. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Dawn publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Denticon
providers.description: Denticon is a cloud-based dental practice management platform built for dental service organizations (DSOs) and multi-location group practices, owned and operated by Planet DDS (which also owns Cloud 9 Ortho and Apteryx imaging). The Denticon API program - relaunched in July 2024 on a new developer portal powered by Azure API Management - exposes RESTful APIs, webhooks, and batch data extracts covering patient, appointment, financial/ledger, insurance and claims (Revenue Cycle Management), clinical, and practice/office data, with OAuth 2.0 auth, an event-driven architecture for synchronized updates, and writebacks into Denticon. API access is partner-gated - Planet DDS must approve vendors and each client practice authorizes vendor access to specific office locations (OIDs). Public documentation exists, but keys and interactive access require program enrollment, so the endpoint surface below is modeled from the published API categories rather than a downloadable OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Edge Case Research
providers.description: Edge Case Research (operating as "Edge Case", ecr.ai) is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania company founded in 2013 that provides functional safety engineering, risk management and safety-assurance software for autonomous and other "frontier technology" systems. Its DevSafeOps methodology carries safety through the whole product lifecycle — hazard identification in design, verified safety evidence in build, and continuous safety monitoring in operations — and its nLoop live-safety-case platform assembles evidence from design, simulation, test and field operations into an auditable, continuously updated safety case. The company works across aerospace and defense, automotive and autonomous trucking, space, oil and gas, and supply chain and logistics, and publishes the Open Autonomy Safety Case framework as SACM XML on GitHub. Edge Case publishes no public product API or OpenAPI; the only machine-readable surface reachable on its own host is the Wix-provided site MCP endpoint advertised in its llms.txt.

providers.name: Education Holdings 1 (The Princeton Review)
providers.description: Education Holdings 1 operates The Princeton Review, an educational services company offering standardized test preparation, one-on-one and on-demand tutoring, and college, graduate, medical, and law school admissions counseling. The Princeton Review prepares students for the SAT, ACT, PSAT, AP, MCAT, DAT, OAT, LSAT, GRE, GMAT, SSAT, ISEE, and SHSAT through live, self-paced, and honors courses, publishes college and graduate school rankings and guidebooks, and provides free practice tests, events, and study resources. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. The Princeton Review operates a consumer web presence rather than a public developer program; it publishes an llms.txt AI-discovery file but does not expose a documented public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Eero
providers.description: eero makes home mesh Wi-Fi systems that are simple, powerful, secure, and reliable. eero pioneered home mesh wifi and sells products for homes, businesses, service providers, pro installers, and communities, including the eero Pro 7, eero PoE 7, and eero Signal, plus the eero Plus subscription for enhanced security and multi-network management. Devices are managed through the award-winning eero app and are deployed across 27+ countries. eero LLC is based in San Francisco, CA and is an Amazon company. eero does not publish a public developer API or first-party SDK; the eero app communicates with a private, unpublished backend.

providers.name: Eliq
providers.description: Eliq provides energy data and analytics APIs for utilities and energy app developers. The platform combines a decade of analytics and machine learning trained on millions of homes to deliver consumption insights, disaggregation, forecasting, peak detection, tariff comparison, and customer segmentation.

providers.name: Enclave
providers.description: Enclave (enclave.ai) is an AI-powered application and cloud security platform that operates as an "agentic security engineer." It continuously builds a living model of an organization's attack surface across services and cloud providers, then autonomously triages and investigates vulnerability findings against known CVEs to determine real-world exploitability and reachability. Rather than flooding teams with signature-based noise, Enclave traces data flows to confirm whether a CVE is actually reachable, surfaces cross-service exploits that traditional scanners miss, and routes prioritized remediation plans with proof to the owning teams. Founded by veterans from Stripe, Box, VMware, Salesforce, and Yelp, the company is backed by 8VC and Marc Benioff. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Equipboard
providers.description: Equipboard is a community-sourced music-gear discovery platform where musicians, producers, and DJs find the equipment behind the music. Members browse the gear their favorite artists play — guitars, effects pedals, synthesizers, DAWs, plug-ins, microphones, drum machines, and keyboards — build and share their own rigs and gear lists, read and write reviews, and follow buy-links to retailers. Equipboard is built by musicians for musicians and monetizes primarily through affiliate relationships (including the Amazon Associates Program). Recent product work adds album- and track-level gear attribution. The company is backed by 500 Global. Equipboard does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network and enriched from Equipboard's public web surface.

providers.name: Ethos Systems
providers.description: Ethos Systems is an AI-powered human readiness platform that unifies learning, performance, and outcomes management in a single system built for enterprise and government deployment across both commercial and classified networks. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Ethos delivers personalized training with algorithm-driven interventions, rapid AI content development, and real-time readiness dashboards that connect learning to operational outcomes. It serves the U.S. military, federal civilian agencies, life sciences, manufacturing, freight and logistics, hospitality, athletics, utilities, insurance, and government contractors, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the Westly Group, and Pear VC. The company operates the Ethos and Learn to Win platforms; its developer and product documentation is gated behind authentication and it exposes no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Finni Health
providers.description: Finni Health is a telehealth company that connects families of children on the autism spectrum with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapists and mental health providers. Operating across more than 30 states, Finni offers both in-home and in-clinic ABA therapy with flexible scheduling, handles insurance coordination and billing for its provider network, and gives parents a portal for progress tracking and family-led goal setting. The company positions itself as an operating platform for ABA practices as well as a care provider for families, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Fiture
providers.description: Fiture is a consumer smart-home fitness company that makes interactive AI-powered fitness mirrors for at-home workouts. Its hardware line includes the Fiture Core flagship mirror and the compact Fiture Mini, each pairing a wall-mounted display with a camera and on-device AI that delivers real-time motion tracking, gesture recognition, rep counting, and posture feedback across a library of live and on-demand fitness classes sold through a membership. The company was founded in China and is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Fiture operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership website but does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company and its public web surface (support, legal, and account pages).

providers.name: Five Lives
providers.description: Five Lives is a health-technology company building evidence-based digital tools for dementia prevention and brain health for adults aged 50 and over. Founded by former Peak brain-training leaders Xavier Louis (CEO) and Sylvain Piquet (COO), the fully remote company operates two consumer mobile apps: Five Lives Brain Health, a prevention app available since 2021 with cognitive tests, brain games, and lifestyle tracking across five pillars (nutrition, sleep, physical activity, mood and social connection, and mental stimulation); and Five Lives Care, an evidence-based memory and autonomy programme for people aged 60+ launched in January 2026 and developed with leading memory centres in the UK and France. Its work draws on the FINGER study and the Lancet Commission's modifiable dementia risk factors, with research partners including the University of Oxford, Trinity College Dublin, the FINGER Brain Health Institute, Dementias Platform UK, and the Gerontopole d'Ile de France. Backed by Speedinvest. Five Lives does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Flockjay
providers.description: Flockjay is a sales enablement platform that helps revenue teams capture, organize, and scale their best practices. It combines a learning management system, a content and knowledge management system, and AI-powered coaching — including semantic search across sales content, real-time deal and rep coaching, call scoring, and pitch grading — so sales leaders, revenue operations, and enablement professionals can onboard reps faster and reinforce winning behaviors. Flockjay advertises 50+ integrations with tools such as Slack, Zoom, and common CRMs. The company is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Flockjay does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, trust, integration, and security surface.

providers.name: Frontera
providers.description: Frontera (Frontera Health) is an AI-assisted clinical documentation company for behavioral health. Its software automates assessment and diagnosis report writing for Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and clinical psychologists working in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and autism care, cutting report time from 6-10 hours to 2-3 hours. The platform pairs a BCBA-trained AI Assessment Builder and Diagnosis Builder with digital phenotyping, and is delivered as a HIPAA-compliant web application (customer login at portal.fronterahealth.com) rather than a public API. Frontera is a venture-backed portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and security surface; as of this pass Frontera publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Groundcover
providers.description: Groundcover is a cloud-native observability platform using eBPF for zero-instrumentation monitoring of Kubernetes workloads.

providers.name: Grouper
providers.description: Grouper, operated by Element3 Health, Inc. (d/b/a Grouper) and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a healthy-aging benefit company that connects older adults to social clubs, group activities, and virtual community programming through health plans. Its consumer product, "Hello by Grouper," is a membership platform offering live and on-demand instructor-led virtual classes, research-based monthly brain-health challenges, and members-only online events, with the goal of keeping members active, socially connected, and healthier as they age. Grouper distributes primarily through Medicare Advantage and other health-plan partners rather than a direct developer channel; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface as of this profile, which was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture (a16z-associated) portfolio lead.

providers.name: Hilbert's AI
providers.description: Hilbert's AI is an AI-native growth infrastructure platform for B2C companies, backed by a16z. It unifies fragmented product, marketing, and finance data into a single source of truth and layers agentic automation on top through four intelligence stages: Detect (anomalies, churn signals, and behavioral shifts), Reason (ML/deep-learning root-cause analysis and forecasting), Act (autonomous growth interventions such as churn plays and channel adjustments), and Optimize (continuous budget and strategy tuning). A natural-language interface lets growth, product, and finance teams collapse months-long decision cycles into minutes without writing code or navigating dashboards. Hilbert connects to existing data and paid-media stacks via prebuilt integrations (Meta, Google, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, Google Analytics 4, Triple Whale, Klaviyo, Braze) and is SOC 2 certified. The product is delivered as a hosted application; there is no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Hole19
providers.description: Hole19 (Stat Track Technologies Lda) is a golf app for iOS, Android, and smartwatches used by 4.8M+ golfers across 42,000+ golf courses in 200+ countries. It provides GPS rangefinder distances, digital scorecards, shot tracking, performance statistics, an Otto AI game assistant, and a WHS handicap calculator, plus social features such as LivePlay live leaderboards and a social feed. The company also ships CORE Golf, a practice app with structured plans and 100+ drills, and operates a worldwide golf course directory, a golf glossary, and The 19th Hole magazine. The core app is free with two subscription tiers, Premium and Intelligence. Hole19 does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal, support, and llms.txt surface.

providers.name: IHG Hotels & Resorts
providers.description: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (trading as IHG Hotels & Resorts) is a British asset-light hotel group headquartered at Windsor Dials, 1 Arthur Road, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1RS, United Kingdom, with an Americas office at 3 Ravinia Drive, Atlanta, Georgia. Its own corporate site states 7,014 hotels and 1,035,589 rooms across more than 100 countries, around 400,000 colleagues, 20 brands and the IHG One Rewards loyalty programme (figures read from ihgplc.com on 2026-07-28). The brand portfolio spans Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, voco, HUALUXE, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resorts, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Garner, avid, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites, IHG Army Hotels and Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. In the distribution chain IHG sits on the supply side as a franchisor and manager rather than an owner: it aggregates independently owned and operated properties into a single central reservation system and pushes that inventory out through its own ihg.com and app direct channels, through the three GDSs and their agency terminals, through OTAs and wholesalers, and through corporate and group channels. Critically, IHG does not run its own reservation platform any more. It announced a partnership with Amadeus in 2015 to build a cloud Guest Reservation System to replace HOLIDEX, its proprietary system in service since 1965, and migrated onto it across 2018 and early 2019 — so the hotel group most likely to be a lock-in vendor is itself a customer of a GDS company's platform, and group bookings land in Amadeus Delphi and Meeting Broker. Its API posture, stated honestly, is gated and undocumented. There is no live developer portal. The one that existed — PartnerConnect RoomService at pcroomservice.ihg.com, a TIBCO Mashery portal publishing five rate, availability and hotel-content APIs — is decommissioned: the hostname is NXDOMAIN on Google, Cloudflare and Quad9 resolvers as of 2026-07-28 and the Internet Archive holds no page capture after 2019. What remains live is partnerconnect.ihg.com (HTTP 200), an affiliate marketing programme whose signup routes to Commission Junction and which still advertises "access to real-time hotel rates, availability and hotel content API's" without linking to any technical resource. Real API hostnames exist — api.ihg.com CNAMEs to ihg.api.mashery.com with an sb-ihg.mashery.com sandbox, and apis.ihg.com, b2b.ihg.com, mcp.ihg.com, booking.ihg.com and concerto.ihg.com all sit behind Akamai — but every one returns 403 Access Denied or 401 on every path probed, including /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, WSDL, XSD, OpenTravel/OTA or HTNG reference is published anywhere by IHG. apis[] is deliberately empty: listing an Akamai-gated hostname or a decommissioned 2017 portal as a live API would be fabrication. The value of this record is the switchingCost block in review.yml, which captures what published IHG documents actually say about what it costs to leave — including the archived RoomService Terms of Use classing "API parameters" as Confidential Information and binding partners to the Master PartnerConnect Terms and Conditions plus the Six Continents Hotels E-commerce Master Service Agreement, and the current IHG One Rewards member terms stating that members whose accounts are cancelled "by IHG or by the Member, will forfeit all Points, Point vouchers, Reward Nights, and any other benefits associated with the account".

providers.name: Inovalon
providers.description: Inovalon is a healthcare technology company providing cloud-based data analytics and data-enabled intervention platforms for the healthcare industry. Its Inovalon ONE Platform pairs national-scale primary-source datasets with analytics, workflow, and SaaS applications used by health plans, providers, pharmacies, life-sciences, and specialty organizations for risk adjustment, quality measurement, care-gap closure, and revenue-cycle and claims management (including the ABILITY provider workflow products). Inovalon was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise and auth-gated: the corporate site is WAF-protected and the API host api.inovalon.com requires authentication (HTTP 401); security and compliance posture is published on the public Inovalon Trust Center.

providers.name: Junk King
providers.description: Junk King is a professional junk removal and hauling franchise operating across the United States and Canada as part of the Neighborly family of home service brands. Through locally owned and operated locations, Junk King provides full-service junk removal, self-service dumpster rental, and dumpster bag pickup for residential and commercial customers, handling appliance and furniture removal, estate and property cleanouts, construction debris, yard waste, and e-waste. The company emphasizes eco-friendly disposal, recycling, donating, and reusing as much collected material as possible. Junk King offers free estimates, same-day service in many markets, and online, phone, and text-based booking. It is a portfolio company associated with Norwest Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Junk King publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Kindara
providers.description: Kindara is a fertility-awareness and reproductive-health company offering a digital fertility charting system across web (app.kindara.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps. It lets users track basal body temperature, cervical fluid, and menstrual cycle data to understand their fertility, time conception, or practice fertility-awareness-based birth control. Kindara pairs its charting app with the Wink basal thermometer and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer-facing femtech product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Kinema
providers.description: Kinema is a social cinema platform and independent film distribution service. It empowers independent filmmakers to release, control, and get paid for their films through global distribution, partner-driven and live screenings, and direct-to-audience streaming, with ownership retention, transparent weekly payouts, and real-time earnings dashboards. Hosts and community builders get screening software and event tools to turn any space into a movie house, in person or online, while audiences discover independent films and attend virtual or in-person screenings, directly supporting filmmakers through ticket and rental purchases.

providers.name: Known
providers.description: Known is a voice-first, swipeless dating application founded in 2025 by Celeste Amadon and Asher Allen and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Instead of profiles, feeds, queues, and swiping, Known onboards users through a voice-AI interview and then sends one curated introduction at a time, with a 24-hour acceptance window on both sides. When both people accept, Known helps pick a restaurant that fits both sets of preferences and checks calendar availability, then collects a short post-date check-in to refine future matches. The company optimizes for in-person dates rather than engagement, and has raised $9.7M from Forerunner Ventures, NFX, and other investors. The product is iOS-only in the United States today, with waitlists for Android and for Apple users outside the US. Known publishes no public developer program, API, or SDKs; it does publish a first-party llms.txt describing the product for AI agents.

providers.name: Kyros College Prep
providers.description: Kyros (kyros.ai) is an AI-driven college preparation and admissions platform. In the company's own words, it is "a College Prep Platform by former Googlers, Admissions Officers, and Professors" that "uses AI to offer 100K+ summer and financial aid programs." The product combines student assessments for college and major fit, one-on-one counseling, college essay and letter-of-recommendation support, extracurricular and summer-program discovery, and structured program tracks such as Future You Lab, the UC Bootcamp, and industry immersion and research programs. Kyros also sells through partner channels, with education-partner, VAR, counselor-advisory, college-success, and Fortune 1000 employer offerings, and publishes a large admissions blog. As of 2026-07-19 Kyros publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Leland
providers.description: Leland is a marketplace for ambitious people to access the coaching, classes, and community they need to reach career and educational goals. It connects individuals with vetted 1-on-1 coaches across MBA and college admissions, management consulting, investment banking, private equity, product management, law, medicine, and executive and career development, and sells structured live programs, bootcamps, and test prep for the GMAT, GRE, LSAT, MCAT, SAT, and ACT. Leland+ is a subscription content library of video guides, essay and resume examples, templates, and expert-built AI tools. For organizations Leland offers AI-native talent training, agentic workflow deployment, recruiting, and outplacement, plus university and HR partnerships. Leland publishes no public API or developer portal as of 2026-07-19.

providers.name: Lendorse
providers.description: Lendorse GmbH is a Berlin-based education-finance company that funds international master's students studying in Europe through Income Share Agreements (ISAs) instead of traditional credit-scored loans. Students receive between EUR 3,000 and EUR 20,000 toward tuition, visa deposits, relocation and living costs, then repay a fixed 6-12% share of gross monthly income for 12 to 60 months once they earn above a EUR 2,500 monthly salary floor, with total repayment capped at 2.3x the funded amount. No collateral, co-signer, parental guarantor or credit check is required, which opens funding to students from developing and emerging markets who are normally excluded. Lendorse also provides mentorship, CV review, mock interviews and industry introductions. It covers universities in Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland, went through the Techstars and ABN AMRO Future of Finance Accelerator, and raised EUR 1.75M co-led by LUMO Labs and Soulmates Ventures. Lendorse publishes no public API, SDKs or developer portal as of July 2026; this profile is a company record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Letswork
providers.description: Letswork is a Dubai-headquartered flexible workspace booking platform that lets members work from coworking spaces, cafes, hotels, meeting rooms, private offices and creative studios through a single credit-based monthly membership with no long-term contract. Founded in 2019 by Omar AlMheiri and Hamza Khan, the platform covers 1030+ workspaces across 63+ cities in 18+ countries, serving 80,000+ members across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Europe and Sub-Saharan Africa. The product ships as iOS, Android and web apps with one-tap check-in, day passes, hourly meeting-room booking, a private-offices marketplace, and team plans that add a shared credit pool, admin dashboard and usage analytics for hybrid companies. Letswork publishes no public developer API or developer portal; it does publish a first-party llms.txt canonical fact set for AI assistants.

providers.name: Lindy
providers.description: Lindy is an AI automation platform for building customizable AI agents across CRM, inbox, and internal tools.

providers.name: Lucid Lane
providers.description: Lucid Lane (now operating as Skyler Health) is a telehealth mental health platform delivering virtual talk therapy and counseling for mental health conditions, an AI-powered coaching companion, and guided meditation and mindfulness content through its Listen Therapy service. Originally founded to help patients taper off opioids and manage medication dependence during and after surgery, the company has since broadened into remote behavioral and mental health care delivered to members, employers, clinics, and providers. It is a consumer- and employer-facing care service with no public developer or API surface; member access is via the Skyler Health member portal. Backed by Accel and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Mechanical Orchard
providers.description: Mechanical Orchard is an enterprise software company, founded by Pivotal veterans, that modernizes mission-critical legacy and mainframe systems. Its flagship platform, Imogen, uses AI to observe how legacy applications actually behave, then incrementally rewrites them into modern, cloud-ready code while continuously verifying that behavior is preserved so nothing breaks during migration. The company pairs the Imogen platform with professional services and a free proof of concept, integrates with AWS Transform and Google Cloud, and serves both commercial enterprises and government agencies looking to retire risky COBOL and mainframe estates. It is backed by Bloomberg Beta, Emergence Capital, and GV.

providers.name: MidFirst Bank
providers.description: MidFirst Bank is a federally chartered savings association (thrift) headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and owned by Midland Financial Co. Founded in 1982 with roots in Midland Mortgage from the early 1950s, it is the largest privately owned bank in the United States, with roughly $42 billion in assets and retail banking, private banking, commercial real estate lending, and nationwide mortgage servicing operations across Oklahoma, Arizona, California, Colorado, Nevada, Texas, and Utah. MidFirst does not operate a first-party public developer portal or publish downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Its open-finance posture is aggregator-mediated: through its "Open Access" program, MidFirst adds direct API connections between its Business Online Banking platforms and consumer-permissioned data aggregators (Plaid, MX, Stripe, Intuit, Mastercard/Finicity, Envestnet Yodlee, and Morningstar), replacing screen scraping. There is no publicly documented first-party API surface, and no FDX participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture is published on its site as of this review.

providers.name: Mill
providers.description: Mill is a consumer sustainability company that makes a smart kitchen bin which dries and grinds household food scraps overnight into dry, nutrient-rich "Food Grounds," keeping food waste out of landfills and cutting the methane it would otherwise produce. Sold as a membership starting around $799 or roughly $66/month, the bin is odorless, reduces food-waste volume by about 80%, and the resulting grounds are reused in gardens, as chicken feed, or through farm partnerships. Mill also runs a commercial line for grocery, offices, food service, and municipalities. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Mill is a consumer hardware and subscription business with a companion mobile app; it exposes no public developer API — its /api/ path is an internal app backend disallowed in robots.txt.

providers.name: Milu Health
providers.description: Milu Health is a health technology company that pairs a virtual care team with an AI engine to help employees and their families get higher-quality healthcare at a lower cost. Founded in 2023 by Sasha Gribov and Gautam Kumar, Milu integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) data from tens of thousands of provider groups and health systems to proactively flag medication issues, care gaps, fairly priced and high-quality doctors, incorrect medical bills, and more affordable medications. The platform also ingests an employer's health plan and benefits so it can notify members when an existing benefit could help. Milu is offered through employers and benefits advisors as well as directly to individuals. The company raised a $4.8M seed round led by a16z Bio + Health in March 2024. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; Milu does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Misfits Market (fka Imperfect Foods)
providers.description: Misfits Market is an online grocery delivery service that rescues surplus and cosmetically imperfect produce, plus organic vegetables, dairy, meat, seafood, pantry staples, and wine, delivering sustainable groceries across the United States to help reduce food waste. It merged with Imperfect Foods in 2022, and both brands now operate under Misfits Market. The company has no public developer API program: its digital surface is a consumer e-commerce website, a customer help center, and iOS/Android mobile apps. It publishes a machine-readable llms.txt for AI agents.

providers.name: Monte Carlo
providers.description: Monte Carlo is a data observability platform that uses ML to detect, resolve, and prevent data quality issues.

providers.name: Mottu
providers.description: Mottu is the leading motorcycle-rental ecosystem in Latin America, founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, Brazil by Rubens Zanelatto. It rents motorcycles to gig and delivery couriers who lack access to traditional credit, bundling insurance, maintenance, 24-hour support and financial services (Mottu Pay) so workers can earn income through food delivery, e-commerce and last-mile logistics. Mottu has verticalized the value chain, running its own assembly line, parts and service network, and fleet-management software, and offers white-labeled last-mile delivery (Mottu Entregas) to more than 1,000 retailers across 100+ cities in Brazil and Mexico. Backed by QED Investors, Mottu has raised over US$150M. It operates as a consumer and B2B mobility/fintech app and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Musely
providers.description: Musely is a telehealth platform, founded in 2012 by Jack Jia and Carrie Jiao and based in San Jose, California, that connects patients with U.S. board-certified dermatologists for personalized, prescription-strength skincare and related care. Patients share skin concerns online, physicians craft personalized treatment plans, and freshly compounded formulas are shipped to the patient. Since pivoting from a wellness community to prescription skincare in 2019, Musely has expanded into hair loss, hormonal/menopause health, and longevity, serving more than 1.2 million patients. Musely is a consumer/health company in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a direct-to-consumer web and mobile telehealth experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Netreo
providers.description: Netreo is an IT infrastructure monitoring platform (now part of BMC as BMC Helix Operations Management with Netreo) that provides full-stack observability across networks, servers, applications, cloud services and databases. The platform exposes a documented REST API for programmatic access to monitoring data, configuration, and automation workflows.

providers.name: Noh
providers.description: Noh is a Brazilian consumer fintech (neobank) founded in November 2021 by Ana Zucato and Octavio Turra, headquartered in Sao Paulo, SP. Noh pioneered Brazil's first joint account and shared card for couples, letting two partners manage money together with equal permissions, real-time expense visibility, automatic categorization, and a shared spending limit based on combined income. Products include a joint checking account, a shared Visa card (prepaid and credit), and payments via Pix, boleto, and card, plus joint investing. It is a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time. Backed by Kindred Ventures and other investors; added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile.

providers.name: Optimal
providers.description: Optimal is a preventive-health and longevity company based in Mexico City, backed by 500 Global, operating across Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, and Peru). Optimal offers a consumer blood test that analyzes more than 300 biomarkers and uses AI to surface problems before symptoms appear, positioning itself as a predictive health platform (branded "health OS") that integrates biological data, wearable metrics, behavioral patterns, and medical history into longitudinal health models to identify risk before it becomes disease. The company sells directly to consumers via a web app and subscriptions and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Panora
providers.description: Panora is an open-source unified API platform that allows developers to integrate with hundreds of third-party tools through a single API. It provides a unified interface for CRM, HR, accounting, and other integrations.

providers.name: Partender
providers.description: Partender is a bar and beverage inventory management platform that lets hospitality operators complete a full physical liquor, wine, beer, and keg inventory in roughly fifteen minutes by tap-and-swipe estimating how full each bottle is, at up to 99.2% accuracy. The subscription SaaS spans iOS, Android, and web apps and adds online ordering, purchase orders auto-sorted by distributor, pour-cost and variance reporting, and lightweight accounting so venues can cut time, labor, and inventory loss. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, Partender serves bars, restaurants, hotels, and stadiums. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Partender exposes a consumer mobile/web product rather than a publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Personetics
providers.description: Personetics is a Cognitive Banking platform that helps banks and financial institutions deliver AI-driven, financial-data-personalized customer engagement and money management. Its products analyze customer transaction data in real time to surface personalized insights, proactive financial guidance, automated savings and cash-flow programs, and self-driving finance experiences embedded inside a bank's own mobile and web channels. Personetics serves hundreds of banks and financial institutions across roughly 30 global markets, reaching an estimated 150 million banking customers, and positions itself as a way for banks to deepen and monetize customer relationships. The platform is delivered as enterprise software integrated into a bank's digital banking stack rather than as a public self-serve developer API; developer and integration material lives in a gated Personetics Documentation Hub.

providers.name: Poppins
providers.description: Poppins is a French digital health company that develops a clinically validated digital therapeutic (DTx) for children aged 7-11 with dyslexia. Classified as a Class I medical device under EU Regulation 2017/745, the mobile application delivers home-based, game-based training sessions of about 20 minutes per day, 3-5 times per week, targeting phonological awareness, reading speed, and visual attention span. Poppins complements in-person speech therapy, supports speech-language pathologists through professional accounts, and partners with insurers. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Poppins publishes a consumer and healthcare-professional web/mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Posha
providers.description: Posha (formerly Nymble) is a consumer robotics company that makes an autonomous countertop kitchen robot which cooks fresh, home-style meals from raw ingredients across 1,000+ recipes. The device combines robotics, computer-vision cameras, automated heat, timing and stirring control, and culinary AI, paired with an iOS/Android companion app for real-time monitoring and recipe control. Backed by Accel, Posha is a consumer hardware and appliance product with a companion mobile app; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with real, verifiable public properties.

providers.name: Q Bio
providers.description: Q Bio is a Redwood City, California health-technology company offering the Q Exam and the Q Bio Health Dashboard, sold directly at its clinic and through enterprise partners. The Q Exam is a comprehensive preventive-health assessment that combines whole-body non-contrast MRI, 120+ blood biomarkers, analysis of 163 risk-relevant genes, wearable data, medical history, and board-certified physician review into a single longitudinal health baseline. Imaging is quantified by Constellation, the company's FDA-cleared AI image-analysis software that segments organs and measures anatomy, and results are stored in the Q Bio Health Dashboard for year-over-year comparison. Q Bio is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Reco
providers.description: Reco is a SaaS security platform using identity-centric analysis to detect threats, prevent data exposure, and manage access across SaaS applications.

providers.name: Rex Airlines
providers.description: Rex Airlines (Regional Express, IATA ZL / ICAO RXA) is Australia's second-largest regional carrier, headquartered in Mascot, New South Wales, flying a Saab 340 fleet to roughly 45 regional destinations across every Australian state. Formed in 2002 from the merger of Hazelton and Kendell Airlines, Rex entered voluntary administration in July 2024 and was acquired by US holding company Air T in December 2025 with Australian federal government debt support. In the distribution chain Rex is the inventory owner, not an intermediary — it runs Sabre's SabreSonic passenger service suite (inventory, reservations, ticketing, ancillaries, check-in) per Sabre's February 2021 announcement, sells direct through its own ASP.NET booking engine at ibe2.rex.com.au, and reaches trade through a web-only Travel Agent portal gated on an IATA, DAPA or TIDS agency number. Its API posture is honest to state plainly: no developer portal, no public documentation, no OpenAPI, and no NDC claim anywhere on rex.com.au. The only published trace of a programmatic interface is a bare "Request API Access" checkbox on the agent registration form — accreditation required, contract unspecified, nothing documented, and no exit path beyond a privacy-law request to the Customer Contact Centre.

providers.name: ScienceLogic
providers.description: ScienceLogic is an AIOps platform providing IT infrastructure monitoring, service management, and automated remediation.

providers.name: Serena & Lily
providers.description: Serena & Lily is a California home furnishings and lifestyle brand founded in 2003 in Sausalito by textile designer Serena Dugan and entrepreneur Lily Kanter. It sells furniture, custom upholstery, bedding, rugs, lighting, wallpaper, art and home decor direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, a printed catalog, and a network of physical Design Shops, alongside a Designer Circle trade program for interior designers. The storefront runs on a headless, composable commerce stack — Elastic Path for commerce and Amplience for content, served from a Vercel-hosted front end in front of AWS AppSync and Amazon API Gateway — but Serena & Lily publishes no developer program, no public API documentation, and no machine-readable specification of any kind. The GraphQL endpoint backing the storefront answers anonymous requests with introspection disabled, and the api.serenaandlily.com gateway rejects every unauthenticated path.

providers.name: Signos
providers.description: Signos is a metabolic health technology company founded by Sharam Fouladgar-Mercer and Bill Tancer that pairs a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor with an AI-powered mobile app to help people understand their individual metabolic responses to food and make data-driven lifestyle changes for weight management. In August 2025 Signos received FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter glucose monitoring system for weight loss, making it available without a prescription to adults not on insulin. The platform integrates with the Dexcom Stelo sensor, Apple Health, Google Health Connect, smartwatches and smart scales, delivers real-time glucose insights, personalized meal and movement recommendations, registered-dietitian support, and daily and weekly metabolism scores, with optional GLP-1 medication access through partner healthcare providers. Signos was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Slice
providers.description: Slice is a done-for-you online ordering, marketing, payments, and point-of-sale platform for independent pizzerias, serving more than 19,000 shops across all 50 states and 3,000+ cities. Consumers order through slicelife.com and the Slice apps; shop owners run their business through slice.com, the Owner's Portal (owners.slicelife.com), and the Slice Register POS. Slice does publish a developer portal titled "Slice Public API" at developer.slicelife.com (built on Stoplight) and a separate merchant/banking API portal at developer.slicebank.com, but neither is an open, self-serve API - there is no public API-key signup and the endpoint reference is not openly rendered or documented for third parties. API access is partner-gated and arranged through Slice's partnerships team (partner@slicelife.com). The APIs listed below are logical groupings modeled from the platform's known merchant surfaces (shops, menus, orders, customers); no public OpenAPI definition is available, so no specification is included.

providers.name: Somnee
providers.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Spline
providers.description: Spline is a web-based, real-time collaborative 3D design platform used to create interactive 3D scenes, animations, and product experiences for the web, iOS, and Android. The Spline editor runs in the browser and supports multi-user collaboration with comments, link sharing, and team workspaces. Designers build scenes using primitives and modeling tools, a layer-based material system, states, events, timeline animation, game controls, physics, and particles. Scenes can be exported as GLTF/GLB, USDZ, STL, video, image sequences, or as code for the web, SwiftUI, and Kotlin. Spline's developer surface centers on runtime libraries — `@splinetool/runtime`, the `@splinetool/react-spline` React component, the `r3f-spline` hook for react-three-fiber, and `spline-ios` for Apple platforms — plus an embeddable Spline Viewer web component. Inside scenes, Spline exposes a Real-time API for dynamic data binding and webhooks for event-driven integrations. The company also ships Hana, a web-based collaborative UI design tool with infinite canvas, vector networks, visual effects, and motion design. Spline's revenue model is SaaS subscription with Free, Starter ($12/mo annual), Professional ($20/mo annual), and Enterprise tiers, plus a Spline AI add-on ($5/seat/month, 2000 AI credits) for prompt-driven 3D generation. There is no publicly documented Spline REST/management API or OpenAPI specification at this time; programmatic surfaces are limited to the runtime SDKs, the Real-time API, and webhooks exposed from within a scene.

providers.name: Telephone and Data Systems
providers.description: Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) is a diversified telecommunications holding company providing broadband, video, and voice services across the United States through its subsidiary TDS Telecom, and wireless infrastructure through Array Digital Infrastructure (formerly U.S. Cellular). TDS serves customers in rural and suburban communities across 30 states, delivering fiber-based broadband and advanced connectivity solutions.

providers.name: The Helper Bees
providers.description: The Helper Bees is an Austin-based aging-in-place technology company that operates one connected platform linking benefits, in-home service providers, and support so older adults can safely age at home.
