It is a consumer of other operators' distribution APIs rather than a publisher of its own - it was the first UK OTA to take a direct NDC connection to Emirates' Online B2B API in 2019 and signed a direct Ryanair "Approved OTA" partnership in 2024 - and it explicitly bypasses the GDS layer entirely. Its API posture as a producer is almost non-existent. The FY25 results describe an "API-first microservices architecture" and a proprietary Hotel Discovery Cache managing more than 5 billion hotel prices, but none of that surface is published: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no partner or trade API, and no self-serve access of any kind. Its only remaining B2B channel, Classic Collection, was put into orderly wind-down on 23 September 2025. The single exception, and the first externally addressable machine surface the company has ever shipped, is a ChatGPT App launched on 1 April 2026 - claimed as the first by a UK OTA - which serves live, bookable package combinations to ChatGPT users over MCP. That surface is distribution-gated rather than developer-facing: no endpoint, tool list, schema, auth flow or terms are documented, and a deliberate mcp.onthebeach.co.uk host exists but is Cloudflare WAF-blocked to every probe.

providers.name: Pickle
providers.description: Pickle is a peer-to-peer fashion rental and resale marketplace that makes closets across the United States shareable. Through its iOS app and web storefront, shoppers rent, lend, buy, and sell clothing and accessories directly from one another at a fraction of retail, with same-day local courier delivery and nationwide two-day shipping, while owners earn income on pieces they already own between wears. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York City, Pickle has raised roughly $20M (including a $12M Series A) from investors including Craft Ventures. The company operates a consumer marketplace with no publicly documented developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Rally Rd
providers.description: Rally (formerly Rally Rd.) is a New York-based alternative-asset investment platform that lets everyday investors buy and sell equity shares in collectible assets — classic cars, watches, art, wine, sports memorabilia, natural-history artifacts, musical instruments and first-edition books. Rally sources and authenticates each item, registers it with the SEC as a security through FINRA/SIPC registered broker-dealer partners, splits it into equity shares, and opens an Initial Offering in its iOS, Android and web app where investors of all sizes can buy in from as little as $50 and later trade via in-app Bid/Ask. Rally was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis. It publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Renovate
providers.description: Renovate is an Open Source, cross-platform dependency automation tool by Mend.io that automatically creates pull requests to keep software dependencies up to date. It supports over 90 package managers and language ecosystems including npm, PyPI, Maven, Docker, Helm, Go modules, Ruby Gems, NuGet, and more. Renovate runs as a CLI, Docker container, GitHub Action, or hosted cloud service (Mend Renovate App). It integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Forgejo, and AWS CodeCommit. Configuration is done via a number of different locations in the repository: most commonly a `renovate.json` file in the repository root. The tool supports advanced scheduling, monorepo support, preset sharing, merge confidence scoring, and automatic replacement of deprecated packages.

providers.name: Responsiv
providers.description: Responsiv is an AI-powered regulatory intelligence and compliance platform that helps organizations monitor regulatory change, translate laws and regulations into clear actionable requirements, identify compliance gaps against existing policies and controls, and track remediation through to completion. The platform continuously monitors 1,000+ regulatory sources across 50+ jurisdictions, routes alerts by business unit, topic, or jurisdiction, maintains an obligations register, and offers agentic legal research with fully cited sources. It serves compliance teams in financial services, health and P&C insurance, and consumer tech. Backed by Greylock. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Scalyr
providers.description: Scalyr was a cloud log management, server monitoring, and observability platform for engineering, DevOps, and security teams, known for an index-free, columnar architecture delivering sub-second queries across hundreds of terabytes of structured and unstructured log data. Founded in 2011, Scalyr was acquired by SentinelOne in 2021 and rebranded as DataSet; the scalyr.com domain now redirects to dataset.com. Its REST API (hosted at app.scalyr.com) covered log ingestion (addEvents), querying, and account/file management via API-key authentication. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta, gv, and susa-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Signal Advisors
providers.description: Signal Advisors is a financial technology company building an integrated software platform for independent financial advisors and insurance professionals. The Signal Platform consolidates annuity, life insurance, and wealth management workflows into a single system, replacing the traditional Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) model. Product lines include Signal Annuity (quoting, design, and submission), Signal Wealth (portfolio and compliance management), and Signal Life (life-insurance workflow automation), with features such as real-time carrier status updates (TrueStatus), fast commission payouts (TruePay), AI-generated policy summaries, and integrated householding. The company operates a closed, account-based advisor portal and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Talk-A-Bot
providers.description: Talk-A-Bot is a Budapest-based, Techstars-backed enterprise chatbot company building compliance-first conversational AI for regulated industries including banking, healthcare, government, retail, and HR. Its platform emphasizes "zero hallucination" answers grounded only in verified knowledge bases, full conversation logging and audit trails, EU-based infrastructure with on-premise deployment options, and daily human review. Products include an FAQ Chatbot, an Agentic Chatbot, FeedbackHub, and the CHEQ internal-communications assistant, deployed across web, mobile, Messenger, and Viber. The company markets an API-first architecture for integrating with customer systems (CRM, ERP, payments, ticketing, HR) but publishes no public self-serve developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK; engagement is full-service. Compliance posture spans HIPAA, DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

providers.name: Thndr
providers.description: Thndr is an Egyptian investment and brokerage mobile app that lets retail users open a regulated brokerage account and invest in Egyptian Exchange (EGX) stocks, US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, and IPOs from their phone. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Cairo, Thndr is licensed by Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) and registered with the Egyptian Exchange as a brokerage, positioning itself as a low-cost, mobile-first gateway to the capital markets across Egypt and the wider MENA region. The company raised a $20M Series A in 2022 led by Tiger Global with participation from Prosus Ventures and others, and has been recognized among Forbes Middle East's top fintech companies. Thndr's product surface is a consumer investing app (iOS, Android, and a web account-access portal) with an educational Learn hub and a customer support center; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Tripo3D
providers.description: Tripo3D (by VAST) is an AI 3D generation platform with text-to-3D, image-to-3D, mesh refinement, and texturing APIs producing game-ready 3D assets. The Tripo API uses an async task-based REST pattern at https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/openapi/task. Authenticate with API key.

providers.name: Vake
providers.description: VAKE is a Norwegian maritime domain awareness company that detects, identifies, and tracks "dark vessels" from space. The VAKE platform fuses satellite imagery, AIS signals, and machine learning to reveal hidden vessel activity at sea for governments and industry. Its three products are Pathfinder, which reconstructs a vessel's past, present, and predicted movements and searches satellite imagery for vessels that go AIS-dark; Overwatch, which monitors an Area of Interest around ports, critical infrastructure, and economic zones to surface unreported activity such as illegal fishing, transshipments, and spoofing; and Clearview, a machine-learning service that identifies dark-vessel observations in multispectral satellite imagery against a global vessel-signature database spanning 2016 to today. The platform is delivered as a web application (studio.vake.ai) backed by a private API (api.nemme.io); onboarding is sales-led rather than self-serve.

providers.name: Waterfall
providers.description: Waterfall is a sequential software development methodology where progress flows steadily downward through defined phases including requirements, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance. It emphasizes thorough documentation, fixed-scope planning, and phase-gate reviews before proceeding to subsequent stages. Waterfall remains widely used in regulated industries, government contracting, and projects with well-understood, stable requirements.

providers.name: Withcoverage
providers.description: WithCoverage is a technology-driven risk management and commercial insurance platform that aims to replace the traditional insurance broker for growing businesses. It pairs a team of insurance advisors, claims specialists, and attorneys with an AI-powered digital platform to analyze policies, reduce premiums, manage certificates of insurance, and handle claims proactively as companies scale. Headquartered in New York City and backed by venture investors including 8vc, WithCoverage operates in the insurtech sector. This API Evangelist profile was created as a portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the company currently exposes no public developer API surface (client access is through the app.withcoverage.com web application).

providers.name: 8fig
providers.description: 8fig is an eCommerce growth platform and direct lender that provides continuous, revenue-based funding and cash-flow planning technology to online sellers on Amazon, Shopify, and other marketplaces. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Miami, Florida (with R&D in Tel Aviv), 8fig offers funding of up to $10 million through its Growth Plan product, using proprietary AI-driven cash-flow modeling to align capital disbursements to a seller's supply-chain costs. 8fig also exposes an integration/partnership program that lets platforms embed its funding tools, though it does not publish a public developer portal or API reference.

providers.name: Abra
providers.description: Abra is a digital asset wealth and treasury management platform founded in 2014 that provides institutional-grade services for high-net-worth individuals, institutions, corporations, and family offices across all 50 US states. Its products include Vault (segregated-account custody built on Fireblocks MPC wallet technology), proprietary Yield strategies on BTC, ETH, SOL and stablecoins, crypto-backed loans up to 50% LTV, and institutional treasury management, OTC execution, staking, and advisory. The company reports $10B+ in transaction volume and $2.5B+ in loans processed, and is backed by Pantera Capital. Abra does not currently publish a public developer API, API documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Acre Open Data
providers.description: Acre Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 20 datasets.

providers.name: Adalah for IT Systems LLC
providers.description: Adalah for IT Systems LLC operates Qanoniah, a Saudi Arabian legal technology platform that enables companies to access, understand, and act on the latest and most accurate legal information and procedures in seconds. The AI-driven service targets legal and compliance teams across Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer surface has been discovered to date.

providers.name: Adept
providers.description: Adept was an AI research lab building action-taking foundation models (the ACT family) that can use software tools and complete tasks across business applications. In mid-2024, several Adept co-founders and senior researchers joined Amazon's AGI organization in a non-acquisition arrangement, and Amazon licensed Adept's technology. Adept the entity continues to exist, but it has no current public commercial API; its primary remaining footprint is open-source models published on Hugging Face (Fuyu-8B, Persimmon-8B) and historical research outputs (ACT-1, ACT-2).

providers.name: Admittedly
providers.description: myOptions (myoptions.org redirects to encourageme.com; operated as the Encourage platform by Encoura, LLC) is a free college and career planning platform for middle- and high-school students, families, and educators across the United States. Students explore colleges, majors, careers, and scholarships and get matched to institutions, while educators deliver guidance through lesson plans, preference forms, and reporting dashboards. The platform reports serving roughly 4 million students across 5,000 school districts and 10,000+ high schools in all 50 states and D.C., funded through partnerships with colleges and education providers rather than user fees. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or documentation surface, and no real /.well-known/ documents (all such paths return the SPA/404 catch-all). Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead under the stub slug 'admittedly'.

providers.name: Agentio
providers.description: Agentio is an AI-native platform for creator advertising that connects brands with content creators across YouTube, Meta, and beyond. The two-sided platform gives brands agentic tooling to build, automate, and scale creator programs — handling creator matching and vetting, performance prediction from first-party creator data, campaign management, full-funnel measurement, and optimization — while giving creators personalized opportunities from top brands without manual negotiation. Founded by Arthur Leopold and Jonathan Meyers and based in Brooklyn, New York, Agentio holds official API marketing-partner status with closed advertising ecosystems and has raised $56M total, including a $40M Series B led by Forerunner at a $340M valuation. Agentio operates a private product application (app.agentio.com) and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Agryco
providers.description: Agryco — trading as Agriconomie until its September 2024 rebrand — is a French online marketplace and e-commerce platform that sells agricultural supplies direct to farmers: mineral, organic and foliar fertilizers, conventional and organic seeds, phytosanitary products, animal nutrition and livestock equipment, plus tractor, spraying, harvesting and soil-working spare parts. Founded in 2014 by Clement Le Fournis, Dinh Nguyen and Paolin Pascot, the company operates a one-stop procurement site for professional farmers across France, Belgium, Germany, Spain and Italy, wrapping the catalog in advisory services (agronomy experts on the phone six days a week), fertilizer blending, equipment valuation and 60-day payment terms. It raised a EUR 60 million Series B in 2022 co-led by Treis Group, Temasek and Aliment Capital with Eurazeo participating, and publishes the Agrycomag technical magazine at agryco.com/blog. Agryco is an end-user commerce product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Ameren
providers.description: Ameren Corporation is a regulated electric and natural gas utility serving customers in Missouri and Illinois. The company provides reliable energy delivery, smart grid infrastructure, and renewable energy programs. Ameren Illinois implements the Green Button Connect My Data program (Share My Usage) based on the ESPI standard, enabling authorized third parties to access customer energy usage data. Ameren also operates a Renewables Portal for community solar generation owners and participates in grid modernization initiatives.

providers.name: AMP Robotics
providers.description: AMP Robotics (operating as AMP Sortation) is an artificial-intelligence company for the waste and recycling industry that designs, builds, and operates advanced, cost-competitive facilities to process single-stream recycling and municipal solid waste. Its Smart Sortation technology suite combines computer vision (real-time material characterization), high-speed air-jet sortation (Jet and MicroJet), and robotic-arm sortation (Delta) to raise material-recovery rates, cut contamination, and extend landfill life. The flagship AMP ONE platform delivers fully automated, facility-scale sortation processing from 10K to 1M+ tons annually for waste haulers, material-recovery facilities, and municipalities. AMP Robotics is a Google Ventures (GV) portfolio company. No public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal is published; this profile is maintained for network discovery and identity.

providers.name: Amperos
providers.description: Amperos provides AI-powered insurance claims management and revenue recovery for healthcare providers, using agentic AI to recover insurance revenue end-to-end and drive more collections, faster. The platform automates denial management, claims processing, and collections workflows while keeping human experts in the loop for complex cases, and integrates with major EHR / practice-management systems including eClinicalWorks, Athenahealth, NextGen, Epic, ModMed, and Dentrix. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Amperos exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; the product is delivered as a managed service and web application.

providers.name: AnswersNow
providers.description: AnswersNow is a virtual Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy provider for individuals with autism, delivering personalized, evidence-based care from board-certified behavior analysts (BCBAs) through its proprietary telehealth platform. Families access one-on-one therapy sessions, caregiver and parent training, and individualized treatment plans remotely, expanding access to ABA care in areas with limited in-person availability. AnswersNow accepts major insurance carriers including Medicaid, is BHCOE accredited and a CASP member organization, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company. This profile has been enriched with company identity and domain-security posture; AnswersNow publishes a consumer web application (web.getanswersnow.com) but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Applepie Capital
providers.description: ApplePie Capital is a San Francisco-based franchise-finance marketplace lender that connects franchisees and franchisors with the capital they need to start, refinance, and grow multi-unit franchise businesses. Founded in 2014 by Denise Thomas, the company operates an online lending platform focused exclusively on franchising, offering conventional term loans, SBA loans, refinancing, equipment financing, and accounts-receivable financing, and partnering with banks such as Fifth Third and providers like LSQ. ApplePie has provided billions in loans across 200+ franchise brand partners. It is backed by QED Investors and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a fintech company profile; no public API or developer program has been identified as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Aprende
providers.description: Aprende (Aprende Institute) is an online vocational education platform delivering Spanish-language courses and diplomados to Hispanic entrepreneurs and professionals across the United States and Latin America. The platform offers on-demand, mobile-friendly training across six main areas — gastronomy, entrepreneurship, wellness, beauty, skilled trades, and hospitality/events — taught by expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. It operates as a consumer education company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its identity and web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Arcol
providers.description: Arcol is a browser-based, real-time collaborative building design and documentation platform for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, often described as a "Figma for BIM." Founded in 2021 by Paul O'Carroll and based in New York City, Arcol keeps massing, floorplans, metrics, estimating, and construction documentation connected in a single cloud-native workspace so early design decisions stay constructible. It supports multiplayer editing (built on Liveblocks), IFC and Excel import/export, a Rhino integration, and AI-assisted modeling. Arcol is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Craft Ventures. A public plugin API and developer SDK are described on the roadmap but are not yet published, so this profile currently exposes no programmatic API surface.

providers.name: Arta
providers.description: Arta Finance (Arta Finance Wealth Management LLC) is a global digital wealth management platform that gives accredited investors and professionals from leading technology companies access to sophisticated investment strategies historically reserved for the ultra-wealthy and institutions. Its products include a High-Yield Cash Reserve (an automated U.S. Treasuries portfolio), curated private-market funds spanning private equity, private credit, real estate, venture capital and hedge funds, bespoke structured investments, private placement life insurance, and AI-assisted portfolio tools (AI for Wealth). Founded by former Google executives and backed by Ribbit Capital and other venture investors, Arta is an SEC-registered investment adviser (with a Singapore entity regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore), with clearing and custody provided by Pershing LLC. Arta operates as a consumer/member wealth application and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: ATC (Alquila tu cancha)
providers.description: ATC (Alquila Tu Cancha) is an Argentine sports-technology company, founded in 2020, that operates LATAM's leading platform for booking amateur sports venues — courts for football, padel, tennis and more — alongside cloud management software for the clubs and complexes that run them. Consumers search real-time availability by location, sport and time and reserve in a few steps through the ATC Sports mobile apps and web app, with online payments guaranteed via Mercado Pago. Clubs use the ATC management software to handle online reservations, cash control, reporting and service sales. ATC operates across eight-plus countries including Argentina, Peru, Chile, Uruguay, Panama, Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica and the United States, spanning 500-plus venues and more than 200,000 active players. The company is a 500 Global (500 Latam) portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal at this time; this profile tracks its public web presence.

providers.name: Atoms
providers.description: Atoms is a direct-to-consumer footwear brand founded in 2019 by Waqas Ali and Sidra Qasim and headquartered in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, New York. The company designs, develops, and sells minimalist everyday sneakers - notably its Model 000 and Model 001 lines - and differentiates itself with quarter-size sizing and the ability to buy a pair in two different sizes for each foot. Product features include lightweight foam cushioning, a copper-infused antimicrobial lining, stretch slip-on laces, and an 8mm heel-to-toe drop. Atoms sells online via a Shopify storefront and is backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, DST Global, and Serena Ventures. It has no public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: August AI
providers.description: August AI is a consumer health-AI companion that helps people understand their symptoms, lab reports, prescriptions, and medications, and connects them to licensed physicians through asynchronous, chat-based telehealth visits. Founded in 2022 by Anuruddh Mishra after a four-month misdiagnosis, August operates as a 24/7 health assistant available on iOS, Android, and WhatsApp, storing lab reports and conversation history in long-term memory to deliver personalized guidance. The service pairs a free AI symptom-assessment experience with paid online doctor consultations from board-certified MDs licensed across all 50 US states. August reports serving millions of users across 160+ countries in 30+ languages, and publishes medical benchmarks including 100% accuracy on the USMLE, 97.4% on MedQA, 99.4% on lab-report document processing, and 100% precision/recall on emergency escalation. It is backed by Accel and Claypond Capital. August is a consumer application and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: AWST
providers.description: AWST is the software company behind WorkRamen, a productivity and business-operations platform aimed at small and medium businesses, startups, agencies, and freelancers. WorkRamen brings meeting scheduling (with Google Calendar and Outlook sync, plus Google Meet and Zoom), trackable document sharing, secure e-signatures, routing forms, visitor management, and Stripe-based payment acceptance into a single workspace. AWST is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a SaaS product only — its brand domain awst.io redirects to workramen.com, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or API documentation surface could be found.

providers.name: Axiamatic
providers.description: Axiamatic is an enterprise-transformation AI platform that aims to de-risk and accelerate large modernization programs, claiming to cut up to 50% off the cost and timeline of enterprise transformations. Its agentic platform combines a Living Context Graph (a digital twin of a transformation program built from structured and unstructured data), autonomous Transformation Agents that detect risks such as translation loss, resistance, and cross-stream drift, role-specific Playbooks delivered into existing workflows, and Axia, an AI assistant available via voice, chat, Microsoft Teams, or Slack. It targets ERP modernization (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365), CRM consolidation (Salesforce, Dynamics), and supply-chain and business transformation. The company is backed by Greylock and announced a $54M raise. It was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it currently publishes a marketing site and a login application (app.axiamatic.com) but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Bahia Blanca Open Data
providers.description: Bahia Blanca Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Argentina running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 221 datasets.

providers.name: Bahia Open Data
providers.description: Bahia Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 21 datasets.

providers.name: Beewise
providers.description: Beewise is an agricultural technology company building the BeeHome, an AI- and robotics-enabled beehive that autonomously monitors, cares for, and protects honeybee colonies to reduce colony loss and deliver reliable pollination. Founded to address bee colony collapse, Beewise combines computer vision, robotics, and cloud software to detect pests and disease, regulate hive climate, and dispatch precision pollination for growers. The company serves growers with guaranteed pollination services, beekeepers with technology-enhanced hive management, and property owners through its Bees for Buildings program. Beewise is a venture-backed company (Insight Partners portfolio) surfaced into the API Evangelist network; it operates a customer grower portal but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Bellhops
providers.description: Bellhops (branded as Bellhop) is a US technology-enabled moving-services company that operates an online booking platform for residential and commercial relocations. Customers get a free estimate and reserve local moves, long-distance relocations, hourly moving labor, packing help, and last-minute moves with no money down, then manage their reservation through an online dashboard staffed by background-checked movers. The company reports more than 300,000 completed moves and a 4.8/5 average rating across 20,000+ reviews. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Bellhops is a consumer-facing service with no publicly documented API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Benchmark Minerals
providers.description: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence is the world's leading market intelligence and price reporting agency for the lithium-ion battery supply chain and energy transition materials. The company provides mine-to-grid supply chain data, price assessments, forecasts, and databases covering lithium, nickel, cobalt, graphite, batteries, electric vehicles, rare earths, and permanent magnets. Benchmark's proprietary price assessment methodologies are assured to Type 2 IOSCO standards. API access is available to subscribers for programmatic integration of price data, supply chain data, and market intelligence into business systems and analytics platforms.

providers.name: Bending Spoons
providers.description: Bending Spoons S.p.A. is a Milan, Italy technology company founded in 2013 that acquires established digital products and operates them for the long term rather than reselling them. Its portfolio spans more than 50 acquisitions and includes AOL, Brightcove, Eventbrite, Evernote, Harvest, Issuu, komoot, Loomly, Meetup, Remini, Splice, StreamYard, Tractive, Vimeo and WeTransfer, serving over 500 million monthly active users and more than 9 million monthly paying customers. The company listed its ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker BSP on 1 July 2026. Bending Spoons itself publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at the holding-company level: every API surface in the group belongs to an individual acquired product, each profiled separately in the API Evangelist network. What the corporate entity does publish is a PGP-signed RFC 9116 security.txt, a compliance hub, a support center, an investor relations site, and a small set of first-party open-source Swift frameworks (Katana, Tempura).

providers.name: Betterleap
providers.description: Betterleap is an AI-powered healthcare recruiting platform that automates candidate sourcing, credential verification, and multi-step outreach for talent acquisition teams. Its agentic search lets recruiters describe an ideal candidate conversationally and surfaces qualified matches from a database of 35M+ verified healthcare professionals, with licensing verified through 25+ state board partnerships. The platform autonomously drafts and sends personalized email sequences with follow-ups, integrates with ATS platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and UKG for talent rediscovery and data refresh, and reports recruiting performance and ROI through an insights dashboard. Betterleap is a venture-backed company (a16z portfolio) added to the API Evangelist network; it operates as a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Blidz
providers.description: Blidz is a membership-based social and gamified e-commerce platform ("Make Money, Save Money, Have Fun") offering deeply discounted deals across grocery, electronics, home goods, and other consumer categories through its iOS and Android shopping apps. Backed by General Catalyst, Blidz operates a consumer mobile marketplace rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web domain.

providers.name: Block Renovation
providers.description: Block Renovation is a home renovation and construction platform that connects homeowners with vetted, local contractors and provides free design, cost-estimation, and project-planning tools for kitchen and bathroom remodels, home additions, basement renovations, ADUs, new construction, and commercial projects. It operates across all 50 US states and layers on a protection program covering price assurance, progress-based payments, a workmanship warranty, and dedicated Project Planner support. Backed by Obvious Ventures and the SoftBank Vision Fund, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass Block Renovation publishes a consumer-facing marketplace but no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Bloxtel, Inc.
providers.description: Bloxtel, Inc. builds a decentralized private 5G platform that lets enterprises deploy standalone 5G networks in hours. Its all-in-one 5G Access Point runs Open6GC, Bloxtel's decentralized network core, and pairs with tokenized dSIM electronic-SIM technology and a Web3 Operator dApp for configuring networks, managing dSIM subscriptions, and AI-powered predictive maintenance. Solutions span indoor coverage, SIM-swap protection, neutral hosting, peer nodes, and network analytics, targeting lower latency, reduced threat surface, and lower cost versus traditional carrier deployments. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile Bloxtel publishes a marketing and lead-generation site only, with no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDK yet available.

providers.name: Booqed
providers.description: BOOQED is a Hong Kong-based proptech company building flexible workplace technology that turns underutilized real estate into bookable, on-demand workspace. Its flagship product QUBIC is a line of sound-isolating, modular smart booths and work pods (for one to six people) with soundproofing, ventilation, power, and a proprietary access-control system managed through a mobile web app. Alongside the hardware, BOOQED offers space-management SaaS that makes existing meeting rooms and desks bookable and trackable with utilization analytics, plus the BOOQED app for individuals to book hot desks and meeting rooms on demand across Hong Kong, Singapore, and Shenzhen. Founded by David Wong, Charles Oh, and Ken Huang, BOOQED went through the Colliers and Techstars proptech accelerator and raised seed funding in 2019. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; BOOQED does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: BoxGreen
providers.description: BoxGreen (BoxGreen Pte. Ltd., incorporated 2014 in Singapore) is a Certified B Corporation and social enterprise selling all-natural, individually packaged healthy snacks direct to consumers and to businesses. Its consumer offering is a Shopify-based e-commerce store with build-your-own snack boxes, curated collections (nut mixes, crunchies, vegan and gluten-free ranges), gift and party packs, and a subscription delivery model; its B2B side covers corporate gifting, office pantry supply, and cashless healthy-snack vending machines. Every BoxGreen snack is packed in prison by beneficiaries of Singapore's Yellow Ribbon Project to build skills and employability. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company, BoxGreen publishes no first-party API or developer program; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is Shopify's New Customer Accounts OIDC/OAuth discovery.

providers.name: Brightside
providers.description: Brightside (Brightside Benefit, Inc.) is an employer-sponsored financial care benefit that helps working families reduce everyday money stress. Delivered as an employee benefit through employers, Brightside pairs each employee with a human Financial Assistant and a mobile/web app offering emergency cash and loans, debt management and credit-score improvement, savings and early wage access, bill negotiation, crisis support (eviction, utilities, food), and guidance through major life events. The company is backed by a16z, Obvious Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Brightside is a consumer-facing benefits platform and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: BRKZ
providers.description: BRKZ is a Saudi Arabian construction-technology company operating a B2B online marketplace for building materials and construction equipment. Positioned as a top online building materials store in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), the platform connects contractors and construction businesses with material suppliers, streamlining procurement and offering nationwide delivery across Saudi Arabia. The bilingual (Arabic and English) storefront lets buyers source construction supplies online, and the company is backed by 500 Global among its investors. This profile was enriched from BRKZ's public web presence; the company runs a private, authenticated API host (api.brkz.com) but does not publish a public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: buynomics
providers.description: Buynomics is a Cologne, Germany-based software company providing an AI-powered Revenue Growth Management (RGM) platform for consumer goods, retail, telecom, and consumer software companies. Its proprietary "Virtual Shoppers AI" runs agent-based simulations of consumer purchasing behavior so commercial teams can optimize pricing, promotions, price pack architecture (product mix), and trade terms before going to market — capturing cross- effects, cannibalization, and competitive response. The platform's Decision Guide generates prescriptive recommendations from thousands of evaluated scenarios. Buynomics is used by brands including Unilever, Nestle, L'Oreal, Danone, General Mills, Vodafone, and Ferrero, and is backed by Insight Partners and Seedcamp. The product is delivered as a web application; no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: Capstack
providers.description: Capstack Technologies operates a digital bank-to-bank marketplace that lets banks, credit unions, and other financial institutions trade whole loans and loan participations, access liquidity, and manage portfolio concentration risk. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Miami, FL, the SaaS platform integrates with originating banks' core banking systems and loan-origination systems (LOS) to surface loans available for syndication, then lets participating institutions search by criteria, ask questions live, and submit bids. It adds loan servicing (payment processing, remittance reporting, loan status tracking) and real-time portfolio analytics, specializing in commercial real estate, multifamily residential, and farmland loans. The marketplace has featured over $2B in assets across 200+ registered banks and credit unions. Capstack is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Citi Ventures. This is a private enterprise platform accessed via a demo/onboarding flow; no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Carbon Robotics
providers.description: Carbon Robotics is a Seattle-based physical-AI and agricultural robotics company building autonomous systems that help farmers cut costs and reduce chemical use. Its flagship LaserWeeder G2 uses computer vision and high-power lasers to eliminate weeds without herbicides, and its Carbon Autonomy product adds remote-supervised autonomy to compatible John Deere tractors. The underlying Carbon AI Large Plant Model is trained on 150 million labeled plants across 15 countries and 100+ crops. Carbon Robotics operates a customer grower cloud portal and Starlink-connected fleet control, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal as of this profiling.

providers.name: CareLuLu
providers.description: CareLuLu is a consumer marketplace that helps parents find and compare licensed child care — home daycares, child care centers, and preschools. Families can search across roughly 200,000 licensed programs and filter by location, age, hours, tuition, and availability, then view photos, verified parent reviews, and schedule tours or consultations. The service is positioned as an easy, fast, and free way to find safe, high-quality, affordable child care, and it also lets providers list and market their programs to local parents. Backed by 500 Global. Note — CareLuLu runs a consumer web application (an AMP/React SPA) and an internal API host (api.carelulu.com), but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — this profile captures its public website and identity surface only.

providers.name: Caribou
providers.description: Caribou is a Denver-based fintech that helps drivers lower their monthly car payments by refinancing existing auto loans through a network of banks, credit unions, and community lenders. Customers check personalized rates with a soft credit pull (no score impact), compare offers, add co-borrowers, and complete refinancing online, and can bundle optional vehicle protection plans. Caribou reports 150,000+ customers and average savings of about $162/month. The company exposes a consumer web application and a contact-gated partner integration program (click-out and API options for affiliates); it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API at this time.

providers.name: Carmoola
providers.description: Carmoola is a UK-based, mobile-first car finance platform that lets consumers get a pre-approved budget in minutes through its app, then pay dealers or private sellers directly with a virtual card. It offers Hire Purchase (HP) and Personal Contract Purchase (PCP) financing, soft credit checks that do not affect the applicant's score, flexible repayment terms, and the ability to refinance an existing car loan. Carmoola is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and is backed by investors including QED Investors. This profile was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Carmoola operates a consumer app rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: CarNow
providers.description: CarNow is an AI-enabled conversion platform built specifically for automotive dealerships, helping them turn more website visitors into leads, more leads into sales, and more buyers into lifelong service customers. Its product suite spans website solutions (AI-powered chat, digital retail, and shop-by-payment experiences), sales follow-up automation (Cruise Control, which prioritizes high-intent shoppers and automates nurture workflows), and service retention (Lane Assist, which drives post-sale engagement and service scheduling). CarNow works with more than 4,000 dealer partners and integrates with major OEM programs including Acura, Audi, BMW, Ford, General Motors, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, Land Rover, and Lexus. The company is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina and is backed by Battery Ventures. CarNow does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; its api.carnow.com endpoint is a partner/internal AWS API Gateway that requires authentication.

providers.name: Catalant
providers.description: Catalant is a consulting platform that connects organizations with a global marketplace of experienced independent consultants and boutique firms, positioning itself as "Consulting 2.0" fit-to-purpose consulting that is faster, more flexible, and more cost efficient than traditional large consulting firms. Its network spans 10,000+ vetted consultants (many from Fortune 500 companies and top-tier consulting firms, averaging 19+ years of experience) and serves 700+ businesses across 20+ countries. Catalant covers engagement areas including Digital & AI, Transformation & Value Creation, Operations, Sales & Marketing, M&A / Integration & Separation, Strategy & Finance, and Organization & People. Catalant is a General Catalyst portfolio company. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, and support properties.

providers.name: Chamber Cardio
providers.description: Chamber Cardio is a Washington, D.C.-based healthcare technology company building a cardiology-focused platform for value-based care. Chamber partners with cardiology practices and health plans to align clinical signals, workflows, and patient data so cardiologists can identify high-risk patients earlier, close gaps against treatment guidelines, and reduce administrative burden. Its workflow-integrated AI surfaces clearer signal from the large volumes of cardiovascular data generated in care, supporting better patient outcomes and financial predictability for payers as cardiology moves beyond fee-for-service. The company supports more than 500 cardiologists across seven states and raised a $60M Series A led by Frist Cressey Ventures, with participation from General Catalyst, AlleyCorp, American Family Ventures, Company Ventures, Optum Ventures, Healthworx Ventures, and Black Opal Ventures. Chamber does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; its platform is built on a FHIR-based data stack (Medplum) with internal REST and GraphQL services.

providers.name: ChangEd
providers.description: ChangEd (Changed) is a consumer financial-technology company whose mobile app helps people pay off debt faster by automatically rounding up everyday purchases to the nearest dollar and directing those micro-savings toward student loans, credit cards, mortgages, personal loans, and auto loans. Founded by brothers Dan Stelmach and Nick Sky, the app launched in 2017, appeared on Shark Tank and took investment from Mark Cuban, and is a Techstars portfolio company. It links to a user's bank account, tracks spending, automates extra debt payments, supports savings goals, and visualizes payoff progress for a $4/month subscription, with banking services provided by nbkc bank (Member FDIC). ChangEd is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clearco
providers.description: Clearco is a fintech company providing non-dilutive, revenue-based capital to direct-to-consumer ecommerce and SaaS businesses, having deployed over $3 billion across more than 10,000 funded companies. Its funding products include Fixed Funding Capacity, Rolling Funding Capacity, Cash Advance, and Invoice Funding, with capped weekly payments and funding decisions within 24 hours. Clearco connects to a founder's existing commerce and payments stack (Amazon, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Square, BigCommerce) to underwrite revenue, rather than exposing a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Emergence Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface is currently published.

providers.name: Club Feast
providers.description: Club Feast is a technology-enabled restaurant delivery and corporate catering company founded in 2020 by Atallah Atallah, Ghazi Atallah, and Chris Miao. It began as a subscription-based consumer meal service delivering signature dishes from neighborhood restaurants at deep discounts through a pre-order, scheduled batch-delivery model, and has since focused on corporate catering, group meal ordering with individual customization, event catering, and managed office pantry services for teams. Club Feast handles restaurant partnerships, menu curation, driver logistics, and delivery while employees select meals through its web app. The company raised seed funding led by General Catalyst and operates primarily in the San Francisco Bay Area. Club Feast does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile tracks its company identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clubessential
providers.description: Clubessential is a Cincinnati-based provider of club management software for private country, golf, city, athletic, and yacht clubs. Its cloud suite unifies club websites and mobile apps, tee-time and dining reservations, membership CRM, point-of-sale, accounting, business intelligence, and integrated payments so club staff can manage operations and member experiences from a single platform. Part of Clubessential Holdings (unified under Xplor Technologies alongside ClubReady, foreUP, Vermont Systems, PrestoSports, and Exerp), the company serves more than 1,300 private clubs and, with its sister brands, thousands of courses and clubs worldwide. Backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: CNC24
providers.description: CNC24 is a German online manufacturing platform for ordering custom CNC parts and precision components. Customers upload CAD files (STEP, STP, DWG, DXF, PDF and 3D data) and receive a binding quote within 48 hours, with production routed through a vetted network of 500+ manufacturers across 21 countries and roughly 5,500 machines. An AI-powered matching algorithm assigns each request to partners with the right expertise and production environment. Supported processes include CNC milling, turning, laser and waterjet cutting, sheet metal bending, punching, EDM, 3D printing, injection molding and die casting, serving aerospace, automotive, medical, robotics, construction and energy customers. The platform runs a fully digital workflow from quoting to delivery with order tracking, ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance, AES-256 encryption and anonymized drawings shared with partners. CNC24 is a Seedcamp portfolio company. No public developer API, SDKs or API documentation are published.

providers.name: Common Sense Machines
providers.description: Common Sense Machines (CSM) builds 3D world models with image-to-3D and 3D world simulation APIs aimed at games, robotics, and synthetic data. The CSM Cube product family released a single-click model pipeline with mesh-parts-based topology in early 2026. API access is bundled with mid-tier and enterprise CSM subscription plans.

providers.name: Con.doit
providers.description: Con.doit (condoit.io) is a digital platform for electrical contractors that turns field-captured electrical infrastructure data into recurring service revenue. Its mobile capture app collects on-site photos, thermal scans, and system data, then generates same-day infrared thermography reports, auto-updating single-line diagrams, asset tags, arc flash studies, and NFPA 70B preventive-maintenance programs. Con.doit is a FLIR Global Approved App and reports over 4.5 million electrical assets under management across 2,000+ critical facilities nationwide. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification is currently published; this profile is enriched from the public marketing surface only.

providers.name: Corca
providers.description: Corca is an AI-native, collaborative workspace for mathematics — a browser-based editor that lets people write math naturally (without special syntax), run calculations in real time, and collaborate the way teams do in Figma or Google Docs. Typing keywords like "sum" or "integral" surfaces the right symbols and functions, documents import from and export to LaTeX, and built-in AI helps solve problems, manipulate expressions, and generate code without switching tools. It is used for lab research, lecture creation, team knowledge bases, and publishing academic work. Founded in 2023 and based in New York, Corca raised a $7.8M round (led by NEA, with Bloomberg Beta, NVIDIA's NVentures, Daft Capital, Slow Ventures, Liquid 2, Path Ventures, and Mana Ventures). The product is a consumer/team SaaS application; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Cowbell
providers.description: Cowbell is a Pleasanton, California-based adaptive cyber insurance provider serving small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) and the middle market with standalone cyber liability coverage, technology errors & omissions (Tech E&O), management liability, and excess cyber products. Founded in 2019, Cowbell pioneered continuous underwriting through its proprietary Cowbell Factors risk benchmarking, which scores organizations against millions of data points to surface vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation. The company pairs its policies with a closed-loop resiliency program (assess-insure-respond-improve) that includes complimentary risk assessments, Cowbell Insights threat detection, incident response planning, cybersecurity awareness training, micro-penetration testing, and vendor risk assessments, plus subscription-based managed detection and response (MDR), penetration testing, identity monitoring (IdentityAI), and Compliance-as-a-Service (COMPaaS). Cowbell operates across the United States (all 50 states plus DC), the United Kingdom, and Australia, is backed by reinsurance partners including Zurich, and offers a public developer program at developers.cowbellcyber.ai exposing REST APIs for agencies, accounts, risk factors, quoting, binding, policy management, and webhooks across its Prime 100, Prime 250, and PrimeOne products. The API surface powers digital aggregator integrations with partners such as Bold Penguin, Herald, Semsee, Sayata, Limit, iBynd, and AmWins. No public OpenAPI specification or open-source SDK is published by Cowbell.

providers.name: Creative Market
providers.description: Creative Market is an online marketplace for community-generated design assets, where independent creators sell fonts, graphics, illustrations, templates, photos, icons, mockups, add-ons, and 3D assets to designers and businesses. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, the platform operates a storefront and seller dashboard model with per-product commercial licensing, an affiliate and ambassador program, a design blog, and enterprise sales. As of this enrichment pass Creative Market publishes no public developer API, API documentation, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity, published policy and support surfaces, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Curtsy
providers.description: Curtsy is a mobile-first resale marketplace for secondhand women's fashion, focused on Gen Z and young-millennial shoppers roughly ages 15 to 30. Through its free iOS and Android apps, users buy and sell trending clothing, shoes, and accessories from brands like Lululemon, Free People, and SKIMS, saving up to 70% off retail. Curtsy holds no inventory of its own — sellers ship directly to buyers using prepaid shipping labels and free Curtsy-branded starter kits — and the company earns a 20% fee on each completed sale. Founded in 2016 as part of Y Combinator's Summer 2016 batch and headquartered in San Francisco, Curtsy has raised venture funding from Canaan Partners and Index Ventures. Curtsy is a consumer app with no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: CyberTalents
providers.description: CyberTalents is a global cybersecurity platform that ranks and connects security talent with employers based on real, hands-on skills. The platform automates Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, delivers cybersecurity courses and training camps, runs technical assessments for enterprises, and provides recruitment and headhunting services to close the global cybersecurity skills gap. Backed by 500 Global, CyberTalents operates from Egypt, the UAE, and the United States and hosts one of the largest cybersecurity practice communities in the world. This API Evangelist profile tracks CyberTalents as a company; no public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Dare Drop
providers.description: Dare Drop is a gaming influencer marketing platform that connects game publishers and brands with content creators across Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. The platform runs reward-driven "Dares" — challenges that incentivize streamers and creators to produce longer, more engaging content around a title, while automating creator targeting, campaign management, and reporting. Dare Drop offers influencer campaigns, ongoing influencer programs, and organic outreach, and has facilitated over 18,000 publisher Dares and distributed more than 30,000 rewards to creator communities. Its customers include game studios and publishers such as EA, Respawn, Raw Fury, Tencent, Obsidian, and Gearbox. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: DAS Technology
providers.description: DAS Technology (formerly Digital Air Strike) is an automotive-retail marketing and customer-experience technology company serving more than 9,300 dealerships and OEMs. Its AI-native CDXP (Customer Data and Experience Platform) unifies sales, service, and retention data across three product lines: Attract (multi-channel digital advertising across Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Amazon, and TikTok), Convert (AI-powered lead response, instant quotes, and long-cycle nurturing), and Retain (reputation management, equity mining, and service-retention campaigns). DAS Technology publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or self-serve developer portal; this profile captures its public company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Datafy
providers.description: Datafy is a location-analytics and advertising platform, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Ogden, Utah, that helps destinations and communities turn visitation, spending, and behavioral signals into marketing decisions. It serves travel and tourism boards, attractions, downtowns, retail partners, and civic organizations with three core offerings — data analytics, targeted advertising, and real-world attribution — alongside Tally, an attendance-measurement product. The company reports 500+ clients and states that it maintains SOC 2 compliance. Datafy operates a client portal at portal.datafyhq.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Datumate
providers.description: Datumate is a construction technology company whose cloud-native SaaS platform, DatuBIM, turns drone imagery, laser-scanning, and site data into real-time progress tracking, deviation detection, automated reporting, and actionable analytics for heavy civil infrastructure projects. It serves asset owners, general contractors, and engineering and consulting firms across roads, highways, rail, bridges, and earthworks, giving multi-site visibility from design validation through construction to final inspection. The company reports 125+ active customers, thousands of managed sites, and tens of thousands of processed drone flights. Datumate has Israeli engineering roots (Technion) with leadership based in Miami, Florida, and is backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: defi SOLUTIONS
providers.description: defi SOLUTIONS is an auto and consumer lending technology company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Westlake, Texas. It provides cloud-native, API-enabled loan origination software (defi ORIGINATIONS), a servicing platform for account, collateral, and default management, digital borrower acquisition and self-service portals, and outsourced (BPO) managed servicing. The platform serves captive auto finance companies, banks, credit unions, and consumer finance companies, and ships 135+ pre-built partner integrations (Dealertrack, RouteOne, TransUnion, Equifax, LexisNexis, Experian, Black Book, J.D. Power, Zest AI, and more). APIs move borrower and loan data between origination and servicing but are exposed to enterprise customers and integration partners rather than through a public developer portal.

providers.name: DevAI
providers.description: DevAI (DevAI Solutions, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley enterprise IT company, founded in 2024 by Susie Wee (CEO) and Edwin Zhang, that builds agentic AI for IT operations teams. Its DevAI Network Intelligence Engine reconciles data across fragmented IT tools of record (CMDB, vCenter, NetBox and other infrastructure, network, compute, and security systems) into a single trustworthy operational view, and its Network Intelligence Agent "Neo" streamlines IT planning, incident response, patch management, and security and compliance workflows through a chat interface. DevAI reports deployment at Fortune 50 enterprises and won Best-in-Show (Automation) at the AI Networking Summit 2025. The company raised a $6M seed round led by Emergence Capital with Pear VC, Base10 Partners, and Benchstrength. No public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Diagonal Therapeutics
providers.description: Diagonal Therapeutics is a Watertown, Massachusetts clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2022 by CEO Alex Lugovskoy in partnership with Atlas Venture, developing "clustering" agonist antibodies that switch broken signaling pathways back on rather than inhibiting them. Its DIAGONAL product engine pairs computational epitope filtering with experimental screening — generating roughly 200,000 candidate antibody sequences per target, clustering them by predicted shape, binning by receptor complementarity and assembling multispecific antibodies from those bins — to make agonist antibody discovery tractable. The lead program, DIAG723, is a first-in-class ALK1:BMPRII clustering agonist antibody that restores ALK1 signaling; it holds US FDA and EMA orphan drug designation for hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT) and entered the Phase 1/2 DIAMOND trial (NCT07623525), with a first patient dosed in July 2026, alongside preclinical work in pulmonary arterial hypertension. The pipeline extends into hematology, hepatology, nephrology and cardiovascular disease. The company has raised roughly USD 255 million across a USD 128 million Series A (April 2024, co-led by BVF Partners and Atlas Venture) and an oversubscribed USD 125 million Series B (January 2026, co-led by Sanofi Ventures and Janus Henderson Investors). Diagonal is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it operates a Next.js marketing site backed by a Sanity CMS, and publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Dialogue AI
providers.description: Dialogue AI is an AI-native customer and market research platform, founded in 2025 and backed by a Lightspeed Venture Partners seed round, that helps product, design, and research teams uncover customer needs, test ideas, and capture authentic feedback through adaptive AI-moderated interviews. The platform automates the research workflow end to end — study design, participant recruitment (including a Prolific partnership), AI-led interviewing across multiple research formats, and real-time reporting and insight synthesis — so organizations can make agile, data-driven decisions aligned with real-world market changes. Dialogue AI is a web application (app.dialogueai.com) rather than a public developer API provider; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dimension
providers.description: Dimension is a nationwide, on-demand waste management and junk removal platform (formerly Trash Warrior) backed by 500 Global. It offers digital booking with instant AI-generated pricing (their "Mirror Mirror AI" quoter), same-day and next-day pickup for cardboard, appliances, mattresses, hazardous and medical waste, plus dumpster rentals, for both businesses and individuals. Every job includes tracking with detailed diversion data, receipts, and photos, and can be booked as a one-off or recurring service. Dimension has been awarded a State of California RFP contract for PPE waste removal. The company operates a customer-facing booking application and help center but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Divi Official
providers.description: Divi Official Inc. (Divi Growth Care) is a direct-to-consumer haircare and scalp-care brand formulated "for women by women," selling vegan, science-backed serums, shampoos, conditioners and supplements aimed at the hair-growth journey. The company operates an e-commerce storefront hosted on Shopify at diviofficial.com, with a subscription "Club Divi" program, a content blog, and a customer-account experience. Divi is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It is a consumer packaged goods / beauty commerce business and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify Customer Accounts OAuth/OIDC discovery documents that the storefront platform exposes. This profile captures the company's public identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dollar Shave
providers.description: Dollar Shave Club is a direct-to-consumer men's grooming and personal-care brand founded in 2011 and acquired by Unilever in 2016, best known for pioneering the subscription razor model that ships blades, shave butter, skincare and body-care products to members on a recurring schedule. The company sells through its own e-commerce storefront (dollarshaveclub.com, built on Shopify) as well as retail channels, offering razor handles and cartridges, grooming kits and gift sets. It surfaces in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Dollar Shave Club does not operate a public developer program or documented API; its digital surface is a consumer Shopify storefront whose only machine-discoverable interface is Shopify's customer-account OAuth/OIDC (including a customer-account MCP API scope) exposed at the store's /.well-known/ discovery endpoints.

providers.name: Earnest
providers.description: Earnest is a technology-driven consumer finance lender headquartered in San Francisco, offering student loan refinancing, private student loans, Parent PLUS loan refinancing, and personal loans through Earnest Operations LLC and its bank partner FinWise Bank. Founded in 2013 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Battery Ventures, and Slow Ventures, Earnest uses data-driven underwriting and merit-based pricing to serve borrowers, reporting more than $24 billion in student loans refinanced and over 420,000 clients. Earnest is a consumer-facing lending brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile captures its public web, security, and legal surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: EAS Innovations Inc
providers.description: EAS Innovations Inc operates ELEV8, an end-to-end, cloud-based dealer management system (DMS) built for independent auto dealers and automotive finance companies. The platform unifies real-time accounting, inventory management, CRM and desking, loan servicing, payments and collections into a single fully-integrated system. It offers per-seat pricing, user-based access rights, user-level audit logs, whitelisted IP addresses, multi-rooftop access and department-level restrictions, and is delivered as a SaaS web application at app.elev8dms.com. EAS Innovations is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Easop
providers.description: Easop is a global equity compensation platform that helps startups and growing companies award and manage employee stock options and equity incentives across 70+ countries. It automates the legal workflows, board consents, country-specific tax and regulatory compliance, and employee education required to grant equity to international teams, and offers equity projection and compensation-grid planning plus integrations with cap-table tools such as Carta and Pulley. Easop was acquired by Remote in 2024. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company; Easop is a business SaaS application and publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Eden
providers.description: Eden is a Latin American healthcare technology company providing cloud-based medical imaging and radiology software for hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers. Its platform includes Eden PACS (a cloud picture archiving and communication system and DICOM viewer), Eden Management (scheduling, referral, and operational workflow tools), Eden Intelligence (data-driven analytics for medical institutions), and Eden Creator (an AI assistant for drafting diagnostic impressions). Eden is backed by Sierra Ventures and serves medical institutions across Latin America. No public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Emma
providers.description: Emma (by EDAILABS) is an AI-powered English language learning application built around a 3D interactive avatar tutor that offers real-time spoken conversation practice, instant pronunciation and grammar corrections, and personalized, adaptive learning paths. Positioned as "more than just a chatbot," the app models native accents and speech patterns for judgment-free practice available 24/7, and reports more than 500,000 users. It is a consumer iOS mobile application backed by Seedcamp; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Entre Rios Open Data
providers.description: Entre Rios Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Argentina running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 121 datasets.

providers.name: EquityBee
providers.description: EquityBee is a fintech marketplace that helps startup employees fund the exercise of their stock options before those options expire, giving them the cash needed to purchase their equity while the company is still private. On the other side of the marketplace, EquityBee connects accredited investors with the opportunity to invest in pre-IPO companies by funding those employee option exercises in exchange for a share of the future proceeds. Founded in 2018, the company operates a two-sided platform spanning startup employees, accredited investors, and the private companies whose equity underlies each funded position. EquityBee publishes a public marketing and account website but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Espirito Santo Open Data
providers.description: Espirito Santo Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 452 datasets.

providers.name: Ethiopia Open Data
providers.description: Ethiopia Open Data is a national government open-data portal for Ethiopia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 3 datasets.

providers.name: Eventnoire
providers.description: Eventnoire is an event discovery and ticketing platform centered on Black culture, helping attendees find and buy tickets to concerts, festivals, parties, and community events while giving organizers tools to create and manage events, sell tickets, and grow their audiences. A Techstars-backed company, Eventnoire runs consumer discovery at eventnoire.com alongside an organizer/partner portal and a culture-focused blog. It currently exposes no public developer API, so this profile captures the company's public web surface (blog, legal, organizer sign-up, attendee login, support) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Fashinza
providers.description: Fashinza is a tech-enabled apparel manufacturing and supply-chain platform that connects fashion brands and retailers with a vetted global network of garment manufacturers. It streamlines end-to-end production: sourcing designs and fabrics, AI-powered supplier matching, tech-pack and sample creation, real-time production tracking, quality control, and merchandising and forecasting support so brands can move from design to delivery in shortened 30-45 day cycles. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates a buyer login and a supplier onboarding surface but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: FIFOplus
providers.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Filmhub
providers.description: Filmhub is a global film and television sales and distribution company that operates a self-service marketplace connecting independent filmmakers and rights holders directly to more than 100 streaming channels and platforms worldwide, including Tubi, Plex, Xumo, Amazon, Fandor, and others across AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, and FAST business models. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Los Angeles, Filmhub charges no upfront listing fees and instead earns a 20 percent share of the royalties generated by the distribution deals it facilitates. Filmmakers upload their titles, technical specifications, and metadata to the Filmhub app; channel partners browse the catalog and license the content they want; and Filmhub manages technical delivery, revenue collection, and reporting. The company is backed by a16z and other investors. Filmhub does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Firstjob.me
providers.description: FirstJob (firstjob.me) is a Latin American employment platform founded in Chile in 2012 to improve working conditions for young professionals by connecting students and early-career candidates (0-2 years of experience) with entry-level jobs and internships at large employers. The platform lists 1,200+ active opportunities across engineering, administration, operations, and technology, maintains an employer directory, and runs networking events and webinars. It also operates related initiatives including Employers For Youth (EFY) and Best Internship Experiences (BIE) employer-ranking programs. FirstJob is a consumer-facing web platform used by more than 500,000 young professionals; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, SDKs, or a developer portal. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: flatfair
providers.description: flatfair is a UK-based tenancy deposit platform for letting agents, landlords, and Build-to-Rent operators, offering deposit alternatives and deposit administration products. Its products include No Deposit (tenants pay 28% of one month's rent plus VAT instead of a five-week cash deposit), Deposits, Unlock Deposits, Deposit Boost, tenant Referencing, and Tenant Guarantor. flatfair is used by more than 850 agents and Build-to-Rent operators to reduce move-in friction and cut deposit administration time by around 60 minutes per tenancy. The company operates a web application for agents and tenants but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Flease
providers.description: Flease is a French vehicle-leasing marketplace offering flexible long-term (LLD, 24-50 month) and medium-term (LMD, 1-12 month) car and utility-vehicle rental to SMEs and small businesses. It sources quasi-new vehicles (under two years old, fewer than 30,000 km), delivers within a week for LMD and a month for LLD, and bundles a fleet-management web application (webapp.flease.fr) for tracking mileage, drivers, maintenance, contracts, and invoices. Flease positions on transparent pricing and a roughly 20% lower total cost of ownership versus traditional leasing, with a circular-economy angle of redeploying used vehicles. Backed by Partech. No public developer API or documentation is published; the customer-facing webapp is a Vue single-page app authenticated with AWS Cognito.

providers.name: Fleek
providers.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital.
