The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

providers.name: Scoutbee
providers.description: Scoutbee is an AI-powered supplier discovery and procurement intelligence platform that helps enterprise buyers instantly find, vet, and connect with trusted suppliers. Founded in 2015 in Berlin, Germany, Scoutbee uses large language models, knowledge-graph technology, and a global supplier network to power supplier discovery, sourcing project execution (Streamline), and a centralized supplier data foundation (DeepSee), surfaced through the Scoutbee Intelligence Platform. Its AI gives procurement, sourcing, and category-management teams recommendations for suppliers matched on qualifications, risk, certifications, sustainability, diversity, cost, and experience. Scoutbee integrates with SAP Ariba guided sourcing and, following its October 2025 acquisition by Coupa, is being embedded into the Coupa Supplier Portal. Scoutbee does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Section AI
providers.description: Section AI (formerly Section School) is an enterprise AI training and adoption platform that helps large organizations turn AI investment into measurable workforce transformation and ROI. Its two products are Section HQ, a command center for Heads of AI to track usage, measure "AI fitness," surface real-time insights, and manage transformation roadmaps; and Section Coach, personalized AI coaching that delivers skills training, certification programs, and workflow identification to employees and teams. Section also runs AI transformation planning, leadership coaching, AI strategy support, workflow automation, and agentic AI workshops for enterprises of 100+ employees, with customers including Johnson & Johnson, Nike, Okta, Unilever, Mercer, and Publicis. Backed by General Catalyst and led by founder Greg Shove. As of this profile the company exposes a web/app product surface (app.sectionai.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation.

providers.name: Sellersfi
providers.description: SellersFi is a financial technology company providing working capital and inventory financing to e-commerce merchants, including sellers on Amazon and direct-to-consumer channels. It offers flexible funding lines with approvals in as fast as 48 hours, helping online businesses manage cash flow, purchase inventory, and scale operations. Backed by Northzone, SellersFi operates a lending platform and applicant portal rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sensi (fka Clanz)
providers.description: Sensi.ai (formerly Clanz) is a home-care technology company whose 24/7 Care Copilot is an AI platform for senior home-care agencies. Using ambient audio sensing and a set of AI agents (Care, Growth, and Ops), Sensi gives care providers a holistic view of seniors' physical, emotional, and cognitive needs to support aging in place and proactive intervention when no caregiver is present. The company markets reduced hospitalizations, revenue growth, and operational efficiency for agencies. Sensi is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment; the customer application lives at app.sensi.ai.

providers.name: Sesh
providers.description: Sesh (Sesh Products US, Sesh+) is an Austin, Texas consumer packaged goods company that manufactures and sells tobacco-free nicotine pouches. Products ship in multiple flavors (Mint, Wintergreen, Clear, Mango, Cappuccino, Raspberry Lemon) and strengths (4mg, 6mg, 8mg), sold direct-to-consumer via subscription and through 5,000+ retailers. Surfaced as an 8vc portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a physical-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront, so the profile carries identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: Seso
providers.description: Seso is an all-in-one employee management platform built for U.S. agricultural operations, serving customers across all 50 states including 35 of the top 100 agricultural employers. Its software combines a modern farm HR system, compliant digital onboarding (I-9/W-4 with direct E-Verify integration), H-2A visa filing and compliance backed by legal resources, self-serve and managed payroll, and digital paycards for paycheck delivery. Seso also provides H-2A worker services such as consulate scheduling, recruiting, and logistics coordinated from its Monterrey, Mexico office. Backed by Bond Capital and Index Ventures. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: Shakers
providers.description: Shakers is a Spanish technology platform — "the house of freeworking" — that connects enterprises with vetted, top-tier freelance developers and digital professionals. Its AI-powered products include Shakers AI (a copilot for project scoping and talent matching), Talent Insight (profile and skills analysis), Shakers Verified (technical verification of freelance profiles), and AI Interviews (automated candidate assessment). The platform serves 450+ enterprise clients including Telefónica, EY, BBVA, Microsoft, and HP across a community of 10,000+ tech freelancers. Backed by Partech, Shakers was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; as of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer web platform but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Shuttle Central
providers.description: Shuttle Central (shuttlecentral.com) is a ground transportation booking platform for airport and point-to-point shuttle transfers across Mexico, the Caribbean, the United States, and Latin America, covering 100+ destinations including Cancun, Punta Cana, Nassau, Los Cabos, Mexico City, Puerto Vallarta, Montego Bay, and Miami. Travelers book confirmed transfers online with secure payment, instant confirmation, and 24/7 support, and a separate transportation-provider program (shuttlecentralinc.com) lets ground operators sell transfers through the platform. The company is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Sidekick
providers.description: Sidekick is a UK-based online wealth management and investing platform that offers expert-led investments and savings products once reserved for the ultra-wealthy, delivered through a mobile app and web platform. Its product range spans managed investment portfolios, savings accounts, private equity access, and cryptocurrency exposure. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp, Sidekick is a consumer (B2C) fintech and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Sioma
providers.description: SIOMA is a Colombian precision-agriculture (agtech) software platform for tropical crops such as oil palm, banana, and cacao. It helps plantations monitor field labor, track harvest and weighing (pesaje) operations with GPS, and make data-driven decisions to raise productivity. The product combines a mobile field-management app, GPS-based labor tracking, smart weighing hardware (Nukak, Sigma, Jaco, and Bascula-G scales), and Siomi, an AI assistant for agriculture. SIOMA is delivered as a customer web and mobile application and is backed by 500 Global. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Sketchdeck.ai
providers.description: SketchDeck.ai is a B2B SaaS company whose flagship product, LIFT, is AI-powered material takeoff and counting software for the structural steel fabrication and erection industry. LIFT analyzes uploaded blueprints and shop drawings to automatically extract quantities and generate Bills of Materials, with claimed 95-99% accuracy and up to an 80% reduction in takeoff time so estimators can complete bids in minutes rather than hours or days. The platform adds revision management and exports data to industry estimating programs; the company reports more than $25 billion in projects bid through LIFT to date. SketchDeck.ai is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-request website only - there is no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification surface to catalog.

providers.name: Skiptown
providers.description: Skiptown is a modern pet-care company operating premium dog daycare, boarding, grooming, and walking services alongside its signature Dog Bar & Park — an indoor/outdoor social club where owners enjoy craft cocktails and coffee while dogs play off-leash. Backed by Techstars, Skiptown runs company-owned locations in Charlotte, Atlanta, and Denver and offers franchise expansion opportunities. Its consumer experience is delivered through a mobile app for booking, curbside dropoff, and daily photo updates. Skiptown does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Slate Auto
providers.description: Slate Auto is an American electric-vehicle manufacturer building a radically simple, affordable, and customizable electric pickup truck. Designed in California and Michigan, engineered in Michigan, and assembled in the Midwest, the "Blank Slate" starts around $24,950 and offers roughly 205 miles of range, with interchangeable body panels and 200+ accessories that let owners reconfigure the vehicle over its life (including SUV and Fastback body styles). Slate sells direct through a preorder/reservation model, rejects mandatory feature packages and large touchscreens in favor of durability and owner control, and offers fleet solutions. Backed by General Catalyst. As a consumer automaker, Slate Auto publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Smart Crowd
providers.description: SmartCrowd is MENA's first and biggest regulated real estate crowdfunding and investment platform, based in Dubai and licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). It lets retail investors pool capital to co-own income-generating Dubai properties from as little as AED 500, offering both long-term Hold properties (rental yield) and short-term Flip properties (renovation upside), plus a secondary Share Transfer Facility for liquidity. SmartCrowd operates a consumer web and mobile app experience with no public developer API surface documented at this time.

providers.name: Smartex
providers.description: Smartex is an AI and computer-vision company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Porto, Portugal that builds hardware-enabled software for the textile manufacturing industry. Its systems inspect fabric in real time on the knitting machine to detect defects at the source, cutting textile waste, CO2 emissions, water, energy and rework. The product suite spans CORE (a machine-vision inspection add-on for circular knitting machines), FACT (an all-in-one digital factory-management platform for production visibility and quality control) and LOOP (supply-chain communication and traceability). Smartex is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, DCVC, Tony Fadell's Build Collective, H&M Group, SOSV/HAX, Spider Capital, Momenta Ventures and Fashion for Good. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; customer access is through the FACT platform login. This profile was surfaced from the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched from Smartex's public web surface.

providers.name: Smiler
providers.description: Smiler is an Amsterdam-based on-the-spot photography marketplace that connects travelers and consumers with a network of professional freelance photographers at popular tourist hotspots and leisure locations worldwide. Founded in 2020, Smiler lets people book fast, affordable photoshoots in advance across 100+ destinations, with photos delivered within 48 hours and free cancellation up to 24 hours before the shoot. The company also operates the Smiler Photographer Suite, an all-in-one tool for photographers to build portfolio websites, manage bookings, deliver mobile-friendly client galleries, and handle payments. Smiler is trusted by tens of thousands of photographers across 50+ countries and is backed by Speedinvest, Mosaic Ventures, Dutch Founders Fund, and PROfounders.

providers.name: Snapsheet
providers.description: Snapsheet is a cloud-based property & casualty (P&C) claims management platform for insurance carriers, MGAs, and TPAs. It runs the full claims lifecycle with no-code workflow configuration, intelligent automation, document management, virtual vehicle appraisals, total-loss settlement, integrated claims payments, and analytics. Snapsheet reports serving 170+ customers, including 16 of the top 20 P&C carriers, and processing more than 400 million API calls per month. It exposes open APIs and webhooks to customers and partners for connecting policy, billing, underwriting, and vendor systems, though API access is arranged through its sales and partner channel rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Solovis
providers.description: Solovis is a multi-asset investment analytics and portfolio management software platform for institutional investors, including endowments, foundations, pension plans, outsourced CIOs (OCIOs), and family offices. It aggregates data across public and private asset classes into a single dashboard for portfolio modeling, performance analysis, risk analytics, and reporting. Core products include Portfolio Analytics, Risk Analytics, Predict (performance and risk prediction for asset allocation), Risk Pro (factor-based risk analytics, formerly Venn Pro), and Analyst Services for outsourced data capture and portfolio data aggregation. Solovis became part of Nasdaq's investment intelligence business following its 2020 acquisition. The platform is delivered as a private, authenticated SaaS accessed through a client login; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, OpenAPI specification, or `/.well-known/` discovery surface. The host api.solovis.com exists but is fully authentication-gated (HTTP 401) with no public specification.

providers.name: Sourceday
providers.description: SourceDay is an AI-driven supplier collaboration and purchase order (PO) management platform for manufacturers and distributors. It synchronizes buyers, suppliers, and ERP systems in real time to prevent supply chain disruptions, automating PO change management, shipment visibility, supplier scorecards, and request-for-quote (RFQ) workflows. SourceDay reports managing more than $5B in quarterly direct spend across 100K+ activated suppliers, with 500+ certified ERP integrations spanning Acumatica, Epicor (Kinetic and Prophet 21), Infor, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through certified ERP connectors rather than a public self-serve developer API; there is no public API documentation, developer portal, or published OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: SplashLearn
providers.description: SplashLearn (operated by StudyPad, Inc.) is a game-based learning platform offering math and English/ELA curriculum for preschool through Grade 5 students, used by parents, teachers, schools, and homeschoolers. It delivers interactive games, worksheets, lesson plans, and progress tracking across web and mobile (iOS/Android) apps, plus homeschool, summer-learning, and SpringBoard programs. Surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web/security surface.

providers.name: Summer
providers.description: Summer (Summer, PBC) is a financial wellness platform that helps individuals, employers, and government organizations manage student loan debt and education expenses. Summer connects members with 150+ federal and state loan programs to lower monthly payments, pursue loan forgiveness (including Public Service Loan Forgiveness), and build tax-advantaged education savings. It is delivered as an employee benefit and through public programs, offering debt optimization, college cost planning, tuition assistance, tax-favorable direct student-loan contributions, and retirement matching of loan payments. Summer reports over $2B in savings delivered and a 97% member satisfaction rate.

providers.name: SustainCERT
providers.description: SustainCERT is an independent, digitally-enabled climate impact verification company. It provides third-party validation and verification for carbon-market projects, corporate greenhouse-gas inventories and climate reporting, value-chain (Scope 3) decarbonization claims, and digital monitoring, reporting and verification (DMRV) for renewable energy and product carbon footprints. Customers work through the SustainCERT web platform; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Partech portfolio and enriched with domain-security probes and identity metadata.

providers.name: SyncOnSet Technologies
providers.description: SyncOnSet Technologies is an Emmy Award-winning digital continuity, inventory, and money-tracking platform for film and television production, now part of Entertainment Partners. It replaces paper continuity binders with a collaborative online/offline web and mobile app that manages automatic script breakdowns and revisions, continuity photos, costume and wardrobe pieces, hair and makeup looks, props, set decoration, and locations, alongside per-character and per-scene budgeting and asset reports from prep through wrap. SyncOnSet is a login-gated SaaS application (production teams access it by account) and exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or self-serve developer program, so this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: TableApp
providers.description: TABLEAPP (Tableapp Sdn Bhd, part of FunNow Ltd) is a real-time restaurant discovery and reservation platform serving diners across Malaysia (Klang Valley) and Thailand. Consumers discover restaurants and book tables with instant confirmation through the TABLEAPP website and iOS/Android apps, and the TABLEAPP ELITE membership unlocks free signature dishes at partner restaurants, alongside dining vouchers and gift cards. Restaurateurs list on both TABLEAPP and FunNow and manage reservations and guest preferences with the TABLEAPP Manager tools. TableApp is a 500 Global portfolio company; it operates a private mobile-app backend (api.tableapp.com) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Tapstitch
providers.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

providers.name: Techstars Ventures
providers.description: Techstars Ventures is the venture-capital arm of Techstars, the global pre-seed accelerator and investor founded in 2006 in Boulder, Colorado. Techstars backs early-stage founders with capital, three months of intensive mentorship, and access to a worldwide network of investors, operators, and corporate partners across accelerator programs in cities including Boulder, Boston, Chicago, London, New York, and Tokyo. Its portfolio spans fintech, health, critical infrastructure, and software, and includes companies such as Uber, Twilio, ClassPass, DigitalOcean, Chainalysis, and Remitly. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Telepatia AI
providers.description: Telepatia is an AI-native clinical platform built for Latin American healthcare. It listens to doctor-patient consultations and generates clinical documentation in real time (AI Writer), surfaces evidence-based clinical recommendations during the visit (AI Advisor), integrates with 50+ electronic health record and hospital systems such as Epic, TASY, iClinic and MV (AI Integrator), and produces analytics on protocol adherence and clinical performance (AI Business Intelligence). Founded by Nicolas Abad and backed by a16z with a $33M Series A, the platform has deployed across 25+ hospital systems in Brazil, Colombia and Mexico. As of this enrichment pass Telepatia exposes a product and web application but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tenkara
providers.description: Tenkara is an AI-powered operations and supply chain platform for material manufacturers across food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, beverages, and OTC products. The platform automates 75+ workflows spanning supplier sourcing and qualification, procurement, freight and logistics booking, order tracking, and compliance documentation (COA, SDS, and audit records), helping manufacturers find better suppliers faster, prevent delays, and run more efficient operations. Tenkara is backed by True Ventures.

providers.name: The Expert
providers.description: The Expert is a consumer marketplace that connects people with top interior designers worldwide through paid one-on-one video consultations, paired with an Expert-curated home shopping marketplace where those designers' product picks can be purchased directly. Founded by celebrity interior designer Jake Arnold and tech entrepreneur Leo Seigal, the company is backed by Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, WndrCo, and others. It operates as a business-to-consumer platform with a trade program for design professionals; it publishes no public developer API. This profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: The Learning Experience
providers.description: The Learning Experience is an early childhood education and childcare franchise operating academies of early education for children from six weeks to six years old across a nationwide network of centers. Its programs span infant, toddler, preschool, and pre-kindergarten care built on a proprietary curriculum. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer-facing childcare operator it publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Think Parametric
providers.description: Think Parametric is an online learning platform for architecture, engineering, and design professionals, offering expert-led courses and professional certifications in computational and parametric design tools including Rhino, Grasshopper, Revit, Dynamo, SketchUp, and V-Ray. Membership plans give individuals and organizations access to a library of 60+ courses taught by practitioners from leading firms such as SOM, BIG, Gensler, AECOM, and Arup, alongside community forums, downloadable assets, and progress tracking. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Thyrocare
providers.description: Thyrocare Technologies Limited is an Indian chain of diagnostic and preventive-care laboratories headquartered in Navi Mumbai, founded in 1996. Built around a centralized, highly automated laboratory model, it focuses on affordable preventive health checkups, thyroid and pathology testing, and sells through a nationwide network of DSA (Direct Selling Agent) franchise partners. Norwest Venture Partners invested pre-IPO, and PharmEasy (API Holdings) acquired a majority stake in 2021. Its partner order-booking API (TechSo/BTS) is gated behind the DSA program and publishes no public OpenAPI.

providers.name: Tiff's Treats
providers.description: Tiff's Treats is an Austin, Texas cookie company founded in 1999 by University of Texas students Tiffany Taylor and Leon Chen, built around warm, baked-to-order cookies delivered same-day. The company operates roughly 90 bakery-storefronts across Texas and the southern and western United States, combining walk-in retail with an owned delivery fleet, an online ordering platform at cookiedelivery.com, and iOS and Android ordering apps. Alongside consumer delivery it runs a substantial corporate gifting, catering, e-gift-card and special-events business, plus an "Elites" subscription membership and a rewards program. Tiff's Treats has raised more than $50 million in outside investment, including a $25 million round led by Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital, and counts Andy Roddick, Brooklyn Decker, Kendra Scott and Dirk Nowitzki among its investors. It is a direct-to-consumer food and delivery operator, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Titan
providers.description: Titan (Titan Global Capital Management USA LLC) is a New York City wealth-management firm founded in 2017 that offers app-based investing and advisory services to high-performing professionals and emerging high-net-worth individuals. Its product suite spans actively managed Flagship, Smart Treasury and Opportunities funds, direct indexing, automated stocks and bonds, venture-fund access, credit and real-estate strategies, crypto, and dedicated CFP-led wealth advisory, managing over $1.2 billion for 10,000+ clients. Titan is a consumer fintech application delivered via web and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, accel, and general-catalyst.

providers.name: tldraw
providers.description: tldraw is an infinite-canvas SDK for building whiteboard and canvas applications. The primary distribution is the `tldraw` React component package; tldraw also offers a multiplayer sync server. License is the tldraw SDK License (free with watermark for small businesses; paid commercial license to remove watermark).

providers.name: Tolan
providers.description: Tolan is a consumer AI companion application built by Portola and backed by Homebrew. The product is a friendly alien character that users befriend for emotional support, daily check-ins, and relationship guidance through conversational AI on iOS. Tolan reports 100,000+ subscribers, over two million hours of user engagement, and a 4.8-star App Store rating across 160,000+ reviews. It is a mobile-first, direct-to-consumer product with no public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface; this profile captures the company identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: TriNet
providers.description: TriNet is a Dublin, California-based professional employer organization (PEO) for small and mid-market businesses, founded in 1988 by Martin Babinec and led today by President and CEO Mike Simonds. TriNet delivers full-service HR through a co-employment model — payroll processing, Fortune-500-grade health, retirement and ancillary benefits, workers' compensation, employment-practices liability coverage, compliance and risk management, and strategic HR advisory — to thousands of SMBs across the United States. The company offers two main packages: TriNet PEO (full co-employment) and HR Plus (technology platform plus support). TriNet is publicly traded on the NYSE as TNET with trailing-twelve-month revenue of roughly $5.0B as of FY2025. TriNet exposes its HR Customer Platform through three SwaggerHub-documented API groups — DCP, HRIS, and PEO — covering Employees, Companies, Payroll, Money, and Time-Off domains, with API credentials issued to approved customers and Integration Center partners rather than offered as a fully open developer program; OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman/Insomnia collections, a sandbox, OAuth playground, and webhook management are available to authorized developers. Public 1:1 API access typically requires partner-program qualification and technical review, which is why most TriNet customers consume the platform via the curated Integration Center marketplace (accounting, HRIS, identity, ATS, payroll, benefits and learning partners) or via unified-API aggregators such as Finch, Merge, Apideck and Truto.

providers.name: Udaan
providers.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

providers.name: Velocia
providers.description: Velocia is a transit ridership solutions company that uses real-time rewards, incentives, and digital tools to increase public-transit ridership and engagement for transit agencies and cities. Its programs include a Rider Incentive Program, Transit Ambassador Program, Mobility Wallet, rider surveys, an Automated Guaranteed Ride Home Program, and Major Event Solutions, integrated into transit apps to drive behavior change. Velocia partners with agencies and mobility services such as Miami-Dade County, King County Metro, Seattle DOT, Lime, Zipcar, Uber, Lyft, and CitiBike Miami. Founded in 2018 and based in Toronto, Velocia is a Techstars-backed company. This profile has no public developer/API surface at enrichment time.

providers.name: Verbal
providers.description: Verbal (tryverbal.com) is an AI-powered clinical compliance and quality-assurance platform for healthcare organizations. It automatically audits patient interactions — phone and video calls, telehealth visits, AI-agent conversations, and clinical chart notes — against customizable regulatory and quality checklists, scoring compliance in real time and surfacing gaps for supervisors and QA teams. Verbal integrates with communications and EHR platforms including Zoom, Five9, Epic, and Athena. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and customer app but no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Vetted
providers.description: Vetted (formerly Lustre) is a San Francisco based AI-powered shopping research assistant that helps consumers find the best products and lowest prices. The service analyzes reviews and recommendations from trusted sources such as Reddit, YouTube, user reviews, and expert articles to surface the most recommended brands and products for a shopper's needs, then compares retailers to identify the best available price. Vetted is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience, and is backed by Index Ventures. It exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time (api.vetted.ai serves the mobile apps as a private backend). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Vocca Ai
providers.description: Vocca is a healthcare voice-AI company (backed by Speedinvest) that builds AI voice and text agents acting as a 24/7 receptionist for medical groups and practices. Vocca handles inbound and outbound patient calls, appointment bookings, reminders, and follow-ups across specialties including imaging, dental, cardiology, gynecology, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, general medicine, hospitals, and multi-practice clinics, so clinical teams spend less time on admin and more time on care. The company operates a customer-facing product with French and English coverage; it does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile carries company identity and website link-properties only.

providers.name: Vridhi Home Finance
providers.description: Vridhi Home Finance (Vridhi Finserv Home Finance Limited) is an affordable housing finance company (HFC) headquartered in Bengaluru, India, founded in 2022. Operating as a tech-enabled brick-and-mortar lender across tier-2 and tier-3 cities, it provides home purchase loans, home construction loans, plot-and-construction loans, balance-transfer and top-up loans, and loans against property to salaried and self-employed customers. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and Elevation Capital. It operates a public marketing website, a customer service portal, a refer-and-earn portal, and an Android mobile app, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Walter
providers.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wave
providers.description: Wave is a virtual entertainment company that produces interactive, avatar-driven virtual concerts and immersive live music experiences known as "Waves." The platform streams stylized, real-time performances from major recording artists — including The Weeknd, Justin Bieber, John Legend, J Balvin, and Alison Wonderland — as animated avatars across VR headsets, desktop, mobile, and social video platforms, letting fans attend and interact with shows from anywhere. Wave is a consumer-facing entertainment and media product (accessed at wavexr.com) rather than a developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. It was surfaced as a venture-portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, where this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: wayup
providers.description: WayUp is a US early-career job and internship marketplace that connects college students and recent graduates with roles at 3,800+ vetted employers. Founded as Campus Job and rebranded WayUp in 2015, it was acquired by campus-recruiting company Yello in 2021. Candidates upload a resume and are matched to entry-level jobs, internships, and virtual career fairs, while employers use WayUp for early-talent sourcing and diversity recruiting. As of this profile WayUp publishes no public developer API or developer portal; its surface is a consumer web application plus a Help Scout knowledge base. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

providers.name: Webster Bank
providers.description: Webster Bank, N.A. is a nationally chartered commercial bank (National Association) and the principal banking subsidiary of Webster Financial Corporation (NYSE: WBS), a Delaware-incorporated bank and financial holding company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. A values-based super-regional institution with roughly $84 billion in assets, Webster serves businesses, individuals, and families across the Northeast from the New York City metro area through Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts, and operates the HSA Bank division, a leading national provider of health savings accounts and consumer-directed benefit administration in all 50 states. Webster does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications. Its open-finance posture is consumer- and commercial-permissioned data sharing delivered through aggregators rather than a direct API: in June 2026 Webster went live on Prolific Banking's FI-Streams Connector using Plaid's FDX-aligned Core Exchange specification to give commercial clients secure, tokenized connectivity to the Plaid network, and consumer account data is also reachable via Plaid and Finicity. There is no publicly documented first-party REST API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, or self-serve developer program.

providers.name: WeGoWhere
providers.description: WeGoWhere is a consumer social-activity coordination mobile app (originally launched as EatMatch) that helps friends discover what the people around them are doing and join those plans in real life. Available on iOS and Android with more than 700,000 active users, the app centers each hangout on a dedicated group chat for attendees plus high-resolution photo and video sharing, spanning activities such as dining, movies, photography, sports, karaoke, and general socializing. Based in Bangkok, Thailand, the company raised US$1.2M in seed funding in 2023 and is backed by 500 Global. WeGoWhere is a consumer mobile product and does not currently publish a public API, developer platform, or SDK.

providers.name: WiredScore
providers.description: WiredScore is the global standard-setting organization for digital connectivity and smart technology in the built environment. It assesses, benchmarks, and certifies buildings through two programs — WiredScore (digital connectivity) and SmartScore (smart building technology) — across office, residential, industrial, and hotel asset types. Landlords, developers, and occupiers in more than 40 countries use its certifications and its network of Accredited Professionals to demonstrate that a building meets modern technology and connectivity expectations; over 4,000 buildings covering roughly one billion square feet have been certified. WiredScore is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Fifth Wall. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Wonderskin
providers.description: Wonderskin is a direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand best known for its WONDER BLADING all-day peel-off lip stain, along with longwear eyeliners, serum foundations, blush, brow products, skincare, and beauty tools sold through its Shopify-powered online store. The company runs a SKINSIDER loyalty membership, publishes THE SKINSIDER beauty and lifestyle blog, and partners with athletes and celebrities on product marketing. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Insight Partners. As a consumer e-commerce retailer, Wonderskin publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures the brand identity, customer-facing web properties, and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Yogaia
providers.description: Yogaia is a Finnish online fitness company, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Espoo, that streams live and on-demand yoga, Pilates, meditation, and workout classes to members on any device. Backed by Point Nine, Inventure, and Sanoma, the service runs as a consumer subscription product (web and mobile apps) with sessions ranging from three-minute quick practices to sixty-minute relaxation programs. As of this enrichment pass Yogaia publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDKs; its api.yogaia.com host serves the session-based web application backend rather than a documented public API. This profile was surfaced as a Point Nine portfolio lead and is enriched here with verified identity, public web properties, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: YQN
providers.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

providers.name: A.Team
providers.description: A.Team is an enterprise AI talent network that connects companies with elite, pre-vetted tech builders — senior engineers, product managers, designers, and data scientists — to design, build, and scale AI products and solutions. The platform matches Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups with dedicated talent and full cross-functional "expert teams," and increasingly delivers packaged AI agent solutions (voice agents, market-data and reporting agents, legal-document and due-diligence agents, municipal-code workflow agents) that integrate into existing tools like Slack, Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel. A.Team operates as a services and talent-marketplace business rather than a self-service developer API provider; it exposes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alix
providers.description: Alix is an estate settlement service that pairs technology with human experts — Settlement Specialists, fiduciaries, CPAs, and probate attorneys — to execute the 150+ administrative, legal, financial, and tax tasks required to settle an estate after a death. It coordinates probate court filings, asset discovery (50-state unclaimed-property and federal life-insurance searches, hidden 401(k)s and bank accounts), estate bank-account and IRS EIN setup, creditor and debt negotiation, final personal (1040) and estate (1041) tax filings, property liquidation and estate sales, and the legally compliant distribution of funds to beneficiaries — while keeping the executor informed through a dedicated app. Alix charges a flat 1% of gross estate value (minimum $9,000, $2,500 initial deposit). Backed by Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Amp
providers.description: Amp is an Ethereum-based digital collateral token (an ERC-20 fungible token extended with ERC-1400-style partitions and ERC-777-style operator semantics) designed to collateralize and instantly settle value transfer worldwide, most notably as the collateral layer behind Flexa payments. The AMP contract (0xff20817765cb7f73d4bde2e66e067e58d11095c2) supports partitioned staking, registered collateral managers, and operator authorization, and has been independently audited by ConsenSys Diligence (June 2020) and Trail of Bits (August 2020). Amp is smart-contract-only and exposes no REST/HTTP API; its published "API reference" documents the on-chain contract interface. The project is stewarded by the Acronym Foundation and was backed by Pantera Capital.

providers.name: Apna
providers.description: Apna is India's leading professional networking and job-search platform, headquartered in Mumbai, India. Job seekers use Apna to search and apply to jobs online for free, join profession and location-based community groups, build a professional profile, and prepare for interviews, while employers post job vacancies and hire quality candidates in as little as 48 hours. Apna is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. At the time of this profile Apna does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this entry captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Atlantic Union Bank
providers.description: Atlantic Union Bank is a Virginia state-chartered commercial bank with roots going back to 1902, and the principal banking subsidiary of Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation (NYSE: AUB), a Richmond, Virginia bank holding company regulated under the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956. It is the largest regional bank headquartered in Virginia, with roughly $37 billion in assets and a branch network across Virginia, Maryland, and North Carolina, offering consumer and business checking, savings, lending, mortgages, credit cards, and wealth management. Like most US regional banks, Atlantic Union Bank operates under the voluntary, fragmented US open-finance landscape rather than a mandated open-banking regime: it publishes no first-party public developer portal or documented public API. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reached indirectly through third-party data aggregators (Plaid, Finicity by Mastercard, MX, Teller) as surfaced by aggregator coverage directories, and no direct FDX-conformant data-access endpoint, Akoya participation, or published CFPB Section 1033 posture was found. This is an identity-only, aggregator-only record with no first-party API surface.

providers.name: Awfar Market
providers.description: Awfar is a Cairo- and Riyadh-based digital solutions company (founded 2013) offering an integrated customer engagement and commerce platform. It combines an omnichannel Chat Center with AI agents (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook), a cloud Call Center, and a Commerce & Delivery platform for order, inventory, and logistics management within a single interface. Awfar serves more than 2,000 clients across retail, pharmacy, restaurant, e-commerce, tourism, healthcare, education, and real estate, and ships prebuilt integrations for Shopify, Meta, Odoo, Zid, and Salla plus custom API connections. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specification is published at this time; integration is arranged via the sales and demo channel.

providers.name: BeyondHQ
providers.description: BeyondHQ is a distributed workforce planning platform that combines talent, cost, and location data to enable cross-functional decision making for hybrid and distributed teams. It equips HR, Real Estate, and Finance teams with a single, integrated experience that centralizes hiring and location-planning processes, providing real-time interactive comparisons across 500+ markets, 70,000+ searchable job skills, 750+ searchable occupations, and 50,000+ market-data combinations. The platform helps companies determine where to hire and physically locate their workforce using trusted, real-time data. BeyondHQ is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. BeyondHQ does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: BlueOcean
providers.description: BlueOcean is a Context AI platform purpose-built for marketing teams. Its agentic AI framework, Spark, combines brand, market, product, and customer context to help marketers unlock creativity, accelerate go-to-market, and deliver measurable impact — automating work from strategy through content creation, competitive intelligence, brand performance analytics, and reporting. The platform surfaces evidence-grounded recommendations across brand, product marketing, and content, and is used by enterprise marketing teams at companies such as SAP, AWS, and Cisco. BlueOcean is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Broadlume
providers.description: Broadlume is an all-in-one business platform for the flooring industry, serving more than 4,000 retailers and 300+ manufacturers. Its products span lead-generating websites, digital advertising, SEO and reputation management, product catalogs, and a suite of flooring business software covering accounting, inventory management, job costing, and lead management, plus a retail selling system with in-store visualization and e-commerce sample ordering. Broadlume is owned by Cyncly. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network and tracks Broadlume's public web and security surface.

providers.name: Bunch
providers.description: Bunch is a Berlin-based financial technology company building AI-native infrastructure for private markets. Its all-in-one platform combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services so venture capital and private equity funds and investors can seamlessly transact, close, and securely operate — spanning fund administration, SPV and vehicle setup, investor onboarding and KYC, capital calls, and reporting. Bunch was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Northzone and profiled into the API Evangelist network. Bunch operates a private, customer-facing product at app.bunch.capital and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Candid Co.
providers.description: Candid Co. (candidco.com), operating today as CandidPro, is a New York-based dental-technology company that delivers custom clear aligners for teeth straightening. Founded in 2017 as a direct-to-consumer brand backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Greycroft, and e.ventures, Candid pioneered at-home impression kits and remote monitoring, and has since pivoted to a dentist-directed model: aligners are prescribed and overseen by a licensed dentist with orthodontist support and convenient virtual visits (CandidMonitoring). Candid handles the clinical treatment plan, 3D-printed aligner manufacturing, and patient communication for crowding and common bite misalignments. This is a consumer/health brand with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and commercial link properties.

providers.name: Conduct AI
providers.description: Conduct AI (conduct.ai) is an enterprise "AI operating system" that helps IT teams understand, operate, and transform their business software, starting with SAP and expanding across the wider enterprise stack. Its platform analyzes custom code to reveal dependencies and system relationships (Understand), automates software-development workflows from planning through deployment (Operate), and accelerates system migrations such as S/4HANA with automated analysis and code refactoring (Transform). The company markets outcomes like faster S/4HANA migration planning, reduced manual system analysis, and shorter change-implementation cycles. Conduct raised a $60M Series A and is backed by ICONIQ Capital. It publishes a marketing site, blog, and case studies but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Curve Health
providers.description: Curve Health is a New York City-based digital health technology company, founded in 2020, that delivers a virtual care and telemedicine platform purpose-built for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and senior care. The platform unifies telemedicine, a health information exchange, predictive analytics, and smart billing into a single system so nurses, physicians, behavioral health providers, and facility operators can deliver care in place and reduce avoidable hospital transfers. Curve Health reports enabling 150,000+ remote care visits and an 80% reduction in hospitalizations for partner facilities, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Morningside. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web and product-documentation surface; Curve Health does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Dokku
providers.description: Dokku is an open-source Docker-powered self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service that helps you build and manage the lifecycle of applications from initial push to scaling out. Often described as "the smallest PaaS implementation you've ever seen" and a self-hosted mini-Heroku, Dokku turns a single Linux host (or a multi-host scheduler such as K3s or Nomad) into a git-push deployment target that builds applications from Heroku-compatible buildpacks, Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfiles, or pre-built Docker images. Dokku is MIT licensed, written primarily in Bash, and maintained by the Dokku organization on GitHub since 2013. It ships an extensive plugin ecosystem covering data stores (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Meilisearch, Typesense), TLS via Let's Encrypt, HTTP basic auth, maintenance mode, redirects, schedulers for Docker, K3s and Nomad, multiple HTTP proxies (Nginx, HAProxy, Caddy, Traefik, OpenResty), CI integrations, and an official GitHub Action. Dokku's primary interface is the `dokku` CLI invoked over SSH; there is no first-party public HTTP REST API in core (the historical `dokku-api` Ruby wrapper is archived and unmaintained).

providers.name: Drip Capital
providers.description: Drip Capital is a digital trade finance and working capital company founded in 2016, headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with operations in Mumbai, India and Mexico City, Mexico. It provides collateral-free post-shipment finance to small and medium-sized exporters and importers through data-driven underwriting, offering invoice factoring, export finance, an importer credit program, supply chain and vendor financing, receivables financing, and revolving lines of credit. The company has financed over $9 billion in trade transactions for 11,000+ businesses worldwide. Drip Capital does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel, Initialized Capital, Wing Venture Capital, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Dupe
providers.description: Dupe.com is a free AI-powered visual search engine and product-comparison platform that finds near-identical, lower-priced alternatives ("dupes") to designer and higher-priced products. Users paste any product URL, upload an image, or type a description, and Dupe's visual matching surfaces similar items from thousands of online retailers at up to 90% less — spanning furniture, home decor, fashion, footwear, beauty, and more. The service also offers AI research reports, room/outfit restyling, a Chrome extension, an iOS app, and a $DUPE rewards program, and it earns revenue through affiliate commissions at no extra cost to users. Dupe additionally operates a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI assistants can search its catalog programmatically. Backed by Kindred Ventures.

providers.name: ECI Solutions
providers.description: ECI Solutions is a leading provider of cloud-based business management software for small and medium-sized businesses across manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, field service, and retail. ECI's integrated suites span ERP, e-commerce, CRM, accounting, inventory, and analytics, helping customers streamline operations and grow.

providers.name: Edgefolio
providers.description: Edgefolio is a London-based financial technology company providing a digital capital-raising and fund-marketing platform for the hedge fund industry. Its SaaS products connect hedge funds, prime brokers, and institutional investors: Edgefolio for Managers offers a secure data-room and CRM for fund managers to control their data, manage investor relationships, and collaborate; Edgefolio for Prime Brokers delivers capital introduction and consulting tooling for cap intro teams; and Edgefolio for Investors is a fund screening and research platform with integrated market data. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp. As of this enrichment pass Edgefolio publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — the platform is delivered as a private B2B application accessed via demo and client login.

providers.name: Equitable Bank
providers.description: Equitable Bank is Canada's seventh largest independent Schedule I bank by assets and a wholly owned subsidiary of EQB Inc. (TSX: EQB), a Toronto-based Canadian financial services company with over CAD $144 billion in combined assets under management and administration. Federally chartered and Canadian owned, Equitable Bank markets itself as "Canada's Challenger Bank" and, in 2016, launched EQ Bank, its digital-only banking platform offering high interest savings accounts, GICs, and payments alongside the parent bank's single-family residential and commercial lending. Equitable Bank and Equitable Trust are members of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC). On the open-finance front, Equitable Bank does not operate a public first-party developer portal or publish downloadable API specifications; consumer permissioned data sharing is delivered through the Canadian aggregator Flinks (Flinks Outbound) rather than a first-party API. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada as overseer) is not yet operational, so the bank's data-access posture today is voluntary and aggregator-mediated.

providers.name: Fold
providers.description: Fold (NASDAQ: FLD) is a bitcoin financial services company founded in 2014 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, billed as the first publicly traded bitcoin financial services company. Fold makes it easy for individuals and businesses to earn, save, and use bitcoin through consumer products including the Fold App, the Fold Bitcoin Rewards Credit Card, the Fold Debit Card, and the Fold Bitcoin Gift Card marketplace, paying real bitcoin rewards (not points or a proprietary token) on everyday purchases and bill payments. Bitcoin custody and Lightning Network payouts are powered by partners such as BitGo and OpenNode. Fold is a consumer-facing fintech application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fortem Technologies
providers.description: Fortem Technologies is an airspace security and defense company based in Lindon, Utah that builds counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) for military, government, critical infrastructure, and commercial customers. Its SkyDome System combines TrueView AESA radars, long-range TrueView cameras, RF sensors, and the autonomous DroneHunter interceptor into a single detect-track-defeat capability, orchestrated by SkyDome Manager command-and-control software. SkyDome Manager exposes REST, realtime, and track-only integration APIs so third-party C2 platforms (such as the U.S. Army FAAD C2 and Lockheed Martin systems) can exchange over a hundred fields and commands for airspace awareness and drone mitigation. Fortem is backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, Boeing, and other strategic investors, and its systems have been selected for high-profile deployments including protection of venues at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

providers.name: FreightRoll
providers.description: FreightRoll is a logistics technology company whose flagship product, YardOS, is a customizable Yard Operating / Management System (YMS) that turns shipping and receiving yards into driver-friendly, self-service hubs. YardOS reduces truck-driver wait times, improves yard throughput, and streamlines gate and dock operations, with the company citing up to a 50% reduction in truck turnaround time, 95%+ fewer human-to-driver interactions, and $100K+ annual savings per facility across a network of 150,000+ registered drivers. FreightRoll integrates with existing systems across API, EDI, and SFTP mechanisms and deploys remotely in under an hour. The company is backed by 500 Global. FreightRoll does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; its public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access to public site content.

providers.name: GE Vernova
providers.description: GE Vernova is accelerating the path to more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy through its innovative portfolio of electrification, power, and decarbonization technologies. Spun off from General Electric, GE Vernova brings together the legacy GE Power, Renewable Energy, Digital, and Energy Financial Services businesses to help solve the world's energy transition challenges.

providers.name: General Fusion
providers.description: General Fusion is a Canadian fusion energy company founded in 2002 by physicist Dr. Michel Laberge and headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia, in the Vancouver area. It is developing Magnetized Target Fusion (MTF), an approach that combines plasma formation, mechanical compression by a liquid metal liner, and practical heat capture for electricity generation. The company operates LM26, which it describes as the world's largest and most powerful operational fusion plasma injector, and reports 24 plasma prototypes, more than 200,000 plasma experiments, 35+ peer-reviewed papers, and roughly 210 issued and pending patents. In July 2026 General Fusion completed a business combination with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III and became the first publicly listed fusion energy company, trading on Nasdaq under the ticker GFUZ. It is an energy hardware and research company rather than a software or API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contracts. Its only machine-readable public surfaces are a Yoast-generated llms.txt and the WordPress REST discovery index behind its marketing site.

providers.name: Genomatica
providers.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.

providers.name: Happypal
providers.description: Happypal (HappyPal) is a Paris-based HR-tech and fintech company, founded in 2019, that operates the most widely used digital platform for French works councils (Comite Social et Economique, or CSE). The SaaS and payment platform lets CSE administrators distribute employee benefits and perks, manage budgets and accounting, run ticketing and gift-voucher (cheques-cadeaux) programs, and engage more than 500,000 beneficiaries through a mobile app. Happypal replaces paper gift vouchers with a dematerialized SaaS-plus-fintech model targeting France's employee-benefits market. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. Happypal does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and identity surface.

providers.name: HEDNA
providers.description: HEDNA (Hotel Electronic Distribution Network Association) is a not-for-profit trade association founded in 1991 and headquartered in Forest Hill, Maryland, United States, that convenes the hotel distribution industry — hotel chains, GDS operators, OTAs, switches, channel managers, payment providers and connectivity vendors — around shared best practice for hospitality electronic distribution. It sits alongside rather than inside the distribution chain: it moves no inventory and processes no bookings, but its Disciplines (Connectivity, Content Distribution, Payments, Data & Analytics, Revenue Optimization) produce recommendation documents, and it co-authored the Open Payments Alliance Standards Specification with HTNG and OpenTravel. HEDNA publishes no developer portal, no API, and no machine-readable specification on hedna.org; every probe of developer./developers./docs./api. subdomains and of /developers, /api, /docs, /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ failed (DNS failure or HTTP 404). Its publications library, research reports and HEDNA U courseware are gated behind paid membership at members.hedna.org (HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge unauthenticated) and pathlms.com/hedna. Honest posture: member-gated documents, no public API, no exit path published.

providers.name: Helloworld Travel
providers.description: Helloworld Travel Limited (ASX: HLO) is an Australian travel distribution group headquartered in Sydney, operating retail agency networks, corporate travel, wholesale packaging, air ticket consolidation and inbound tour operations across Australia, New Zealand, Fiji and Europe with more than 700 staff and over 2,700 retail members. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain — an aggregator and reseller of third-party air, hotel and land content rather than an inventory owner — reaching travellers through its member agencies and reaching air supply through GDS-based consolidation and ticketing (Air Tickets, Express Tickets, SmartTickets). Its API posture is closed. There is no public developer portal, no OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI or Postman artifact, and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Every trade system is behind an agent login — ReadyRooms (B2B hotel and activity booking), AOTonline.net (inbound trade booking engine), Air Tickets and Express Tickets. A developer host is provisioned at developer.readyrooms.com.au but returns HTTP 401 with a Basic auth challenge on every path probed, so access is partner-only. There is no published exit path — the only documented way to get data back is a Privacy Act access request to the Helloworld Privacy Officer.

providers.name: Homeday
providers.description: Homeday is a German proptech real estate brokerage founded in 2015 and headquartered in Berlin, combining a nationwide network of local partner brokers with digital tools to help owners sell, buyers purchase, and both finance residential property across Germany. Its consumer products include free online and in-person property valuation, full-service sales brokerage, buyer representation, mortgage and financing brokerage through partner banks, and the Preisatlas transparent real estate price map for Germany. Homeday is backed by 500 Global and other investors. The company runs an active engineering organization on GitHub (homeday-de) publishing internal tooling, a Vue component library, design assets, and Ruby clients for third-party real estate APIs (ImmobilienScout24, onOffice), but does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or OpenAPI specification. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with identity, link-property, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Hometree
providers.description: Hometree is a UK home services and residential energy company offering homeowners and landlords subscription-based boiler and home emergency cover with unlimited repairs and annual maintenance from around £12.95 per month. Its nationwide network of Gas Safe registered engineers handles breakdowns across heating, plumbing, electrics, drainage and gas fires, and the company also arranges boiler installations and green home upgrades such as heat pumps and solar panels. Operating as an insurance distributor and installer across mainland England, Scotland and Wales, Hometree is backed by Anthemis, DN Capital, Barclays, BlackRock, 2150 and Puma Growth Partners.

providers.name: HTTP Client
providers.description: HTTP Client is JetBrains' built-in tool for creating, editing, and executing HTTP requests directly from the IDE. Requests are stored in .http and .rest files alongside source code, with code highlighting, completion for hosts and methods, code folding, inline documentation, and live templates accelerating composition. The client supports HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 requests, gRPC unary and server-streaming calls, WebSocket connections, GraphQL operations, server-sent events, and imports from cURL and Postman collections. Environment files define reusable variables across global, request, and secured scopes; the cookie jar, request history, run/debug configurations, and Services tool window response viewer round out a workflow tightly integrated with the IntelliJ-based IDE family.

providers.name: Imper.AI
providers.description: imper.ai is an Israeli workforce identity security company that stops AI-driven impersonation, deepfakes, voice clones, and social-engineering attacks in real time across enterprise communication channels such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Slack. Rather than scanning message content for anomalies, the platform correlates hard-to-fake signals — device telemetry, network diagnostics, and behavioral patterns — to validate identity at high-risk lifecycle events including hiring, employee enrollment, and help-desk verification. Founded by cyber-intelligence veterans and backed by Redpoint Ventures and Battery Ventures (about $34M raised), imper.ai integrates with ATS, HRIS, IdP, ITSM, PAM, IVR, and meeting platforms, and is deployed across financial, health care, and technology enterprises. This profile was seeded from Battery Ventures' portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; imper.ai currently publishes a product knowledge base rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: Jargon
providers.description: Jargon is a platform for Domain Driven Design for APIs and Enterprise Data Modelling. It provides text-based modelling, template-based API design, real-time validation, version control with breaking change detection, and generation of artifacts including JSON Schema, OpenAPI specifications, and JSON-LD. Jargon supports DevOps-driven collaborative modelling for teams designing and governing domains at enterprise scale.

providers.name: Jays
providers.description: JAYS is a Swedish consumer audio brand founded in 2006 by Jens and Johan, headquartered in Sweden and owned by the Northbaze Group AB. It designs and sells wireless and wired headphones, true-wireless earbuds, Bluetooth and multiroom speakers, and audio accessories, sold direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at jaysheadphones.com. JAYS publishes no first-party developer API; its only machine-accessible surface is the Shopify-provided agent-commerce layer: a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) merchant profile with a hosted MCP shopping endpoint, Customer Account OpenID Connect / OAuth discovery documents, and an llms.txt. This profile was surfaced as a Creandum portfolio/commitment lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Keystatic
providers.description: Keystatic is an open source, Git-based content management system that stores content as Markdown, JSON, and YAML directly in a project's Git repository. The Keystatic Reader API is a Node.js library that lets applications read Keystatic content from any local directory or GitHub repository server-side, supporting frameworks like Next.js, Astro, Remix, and React Server Components.

providers.name: Koordinator
providers.description: Koordinator is a QoS-based scheduling system for hybrid workloads orchestration on Kubernetes, providing colocation, interference detection, and resource optimization capabilities to improve cluster utilization.

providers.name: Kraka
providers.description: Kraka Technologies GmbH is a Berlin-based industrial AI company whose platform turns plain video recordings of shop-floor tasks into standardized, multilingual, step-by-step work instructions. Kraka Studio is the core product, extended by Training, Maintenance and Quality modules covering workforce qualification, AI-assisted fault diagnosis and checklist-driven quality control. Kraka positions itself as closing the execution gap between ERP systems that manage data and the work actually performed on the factory floor. Backed by Seedcamp. No public API, developer portal or SDK is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: LedgiFi
providers.description: LedgiFi (formerly Krypto Ledgers) is a Latin American cryptocurrency tax and portfolio-tracking platform founded in 2020 and headquartered in Antofagasta, Chile. The product syncs a user's transaction history from exchanges and wallets — Binance, Coinbase, Kraken and MetaMask among them — normalizes it across more than 25,000 assets, and computes realized capital gains using the valuation methods and monetary-correction adjustments each jurisdiction requires, so investors can file a compliant return. Its Chilean profile applies the SII's specific rules (IPC indexation and dollar-variation adjustments, Impuesto de Primera Categoría and Impuesto Global Complementario), and the platform has since expanded to Mexico, Spain, Colombia and Argentina. Alongside tax reporting it offers a portfolio view spanning crypto, stocks and ETFs, with per-asset performance and allocation. LedgiFi is a 500 Global (500 LatAm B18) portfolio company. It runs a monitored production API at api.ledgifi.com that backs its own web and mobile apps, but publishes no developer portal, no API specification and no self-service API program.

providers.name: LF Broadband
providers.description: LF Broadband is a Linux Foundation Directed Fund established in late 2023 that supports open source broadband networking projects, including reference designs and virtualization tools for broadband access networks. Its flagship projects, SEBA and VOLTHA, virtualize multi-vendor Passive Optical Network (PON) systems and are deployed by major operators such as Deutsche Telekom and Turk Telekom.

providers.name: Mentor Spaces
providers.description: Mentor Spaces is a structured mentorship platform that helps nonprofits, universities, and companies launch, manage, and measure mentorship programs at scale. The software handles automated mentor-mentee matching, scheduling, communication, and real-time outcome tracking so organizations can secure and renew grant funding with funder-ready impact reports, improve student persistence and career outcomes, engage alumni in time-bound structured mentorship, and run skills-based volunteering and corporate CSR/ESG programs. A public developer API and custom integrations are offered only on the enterprise Thrive tier (with SSO); no public API documentation is published. Founded by Chris Motley and backed by Techstars.

providers.name: mPower Social
providers.description: mPower Social Enterprises Ltd. is a Dhaka, Bangladesh technology-for-development company founded in 2008 by Harvard and MIT graduate students as ClickDiagnostics — winner of the MIT $100K competition — and renamed after moving its center of gravity to Bangladesh in 2010. mPower designs, builds and operates information systems for governments, UN agencies, donor organizations and international NGOs across health and nutrition, water and sanitation, agriculture and livestock, education, governance and rights, livelihood and poverty alleviation, climate and environment, and humanitarian response, and states it has deployed more than 300 ICT solutions across 17 countries in the Global South. Its engineering practice is built on open-source digital public goods — DHIS2, OpenMRS, OpenSRP / FHIR Core, Bahmni and Moodle — which it customizes, integrates and supports for national health management information systems, electronic medical records and shared health records, rather than shipping a hosted product of its own. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified. mPower publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract; its public software surface is a GitHub organization made up largely of downstream forks of the open-source health platforms it implements, plus a set of first-party Android apps on Google Play.

providers.name: Myclubs
providers.description: Myclubs is a Vienna- and Zurich-based digital sports membership company, founded in 2014 by Tobias Homberger, that gives members flexible access to a network of more than 1,200 sports and fitness providers across Austria and Switzerland through a single subscription.
