One membership covers over 35 sport and activity types and more than 10,000 bookable workouts per week, from gyms and yoga studios to tennis, boxing and cross training. Myclubs also runs a corporate fitness program used by over 300 employers as an employee benefit. The company was acquired by Urban Sports Club in August 2024 and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. Myclubs is a consumer-facing membership brand and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Omnidian
providers.description: Omnidian, Inc. is a Seattle-based clean energy performance assurance company, founded in 2015, that protects and accelerates investments in residential and commercial solar and battery storage. Its proprietary, machine-learning driven software platform continuously monitors distributed solar assets, diagnoses hardware, communication and environmental faults such as soiling, shading and snow, dispatches a nationwide field service technician network across 48 states, Washington D.C. and Puerto Rico, and underwrites a 95% energy production guarantee that reimburses owners for covered shortfalls. Omnidian serves installers, EPCs, developers, IPPs, solar financing providers, commercial real estate owners and asset investors, and is a Certified B Corporation and a member of the SunSpec Alliance. Its monitoring platform, client portal and field service partner portal are operated as private, authenticated systems; Omnidian publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: OneHealthCompany
providers.description: The One Health Company is a Palo Alto veterinary precision-oncology company, best known for its FidoCure platform, that brings human-grade precision cancer medicine to dogs. FidoCure sequences a dog's tumor with next-generation DNA sequencing, matches the cancer-driving mutations to targeted therapies, and gives veterinarians an individualized treatment plan grounded in the world's largest proprietary canine cancer dataset (billions of data points across a network of more than 1,300 veterinary clinics). The company was founded in 2015 by Christina Lopes and Ben Lewis on the "One Health" thesis that treating cancer in companion dogs also advances real-world evidence for human oncology. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z bio), Y Combinator, Polaris Partners, Borealis Ventures, Lerer Hippeau and Tau Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes a consumer and veterinarian web experience (including a veterinarian login portal) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Paramark
providers.description: Paramark is a marketing measurement and forecasting platform that helps growth and finance teams understand the true incremental impact of their marketing spend. Founded in 2022 by Pranav Piyush and Pete Belknap and backed by Greylock, Paramark combines incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and scenario planning in one place, augmented by human growth advisors and AI agents. Rather than relying on last-touch attribution, the platform uses statistics and machine learning to quantify each channel's incremental contribution across search, social, TV, and out-of-home, giving marketers defensible ROI numbers to bring to their finance teams. Paramark maintains an open-source Marketing Mix Modeling workbench and forks of the major MMM libraries under its paramark-inc GitHub organization. Paramark does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; API access is offered as a feature of its Advanced commercial tier.

providers.name: Peace Corps
providers.description: The Peace Corps is a U.S. government agency that sends American volunteers abroad to work with communities on development projects. They provide data APIs for accessing Peace Corps volunteer data, country information, and project statistics.

providers.name: Polsia
providers.description: Polsia is an autonomous AI business-management platform marketed as "AI that runs your company while you sleep." It deploys a set of specialized AI agents — business planning, competitor research, social media, ads, email outreach, customer support, code generation, finance, and deployment — coordinated by an orchestrator to run a company's daily operations on recurring schedules for a monthly subscription plus a share of revenue generated on the platform. Founded by Ben Sera and backed by True Ventures and Sound Ventures (raised $30M at a $250M valuation in 2026), Polsia is a hosted consumer/SMB SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Praxis Labs
providers.description: Praxis Labs is an AI-powered leadership and human-skills learning platform, surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and acquired by Torch. Its flagship product, Pivotal Practice, uses immersive simulations, personalized AI coaching, and role-play scenarios to build critical management capabilities such as difficult conversations and performance discussions, with behavior-change tracking and ROI analytics. The learning application runs at practice.praxislabs.co behind login and integrates with HR/L&D systems including Workday, Docebo, and Degreed. Praxis Labs is SOC 2 Type 2 certified. No public API, developer portal, or SDK was found during enrichment; this remains a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Quant Network
providers.description: Quant Network is a blockchain interoperability company whose Overledger platform provides APIs to issue, connect, and monitor digital assets, smart contracts, transactions, and accounts across multiple distributed ledger technologies without requiring blockchain expertise.

providers.name: Quantive
providers.description: Quantive is a strategy-execution and OKR (Objectives and Key Results) software company, originally launched as Gtmhub and rebranded to Quantive in 2021. Its flagship product, Quantive Results, helps organizations set, align, track, and report on goals and outcomes with dashboards, insights, and integrations. In 2025 Quantive merged into WorkBoard and the Quantive name became a WorkBoard, Inc. trademark; the quantive.com domain now redirects to workboard.com, and the live developer surface is the WorkBoard REST API v1.0 (OAuth 2.0 plus an instant-token flow) hosted on myworkboard.com. Quantive was surfaced through the Index Ventures and Techstars portfolios and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: QuEra Computing
providers.description: QuEra Computing is a Boston-area neutral-atom quantum computing company, founded in 2021 by scientists from Harvard and MIT. Its flagship system, Aquila, is a 256-qubit field-programmable analog neutral-atom quantum processor that has been publicly available since November 2022 through Amazon Braket and through a direct Premium Access channel. QuEra develops Bloqade, an open-source software stack for neutral-atom quantum computing delivered as a Python SDK (Bloqade Python) and as the original Bloqade.jl Julia package, along with surrounding tooling for circuits, analog control, atom shuttling, decoders, and tensor-network simulation. The company is building toward fault-tolerant quantum computing with its Gemini-class next-generation systems and has demonstrated logical-level magic state distillation on neutral-atom hardware. QuEra works with HPC centers, national labs (NERSC, Los Alamos), DARPA, NEDO/AIST, NVIDIA, AWS, BCG X, Deloitte, Classiq, Kipu Quantum, Wolfram Research, and enterprise customers including BP, BASF, Merck, and Amgen. The system is consumed via the Bloqade SDK or AWS Braket; QuEra does not currently expose a public REST API to its QPU.

providers.name: Relay Payments
providers.description: Relay Payments operates a secure digital payment network purpose-built for the freight and trucking industry. Its mobile app and platform let carriers, owner-operators, brokers, and merchants transact contactlessly for diesel fuel, lumper (dock unloading) fees, scales, parking, truck repairs, and freight payments between brokers and carriers, replacing cash, fleet checks, and legacy fuel cards while reducing fraud and streamlining back-office reconciliation. Relay is backed by Ribbit Capital. Partner/system integration is offered under a Relay System Integration Agreement, with developer documentation gated behind partner authentication at docs.relaypayments.com; no public API specification is currently published.

providers.name: Rex Inc
providers.description: Rex Inc, operating as Rex.fit (BabylonAI Inc.), is a Y Combinator (W23) health and fitness company building AI-powered, fully automated nutrition tracking. Its consumer products include Rex Nutribot, a WhatsApp AI nutrition coach; the Drop, a wearable AI camera pendant that detects meals and automatically logs calories, protein, carbs, and fats via computer vision; an AI body scanner; and personalized coaching with daily health reports. Rex also offers a white-label B2B nutrition-and-fitness AI that fitness chains and app builders integrate to add meal logging (photo, barcode, or text), recipe and meal-plan generation, workout logging, 3D body scans, and nutrition analytics under their own brand.

providers.name: Savvy
providers.description: Savvy (Savvy Advisors, Inc.) is a technology-driven, SEC-registered investment advisory firm founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY. It combines licensed fiduciary financial advisors with proprietary technology — including Savvy Intelligence, an AI workspace for advisors — to deliver personalized wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and independent financial advisors. Savvy manages $5B+ in assets across 100+ advisors in 30+ U.S. locations, custodying at Fidelity and Charles Schwab. The firm serves two audiences: clients seeking wealth management (financial planning, investment management, direct indexing, tax optimization, retirement, trust and estate planning) and advisors looking to join or build a practice on its platform. Savvy publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain security posture, and the verbatim /llms.txt it exposes for agents.

providers.name: Science
providers.description: Science Corporation is a clinical-stage medical technology company founded in 2021 by Max Hodak and headquartered in Alameda, California, with offices in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina and Paris, France. Science develops brain-computer interface (BCI) and neural-engineering technologies to restore vision, cognition, and mobility, including the PRIMA retinal implant for patients with macular degeneration, the Biohybrid neural interface, and the Vessel perfusion platform. Through its Foundry division Science also offers MEMS production and neural-engineering services to external partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Science publishes no public web API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Silq
providers.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

providers.name: Solv Health
providers.description: Solv Health operates a consumer marketplace (solvhealth.com and the Solv app) for booking same-day urgent care, primary care, and lab appointments, plus a provider-facing platform (scheduling, intake, patient acquisition, reputation management, messaging, payments) sold to clinics and health systems. There is no self-serve public developer API or published API reference on solvhealth.com; API access is gated behind a sales-led partnership. Solv states it exposes "interoperable APIs" that power custom booking experiences on partner websites and apps, a "Final Mile" API/network that lets digital-first and virtual-care partners (e.g. Included Health) hand patients off to real-time same-day appointment availability at Solv's national network of urgent care clinics, and bidirectional EHR interoperability (APIs, HL7, FHIR, and RPA) that syncs patient demographics, appointment status, and documents with systems like Epic, Athena, Cerner, Allscripts, DrChrono, eClinicalWorks, Experity, and NextGen. None of these capabilities have a published base URL, endpoint reference, or self-serve API key signup; access is provisioned per partner/clinic inside a commercial contract.

providers.name: str8bat
providers.description: str8bat is a Bangalore, India based sports-technology company that builds a pocket-sized IoT sensor which attaches to a cricket bat and captures batting metrics in real time — bat speed, impact speed, back-lift angle, timing, sweet-spot placement and a 360-degree view of every shot. The sensor pairs with the str8bat mobile app (iOS and Android) to deliver instant, visual and actionable insights plus an AI cricket coach. The company reports 30,000+ active users, 6+ million shots recorded and operations across 350+ Indian cities and 14+ countries. str8bat is a consumer hardware and mobile-app company and publishes no first-party developer API; its str8bat.com storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes standard commerce discovery surfaces (customer-account OIDC and a Universal Commerce Protocol agent-commerce MCP endpoint).

providers.name: Verve Motion
providers.description: Verve Motion is a wearable robotics company spun out of the Harvard Biodesign Lab that builds SafeLift, a soft powered exosuit for industrial workers who lift repetitively. Inertial sensors woven into the suit detect lifting motion and trigger assistive force that the company says takes up to 40% of the strain off a worker's back, while Verve Logic — its cloud platform — collects the resulting movement data and reports ergonomic risk, unsafe-posture trends and exosuit utilization to safety managers. SafeLift is sold as a subscription bundling the exosuit, the Verve Logic data portal and Verve Care support, and is distributed in part through partners such as HexArmor. Verve Motion publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; the Verve Logic portal at logic.vervemotion.com is a customer-only single-page application that disallows crawling in robots.txt.

providers.name: VillageMD
providers.description: VillageMD is a Chicago-based, value-based primary care organization that operates and supports physician practices across the United States through its Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD and Starling Physicians operating companies, serving millions of patients across primary care, multispecialty and urgent care. It runs clinics — free-standing practices, in-Walgreens practices, home-based care and virtual visits — rather than selling software, and its clinical record and patient-facing digital surface run on athenahealth: patient portals are hosted at practice-specific athenahealth portal subdomains and the Village Medical mobile app is the athenaPatient experience. VillageMD publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no machine-readable specification and no SDK; the only public machine-readable interfaces touching its patients are athenahealth's certified FHIR R4 APIs, which are operated and documented by athenahealth, not by VillageMD. Since Sycamore Partners took Walgreens Boots Alliance private in August 2025, VillageMD has operated as a standalone company in that portfolio.

providers.name: WOO Sports
providers.description: WOO Sports makes a sensor-based performance-tracking system for kitesurfing, wingfoiling, and windsurfing. The WOO 4.0 device mounts to a board and measures jump height, airtime, G-force, and landing impact, syncing sessions through the WOO Sports mobile apps (iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, and Garmin) to a global community platform with leaderboards, spots, activity feeds, and events. More than 100,000 riders use WOO to track sessions and compete, including on the GKA Kite World Tour. WOO Sports is a Techstars-backed brand operated under Boards & More. This profile was enriched from the provider's public web surface; no public developer API was found (docs.woosports.com is a consumer user guide, not an API reference).

providers.name: Xayn (now Noxtua)
providers.description: Xayn is a Berlin-based AI company founded in 2017 as XAIN out of research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbaek and Prof. Michael Huth at Oxford and Imperial College London. Rebranded to Xayn in 2020, it built the Xaynet privacy-preserving federated learning framework and a privacy-protecting search and discovery engine. In February 2024 the company pivoted to legal AI and rebranded as Noxtua AG (noxtua.com), Europe's sovereign Legal AI for research, document analysis, and drafting, backed by a Series A of EUR 10M (2021, Global Brain/KDDI, with Earlybird) and a Series B of roughly EUR 81M led by legal publisher C.H. Beck. xayn.com is offline and the company publishes no public API or developer portal today; its former open-source SDKs and packages are archived.

providers.name: XSquare
providers.description: XSquare (listed as XSquire in the 500 Global portfolio) is a Dubai-based B2B financial operations platform for the GCC, live across the UAE and Qatar. It unifies e-invoicing, receivables collection via embedded payment links and QR codes (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank), supplier payables on corporate card, and automatic invoice-to-payment reconciliation on a single ledger, with native ERP integrations (Zoho, Xero, Wafeq, Odoo) and a PSP network (Tess, Telr, Geidea). PCI DSS Level 1 v4 certified, UAE FTA e-invoicing ready (PEPPOL, structured XML), and non-custodial by design through licensed PSP partners regulated by CBUAE and QCB. Founded in 2023 by Tanvir Shah and Ashwin Shenoy; operates as XSquare Payment Services LLC (Dubai) and XSquare LLC (Doha). No public developer API, docs, or SDKs are published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Zeel
providers.description: Zeel is an on-demand wellness marketplace that connects consumers with licensed, background-checked massage therapists for in-home, in-hotel, in-office, and event chair massage delivered same-day and often within an hour of booking. The platform covers a range of modalities including Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, sleep, and couples massage, and offers memberships, gift certificates, and a spa-staffing service (Zeel Spa Staffing) that supplies therapists to hotels and spas. Zeel operates a consumer-facing web and mobile booking experience across dozens of US metros; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration program.
